Adult Leisure
events.description:
Formed in 2020, Bristol’s melodic alt-indie four-piece Adult Leisure have fast become one of the UK’s most promising new bands. After making an instant impact with debut single ‘Things You Don’t Know Yet’ and acclaimed EPs ‘The Weekend Ritual’ and ‘Present State of Joy and Grief’, championed by BBC Radio 1, Under The Radar Magazine, Wonderland Magazine, The Telegraph, Jake Gosling and RTE, the band now arrive with their debut album ‘The Things You Don’t Know Yet’, released on October 3rd 2025.


Featuring standout singles ‘The Rules’, ‘Boy Grows Old’ and ‘See Her’ (both featuring John Waugh of The 1975), the album showcases their signature blend of cinematic alt-indie and heartfelt lyricism. Supported by BBC Radio 6, The Line of Best Fit, and Spotify editorial playlists, Adult Leisure continue their rise with a headline UK tour and festival dates across Norway, Sweden, the Netherlands (VestRock), France (SuperSonic Paris) and New York (New Colossus Festival).

events.title: Aiko
events.description:
Czechia raised, UK based, Aiko is an alt pop artist with music talking about confidence and empowerment and a high energetic performance as a duo together with the drummer Kat Almagro. Highlights include:
- representing Czechia at Eurovision 2024
- headline European tour with 23 stops, multiple sold out stops in cities like London, Warsaw, or Paris
- performing at SXSW, Japan EXPO, Sziget festival, Rock for people, and many more
- appearing on Times Square as part of the Spotify Equal programme, editorial playlisting, face of the Glow playlist
-  music in the Netflix show Elite, Love Island UK and multiple MTV series
- latest album accumulated over 10 million streams
- mentions in Vogue, Harpers Bazaaar, The Rolling Stone UK, Austin Chronicle, Elle and many more

Aiko is currently in the process of creating her fourth album that is planned to be released in September/October 2026 and with another headline tour ahead of her in Autumn of 2026.

events.title: Alahsîn
events.description:
Alahsîn is more than an artist , she’s a storyteller and visionary whose music lives in the space between confidence and vulnerability. Blending melodic flows with atmospheric production, her sound captures late nights, love, ambition, and the moments that shape who we become.

With a visual world inspired by symbolism, art, and emotion, Alahsîn creates not just songs but experiences. This March, she brings that immersive, expressive energy to the stage in Texas, delivering a performance designed to connect and leave a lasting impression.

events.title: Alkyone
events.description:
Alkyone is a Greek singer-songwriter hailing from the mountains of northern Greece. Born and raised in a small town surrounded by rivers and forests, she began her musical journey at the age of six, training as a classical pianist, before embracing songwriting as her true path.
Influenced by her father’s deep love for folk music, Alkyone began experimenting with traditional songs and textures, weaving a distinct folklore thread into her musical identity. Her sound blends indie songwriting, cinematic atmospheres, and folk elements from the Mediterranean and the Balkans. Singing in both English and Greek, her lyrics explore memory, growing up, and our evolving relationship with the world, while her concerts carry an intimate, personal, and emotionally charged atmosphere.
She has performed across Europe (Konzerthaus, Tonhalle, Carré, SNF, Onassis Foundation and others). In 2023, she collaborated with Vincent Moon and was featured on La Blogothèque. Her critically acclaimed debut album Exit Sign was released in 2023, while her second studio album, Small Philosophies, is expected in late spring 2026.
Her stage name, Alkyone, is a tribute to a recurring dream in which she was a bird.

events.title: The All-American Rejects
events.description: Formed in 1999 in Stillwater, Oklahoma, The All-American Rejects quickly became one of the most iconic rock bands of the 2000s. Led by Tyson Ritter and Nick Wheeler, the band debuted in 2002, featuring their hit "Swing, Swing." Their 2005 album Move Along cemented their place in rock with chart-toppers like "Dirty Little Secret" and "It Ends Tonight." In 2008, "Gives You Hell" became a global hit and a Billboard No. 1 in 2009. The band continued pushing creative boundaries on Kids in the Street in 2012. Throughout the years, The Rejects have continued evolving, taking their sound in new directions while staying true to the emotional core that’s always defined their music. Their latest singles, “Eggshell Tapdancer” and “Easy Come, Easy Go”, from their upcoming 5th album have proven their undying commitment to writing songs that resonate with fans and prove that their relevance and connection with fans are only getting stronger with time.

events.title: Anaya Kobe
events.description:
Anaya Kobe is a Houston-based Hip-Hop and R&B artist originally from Columbus, Ohio, known for her emotionally resonant lyricism, refined storytelling, and moody, early-2000s-inspired aesthetic. A classically trained musician and lifelong creative, she blends soulful melodies with incisive rap, exploring themes of love, power, vulnerability, and personal reckoning.

Her most-streamed single, “Love Sick,” has connected deeply with listeners, showcasing her ability to translate emotional complexity into memorable hooks and intimate songwriting.

In 2025, Anaya released her second EP, Lord Save Me, a fully self-directed, zero-budget visual project that reflects her commitment to cohesive storytelling and independent creative control. She was selected as an official SXSW Artist for 2025 and has been featured in The Austin Chronicle for her live performances, recognized for their commanding presence and genre-blending sound.

With a growing catalog and a distinct visual identity, Anaya Kobe continues to carve out her own lane — poised, emotionally compelling, and unmistakably her own

events.title: Bára Zmeková
events.description:
“Dreamlike.” “Poetic.” “Beautiful.” — this is how audiences describe Bára Zmeková’s performances.
The moment she steps on stage, intimacy and imagination take over. A Prague-based singer, pianist and composer, she draws from the rich Czech singer-songwriter tradition while blending it with modern jazz and subtle electronics, creating music that feels both deeply rooted and strikingly contemporary.
Her expression is civil yet emotionally powerful, inviting listeners into an inner world shaped by melody, atmosphere and nuance. Although she sings in Czech, language is never a barrier; the natural rhythm and softness of the language add a distinctive colour to her sound. Audiences across Europe and Japan consistently respond beyond words.
Her trio moves between quiet minimalism and expressive intensity, built on strong melodies and precise interplay.
The critically acclaimed Lunaves established her as one of the distinctive voices of the contemporary Czech scene. In 2024 came the album Jediný na světě, followed by the single Jiné stromy, recorded with Norwegian tubist Daniel Herskedal.
Following their second Japan tour in early 2026, the trio heads to SXSW directly from Tokyo.

events.title: Big Soto
events.description: Gustavo Rafael Guerrero Soto, known professionally as Big Soto, is a Venezuelan singer and songwriter recognized for blending synthwave and city pop with trap, R&B, reggaetón, hip-hop, and soul. Born on October 19, 1996, in Cumaná, Venezuela, he began his career in 2017 and quickly became a pioneer of these sounds in his country, building a global audience with over 3 million monthly listeners on Spotify. Big Soto stands out for his fresh sonic identity and introspective lyrics that reflect everyday life experiences. In October 2024, he released SOTORIUS, an album filled with deeply personal stories that further strengthened his connection with fans. Throughout his career, he has collaborated with artists such as Eladio Carrión, Neutro Shorty, Santa Fe Klan, Danny Ocean, Mora, Junior H, Farruko, Jowell & Randy, Lunay, and Gera MX. His music has been recognized at multiple award ceremonies, positioning him as one of the most promising artists of his generation. Notable songs from his catalog include “Todo Va a Estar Bien,” “Vengo de Nada,” “La Noche Entera,” “Mezcalito en Copa,” and “El Favorito de Mami.”

events.title: Big Zeeks
events.description:
Hailing from the heart of Harlesden, North West London,
“The Fresh Prince of
Harlesden” aka “BIG ZEEKS” is an independent, universal dancehall lyrists, who
is an undisputed, talented artist, who consistently sets the bar high with
continuous growth and versatility.
Firmly cementing his place as a pivotal figure within UK dancehall music with
hits: #Happy, YO, It’s a lot of money, BIG ZEEKS has built much of his notoriety
by building a cult following, bridging the gap between UK Rap and Jamaican
Dancehall merged to create a sub-genre: UK Dancehall.
BIG ZEEKS has gained much of his notoriety by building a sound reputation
working with some of the most critically acclaimed artists such as Dexta Daps,
Chronic Law, Spice, Shensea, Kranium and WSTRN
His roaring talent has allowed him to sell out his own headline shows, toured
the world as a supporting act globally, and had the amazing opportunity of
performing at various international festivals including the reknowned
infamous Glastonbury, City Splash+ more. Not only is Big Zeeks
building an organic following, he has managed to accumulate over 5,000,000
streams on Spotify alone with the continuity of numbers rising daily.

events.title: Brionne
events.description: After the raving success of her first two EP’s “23” and “Playa Shit Only” followed by the certification of her position as the DON DADA on her first full length project “ Donatella,” Brionne is ready to expand her territory towards new horizons. Meet the Griselda Blanco of Dallas’ rising Hip-Hop scene. In the past three years since her introduction to the game, she’s invested the blood, sweat, and tears which earned her the stripes needed to bet on her ability to turn a phrase for “Profit.” For those that know of Brionne, her style is, quiet as kept, setting the precedent that she is no less accepted at the table of success in any room she inhabits. Words are her luxury. Never lacking in intentionality, Brionne carefully crafts her flows together into a web that leaves you stuck hanging on her every word.

events.title: Buddha
events.description:
Buddha is a dynamic and genre-blending rapper proudly representing New Orleans, Louisiana. Raised in the Marrero Projects, his journey into music was shaped by resilience, sacrifice, and an unwavering commitment to his craft. Rooted in the rich cultural melting pot of New Orleans, Buddha’s sound is as diverse as the city itself. His music blends rap and hip-hop with elements of jazz, blues, pop, reggae, country, R&B, and even inspirational influences. 

Deeply committed to representing his city, Buddha aims to showcase a broader narrative of New Orleans, highlighting its depth, culture, and talent. For Buddha, music is not just a passion; it is his calling, his livelihood, and his platform to inspire the world.

events.title: Cardinal Bloom
events.description:
Cardinal Bloom is an Indie Rock Band from Salt Lake City Utah, one of the birth places of the modern Indie Rock genre. Cardinal Bloom's debut album “The Only Place I’ve Ever Known” released September of 2024 marking a new era of their music while still holding true to the sound they've carved as their own. Cardinal Bloom’s music encapsulates the nostalgic and bittersweet feeling of ‘better days,’ yet leaving you a notion there is still so much life ahead of us to be lived.

Cardinal Bloom is currently on tour throughout the U.S. and you can find tickets here on spotify or on their website www.cardinalbloom.com.
 
“Everything they did worked together to absolutely nail that dusty Deseret sound—one that sits in between pop, rock, and folk.” -Zach Collier (Provo Music Magazine)
 
Their members include Joey St. John on guitar and vocals, Jacob Silvester on the bass and vocals, Josh Thomas on guitar, and Nate Adair on drums.

events.title: Cha’Keeta B
events.description:
Cha’Keeta B is a lyrical emcee from Austin, Texas, known for delivering rap with substance and intention. Influenced by a wide range of artists and genres, her first love has always been writing, drawing inspiration from poets and artists like Jill Scott.

Since 2011, she has released two mixtapes and two EPs, been featured on the “Coast 2 Coast Hottest in Texas” mixtape, and performed multiple times as an official artist at South by Southwest. She has opened for renowned acts including Slim Thug, Naughty By Nature, Tink, Wu-Tang Clan, Oshun, and Z-Ro, among others.

Beyond music, Cha’Keeta B is committed to community impact. She founded the Christmas charity initiative “Rap 4 A Reason,” collecting gifts for underprivileged children in East Austin. She is also the creator of the annual “Kinky Curly Coily Fest,” a natural hair festival celebrating Black women, men, and children, while creating opportunities for artists and small businesses to thrive.

events.title: Chuck Prophet and His Cumbia Shoes
events.description:
Chuck Prophet’s streak of more than a dozen critically acclaimed solo records stretches all the way back to 1990, when the California native first shifted focus from his tenure with pioneering neo-psych band Green on Red to working under his own name. Since then, his songs have appeared in a slew of films and television shows, and his work has been covered by Bruce Springsteen, Solomon Burke, Heart, and a host of others. Rolling Stone dubbed him a “streetwise city kid with an eye for the country,” while Uncut proclaimed him a “renaissance-rocker,” and NPR declared that “no one can turn tales from the outer limits into catchy songs quite like Prophet does.” 

Wake The Dead, Chuck Prophet’s extraordinary new album recorded with ¿Qiensave?, dives headfirst into the world of Cumbia music. The songs are intoxicatingly rhythmic, all but demanding you move your body while you listen. There are flashes of rock and roll, punk, surf, and soul, wrapped up in the rich legacy of a genre that traces its roots back hundreds of years and thousands of miles.

speakers.name: Chuck Prophet and His Cumbia Shoes

events.title: Creature Canyon
events.description:
Hailing from the vibrant scene of San Diego, CA, Creature Canyon ignites the essence of indie/alternative rock fused with tinges of modern psychedelia. Comprised of Austin Steele, Ryan Amyot, and Aaron Lund, the band radiates with electrifying performances that have garnered acclaim from Billboard, Paste, and various industry tastemakers. With a sonic journey that began with EPs like "Life I Know" and "Did You Want That," and a notable feature of their track "Brooklyn Baby" in the hit series Shameless.

Having left an indelible mark with their debut album ‘Remarks’, Creature Canyon has collaborated with the talents of producer Christian Lum (Private Island), recording engineer Mike Schuppan (Foster The People, Young the Giant), mixing engineer Jordon Silva (Vance Joy, The Avett Brothers), and mastering engineer Brian Lucey (Cage The Elephant, Arctic Monkeys, The Black Keys). The band now strides confidently into the future, embracing the next phase of their musical evolution.

events.title: D2BLEE
events.description: D2BLEE is a rising Rap and Urban Latin artist delivering a bilingual, culture-driven sound that blends raw lyricism with modern Latin energy. Influenced by hip-hop icons such as Tupac and The Notorious B.I.G., alongside reggaeton pioneers like Daddy Yankee and contemporary leaders including Myke Towers, D2BLEE bridges English rap and Latin rhythms with authenticity and intent. With roots in salsa and a global sonic perspective, his music reflects real experience, discipline, and ambition. In 2024, D2BLEE has performed across multiple cities, completing over a dozen live shows and continuing to build momentum as an independent artist. Focused on longevity over trends, he positions himself not by genre, but by vision—contributing to the next evolution of Mexican reggaeton and modern Latin hip-hop.

events.title: DJ Napalm
events.description: Born & raised in Austin, TX, DJ Napalm has been immersed in the local music scene from a young age. At just 14, he launched his journey into radio with KAZI 88.7, one of the longest running stations in Central Texas. There, he was apart of a teen-focused show that offered guidance for high school students navigating everyday challenges, transitioning into a solo radio personality. Along with up & coming local talent, he also interviewed major artist such as Slum Village, Trey Songz, Dorrough & Nivea to name a few. After college, Napalm came back to Austin ready to embrace the Hip Hop scene by linking up with ScoreMore Shows. There he learned the behind the scenes work for live music events and immersive experiences for consumers, such as The Illmore. Meeting artist like Kendrick Lamar, Curren$y and Big Sean evolved his passion into supporting local talent because he knew Austin had artist that could reach the same heights. Linking up with Austin pioneer J Soulja, The Smoke Out ATX (M.A.D.E Agency) & The Pre Roll ATX were born. The highest demanding Hip Hop platform in CTX, they advocate for local artist independence while providing a save space to network and build community.

events.title: Don Glori
events.description:
Unpicking the thread that stitches together Don Glori’s music would be an impossible task. His records combine elements of Jazz, Funk, Soul, RnB and Samba, yet he doesn’t fit neatly into any of those genres. His live show is more jazz - punk - funk than anything. One thing is certain, there is an undeniable, joyful, spirit that permeates through his music.

Following on from the success of his 2024 album ‘Don’t Forget to Have Fun’, Don Glori is back with his third offering, this time on Mr. Bongo - ‘Paper Can’t Wrap Fire’.
“A kaleidoscopic genre-surfing odyssey that brings together the worlds of jazz, soul and funk. Feeling both contemporary and classic, familiar yet novel, it’s an assured third release that sees an artist in full flight, showcasing their creative prowess and the uniqueness of their musical voice.”

events.title: FAMA
events.description:
FAMA is the musical project of brothers Facundo and Mateo, born in Peru with Argentine roots. Their name [Fa + Ma] reflects a lifelong bond shaped by music, art, and shared creative curiosity. Blending intimate acoustic pop with touches of country, funk, and organic textures. Their first-ever release surpassed 100K views on YouTube, and they continue to build momentum with a steady stream of new music.

Raised on influences like Michael Jackson, Elvis Presley, Justin Bieber, and Shawn Mendes, both brothers bring distinct creative backgrounds (acting, fashion, and DJ culture) into a single, authentic vision. Currently working with Los Angeles-based producers including Joel Jones, Brandon Shoop, and Juan Ariza, FAMA represents the meeting point between intimacy and universality, music that feels personal, yet instantly relatable.

FAMA is born from the need to feel without fear. To speak from the heart in a world that so often hides it. They don’t come to be perfect, they come to be real. FAMA doesn’t seek fame; it seeks connection. Every verse, every chord, every silence is an invitation to look inward and recognize yourself, always from a place of love.

events.title: Gogol Bordello
events.description:
Since 1999, international punk band Gogol Bordello, led by Ukrainian frontman Eugene Hütz, has been filling up rooms with an energy that could run a whole city. A lifelong lover of the punk scene growing up in Ukraine, Hütz finally found himself where he felt he belonged, in New York’s Lower East Side in the late 90s, where he went to shows and later performed at the legendary CBGB. Crashing at friends’ apartments and playing acoustic sets in NYC Ukrainian bars, his group steadily grew to an 8 piece multicultural band, combining Eastern, Western and Latin traditions. Since then the band has lit up stages around the world alongside System of a Down, Primus, Rancid, Dropkick Murphys, dueted with Regina Spektor, and cut albums with legends Rick Rubin, Steve Albini and a forthcoming album with Nic Launay.

Russia's war in Ukraine is personal for Eugene & the band, who have been tirelessly advocating for Ukrainian solidarity, partnering with Nova Ukraine, ArtDopomoga, and putting together benefits with Patti Smith, The Hold Steady, Suzanne Vega, Magnetic Fields, Matisyahu and more. Additionally, they collaborated with Bernard Sumner on a cover of the Angelic Upstarts “Solidarity” with proceeds going to the Ukrainian Soldiers Recovery.

Gogol Bordello’s forthcoming record, We Mean It, Man!, is due out in March 2026. For this album, Hütz set out to blend post-punk textures and aggro to Gogol Bordello’s free-wheeling gypsy-punk. He chose to work with the production team of Nick Launay (Gang of Four, Yeah Yeah Yeahs, Idles) and Adam “Atom” Greenspan (Nick Cave, Idles, Flogging Molly) to accomplish this goal. Together with his long running band, they knocked out twelve super punchy and hook-laden songs. The title track, “We Mean It, Man!” is all pile-driving punk intensity which crescendoes into no-wave sax skronk. “No Time For Idiots” is a Strummer/Jones-esque riff-punk with a giant chorus payoff. “Life Is Possible Again” voices an optimism against the dread of the Ukraine war. “Solidarity” features New Order’s Bernard Sumner on the Angelic Upstart’s Solidarność-punk anthem updated to address the Ukraine war effort. This is the album and political message the world needs now.

events.title: H
events.description: Noah Peña, better known by his stage name “H,” is a South Texas-born singer, songwriter, and rapper recognized for his distinctive and dynamic style. A visionary performer blending eccentric creativity with polished professionalism, he began releasing music in February 2022 and has swiftly risen in popularity and acclaim. Quickly emerging as an artist to watch, H is on track to become a widely celebrated name in the American music scene.

events.title: JayaHadADream
events.description: Jamaican-Irish rapper JayaHadADream is one of the UK’s most exciting new voices, blending raw, introspective lyricism with grime and hip hop influences. Raised in Cambridge and shaped artistically in Nottingham, she took an unconventional path into music—starting a career teaching A-Level Criminology at just 21, before leaving the profession in 2023 to pursue music full-time. Her breakout came in 2024 when she won the Glastonbury Emerging Talent Competition, handpicked by Michael and Emily Eavis, earning a coveted slot on one of the festival’s main stages. Since then, she’s lit up Reading, Leeds, Boomtown, BBC Radio 1’s Big Weekend, and SXSW London, with a range of packed sets at Glastonbury 2025. Known for her emotive delivery and sharp pen, Jaya has received critical acclaim from Rolling Stone UK, NME, and TRENCH, with airplay on BBC Radio 1, Capital Xtra and Kiss. Her bold, genre-spanning sound has led to standout collaborations in both rap and electronic music, including tracks with Zero and Gardna. With co-signs from Mick Jenkins, Stormzy and so many more, JayaHadADream is defining the future of UK rap.

events.title: Lexaay
events.description:
Lexaay is a Springfield, MO–born, Dallas-based pop/R&B singer, songwriter, dancer, and creative director crafting genre-blending music rooted in classic R&B, funk, and early-2000s pop. A movement-first artist, she develops each song with choreography in mind—allowing ideas to travel from brain to body before they reach the stage. The result is cinematic, high-concept performance work merging storytelling, dance, fashion, and bold visual direction.

She released her debut EP Wild, But True in 2020, introducing audiences to her emotionally honest songwriting and performance-driven artistry. Since then, Lexaay has quickly emerged as one of the region’s most promising live performers, known for immersive showcases that blur the line between concert, dance production, and theatrical experience.

Her work explores self-definition, desire, softness, and emotional complexity, presenting a multidimensional modern twenty-something perspective—bold, nostalgic, playful, spiritual, messy, and self-aware.

With her EP NEXT, Lexaay steps into a confident new era, redefining what urban pop can look and feel like. 

Dynamic, intentional, and magnetic, she continues shaping her own lane.

events.title: Lila Tristram
events.description:
Lila Tristram is an evocative folk-rock artist, acclaimed for her atmospheric sound and striking lyricism. Her 2025 debut album, America, heralded as “genuine, brilliant art” by Line of Best Fit, marks a transformative chapter in Tristram’s creative journey, expanding her earlier bucolic folk style into a richer, elegiac folk-rock landscape. 

The release of America has seen her social media following more than double and listenership grow tenfold. Partnering with Too Lost, her work has garnered over 400,000 streams, and received continuous support from BBC Radio 6, Soho Radio and BBC Introducing. Featured in over 50 publications and playlisted by Alex Rainbird, as well as Apple and Tidal editorial teams, Tristram is poised for her biggest year to date.

She has recently performed sold-out headline shows at St Pancras Old Church and Third Man Records, completed four tours in the UK and Europe, including a solo headline tour of southern Germany and a ten day UK support tour with Black Foxxes. She has recently returned from Rotterdam’s Left of the Dial Festival and is looking forward to making her debut performance in the USA at SXSW 2026.

events.title: Lynn
events.description:
LYNN is a 24-year-old artist from Birmingham, Alabama, making waves in the Hip-Hop/Rap and R&B scene. Her music is all about owning the moment, showcasing the power of women through bold, unapologetic rap bars, while also hitting us with those smooth, soulful R&B vibes.
Though she’s just getting started, LYNN has already made a big splash, earning the title of “Bama Hip-Hop/Rap Female Artist of the Year” at the 2022 Alabama Music Awards. She’s all about breaking boundaries and creating a space for herself in the industry while uplifting her community along the way.
With her unique sound and unstoppable energy, LYNN is on a mission to inspire and pave the way for others, all while cementing her place as one of the freshest voices in the game.

events.title: Moio
events.description:
MOIO doesn’t just make music, he commands emotion. In fact, the Nigerian- Irish singer, songwriter, producer, and multi-instrumentalist chases emotion with every lyric he pens, melody he sings, and beat, bassline, or guitar riff he plays. This pursuit has brought him to a space between genres, co-existing in the realms of R&B, indie, alternative, and soul—yet cleverly never committing to one above the other. By helming every aspect of his artistry, he’s able to operate fluidly, and his vision resonates across boundaries. 

Growing up in Dublin, music called to MOIO as a child. His passion was fostered by church and the radio in equal measure. After taking piano lessons for several years, he taught himself guitar and bass. At 10-years-old, he sang live for the first time at school and fell in love with performing. Buzzing on Soundcloud with early uploads, he slowly but surely attracted an audience.  Moio released His Debut EP " Earthday" October 3rd 2026.

events.title: Mosmo
events.description:
Carlos Ramos Molina, known as MOSMO, is a new voice reshaping regional Mexican music.
Born in Hermosillo, Sonora, he broke into the spotlight in 2022 on Netflix’s La Firma, performing before industry leaders including Rauw Alejandro, Yandel, Nicki Nicole, Lex Borrero, and Tainy.

Blending corridos with raw emotion, MOSMO fuses the bélico with the romantic, the party with introspection. Inspired by tumbados but influenced by pop, trap, and urban melancholy, his music is honest, unfiltered, and deeply personal.

Built without shortcuts or backing, MOSMO represents a generation raised on Peso Pluma, Natanael Cano, and Junior H, while carving a lane entirely his own.
He’s not chasing virality. He’s building something real

events.title: N@te!
events.description: N@te! is an up and coming artist hailing from the land of the 7—the 757, the 7 Cities. Known for his raw, unmistakable sound, N@te! is a true lyrical powerhouse, effortlessly delivering both hard-hitting hip-hop/rap and smooth R&B hits. His music blends sharp storytelling with emotion and melody, showcasing versatility, authenticity, and a voice that commands attention across genres.

events.title: New Constellations
events.description:
New Constellations – the ethereal brainchild of lifelong sidekicks Harlee Case and Josh Smith –
encapsulates a sonic dreamscape of eager melodies, striking guitar hooks, and celestial vocals
that softly tangles listeners into a web of cosmic glow.
The Portland-based duo first explored collaborating when they were 14, recording a song together in
Josh’s childhood bedroom, before spending the next 15 years exploring their individual
approaches to music separately and eventually crafting the dynamic perspective that would
become New Constellations.
The two debuted with the single, “Hot Blooded,” an incomprehensibly magnetic voyage that
offers warmth and compassion, and has now amassed over 120M streams. After a monumental
first few years, Harlee and Josh are electric as ever, poising themselves for upcoming releases that
can only be described as a continuation of their signature gilded alchemy.

events.title: PIAO
events.description:
Shanghai born, Los Angeles transplant PIAO is the artist you’ve been waiting for. With heartfelt lyrics and a vocal range that hits both ends of the spectrum, PIAO breaks the mold of the traditional pop artist and creates her own lane. Berklee graduate and multi-instrumentalist, PIAO's relentless pursuit of musical growth has granted her invaluable opportunities to collaborate with esteemed artists, producers, and industry giants including the likes of T-Pain, Myles William, Banx & Ranx, and more, as well as touring with notable acts like Mariana Trench, Tiffany Day, Jhariah, and more.

Since releasing her debut EP, Tissues, PIAO’s music has quickly captured the attention of listeners and industry tastemakers alike. Landing on major editorial playlists like New Music Friday, Hyperpop, Next-Gen Singer-Songwriter, Jasmine, Pop All Day, Alpha, Feeling Blue, and New In Pop, PIAO’s music has amassed millions of streams and received praise for her strong melody and relatable storytelling. With new music set to release in Spring 2026, prepare to immerse yourself in the enchanting world of PIAO and experience a new era of pop music.

events.title: Sarah Crean
events.description:
Irish/Brighton-based artist Sarah Crean is an indie-pop singer-songwriter whose music combines emotional clarity with layered, melodic arrangements. Her 2023 EP Death by Laundry featured the breakout single “2:00am,” now streamed over 7.5 million times on Spotify, and earned support from BBC Introducing, BBC Radio 1, The Line of Best Fit, Clash, Nialler9, and Spotify editorial playlists. The first single from her upcoming album, “22 Angel,” has already reached 80,000 streams and was featured on New Pop UK.

Sarah has toured the UK supporting acts including Florence Road, U.S. Girls, and Bombay Bicycle Club, with highlights such as a performance at the O2 Forum London alongside CMAT. Now independent and on the verge of her debut album - created entirely by women and inspired by the myth of Calypso - Crean explores heartbreak, home, and everything in between. With the album due mid-2026, she is emerging as one of alt-indie pop’s most compelling new voices.

events.title: Vin Zeal
events.description:
Vin Zeal is a Houston, Texas–based artist blending the emotional depth of R&B with the infectious appeal of pop. Performing professionally since 2012, Vin Zeal has spent over a decade honing a sound rooted in authenticity, stage presence, and connection—bringing both polish and passion to every performance.

Known for smooth vocals, melodic storytelling, and live guitar accompaniment, Vin Zeal creates music that feels both timeless and contemporary. Her ability to seamlessly incorporate guitar into her performances adds a dynamic, intimate edge to both recorded and live experiences.

With extensive live performance experience and a clear artistic vision, Vin Zeal continues to build a compelling catalog that bridges pop accessibility with R&B soul—positioning her as a dynamic and evolving artist with longevity in mind.

events.title: Wilby
events.description: Jersey-born Maria Crawford has been paving her way through the Nashville independent music scene since 2014. Now Brooklyn-based, she continues to capture listeners with her fiercely vulnerable songwriting and compelling live performances. Wilby’s debut single “Bad” (2020) gained immediate attention, followed by "Translucent Beauty” (2021), drifting between bedroom pop and indie rock. Her sophomore EP, “Happiest Woman” (2023), marked a shift toward showcasing a full-band production, mirroring the force of Wilby’s live sound. Wilby’s debut album, “Center of Affection” (2025, via Hit the North Records), explores both the cathartic side of indie-rock and the vulnerable side of twangy folk. Wilby has been featured in FLOOD Magazine, Luna Collective, and Ones To Watch, named an Artist to Watch by Atwood Magazine, with support from Seattle’s KEXP and Nashville’s WNXP and Lightning 100.

events.title: willoh
events.description:
Missouri native willoh is riding the crest of a wave of excitement over her new series of singles leading up to her spring 2026 album release.  On her latest track, EARMILK writes ““OUCHIE” defies easy categorization, blending synth-pop, raw punk attitude, and alt-rock vibes into a shifting, avant-garde sound.”  


Willoh’s self-produced 20205  debut, not more than that, but more please presents us with a raw honesty rendered through snowy vocals that sit in rarefied air and belies the artist’s 19 years. In September she released the labyrinthine “Buckshot” to critical acclaim.

From her home in Springfield, Missouri, willoh records and creates music, having first found her footing on Garageband before graduating to LogicPro–making the upgrade from her earnings working many long shifts at McDonalds.

events.title: Wellness Mornings at Fairmont Austin
events.description:
Recharge between panels at Fairmont Spa Austin’s SXSW Wellness Mornings. Nestled on the hotel’s 7th floor rooftop cabanas, guests are invited to move through a curated reset featuring Hyperice recovery, Ulu Wellness IV therapy, AG1 ritual shots and Kohler contrast circuits. March 12–14 | 7:00am–12:00pm. Recover with intention. Perform without compromise.

https://www.fairmont-austin.com/events/sxsw-wellness-mornings/

events.description: Pick up your SXSW Badge or Music Wristband on the Capitol View Terrace of the Downright Hotel. Your badge is required in order to attend any sessions, events, or socials.

events.description: Pick up your SXSW Badge or Music Wristband in Griffin Hall of the JW Marriott. Your badge is required in order to attend any sessions, events, or socials.

events.description: Pick up your SXSW Badge in the Guadalupe Room of the Omni Downtown. Your badge is required in order to attend any sessions, events, or socials.

events.title: “Second Nature” Screening & Q&A
events.description: Did you know that clownfish change sex from male to female? (So if Nemo’s mom had died in real life, his dad would have become his mom!) Did you know that albatross, penguins and swans parent in same sex pairs? Or that bonobos, who are just as closely related to us as chimps, are matriarchal and have same-sex sex every day?!Narrated by Elliot Page, Second Nature debunks myths that females are “inferior” and being queer is “unnatural,” following trailblazing Evolutionary Biologist Dr. Joan Roughgarden as she meets other groundbreaking scientists exploring the 1500+ animal species who engage in same-sex sexual behavior and parenting, change sex, form matriarchies, and more…Second Nature — everything you didn’t learn in high school biology.

events.title: Laura Geller's Mature Beauty Boutique
events.description: Step into Laura Geller’s Mature Beauty Boutique at the Congress Ave Block Party, a beauty experience designed for confidence at every age. Get expertly shade-matched and receive a FREE Baked Balance-n-Brighten Color Correcting Foundation. After that, enjoy photo moments at our sticker wall, plus free swag and even more makeup goodies. Discover easy, glow-boosting essentials designed to enhance your natural beauty!

events.title: Registration (Fairmont Austin)
events.description: Pick up your SXSW Badge in the Manchester Ballroom of the Fairmont Austin. Your badge is required in order to attend any sessions, events, or socials.

events.title: SXSW Expo: International Innovations
events.description:
Featuring a powerful mix of established global brands and budding startups, the International Innovations Expo highlights cutting-edge businesses that are pushing boundaries to move the world forward. From groundbreaking concepts to bold new business models, exhibitors are redefining what’s possible across industries around the globe. Join the community that’s driving change on a worldwide scale.

See the floor plan here: https://sxsw2026-sxexpointinnov.expofp.com/

events.title: Welcome to SXSW
events.description: The head of programming, Greg Rosenbaum, kicks off the 40th year of SXSW with opening remarks. Setting the stage for seven days of incredible content, connection, and impact across music, film, innovation, and comedy, this short address will share the must know info to make the most of your time at the event. From the new footprint to the experiential plans for this year, join to learn more about what SXSW has in store for you.

events.title: Agents vs Managers: When are you ready to be signed and by who?
events.description: The line between agents and managers is blurrier than ever, especially for creators and talent building multi-income careers. This session breaks down how representation works today, including who does what, when each role is needed, how opportunities flow, and where incentives can misalign. Panelists include Laura McDonald, agent at Gersh Agency representing nonfiction talent and producers, creator Luca Schaefer-Charlton (MostlyLuca), and moderator Jeff Duncan, CEO of Ingenuity Live, offering perspectives from agency, creator, and management sides.

events.title: AI & the Brain: As We Embrace AI, Let’s Not Forget Our Minds
events.description:
Across homes, offices, and classrooms, AI is becoming ubiquitous—mapping our routes, writing our code, even dreaming up art in seconds. What once sounded like science fiction is now silently transforming our daily existence. And yet, amid this great digital leap forward, a quieter, more fragile system is at stake: the human brain.
We are perched at a precipice in history. As AI systems grow in power and presence, we must ask a question too few dare to voice: What is this doing to us - our capacity to explore, to learn, to reason, and to create? The machines are learning. But are we forgetting?

events.title: AI’s Rise, Talent’s Fall: Fixing the Skills Deficit
events.description: Everyone’s talking about AI disruption — but not enough are talking about the human talent disruption it demands. This candid session challenges the myth that AI alone will future-proof workforces. It exposes blind spots in today’s upskilling agendas — from overlooked durable skills to the illusion of instant AI fluency. Backed by global insights and fresh data, this session offers a bold roadmap to turn AI anxiety into human potential — where curiosity, creativity, and adaptability matter as much as code.

events.title: Alpha X Showcase
events.description: The future of education is here. Step inside Alpha Austin for the SXSW Alpha X Showcase, where students launch entrepreneurial ventures, invent solutions, and bring bold ideas to life. Attendees experience hands-on innovation, witness AI-powered personalized learning driving mastery and life skills, and engage directly with students shaping the next generation of education. From startups to engineering feats, this immersive showcase proves how Alpha equips students to create, lead, and thrive in school, life, and beyond.

events.title: Authority That Drives Change: How Leaders Shape Societal Impact
events.description: In a world overwhelmed by noise and fractured trust, real authority still sparks movements and meaningful change. This cross-disciplinary panel explores how innovators, founders, technologists, and storytellers can use their influence not just for visibility, but to drive societal impact. Learn how mission-driven leaders build trust, shift conversations, and activate communities in a post-AI, hyper-connected world.

speakers.name: Michelle Prince
speakers.title: Publisher
speakers.company: SXSW Books - Advantage | The Authority Company

events.title: The Box Sent Back from the Future
events.description: A mysterious archive of artifacts from the year 2051 has just been discovered in Austin, and SXSW EDU participants are the first invited to investigate. In this imaginative, immersive, hands-on session, participants will explore provocative “ephemera from the future of education,” collaborate to reverse-engineer how we got there, and reflect on what must change now to shape a better tomorrow. Featuring worldbuilding, collective analysis, and live performance, this experience invites educators to engage in creative resistance for a future aligned with justice, joy, and collective imagination.

events.title: Building a New, Future-Proof University in 2026
events.description: What happens when an academic's vision for transforming higher education meets building an actual university? This session explores the journey from Alternative Universities' theoretical framework to building a new university in 2026 that is debt-free and apprenticeship-based. We examine the "ROTC for private sector" funding approach that shifts costs from students to employers, polymathic curriculum combining three non-adjacent majors, and navigating 2026's unique obstacles like accreditation and funding while leveraging opportunities from starting without entrenched bureaucracy.

speakers.name: Emily Balog
speakers.title: Associate Professor
speakers.company: Rowan-Virtua New Jersey Institute for Successful Aging, Rowan University

events.title: CTRL + SHIFT: Reimagining School Engagement Through Esports
events.description: School esports can increase attendance, raise engagement, and foster belonging. Learn why hundreds of Texas school districts (and thousands around the US) are investing in esports programs, both in the classroom and afterschool. This session breaks down the myths and shows how campus and district esports programs connect students to school and to each other.

events.title: Designing the Partnership Ecosystem: Five Systems Missions
events.description: What if partnerships worked like ecosystems—adaptive, intentional, and built to lift entire systems? In this immersive workshop, participants become boundary-spanning “agents,” completing five design missions: The Connector, The Broker, The Buffer, The Coordinator, and The Innovator. Each mission unlocks a new way to build systems that connect education, industry, and community around shared purpose. Blending research, design thinking, and play, this session turns collaboration into strategy. Attendees leave with a blueprint for designing ecosystems that sustain innovation and measurable impact.

events.title: Division Defiance: Building Cross-Racial Solidarity
events.description: This interactive workshop explores how the Model Minority Myth and Anti-Blackness serve as tools of racial division, perpetuating a hierarchy that undermines collective liberation. Participants will unpack and analyze these harmful narratives, reflect on their own experiences within systems of oppression, and engage in practices that foster cross-racial solidarity. Designed for educators and advocates of educational equity, the session offers a space for building shared understanding and cultivating strategies for dismantling racial hierarchies in pursuit of cross-racial solidarity.

events.title: Engineering Confidence: Raising Girls to Build Companies
events.description: Two extraordinary engineers-turned-entrepreneurs share how early exposure to entrepreneurship can change the trajectory of young women’s lives. This fireside chat explores why entrepreneurial mindsets should be taught as early as elementary school, how engineering thinking fuels problem-solving, and how giving back can spark a movement. Through personal stories and practical strategies, this session highlights how nurturing girls’ confidence and creativity prepares them to launch ventures, shape industries, and transform the future of entrepreneurship.

events.title: Fans of East Asian Film Meet Up
events.description: Whether you grew up on Ozu’s quiet poetry, were shaped by Edward Yang’s urban epics, or fell for Wong Kar Wai’s aching romance, this Meet Up is for you. Maybe you found your way in through Hirokazu Koreeda’s tender humanism or Bong Joon-ho’s genre-bending thrillers. Join fellow fans to celebrate classics and new voices from Japan, Korea, China, Hong Kong, Taiwan, and beyond. We’ll swap recommendations, share behind-the-scenes stories, and explore the role East Asian cinema plays in today’s global film culture. Open to newcomers and longtime cinephiles alike!

events.title: Featured Session: Moonshots that Move the Needle
events.description: Advanced tech is quickly expanding the ways we can support teachers and students both in and out of the classroom. But how do we design and fund programs that turn potential into impact? This panel explores how setting bold, time-bound learning goals can accelerate and level-up innovation while catalyzing impactful financial support. From coordinated research programs to targeted funding strategies, this session will explore how moonshot-centered models can rally diverse innovators around a shared outcome, encourage rigorous validation, and accelerate breakthroughs for teaching and learning.

speakers.name: Arati Prabhakar
speakers.title: Former Presidential Science & Technology Advisor
speakers.company: Office Of Science And Technology (Biden Administration)

events.title: From TikTok to Toolbelt: Preparing Gen Z for Work
events.description: Dubbed the ‘toolbelt generation,’ over half of Gen Z respondents in a recent survey say they are considering a skilled trade career—up 12% from last year. Schools are now working to modernize career preparation to meet the moment, including by tapping immersive technology to expose students to in-demand skilled trades. This panel brings together tech, career prep and school leaders to discuss how we can harness tech to engage students in learning while preparing them to successfully meet workforce demands.

events.title: Game On: Reimagining Career Exploration Through Play
events.description: Manufacturing is high-tech, high-paying, and full of opportunity—yet this vital industry still ranks last among teens’ career choices. By blending game-based learning, Dimensions of Success, and authentic career experiences shaped by SMEs and teachers, a futuristic learning pod is reshaping how students view advanced manufacturing. After one semester, students are 75% more likely to consider careers in the field, and 63% want further learning. Discover how a global industry leader, a nonprofit, and educators are sparking new enthusiasm and transforming perceptions of technical careers.

events.title: hālo haus
events.description: hālo haus is a 4 day gathering centered on beauty, wellness, and longevity. Hosted on a full street closure in downtown Austin, the program blends fireside chats, leading voices, experiential activations, and recovery-focused offerings within an open, discovery-driven format. hālo haus brings together founders, creators, clinicians, and cultural leaders to explore how self-care and performance are evolving alongside culture.

events.title: Health Moonshot: Healthy Students, Educators, Communities
events.description:
Our students, educators, schools, and nation face a health crisis—our diets and inactivity are killing us. Over 70% of youth are unfit for military service. 71% of girls, 58% of boys don’t meet activity guidelines. By 2030, Americans will be half as active as in 1965. 
This Meet Up unites cross-sector changemakers ready for a Moon Shot: bold, collaborative action to improve the health of students and educators.

speakers.name: Judi Clarke
speakers.title: Chair of the National Fitness Foundation

events.title: Hsu Untied: Beyond Numbers: Decision-Making in the Math Classroom
events.description: Join a live podcast recording that explores the dynamic relationship between math and decision-making. Our guests will examine how math instruction can nurture decision-making skills such as probabilistic thinking and numeracy, and how applying decision-making contexts can lead to new math structures that feel more meaningful and relevant. Through practical examples, the discussion will show how integrating these approaches helps students apply mathematical reasoning to real-world choices and develop lasting habits of thoughtful, evidence-based analysis.

speakers.name: Katey Arrington
speakers.title: President (NCSM) & Director of Systemic Transformation (Charles A. Dana Center)
speakers.company: NCSM & Charles A. Dana Center at The University of Texas at Austin

events.title: Innovation Without Borders: The World’s Top EdTech Startups
events.description: Discover the world’s largest and only community uniting EdTech organizations representing every world region,  connecting, supporting, and spotlighting the brightest startups shaping the future of learning. This session showcases the standout talents selected as the best by global EdTech leaders and investors (from 138 countries). Through real examples and direct engagement with the founders, participants will uncover actionable strategies for building cross-regional partnerships, designing adaptable learning solutions, and identifying what truly resonates with today’s learners and educators.

events.title: Media That Matters: Nuclear Weapons & the Next Generation
events.description: How can we prepare a generation to understand the renewed global nuclear threats when so many students know little about nuclear history or policymaking? This session features two nuclear policy experts–supporters of education on these issues–and spotlights public media’s role in creating compelling video, primary sources, and inquiry-based learning to bring nuclear history and global security policy into the classroom. We’ll explore how media-based tools can help teachers address topics like deterrence, disarmament, and democratic accountability in a complex world.

speakers.name: Ira Helfand
speakers.title: Physician, Author, Nobel Peace Prize Winner

speakers.name: Susan Wilkins
speakers.title: Director of Social Studies Curriculum & Instruction

events.description: Meeting with this mentor is highly recommended if you're interested in Entrepreneurship, Funding, Business Development, Nonprofits, Marketing/Advertising/PR.

events.title: Mentor Session: Avantika Bagri (Centana Growth Partners)
events.description: Meeting with this mentor is highly recommended if you're interested in Funding, Fintech, "Diversity, Equity & Inclusion".

events.description: Meeting with this mentor is highly recommended if you're interested in Immersive Technology, XR, Policy.

speakers.name: Brittan Heller
speakers.title: Lecturer, Program in Law, Science, and Technology

events.title: Planet Margo
events.description: A unique photo opportunity inspired by the world of Apple TV’s highly anticipated series Margo’s Got Money Troubles, Planet Margo immerses attendees directly into Margo’s universe.

events.title: SXSW Bookstore
events.description: Check out the SXSW Bookstore to browse the latest work authored by this year’s conference participants. Support your favorite speakers and find something you connect with to take back home. Open daily on the 6th floor of the Hilton Austin Downtown.

events.title: Technology Convergence: Winning the Exponential Upswing
events.description: Every industrial revolution started with mashups. Today, advanced digital, biological, and physical technologies are creating their S-Curves together, unleashing a burst of convergence that generates value none could release alone, a dynamic mapped by the World Economic Forum's Technology Convergence Report. In this hands-on session, executives and founders will work through a diagnostic framework to map the intricacies of today's technology landscape, stress-test where their next major bet sits within the convergence wave, and walk away with a practical lens they can apply immediately.

speakers.name: Kary Bheemaiah
speakers.title: Chief Tech & Innovation Officer- Capgemini Invent I Exec Fellow – World Economic Forum

events.title: Turning Up the Heat: Climate Content That Clicks
events.description: From YouTube science shows to animated series and hit podcasts, climate content is getting a creative reboot. And today, climate-smart content isn't optional; it's foundational.This session brings together leaders from media, education, and policy to explore how we prepare the next generation to adapt and lead in a changing world. Learn how storytelling, humor, and accessibility are helping families make sense of climate change and act on it together.

speakers.name: Mindy Thomas
speakers.title: Co-Founder and Chief Creative Tinkerer, Host of Wow in the World

events.title: Valeo Tech Drive-in
events.description:
The car is no longer just a vehicle, it's where the future of tech starts.

At the Valeo Tech Drive-In, we’re transforming the journey into a high-stakes arena. Experience the machine-learning-powered Valeo Racer, gaze-tracking Panovision head up display, and e-Chromic lenses that sync to the road’s pulse. We’re even exporting automotive thermal DNA to cool the AI revolution in global data centers. From hyper-personalized lighting to the cloud edge,, witness the vehicle become the world’s most immersive, high-performance tech frontier.

events.title: What We’re Unlearning on Supporting Education Systems
events.description: The rules that have governed decades of education policy and practice are being rewritten. Advocates are adapting their strategies to play by the new rules and funders must also consider how its own rules can better meet the moment – from setting strategy or tracking impact amid rapid change to collaborating with other funders and partners through uncertainty. This meetup is a space for funders and other changemakers to discuss how philanthropy can adapt alongside advocacy partners and others to continue advancing change for all learners.

events.title: Who Owns the Truth?
events.description: Truth is harder to pin down than ever. This session explores how algorithms, AI, platform design, and evolving media ecosystems are reshaping how people understand what’s real. As trust in information sources shifts, we’ll look at how public belief is formed, how it can be influenced, and what that means for the future of shared reality. The conversation will offer practical insight into how creators, technologists, and communicators can help rebuild trust in an age of information overload. In conversation with Imran Ahmed, the session will feature a leading, award-winning journalist known for shaping national conversations on truth, media, and influence.

events.title: Who’s Funding the Future—and Who’s Getting Left Out
events.description: While billions flow into tech, too little reaches the people building for equity, justice, and long-term public benefit. This session brings together leaders rethinking who gets to fund emerging tech and why—across both venture capital and philanthropy. We'll explore how to back founders closest to the problems, build alternatives to extractive tech, and redirect capital toward innovation that actually serves communities. It's time to expand who defines innovation—and who profits from it.

events.title: Why the Future Depends on How Kids Play
events.description:
Using kids’ play and games as a lens, this session reframes imagination as one of the most critical future skills, challenging creators, designers, educators and technologists to consider how the experiences they make today shape how the next generation thinks tomorrow.

Drawing from early childhood development and game design, this talk explores why creative thinking isn’t innate but shaped early, how children develop imagination through open-ended play, and why games—often dismissed as passive entertainment—can be powerful environments for learning how to think. In a world where AI generates endless content and instant answers, the ability to ask better questions, see possibilities and imagine new paths forward will matter more than ever—making how kids play one of the most important design challenges of our time.

events.title: World Happiness Summit® on Tour at SXSW 2026
events.description:
During SXSW 2026, WOHASU brings its global happiness movement to Austin for a one-day, boutique experience designed for connection, conversation, and bold ideas. World Happiness Summit®

(WOHASU) On Tour features The Live Podcast Extravaganza, with live recordings of The Happiness Lab with Dr. Laurie Santos and Happier with Gretchen Rubin, two of the world’s most listened-to happiness podcasts, alongside short talks from leading voices in happiness and wellbeing. With Hyatt as Official Host & Hotel Sponsor, enjoy audience Q&A and insights that go beyond the microphone.

More information here: https://worldhappinesssummit.com/world-happiness-summit-on-tour-sxsw-2026/

events.title: American Exchange Project: Experiential Civics in Action
events.description: Picture this: Students from 8 different towns across the U.S. are watching the sun set in L.A. Among them is a line-dancing photographer from Texas, an aspiring chef from south L.A., and an avid reader becoming a real-life main character. Through the American Exchange Project, a free domestic exchange program, students get a greater understanding of themselves, their new friends, and the country we all share. In this solo talk, David McCullough III explores how domestic exchanges are the interactive civics lesson students need at this crucial time in American history.

events.title: Empowering Students for the Jobs of Tomorrow
events.description: As higher education faces shifting expectations, the value of a college degree is being challenged like never before. This session explores how institutions of all sizes can expand access and align degrees with workforce needs to stay relevant in changing local and federal landscapes. Learn practical strategies to remove barriers, serve diverse students and adapt programs to meet evolving demands.

events.title: Aguasol Tasting
events.description: Come sip Aguasol! We’ll be offering complimentary samples of our smooth, additive-free tequila, plus Aguasol cocktails for purchase at the bar. Pure sunshine, spring water, and agave—no shortcuts. Refresh, recharge, and keep the SXSW energy going.www.aguasol.com

events.title: Austin Eastciders Giddy Up Tasting
events.description: Giddy Up & Go at SXSW with Austin Eastciders! We'll be slinging samples of our newest 11% ABV Giddy Up Electric Punch lineup: Tropical Blast & Blue Raspberry. We lassoed that party magic with none of the mixing - just crack it up and let the good times ride.https://austineastciders.com/

events.title: Congress Avenue Block Party
events.description: The Congress Avenue Block Party (formerly known as the Registrant Lounge) is the go-to space for all SXSW attendees to maximize their SX experience, offering daily complimentary drinks, food, and sponsor swag. Open throughout the conferences & festivals, this convenient and relaxing meeting point near the hub of SXSW action is an ideal spot to unwind and connect with other attendees. New for 2026, the Block Party is free and open to the public!

events.title: Einstein Energy Super Snack Bars - Think You're A Snack Genius?
events.description: Think You’re a Snack Genius?Einstein Energy Super Smart Snack Bars bring brainpower to SXSW with The Einstein Game Show—fast, buzzer-style trivia hosted by an Albert Einstein look-alike. Win exclusive merch and bars, snap iconic photos, and fuel up with smarter snack breaks guided by brand ambassadors. Live screens, social moments, and QR-powered rewards keep the energy high—plus a special birthday celebration for Albert on March 14.

events.title: A Flavor-Filled Experience
events.description: You’re invited to a flavor-filled experience, where nature meets delicious. Come sip, sample, and explore everything from bold flavor innovations to functional hydration and premium teas. No artificial stuff. Just pure, crafted taste, and a few fun freebies you don't want to miss!

events.title: My/Mochi Joyfully Chill Ice Cream Shoppe
events.description: My/Mochi, the original and world's largest mochi ice cream brand, is inviting SXSW-goers to Taste the Joy! Our delightfully delicious ice cream wrapped in pillowy sweet rice dough comes in more than 20 flavors like Cookie Dough, Strawberry and Mango. So stop by our Joyfully Chill Ice Cream Shoppe at the Congress Ave Block Party Mar 12-18 to experience the joy for yourself!

events.title: SXSW Community Service Awards Recognition: The Bell
events.description: The SXSW Community Service Awards celebrate leaders and non-profit organizations from Austin and around the world who work tirelessly to improve the standing of the specific groups and causes that they serve.Taylor McGraw is a journalist and educator dedicated to giving young people the tools to tell their own stories. Prior to co-founding The Bell in 2017, he spent five years teaching and coaching in New York City schools, where he recognized that the voices most impacted by education policy were the ones least involved in shaping it.Under his leadership, The Bell has grown from a podcast project into a nationally recognized leader in youth-led journalism. The organization’s student reporting has shifted from the classroom to the halls of power: its coverage of school segregation and inequity has been cited in citywide policy discussions and featured on national airwaves. The Bell’s student reporters have twice been named finalists for the National Awards for Education Reporting, competing against professional newsrooms of all sizes.Beyond producing impactful youth-led storytelling, Taylor is a driving force for systemic change in journalism education. In 2022, he spearheaded the formation of the NYC Youth Journalism Coalition, a collective effort to strengthen the journalism career pipeline. Through the Coalition's ""Journalism for All"" initiative, The Bell and partners are actively expanding journalism programs to dozens of schools that historically lacked them, democratizing access to the field for thousands of students.Now based in Jackson, Mississippi, Taylor is scaling The Bell's work through the Jackson Youth Newsroom, a program focused on building a new generation of civic-minded journalists in the Deep South.Taylor holds an MFA in Creative Writing from The New School, an MA in Teaching from Relay GSE, and a BA in Public Policy Leadership from the University of Mississippi. His love for journalism began at his own high school newspaper in Oxford, Mississippi, and he remains committed to ensuring that every student has a platform to speak truth to power.

events.title: “The Reading Reboot” Screening & Q&A
events.description: We are in the worst reading crisis in American history, a reflection of an education standard that has stagnated for almost half a century, yet the system is now being transformed through the Science of Reading. Author James Patterson takes us on a journey with several elementary schools throughout Florida that have implemented curriculum based on the Science of Reading provided by the UFLI Foundations program led by Dr. Holly Lane.  This new system is rebooting the entire way we teach reading to our kids, and these are the emotional stories from the front lines of The Reading Reboot.

events.title: Afraid of AI? In Cleveland, It’s Enabling Economic Mobility
events.description: A tale as old as time: employers need talent but can’t see who’s job-ready, and job seekers need quality jobs but have limited visibility into what’s available and pathways to get there. We’re changing that in Cleveland by coming together around a shared vision of what works and what will drive better outcomes for everyone—especially those who’ve been systemically excluded. By leveraging AI (without sacrificing any existing jobs!), we’re transforming how we connect people to opportunity and advancing economic opportunity and mobility through a smarter, more equitable workforce infrastructure.

events.title: The Climate Paradox of AI Education
events.description: As AI transforms climate education with personalized learning and interactive simulations, we face an uncomfortable truth: the data centers powering these solutions are driving massive energy consumption that threatens to undermine our climate goals. With data center electricity use projected to double by 2030, how do we justify using energy-intensive AI to teach climate solutions? We'll examine real trade-offs, share concrete solutions, and propose a path toward AI-powered climate education that helps rather than harms our environmental future.

speakers.name: Rebecca (Becky) Boyles
speakers.title: Deputy Director, RENCI; Professor of the Practice, Data Science & Society

events.title: Code Switch: Defending Black EdTech amid AI Crackdowns
events.description: As AI takes center stage and political resistance to equity accelerates, Black-centered EdTech stands at a crossroads. This panel spotlights philanthropic, nonprofit, product, and platform leaders working to protect the cultural, pedagogical, and digital infrastructure of Black EdTech. One year into new AI regulations and increasing DEI rollbacks, we’ll explore how to build for resilience – embedding protections into platforms, pedagogy, and policy. What does it take not just to survive, but to lead and thrive in the face of erasure?

events.title: Convene, Collaborate, & Cultivate Connection: Moms Meet Up
events.description: Calling all Moms: Join women from diverse backgrounds, all united by their shared experience of balancing professional ambitions and motherhood. Here, we aim to create a supportive and empowering environment where moms can network, share insights, and build lasting connections. Expect: Networking Opportunities to exchange ideas, experiences, and strategies that help you thrive, collaborative discussions about the unique strengths and skills moms bring to the table, and cultivate connections with women who can offer advice, encouragement, and friendship long after SXSW ends.

speakers.name: Erica Rooney
speakers.title: CEO & Founder | Chief Human Resource Officer

events.title: Cracking Higher Ed: Why Startups Miss the Mark
events.description: Why do early-stage EdTech startups stall in higher ed? They build for assumptions, not real institutional needs. This talk introduces the Jobs to Be Done (JTBD) framework to help founders validate demand early, avoid false positives in pilots, and align products with urgent 2026 campus priorities. Fast. Focused. Brutally useful.

events.title: The Creative Power of Letting Go: Why Quitting Can Be Your Biggest Breakthrough
events.description: In a culture built on hustle, knowing when to walk away can be a Creator’s most powerful advantage. Emmy-winning Creator and TIME Next 100 honoree Charlie Engelman joins Axios Media reporter Kerry Flynn for a candid conversation exploring the surprising role that quitting plays in creative success.  After eight years chasing projects that never took off, Charlie found success only when he stepped back and started fresh. Together, they’ll explore how to recognize when a project is holding you back, why letting go is not failure but a strategic move, and how smart quitting can be an essential skill for anyone building a sustainable career in today’s Creator Economy.

events.title: Deeply Human in an AI World
events.description: In an AI-driven world, this meet-up invites on-the-ground educators to share what’s working, to keep teaching deeply human. Human relationships are at the heart of learning. Warmth and presence matter more than ever. Let’s talk connection, creativity, and the skills students can’t get from machines. Bring your heart, your joy, and your wisdom. Leave with new tools, real strategies, and inspiration. Participants will also have the chance to share their insights with the wider educator community.

events.title: Early Days Again: What AI Makes Possible for New Schools
events.description:
AI tools are improving quickly, and educators are already finding meaningful uses for them. What hasn’t been defined yet is the school model that makes AI work for students and teachers in a coherent, reliable way at scale.

This session examines what early adopters of AI in public education are learning in real classrooms and school systems, the concrete design choices and conditions behind early success, and the operational, instructional, and governance questions that must be resolved over the next five years for AI to strengthen public education rather than fragment it.

events.title: Featured Session: Strategy in the Times of Chaos: Imagining Futures of Education
events.description: Daily, we wake to the unimaginable becoming reality: the highest temperatures in recorded history, technology acquiring human-like communication capabilities, realignment of global alliances and ideologies. Such times of upheaval are opportunities to reinvent the institutions, ways of thinking, and modes of doing. Sociologist John Fabian Witt said, these are “occasions in which people remake the world.” In this conversation, experts with decades of experience in future-facing strategies, will share foresight techniques for imagining radically different futures and detecting signals of reinvention and scholarship on how communities depicted as under-resourced create practices and institutions of their own—as examples for building more just and equitable futures.

events.title: German DeepTech and AI Innovation Unleashed: Day 1 at German Haus
events.description:
Join us for the grand opening of the German Haus 2026 during the landmark 40th edition of SXSW! We kick off Day 1 with a high-energy German Happy Hour, the ultimate hub for founders, investors, and global ecosystem players to connect. Experience the synergy of German engineering and digital creativity as we showcase the next generation of industry disruptors. Engage with expert-led discussions, gain fresh perspectives, and cap off your day on the German Haus Rooftop as the sun sets over Austin. Whether you are seeking your next big investment, a strategic partnership, or world-class insights, the German Haus is your essential SXSW destination.

For more information please visit: https://www.german-haus.com

events.title: Growing Intelligence: Youth, AI, and the Future of Ag
events.description: AI is revolutionizing the world around us, from how we grow food and educate our children, to how we deliver care – and it’s happening fast. So how do we ensure the next generation is empowered to thrive in an unknown future? Since 2017, 4-H and Google have equipped nearly 1.5M youth with the skills to succeed in an AI-powered world. Join this session to explore why equitable access to AI education and support for youth-led innovation are essential to building prosperity and resilience across communities and industries.

speakers.name: Maab Ibrahim
speakers.title: Head of Knowledge, Skilling, and Learning, Americas

events.title: Hidden Brilliance Revealed: Reimagining Leadership in a Fragmented World
events.description: Most leaders are taught to narrow themselves to fit the world. But what if innovation requires the opposite? In this intimate fireside chat, Tony Martignetti shares insights from his latest book, Illuminating Hidden Brilliance, revealing how reclaiming the sidelined parts of our identity is the key to creativity, connection, and transformative leadership. Through stories, research, and practical tools, Tony shows how multidimensional thinking becomes a catalyst and why the future belongs to leaders who bring all of themselves to the table. Attendees will learn why a multidimensional perspective is a strategic advantage, how to spot hidden brilliance in themselves and others, and how organizations can create environments where people can think and lead beyond the one-dimensional demands of modern work.

events.title: Hospitality as Pedagogy
events.description: What if classrooms were designed like hospitality spaces—hotels, restaurants, places of welcome, rhythm, and care? In this talk, designer-researcher Shruthi Manjula Balakrishna explores how hospitality frameworks such as arrival sequence, wayfinding, sensory design, and emotional arc can reshape the rituals and environments of learning. Drawing from design psychology and service strategy, this session offers a fresh lens for fostering trust, comfort, and connection in education.

events.title: Innovating in Science & Tech When Budgets are Tight
events.description: When public funding becomes unpredictable, how can organizations boost efficiency without stifling innovation? This fireside chat explores how the Space Telescope Science Institute, home of the Hubble and Webb telescopes, revolutionized access to space data. The lessons, born before today’s budget pressures, offer a powerful blueprint for any organization facing resource constraints. Whether you're advancing science, education, or social impact, the message is clear: Transformation is possible, even in lean times.

speakers.name: Susan Reed
speakers.title: Director of IT Solutions / Acting Division Head of IT / Deputy Division Head of IT

speakers.name: Vanessa Smith
speakers.title: ServiceNow Chief Corporate Affairs Officer and President, ServiceNow.org

events.title: Leading the AI Future: How to Think Exponentially in a Chaotic Decade
events.description: AI is accelerating markets, work, and entire industries faster than most leaders can process. In this Core Conversation, Kian Gohar (former Singularity University Executive Director) joins Jeff Duncan, CEO of Ingenuity Live, to explore how leaders must shift from linear thinking to exponential thinking. Drawing on experience with NASA, XPRIZE, and Fortune 500 companies, Kian shares mental models for navigating uncertainty, reframing risk and opportunity, and building a “future operating system” to lead confidently in an AI-driven decade.

events.title: The Learning Geeks: How to Think When Machines Think Faster
events.description: AI helps us work faster than ever—but are we sacrificing how we develop? In this live podcast, we discuss why metacognition—how we think, feel, and learn—is the human advantage when partnering with AI in our work. We’ll unpack how intentional thinking helps people decide when to offload to AI, when to lean in, and how to grow through the process. Expect practical insights, geeky discussions, and evidence-based strategies you can immediately apply to monitor, evaluate, and optimize your learning and working as AI increasingly influences our lives.
