events.title: Ancient Greece
events.description: Ancient Greece hails from the underworld of the Toronto music scene. This is the odyssey of a band stitched together not just by music but by camaraderie and a penchant for the anarchic. Raspy echoes, beating drums, guttural chords, and sharp melodic riffs weave tales of urban decay and what it means to be chewed up, swallowed alive, and come out the other end kicking and screaming.

events.title: Caleb De Casper
events.description: From the horror cabaret and glam-rock theatrics of his early career to the shadowy, neon-lit world of his current dark synth-pop, Austin-based performer Caleb De Casper has never stopped evolving. A classically trained pianist and vocalist, De Casper commands the stage with a sharpened, unmistakable intensity — trading in the avant-garde gowns and stilettos of the past for a bold, more masculine and unfiltered presence that puts the focus squarely on the music, the message, and the electricity of performance. His 2022 debut LP Femme Boy expanded his sonic world, weaving dancefloor heat, cinematic drama, and queer storytelling into a record that was equal parts brooding and explosive. That same year, the City of Austin proclaimed Caleb De Casper Day, recognizing his cultural impact. He went on to perform yearly at SXSW, Austin City Limits Music Festival, Utopia Fest, Houston’s Art Car Festival, Thin Line Fest,  and multiple Pride celebrations, while continuously advocating for LGBTQIA rights at the Texas State Capitol and beyond. Now, with his forthcoming sophomore album Delirium, De Casper enters a new creative chapter — darker, dirtier, dance-driven, and poised for a breakthrough.

events.title: Grace Sorensen
events.description: Grace Sorensen is one of the fastest independent-rising stars in the music scene. As a multi-hyphenate singer, songwriter, and dancer, she’s been dubbed "Austin's Wonderkid" and “Austin’s R&B Cool Girl” by the Austin Chronicle and KUTX. In her young career she has already been featured on Joe Budden’s “Sleeper Picks,” collaborated with BLK ODYSSY, been inducted to the Recording Academy's Class of 2025, played Austin City Limits Festival, SXSW Austin & London, and surpassed one million organic streams on her single "Digits.” She debuted her versatile album "BLUEPRINT" February 2025 and has exciting expectation of new collaborations, visual projects, and records.

events.title: grima
events.description:
Reverby guitars and post-punk energy meet dreamy Spanish
vocals – somewhere between future anxiety and the desire for
self-realization.
German-Spanish artist grima emerged on Cologne’s wave scene in
2024, leaning into a '90s-inspired shoegaze sound that now defines
both his live shows and debut EP.
Early single En busca de caught international attention – including
airplay by London DJ and musician Nabihah Iqbal on her BBC Radio
6 show. Following his live debut in Berlin, grima played international
showcases in spring 2025, including Liverpool Sound City (UK) and
c/o pop Festival (DE).
His debut EP instantes (antes de caer) was released in July 2025,
accompanied by a sold-out release show in his adopted hometown
Cologne. The EP was featured on several Spotify Editorial Playlists
and even landed the cover of Fresh Finds Spain.
Recent highlights include a support slot for acclaimed American
shoegaze band glare and three shows at Reeperbahn Festival
2025 – all while grima is already working on new material.

events.title: Startup Germany Night
events.description:
Join us for the Startup Germany Night, the central meeting point for Germany’s startup scene and its global partners in Austin. After a productive day at SXSW, we invite you to unwind in a sophisticated yet relaxed atmosphere. Connect with founders, investors, and ecosystem builders from both sides of the Atlantic. Discover the bold ideas driving the next wave of innovation while enjoying first-class DJ sets and a premium selection of drinks. Experience firsthand why Germany remains a world-class launchpad for scalable solutions and lasting partnerships.

https://startupgermanynightsxsw.eventbrite.de

events.title: SXSW 2026 Innovation Opening Party
events.description: Bringing together tech enthusiasts and industry leaders, the SXSW Innovation Opening Party kicks off SXSW 2026 with unmatched energy and excitement in the new Innovation Clubhouse. Join Coder for a special night celebrating the start of another unforgettable SXSW.

events.title: Worship Music DJs
events.description: A Dj group specializing in Christian music. Love Austin ministry.

events.title: Beyond The Duplex Planet
events.description: In 1979, David Greenberger, a recent art school grad became activities director at a Boston nursing home. David began interviewing the residents, rejecting pat questions with the unexpected: "Which do you prefer – coffee or meat?," “What is embarrassment?,” and “How close can you get to a penguin?” The result was The Duplex Planet, an early ‘zine characterized by humor, warmth and sincerity. Today David’s work takes the form of spoken word shows and recordings. Beyond the Duplex Planet explores notions of aging and its intersection with art and community. It’s also a slightly ironic look at the life of an artist devoted to documenting the elderly who is himself in his senior years.

events.title: My NDA
events.description: Three people bound by non-disclosure agreements face extreme personal risk to expose how a simple intellectual property contract is weaponized to silence, manipulate and control.

events.title: Jessie Chambers
events.description:
Jessie Chambers is an independent singer-songwriter crafting timeless pop with a glam-rock edge. Her effortless, unmistakable voice delivers songs that are both deeply personal and irresistibly catchy. After featuring on Nurko & Last Heroes’ “Promise Me,” Chambers broke through with singles like “Guess U Suck” (850K+ streams) and “Fever Dream,” which landed on Spotify’s Fresh Finds Pop.
In 2025, she was featured on Algorhythm by Los Wizzards, a project nominated for a 2026 Grammy Award, marking a career milestone and highlighting her versatility as an artist and collaborator. Her music will also be featured in the upcoming short film Lake St. Claire, written & directed by Caitlin Meyernik, expanding her work into film and visual storytelling.
Her single “Fall Right Back” made waves across streaming and social media and was highlighted by Women in Music as one of their Top Songs of 2025. Chambers’ performances have taken her from The Troubadour to Revolution Live, opening for Saint Motel, appearing in respected showcases nationwide, and making her SXSW debut this year. With new music on the way, Jessie Chambers continues to carve a singular path through today’s indie-pop landscape.

events.title: Saint Harison
events.description: Bio: Saint Harison is a rising artist with an undeniable voice from Southampton, United Kingdom. He currently lives in Los Angeles, CA. Having quickly risen to Internet fame from public support from SZA and Jazmine Sullivan to Justin Bieber, Timbaland and Elton John, he’s one of the latest artists to watch. Citing Amy Winehouse and Frank Ocean as two key musical influences, Saint has been covered by Rolling Stone, British Vogue, Wonderland, etc. and was named Apple Music's global Up Next artist. He made his late night TV debut on Jimmy Kimmel Live! after his viral COLORS performance of “ego talkin,” which sparked the viral #egotalkinchallenge on TikTok. His 7-track EP lost a friend was released in 2023 and has amassed over 200M cumulative streams, continuing to grow. He returned in fall 2025 with his single "ghosted," and recently released his latest single "bad," produced by Grammy-winning producer duo NovaWav (Beyoncé, JAY-Z, Jazmine Sullivan, etc.). He's gearing up to release his highly anticipated project this year.
events.venue: Austin City Limits Live at the Moody Theater

events.title: Sam LLanes
events.description:
Sam Llanes is a Christian Hip Hop artist with a message rooted in hope, love, and faith. Blending CHH with heartfelt storytelling, Sam brings a fresh sound with a timeless purpose. His music speaks to the ones who feel forgotten, the youth searching for direction, and anyone needing a reminder that God still moves.

From the stage to youth groups, and through his work with 4KIDS and the Youth Group Tour, Sam lives what he raps. Every lyric is a reflection of his journey—a husband, a father, a worship leader, and a man who found purpose through Jesus.

For the overlooked. For the outcast. For every kid. This is Sam Llanes.

Love God Love People Change The World

events.title: Caleb Lemons
events.description: 26 Year Old Vocalist, Songwriter, & Music Producer based out of Austin, Texas. Caleb blends classic soul melodies with the combined use of real instruments , & modern R&B and Hip Hop production, for a poppy but classic feeling in his songs.

events.title: Next of Kin
events.description:
Next of Kin is an alt-country trio with a sound that blends country-tinged soundscapes, rich three-part harmonies, and honest storytelling. 

In just over a year, what started as a chance collaboration between three solo artists transformed into much more – a budding new band, a full album, an ACL Festival debut. 

Some call it fate, others luck – they call it Next of Kin.

events.title: Petrina DeLacey
events.description:
Petrina DeLacey is a Los Angeles–based artist blending rap, pop, R&B, and Afro influences into a bold, faith-driven sound that celebrates identity, confidence, and purpose in Christ. 

Her music empowers men and women of God to live unapologetically for Jesus—reminding women especially that they are God’s princesses, deeply loved and divinely chosen. Her voice carries both strength and softness, bridging the gap between mainstream and conviction.

Beyond the music, Petrina and her husband JBthaPreacher, co-own Club 2:17, LA’s most vibrant Christian club, where artists like Porsha Love and Tommy Zuko have performed. Featured on Derek Minor’s Highlight Tapes, Vol. 2, Petrina continues to rise as a voice of faith and authenticity in today’s music scene. 

Rooted in love for her city and her community, she’s known for following God’s direction above all—even turning down a record deal when He said no. Her life and music stand as proof that obedience, confidence, and purpose can coexist—and that faith is meant to move culture.

events.title: I See Orange
events.description:
We are a Mexican lead British 3-piece alternative post-grunge rock band. Starting in early 2022, our lead singer moved from Mexico to the UK. The band formed after an impromptu rehearsal session and discovering the chemistry we had playing together we quickly got to work. Writing, playing gigs and recording, releasing our first single in that same year, shortly followed by our debut EP Lonesome Joy. We are now about to release our debut Album with the first few singles already out and their music videos on YouTube hitting almost half a million views. 
Hailing from Mexico, Giselle brought to the UK her unique taste and a talent for writing folk pop, looking to explore a new musical direction fuelled by a passion for rock. Finding Cameron and Charlie, two British born and raised musicians marked the inception of I See Orange, mixing multiple genres into their unique post-grunge sound, a deliberate combo of captivating melodies, clever lyricism and heavy rock.
Bringing raw energy, heavy riffs and powerful melodic vocals to every stage we hit. We blend the gritty, nostalgic sound of the 90's with our own unique twist.

events.title: Astralorp
events.description: They define themselves “Discomatica”: an electric guitar that becomes a synthesizer, were a classic arpeggio moves bass and melody in a flowing counterpoint as if it were three instruments in one, and a drumbeat that flows between disco, dance, math-rock and alternative, all with a video game feel. Everything is recorded live! An electronic DJ set played with feet and fingers by guitarist Andrea Faccioli (already with Vasco Brondi, Le Luci Della Centrale Elettrica, Baustelle, Cisco), and drummer Niccolò Fornabaio (already with Vasco Brondi, Le Luci Della Centrale Elettrica, Vinicio Capossela, Marlene Kuntz).

events.title: Astrokeyy
events.description:
Astrokeyy is a Houston-based hip-hop artist carving his own lane with sharp lyricism, atmospheric production, and a sound rooted in Southern culture with a forward-thinking edge. Known for his commanding live presence, Astrokeyy has been selected as an **official SXSW artist twice**, cementing his reputation as a standout performer on one of the world’s most influential stages.

He has shared stages with respected names in hip-hop including **Rome Streetz, Jay Worthy, and Devin The Dude**, holding his own alongside both underground heavyweights and Southern legends. Recently, Astrokeyy released his latest project "Southern Hospitality" fully produced by Marc Spano and executive produced by Dough Networkz a cohesive body of work that highlights his growth, Southern identity, and refined sonic vision.

Blending raw storytelling, confident delivery, and hypnotic beats, Astrokeyy represents the grind, ambition, and creativity of Houston’s new generation. With momentum fueled by high-profile performances and a focused artistic direction, he continues pushing his sound forward with longevity, authenticity, and impact in mind.

events.title: Haters
events.description:
Haters are an Australian indie punk/garage band formed by Jai Sparks (vocals/guitar), James Priest (drums), and Kaito (Kaitlyn Hold – bass/vocals). For fans of Fontaines D.C., The Beths, IDLES, and Wunderhorse. Their songs are drenched in emotion and exist to make you feel something, they speak of real life, friendship, mental health, profound loss and the beauty of the human experience.

The band travelled to Canada to record their debut album non-violent with Scott Middleton (Cancer Bats), capturing their intense, unfiltered sound. Known for their high-energy live shows, Haters have performed at Bigsound (Australia), NXNE (Toronto), Sled Island (Calgary), and completed several cross-country Canadian tours.

Their debut album non-violent was released in March 2025, accompanied by sold-out shows throughout Canada and Australia accompanied by rapid growth across streaming and fan engagement, with listenership led by the US, followed by Canada and Australia, 1000's of playlist adds and major Apple Music and Spotify editorial support.
With a fierce commitment to honesty, connection, and powerful performances, Haters continue to build momentum as a force in the indie punk scene.

events.title: Pierce Washington
events.description: Pierce Washington is an award-winning hip-hop artist from Dallas, Texas, whose sound bridges jazz influences, live instrumentation, and modern production — creating music that feels both timeless and forward-thinking. Known for his cinematic storytelling and commanding stage presence, Pierce has emerged as one of the leading voices in Dallas hip-hop. His collaborations with legendary producer Madlib and rap icon Lil Wayne showcase his versatility and creative range. Fresh off headlining The Proof of Concept and Folktales tours, Pierce continues to push artistic boundaries through his innovative approach to music, visuals, and brand artistry.

events.title: Saige Davis
events.description: Raised in a sunny southern California beach town, Saige Davis writes country-leaning songs straight from the heart with melodies that feel everlasting. Writing primarily on her own, she creates music that feels grounded and familiar - and yet wholly her own. Influenced by both the country classics and also Americana with a modern edge, her songs lean on acoustic guitars, simple arrangements, and lyrics that leave room to breathe. Whether written quietly at home or brought to life in the studio with producers Caleb Nelson (Mt. Joy) and Patrick Lyons (Colter Wall, Luke Grimes, Noeline Hoffman), Saige’s music shows a deep respect for timeless storytelling and feels imminent for a breakthrough in the year ahead.

events.title: SXSW 2026 Music Opening Party
events.description: The SXSW Music Opening Party, proudly presented by Rivian, serves as the definitive launchpad for the festival. Join us to officially kick off the SXSW 2026 Music Festival with an electrifying evening featuring The All-American Rejects headlining a powerhouse showcase of artists.

events.title: Zastava
events.description: zastava is a music band from detroit, mi

events.title: Gavin the Hotrod
events.description: Gavin the HotRod is a Jacksonville, Florida–based hip-hop artist known for blending Southern grit, faith-rooted conviction, and sharp, punchline-heavy lyricism. He has steadily built momentum through consistency, live shows, and a catalog that balances technical skill with substance. Drawing from classic Southern rap energy while staying modern and introspective, Gavin has grown a loyal audience with thousands of monthly listeners.

events.title: Nathaniel Stewart
events.description: Nathaniel Stewart writes songs that evoke nostalgic memories, inspired by the sincerity and sound of early 1970s songwriters, engulfed in the hazy glow of modern dreamy indie. His music drifts between melancholy and hope, acting as a witness to the human experience. Each song is a quiet reflection of nature, stillness, and a longing for connection and purpose – an invitation to slow down and be present in the moment.

events.title: Lew Apollo
events.description:
Lew Apollo is a rising force in modern soul, captivating audiences with his soul-stirring melodies and poignant songwriting. KUTX praised him as “the perfect summer vibe,” a fitting description for an artist whose music blends hypnotic guitar, cinematic production, and a sultry, smoky voice into lush, resonant soundscapes. Originally hailing from rural Barnum, MN, Lew’s artistry is deeply rooted in his home state’s heritage, fusing the legacies of Bob Dylan and Prince with modern influences like Hozier, Leon Bridges, and Labrinth.
The tragic loss of his father in 2022 profoundly shaped Lew’s songwriting, catalyzing a body of work that confronts themes of grief, isolation, and resilience while offering hope and connection. His debut EP JUNGLE, produced by BLK ODYSSY, introduced him as a bold new voice and fueled a run of sold-out shows at iconic Austin venues like The Pershing and Antone’s.
Since then, Lew has taken his music to wider audiences, touring in support of Los Lonely Boys and earning airplay on KUTX with his single “Diamonds and Gold” as well as “Let the Light In” from his debut album. Self-produced from start to finish, Fool’s Gold has already surpassed 300,000 streams in under two months and is creating buzz for its fearless vulnerability and lush production. Press outlets have echoed the excitement: AMP Music declared “Lew Apollo will be a force in the R&B and pop stratospheres. Be warned,” while Earmilk praised how “Apollo’s signature smoky voice sets the tone for a sultry soundscape.” With his clear vision and unwavering dedication to using music as a vessel for healing, Lew Apollo is quickly emerging as one of the most exciting new voices to watch in soul.

events.title: Sofia and the Antoinettes
events.venue: Austin City Limits Live at the Moody Theater

events.title: Knats
events.description:
Knats, a quintet led by two lifelong best mates from Newcastle Upon Tyne, Stan Woodward (Bass) and King David-Ike Elechi (Drums), alongside their younger sidekick and virtuoso Trumpeter, Ferg Kilsby, making Geordie Jazz, with sophisticated arrangements, strong melodies and danceable grooves.

After moving to London at the end of 2022, Knats took London by storm playing sold out jazz re:freshed and Rough Trade East headliners, supporting Str4ta at a sold Jazz Cafe and performing for the BBC proms; as well as working with and backing the likes of Geordie Greep, Eddie Chacon, Yellowdays and collaborating with major fashion brands Palace, Beams and Arc’teryx. Following their signing to Gearbox Records at the beginning of 2024, Knats released their debut self-titled album in March of 2025 and embarked on their first UK headline tour. From this they went on to receive critical acclaim from the likes of Jazzwise, Downbeat, Rolling Stone Japan, The Guardian and many more; as well as being nominated for ‘Jazz Newcomer of the Year’ at this year’s Parliamentary Jazz Awards.
events.venue: British Music Embassy @ Palm Door on Sixth Patio

events.title: Mission
events.description: Born in Greenville, Mississippi, and raised in Sacramento, California, Antonio Smith, better known as Mission, is a genre-defying Christian music artist who has dedicated his life and music to glorifying God. As a husband to Shawnay Smith and father of four—two boys and two girls—Mission’s journey of faith began when he gave his life to Christ at the age of 18, and his music continues to reflect that commitment. Mission’s life and music are deeply rooted in Matthew 6:33: “Seek first the kingdom of God and His righteousness, and all these things will be added to you.” He believes in doing God’s will, not his own, and encourages others to love God’s people. His personal motto, “All of You, none of me,” is based on the scripture “I must decrease so the Lord can increase,” signifying his desire for God’s will to be done in his life above all else.

events.title: Boooka
events.description: Boooka is an Austin-based hip-hop artist, curator, and creative director known for blending sharp lyricism with intentional storytelling. As the founder of SUMN2SAY, he has built a platform dedicated to spotlighting independent artists and cultivating real community through live experiences. With the release of his 2026 album BTS, Boooka continues to push his sound forward—balancing introspection, ambition, and culture while creating opportunities both on and off the stage.

events.title: Dallas Tetnus
events.description:
Dallas Tenus is a four piece rock band from Raleigh, North Carolina that formed in 2022 and includes a collective of members who have traveled the world playing and performing music.  The four established band members - Greg Clayton (Rhythm guitar and vocals), Billy Alphin (drums), Danny Kurtz (lead guitar) and David Wright (bass guitar) - have collectively played in various major label and national touring bands through the years including Whiskeytown, AntiSeen, Drivin’ n Cryin', Flat Duo Jets, Squirrel Nut Zippers, The Backsliders, Sarah Shook, Lustre, and The Rosebuds (to name a few).  The new collective that is Dallas Tetnus is a musical combination of all of these influences, with a stage show that is packed with static energy and a pure rock showmanship that is one to be seen.

The band plays loud, short, catchy, 70s - inspired tunes with influences from The Ramones, The Stooges, and KISS. Their unique and original stage presence is hard to forget. Their shows have plenty of visual appeal and engagement with smoke and bubbles rolling through every set, with white suits and a pink lit backdrop to boot.  

The debut album, Welcome To Dallas Tetnus, is available everywhere now.

events.title: Danxgerous
events.description:
Danxgerous – the solo project of Daniela “Dan” Mariti – is born from the meeting of Italian and Czech roots and a musical heritage steeped in singing and instruments. A singer-songwriter and multi-instrumentalist, Danxgerous crafts a sonic universe suspended between indie-rock, dreamy pop, and contemporary indie-folk, where light and melancholy intertwine to create deep and captivating emotional landscapes.
After studying music theory and harmony at Saint Louis in Rome and performing with the band In June, Danxgerous debuted as a solo artist in 2023 with the independent label We Were Never Being Boring (WWNBB), releasing the singles Keys, Sides, Cold Yet Dazzling, and Venom. In 2024, she brought the project to international stages, with a standout moment at SXSW 2024 in Austin, Texas, performing four shows including the prestigious International Day Stage, marking a pivotal step in her career and expanding her international audience.
2025 is dedicated to writing, recording, and producing her debut album “Old Soul” — a journey into the universe of an old soul navigating the modern world, exploring mystical dreams, introspection, and the beauty of nature.

events.title: Margo's Got Money Troubles
events.description: “Margo’s Got Money Troubles” is a bold, heartwarming and comedic family drama following recent college dropout and aspiring writer, Margo (Elle Fanning), the daughter of an ex-Hooter’s waitress (Michelle Pfeiffer) and ex-pro wrestler (Nick Offerman), as she’s forced to make her way with a new baby, a mounting pile of bills and a dwindling amount of ways to pay them.

events.title: OKAN
events.description:
Taking their name from the word for “heart” in the Afro-Cuban religion of Santería, the duo OKAN creates an alchemy of Cuban rhythms and chants with high-octane indie jazz and pop. Singing in Spanish, Yoruba, and Spanglish, OKAN explores resistance, rebirth, and joy — forging rhythm and harmony through acts of survival, both personal and cultural.

Following their Juno Award–winning album Okantomi — performed on NPR’s Tiny Desk and toured internationally while supporting Grammy-winning duo Rodrigo y Gabriela — OKAN’s upcoming fall release "Ife Ira" features a collaboration with Daymé Arocena.

OKAN is led by violinist and vocalist Elizabeth Rodríguez and percussionist and vocalist Magdelys Savigne — both Grammy and Latin Grammy nominees — whose powerful harmonies and fearless musicianship have earned the duo a global following.

events.title: Parris Chariz
events.description: "A Detroit native, on the rise with a mission to bridge the gap between faith-based platforms and mainstream music. Parris Chariz, short for charismatic, is an edgy, yet vibrant artist with a trap sound. Parris experienced numerous downfalls throughout his life but those valleys lead him to music. His debut album “2045” gained the attention of tastemakers within the CHH and mainstream Hip-Hop community. From being listed on Rapzilla’s Freshman in 2016 List to headlining a nationwide tour along with Ty Brasel, WHATUPRG, & Aaron Cole. Parris has made his mark within the Hip-Hop community that is extremely unique and far from the rest. His music has encouraged his listeners to know what’s real and to be true to yourself through every obstable this life brings us. His recently released album “Take You To Parris” has set a standard of authentic creativity provided a voice to the unheard. Parris has made his mark as a creative and will continue to make music that speaks to the soul."

events.title: NOAMZ
events.description:
NOAMZ is a flutist, vocalist, multi-instrumentalist, and producer making alt soul music. She was raised in a small town in Wisconsin by a Guadeloupean mother and French father.

She went on tour in 2024 on her artist project, released her EP “Personne” August of 2025 with Guesthouse, and plays regularly across SoCal and the Midwest. And has recently grown in popularity online for her flute beatboxing. 

Featured on numerous LA based artist tracks, radios, and the Senegalese soccer anthem, she plans to release three musical projects this coming year, from her meditative flute project “Retrouvaille” to her soulful Melodic DnB EP “TEXTURES” dropping this March.

events.title: Gwenno
events.description: Gwenno is a Welsh songwriter and music producer from Cardiff, Wales. She explores her Celtic/Anglo British identity through her songs in Welsh, Cornish and English, blending early folk and blues guitar with psychedelic electronic BBC Radiophonic Workshop and Joe Meek flourishes to capture a history of 1500 years. She released he debut album, the Welsh Music Prize Award winning Y Dydd Olaf, in 2015, a concept album inspired by a late 60s sci-fi novel of the same name about a world which is taken over by artificial intelligence with its protagonist documenting it all in Welsh as an act of defiance and preservation of a minoritised language against Big Tech. In 2018 she released her Cornish language album, Le Kov, an exploration of 2000 years of Cornish history which led to an increase of 10% in Cornish learners worldwide. Her third album, Tresor, was released in 2022, an album about motherhood which was shortlisted for the Mercury Music Prize the same year. In 2024 she released her 4th, trilingual album, Utopia, which included songs written in English for the first time in her solo career.
events.venue: British Music Embassy @ Palm Door on Sixth

events.title: Yoso
events.description: Yoso is an Austin-based hip-hop artist known for blending high-energy performance with melodic, emotionally driven records. His sound reflects Southern influence, ambition, and authentic storytelling, allowing him to connect with both hype-focused and vibe-driven audiences. After gaining traction with his breakout single “You Don’t Know,” which surpassed 200K+ views, Yoso has continued building momentum through consistent releases and strong digital engagement. His latest release “NOW” represents a new chapter focused on growth and creative evolution. With official SXSW artist recognition and an expanding catalog of music and visuals, Yoso continues to establish himself as a rising independent artist focused on long-term development, performance excellence, and cultural impact.

events.title: Canon
events.description: Canon is an independent artist who turns pain into purpose and lyrics into lifelines. Raised between Chicago and Atlanta, his music is raw, cinematic, and rooted in real-life battles—surviving trauma, questioning faith, rebuilding identity, and refusing to quit. Every bar is personal, every beat intentional. He doesn’t make music to impress—he makes it to connect, to challenge, to heal. Fully hands-on with his sound, visuals, and message, Canon creates from a place of truth, and invites his listeners to face theirs. This isn’t just music—it’s movement. Welcome to the journey.

events.title: xBValentine
events.description: xBValentine is a queer Latina artist from Georgetown, Texas, unapologetically carving her own lane in the music world. As a first-generation creative, she’s spent over a decade breaking barriers from racking up accolades at open mics to sharing stages with names like Joyner Lucas, WESTSIDE Boogie, Snow Tha Product, Lupe Fiasco, & more. Known for her bold, genre-blending sound, XB’s music fuses hip-hop, R&B, and Latin influences, reflecting her diverse roots and fearless individuality. Her rise has been meteoric first going viral in 2020 with her LGBTQ+ anthem “Vibe With You,” surpassing a million streams across platforms. In 2023, she made waves again with Paul Wall on “LIKE DIS,” amassing over 10 million TikTok views. Most recently, her hit “Don’t Play With Me” featuring Amanda Perez exploded online, earning 2.2 billion TikTok views, nearing 1 million YouTube views, and surpassing a million streams across platforms. xB isn’t just a voice; she’s a movement.

events.title: Cornbread Mafia
events.description:
The unbelievable true story of the Cornbread Mafia, a group of Kentucky farmers who built the largest domestic marijuana syndicate in U.S. history. Sons of tobacco farmers, moonshiners, and bootleggers, they turned to pot to keep their families fed.  

What followed was straight out of Kentucky folklore: lion cubs on the farm, backroad police chases, and a code of silence that baffled prosecutors. Part true crime and part cartoon, the film blends community, the War on Drugs, and a whole lot of weed with the humor and heart of the folks who lived it.
events.venue: Rollins Theatre at the Long Center

events.title: Panam
events.description: Formed in Barcelona in 2015, PANAM is an alternative rock band that sings in English and blurs the lines between genres. Their sound, driven by guitars, synths, and powerful vocals, fuses 2000s indie, 70s psychedelia, Brit-pop, dance rock, new funk, and organic electronica. Each song delivers a cinematic, immersive experience with a message that inspires and a bold identity that defies labels. PANAM doesn’t just make music, they build a sonic universe of their own.

events.title: A Safe Distance
events.description: Alex and her boyfriend Joey head into the wilderness for a romantic getaway. When Alex turns down Joey's surprise proposal, he abandons her in the woods. She’s rescued by Kianna and Matt, an enigmatic young couple living off the grid. Stranded and shaken, Alex accepts their invitation to stay at their remote campsite. As she’s drawn into their intoxicating world, complicated emotions and unexpected connections begin to surface. But when she learns they’re fugitives wanted for a string of violent bank robberies, Alex must navigate the blurred lines between desire, loyalty, and survival.

events.title: Same Same But Different
events.description: When Rana’s visa application is denied, she faces the reality of returning home to Iran. That is, until Adam – her wealthy boss’s son and her summer fling – proposes a green card wedding. Wrestling with the implications of his offer, Rana enlists help from a questionable shaman, Adam’s pure-hearted mom, and most importantly her two Iranian best friends Nadia and Setareh, who arrive on Cape Cod for a wedding weekend full of opinions, chaos, and drama with their own American boyfriends. Just as total disaster approaches, the three women come together in a transformative moment of acceptance, growth, and coming of age – evolving this weekend into one that will change them all forever.

events.title: Wishful Thinking
events.description: Julia and Charlie, a volatile couple in Portland, Oregon, are at a loss for how to repair their broken relationship. Julia, an ambitious game designer, and Charlie, a struggling musician working in sound design to pay the bills, are pushed by Julia's friend into attending a couples-therapy seminar run by twin healers, the Tillies, who claim to fix relationships through energy work. The session triggers a karmic universal system that makes the state of their relationship affect the world around them. With earthquakes, the stock market, and entire nations at risk, Charlie and Julia must confront whether their love can survive amidst so much destruction.

events.title: Electric Enemy
events.description:
Electric Enemy is the alternative rock project of London-based multi-instrumentalist and three-time award-winning songwriter Jim Lawton. Fusing the raw power of Muse, Royal Blood and Foo Fighters with sharp social commentary and introspective lyricism, Electric Enemy deliver a high-energy sound built for modern rock stages.

With 15M+ streams, multiple sold-out tours, #1 and #3 European iTunes Rock chart positions, eight weeks in Germany’s Top Rock Radio chart, and a #1 spot on TikTok’s GSA Rock playlist, the band has quickly established itself as a standout international live act.

Renowned for their explosive performances, Electric Enemy were personally invited to support Jerry Cantrell on tour across Europe, with Lawton requested to duet on Cantrell’s iconic Rooster at the London Shepherd’s Bush Empire finale. Recent headline and showcase performances across Italy and Germany have further accelerated their global momentum.

Outside the band, Lawton is an in-demand multi genre writer-producer for Universal-Sony + his music secured multiple sync placements with Netflix, ESPN, Disney+ WarnerBros+Gibson Guitars. “Is this the best live band in the UK”? - Sat Bisla - A & R Worldwide

events.title: The Reverent Few
events.description: The Reverent Few emerged from Chicago’s blues scene and have called Austin home for over a decade. They are a band bound  by shared history, raw honesty, and a lived-in belief in the power of music to connect and heal. With voices that carry like old hymns and instrumentation that cuts with both grit and grace, their songs aren’t just played, they’re inhabited. There’s gospel in the bones, blues in the breath, and rock and roll in the resolve. Their debut album, Ain’t No Place to Be (2020), was recorded in Dripping Springs and released through Bearpath Records. It's an eight-track collection steeped in soul both sonically and spiritually featuring contributions from Anthony Farrell of The Greyhounds. Critics praised its emotional weight and its blend of warmth, pain, and resilience. Their latest single, The World Will Be Wood to You, recorded live to tape at DogStar Studios, is a raw, analog meditation on loss and grace. Written during quiet reckonings and bedside goodbyes, it holds ache and light in equal measure. It's an offering, a gesture toward gentleness in a fractured world. The Reverent Few remind us that tenderness still matters, that community still holds.

events.title: Cure for Paranoia
events.description:
Formed in the heart of Dallas but born on the highway, Cure for Paranoia came together during a “doomsday road trip” intended to be their last. Having recently been diagnosed with bipolar paranoid schizophrenia, frontman Cameron McCloud found clarity in a hot-boxed rental car; making music with collaborators Jay Analog and Tomahawk Jonez gave him peace of mind. “He said, ‘this is my cure for paranoia.’ Instantly, everyone’s eyes lit up,” a pivotal realization that cemented the group’s moniker. When the predicted earth-shattering meteor failed to hit, inspiration struck instead. As Jonez recalls, “On the way from Amarillo to Colorado Springs, like eight songs got written.”

Since then, Cure for Paranoia has shared bills with icons ranging from George Clinton & Parliament Funkadelic and Nas to Ludacris and Leon Bridges. Their resume includes stops at SXSW, Fortress Festival, and the NPR Tiny Desk Contest "On The Road" Tour, solidifying their status as festival favorites. While keen to distance themselves from standard regional production, they cultivated a signature "Trippy Soul infused hip hop" sound—a blend prioritized on their anchor project, the Work of A.R.T. EP.

events.title: Marty
events.description: Marty, is an independent artist, producer, and entrepreneur based in Los Angeles. With over 1 billion streams he runs Apollo Records, a creative label built on craftsmanship, faith, and long-game thinking, blending music, design, and culture into a cohesive vision.

events.title: Stages
events.description: It's make or break time for Ben Garza as he embarks on his solo first tour after the collapse of his band. By his side are Rita, his former tour manager stepping away from her stable life to help him, and Parker, a remaining bandmate who joins Ben as a utility player. However, Rita also secures Jessie Ramos as the opening act, a rising star whose sudden surge in popularity will completely destabilize Ben. Throughout this musical odyssey, Ben will face characters on the road who challenge his ideas of success, relevance, and purpose. Some encounters offer hope; others deepen his doubt. By the tour’s end, Ben must decide whether to keep chasing the life he once had—or chart a new path forward.
