events.title: Lola Young
events.venue: Austin City Limits Live at the Moody Theater

events.title: Alien Chicks
events.description:
Alien Chicks are a trio hailing from the streets of South London, known for their electrifying blend of punk, rap and jazz. They create a sound that is raw and innovative, capturing the spirit of London's underground music culture. The line-up features the vocals and sharp guitar work of Josef Lindsay, the pulsating basslines of Stefan Parker-Steele and the explosive drumming of Martha Daniels. Whether delivering rapid-fire rap verses, intricate jazz-inspired bass riffs, or thunderous punk rhythms, Alien Chicks continue to push boundaries and defy expectations, drawing praise from The Independent, NME, Rolling Stone, and Radio 1.

The band’s journey began in grassroots venues across the city, in particular The Windmill, Brixton, where their high-energy performances and unique sound helped them build a loyal following. With huge momentum following their biggest London headliner yet at The Garage, following a sold out Oslo Hackney, four iconic sets at The Great Escape, 2000 Trees and Glastonbury. They have also toured with English Teacher, Lambrini Girls, The Libertines and Big Special.

Alien Chicks' music is a testament to their diverse influences and fearless approach to genre.

events.title: Big Bill
events.description:
Austin's ripping, idiosyncratic Big Bill forges their own darkly comedic brand of philosophical post-punk. Vocalist Eric Braden conjures weirdo underdog characters, often in deadpan wit, while Alan Lauer plays scarily spring-loaded bass lines, Alex Riegelman scratches crazily on guitar, and ex-White Denim Jeff Olson pummels his drums with elegant aplomb. The result of this combination is a legendary live show, fueled by what has been called “climbing-up-the-rafters energy.”

After being named Best Punk Band at the 43rd Austin Music Awards, Big Bill dropped their fourth full-length album, Sick Myth, November 2025 on Todo Records-- distilling the band's politically righteous, hook-laden approach down to its purest essence yet.

events.title: congratulations
events.description:
congratulations are a hall of mirrors party troop. they are devils and tarts in equal measure. they lock their horns and then spin round and round and round until dizzy cacophony erupts. sugarcane hooks vs. slaughterhouse screams. taut, fizzing guitars & caustic electronics nipping at the heels of huge fuzz bass & booming percussive grooves. leah is the green one. jamie is dressed in blue. greg’s red, james is yellow. they’re here to move you.

Bursting onto the scene with a kinetic new sound, congratulations have quickly garnered a reputation for their raw energy, tight instrumentation and electrifying live performances. With punchy melodies and infectious hooks, congratulations deliver a mix of anthemic and experimental sounds fusing art-rock, garage, synth-pop and post-punk. The band’s lyrics explore themes of modern life, love, and self-discovery, delivered with a compelling honesty and emotion. congratulations’ fresh take on familiar sounds has earned them critical acclaim and a devoted and rapidly-growing fanbase, positioning them as one of the UK’s most exciting up-and-coming acts.

Signed to Bella Union records, with the bands debut album "Join Hands" due for release on February 13th. 

Having gained support previously from BBC Radio 1 and BBC 6Music including a live session for 6Music for Marc Riley.  Previous supporters of congratulations include Iggy Pop, Craig Charles, Nick Grimshaw, Chris Hawkins and Jess Izzatt.
events.venue: British Music Embassy @ Palm Door on Sixth Patio

events.title: Grandmaster
events.description:
GRANDMASTER

The Grandmaster is an intergalactic traveler of time and space, writing all that he has witnessed down in a text known as the Sacred Prophecy. He has made a name for himself collecting sacred artifacts across the lands of gods and men.

This cohort of nine seasoned musicians and creatives proudly rallies as The Grandmaster’s “Zealots,” performing his “ritualistic funk” compositions as their songs. 

The Zealots are prominent Texas artists:
Zealot Brown (Bass)
Zealot Casey (Harp, Vocoder, Modular Synthesis)
Zealot Decker (percussion)
Zealot Dow (Guitar)
Zealot Eldred (Piano, Organ, Synthesizer, Vocals)
Zealot Harding-Sloan (Vocals, Vocal Effects)
Zealot Leon (Piano, Electric Piano, Clavinet, Vocals)
Zealot Mizell (Drums, Vocals, CGI)

The group’s ranks include members of Sexpop, Hey Cowboy!, Rusty Dusty, Narcissus Garden, Dodo, Billy Glitter, and more. 

Grandmaster released their self-titled debut LP on May 3rd, 2024, produced by the great Nolan Potter of Nolan Potter's Nightmare Band. It was recorded at Electric Deluxe records in Austin, TX, with esteemed engineer Will Grantham.

Their new album “Grandmaster II” just released! 

Instagram: @grandmaster

events.title: Holly Macve
events.description:
Holly Macve is an Irish-born, English-raised singer, songwriter, and producer known for her cinematic, haunting sound that blends Americana, alt-country, and dream pop. Described by Record Collector as “an ethereal offspring of Nick Cave blessed with the stark musical backdrop of Johnny Cash’s ‘American’ series of recordings,” she has spent the last decade penning immersive anthems of love, loss, and spiritual searching - revealing a born storyteller with a deep longing for human experience and a romantic curiosity about the world around her.

It’s no wonder her talents caught the attention of Lana Del Rey who, after featuring on Holly’s single ‘Suburban House’, declared her “one of the most beautiful singing voices in the world.”

With a voice described as “celestial” by The Line of Best Fit, Macve moves between fragility and force, writing timeless melodies that explore heartbreak, escape, and existential longing.

Following three critically acclaimed albums, Holly has relocated to the US and is currently recording her fourth studio album.

events.title: I Got Bombed at Harvey's
events.description: In 1980, an ingenious boobie-trapped ticking time bomb - filled with 1,000 pounds of dynamite - was wheeled in the front doors of Harvey’s Wagon Wheel Casino in Lake Tahoe. Along with the bomb was a note demanding $3 million within 24 hours. While the bomb squad attempts to disarm the explosive, the FBI races the clock to deliver the ransom and simultaneously catch the extortionists. Nothing goes as planned, and each step uncovers darker secrets and suspicions of a deeper motive.

events.title: I Got Bombed at Harvey's
events.description: In 1980, an ingenious boobie-trapped ticking time bomb - filled with 1,000 pounds of dynamite - was wheeled in the front doors of Harvey’s Wagon Wheel Casino in Lake Tahoe. Along with the bomb was a note demanding $3 million within 24 hours. While the bomb squad attempts to disarm the explosive, the FBI races the clock to deliver the ransom and simultaneously catch the extortionists. Nothing goes as planned, and each step uncovers darker secrets and suspicions of a deeper motive.

events.title: Kill Me
events.description: Jimmy wakes up in a bathtub filled with his own blood, his wrists slit and his life rapidly nearly completion. This would be a textbook failed suicide attempt, only…Jimmy didn’t do it? At least, he’s pretty sure he didn’t. Alongside Margot, the 911 operator who took his call that faithful night, Jimmy begins an amateur-hour murder investigation, desperate to prove that this is a whodunnit and not a hedunnit. The list of suspects who might be happy if Jimmy wasn’t around anymore is fairly long—angry ex-girlfriends, frustrated siblings, exasperated psychiatrists, and resentful stepfathers. But the prime suspect is Jimmy himself.

events.title: Oscar Twins
events.description: Oscar Twins are an alternative/post-punk band from Turin, Italy. After a period of writing and perfecting their songs, the band recorded the 9 tracks that became their self-titled debut album. released in 2025 by We Were Never Being Boring, and representing the synthesis of the band's musical maturity and self determination.

events.title: The Sophs
events.description: The Sophs is a multi-genre six-piece hailing from Los Angeles, California, who’s confessional lyrics and nostalgic instrumentation make a statement regardless of whether they intend to or not

events.title: Yung Bryse
events.description: Yung Bryse is an Austin, TX–based Southern hip-hop artist, known for his consistent presence within the SXSW ecosystem. As a recurring showcasing artist, Bryse has become a staple in the city’s underground hip-hop scene—recognized for both his music and his entrepreneurial drive. As a local advocate, he focuses on building bridges between the streets and the music industry, earning recognition from outlets like The Austin Chronicle and appearing in SXSW-related lineups and events across the city. Yung Bryse represents the grit, culture, and forward motion of Austin’s hip-hop community.

events.title: Ali Almighty
events.description:
Ali Almighty, born Aaliyah Ashante White, is a rising rapper from Greenville, TX, proudly known as the "Queen of da 903." Her music blends Southern rap with contemporary sounds, creating a unique and captivating style that resonates with a diverse audience.  
Her latest album, *EA$T TX $HAWTY*, showcases her lyrical talent and storytelling, offering authentic narratives rooted in her experiences. With compelling beats and insightful lyrics, she is quickly gaining recognition in the rap community.  
Beyond music, Ali Almighty actively engages with her growing fanbase on social media, sharing her journey and connecting with supporters. Her strong online presence has helped build a dedicated following eager for her next move.  
Inspired daily by her family, Ali Almighty is a testament to resilience—never willing to give up or give in. Focused on making a lasting impact, she continues pushing boundaries, representing her East Texas roots with powerful and authentic music.

events.title: Monitor
events.description: Maggie works as a content moderator for VueQ Moderation Services, spending her days filtering the internet’s darkest content, driven by guilt over her sister's suicide.  When Maggie blocks a cryptic video uploaded by an anonymous user, she and her team begin to be hunted by an insidious entity that haunts them through every screen in their lives.

events.title: The Animeros
events.description:
With musical notes that span well beyond genres like bolero, psychedelic, and cumbia, The Animeros not only make their audience hit the dance floor, but they also invite their listeners and tastemakers alike to a glimpse of their rich cultural upbringing.  

The group who is made up of Nick Tozzo (drummer and percussionist), Nicolas Sanchez (bassist), and Mauro Lopez (guitarist) craft a genre-blending sound that drifts between the lush jungles of Colombia, the palm-lined streets of 1960s coastal Mexico, and the dusty cantinas of West Texas.

Their journey took an unexpected turn when their music reached the ears of Dan Auerbach, (The Black Keys). Auerbach first heard them by chance, music floating from an open hotel window that stopped him in his tracks. They are now signed to Auerbach’s Easy Eye Sound label.  

“I feel like it's only a matter of time for these guys and for the music that they play. All they have to do is be themselves,” Auerbach said. “They're playing the kind of music that they can play forever until they're 100 years old because it's rooted in history, but it's very much in the present.”

events.title: Tipa Tipo
events.description: Tipa Tipo fuses '70s soft rock and disco with Latin rhythms to create their fresh take on tropical yacht rock en español. Praised by KEXP for their "spellbinding rhythms, infectious pop hooks and endless grooves," the power trio serves up a bilingual sonic landscape that makes you want to dance and think.  Fronted by co-producers Adele Fournet and Felipe Wurst, with Jordan Auber on drums and percussion.

events.title: Derek Minor
events.description: Derek Minor is a 2x Grammy-winning American Christian rapper, singer, songwriter, record producer, entrepreneur, actor, and screenwriter known for his impactful contributions to Christian hip-hop. His music blends faith, social issues, personal growth, and life experience into lyricism aimed at both entertainment and spiritual reflection.

events.title: Grind
events.description:
This horror anthology tackles the modern work landscape through four timely perspectives – the hustle culture of an MLM, the endless repetitiveness of a food delivery driver, the online horrors of a content moderator, and the unionization of a familiar-feeling coffee shop. "Grind" shows what it means to be a worker in a world defined by wealth inequality and ruled by endlessly greedy oligarchs, one not so far removed from our own. 

This is a film for anyone who's ever hated their job, had a bad boss, or felt taken advantage of at work. In other words, it's a film for all of us.

events.title: Sinner Supper Club
events.description:
Nora is late. Alice unceremoniously brought her partner, whose name no one can remember. Jayae doesn't want to be around "these" people...but came anyway? And Genevieve, the host, has put an unhealthy amount of pressure on this eviction funeral (kinda cringe, right?) to solve all of their problems. 

As they barrel through the evening, this disintegrating friend group, delirious from the heat and lack of food, desperately throws Hail Marys, caution to the wind, and lamb against the wall, trying to harness some semblance of what they used to have.

...and then their dead friend shows up.

events.title: The Haunted Youth
events.venue: British Music Embassy @ Palm Door on Sixth

events.title: Mama Duke
events.description: Fresh off the national spotlight of America’s Got Talent, Mama Duke has emerged as one of the most commanding voices in music and culture today. As a Season 20 finalist, she earned Mel B’s coveted Golden Buzzer, launching her straight into the finals and into living rooms across the country. In that historic run, she became the first female rapper ever to reach the Top 10 in the show’s history—shattering expectations and proving that rap can be stadium-sized, deeply vulnerable, and undeniably powerful all at once. Comparisons to icons like Missy Elliott followed, but Mama Duke made it clear. She’s not here to imitate, she’s here to redefine.

events.title: Glassio
events.description: Glassio is the Dream-Pop–tinged Indie-Dance project of Irish-Iranian songwriter and producer Sam R. Blending melodic sweetness with brooding dance beats, his self-described “melancholy disco” sound has earned over 25 million streams and global acclaim. Since emerging with the viral 2016 EP Poptimism (whose single “Try Much Harder” hit No. 9 on Spotify’s Global Viral Chart), Glassio has toured internationally with acts like Clap Your Hands Say Yeah, Nada Surf, and Electric Youth, and released two acclaimed LPs—For the Very Last Time (2020, Downtown Music) and See You Shine (2022)—with songs featured on Netflix and HBO. Raised between the Middle East and California and later based in New York and London, Sam draws influence from New Wave, 60s chamber pop, and early-2000s electronica, channeling it into rich, cinematic pop. His upcoming third album, The Imposter (2026), written during his move from New York to London, fuses shoegaze, folk, and dream pop in a neo-noir exploration of self-confrontation and creative rebirth. “I wanted this album to make people ask if they’re living the life they’re meant to,” he says. “For me, this is about rediscovering who I am as an artist.

events.title: indie tribe
events.description: Indie Tribe is an influential independent Christian hip-hop collective founded in 2016 by rapper nobigdyl.. Currently, the group consists of nobigdyl., Mogli the Iceburg, Jon Keith, DJ Mykael V, and Torey D'Shaun. Known for their high-energy, collaborative, and authentic style, they blend diverse musical influences with faith-based lyrics to bring glory to God. In 2026, they are set to release their first album since 2023, along with a full tour & their 6th annual festival, Holy Smoke.

events.title: Angela Autumn
events.description: Angela Autumn is a songwriter and banjo player from a forgotten steel town. Strongly tied to the buried stories of her childhood, her dark country songs reinvent folk tradition through the lens of eco-feminist transcendentalism. The singer’s straightforward lack of pretension speaks from the vantage point of the outsider— and, often — the sounds of the unspoken.

events.title: Grandmas House
events.description:
Grandmas House, Bristol’s finest and loudest 4 piece, have been busy honing their grunge and post-punk influenced sound. With an attack that is both relentless and melodic, the all-female band are a genuinely unique proposition - refusing to be pigeon holed, they are here to shake up perceptions with their intelligent, stylish and raucous take on rock music.

Citing influences from Nirvana to Porridge Radio and Idles to boygenius, the band have been developing their dynamic songwriting. The music moves between aggressive and heavy instrumentation and slower, more melodic passages, creating a powerful contrast. They use their voices to create layered harmonies and the result is a unique and expansive sound.

The band have supported Idles, Big Special, Katy J Pearson and Arxx. They’ve been championed by BBC Introducing and BBC Radio 1 and have had BBC 6 Music support from Steve Lamacq, Emily Pilbeam and Amy Lamé.

events.title: Lofi Legs
events.description:
Conceived in the waters of Arroyo Seco, forged in the Bay Area DIY scene,
Lofi Legs is an SF-based band whose rotating members always includes Paris
Cox-Farr writing songs about falling in love, dropping acid, and being nowhere
and everywhere at once. Starry-eyed love ballads share space with broken hearts
and killer guitars.

events.title: NIGHT DRIVE
events.description:
“Exactly the kind of glossy, echoed Interpol and Lower Dens vibes that are ideal to put on while rocketing down the interstate at 90mph in the dead of night.” — Spin Magazine

Night Drive transforms cinematic sci-fi landscapes into high-impact synth-pop. Their emotive style fuses shadowed textures and reflective lyrics with soaring hooks and driving beats, creating a sleek, kinetic sound that has resonated across film, television, and radio worldwide.
Touring alongside Crystal Castles, CHVRCHES, Ladytron, ACTORS and The Psychedelic Furs, the group has built a reputation for immersive live performances that resonate long after the final note. New releases arriving very soon.

events.title: Olivia Ellen Lloyd
events.description:
Olivia Ellen Lloyd will try anything once. From flight attendant school in Dallas to producing theater in New York City and teaching in Guatemala, Lloyd sought an adventurous life, but struggled to find a greater sense of purpose. That is, until she found her way back to music. Lloyd channels her restless spirit into songs that pay homage to her Appalachian roots while charting fresh territory for a sound that is uniquely her own. 

Heavily influenced by country, folk, and indie rock, Lloyd’s sound combines the rooted sounds of her traditional Appalachian upbringing with the fly-by-the-seat-of-your-pants nature of her current life. She is inspired by the rich sounds of New York City, the peaceful quiet of her small West Virginia hometown, and life on the road in between.

Her 2025 sophomore record "Do It Myself" landed her debut appearances at Mountain Stage, Americana Fest, and Brooklyn Folk Festival and her debut album, Loose Cannon, has been streamed over 1 million times while Olivia has been busy crossing the country opening for artists like Kelsey Waldon, Tommy Prine, and Jobi Riccio, winning songwriting contests (Kerrville in 2023), and generally eating life down to the rind.

events.title: Bricknasty
events.description:
Conflict is interesting in art. It forces conversations, and asks questions that often still need to be answered. On “Black’s Law”, the third body of work from Irish quintet Bricknasty, some of society’s most complex topics are explored — religion, political disillusionment, nationalism, human mentality. For mercurial frontman/guitarist Fatboy and co, it’s less about seeing the light themselves — and more pointing others in the right direction.

The winding road to releasing the nine-track project has been arduous but enriching. After forming while studying at BIMM university in Dublin, the five initial members of the band, including the aforementioned masked maverick Fatboy, production whizz Cillian McCauley and drummer Korey Thomas, released their debut EP “INA CRUELER” via FAMM (Jorja Smith, Maverick Sabre) in June 2023, turning heads critically and garnering a loyal fan base with its idiosyncratic style and soulful tonal core. 

Their inaugural project was a stinging reflection of Fatboy’s life in Ballymun, the troubled North Dublin estate where he grew up, and a vivid rumination of the familial turmoil and crippling addiction he endured during his young adulthood. But the band’s follow up mixtape a year later was “just songs,” the frontman says. That’s even what they named it — or “XONGZ አስቀያሚ ጡብ” to be precise.  

Although by no means a sub par end product, Bricknasty internally were never quite content with “XONGZ”; and the assembling of the mixtape proved a tumultuous time for McCauley and Fatboy’s personal and professional relationship, having fallen out in the process of making its predecessor “INA CRUELER”. “[XONGZ”] wasn't really a hard thing to pull off,” the latter says. “Me and Cillian, we felt like we didn't give the best account of ourselves. We didn't push ourselves as hard as we should have.” 

When it came to approaching this latest, third outing, the band hit the reset button. Both Fatboy and McCauley were working on music individually, but were struggling to progress beyond initial ideas. So the pair decided to escape from the drudgery of the everyday in order to gain some perspective, and booked a B&B in Ard Mhaca on the Irish border to tackle the starting foundations of the new work. 

The process was reminiscent of the early days of their artistic partnership; a time prior to Bricknasty’s genesis when, having stumbled upon each other on Soundcloud as teens, they’d have stints making music in each other’s bedrooms until the early hours. The full circle return to this familiar DIY process rejuvenated the duo’s vision, and the roots of “Black’s Law” were born.

The entire project was made in six months — only six of those days were spent in a professional recording studio. Two of those months were spent on tour. “It was a huge amount of work that we had to get done in a tiny amount of time,” Fatboy recalls. “It was a bit too much for everyone to be honest.” With much to do, limited time and pressures high, the band hit a tipping point. Founding members — bassist Dara Abdurahman and keyboard/saxophonist Louis Younge bowed out of the collective, now replaced by Sam Healy and Chris LaMotte. 

Despite the difficult turn of events, the remaining Nasties plowed forward to finish “Black’s Law”, largely thanks to the symbiotic musical bond between Fatboy and McCauley. The producer holds the craft and patience to condense his frontman’s volatile creativity, chiseling his bursts of genius into a digestible palette. “I can spin my wheels until the cows come home,” Fatboy laughs. “Cillian definitely is like the Quincy Jones. He finds the right spot for the right thing. I'll come in aggressive from the out go and start dancing and moving around and just trying to find stuff.”

“When it gets real sweaty,” McCauley takes over, “when it gets hot in the room, sometimes you just need to be able to see the take. That is the job.” 

His counterpart interjects: “I’m in the heat of the chase. I have to make mistakes. I'm obligated to shit the bed. 

The testing creative process was ultimately worth its endeavour. Rip-roaringly ambitious in its song structures, “Black’s Law” crams vast sonic and thematic themes into sharp, groove-laden, often luscious compositions that never end as they begin. The musical variety is wide-spanning — from the house-tinged varnish of “imperret illi deus " to the wonderful Irish trad folk on “is é a locht a laghad”, and a hardcore edge on the backend of “go get that blade”. The EP plays out like a musical encyclopaedia, stunningly original with an almost competitive edge to its eclectic interior; a desire to “put the audience in the tumble-drier and stamp on their neck,” Fatboy jokes.

The frontman’s lyricism is instinctively written and delivered through pained gasps and vibrato’d whispers. His words put religion at the centre, the foundations of such narrative stemming from his own finding of God in the darkest of times. Stricken by drug and alcohol ad...
events.venue: British Music Embassy @ Palm Door on Sixth Patio

events.title: Julie Nolen
events.description:
Julie Nolen is a Texas-based singer-songwriter whose music blends raw storytelling with the grit of rock & roll. Born under the wide-open skies of West Texas, her songs carry the dust of desert highways and the resilience of those who call them home. A proud voice in queer country, Julie brings authenticity to a genre rooted in tradition, proving that country music is for everyone.

In 2025, she was an official SXSW artist, showcasing her dynamic live performance. Now, she’s rolling out a five-song project leading up to a full EP drop in time for AmericanaFest in September. The lead single, “Love Me When I’m Leaving,” sets the tone for a collection of songs that explore the beauty and heartbreak of moving on.

Whether playing an intimate acoustic set or leading a full band, Julie delivers music that’s as honest as it is powerful. 

Little bit moody, little bit soulful country, a little in your face, unapologetic, bold.

events.title: Sultanes del Yonke
events.description: Born on the frontera, Sultanes del Yonke channels the chaos, color, and rhythm of the border into a sound built from the unexpected. As they prepare to promote their debut album, due in April, the band is evolving its sound — keeping their regional rhythms and DIY spirit while weaving in samples, drum machines, and experimental, dance-driven styles. This collision of influences does true justice to the yonke in their name: raw, eclectic, and born from the beautiful chaos of the border. Recent milestones include a tour supporting Tropa Mágica and a standout performance at SXSW, solidifying their expanding live footprint.

events.title: Holy Gabbana
events.description:
John Robert Hill Jr. (b. August 3, 1996), better known by his stage name Holy Gabbana, is a rapper coming out of Jacksonville, Florida.

In December of 2018, John was sentenced to 5 months in county jail and had a life changing experience. He began to grow an understanding of Jesus Christ due to his cellmate, which ultimately led him to getting saved and starting a Christian hip hop career. He released his first single as a Christian rapper, “Holy Flow” in August 2022.

events.title: DD Island
events.description: DD Island is a Brooklyn-based folk-rock band, formed in 2023 over a shared love of analog recording. Drawing on the familiarity of '60s and '70s West Coast country and psychedelic rock, DD Island still pulses with a brightness and grit that is grounded in present-day New York. The band’s debut LP, “Setting Sun” is due in Spring 2026.

events.title: Agatha is Dead!
events.description:
Formed in the lockdown winter of 2021, Agatha Is Dead! began as a post-punk experiment between longtime friends Lilly and Noah, who first made music together in their school days. Their shared love for Joy Division, The Cure, Molchat Doma, and Fontaines D.C. laid the foundation for their darkly urgent sound. With the addition of drummer Joey Ramone Hansen−bringing grunge and pop−punk bite−and Arthur on bass, the band played their first shows in 2022 and quickly carved out a place in Berlin's underground scene.

The band signed to Berlin label Duchess Box Records in May 2025 and will release their debut EP "order" in on 10th October.

The first singles drew attention from big online magazines such as Post-Punk.com and Diffus as well as major radio station airplay and big playlist support from Spotify and Apple Music.

This September, the band will embark on their first-ever headline tour with shows in Berlin and Leipzig selling out in advance., marking a new chapter in their journey. Their Berlin show at Privatclub sold out an incredible five months in advance, underscoring the growing excitement surrounding the band.

Drawing further inspiration from The Pretty Reckless, DIIV, Liily, and Bloc Party, Agatha Is Dead! have honed a sound that is heavy, hypnotic, and deeply emotional. With their debut EP Order on the horizon, the band are staking their claim in the next wave of alternative rock−grabbing hearts, shaking stages, and refusing to go unnoticed.

events.title: DJ Trendsetter Sense + Trendsetter Cypher
events.description:
DJ Sense, a founding member of "The Aphilliates,
" gained recognition as Trendsetter
Sense. Co Creator of the famous brand “Gangsta Grillz & Gangsta Grillz Radio,
landing shows on Eminem's Shade 45 and Atlanta's Hot 107.9, reaching over 30
million listeners. He then produced the mixtape series"Rhythm &
Streets”,collaborating with artists like Monica, Chris Brown, T Pain, Akon, Usher,
K.Michelle & more. In 2016, he partnered with Lil Jon, managing his worldwide tour.
Trendsetter expands his influence with Chosen Journey, a new chapter in his brand
that merges Faith, Music and Culture. Through this platform, he uplifts artist
perspectives in modern media while embracing a transformative path rooted in
faith based and purpose driven living.
Chosen Journey made history with the first ever Christian Hip Hop set at Rolling
Loud Miami 2024. Returning with CHOSEN JOURNEY PART II ROLLING LOUD ORLANDO 2026.
The Rise of Christian Hip Hop has opened a powerful new door
that a new generation desires to be filled with a message of fullfillment and
inspiration. Catch Trendsetter Sense’s Chosen Journey shows every Sunday from 8-
10am ET on HOT 107.9 ATL and SiriusXM Hip Hop Nation 10-12p ET.

events.title: Firecracker
events.description:
Firecracker is a punk rock’n’roll outfit from Bologna, Italy,
born in 2020. Their sound fuses the raw edge of punk
with grunge‑driven moods and a straight‑ahead,
no‑nonsense attitude. After a lineup shake‑up in 2023,
the band tightened its direction, keeping its trademark
grit while pushing for richer, more dynamic
arrangements. April 2025 saw the release of their new
EP Not Your City, a record that captures Firecracker’s
evolution and marks a new chapter in their sonic
journey.

events.title: Honey Made
events.description: Austin’s Honey Made delivers a modern, high-energy spin on vintage soul -and funk, channeling legends like James Brown, Sly and the Family Stone, and Earth, Wind & Fire while staying rooted in rich R&B traditions. Honey Made calls its take on contemporary RnB, Texas RnB.  It is RnB with Texas Heat. Named Best Live Band in Austin by Austin Fit Magazine twice in a row, the band’s dynamic performances have earned them multiple official SXSW showcases, and stages alongside Karl Denson’s Tiny Universe, The Soul Rebels, Funk You, and The Spin Doctors. With acclaimed releases including Brand New, Charge It To The Band Fund, and Pass Me By, Honey Made is quickly expanding their reach beyond Austin with their infectious hooks, fearless funk grooves, and a sound that invites every listener into the fold.

events.title: Reilly Downes
events.description:
Reilly Downes is a torchbearer of modern heartbreak, blending rustbelt grit with cosmic country soul. Hailing from Texas and now rooted in the Chicago music scene, she’s made a name for herself with her “small, but mighty” voice and songs that cut to the bone. Downes has shared the stage with artists like Maggie Rose, Kaitlin Butts, and Jaime Wyatt, and has been featured in Rollingstone.

With a background in both the Americana and indie circuits, Reilly delivers raw, emotionally charged performances with her band, The Acid Cowboys. Her songs, like sad polaroids of  love and loss, explore themes of queer identity, grief, and survival.

She is currently in the process of recording her sophomore album with executive production by Jaime Wyatt who has worked alongside Butch Walker, Shooter Jennings, The Black Pumas, and more.

events.title: Sassy 009
events.description:
Sassy 009 is the shape-shifting project from Oslo-based producer, songwriter and vocalist Sunniva Lindgård. After finding early acclaim as a trio with 2017’s Do You Mind EP, Sassy 009 rebooted as a solo vehicle in 2019, later evolving into 2021’s sultry, bass-driven Heart Ego mixtape. But for Lindgård, her album Dreamer+ is her true debut: a concept-driven album pieced together from nearly four years of studio effort, and an ambitious attempt to take complete control of her artistry. Steered by freshly distorted vocals and elements of grunge, shoegaze, ‘90s beatronica and gauzy hyperpop, the album is a record of self-discovery and self-effacement at once, studded with guest contributions from Blood Orange, BEA1991 and Yunè Pinku.

Since the release of Dreamer+ in January, Sassy 009 has sold out her UK and EU tour dates, toured as main support for Blood Orange, had press support from Pitchfork, Stereogum, The FADER, CLASH, CRACK, DAZED and more.. she's collaborated with US rap superstar Don Toliver by adding vocals to his track 'Pleasures Mine' from his Billboard no.1 album 'Octane'. 2026 has a lot more in store for Sassy 009.
events.venue: British Music Embassy @ Palm Door on Sixth

events.title: Lucky
events.description:
Growing up in Staghorn Flat, Victoria, Lucky burst onto the scene in flurry of fuzzy guitars
and captivating storytelling. Blending the raw energy of alternative rock, with the dreamy
haze of modern indie, her music captures the nuances of life's everyday moments and
dives deep, putting you right at the centre of her world.

Having supported the likes of The Belair Lip Bombs, Hockey Dad, Armlock and Dear
Seattle, the Melbourne based artist is set for an exciting 2026 - following the release of
her single ‘Lady Beetle’, Lucky is building a devoted audience who are eagerly waiting to
see what’s in store next.

events.title: Samy Sharif
events.description:
Samy Sharif moved to Los Angeles in mid 2023 to launch a solo effort after having spent the prior decade in the Chicago-based Alternative quartet, Bonelang. 

In 2024, he released three albums (House of Failure, House of Fix, and House of Bliss) that were then put together and re-released as one large body of work entitled Three Houses. 
​
​Samy is a first generation Egyptian/Irish artist; New York born and Chicago raised. He is a published poet, songwriter, and an aspiring writer/director.

events.title: The Braymores
events.description: The Braymores are an Alternative/Folk Rock group hailing from Chicago, IL. The group features members Matt Tilles (Vocals/Guitar), Keegan Melaniphy (Guitar), Russell Oren (Drums), and Connor Kohanzo (Bass). The band released their first EP ‘Talking to Trees’ in late 2023 followed by their debut LP ‘Who You’d Have Been’ in late 2024, receiving considerable underground buzz and cementing their position in the Chicago scene.

events.title: Calder Allen
events.description:
Born and raised in Austin, Texas, Calder Allen is a fifth-generation Texan whose music reflects the deep roots and creative spirit of his upbringing. Influenced by his artist grandparents, Terry and Jo Harvey Allen, Calder grew up surrounded by authentic artistic expression. Originally set on becoming a fly-fishing guide, he turned to songwriting during the 2020 pandemic, leading to his debut album The Game, produced by mentor Charlie Sexton.
With his new album, Fault Lines, recorded at Austin’s legendary Arlyn Studios with Sexton and Jacob Sciba, Calder delivers his most personal work yet—a cinematic exploration of love, loss, and self-discovery. Featuring contributions from Martie Maguire, Jon Randall, and Jack Ingram, the record captures the emotional depth and honesty at the heart of his songwriting.
A commanding live performer, Calder has shared stages with Cody Jinks, Turnpike Troubadours, Miranda Lambert, and others, earning acclaim at festivals like Austin City Limits, Bonnaroo, and Two Step Inn. With Fault Lines, Calder Allen cements himself as a powerful new voice in Americana, blending Texas tradition with raw, introspective storytelling.

events.title: Secret Family
events.description: Bump the mids and tap the fuzz.  Insert sway, conjure a bounce: jangle, thud, chime. A union hall for proletariat pipe dreams. Soundtracks for the world’s longest lunch break. Friends on amaro. Wind chapped melodies pulled thru the fog conduit. Sounds hung in vaped memory, old friends/new feelings. Music for garbage trucks and the babble of brooks. Anchored in Bay Area garage lust and Montana river rock. Rock for now. Rock however. Taste like always. Rock n’ roll for whomever.

events.title: AJ McQueen
events.description: Starting as a soulful midwestern emcee, 'AJ McQueen has evolved his lyricism, consciousness, and his own life experiences into his music. After finding his rhythm and style, AJ has further developed into an artist who has developed a voice for the people. As AJ looks to the future, he recognizes his musical inspirations ranging from 2Pac, Common, Nas, Lauryn Hill, and Bob Marley. With the purest intent of making an impact, AJ encourages the exercise of freedom, the pursuit of truth, and raising others to their full potential through his music. As a lyrical painter who has been given a world-sized canvas to compose masterpieces. His music is organic, transparent, poetic, challenging, and introspective. As a man of many talents, AJ brings a raw and captivating sound to Hip-Hop.

events.title: ALANN
events.description:
From the heart of Houston, Texas — rooted in Missouri City (Mo City Tx) — ALANN creates music that feels like confession and communion all at once. She began writing at 14, turning teenage thoughts into melodies and finding her voice in the quiet spaces between feeling and faith.
Raised in the church, her sound was shaped by sacred harmonies and Sunday morning soul. What started in the choir grew into a deeper calling — to make music that heals, that lingers, that speaks when words alone fall short.
Blending Neo Soul warmth with tender R&B vulnerability, ALANN doesn’t just sing — she pours. Every lyric is intentional. Every note carries emotion. Her music isn’t just heard… it’s felt.

events.title: Are You Smarter Than a Robot?
events.description: Rivian CEO RJ Scaringe and CrunchLabs Founder Mark Rober host the ultimate autonomous robot challenge. This interactive presentation pits audience members against the robot brainchild RJ and Mark teamed up to build, testing human reactions vs machine learning. Can people compete with computers? How is Rivian approaching autonomy? Are people really that slow?!?!?? We’ll find out.

events.title: bloodsports
events.description:
Taking over the sweaty New York venues and curbside congregations that came to be
synonymous with the name, Bloodsports is set to release their long awaited debut LP Anything
Can Be A Hammer via brand new New York label Good English Records on October 17th.
Bloodsports has become an undeniable force amidst their latest line up, where members Sam
Murphy (guitar/vox), Jeremy Mock (Guitar), Liv Eriksen (bass/vox) and Scott Hale (drums) find
solace in the capitulation of sonic strain; where angular sedition blends with economical
melodies that lighten the load of the self-destruction that these songs embrace. But as bold as
their landscapes have been prior, Anything Can Be A Hammer finds the band embracing a more
dynamic approach, maturing in their techniques as these songs brim over with subtle fixations –
balancing a steady pace of experimentation and curiosity that linger amongst the rhythmic blows
and befuddling depths that the band confidently explores. Fragile, yet abundant, Bloodsports
leans into that patience that plays to our own interior designs, where Murphy’s lyricism is a
notion of both what we know and what we think we know, as it all comes to the fore when our
obsessions are at large. It’s an album that’s got blood in its veins and a finger on the pulse.

events.title: Clova
events.description:
Hailing from the vibrant music hub of South Austin, Texas, Jarrett S. Williams, better known as Clova Rap Game Yoda, has been a dynamic force in the music industry for over a decade. His journey began with the legendary Austin supergroup Die Slo Ent, alongside Sertified, Southside Hippie, and WKDZD, laying a solid foundation for his solo career.
  A staple in the ATX scene, Clova has graced the stages of renowned festivals like SXSW and A3C(ATL), sharing the spotlight with a diverse range of acclaimed artists including  Talib Kweli, Dave Chappelle , Lil Flip, Curren$y , Niko Is, Rah Digga,Mo3, Devin The Dude, Coast Contra  and more. 

 His talent has also garnered attention in the sync licensing world. In 2019, Clova secured a single/sync deal with Crucial Music, landing a placement on OWN Network’s critically acclaimed series "Queen Sugar" with his track "Connect The Dots." This success was followed by another placement in 2020 with the short film "Shadows," which premiered on HBO Max and Hulu. 

With a discography of 16 albums, He is currently immersed in the creation of a highly anticipated new project with Niko Is, under the executive production of the esteemed Chino Chase.

events.title: Don Toliver
events.venue: Billboard Presents The Stage at SXSW

events.title: Enfants
events.description:
Enfants is a four-piece Japanese alternative rock band formed in 2022. Their name, pronounced "En-fant," means "children" in French.

The band’s sound is a raw fusion of primal impulse and liberation, woven with the delicate nuances of Japanese lyrics. They gained momentum in 2023 when their track "Play" went viral. By early 2025, they were named a "Top 10 Artist" by industry pros on national TV, solidifying their place on Japan's viral charts.

A powerhouse live act, Enfants has performed at major festivals like SUMMER SONIC 2024 and expanded internationally to Taiwan and Korea. Following their 2025 SXSW debut, they return to Austin in March 2026, fresh off the release of their new album Bedford Hedgehog (Feb 4) and a sold-out 1,500-capacity show in Tokyo.

Frontman Dai Matsumoto’s songwriting is a defiant resistance against a society that dismisses emotional vulnerability, transforming "weakness" into strength. On stage, their performance is a visceral explosion of pure emotion. Enfants creates anthems for those struggling to find their place, serving as a "quiet revolution" for a generation forced to suppress their feelings.

events.title: FINLANDS
events.description:
“A Voice Like No Other.”

Formed in 2012, FINLANDS is a Tokyo-based indie rock band fronted by distinctive female vocals. Known for sharp songwriting and an emotionally charged sound that bridges alternative rock and melodic pop, the band has steadily expanded its audience since their major-label debut, performing headline shows at mid-to-large venues and appearing at major Japanese festivals.

With a reputation for powerful live performances and a passionate fanbase, FINLANDS continues to grow beyond Japan, strengthening their presence at international showcases, touring circuits, and festival lineups.

Currently, vocalist and guitarist Fuyuko Shioiri serves as the sole official member, performing with supporting musicians. In addition to leading FINLANDS, Shioiri is also active as a songwriter, contributing works to a variety of artists.

events.title: Foolish Ty
events.description: Foolish Ty is a versatile melodic Rap/R&B artist from Austin, Texas. Making his first appearance at SXSW he looks forward to introducing a new audience to his unique sound that has amassed him over 100,000 streams across all platforms.

events.title: Gavin Copeland
events.description: Gavin Copeland is a Texas-based singer and songwriter blending modern pop and hip-hop with Southern-rooted storytelling. Since releasing his debut music in 2025, he has built a rapidly growing audience through organic fan engagement, earning millions of streams and a strong digital following without paid marketing. His songs balance emotional clarity with polished production, positioning him as a notable emerging voice in the independent music space.

events.title: GOKUMON
events.description:
The band 'Uchikubi Gokumon Doukoukai' is a three-piece band formed in Japan in 2004.
While active within Japan under the kanji name '打首獄門同好会' (Uchikubi Gokumon Doukoukai),
representing Japanese culture, they operate internationally under the more easily pronounceable name 'GOKUMON.'

Featuring a mixed-gender lineup with a male guitar/vocalist and a female rhythm section,
the band is known for its unique style that combines a heavy sound with a 7-string guitar and 5-string bass.
This distinctive musical approach, coupled with laid-back lyrics infused with a sense of everyday life, has established a new genre known as 'Seikatsu Micchaku-gata Loud Rock' (Life-Immersed Loud Rock).

In their live performances, the band incorporates VJ (visual jockey) elements,
projecting visuals and lyrics on screens synchronized with the music.
This not only enhances the auditory experience but also provides a visually captivating aspect.

events.title: ISCREAM NEVER GROUND
events.description:
Japanese Super Loud Rock Band, Iscream Never Ground (commonly known as ING), was formed in 2017. 

Blending an intense loud rock foundation with diverse musical elements, ING crafts each song with a unique approach :sometimes incorporating digital sounds, other times featuring wind instruments. 

The electrifying synergy of stormy lyrics, fierce shouts, and the dynamic interplay of male and female triple vocals (Rango, Ziro~, and Miki) fuels a high-energy, danceable rhythm that never lets up, creating a sweat-drenched frenzy akin to a non-stop sports festival. 

Fusing metal, hardcore, punk, and game music influences, ING continues to ignite rock fans worldwide, both online and onstage.

events.title: LilJayFromDaO
events.description:
LilJayFromDaO is a rising reality rap artist from Austin, Texas, known for blending raw street perspective with authentic Texas storytelling. Rooted in real-life experience, his music reflects the resilience, ambition, and culture of the city that shaped him, delivering records that connect across generations and communities. His sound carries the grit of Southern hip-hop while remaining energetic, accessible, and purpose-driven.

Building strong momentum, LilJayFromDaO is a two-time official SXSW artist and has toured across Texas alongside legendary artist Chingo Bling, solidifying his reputation as a powerful live performer. His rise has earned notable recognition, including being named “Next To Blow” by Rap Economics, “Top 20 Texas Latino Artist” by Texas Buzz, and “Top 20 Rap Artist” by AustinStreetsTV.

He's received genuine co-signs from Texas hip-hop icons Paul Wall, Bun B, and Lil Keke, and has worked with artists such as Chingo Bling, GT Garza, Wacotron, Slim Thug, OC Chris, That Mexican OT, Dee Baby, and more. As his platform continues to grow, LilJayFromDaO remains focused on representing Austin with authenticity while pushing Texas hip-hop forward on a national level.

events.title: Next of Kin
events.description:
Next of Kin is an alt-country trio with a sound that blends country-tinged soundscapes, rich three-part harmonies, and honest storytelling. 

In just over a year, what started as a chance collaboration between three solo artists transformed into much more – a budding new band, a full album, an ACL Festival debut. 

Some call it fate, others luck – they call it Next of Kin.

events.title: Redzed
events.description:
REDZED is a Czech rap-metal outlier turning underground chaos into global momentum. Writing and producing everything himself — from raw guitar riffs to hard-hitting beats — he fuses serrated modern rap with the weight of late-’90s/’00s metal. The result is a dark, cinematic crossover that speaks fluent mosh pit and playlist alike.

His 2024 album Tales Of A Necromancer solidified a singular vision, while viral tracks like “Rave In The Grave,” “Meth Phonk,” and “Drugs = Magic” have racked up tens of millions of streams, pushing him past one million monthly Spotify listeners worldwide.

Onstage, REDZED is relentless — sweat-drenched, high-impact, and impossible to ignore. After sold-out headline shows, international tours, and major European festival slots, he arrives ready to turn SXSW into a collision of rap kids and metal die-hards.

Enter the pit.

events.title: REJAY
events.description:
REJAY, singer-songwriter from Niseko, Hokkaido. During her childhood, she was 
influenced by her Australian father and grew up listening to many different genres 
of music. She started writing her melodies and lyrics at the age of 13. With a 
video she uploaded on YouTube, her singing voice attracted the ears of JQ from 
Nulbarich. After she moved to Tokyo, she started her career under the production 
of JQ. She has a one-of-a-kind voice that combines the extremes of shadow and 
transparency.

events.title: Wacotron
events.description:
Wacotron is a Texas trap artist from Waco, Texas, delivering high impact records rooted in authenticity, pressure, and precision. Built from the ground up, his rise reflects a disciplined approach to music, pairing raw street perspective with elite level production and proven performance metrics.

After building organic traction online, Wacotron’s momentum accelerated through his affiliation with Pick Six Records, where his sound sharpened and his reach expanded. His breakout phase was defined by collaborations with producers from the 808 Mafia camp, resulting in hard hitting releases that generated millions of views and streams across digital platforms. These records didn’t just circulate, they converted, placing Wacotron in front of a national audience and solidifying his market viability.

Anchored by dark, bass driven production and a commanding delivery, Wacotron’s catalog speaks directly to trap culture while maintaining crossover appeal. His visuals and singles consistently perform at scale across YouTube and streaming services, reflecting a growing fanbase and long term positioning in today’s dominant trap landscape.

events.title: Z-Wells
events.description:
Z-Wells is a rapper, singer, songwriter, and producer from Houston, born in Alexandria. Blending Hip-Hop, R&B, and Neo-Soul, he pairs soulful melodies with sharp lyricism and a rich, commanding voice. Known for witty wordplay and a gritty yet versatile delivery, his sound bridges Southern soul with universal appeal. Similar to Kendrick Lamar and D’Angelo, he balances intricate storytelling with expressive, layered vocals, creating music that’s both thought-provoking and deeply soulful.

Featured in the Houston Chronicle as one of the city’s “must-see performers,” he’s helping define Houston’s new wave. His freestyle series, Good Company—where he raps over classic records backed by a live drummer—highlights his musicality and commanding stage presence. The series gained major attention when Erykah Badu co-signed and shared a freestyle, cementing him as one of the most exciting rising voices coming out of the city.

events.title: Wellness Mornings at Fairmont Austin
events.description:
Recharge between panels at Fairmont Spa Austin’s SXSW Wellness Mornings. Nestled on the hotel’s 7th floor rooftop cabanas, guests are invited to move through a curated reset featuring Hyperice recovery, Ulu Wellness IV therapy, AG1 ritual shots and Kohler contrast circuits. March 12–14 | 7:00am–12:00pm. Recover with intention. Perform without compromise.

https://www.fairmont-austin.com/events/sxsw-wellness-mornings/

events.title: Podcast Movement Evolutions @ SXSW
events.description:
Join us as we merge Podcast Movement Evolutions with Sounds Profitable’s SXSW presence to create podcasting’s home base at one of the world’s most influential creative festivals. We will be hosting a series of talks, live performances, and networking events throughout the weekend.

More information here: https://evolutions.podcastmovement.com/

events.title: Registration (Downright Austin)
events.description: Pick up your SXSW Badge or Music Wristband on the Capitol View Terrace of the Downright Hotel. Your badge is required in order to attend any sessions, events, or socials.

events.title: Registration (JW Marriott)
events.description: Pick up your SXSW Badge or Music Wristband in Griffin Hall of the JW Marriott. Your badge is required in order to attend any sessions, events, or socials.

events.title: Registration (Omni Austin Hotel - Downtown)
events.description: Pick up your SXSW Badge in the Guadalupe Room of the Omni Downtown. Your badge is required in order to attend any sessions, events, or socials.

events.title: Coffee Break, Cabu Style
events.description:
Experience the latte reimagined!
While most lattes use dairy or alt milks (yawn); Cabu blends cold brew coffee with the creamy part of the cacao bean for a velvety smooth mouthfeel and subtle notes of chocolate. Taste the difference; caffeinate creatively.

events.title: Daily Decode
events.description:
Start your day with clarity.

Each morning, PwC leaders will break down what’s happening on the ground at SXSW and translate it into practical, actionable insights for you and your clients. These 20-minute briefings cut through the noise to surface what matters most across agentic commerce, Gen Alpha, industry convergence, emerging technologies, and evolving consumer behavior.

You’ll leave with a sharper point of view, clear implications for your business, and tangible ways to turn cultural momentum into competitive advantage.

events.title: FuturePIXEL House
events.description:
FuturePIXEL House is a curated SXSW destination exploring how intelligence becomes playable and culture evolves after AI.

Through immersive installations, industry-leading discussions, AI labs, and live performances, we convene global founders, product leaders, investors, and creative technologists shaping media, systems, and cultural movements. Here, pixels become language, and emerging technologies become lived experiences — not just screen, but a practice.

Designed as a high-signal platform for meaningful exchange and cross-industry collaboration, the House enables select partners to integrate their brand into the narrative — not as passive sponsors, but as active contributors shaping what comes next.

For more information, please visit: https://futurepixel.house/

events.title: Laura Geller's Mature Beauty Boutique
events.description: Step into Laura Geller’s Mature Beauty Boutique at the Congress Ave Block Party, a beauty experience designed for confidence at every age. Get expertly shade-matched and receive a FREE Baked Balance-n-Brighten Color Correcting Foundation. After that, enjoy photo moments at our sticker wall, plus free swag and even more makeup goodies. Discover easy, glow-boosting essentials designed to enhance your natural beauty!

events.title: Lee Ellen Drechsler's morning mimosa lighting talk
events.description:
Join us for Morning Mimosas with Lee Ellen Drechsler. She's sharing how P&G launched a disruptive ecommerce brand with college student partners.

New technologies typically take years, or even decades, to push through the morass of corporate R&D. When P&G researchers decided to create a suite of waterless personal care and home cleaning products, they wanted to sprint. Enter University of Cincinnati design and engineering students. This corporate + college team built a new brand called EC30 in record time. Their experiment is now translating to a cascade of successful waterless product launches. Come hear a first-hand account of how the race was won!

events.title: The Odoo Lounge
events.description: Swing by the Odoo Lounge at SXSW to recharge, kick up your feet, and get some work done. For a chance to win a prize, visit the Odoo Lounge and see how Odoo makes companies better, one app at a time.

events.title: Registration (Fairmont Austin)
events.description: Pick up your SXSW Badge in the Manchester Ballroom of the Fairmont Austin. Your badge is required in order to attend any sessions, events, or socials.

events.title: SXSW Expo: International Innovations
events.description:
Featuring a powerful mix of established global brands and budding startups, the International Innovations Expo highlights cutting-edge businesses that are pushing boundaries to move the world forward. From groundbreaking concepts to bold new business models, exhibitors are redefining what’s possible across industries around the globe. Join the community that’s driving change on a worldwide scale.

See the floor plan here: https://sxsw2026-sxexpointinnov.expofp.com/

events.title: University of Cincinnati Lounge
events.description: Think of us as the ultimate college lounge: coffee, chargers, comfy chairs, some adult beverages, and all the fuel you need to spark your next great idea. Oh, and there will be a free Allbirds drawing every day.

events.title: Innovation for Everyone: Day 2 at German Haus
events.description:
Dive into a day of deep insights and strategic networking at the German Haus. Day 2 showcases the versatility of the German ecosystem, featuring expert perspectives on MediaTech and high-level discussions from the Health and MedTech sectors. The afternoon is dedicated to building bridges: explore cutting-edge solutions from energy and sustainability innovators and discover the strength of Germany’s ties with Europe and the US. A highlight of the day is our special collaborative program with the European Union, fostering transatlantic dialogue. Wrap up the evening with a premium selection of drinks and a showcase of the finest new music Germany and Europe have to offer.

For more information please visit: https://www.german-haus.com

events.title: Ireland House
events.description:
Ireland House where innovation and creativity collide. Join us to connect with our people, our culture and our partners around the world

For more information, please visit: https://www.ireland.ie/en/sxsw/

events.title: AI Safety & Trust: Building Responsible Media Tech
events.description: As AI becomes central to media and entertainment, safety and trust are non-negotiable. This session explores practical steps for building and scaling trustworthy AI, including model testing, transparency, and regulatory compliance.

events.title: The B Word: How to Get Creative with Marketing Budget
events.description: Sometimes the biggest constraints come from inside the house — executive leadership or clients who only see spreadsheets instead of brand-building impact. This session explores strategies for persuasion, covering the skills needed to sell your big idea and get others to buy into your vision. This candid conversation will dive into: the need to spend big for big results, how to get executives to buy in, and ways to execute bold marketing strategies, even in harsh economic times.

speakers.name: Keisha Wright
speakers.title: SVP, Partnerships
speakers.company: THINK450 - The Partnership & Innovation Engine of the NBPA

events.title: The Creative Economy is Thriving: Why Founders Keep Building for Creators
events.description: As the creator economy accelerates, a new wave of founders is redefining how artists, musicians, and creators build, collaborate, and earn. This panel gathers startup founders who are shaping the next generation of creative tools and platforms to unpack why this space continues to attract such intense entrepreneurial momentum. Expect a candid conversation about what it really takes to design technology for creators— the opportunities waiting to be seized, the missteps to avoid, and the lessons learned from what works, what doesn’t, and why.

events.title: Data Meets AI: The New Healthcare Growth Engine
events.description: What happens when insights are accessible to every team that shapes the patient journey? Alex Lirtsman, CEO of CorralData, hosts a conversation with Pfizer, Shore Capital, and Skytale Group exploring how AI is facilitating faster decisions, empowered teams, and more personalized care. Together, they’ll share lessons from large-scale pharma, digital health innovation, and consumer-focused clinics — showing how data democratization is accelerating healthcare transformation at every level.

events.title: Experience the Future of Flight
events.description: Experience flying in a Cirrus aircraft through Apple Pro Vision goggles and then check out the all new SR Series G7+ aircraft on-site.

events.title: The Fandom Force: How to Create a Fan-First Social Approach
events.description:
Fandoms are powerful, passionate groups that drive culture and conversion. New Deloitte Digital research found that 75% of surveyed U.S. adults consider themselves part of a fandom, proving there’s ample opportunity for brands to connect with truly devoted fans. 

In this session, Kenny Gold, Deloitte Digital’s Head of Social, Content and Influencer will be joined by Colie Edison, SVP & Chief Growth Officer of the WNBA, to explore how social-first brands can engage online fandoms, capitalize on their loyalty and build lasting relationships that go beyond the algorithm.

speakers.name: Kenny Gold
speakers.title: Managing Director, Head of Social, Content and Influencer

speakers.name: Colie Edison
speakers.title: Senior Vice President and Chief Growth Officer

events.title: Featured Session: Multiplayer Futures: Co-Creating a Vision of SXSW 2030 (live!)
events.description:
What if the future isn't predicted by one speaker, but imagined by thousands? In this radically inclusive and participatory session, you won't just hear a keynote – you'll co-create one. 

Sketch your vision of SXSW 2030, and watch your idea become part of a map of the room's collective imagination and intelligence. Then we’ll explore its signals, themes and provocations, and leave you with a clearer lens to navigate the rest of the week. 

All live. All together.

events.title: Flatstock
events.description:
Looking for the perfect centerpiece for your gallery wall, a concert poster of your favorite artist, or your favorite Texas-themed memorabilia? Look no further than Flatstock! This eclectic art market continues to capture the spirit of music mementos while also highlighting unique collectibles. Flatstock provides an ongoing series of opportunities to admire artwork in person and to meet the artists who created it. This Expo is free and open to the public.

See the Flatstock Guide here: https://app-na1.hubspotdocuments.com/documents/558236/view/1620947864?accessId=75a3c4

See the floor plan here: https://sxsw2026-flatstock.expofp.com/

events.title: Forget Moments Marketing: Welcome to Worldbuilding
events.description: As our industry faces the death of monoculture and an increasingly fragmented landscape, it’s time for marketers to move beyond single moments or campaigns and build larger, expansive Worlds. This fireside chat will explore how brands and marketers can leverage different communities (and what it means to be a community insider), drive greater ongoing consumer engagement and loyalty, and explore rich insights when we look at Worlds through a local lens. As part of that, we’ll share Worldbuilding examples of brands steeped in culture, including the award-winning Vaseline Verified campaign.

speakers.name: Leandro Barreto
speakers.title: Chief Marketing Officer, Unilever and Beauty & Wellbeing

events.title: From Who to What to You: The Weird AI-Infused Future of the Creator Economy
events.description: First they laughed at YouTubers. Now they're panicking over AI-generated videos with wombats and dead celebrities. Welcome to the next chapter. This talk unpacks the hysteria around AI “slop” and reveals what’s actually changing in the creator economy. Spoiler: the future is even weirder, more customized, and deeply personal, and creators who embrace the chaos will win. And remember: it's not slop if someone loves it.

events.title: Future-Proof Your Strategy: An AI Test and Learn Lab
events.description: Forget fuzzy predictions. It’s time to get real. What if AI doesn’t unfold the way we expect? In this hands-on, high-energy workshop, you’ll test your strategy against four radically different futures: Growth, Constraint, Transform, and Collapse. You’ll game out scenarios, stress-test decisions, and build a future-ready playbook to lead—not just react—through AI’s uncertainty. Walk away with fresh insights, a sharper strategic lens, and tools to navigate the complexity and opportunity ahead.

speakers.name: Maurice Conti
speakers.title: AI Visionary, Futurist and Global Keynote Speaker, Applied Intelligence

events.title: hālo haus
events.description: hālo haus is a 4 day gathering centered on beauty, wellness, and longevity. Hosted on a full street closure in downtown Austin, the program blends fireside chats, leading voices, experiential activations, and recovery-focused offerings within an open, discovery-driven format. hālo haus brings together founders, creators, clinicians, and cultural leaders to explore how self-care and performance are evolving alongside culture.

events.title: How to Win Friends and Overthrow Systems
events.description: Learn how to use your creative skills to spark a cultural movement. From getting arrested in Congress to pulling off an audacious prank in Disneyland, a famous ice cream maker and a cultural theorist teach practical strategies for turning art, design, and media into powerful tools for systemic change. This how-to session reveals the cultural dynamics behind viral activism campaigns and gives creators actionable frameworks for launching movements that matter.

events.title: Independent Film Publicity: How to Earn Media Attention
events.description: Earning press attention for your film isn’t luck—it’s strategy. This session breaks down how emerging filmmakers and creative teams can grab media attention, secure reviews, and build buzz that lasts. Learn how to best position your film for coverage, connect with the right journalists for your story, and use publicity as a powerful tool to grow your audience. You’ll leave with clear, actionable steps to cut through the noise and earn your film the spotlight it deserves.

events.title: It's a Whole Thing: Gen Z Work Relationships in the Age of AI
events.description: Today’s youngest workers are all in on AI — and ghosting their coworkers. There is a new generational shift in workplace dynamics, where Gen Z and emerging Gen Alphas are forming trust bonds with AI tools faster than with humans. They praise AI’s speed, clarity, and lack of pushback, all while struggling with manager feedback, peer collaboration, and team engagement. This panel explores the psychological and social drivers behind these trends and what they mean for designing inclusive, high-trust workplaces powered by both humans and intelligent systems.

events.title: LGBTQ+ and Friends Meet Up
events.description:
This is a space to pause, breathe, and connect. We bring bubbles for your inner child, stories that spark connection, and space to show up exactly as you are.

Join LGBTQ+ creatives, storytellers, and allies for an authentic gathering rooted in curiosity, community, and queer joy. Come curious, leave connected. We can honestly say that for 4 years, this is the space where we had made the most unique and stronger connections!

events.title: MediaTech Morning: Breakfast, Networking & Beyond Screens – MediaTech as the New Infrastructure
events.description:
Start your morning at the German Haus with a MediaTech Networking Breakfast. Connect with global tech pioneers over coffee before our panel, "Beyond Screens: Media Tech as the New Infrastructure." Experts from de:hub MediaTech Potsdam discuss how media layers – from real-time video to synthetic media – now power modern industries. Discover how to stay competitive while navigating the ethical and societal impacts of media tech as a core component of global infrastructure.

https://www.german-haus.com

events.title: Mentor Session: Allison Prasad (Oracle/Oracle Cloud Infrastructure)
events.description: Meeting with this mentor is highly recommended if you're interested in Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning, "Diversity, Equity & Inclusion", Future of Work, Storytelling.

events.description: Meeting with this mentor is highly recommended if you're interested in Funding, Immersive Technology, Product Management/Development.
