events.description: Meeting with this mentor is highly recommended if you're interested in Business Development, "Diversity, Equity & Inclusion", Marketing/Advertising/PR.

events.title: Mentor Session: Hal Kirkland (Studio Farland Inc/Unit9)
events.description: Meeting with this mentor is highly recommended if you're interested in Marketing/Advertising/PR, Storytelling, XR.

events.title: Mentor Session: Michaela Guzy (OTPYM Productions)
events.description: Meeting with this mentor is highly recommended if you're interested in Content Strategy/Production, "Diversity, Equity & Inclusion", Entrepreneurship, Journalism, Marketing/Advertising/PR, Storytelling, Sustainability.

events.title: Mentor Session: Satish Kumar (ExecLabs)
events.description: Meeting with this mentor is highly recommended if you're interested in Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning, Product Management/Development, Future of Work.

events.title: Mentor Session: Sergiu Ardelean (Artivive GmbH)
events.description: Meeting with this mentor is highly recommended if you're interested in Art, Entrepreneurship, XR, Funding, Storytelling.

events.title: Mentor Session: Valerie Itey (Clic Recycle)
events.description: Meeting with this mentor is highly recommended if you're interested in Sustainability, Entrepreneurship.

events.title: More Analog, Less Noise Please: City Builders Meet Up
events.description: More Analog, Less Noise Please is a facilitated meet up for people working across city building, design, culture, and innovation who are interested in rhythm, pause, and recovery in fast systems. Rooted in urban life and public space, the conversation explores how analog experiences, emotional infrastructure, and informal release valves shape connection and resilience. The meet up is designed as a shared conversation that invites reflection, observation, and exchange around how cities and the systems around them can better support human pace.

events.title: Pitching to Angels 101: Think Like an Investor
events.description: Step into the investor’s shoes in a hands-on workshop, hosted by the Central Texas Angel Network, one of the nation’s leading angel groups. In this interactive session, founders will reverse roles, evaluating pitches from companies CTAN has funded—as well as those we’ve passed on, using CTAN’s processes. You’ll vote on which companies should receive investment and compare your decisions with CTAN’s actual investment choices. By dissecting these examples from an investor's lens, you’ll gain a clear sense of the qualities that drive investments and boost your chances of securing an investment.

events.title: The Price of Influence: Why Undefined Value Kills Trust
events.description:
Influencer marketing is booming, but no one can answer the most basic question: What is this actually worth? Creators are guessing. Agencies rely on gut checks. Brands spend millions with no clear sense of ROI. The result? A pricing vacuum that erodes trust across the entire ecosystem. 

This session explores why the creator economy still lacks a standard for value, and what that's doing to credibility and performance. We'll look at how AI distorts signals and what it will take to rebuild a system where trust is the real currency. This is about the very soul of the economy we’re building.

events.title: Ready for your Brand Close-Up?
events.description: Visit YouTube at the Brand & Marketing track to capture your own custom video to post on YouTube Shorts. Our team will guide you through the process and help you capture a unique brand snapshot of your time at SXSW. Open to all attendees during conference hours.

events.title: Realtor.com Open House
events.description: A central hub for real estate, housing, and technology. Designed to connect the industry’s biggest ideas under one roof.

events.title: Resurrecting the Future: The Viral Rise of De-Extinction
events.description: One word rarely used to describe synthetic biology is excitement.  While the world’s leading scientists have worked tirelessly to combat biodiversity loss, public engagement has lagged behind the urgency of the crisis. Until now that is. Colossal Biosciences is disrupting the scientific landscape by capturing mass attention and inspiring children and young people around the world, using de-extinction and advanced genetic technologies to bring unprecedented attention—and tangible solutions—to the biodiversity crisis. As traditional conservation struggles to keep pace with accelerating species loss, Colossal is redefining what’s possible —including the Colossal BioVault, a genetic repository designed to safeguard biodiversity at unprecedented scale. Protecting more than 10,000 species and preserving over one million biological samples, the BioVault represents a modern-day Noah's Ark and a bold new safeguard against extinction. This isn’t science fiction. It’s the next frontier.

events.title: Rethinking Discovery Algorithms for the Creator Economy
events.description: On most platforms, discovery is designed to maximize ad revenue — not creator success. But what if algorithms prioritized creator growth and authentic relationships instead? In this panel, Drew Rowny (VP of Product at Patreon), Dr. Rumman Chowdhury, PhD, and Taylor Lorenz (founder of User Mag and host of the Power User podcast) will unpack how discovery tools can be redesigned to support creators’ businesses first.

speakers.name: Taylor Lorenz
speakers.title: Founder and Host
speakers.company: User Mag and Power User Podcast

events.title: Rewriting the Rules of Business: A Guide to Purpose & Profit
events.description: Today’s consumers are demanding more than just great products—they want brands that reflect their values and contribute to a cleaner planet and better world. A NielsenIQ study found that purpose-led products average 28% growth vs 20% for non-purpose-led products. From reducing plastic waste to promoting a regenerative world, hear from organizations at the forefront of the sustainability movement who are rewriting the rules of business, driving growth through purpose, and proving that conscious capitalism isn’t just a trend, but the future we’re moving towards—brands can thrive by doing good.

events.title: The Rise of the CEO Creator: The Future of Creator Companies
events.description: Charlie Chang has built far more than a 1.4M subscriber YouTube channel. He runs a multi-platform media business spanning video, podcasts, courses, websites, and localized content across languages and markets. In this fireside chat, Charlie shares how creators can evolve from solo operators into founder-led companies, design durable revenue models, and build brands that outlast algorithms. Expect practical lessons on scaling teams, owning audiences, and turning your personal brand into a real business.

events.title: SÃO PAULO HOUSE 2026 - WE ARE BORDERLESS
events.description:
Welcome to São Paulo House, a borderless hub where the world meets São Paulo, now.

Across four days at SXSW, the house brings together global content, meaningful encounters, live music and immersive experiences in one vibrant space on Congress Avenue. By day, ideas and exchanges shape conversations. By night, shows and performances transform the house into a cultural hotspot.

Explore creativity, innovation, and culture, shaping what’s next from the energy of now.

Please find more information here: https://saopaulohouse.com/

events.title: Small Agency Meet Up
events.description: If you work at a small creative agency, you know that it sometimes takes more (or different) people than you have on staff to make your big ideas a reality. You have go-to partners and collaborators and regularly navigate complex systems, making the concept-to-creation pipeline feel seamless for your clients, but you always need to make new connections to bolster that network. This is a space to meet and connect with other small agency innovators to share stories, gain insight, and find new collaborators for your projects!

events.title: SWIFTYNOMICS: How Women Mastermind and Redefine Our Economy
events.description:
Taylor Swift isn't just a pop megastar. She is a working woman whose astounding accomplishments defy patriarchal norms. And while not all women can be Beyoncé or Dolly Parton or Reese Witherspoon, the successes of these trailblazing stars help us understand the central role of women in today's economy.
 
Swiftynomics assesses the complex economic lives of everyday American women through the stories of groundbreakers like Taylor Swift, Misty L. Heggeness digs into the data, revealing women's hidden contributions and aspirations—the unexamined value they create by pursuing their own ambitions. She highlights the abundance of productive activity in their daily lives and acknowledges the barriers they still face.
 
Exploring critical reforms regarding caregiving and gendered labor, this book talk will offer advice for women to thrive in an economy that was not built for them.

speakers.name: Misty Heggeness
speakers.title: Author of Swiftynomics, co-director of the Kansas Population Center, Associate Professor of Economics and Public Affairs at the University of Kansas

events.title: SXSW Bookstore
events.description: Check out the SXSW Bookstore to browse the latest work authored by this year’s conference participants. Support your favorite speakers and find something you connect with to take back home. Open daily on the 6th floor of the Hilton Austin Downtown.

events.title: SXSW Pitch-Healthcare, AssistiveTech & BioTech
events.description:
The SXSW Pitch provides a platform for early-stage technology startups to present their groundbreaking products and services to a panel of distinguished industry experts, influential media professionals, and leading venture capitalists and angel investors.


On Friday, March 13, five innovative companies will take the stage in Salon FGH at the JW Marriott, showcasing their ideas, innovations, and entrepreneurial vision before a live audience and judging panel. Come be inspired by the next generation of tech innovators shaping the future.


Healthcare, Assistive Tech and BioTech echnologies focused on human-centric applications that advance medicine and wellness and connect individuals with health systems and facilities, medical technologies and devices, care teams, providers, health insurance, pharmaceuticals, corporate and personal wellness services, and public health and social services. These startups may include applications in aging and geriatrics, vaccines, mRNA technology, general wellness, assistive technology, diagnosis, treatment, reproductive health, synthetic biology, digital therapeutics, women’s health, genetics, sports and exercise, home fitness, plant-based therapeutics, molecular diagnosis, lab-on-a-chip, child monitoring systems, sleep, and medical wearable technologies.


Winner of the Healthcare, Assistive Tech and BioTech Technologies will be announced at the Award Ceremony, Saturday, March 14th at 6:30pm.

events.title: Technology Convergence: Identifying the Advantage
events.description: History's biggest technology waves, from electrification to the internet, were convergence stories, derived not from single inventions but a combination of them. Today, that pattern repeats where AI, robotics, advanced materials, bioengineering, and energy systems are producing solutions that no single discipline, company, or lab could create alone. Based on the World Economic Forum's Technology Convergence Report, this session unveils the 3C Framework - Combination, Convergence, Compounding - analyzing 246 technologies across 8 advanced technology domains, spotlighting pioneers excelling from this wave of fusion plays. See how convergence unlocks new opportunities and learn to spot, and activate, the next wave before it breaks.

speakers.name: Kary Bheemaiah
speakers.title: Chief Tech & Innovation Officer- Capgemini Invent I Exec Fellow – World Economic Forum

events.title: Through the Noise: The State of Science Storytelling
events.description: Science is a human endeavor, built on curiosity and beauty. So science stories are, at heart, human stories. But as we grapple with paradigm-shifting technologies, changing political landscapes and more, what is the future of science storytelling? What kinds of science stories can break through all the noise, and why? Leaders from documentary film, journalism, and public radio will explore today’s science media landscape - the challenges ahead, as well as the opportunities that might emerge.

events.title: Two Futurists and an AI: Seeing Trouble Ahead
events.description: Join celebrity futurist Faith Popcorn, techno-futurist Sarah DaVanzo, and Delph.Ai, an AI Synthetic Human trained on the minds of female futurists in a boundary-pushing, three-way debate on the future of leadership in the age of intelligent machines. With Faith’s dystopian view, Sarah’s utopian counterpoint, and Delph.Ai’s unexpected input, this session explores the trouble coming as AI challenges the very definition of human agency, influence, and power.

events.title: Valeo Tech Drive-in
events.description:
The car is no longer just a vehicle, it's where the future of tech starts.

At the Valeo Tech Drive-In, we’re transforming the journey into a high-stakes arena. Experience the machine-learning-powered Valeo Racer, gaze-tracking Panovision head up display, and e-Chromic lenses that sync to the road’s pulse. We’re even exporting automotive thermal DNA to cool the AI revolution in global data centers. From hyper-personalized lighting to the cloud edge,, witness the vehicle become the world’s most immersive, high-performance tech frontier.

events.title: Variety True Crime Summit presented by Investigation Discovery
events.description:
Variety will host the first-ever True Crime Summit, presented by Investigation Discovery (ID), spotlighting the crime genre phenomenon. The full day event will explore the cultural obsession with stories of mystery, justice and deception that continue to dominate film, television, and audio storytelling.

Agenda Here: https://variety.com/truecrime

events.title: Waveform: The MKBHD Podcast Live
events.description:
Join Marques Brownlee for a live-taping of his podcast, Waveform: The MKBHD Podcast. Better known as MKBHD, Brownlee has made a name for himself on YouTube reviewing everything from the newest smartphones to electric cars. Pulling from over 10 years of experience covering the tech industry, MKBHD and co-hosts Andrew Manganelli and David Imel will take a deep dive into the latest in tech and what deserves your hard earned cash. 

Part of the Vox Media Podcast Stage at SXSW.

events.title: XR Immersive Filmmaking & The Future of Entertainment
events.description: XR is not just a new format—it’s a new language of interactive cinematic storytelling. Join director Doug Liman’s award-winning team 30 Ninjas as they explore how working with Google XR teams they are combining emerging formats like volumetric capture, spatial narrative, 3D engines and real-time Google LLM driven characters are reshaping entertainment from the inside out. Learn how cinematic craft, game mechanics, XR and AI are merging at the highest level to create the future of audience experience and participation—where the viewer isn’t just watching the story, they’re inside it.

speakers.name: J.P. Guiseppi
speakers.title: Group Creative Lead at Google Strategic Content Partnerships

events.title: YAMAHA CREATOR PASS STUDIO
events.description: A new creative experience is making its SXSW debut. Hands-on music and audio tools. Real-time creation. Designed for creators of all levels. No watching from the sidelines — just jump in and make something.

events.title: You Are STILL the Brand: What AI Can’t Do for You
events.description: AI can write your next caption, but it can’t write your legacy. In this empowering and practical session, we are reminded that real personal brands aren’t built on trends or tools. Rather, they’re built on voice, values, and visibility. Learn what parts of your brand should never be outsourced and how to stay unmistakably you in a world of sameness.

events.title: The Rise of the Red Hot Chili Peppers: Our Brother, Hillel
events.description: An in-depth look at the gritty formative years of the Red Hot Chili Peppers and the singular vision of original guitarist Hillel Slovak. Featuring interviews with bandmates Flea and Anthony Kiedis and others close to Slovak, the film explores the band’s early evolution on the LA music scene and the deep bond of their childhood friendship.

events.title: The Snake
events.description: When Jamie, ungovernable 40 something wild child collides with her venomous mother Anne, her life blows up spectacularly leaving her evicted and single. This sends Jamie on a pig in a hurricane journey for “home”; breaking into her Nana’s house to prove it should be hers, a rejected bid to move in with her van dwelling punk rock ex, and a stint in her best friends pied a terre, which ends with Jamie hooking up with her husband.

events.title: Aguasol Tasting
events.description: Come sip Aguasol! We’ll be offering complimentary samples of our smooth, additive-free tequila, plus Aguasol cocktails for purchase at the bar. Pure sunshine, spring water, and agave—no shortcuts. Refresh, recharge, and keep the SXSW energy going.www.aguasol.com

events.title: Austin Eastciders Giddy Up Tasting
events.description: Giddy Up & Go at SXSW with Austin Eastciders! We'll be slinging samples of our newest 11% ABV Giddy Up Electric Punch lineup: Tropical Blast & Blue Raspberry. We lassoed that party magic with none of the mixing - just crack it up and let the good times ride.https://austineastciders.com/

events.title: Congress Avenue Block Party
events.description: The Congress Avenue Block Party (formerly known as the Registrant Lounge) is the go-to space for all SXSW attendees to maximize their SX experience, offering daily complimentary drinks, food, and sponsor swag. Open throughout the conferences & festivals, this convenient and relaxing meeting point near the hub of SXSW action is an ideal spot to unwind and connect with other attendees. New for 2026, the Block Party is free and open to the public!

events.title: Einstein Energy Super Snack Bars - Think You're A Snack Genius?
events.description: Think You’re a Snack Genius?Einstein Energy Super Smart Snack Bars bring brainpower to SXSW with The Einstein Game Show—fast, buzzer-style trivia hosted by an Albert Einstein look-alike. Win exclusive merch and bars, snap iconic photos, and fuel up with smarter snack breaks guided by brand ambassadors. Live screens, social moments, and QR-powered rewards keep the energy high—plus a special birthday celebration for Albert on March 14.

events.title: Erupcja
events.description: Set in Poland, Erupcja follows two women as they complicate their romantic lives. Nel lives in Warsaw where she works at a flower shop. When her childhood friend Bethany comes to visit with a new boyfriend, a volcano erupts.

events.title: Erupcja
events.description: Set in Poland, Erupcja follows two women as they complicate their romantic lives. Nel lives in Warsaw where she works at a flower shop. When her childhood friend Bethany comes to visit with a new boyfriend, a volcano erupts.

events.title: A Flavor-Filled Experience
events.description: You’re invited to a flavor-filled experience, where nature meets delicious. Come sip, sample, and explore everything from bold flavor innovations to functional hydration and premium teas. No artificial stuff. Just pure, crafted taste, and a few fun freebies you don't want to miss!

events.title: I Love Boosters
events.description: A crew of professional shoplifters take aim at a cutthroat fashion maven. It’s like community service.

events.title: My/Mochi Joyfully Chill Ice Cream Shoppe
events.description: My/Mochi, the original and world's largest mochi ice cream brand, is inviting SXSW-goers to Taste the Joy! Our delightfully delicious ice cream wrapped in pillowy sweet rice dough comes in more than 20 flavors like Cookie Dough, Strawberry and Mango. So stop by our Joyfully Chill Ice Cream Shoppe at the Congress Ave Block Party Mar 12-18 to experience the joy for yourself!

events.title: Phoenix Jones: The Rise and Fall of a Real Life Superhero
events.description: In 2010, reports began surfacing of a masked vigilante in a black-and-gold supersuit stopping crime on the streets of Seattle. His name is Phoenix Jones. Armed with pepper spray, a taser, and a team of costumed crime fighters, he quickly becomes an international media sensation. But when his true identity is exposed by the Seattle Police, the heroic image begins to unravel and his team abandons him. Ten years later, as protesters seize six blocks of Seattle and declare a no cop zone, Phoenix reemerges amid legal trouble and public skepticism. Is he a hero, or a con-artist hiding behind a mask?
events.venue: Rollins Theatre at the Long Center

events.title: Big Girls Don't Cry
events.description: Summer 2006, 14-year-old Sid is caught between her own burgeoning sexual curiosity and acceptance from an older group of girls. As she delves deeper into rebellion, she leaves behind a trail of destruction as she goes. Big Girls Don’t Cry is a love letter to all the women that still feel shame scars from this time of their lives; who did things they wished they hadn’t, or didn’t do things they wished they had; to hold up a mirror and say yes; that was f#&*ed up.

events.title: Cookie Queens
events.description: “Cookie Queens” is a coming-of-age story about the joys, pressures, and pain points woven into one of America’s most cherished rituals: Girl Scout Cookie season. Captivating, candid, and full of heart, the film follows four girls ages 5-12 as they navigate the annual whirlwind of selling, striving, and succeeding. For these Girl Scouts, selling cookies isn’t just about Thin Mints and sisterhood - it’s a crash course in commercialism. Behind the smiles lie real pressure: long hours, ambitious goals, and weighty expectations. With humor, warmth, and a keen eye for small moments revealing big truths, “Cookie Queens” shows how growing up is shaped by tensions between community and capitalism.

events.title: Misty Heggeness Book Signing
events.description: Misty Heggeness will be signing copies of “Swiftynomics: How Women Mastermind and Redefine Our Economy” at the SXSW Bookstore.

speakers.name: Misty Heggeness
speakers.title: Author of Swiftynomics, co-director of the Kansas Population Center, Associate Professor of Economics and Public Affairs at the University of Kansas

events.title: 10 Truths About Technology That Are Shaping Your Life
events.description: Every day, invisible systems shape your decisions, desires, attention, and identity, often without your awareness. This session uncovers 10 hidden truths about how algorithms, AI models, and digital platforms subtly reprogram human behavior. Through real-world examples and sharp analysis, this talk explores how technology influences us psychologically and culturally, and what we can do to remain conscious, critical, and truly in control.

events.title: Activate Your Art House
events.description: Art House Convergence - a coalition that amplifies & connects community and mission-driven exhibitors  -  is working to provide filmmakers with best practices and resources for connecting with independent cinemas,  with  - or without - a traditional distributor.

events.title: AI in Entertainment: Navigating IP, Ethics & Opportunity
events.description: Explore how generative and agentic AI are transforming entertainment and media, from content creation to distribution.  This session will unpack the legal, ethical, and business challenges—especially around IP, fair use, and talent rights—while highlighting new opportunities for innovation and collaboration.

speakers.name: Alex Haskell
speakers.title: General Counsel and Head of Global Affairs

events.title: Baby/Girls
events.description: In post-Dobbs rural Arkansas, teen birth rates remain among the highest in the nation, shaped by generational patterns and limited access to sex education. For pregnant teenagers with limited family support, a Christian maternity home provides housing, prenatal care, and faith-based guidance. Filmed over two years with intimate verité access, Baby/Girls remains inside the house as three young women move through pregnancy, give birth, and step into motherhood. They come from families marked by poverty, addiction, and abuse; several are daughters of teen mothers themselves, continuing cycles that span generations. The film offers a powerful portrait of lives we often cannot see.

events.title: Baby/Girls
events.description: In post-Dobbs rural Arkansas, teen birth rates remain among the highest in the nation, shaped by generational patterns and limited access to sex education. For pregnant teenagers with limited family support, a Christian maternity home provides housing, prenatal care, and faith-based guidance. Filmed over two years with intimate verité access, Baby/Girls remains inside the house as three young women move through pregnancy, give birth, and step into motherhood. events.title: Better Leadership Starts with Understanding the Stressed Brain
events.description: We will have wasted $96 billion on wellness programs, and stress is still killing productivity. Why? Because most initiatives miss the one thing that matters: how stress hijacks the brain. You don’t need another meditation app. You need to understand what happens in the brain under pressure and what great leaders can do about it. This session introduces Integrated Well-Being Leadership, a science-based approach that helps leaders reduce friction, build clarity, and create workplaces where people can actually think, connect, and perform.

speakers.name: Megan Holmes, PhD
speakers.title: Professor
speakers.company: Center on Trauma and Adversity, Case Western Reserve University

events.title: Beyond the Track: Storytelling Across Music, Film & New Visual Frontiers with Vic Mensa
events.description: Music has long been a powerful storytelling tool, but today’s artists are expanding beyond the song. GRAMMY-nominated artist, actor and visionary Vic Mensa explores how musicality shapes cinematic storytelling across film, episodic content and emerging mediums. Mensa shares insights from still with the smoke–filmed on an iPhone in Senegal, his Orange Tree Series, award-winning film Blue Eyes, and a first look at his forthcoming short film. Designed for musicians, filmmakers and creators who refuse to stay in one lane.

events.title: Brand Worlds are the Next Marketing Frontier
events.description:
What if we're missing AI's most transformative potential?

There is a radical paradigm shift: AI as immersive brand worlds where marketers can experience thousands of futures before committing a single dollar to market. Drawing inspiration from Surrealism, where imagination and reality merge into a unified experience, we'll explore how leading brands like Unilever are creating neuro-synthetic environments where strategy, experimentation, and decision-making happen inside intelligent systems.

Join us to make the jump from AI-as-a-tool to "AI-as-Worlds" and reshape the future of marketing.

events.title: Breaking the Sound Barrier: Making Creativity Accessible to All
events.description:
Creators face a growing “sound barrier”: a fragmented ecosystem of tools, platforms, and services that often makes creating feel more complicated than it should be. What should be intuitive and fluid can become complex, costly, and disconnected.

This panel explores what a more unified, creator-first space for music and podcast creation could look like that meets creators where they are in the journey. Whether its beginners  or more experienced creators refining their craft, we’ll explore more streamlined solutions for music and podcasts that support creators at every stage.

events.title: The Creative Industry Meet Up
events.description: Back by popular demand, the Creative Industry Meet Up returns to SXSW. Ready to tap into the creative pulse of a global industry? While the UK is home to one of the world’s most vibrant creator economies, the real value comes from exchanging ideas across borders from the US, UK, and beyond. This meetup connects innovators, brand leaders, and founders worldwide. No pitches, no panels, just real conversations shaping the future of creativity together.

events.title: CTRL + ALT + CREATE: How AI Is Reshaping the Creative Process
events.description: A tech titan and a touring musician dig into how AI is making us reconsider creativity—fueling ideas, speeding production, and widening access, while also raising concerns about ownership, authenticity, and sameness. This candid conversation explores where AI elevates human imagination, where it threatens it, and how creators can keep art innovative and human.

events.title: Designing the Future of Human Performance
events.description:
What happens when elite athleticism meets cutting-edge technology? This session explores how human performance, innovation, and storytelling converge to push the boundaries of what’s possible in sport and beyond.

A conversation with Paralympian Hunter Woodhall, Olympic Gold medalist Tara Davis-Woodhall, Deloitte’s US CMO Scott Mager, and Narrative principal Justin Moore-Lewy.

events.title: The Energy Evolution of Data Centers
events.description: The rapid pace of data center development is testing the ability of utilities to keep pace while providing the steady 24/7 power to businesses and consumers. What if AI data centers could evolve beyond passive electricity users and provide power back to the grid, bolstering grid reliability, resilience, and affordability for all consumers? An EPRI-led effort aims to demonstrate the technologies, policies, and tools to make data center flexibility a reality in different markets. Learn more about data center flexibility in a fireside chat with EPRI and Google.

speakers.name: David Porter
speakers.title: Vice President Electrification & Sustainable Energy Strategy

events.title: Excess is out. Intention is in. How can brands navigate shifting consumer appetites toward moderation?
events.description: In an era of overstimulation and abundance, how can brands position themselves between pleasure and responsibility? This panel brings together leaders from beverages and food to discuss how moderation can become more than a corporate message — a cultural movement. From alcohol to sugar, the conversation explores how industries are reshaping narratives of enjoyment without excess.

speakers.name: Renata Vichi
speakers.title: Advisor and Entrepreneur
speakers.company: Kopenhagen e Chocolates Brasil Cacau (Grupo CRM)

events.title: Featured Session: A Conversation With Spotify's New Co-CEO About The Past, Present And Future Of Delivering Creativity To The World
events.description: Twenty years ago, the music industry faced an existential crisis. Piracy was reshaping consumption, the old model was unraveling, and no clear path forward existed. Spotify was born from a simple but radical belief: that technology could reconnect artists and fans in a way that worked for both. Join Gustav for a look at the future of Spotify’s technological transformation across music, podcasts, and audiobooks, exploring how user control, creator innovation, and thoughtful technology are shaping the next chapter of entertainment.

events.title: From Data to Decisions: Lives, Livelihoods, and the Planet
events.description: Decisions about land, conservation, food and energy systems, and climate are increasingly shaped by data and AI. But how does that information actually enter a decision? How does a farmer decide when to plant, or a policymaker weigh risk and uncertainty? This fireside chat explores how data-driven insights move from analysis to real-world decision-making across very different contexts, and what it takes for data and models to be reliable enough to act on when the stakes are high.

events.title: From Field to Fan: The Future of Sports Storytelling
events.description: Sports brands have more tools than ever to tell powerful, emotionally resonant stories. By bringing fans closer to the action, they are immersed in the atmosphere, and given deeper access to athlete narratives. New opportunities from emerging technologies – from real-time data and spatial experiences to AI-enhanced content and personalised touchpoints – are reshaping how stories are crafted and delivered. This panel brings together top sports storytellers and technologists to explore the future of fan engagement and narrative innovation.

speakers.name: Ryan Dornbusch
speakers.title: Head of Sports and Live Entertainment, Reality Labs

events.title: From Podcasts to Radio: Unlocking Scaled Audio with Modern Attribution
events.description: Radio ad measurement has advanced far beyond traditional metrics, following the path podcasting paved first. As pixel-based attribution reshaped marketer expectations, offline audio is getting a fresh look. This panel explores how radio measurement is becoming smarter, more connected, and more accountable. Leaders from Podscribe, Right Side Up, Gusto, and ESPN will share how context, attention, and cross-platform signals are redefining success—and what marketers need to know to navigate today’s audio landscape.

events.title: From Viral to Viable: Building IP as a Creator
events.description: How do you turn a quick video into a globally recognized brand? Four standout creators share how they used platforms like TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube to launch lasting IP. They’ll break down their creative processes, growing loyal communities, launching physical products like books and games, and keeping creative control from viral moment to full-fledged brand.

events.title: Gen Z Professionals Meet Up
events.description: As Gen Z enters the workforce during a time of cultural, technological, and workplace change, the need for career-building spaces that reflect our realities has never been more urgent. The lines between brand, communications, and content continue to blur. Gen Z professionals are being asked to think holistically across platforms, communities, and culture, often without clear mentorship or support. This session will spotlight how we, as young professionals, can build meaningful careers and elevate the standard for inclusive, cross-disciplinary brand storytelling in the process.

events.title: How Death Became the New Wellness Frontier
events.description: Fitness has trainers. Mental health has therapists. Now, death and grief have their own guides. From eco-burials to "grief influencers" leading online communities, death wellness is emerging as the next phase of the wellness industry. In this provocative panel, Grieve Leave founder Rebecca Feinglos, Queer Grief Club founder and death doula Jamie Thrower, Emmy-nominated writer and death doula Darnell Walker, and USA Today wellness editor David Oliver explore how a new generation  is embracing dying and grieving with the same intention, aesthetics, and openness as modern wellness culture.

speakers.name: Jamie Thrower
speakers.title: Death Doula, Grief Educator & Funeral Celebrant

events.title: How We Could Lose Control: Avoiding the Paths to Runaway AI
events.description: When experts talk about AI risks, they often talk about the loss of human control – but what does that actually mean? And how could it happen? In this fireside chat, physicist Anthony Aguirre and tech ethicist Tristan Harris go beyond surface-level alarm to map out the real mechanisms that could lead humanity to be sidelined by its own creation. From opaque incentives and design choices to systemic misalignment and power concentration, they’ll unpack how humans could lose control over AI and what can still be done to prevent it.

events.title: The Inmates are Running the ASYLM: Ron Perlman’s New Blueprint for Creative-Led Films
events.description:
The traditional Hollywood studio model is a top-down relic. Asylm Studios is flipping the script by handing the keys of the institution back to the people who actually make the magic. From A-list stars to the drivers and cleaners, Asylm is built on a ‘equity-for-all' ecosystem where every contributor is a literal stakeholder.

Join founders Ron Perlman and Willie Morris for a candid look at how radical transparency, unshakable trust, and shared equity aren't just moral choices—they are the blueprints for a more efficient, resilient, and joyful way to create films and TV shows.

events.title: Launch with 0 Investors: A Playbook for Crowdfunding in 2026
events.description: VC money isn't flowing like it used to, but great products still deserve to launch. Crowdfunding is one of the most powerful tools a founder can use in 2026, but most get it totally wrong. This fireside chat brings together top Kickstarter consultancy LaunchBoom's CEO Mark Pecota and Austin-based hardware brand Xebec's CEO Alex Levine to show you how to crowdfund the right way. Learn why just hitting "launch" won't cut it and tactical tips on how to build momentum before day one and the operational strategies brands like Xebec use to win every launch.

events.title: The Lucky 10%: CPGs Flipping Off the Startup Failure Rate
events.description: 90% of CPG startups flame out within two years. This panel is for the scrappy founders and CEOs determined not to be a statistic. Hear from leaders who clawed their way from pre-revenue chaos to nine figures, and who know the secret sauce to sustaining viral and culturally relevant high-growth brands. No BS. No fairy tales. Just hard-won lessons from the trenches on what it really takes to scale in one of the most ruthless industries.

events.title: Prune or Perish: Cut Toxic Leadership for a Thriving Culture
events.description: Toxic leaders can look successful on the surface while quietly poisoning teams and cultures. This research-backed session reveals how to spot early warning signs of toxic leadership, recognize eight common toxic personas, and take courageous action to prevent damage. Learn how to build a healthier, more human-centered workplace where trust and engagement thrive—and where toxic behaviors are addressed before they take root.

speakers.name: Dr. Laura Hambley Lovett
speakers.title: Organizational Psychologist, Speaker, Author, Adjunct Professor, Podcast Host

events.description: An extension of our popular Mentor Sessions, our Round Table Sessions not only allow attendees to learn from the industry experts that sit at each of the three tables in this session but they also allow attendees to learn from the questions and experiences of their peers as well. This Round Table Session will bring together industry experts and SXSW attendees for an enlightening discussion on  Programming.

events.title: See You When I See You
events.description: With the help of his family, a comedy writer battles PTSD after the tragic death of his sister.

events.title: SXSW Pitch-Sustainability, AgTech & Food
events.description:
The SXSW Pitch provides a platform for early-stage technology startups to present their groundbreaking products and services to a panel of distinguished industry experts, influential media professionals, and leading venture capitalists and angel investors.
On Friday, March 13, five innovative companies will take the stage in Salon FGH at the JW Marriott, showcasing their ideas, innovations, and entrepreneurial vision before a live audience and judging panel. Come be inspired by the next generation of tech innovators shaping the future.

Sustainability, AgTech & Food Technologies that enhance agricultural efficiency, improve sustainability, and drive profitability in food production. This includes innovations in agriculture, horticulture, and aquaculture, as well as broader sustainability efforts in environmental management. Examples include food sustainability, food waste reduction, farm data, soil microbe data, crop protection, biofertilizers, biostimulants, supply chain transparency, agri-food testing, alternative proteins, animal health, aquaculture, farm management software, the blue economy, the green economy, hydroponics, vertical farming, Consumer Product Goods (CPG), and precision agriculture. Additionally, this category includes AI-driven farm automation, regenerative agriculture, controlled environments, and smart irrigation systems, along with sustainable practices such as waste management and recycling, water management and conservation, water security, carbon-neutral construction, air quality monitoring and pollution control, and climate change solutionns.

Winner of the Sustainability, AgTech and Food Technologies will be announced at the Award Ceremony, Saturday, March 14th at 6:30pm.

events.title: Syncrets to Success: Conversation With Music Supervisors
events.description:
Want to get your music placed in TV, film, or games? 

Hear directly from top music supervisors on how they discover music, what makes a great pitch, and why some tracks get skipped. 

We’ll break down how artists can build trust, when to reach out, and how sync agents help. 

This is a candid conversation for music creators serious about sync and a continuation from the SXSW experiences I brought in 2025 — with real advice from the people who make the placements happen.

events.title: Tour Support 2.0: How Mental Health is Reshaping Live Music
events.description: The road can be a tough place, and especially for young artists early in their careers. In 2025, the Country Music Association made a major investment to sustain industry-focused mental health organizations with Amber Health delivering those resources directly to emerging artists on the road. This panel shares the story behind that collaboration—how rising country star Wyatt Flores, his manager William Dyer, CMA’s Tiffany Kerns and Dr. Chayim Newman of Amber Health joined forces to reimagine tour support and pioneer a new, replicable model for artist care in country music.

events.title: Tradwives, Throuples, Trends: What Modern Love Means for Ads
events.description: We are obsessed with romantic love. But relationship dynamics in America are changing and other forms of love—from platonic to filial to digital—are taking priority in our lives. These loves aren't secondary, they shape our identities and steer our decisions. There's a reckoning that romantic love can't and shouldn't fulfill all your needs. In a culture where gender roles, dating trends, and intimacy are being renegotiated in real time, how should brands respond?

events.title: Understanding Crypto: Conversations for the Curious Meet Up
events.description: Curious about crypto but unsure where to start? You're not alone. This meet up is a safe, beginner-friendly space to ask real questions and meet everyday people using crypto in practical ways. Join the National Cryptocurrency Association’s VP of Communications, Ali Tager, to demystify how people are using crypto – and why 76% of American crypto users say it has made a positive impact on their everyday lives. No bros, no pros, and no company pitches. Whether you've taken the first step or are trying to figure out what blockchain even means, come ready to share ideas, learn and connect.

events.title: When AI Shops for You
events.description: As AI agents begin to discover, recommend, and even purchase on behalf of consumers, the traditional path to purchase is being upended. This session explores the rise of agentic commerce and how it’s reshaping the consumer journey, from search and consideration to checkout. We’ll examine the infrastructure enabling these agents, the implications for brand visibility and trust, and how marketers, platforms, and technologists must adapt to stay relevant when AI shops for us.

speakers.name: Cheryl Guerin
speakers.title: EVP, Global Brand Strategy and Innovation

events.title: American Doctor
events.description: American Doctor is a vérité non-fiction film following three prominent physicians–Palestinian, Jewish and Zoroastrian—friends who couldn’t be more different but are bound by the shared oath to heal. Dr. Thaer Ahmad is measured, Dr. Mark Perlmutter is blunt, and Dr. Feroze Sidhwa is steeped in scholarship. Filmed in unfolding, on-the-ground scenes, the story follows them from a Gazan hospital under siege, to the halls of Congress. Together they fight to keep a promise to their Palestinian colleagues and patients, which is to continue the struggle where it matters most: the United States.

events.title: AI that Ships: A Tech Lunch on Moving from Policy to Pilot
events.description:
Join us at the German Haus to explore the intersection of Generative AI, ethical data leadership, and global innovation. Our stage conversation bridges the gap between visionary tech and real-world impact, sparking high-level insights and international collaboration. Afterward, enjoy a vibrant networking lunch featuring excellent food and curated beats—a relaxed space designed to turn inspired ideas into lasting connections.

https://www.german-haus.com

events.title: Burger Mart From Invincible, Brought to You by Brisk
events.description: Step into your own episode of Invincible at the show’s iconic Burger Mart, built from the ground up in collaboration with Brisk. Order a hot BM and fries, get your photo taken at the scenic center booth, score a free custom Brisk can, and walk away with a full swag bag of exclusive merch.

events.title: The F-Stop
events.description: The F-Stop is bringing Focus Features films Obsession and The AI Doc: Or How I Became an Apocaloptimist to life through an immersive traveling Airstream experience. Step inside for immersive visuals, exclusive merch, and a creative breather between screenings, all inspired by bold, auteur‑driven storytelling.

events.title: High Score Game Arcade presents the Worldwide Tic-Tac-Toe Championship
events.description:
The Worldwide Tic Tac Toe Championship comes to its final, high-stakes moment at SXSW. After months of play across cities and communities around the world, this activation marks the culmination of a global tournament—bringing finalists, fans, and curious passersby together for live competition, spectacle, and celebration. Simple rules, universal appeal, and unexpected intensity converge in one last showdown where strategy, speed, and bragging rights are decided in real time.

More information here: highscoregamearcade.com

events.title: Invincible VS Arcade Pop Up
events.description: Invincible VS, a new 3x3 tag fighter launching on April 30, 2026, is appearing at SXSW with an exclusive arcade pop up featuring a roster of 10 playable characters including a new unannounced fan favorite fighter. Free swag and giveaways will be available for all who come to play the most epic and bloody fight in the universe, with a special gift for fans who pre-order the game onsite or show proof of preorder.

events.title: Monsters of God
events.description: Most people fear reptiles. A few are fascinated. And a handful will stop at nothing to have them. Collectors call it "the fever"— the relentless drive to chase what is bigger, rarer, deadlier. That fever created a billion-dollar criminal enterprise that spanned six continents over 50 years. Director Eric Goode ("Tiger King," "Chimp Crazy") follows his first love, reptiles, into the dark and gonzo underworld of exotic animal smuggling. As he digs deeper, he uncovers an empire built on obsession, filled with smugglers, collectors, and the animal cops trying to stop them.

events.title: Music Industry Connect: Artists, Creatives & Professionals Meet Up
events.description:
This official SXSW meet-up brings together emerging artists, managers, and music industry
professionals to connect, exchange insights, and build meaningful relationships. In a collaborative and welcoming setting, attendees can discuss career growth, industry trends, and creative strategy while expanding their networks. events.title: Radium Dolls
events.description: Radium Dolls are one of Australia’s most exciting rising rock bands, known for explosive live shows, razor-sharp lyricism, and a sound that balances grit, heart, and swagger in equal measure. Formed in Brisbane the four-piece have built a fiercely independent momentum, with their debut album "Legal Speed" (2024) earning national airplay, critical acclaim, and a Queensland Album of the Year nomination. Their sophomore album "Wound Up" debuted at #2 on the ARIA Australian Albums Chart, marking a major breakthrough and driving another fully sold-out national tour. The band have achieved major streaming and editorial success with singles including “Scorching Heat”, “Golden Boy", "Moving" and "Daddy", while their breakout track “Tractor Parts” has recently surpassed one million streams. The band has even caught the attention of music tastemaker Derrick Gee who named Radium Dolls his “favourite band of the moment”. With their debut American tour ahead and SXSW appearances, Radium Dolls are poised to introduce North America to the next era of Australian rock.

events.title: The Family Battenberg
events.description:
‘The Family Battenberg have perfected a filthy, fuzzy psychedelic sound that they’ve coined as “spider rock.” (The Face)
The Family Battenberg's 'Anteater' single, released in April 2025, is an independent release by the Cardiff based four-piece. The track was written in just a day, and it was recorded at Tom Rees’ (Buzzard Buzzard Buzzard) studio while he was on holiday. To master the recording the group sought out long-time collaborator Eddie Al-Shakarchi (Boy Azooga, Loathe, Swim Deep.)

Aligning with the soundscape that’s signature to them, ‘Anteater’ is The Family Battenberg finessed. Drenched in fuzzy saturation, spacey vocals ricochet between a blistering guitar, all while a double-tracked mono drum plays like a call to action.  This is an anti-love song. When unhealthy adoration becomes a quest for romance, or approval in this case, we find ourselves doing strange things. In this story, the protagonist justifies total metamorphosis in the name of subservience. “It’s self-humiliation in the pursuit of a potential suitor’s attention,” as frontman Eliot puts it. Anyone that has seen this band live before is sure to recognise it from past setlists. The group had played it as an unreleased track amongst their own shows and a host of major festivals, namely,

Greenman, Trans Musicales 2024, Reeperbahn 2024 and ESNS 2025. As budding upcomers, the group have also supported the likes of Getdown Services, Panic Shack, Gruff Rhys and the Bug Club.

Championed by Steve Lamacq, Amy Lame, Huw Stephens and Adam Walton, the group are already making their mark on the industry.

'Wow I love that, a South Walian answer to Psychedelic Porn Crumpets' John Kennedy, Radio X

Legendary filmmaker Steven Spielberg is joined by Sean Fennessey, Host of The Big Picture podcast, for a wide-ranging conversation about his extraordinary body of work, the future of movies and moviegoing, and his upcoming film, Disclosure Day. Across Spielberg’s 60+ year career, he has frequently returned to stories about alien races, the threat of technology to the natural world, the mystery of space, and social panic. The record’s unbridled sincerity isn’t anything new for runo plum, who’s been writing and quietly sharing bedroom dispatches of her intricate folk for a half-decade. During the pandemic years, she steadily caught the ears of a widening circle of listeners and began independently releasing a series of singles and EPs, all while cutting her teeth on the live side supporting Searows, Angel Olsen and Hovvdy.

events.title: Famous Friend
events.description:
Famous Friend is the sun-bleached, indie surf solo project of ASCAP award-winning artist and producer Zachariah Carlson. Born out of the fame-soaked dreamscape of West Los Angeles, Famous Friend began as an alter-ego, a playful mirror of the city’s obsession with image. His music blends washed-out indie surf guitars with sparkling dream pop production and post-punk drums, balancing joy and heartbreak in equal measure.

The result is nostalgic and cinematic: beach day euphoria melts into late night reflections about relationships past and present. Songs like “Tanlines” and “Nora” have earned millions of streams and support from KCRW tastemakers and helped secure him a spot as a recent member of the prestigious Taco Bell Feed the Beat class of 2025. Amidst all the noise, Famous Friend continues to turn California melancholy into shimmering, golden-hour anthems for dreamers and outsiders.

P.S. The multi-instrumentalist is also a frequent writer, producer, collaborator with some of Los Angeles’s premiere indie and alternative acts like Winnetka Bowling League, Casket Cassette, and Floats as well as composer for shows like the Emmy-Nominated “Alexa & Katie.”

events.title: Adult DVD
events.description:
Adult DVD, the Leeds based six piece have become known for their relentless output of euphoric hooks and grooves along with a relentless touring schedule that has taken them to Glastonbury, Greenman, End Of The Road and several European festivals this Summer.
Formed by vocalist Harry Hanson and synth-player Greg Lonsdale, the project quickly expanded to a full band with Danny Blackburn (guitar/synth), Jake Williams (synth), Jonathan Newell (drums), and George Manson (bass). From the outset, their tongue-in-cheek lyrics, pulsating electronics, big choruses and unique production style (their releases are all self-produced) set them apart from the indie-rock landscape. 
Few songs capture the chaotic fun of Adult DVD more than their first release ‘Bill Murray’ - now a firm fan favourite and sing along moment at every festival set. First ‘proper’ single ‘Do Something’ from their 'Next Day Shipping' EP earned a spot on the BBC 6 Music B-list and support from BBC Radio 1, BBC Introducing and Radio X. Subsequent single ‘Because I Like It’ also landed onto the 6 Music B-list, and accompanying live performance from the BBC’s 6 Music festival.
Adult DVD’s live shows are fast becoming legendary. From sold-out hometown headline gigs at Brudenell Social Club and Belgrave Music Hall (2 in the round shows in one day) to storming sets at The Great Escape, Deer Shed Festival, and Live at Leeds, their performances are high-energy and unmissable.
Whether tapping into their love for chorus-centric indie or the influence of acid house floor fillers, DJing, or remixing their musical contemporaries their core appeal remains consistent: undeniable humour, bold danceable instrumentals and instantly memorable songwriting."
events.venue: Radio Day Stage @ Downright Austin Backyard

events.title: Beyond The Duplex Planet
events.description: In 1979, David Greenberger, a recent art school grad became activities director at a Boston nursing home. David began interviewing the residents, rejecting pat questions with the unexpected: "Which do you prefer – coffee or meat?," “What is embarrassment?,” and “How close can you get to a penguin?” The result was The Duplex Planet, an early ‘zine characterized by humor, warmth and sincerity. Today David’s work takes the form of spoken word shows and recordings. Beyond the Duplex Planet explores notions of aging and its intersection with art and community. It’s also a slightly ironic look at the life of an artist devoted to documenting the elderly who is himself in his senior years.

events.title: Jack Johnson: SURFILMUSIC
events.description: An intimate look into Jack Johnson’s evolution from surfer to filmmaker to world-renowned musician. The documentary traces how his early years making surf films with close friends became a foundation for a much broader creative life, capturing moments in and out of the water that later surfaced in his songwriting. Blending rare footage from those formative surf films and Johnson's personal and family archives with present-day reflections, the film weaves together how lived experience, friendship, and exploration shaped the sound and stories behind the music.

events.title: 4D Volumetric Video & Gaussian Splats for XR Creators
events.description: Step into the future of content creation with this hands-on workshop exploring 4D Gaussian Splatting—the next evolution in volumetric video. Learn how real-time volumetric capture is transforming live streaming, XR experiences, and immersive storytelling. From filming with multi-camera rigs to compressing, rendering, and deploying in platforms like Unreal Engine, Unity, SuperSplat, and UVRSE, you'll discover how this cutting-edge tech brings people, performances, and places into fully spatialized digital worlds.

events.title: 7 Lies People Tell Today (& the Brain Science to Beat Them)
events.description: To separate yourself from AI slop and connect with customers, you need authentic, relevant messages.But customers say things about how they behave & what they want that just aren’t true. And their insistence compromises your marketing. Discover 7 current, common lies customers tell, plus the brain science backed ways to counteract them. Jammed with proven research and in-market examples, this session reveals exactly how to avoid messaging landmines at a time when what you say and how you say it makes all the difference. Don’t do what people claim they want. Do what science shows will work.

I introduce fresh frameworks and practical models for bootstrapping—brought to life through the story of starting Bronto Software, growing it year by year on our own terms, and ultimately selling it to NetSuite/Oracle for $200 million. The result is equal parts practical playbook and behind-the-scenes story.

events.title: Beyond Belief: How to Break Limits and Unlock Potential
events.description: What if your beliefs, not circumstances, determined your limits? Grounded in cutting-edge science and powerful stories, this session explores how beliefs shape reality by altering perception, performance, and physical experience. Learn how neuroscience-backed frameworks of Attention, Anticipation, and Agency can transform limitations into strengths, overcome negative narratives, and unlock extraordinary results in leadership, creativity, business, and personal life—without magical thinking.

events.title: Big Ideas, Tiny Budgets: How Creativity Wins
events.description: Grace Wells breaks down how she turned scrappy parody commercials into a full-blown creative career. She’ll walk through her process for producing viral-quality product videos using minimal equipment, a sharp eye, and a lot of imagination. Attendees will learn how creativity, not budget, drives reach—and how to use humor, storyboarding, and craft to make content that brands and audiences love.

events.title: Busting Myths: Why Virtual Production Isn’t What You Think
events.description:
Across the industry there are several misconceptions about virtual production. It’s a VFX tool. It’s only good for car scenes or sci-fi. It’s too expensive for independent films. It’s a silver bullet that can fix all problems. 
In this session our panel will bust these myths and provide insight into how filmmakers can truly benefit from virtual production and how it’s changing the film and TV production landscape. And to put it to the test, the session will end with our panel breaking down a film treatment live to show how filmmakers can plan a shoot to get the most out of virtual production.

events.title: Chasing the Truth: How Stories We Tell Spark Cultural Change
events.description: What does it take to transform a true story into a compelling podcast? Short answer, dedication. In the form of spoken words, podcasts can bring to light hidden truths, scandals and injustices...rallying audiences behind a cause and sparking outrage. And this, in the best instances, leads to change. Join veteran podcast hosts from the true crime and non-fiction podcast space as they reveal the behind the scenes of bringing these stories to life. They’ll share everything from the realities of tracking down reluctant or dangerous sources and navigating legal challenges, to structuring serialize

events.title: Climate Action Core Conversation
events.description: This interactive meetup flips the traditional panel format by turning attendees into speakers. In three fast-paced rounds, volunteers from the audience will take the stage to introduce themselves and answer two curated questions from the hosts. This peer-led format encourages cross-sector dialogue, surfaces unexpected insights, and empowers emerging voices in sustainability, circularity, regenerative systems, and climate action. The session ends with guided, field-specific networking designed to foster collaboration and diversify professional connections within the climate space.

events.title: The Companies Building and Automating Space's Superhighway
events.description: How do we keep space sustainable as it gets more crowded? Enter the Space Superhighway: a network of in-space robots that will keep spacecraft fueled, repaired, upgraded and built in orbit. Just like highways rely on gas stations, tow trucks and repair shops, space will need support systems to be accessible for future generations. This tech is real TODAY. Our panel convenes accomplished doers from startups working to extend the life of satellites, reduce space debris and build a future where space is safe, scalable and sustainable for exploration and economic development to benefit society.

events.title: Customize Your Artist Marketing Rollout
events.description: Drew de Leon, a 15-year music industry veteran, leads a presentation dedicated to customizing your 2026 digital marketing rollout. This session will over key areas such as artist branding, defining your fans, building your community, developing a consistent content strategy, and mapping out a release plan to set your music catalog up for long-term success.

events.title: Featured Session: 5 Non-Obvious Secrets of Human Connection (For Love & Profit)
events.description: What will it take to win the future? We’re suffocated by noise, minimized by algorithms, and living in fear of being replaced by technology. The cocoon of technology is making us lose touch with the messy, irreplaceable spark of real connection. In this provocative featured session, SXSW favorite Rohit Bhargava reveals five counterintuitive secrets from his most recent trend research about how we bond, trust, and remain indispensable in the modern world. The people who understand people always win. If you believe this, then this session is your key to becoming one of them.

events.title: Featured Session: A Conversation with The All-American Rejects
events.description: For their first-ever SXSW appearance, The All-American Rejects will share how their sold-out House Party Tour reimagined live music by performing in backyards, skateparks and unique spaces for fans and artists. Once a staple of the major label system, the band is now fully independent—writing, recording, and releasing on their own terms. In this session, they’ll explore how artists can break into touring without gatekeepers and build community-driven experiences outside traditional venues.

events.title: Featured Session: Shaping Brand Relevance for a New Generation
events.description: Join Disney for a candid, forward-looking conversation on staying culturally relevant and driving growth in a rapidly changing market. Drawing from real-world experience at the intersection of commerce, creativity and global trends, this session will tackle the essential question for any organization: "How can brands remain meaningful and resilient for future generations?"

events.title: Forget Recruiting. Design Your Own Workforce.
events.description: What if your future leaders are already working inside your company - and they haven’t even graduated yet? Forward‑thinking organizations aren’t waiting for talent to emerge. They’re helping shape it.  Companies of all sizes are using work-integrated programs to build stronger talent pipelines, fuel innovation, and cultivate future-ready skill sets. In this candid conversation, you’ll learn why hands-on experience is quickly becoming one of the most valuable credentials and how organizations that invest early gain not just future-ready talent, but a strategic advantage.

events.description: If you ask someone their favorite version of The Great Gatsby, they might say Leonardo DiCaprio as few know there was a 1926 version that no longer exists. With insights from expert film archivists from leading production companies , we'll explore how AI-powered metadata tools are modernizing cultural preservation, making once-lost footage more accessible for creators and audiences alike.

In a time of climate disruption, demographic decline, and AI-driven change, discover which cities are rising, which are falling behind, and how data, design, and long-term thinking can future-proof communities and economies.

events.title: Meet Gen Alpha: Defying Predictions & Rewiring Marketing

Drawing on new global research among more than 80,000 Gen Alphas, this session will unpack the digital behaviors, subcultures, and emotional drivers set to shape the next era of brand connection. What does loyalty mean to a generation raised on creator culture, co-creation and digital experimentation? How are concepts such as trust and value evolving?  We’ll explore how cultural nuance, parenting, and technology shape their worldview, and how brands can build trust through ethical, insight-led engagement.

events.title: Pitch Camp! How To Win Creative Pitches by Being More Human
events.description: Let's be honest, pitching clients for new business is a slog.  Whether you're seeking new partners or locked in a 5-way competition, there is a way to cut through the madness and remain calm. This workshop will focus on human connection, now more important than ever in the age of AI. We will share hands-on tools for deepening client relationships, getting the right flow in your pitch, collaborating with your team, and standing out in a world of sameness. The facilitators have years of experience on both sides of the pitch table: at Frog, McKinsey, Philips, and Publicis Sapient.

events.title: Play to Build: Prosocial AI for Human Connection
events.description: What if AI helped us connect more deeply with each other, not just with a chatbot? This hands-on workshop introduces the 5 Principles for Prosocial AI, a new framework for designing tech that strengthens identity, agency, and real-world relationships. Then, we play The AI Effect, a fast-paced card game that challenges you to debate, design, and reflect: when does AI bring us closer, and when does it pull us apart? Come for the research-backed design; stay for the playful friction, ethical dilemmas, and radical imagination.

events.title: The Real Fight Is Local: Repro Freedom State by State
events.description:
Since the fall of Roe, federal protections for reproductive rights are gone. What happens now is being decided state by state. This panel brings together powerhouse women leading the way on reproductive rights across the country. They’re not waiting on Congress; they’re building the future of reproductive freedom right now.

You’ll hear real-world strategies, often at the intersection of race, gender, and democracy, and you’ll walk away with a clear understanding of what’s working, what’s next, and how to plug in. Because the truth is, we can’t win nationally if we’re losing in the states.

events.title: Round Table: Sales, Acquisitions, and Distribution: John Von Thaden, Joe Yanick, and Shaked Berenson
events.description: An extension of our popular Mentor Sessions, our Round Table Sessions not only allow attendees to learn from the industry experts that sit at each of the three tables in this session but they also allow attendees to learn from the questions and experiences of their peers as well. This Round Table Session will bring together industry experts and SXSW attendees for an enlightening discussion on Sales, Acquisitions, and Distribution.

events.title: So, Everyone Has a Podcast. Should They?
events.description: With more than 4 million indexed podcasts worldwide, it feels like everyone has a podcast… but should they? Join our panel of audio industry experts for a provocative conversation on the low barrier to entry vs. the high bar for success in podcasting. Hear direct insights on how to break through, when to pass on (or bet on) the right talent, and what it actually takes to make, market, and monetize your show for sustainable success.

events.title: Space Workforce Meet Up
events.description: Texas has always been the frontier of America’s biggest ideas - from cattle drives to microchips, music revolutions to moonshots. In 2026, the frontier is shifting upward, and the call for the New Space Cowboy is here.  In this era of commercial space, the next giant leap won’t be driven by astronauts, but welders, coders, machinists, technicians, scientists, mission operators, and dreamers. And no place on Earth is better positioned to cultivate this next gen of talent. Join the Space Workforce Incubator for Texas for a meetup that blends the spirit of the Wild West with the future's promise.

events.title: Sprints for Social Impact: Turn Time Pressure into Purpose
events.description: Discover how to turn purpose into action through rapid collaboration. In this interactive workshop, participants uncover their company’s unique “superpower” and use it to design a purpose-driven prototype addressing a real community need. Through guided exercises, folks will learn to align creativity with impact, build shared value between corporate and community goals, and craft a compelling pitch to bring their prototype to life. Experience how purpose-driven sprint work can empower employees through meaningful volunteerism and opportunities to create lasting social change.

events.title: SXSW Pitch-Smart Cities, Transportation, Manufacturing & Logistics
events.description:
The SXSW Pitch provides a platform for early-stage technology startups to present their groundbreaking products and services to a panel of distinguished industry experts, influential media professionals, and leading venture capitalists and angel investors.

On Friday, March 13, five innovative companies will take the stage in Salon FGH at the JW Marriott, showcasing their ideas, innovations, and entrepreneurial vision before a live audience and judging panel. Come be inspired by the next generation of tech innovators shaping the future.

Smart Cities, Transportation, Manufacturing & LogisticsTechnologies that create and advance smart cities, enhance transportation systems, modernize manufacturing, transform logistics, and strengthen government infrastructure and civic operations. These innovations improve urban environments, mobility, industrial automation, global supply chains, and the travel and tourism industry. Applications include real estate development, infrastructure, utilities, public works, security, population data, government and civic services, digital service delivery, transparency, and urban planning and design. This category also encompasses advancements in transportation, such as autonomous vehicles, automotive improvements, ridesharing, multi-modal mobility, product delivery, and logistics optimization. In manufacturing, it highlights Industry 4.0 innovations like IoT-enabled production, 3D printing, robotics, metamaterials, predictive maintenance, digital twins, augmented construction, omnichannel management, and AI-driven industrial automation. Supply chain and logistics technologies focus on automation in warehouses, last-mile delivery, inventory management, and AI-powered demand forecasting.

Winner of the Smart Cities, Transportation, Manufacturing & Logistics Technologies will be announced at the Award Ceremony, Saturday, March 14th at 6:30pm.

events.title: Today, Explained Live
events.description: Today, Explained is Vox's award-winning daily news explainer podcast. Every weekday, the show takes on one essential news story that defines our moment, and brings listeners the context they need to understand it. Join Vox’s Astead Herndon live for a conversation with a special guest.

events.title: U.S. vs. The World: the Future We’re (Currently) Losing
events.description: Is the United States losing its edge in global innovation? In this high-energy continuation of last year’s SXSW session, Congressman Gabe Amo and VC Matthew Weinberg delve further into how Trump-era research cuts, clean energy rollbacks, and talent restrictions have created lasting consequences for U.S. competitiveness and opened the door for China to surge ahead. Blending policy insight with on-the-ground investor perspective, this advanced fireside chat asks: How do we revamp a system with no Plan B, and what bold, bipartisan moves can win our future back before it’s too late?

events.title: Venture Capital Trends in Texas
events.description: While venture activity has cooled across the U.S., Texas continues to attract a surge of technical talent, ambitious founders, and fresh capital. Valuations remain strong for breakout companies, especially those pioneering the next wave of AI-driven disruption. Join leading VC partners as they unpack the data and explore what’s fueling the state's continued rise.

events.title: Who Gets Credit When Anyone Can Train a Music AI?
events.description: Open-source models like MusicGen and LLaRK have made it possible for anyone to generate music trained on unlicensed datasets, with no metadata, no audit trail, and no path to compensation. This panel unpacks the growing attribution crisis: how metadata is breaking down, how local models make enforcement impossible, and how startups and regulators are working to rebuild trust and traceability. Can ethical licensing survive when the tools of mass creation are in everyone’s hands?

events.title: Your Attention Please
events.description:
A new generation of parents, teens, and reformers are fighting back against Big Tech’s agenda to define the future of human connection. From Kristin, a mother pursuing legislative reform after losing her son, to Trisha, a young programmer building technology to stop cyberbullying, the film reveals how deeply the attention economy is reshaping us.

Blending intimate human stories with insights from leading experts in tech reform and digital wellbeing, "Your Attention Please" asks some of the most urgent questions of our time: Can we reclaim our autonomy? Can technology be redesigned to serve humanity? And what does a healthier relationship with the digital world look like for us and our kids?

events.title: Lucky
events.description:
Growing up in Staghorn Flat, Victoria, Lucky burst onto the scene in flurry of fuzzy guitars
and captivating storytelling. Blending the raw energy of alternative rock, with the dreamy
haze of modern indie, her music captures the nuances of life's everyday moments and
dives deep, putting you right at the centre of her world.

Having supported the likes of The Belair Lip Bombs, Hockey Dad, Armlock and Dear
Seattle, the Melbourne based artist is set for an exciting 2026 - following the release of
her single ‘Lady Beetle’, Lucky is building a devoted audience who are eagerly waiting to
see what’s in store next.

events.title: Black Zombie
events.description: From the flickering screens of Hollywood horror, to the haunted cane fields of colonial Haiti, "Black Zombie" unearths the buried origins of the zombie, reclaiming it as a symbol of survival and spiritual resistance.

events.title: Seahorse
events.description: Nola, a sous chef searching for stability, is barely holding her life together. After a brutal Friday night shift, she crashes her bike and wakes to find her estranged father, Cyrus, now unhoused, standing over her. Taking him in forces long-buried wounds to the surface. As past and present collide, Nola is pulled into a reckoning with grief, forgiveness, and the fragile possibility of repair.
