events.title: The Saviors
events.description: Sean and Kim Harrison are a suburban couple about to divorce. By renting their guest house to a quiet Middle Eastern brother and sister, Amir and Jahan Razi, they find a perfect solution: raise money to fix and sell their house, then separate. But when bizarre occurrences begin to add up – mysterious lights, missing animals, glimpses of unexplainable tech – in the days before the President’s upcoming visit to town, their guests' strange behavior starts to seem suspicious and potentially dangerous. As Sean and Kim investigate their new tenants, they rediscover the emotional connection they once shared. But reconciliation may come at a significant cost in this timely and provocative thriller.

events.title: The Tullamarines
events.description:
The amalgamation of four distinct voices from Adelaide, The Tullamarines tell their stories through a shared perspective that feels intimate, honest, and quietly uplifting. Josh, Angus, Benny and Lucinda met on the local gig circuit, quickly bonding over a mutual love of songwriting and collaboration. From those early connections, they’ve crafted a sound that reflects each member’s individual sensibilities - a style they affectionately call cosy-pop.
 
Their songs move through life’s highs and lows with the warmth of an old friend, inviting listeners into their living room, putting the kettle on, and sitting with whatever feeling the day brings. That sense of closeness runs through both their recorded work and their live shows.
 
Having appeared on festival line-ups including Beyond The Valley, Laneway Festival, Spin Off Festival and New Year’s Eve on the Hill, and toured extensively alongside artists such as Old Mervs, The Preatures, Ball Park Music and Alex Lahey, The Tullamarines continue to build a reputation for heartfelt songwriting and deeply human performances.
events.venue: Radio Day Stage @ Downright Austin Backyard

events.title: We Are The Shaggs
events.description: Three sisters from rural New Hampshire formed a band in the late 1960s, but not by choice. Betty, Dorothy, and Helen Wiggin had no interest in playing music. In fact, they had no musical abilities at all. It was their father Austin, inspired by a prophecy, who became convinced that his girls would become rock stars. He pulled his daughters out of school, bought them a pair of cheap guitars and a drum kit, dubbed them The Shaggs, and basically commanded them to make music. In 1969, he brought the girls to a storefront recording studio outside of Boston, and the result is one of the most head-scratching and polarizing albums ever committed to vinyl. "We Are The Shaggs" is their story.

events.title: What happened to the American Dream?
events.description: As the United States approaches its 250th anniversary in 2026, AMERIGO is a landmark documentary produced for PBS stations that asks: What happened to the American Dream? In a fireside chat, The Bourne Ultimatum writer George Nolfi interviews AMERIGO’s Emmy Award–winning producer, David McCourt, about the middle-class squeeze, its impact on Americans’ physical and mental health, how capitalism can shift from extracting value to delivering community solutions, and why rebuilding local communities is vital to America’s future.

events.title: The AI Doc: Or How I Became an Apocaloptimist
events.description: A father-to-be tries to figure out what is happening with the AI insanity, exploring the existential dangers and stunning promise of this technology that humanity has created.

events.title: Joybubbles
events.description: A boy discovers he can control the global telephone system by whistling a magic tone. Born blind and yearning for connection, his early obsession with the telephone sparks a subculture that shapes the future of hacking and technology.

events.title: Joybubbles

events.title: The Life We Leave
events.description: When Washington state became the first in the world to legalize human composting, entrepreneur Micah Truman puts it all on the line to build the world's first large-scale terramation facility. But when the conventional deathcare industry resists, he is forced to pivot, and must learn to care for the grieving while transforming his business.  Alongside Funeral Directors, Brie Smith and Katey Houston, he begins to understand the double bottom line is the only way to truly profit. What begins as an ambitious venture becomes personal as they rediscover human connection, ritual, and legacy.

events.title: Sparks
events.description:
Cleo is new to Sparks, Nevada when she discovers a cigarette vending machine that inexplicably produces a book on Jean-Luc Godard. When she meets the Crop soon after, Cleo’s morphed into a cinephile, and when she learns of the Crop’s reservoir visits, she’s certain that she could time travel and meet Godard in 60s Paris.	

Crop leader Antoine is enamored with Cleo but rankled by her insinuations that Crop life is boring. When Cleo disappears at the reservoir, Antoine calls into question his own sense of purpose, before unexpected adventures materialize—a shootout, a dreamy gay barbecue—until Cleo returns to Sparks and the Crop must figure out where she’s been and if she’s lost her mind.

events.title: Atsuko Chiba
events.description: Montréal’s Atsuko Chiba offer “pounding, angular rock” (BrooklynVegan), venturesomely crossing genre-defining borders with a cohesive and hypnotic blend of post-rock, progressive rock, and krautrock, weaving together a rich sonic tapestry that subverts through offbeat songwriting. In concert, they combine their unique brand of experimental rock with video and light installations triggered in real time by the band. While touring Canada, the United States, Europe, and the United Kingdom with their telepathic audiovisual tempest, the outfit have shared the stage with the likes of ...And You Will Know Us by the Trail of Dead, Big Business, King Buffalo, and Duchess Says, also playing notable events such as Portals Festival, SXSW, and M for Montreal. Since 2013, they have released three full-length albums (Jinn, Trace, and Water, It Feels Like It’s Growing), two EPs (Figure and Ground and The Memory Empire), as well as a slew of singles. After offering booming tracks “Pope’s Cocaine” and “Climax Therapy” in the Summer of 2025, the five-piece unveil Atsuko Chiba on April 24th, 2026 via Mothland.

events.title: Do You Love Me
events.description: "Do You Love Me" is a playful and personal journey through Lebanon’s audiovisual memory, composed entirely of archival footage. It is a love letter to Beirut, spanning 70 years of film, TV, home videos, and photography, exploring the Lebanese collective psyche - marked by joy and intimacy, destruction and loss. Through the eyes of citizens, filmmakers and artists, the film reconstructs a fragmented history in a country without a national archive, celebrating creative expression as both resistance, renewal and a way to preserve memory.

events.title: The Abortion Highway: Abortion Funds & Texas Abortion Toll
events.description: We dream of reproductive liberation for all communities, within Texas and beyond. Hear from Abortion Funds who advocate daily for abortion seekers and provide folks with compassionate support to make healthcare decisions that are best for them, regardless of age, income level, zip code, documentation status, or gender identity. Join us to learn how to fight back against anti-abortion policymakers and stigma strategically so we can co-create a future where all people have the power and resources to care for and affirm their bodies, identities and health for themselves and their families.

events.title: AI and Inclusive Storytelling: Tech's Effect on Representation
events.description: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is transforming the way stories are told. From shaping narratives to influencing how communities consume and share information, AI is rapidly rewriting the rules of culture, media, and connection. This panel will discuss the intersection of technology and storytelling, and the risks of leaving the American Muslim and other underrepresented communities behind, and what’s at stake if access to these tools are not available to those who need them the most.

events.title: Art as Identity in a Jobless Future
events.description:
As AI handles logic and efficiency, what survival skills do humans have left? TED Speaker Daniel Lismore, Forbes' #1 Futurist Jonathan Brill, and multimedia artist Marco Palou explore how art transitions from elite profession to essential practice: a way of staying human in an automated world.
Attendees will learn:

How to reclaim creativity as a survival skill in the post-work era
Why artistic identity can replace work-based self-definition
Practical frameworks for cultivating presence and meaning-making

When the dust settles, the artists survive.

speakers.name: Marco Palou (a.k.a. Baby Yors)
speakers.title: Multidisciplinary Artist, Author of Homo Artis

events.title: Beyond the Algorithm: Belonging in a Human+AI World
events.description: As AI becomes a collaborator at work, it’s reshaping how people find meaning, connect, and contribute. This panel explores how belonging evolves in Human+AI teams and the behaviors and mindsets leaders must model to inspire trust, motivation, and performance. Talent and leadership experts will discuss how to design emotionally intelligent cultures,  the human skills that matter most in an AI world, and how to ensure people feel valued for what only they can uniquely bring to an AI-augmented workplace.

events.title: Bootleg BBQ
events.description:
The Bootleg BBQ is British Underground’s iconic music show featuring emerging UK talent at Sam’s Town Point, the family-run South Austin honky-tonk bringing together a community of local artists and associates since 1981. Bootleg BBQ will be serving new music from extraordinary UK bands Karma Sheen, Whitelands and Congratulations with a side order of classic Austin BBQ, fine beers and good times. Hosted in partnership with Light In The Attic records.

For more information, please visit: https://www.britishunderground.net/current-projects/sxsw

events.title: Building Without Permission: Democratizing Entrepreneurship
events.description:
For decades, company building required permission from institutional gatekeepers. If you didn't go to the right school or know the right people, you were locked out.
AI is changing that. Just like bedroom producers no longer need record labels, solo founders no longer need MBAs or VC connections to build businesses.
But access to tools isn't enough. Most still fail, not because they can't build, but because they don't know how to navigate uncertainty.
This panel explores what infrastructure needs to exist for entrepreneurship to truly be accessible to everyone, and what happens when it is.

events.title: The Clock Is Ticking for Space – Replacing the ISS
events.description: After 30 years of continuous operation, the International Space Station is going away, and fast. What comes next? Enter Axiom Space. Against all odds, this Houston startup flew four crewed commercial missions to the ISS, led record-breaking research, engaged more than 31 nations in the pursuit of space access and partnered with Prada, Oakley, Nokia, and NASA all in pursuit of building the world’s first commercial space station. The dream of living and working in space is no longer distant. Welcome to the space industrialization era—the time is now to transcend Earth.

events.title: Creators Are the New Gatekeepers: Building Opportunity in Entertainment
events.description: Today’s creators aren’t just reacting to Hollywood, they’re shaping it. As audiences seek authenticity, creators have become the new gatekeepers of what’s seen, shared, and celebrated. From viral interviews to creator-led red carpets, this session dives into how creators can build influence in the entertainment world — crafting content that connects, collaborating with celebrities, studios, and brands, and turning partnerships into genuine growth. Hear from leading creators and industry insiders on how to build your voice, expand your reach, and become part of the next wave driving entertainment forward.

events.title: Fandom Runs The World: How Culture and Marketing Collide in 2026
events.description: Join us on an exploration of how fandom now drives what becomes the next blockbuster, bestseller, or breakout moment. As audiences seek belonging and identity in an increasingly fragmented digital world, fan communities have emerged as the true tastemakers of culture. Spanning entertainment, media, and brands, this panel examines how participation and passion are reshaping how culture is created, discovered, and marketed.

events.title: Featured Session: A Waste of Time with Larry David and Jeff Schaffer
events.description:
After unnerving the populace of the West Side of Los Angeles on Curb Your Enthusiasm, Larry David and Jeff Schaffer decided to cast a wider net on a grander subject - the History of the United States.

In honor of America’s 250th anniversary they have teamed up with the Obamas and Higher Ground for a historical sketch comedy series debuting on HBO this summer.

Larry and Jeff will discuss their process for Curb and the similarities and differences in making their new series - including a sneak peak of never-before-seen footage from the new show. And if you decide to walk out in the middle of it, they will completely understand.

Moderated by Lorraine Ali

events.title: Featured Session: Enough with the Bullsh*T: BuzzFeed Founder Shares His Plan to Make the Internet Fun Again
events.description: After years of doomscrolling and algorithmic slop, BuzzFeed founder Jonah Peretti believes the internet is overdue for a reset, and for the first time he will share his plan to make the internet fun again. We’ll take you behind the scenes of BuzzFeed’s AI incubator where we are creating a new medium for content, self-expression, and social connection. We’ll start with big picture ideas you can apply to your business. Then you’ll see live demos of new products and attendees will get special access to the latest from our lab. You’ll see how AI-powered experiences can create shared cultural moments and help people explore the world together, creating a better alternative to filter bubbles and doomscrolling. We are transforming our business with a new approach to AI, and you can join us to think about how to transform your own work to maximize creativity, human connection, and growth.

events.title: Featured Session: Last Meals Live with Mythical Chef Josh
events.description: From the team behind Good Mythical Morning comes Last Meals – the hit food-interview series where guests share the meal they'd want to eat before they die. Following crowd-favorite live tapings at Cannes and The Infatuation’s EEEEEATSCON 2025, Last Meals Live brings its signature blend of humor, heart, and existential reflection to SXSW. Featuring a special guest(s) tied to the festival, this session promises big questions, viral social media moments and a truly one-of-a-kind experience.

speakers.name: Josh Scherer
speakers.title: Executive Director Of Culinary Content, Host Of Last Meals

events.title: The Groove Effect: Turning Communities into transformational movements
events.description: The Groove Effect explores the deeper dynamics behind communities that truly transform people. Drawing from two decades building Groove Cruise, Jason Beukema shares the 8 Waves he’s observed when environments are intentionally designed for connection, creativity, belonging, and purpose. This Core Conversation examines how those waves unfold and how founders, creators, and culture builders can design experiences that move people from spectator to participant to lifelong advocate.

events.title: How Anyone Can Help Create Social Change: A Conversation with the authors of Somebody Should Do Something
events.description: People often feel powerless to create social change. Issues like climate change, misinformation, and the erosion of democracy are “wicked” problems. They are complex, multifaceted, global challenges with no simple solutions. How can anyone make a difference when it comes to problems like these? Drawing from philosophy, history, and contemporary social science, this talk offers tools for thinking in new ways about how individuals can help create transformative social change. Each of us can make a difference, but not in the ways we usually think.

speakers.name: Michael Brownstein
speakers.title: Professor and Chair of Philosophy
speakers.company: John Jay College And The Graduate Center, CUNY

events.title: I AM The Marketing Plan: Building Brands, Breaking Barriers in Music & Culture
events.description: Some chase the spotlight. Others become the strategy behind it. This panel showcases powerhouse women in entertainment who have mastered marketing, management, and executive leadership across the music industry—while applying that expertise to build personal brands and businesses that work for them. From artist development to campaign execution, they’ve driven culture behind the scenes and on center stage. Attendees will gain actionable insights tailored for artists, creatives, managers, and execs aiming for lasting success.

events.title: Inside the Campaign: Deconstructing Successful Brand-Creator Partnerships
events.description: How did a famous food giant ignite brand growth by collabing with YouTube creators? Go behind the scenes with the brand, the creators, and the influencer marketing agency to deconstruct the high-impact campaign. events.title: Is Brand Dead? The Brand Leader’s Playbook for the AI Era
events.description:
In a world flooded with content, does “brand” still matter?

This provocative panel explores how Gen AI is reshaping brand leadership and the creative process—from production to positioning. Join a diverse panel of Brand Leaders, Ad Execs & AI Natives as they tackle how brand teams must evolve to stay relevant, effective, & resonant. We’ll cover how leading marketers are embedding AI into creative pipelines, shifting talent models, and fighting the rise of "bad creative, faster."

For brand leaders serious about staying ahead of AI-powered brand transformation—this is your roadmap.

events.title: Launching the Ultimate, Research-Driven Creative Power Playbook
events.description:
Qual “testing” in Creative has a bad reputation, but that’s because the way most of it is framed and conducted is shit. It relies on likes and dislikes, dampening the soul of the work - making Creative vanilla. But not in our world. Here, winning Creative comes when brilliant brains are inspired by Qual; we elevate Creative by exploring unknown unknowns and using Creative to stimulate - and to power stronger ideas. Qual is no threat to creativity, it’s a catalyst.

We’ll prove that research is invaluable and deliver a Creative Power Playbook, co-created with
Creatives, CMOs and Insight Directors from the biggest brands to supercharge your work so it really lands in an age when your work has to hit harder than ever.

events.title: Leadership Unblocked: Break Through What's Holding You Back
events.description: Ever feel like you’re doing all the “right” things—yet still feel stuck? The problem isn’t effort or ambition. It’s the unseen beliefs shaping how you show up at work. In this eye-opening talk, Harvard Business Press author and host of the Coaching Real Leaders podcast, Muriel M. Wilkins, pulls back the curtain on what holds even the highest achievers back. Drawing from her bestselling book, Leadership Unblocked, she reveals seven beliefs that limit leadership potential—and offers a practical roadmap to break through them and lead with greater impact and ease.

The First Rule of NDAs - Don’t Talk About NDAs

How do you make a film about the weaponization of NDAs when people are prohibited from even admitting they signed one? This panel will examine how the film My NDA was made and how the filmmakers attempted to mitigate the risks faced by the film’s participants and the production itself. Panelists will discuss the thorny documentary ethics challenges that come into play when subjects are taking legal risks that could potentially lead to significant consequences.

events.title: Saving Monarchs With Machine Learning and Computer Vision
events.description: Monarch butterflies are experiencing severe declines, but AI-powered computer vision offers new hope for their conservation. This session explores how machine learning aids in identifying milkweed and invasive species, supporting precise conservation efforts across millions of acres. Learn how innovative image analysis is transforming vegetation management and habitat monitoring by combining technology and ecology to protect iconic pollinators, and why this approach is vital for maintaining biodiversity resilience.

events.title: Steven Bamidele
events.description:
Nigerian-born, London-based singer, songwriter, musician, and producer Steven Bamidele is known for his distinctive reverb-drenched falsetto, synth textures, and syncopated beats. Citing the influences of contemporary creators Frank Ocean, Tyler the Creator, Solange and Childish Gambino, he puts social commentary and artistic narratives at the forefront of his music. 

His recent sophomore album THE CRASH! was written against the backdrop of an ever-changing world, combining indie-soul and jazz, acoustic and electronic textures, along with daydream-esque storytelling. The LP received support from Blues Project, Somewhere Soul, BBC Radio 3, BBC 6Music, BBC Introducing, WorldwideFM, Clash, Wordplay and Fusicology, alongside playlisting from Jazz FM, FIP Radio France and KCRW.

To critical acclaim, he has headlined London’s iconic 100 Club, Brighton's Dome Studio and Prince Albert, Jazz re:freshed, Pizza Express Live Soho and more.  Steven has supported renowned artists Alice Russell, Sly5thAve, Hot 8 Brass Band, Marlon Craft, Kymara, Ebi Soda, while making festival appearances at We Out Here, Love Supreme, Shambala, The Great Escape, Brick Lane Jazz, SXSW London and beyond.

events.title: SXSW Pitch-Smart Data, Security, and FinTech
events.description:
The SXSW Pitch provides a platform for early-stage technology startups to present their groundbreaking products and services to a panel of distinguished industry experts, influential media professionals, and leading venture capitalists and angel investors.

On Friday, March 13, five innovative companies will take the stage in Salon FGH at the JW Marriott, showcasing their ideas, innovations, and entrepreneurial vision before a live audience and judging panel. Come be inspired by the next generation of tech innovators shaping the future.

Smart Data, Security, and FinTech Innovations that harness data and protect digital ecosystems while reimagining how people and institutions interact with money and information. This category includes startups focused on big data collection, simulation, analysis, and interpretation—turning raw information into actionable insights. These solutions prioritize effective data presentation and visualization, making complex content accessible through advanced analytics and user-centric design. Cybersecurity measures include threat detection, response, digital privacy, identity and access management, encryption, secure communications, infrastructure protection, and resilience against cyberattacks. This category also features cutting-edge financial technologies including fraud prevention, fraud protection, open banking, programmable money, cryptocurrencies, insurtech, embedded finance, payment systems, and alternative risk scoring. Solutions often support e-commerce platforms and help institutions maintain secure, scalable, and data-intelligent infrastructures. These innovations are critical in enabling trusted, connected digital economies across industries like finance and advertising.

Winner of the Smart Data, Security and FinTech Technologies will be announced at the Award Ceremony, Saturday, March 14th at 6:30pm.

events.title: Unlocking Soccer's Development in the U.S.
events.description:
With the FIFA World Cup 26 kicking off in less than 100 days, the time is now for the most popular game globally to reach its full potential stateside. The world’s biggest sporting event has the opportunity to elevate soccer in the US to new heights and build future sustainability for growth far beyond the event.

 
Join former USMNT star Jozy Altidore, City Football Group / Manchester City CMO Nuria Tarre and FIFA World Cup 26 NYNJ Host Committee CEO Alex Lasry for an insightful conversation on the future of the soccer in the United States.

 
In this session, these three notable and unique voices will share perspective on the opportunities and efforts underway to optimize the future of soccer, from fan growth to player development, as well as brand and community engagement.

events.title: Unscripted Insiders: Netflix x Hulu Meet Up
events.description:
Netflix’s Director of Unscripted Casting Rich Leist helped launch Netflix’s first in-house unscripted casting team, giving him a front-row seat to what platforms are actually looking for when they decide who gets on screen.  Joining him is Matt Nagorner, formerly a Warner Bros. unscripted talent lead and now co-president of IM Trying Productions, where he develops personality-driven unscripted series and formats. 

This meet-up is designed for connection first: a quick, candid kickoff on what’s working in unscripted right now (casting, talent packaging, formats, and where the market is moving), followed by plenty of time for fans, aspiring cast, producers, and suppliers to meet each other, swap intel, and leave with new contacts. Along the way, Matt can pull back the curtain on working across major franchises like The Bachelor, The Voice, and event specials including **Friends: The Reunion and the **Harry Potter 20th Anniversary: Return to Hogwarts.

events.title: Vibe Shift: How New Media Upended Our Ideas and Aesthetics
events.description: What are the vibes? This presentation will unpack the idea of a "vibe" - an aesthetic appraisal of a situation - and how these vibes can "shift." These shifts are dictated by cultural and political undercurrents, by current events, but most importantly by developments in technology. In a rapidly changing landscape with more sophisticated generative AI and social media algorithms, the vibes are shifting almost too fast to keep up. New meme genres, political movements, and ideological upheavals are occurring - and this talk will explain how and why.

events.title: What AI Agents Are Doing While You're Not Watching
events.description: Your AI assistant has the keys to everything – email, finances, sensitive systems – but operates in shadows you can't see, a problem that continues to grow as companies unleash agentic AI faster than they can build safeguards. This panel will explore how AI agents are changing the way we think about work and how we trust technology. We'll ask: What happens when an AI assistant, designed to help, accidentally (or intentionally) steps out of line? How do we even know what they're up to when they operate independently? And how can we stop AI agents from becoming the next insider threat?

events.title: Who Owns What: The State of Startups & Top Trends to Watch
events.description: Each year billions of dollars are invested in finding and building the next generation of great companies. So how do you increase your chances of being found and funded? Carta has conducted an analysis of data from tens of thousands of startups in its network since 2018, offering a bird’s eye view of the top trends in startup funding and job distribution. Discover whether employees are still getting meaningful equity, if founder ownership has improved or worsened over the last 5 years, and what you need to know to navigate these challenges as you build and pitch your company.

events.title: Will Podcasts Survive the YouTube Era?
events.description: As YouTube becomes the fastest-growing podcast platform and creators scramble to add video to their podcasts, a critical question emerges: Is pure audio dead? In this head-to-head debate, industry leaders will argue whether podcasting must evolve into a visual medium to survive, or if audio's unique intimacy and convenience will always have a place in our media landscape. We'll explore how creators and networks are navigating this visual-first world—from adding cameras to intimate conversations to leveraging video clips for social discovery while preserving audio's storytelling magic.

events.title: Spike Fuck
events.description:
Spike F*ck is a rare figure in contemporary music: direct, disarming, and impossible to pin down. Emerging from Melbourne’s underground in the late 2010s with The Smackwave EP, Spike fused bleak synth-pop, post-punk melodrama, and brutally honest songwriting into something both vulnerable and confrontational. Armed with only a backing track and a microphone, early live shows saw Spike sing candidly about addiction, gender, dysfunctional love, and collapse: a kind of wounded sincerity that quickly drew a cult following. Just as things seemed to be breaking open, Spike disappeared, retreating from public life amid a personal reckoning.

After a four-year hiatus -- during which time rumours swirled about death, institutions, or becoming a monk -- Spike returned sober, clear-eyed, and transformed. The music that followed is bigger, wilder, and more alive. Performed with a rotating full band, the new material draws from ‘70s glam, spiritual soul, and damaged rock and roll, but always filtered through Spike’s unmistakable voice: bruised, intense, poetic.

These are songs about recovery, identity, survival, and letting go not sanitised, not triumphant, but real. Where the early work stared into the void, the new work steps forward with purpose. It’s not a reinvention. It’s an evolution, one born from chaos, now grounded in clarity.

events.title: Adam's Apple
events.description: "Adam's Apple" is an intimate, collaborative documentary told through the dual perspectives of Adam, a transgender teen, and his mother, visual artist Amy Jenkins, that offers an authentic and tender counterpoint to the hostility facing trans youth today. Adam’s journey balances the milestones of gender transition with the rhythms of adolescence. As Adam asserts his identity and steps out into the world, his parents grapple with the challenges of raising a teen while learning to let go. Through a visually poetic approach, the film transforms a deeply personal archive, collected over two decades, into a powerful, joyful testament to the beauty and difficulty of reckoning with profound change.

Harold von Braunhut and Yolanda Signorelli worked together for forty years before Harold - a genius magician, scientist and inventor – passed away and left his iconic novelty toy in Yolanda’s care. Yolanda alone possesses the true Sea-Monkeys secret formula and she alone must free them, not only from their captors, but also from the stain of her husband’s dark legacy.

events.title: Family Movie
events.description:
The Smiths have gathered once again on their quaint family farm to make the latest in a string of low-budget horror movies. No, the movies aren't particularly "successful." Some might even call them "bad." But at least the family is together, and that's what matters to Jack and Ellen. Their adult children, on the other hand - Trent and Ula - are working up the courage to leave this particular family tradition behind. 
Simmering family dysfunction turns to pure chaos when a real dead body shows up on set. Can they come together to keep the movie on track, or will this be the Smith family's final act?

events.title: Mickey
events.description: Mickey spent the last ten years exploring her transition process within the conservative context of Sinaloa, Mexico. Through digital archives, artistic reenactments, and deeply personal encounters, the film moves between tenderness and rage, transforming memory into an act of freedom. An exploration of self-perception and a non-punitive confrontation with the past.

events.title: Mariae Cassandra
events.description:
Mariae Cassandra is an Australian singer songwriter from Perth, Western Australia, rapidly emerging as one of the country’s most compelling new voices. First capturing attention through her online songwriting videos and viral moments across TikTok, Instagram and YouTube, Mariae’s ability to pair intimate storytelling with hook driven pop has resonated with a growing global audience.

In 2024, Mariae won triple j Unearthed High with her breakout single “MillIon Billion Trillion” - a heartfelt ode to friendship that showcased her knack for emotionally direct, timeless songwriting. The win marked a turning point, positioning Mariae as a standout new artist and accelerating her rise beyond digital platforms.

Throughout 2024-25, Mariae built strong momentum, touring nationally as support for WAFIA, Spacey Jane, The Buoys and boywithuke, signing to Select Music and her debut EP “Everything In my Backpocket” via AWAL. 

In 2025, Mariae warmed up main stages for Charli XCX and beabadoobee at Laneway Festival, was named one of Live Nation’s Ones To Watch and showcased at BIGSOUND and SXSW Sydney.

events.title: My Brother's Killer
events.description: The unsolved murder of Billy London, a gay adult film performer brutally killed in West Hollywood, was an urban legend for 33 years. A documentary intended to honor his life took an unexpected turn when members of the community joined forces to uncover overlooked clues, and seek a resolution to the mystery of who killed him. Drawing on a rare trove of VHS and personal footage, the film reveals a chilling overlap between the victim and some of the suspects who were captured on camera in films made in the narrow window of Billy's death.

events.title: Daughters of the Forest
events.description:
"Daughters of the Forest" is a story of entanglements: between humans and mushrooms; the visible and the invisible; generational knowledge and modern science. This sci-fi documentary invites us to reconsider the experiences of both human and non-human inhabitants of our world.

We follow Lis and Juli, two young scientists from indigenous communities that have long lived in symbiosis with the many mushrooms in their regions. The world they know is changing, and their pursuits are threatened by deforestation, lack of opportunity, and loss. Still, they share how mushrooms show us different possibilities of coexistence, helping them overcome obstacles to reshape their lives and futures.

events.title: Daughters of the Forest
events.description:
