events.description:
Featuring a powerful mix of established global brands and budding startups, the International Innovations Expo highlights cutting-edge businesses that are pushing boundaries to move the world forward. From groundbreaking concepts to bold new business models, exhibitors are redefining what’s possible across industries around the globe. Join the community that’s driving change on a worldwide scale. The Expo will be free and open to the public on Saturday, March 14.

See the floor plan here: https://sxsw2026-sxexpointinnov.expofp.com/

events.title: University of Cincinnati Lounge
events.description: Think of us as the ultimate college lounge: coffee, chargers, comfy chairs, some adult beverages, and all the fuel you need to spark your next great idea. Oh, and there will be a free Allbirds drawing every day.

events.title: Featured Session: Amy Webb Launches 2026 Emerging Tech Trend Report
events.description: Forget hype cycles. The real story of 2026 is bigger, stranger, and closer than you imagine. At SXSW, futurist Amy Webb, CEO of the Future Today Strategy Group and professor at NYU Stern, will take you on a mind-bending exploration of the forces reshaping business, culture, and society. With her signature wit and data-driven approach, Amy will decode the emerging technologies that demand your attention and reveal scenarios that challenge how we think about the future. If you’ve joined Amy’s packed sessions in past years, you know to expect startling insights, big shifts in perspective, and ideas you’ll be talking about long after the session ends. This year, though, there’s a twist you won’t see coming—one that could change the way we track, understand, and act on trends forever. The theme is Creative Destruction. While there's no official dress code for the session, we do recommend you wear black.

events.title: The Audacity of Joyosity™: The Surprising ROI of Joy
events.description:
Depletion and disengagement are everywhere. Leaders are in crisis—decision-fatigued, over-optimized, and white-knuckling their way through weeks. AI, efficiency, and metrics aren’t answers.

Joy is.

In this interactive session, leadership and culture expert Jenn Whitmer—with 10x SXSW featured speaker Rohit Bhargava, founder of the Non-Obvious Company—shares stories and research showing how joy drives performance and profit. Get clear on what joy is, why it works at work, and how to use the Joy Ratio to create repeatable results—without grinding harder, toxic positivity, or lowering the bar.

events.title: Black Founders & Investors Meet Up
events.description: This meetup will foster connections, dialogue, and collaboration within the Black entrepreneurial and startup ecosystem. Explore pathways to success, share insights on overcoming challenges, and discuss opportunities for growth and impact. Whether you're launching a startup, seeking funding, or aiming to scale, this meetup is designed to cultivate a supportive community and inspire action towards greater diversity and inclusion in entrepreneurship.

events.title: Brand Strategy Workshop for Emerging Tech Companies
events.description: This workshop is focused on the strategic brand positioning of your innovative company and cutting-edge technology. We will be firmly situated on the market side of product-market fit. We will start by investigating your target market(s) and then your competitive set. Then we will work together to articulate the qualities of your company and technology that are differentiated and valuable to your next investor or client. All with the goal of helping your company to stand out in an unprecedented time of innovation.

speakers.name: Samantha Wolfe
speakers.title: NYU Adjunct Professor
speakers.company: NYU Steinhardt School of Culture, Education, and Human Development

events.title: Breaking Cultural Codes That Keep Latino Leaders Silent
events.description: What if the biggest barrier to innovation isn’t lack of talent, but cultural dissonance silencing brilliant minds? After nearly 10 years of Latinas sharing their secrets with me, I’ve discovered how collective mindset conditioning clashes with individual-focused business culture. Latinas taught that visibility, ambition, and self-promotion are taboo unconsciously sabotage their potential. One executive never pitched her game-changing strategy - not from imposter syndrome, but because visibility felt like betraying her cultural values. This session reveals how to break these codes while honoring our culture.

events.title: Can Media Survive AI? The Fight for Public Trust
events.description: AI is reshaping how information is created, distributed, and trusted. But it’s not just a threat - it’s an opportunity to reimagine what media can be. We will explore how AI is transforming business models, content incentives, and consumer expectations. From the rise of creators to the reinvention of trust, we’ll unpack what’s breaking, what’s possible, and how to build what’s next.

events.title: Climate in Crisis, Health at Risk: Technology as a Lifeline
events.description: The climate crisis is now a public health emergency. Heatwaves, floods, and droughts are worsening chronic conditions and disrupting healthcare infrastructure. This panel brings together global experts in health, science, and technology to showcase real-world solutions that are strengthening health system resilience—from predictive models using climate and health data to AI tools and digital platforms enabling remote care in vulnerable regions. Technology can be the bridge between collapse and adaptation.

events.title: Couture Cognition: How Fashion Shapes Our Brains
events.description: What if fashion could rewire your brain? Neuroscientist Dr. Heather Collins discusses Neurostyle: How shoes and clothing activate memory, mood, and neural storytelling—boosting focus, emotional resonance, and curiosity. From color-triggered cognition to texture-based associations, fashion activates neural empathy through shared aesthetic choices. Discover how style shapes brain states and how professionals—from designers to technologists—can harness fashion’s cognitive power to craft more inclusive, immersive, and high-performing environments, from runways to boardrooms.

speakers.name: Heather Collins, PhD
speakers.title: Cognitive Neuroscientist, Innovation curator, Peak Performance Expert

events.title: The Creator Growth Blueprint: How Small Audiences Become Real Businesses
events.description:
Every breakout creator starts the same way: with a small but engaged audience. But turning early traction into predictable income is where most creators get stuck. In this fireside chat, two operators who have helped thousands of creators -- and built their own businesses from scratch -- go deep on what actually drives sustainable growth in 2026.

Through a candid, tactical conversation, Tyler Denk and Codie Sanchez will unpack:
1. How early-stage creators identify and keep their highest-value audience.
2. What separates creators who break out from those who stall.
3. The first revenue streams that create real momentum.
4. The systems and workflows that compound growth over time.
5. The most common traps new creators fall into — and how to avoid them.

Attendees will leave with a clear, actionable blueprint for turning a small audience into a meaningful, durable creator business.

events.title: Epitome of Innovation: Long-Term Creator Partnerships
events.description: In the digital age, creator relationships based on trust and long-term investment are the ultimate innovation. These relationships not only empower creators as content engines but as culture-shaping collaborators who drive full-funnel results. Learn how real influence begins when creators start in the strategy room and long-term partnerships are not only established but fostered.

events.title: Experience the Future of Flight
events.description: Experience flying in a Cirrus aircraft through Apple Pro Vision goggles and then check out the all new SR Series G7+ aircraft on-site.

events.title: Featured Session: Why Saying Yes to the Unthinkable Works
events.description: We’re conditioned to play it safe—but what if the wild, unpolished ideas are actually the smartest bets? In this talk, you'll hear real stories of bold ideas that went from "no way" to "how did they do that?" It's a rallying cry for creators and leaders to stop self-editing, embrace bold thinking, and protect the unthinkable—because that’s where the magic (and real impact) happens.

events.title: Filmmakers to Creators: Crowdfunding & Community Masterclass
events.description: What happens when filmmakers stop pitching to gatekeepers and start building their own audiences? They become creators—turning fans into financiers and evangelists. In this hands‑on workshop you'll dissect two campaigns that blew past their goals. You'll see the exact blueprint: pre-launch email lists, social teasers, personal stories, assembling a volunteer team, and designing a campaign video and page with eye-popping visuals. Leave with tactical takeaways you can apply to your projects immediately to build your strategy, craft your narrative, and turn backers into lifelong fans.

events.title: Flatstock
events.description:
Looking for the perfect centerpiece for your gallery wall, a concert poster of your favorite artist, or your favorite Texas-themed memorabilia? Look no further than Flatstock! This eclectic art market continues to capture the spirit of music mementos while also highlighting unique collectibles. Flatstock provides an ongoing series of opportunities to admire artwork in person and to meet the artists who created it. This Expo is free and open to the public.

See the Flatstock Guide here: https://app-na1.hubspotdocuments.com/documents/558236/view/1620947864?accessId=75a3c4

See the floor plan here: https://sxsw2026-flatstock.expofp.com/

events.title: GOING BIG IN TEXAS - Slovak House
events.description:
Slovak House on March 14 returning to Austin,, and we’re making it bigger and better.

Located right in the center of the action on E 6th Street, Slovak House will host an all-day program bringing together people who are serious about business, innovation, and scaling across continents. Join us! If you’re building, investing, or partnering between Europe and the United States, this is the room to be in. Plus, expect great food and drinks, live music, and a room full of good people.

For more information, please visit: https://luma.com/SlovakHouse

events.title: hālo haus
events.description: hālo haus is a 4 day gathering centered on beauty, wellness, and longevity. Hosted on a full street closure in downtown Austin, the program blends fireside chats, leading voices, experiential activations, and recovery-focused offerings within an open, discovery-driven format. hālo haus brings together founders, creators, clinicians, and cultural leaders to explore how self-care and performance are evolving alongside culture.

events.title: How to Design a Successful Work Culture
events.description: Work culture gaps remain unbridgeable at many companies, yet failing to shrink them in today's multi-generational work world is like ignoring the oil light on your dashboard. You're not avoiding a breakdown—you're scheduling it for later. Join this remarkable line-up of today's top work culture experts to hear what keeps driving the divides—and how these designers are helping firms shift traditional career models, link people strategy to business value and use AI and new narratives to improve how people experience work, not as a demographic challenge, but as a design and strategy imperative.

speakers.name: Solange Charas
speakers.title: Professor of Professional Practice and CEO

events.title: Is Search Totally F**ked? What Do We Do Now?
events.description: We’re wired to search. With billions of search queries per day, marketers have long known where and how to find their audiences.Now with the rise of generative engines and AI, the search landscape is facing its biggest upheaval in decades. Traditional search, long the backbone of digital strategy, is being rapidly replaced by generative engine optimization (GEO), fragmented user journeys, and new discovery ecosystems. This session will highlight immediate threats to legacy approaches and inspire strategies for brands, marketers, and advertisers to reclaim visibility and influence.

events.title: Marketing Without a Map: Building in the Age of Chaos
events.description: Marketing playbooks are dead. In this hands-on session, Erik Huberman—founder of Hawke Media—dives into what actually drives brand growth when algorithms shift daily, consumer trust is eroding, and AI-generated content floods the feed. You’ll learn how to test faster, adapt smarter, and build a resilient marketing engine in an era of uncertainty. No fluff. Just a strategy that works when nothing else makes sense.

events.title: Mexico Amplified: How Música Mexicana is Reshaping Global Music
events.description: Over the past few years, the Mexican music scene has undergone a powerful transformation—from a local ecosystem to a global force. This conversation explores how genres are crossing borders, why Spanish and Regional Mexicano have gained global prominence, and how Mexican festivals are attracting international artists and audiences. It will also examine the rise of music-driven tourism and Mexico’s growing influence as a global reference point for music, culture, and live entertainment.

events.title: Missionary Misfits: Why Not Belonging Makes You Build Better
events.description: The best companies come from founders who don't quite fit in. Steve Vassallo (Foundation Capital, former IDEO designer) calls them "missionary misfits,” founders who weave different disciplines together instead of mining one vertical. He believes these cross-domain builders create the most transformative companies. Steve will sit down with Framer co-founder, Jorn van Dijk, whose misfit position helped him and his co-founder spot the dysfunction between design and development, and create a company now worth $2B. Learn why being an outsider might be the ultimate competitive advantage.

events.title: Music Nostalgia: The Secret Weapon in Modern Advertising
events.description: Brands are increasingly turning to beloved songs and artists from the past to craft compelling narratives that resonate across generations. We’ll examine the symbiotic relationship between marketers, musicians, and music companies, showcasing how this approach revitalizes classic tracks while providing new revenue streams and exposure for artists and alternately, how advertisers creatively leverage nostalgia to boost sales and reinforce brand identity and cultural relevance. We'll discuss past campaigns and illuminate why this remains such an effective and enduring storytelling strategy.

events.title: The New Lab Partner: AI and Future Scientific Discovery
events.description: AI is quickly becoming an active thinking partner, completely changing scientific discovery. That means, potentially faster cures, new drug uses, and insights to combat viruses. But it sparks key philosophical questions: Who owns AI-generated insight? How do we validate it? Are we more innovative or dependent? Join experts to explore AI's role in surfacing new questions, defining co-discovery, and navigating its risks/rewards for human health. A critical conversation on AI's radical impact on discovery.

speakers.name: Dona Sarkar
speakers.title: Chief Troublemaker - Copilot and AI Extensibility

events.title: Now is Japan's Time: Leading the Future with Deep Tech
events.description: Japan has a long history of developing fermentation technologies, which have served as the foundation for the growth of its biotechnology industry. Additionally, Japanese anime and games have garnered a large global fan base, generating excitement around new business opportunities utilizing these IPs. In this session, four speakers will share real-time insights from diverse perspectives on the forefront of Japan’s deep tech and IP businesses, as well as the emerging global ventures centered around them!

events.title: PanelPicker Evaluators Meet Up #1
events.description: OPEN TO SXSW PANELPICKER EVALUATORS ONLY! Come meet your fellow SXSW PanelPicker Evaluators! This is your opportunity to network and chat with other professionals in our SXSW community who shape our Conference each year.

events.title: Pride Preview '26: Marketers, LGBTQ+ & Where We Go From Here
events.description: GLAAD, Do The Werq, and PrideNOW (three of the most prominent LGBTQ+ names in marketing and media) present a Pride 2026 forecast for marketers, featuring GLAAD and Do the Werq's expansive new data. Presented by PrideNOW, this first-ever meeting comes in the wake of the most challenging year for LGBTQ+ marketing since the 1990s. Will brands be ready to come out of hiding and support this community again? Why should they? How has the cultural climate shifted? Armed with fresh numbers and new info about LGBTQ+ spending power (current: $4.7 trillion), these experts will break down how to proceed.

Explore creativity, innovation, and culture, shaping what’s next from the energy of now.

Please find more information here: https://saopaulohouse.com/

YOU ARE ALREADY LIVING IN THE SPACE AGE. And this SXSW, you can find out how. Space House is an immersive sanctuary dedicated to new and commercial space - where founders, astronauts, futurists and technologists explore topics spanning from how space is shaping our daily lives, to if the Moon is the “new Mars”. Expect bold ideas, curated experiences, conversations with visionary space leaders of today and the kind of collisions that spark what’s next.

www.thisisspacehouse.com

events.title: Spotify for Artists Masterclass
events.description: At Spotify, we’ve been developing tools to help artists and their teams build hype for new music and connect with new fans across the release cycle — from pre-release to release day and beyond — right on the platform where music is streamed. Join the Spotify music team to learn how to best leverage our products — like Countdown Pages, Clips, Music Videos, Marquee, Showcase, and more — across all phases of an artist’s journey.

events.title: Superhuman Suite at Antone’s: The Future Is All You
events.description:
Superhuman makes its SXSW debut with a three-day takeover of Antone’s. Check out the immersive Epochs of Communication, along with panels, keynotes, comedy, and live music!

11:15am - 12:00pm: Show Up as You: Authentic Expression in the AI Era

2:15pm - 3:15pm: From Cave Paintings to Code: How Tools Have Shaped Human Expression
4:00pm - 5:00pm: The Writers Room LIVE
8:30pm - 9:45pm: Quinn XCII

events.title: SXSW Bookstore
events.description: Check out the SXSW Bookstore to browse the latest work authored by this year’s conference participants. Support your favorite speakers and find something you connect with to take back home. Open daily on the 6th floor of the Hilton Austin Downtown.

events.title: SXSW Pitch-Intelligent Systems, Robotics, & Multisensory Technology
events.description:
The SXSW Pitch provides a platform for early-stage technology startups to present their groundbreaking products and services to a panel of distinguished industry experts, influential media professionals, and leading venture capitalists and angel investors. 

On Saturday, March 14, five innovative companies will take the stage in Salon FGH at the JW Marriott, showcasing their ideas, innovations, and entrepreneurial vision before a live audience and judging panel. Come be inspired by the next generation of tech innovators shaping the future.

Intelligent Systems, Robotics, & Multisensory Technology isTechnologies that enhance the way people connect, communicate, and share unique life experiences with those around them in a digital ecosystem. These technologies may be related to machine-simulated intelligence, consciousness, ease, speech, the Internet of Things and smart devices, or a machine's ability to perform, anticipate, and streamline tasks without human assistance. These startups seek to address a wide variety of issues and may include Web5 and decentralized applications, wearables, blockchain technology, multi-sensory incorporation, augmented reality (AR), virtual reality (VR), Super Apps, generative AI, AI chips, autonomous systems, human-robot interaction, Robotic Process Automation, Natural Language Processing, and more.

Winner of the Intelligent Systems, Robotics & MultisensoryTechnologies will be announced at the Award Ceremony, Saturday, March 14th at 6:30pm.

events.title: Tackling the “snakes” undermining digital rights
events.description:
In the US and globally, civil society is facing existential challenges due to significant funding shortfalls resulting from cuts by the US and other traditional donors. For many nonprofits, this has meant imposing program cuts and layoffs, jeopardizing their ability to deliver on their missions sustainably.
We plan to discuss the following challenges (or “snakes” according to Indigenous prophecy) undermining digital rights and how to overcome them: the shrinking of resources, the increasing power of Big Tech, data colonialism, the rise of war crimes, and energy-demanding technologies.

events.title: Tennessee House - Chattanooga in the Daytime
events.description:
The Tennessee House showcases what's happening in tech, innovation, and culture across the Volunteer State. Be there for 3 days of bold thinking, eye-opening connections, and unforgettable fun.

We're spotlighting Chattanooga from 10am to 3pm. CHATT & chill with game-changing startups in quantum computing and sustainable mobility, and discover why the Scenic City is such an impactful place to build and grow a company.

Doors open at 10am ** Limited-edition swag, bites, and drinks all day **

events.title: Valeo Tech Drive-in
events.description:
The car is no longer just a vehicle, it's where the future of tech starts.

At the Valeo Tech Drive-In, we’re transforming the journey into a high-stakes arena. Experience the machine-learning-powered Valeo Racer, gaze-tracking Panovision head up display, and e-Chromic lenses that sync to the road’s pulse. We’re even exporting automotive thermal DNA to cool the AI revolution in global data centers. From hyper-personalized lighting to the cloud edge,, witness the vehicle become the world’s most immersive, high-performance tech frontier.

events.title: Vibe Coding: From Idea to MVP at Warp Speed
events.description: Forget decks and buzzwords—this is a build-first session. In this interactive workshop, founders will use Vibe Coding, a fast, intuition-driven method for turning ideas into real products. Using LEGO® to spark rapid collaboration and system-level thinking, participants will physically map app components before we Vibe Code them into working software. Along the way, we’ll explore what it actually takes to build an enterprise-ready app—covering usability, security, reliability, and scalability—so speed doesn’t come at the expense of quality. Expect hands-on collaboration, high energy, and an open-source prototype you can keep building after SXSW. No coding expertise required—just ideas, creativity, and collaboration.

events.title: Visual Storytelling from Film Sets to Social Feeds
events.description: Today’s creators aren’t choosing between “the big screen” and “the second screen” - they’re working across both. This panel explores how visual storytelling shifts across platforms and formats, and how three very different filmmakers pursue the same goal: crafting compelling images for a media landscape that’s rapidly reshaping traditional production, distribution, and viewing habits. From a 30-second vertical reel to a full cinematic sequence, we’ll examine what changes, what stays the same, what creators can borrow from each space, and what it all signals about the future of filmmaking.

events.title: Water is the New Sports Arena: The Future of Stadium Racing
events.description: SailGP is transforming water into the world’s most thrilling sports arena. Founded by Larry Ellison and Sir Russell Coutts, this high-speed, data-driven, climate-positive sailing league is built for the digital age. With 60mph races in iconic cities, real-time data, and immersive broadcasting, SailGP delivers scroll-stopping content for Gen Z. It’s not just a sport—it’s a purpose-driven movement redefining how fans experience live competition and putting them at the heart of the action.

events.title: YAMAHA CREATOR PASS STUDIO
events.description: A new creative experience is making its SXSW debut. Hands-on music and audio tools. Real-time creation. Designed for creators of all levels. No watching from the sidelines — just jump in and make something.

events.title: Your Data Isn't Ready - Your Business Can Be with Agentic AI
events.description:
Featuring: Jimmy Priestas, CMT AI and Data Lead, Americas, Accenture

AI moved past the novelty phase. The leaders winning now are wiring it into how work gets done—end‑to‑end—with humans in the lead and AI agents executing and orchestrating. Join us at SXSW for an inside‑out look at how to move from pilots to enterprise‑scale outcomes: faster time‑to‑insight across decisions, redesigned workflows that release 20–40% capacity, and a data foundation that powers secure, cross‑functional impact. We’ll unpack what actually scales—operating models, skills, and governance—not just tools. You’ll see a live multi‑agent demo tackling a real business process, hear client‑tested patterns to modernize data without rip‑and‑replace, and learn how to balance digital sovereignty with global innovation. Walk away with a practical roadmap you can apply Monday morning: the 90‑day moves, the 12‑month reinvention arcs, and the metrics that belong on your P&L—so AI funds growth instead of just cutting cost.

events.title: Black Zombie
events.description: From the flickering screens of Hollywood horror, to the haunted cane fields of colonial Haiti, "Black Zombie" unearths the buried origins of the zombie, reclaiming it as a symbol of survival and spiritual resistance.

events.title: Congress Avenue Block Party
events.description: The Congress Avenue Block Party (formerly known as the Registrant Lounge) is the go-to space for all SXSW attendees to maximize their SX experience, offering daily complimentary drinks, food, and sponsor swag. Open throughout the conferences & festivals, this convenient and relaxing meeting point near the hub of SXSW action is an ideal spot to unwind and connect with other attendees. New for 2026, the Block Party is free and open to the public!

events.title: Documentary Short Program 1
events.description: Authentic storytelling that captivates, surprises, and excites!
events.venue: Rollins Theatre at the Long Center

events.title: Einstein Energy Super Snack Bars - Think You're A Snack Genius?
events.description: Think You’re a Snack Genius?Einstein Energy Super Smart Snack Bars bring brainpower to SXSW with The Einstein Game Show—fast, buzzer-style trivia hosted by an Albert Einstein look-alike. Win exclusive merch and bars, snap iconic photos, and fuel up with smarter snack breaks guided by brand ambassadors. Live screens, social moments, and QR-powered rewards keep the energy high—plus a special birthday celebration for Albert on March 14.

events.title: Family Movie
events.description:
The Smiths have gathered once again on their quaint family farm to make the latest in a string of low-budget horror movies. No, the movies aren't particularly "successful." Some might even call them "bad." But at least the family is together, and that's what matters to Jack and Ellen. Their adult children, on the other hand - Trent and Ula - are working up the courage to leave this particular family tradition behind. 
Simmering family dysfunction turns to pure chaos when a real dead body shows up on set. Can they come together to keep the movie on track, or will this be the Smith family's final act?

events.title: A Flavor-Filled Experience
events.description: You’re invited to a flavor-filled experience, where nature meets delicious. Come sip, sample, and explore everything from bold flavor innovations to functional hydration and premium teas. No artificial stuff. Just pure, crafted taste, and a few fun freebies you don't want to miss!

events.title: Keystone House
events.description: In the spirit of SXSW 2026's theme All Together Now, the Keystone House will showcase the best of Pennsylvania—where innovation, business, and creativity converge. We are excited to present a line up of afternoon sessions, Philly cheesesteaks, a PA Alumni Happy Hour and a Closing House Party featuring talent from across Pennsylvania.

events.title: La French Touch Rendez-Vous
events.description:
“La French Touch Rendez-vous”, the must-attend event to discover French innovation and creativity returns at SXSW. La French Touch is pleased to present :

- Hear from high-profile guests discussing cutting-edge themes - AI, creator economy, fashion, and artistic start-ups demos - By night : networking event and live concerts

Drinks and snacks served all day long!

For more information please visit: https://evenements.bpifrance.fr/e/french-touch-rendez-vous-2026

events.title: The Last Critic
events.description: Sixty years & a million records ago, Robert Christgau invented Rock music criticism. Anyone who has ever read or written a Pop music review has been influenced by Christgau, who canonized legends from The Ramones to Public Enemy & infuriated icons from Lou Reed to Billy Joel. Now in his eighties, Bob is still at it—amazingly with the same vigor, wit, concision and craft that has defined his expansive career. But in a world where albums are irrelevant, where print is dead & where algorithms have eclipsed critics we are forced to ask: What happens next—for Bob, but also for all music criticism? Is this the end of something? Is Robert Christgau the last critic?

events.title: My/Mochi Joyfully Chill Ice Cream Shoppe
events.description: My/Mochi, the original and world's largest mochi ice cream brand, is inviting SXSW-goers to Taste the Joy! Our delightfully delicious ice cream wrapped in pillowy sweet rice dough comes in more than 20 flavors like Cookie Dough, Strawberry and Mango. So stop by our Joyfully Chill Ice Cream Shoppe at the Congress Ave Block Party Mar 12-18 to experience the joy for yourself!

events.title: Ready or Not 2: Here I Come
events.description: Moments after surviving an all-out attack from the Le Domas family, Grace discovers she’s reached the next level of the nightmarish game — and this time with her estranged sister Faith at her side. Grace has one chance to survive, keep her sister alive, and claim the High Seat of the Council that controls the world. Four rival families are hunting her for the throne, and whoever wins rules it all.

events.title: Reinventing Customer Experience for What's Next
events.description:
Featuring: Ami Palan, Americas Lead, Accenture Song

Customer expectations are evolving faster than ever, demanding new ways of thinking about experience, growth, and connection. In this session, we’ll explore how technology, data, and creativity are coming together to help organizations reimagine the customer experience and unlock meaningful, measurable impact.

events.title: Time and Water
events.description: Renowned Icelandic poet and author Andri Snær Magnason is chasing something elusive. As the glacial ice of his homeland melts, he constructs a cinematic time capsule to hold onto this moment and send it to the future, before everything he loves slips away. Using his own collected archives, his grandparents’ photographs, and films, as well as traditional songs and folktales, Andri interlaces his family’s story with that of the land around him. From Academy Award®-nominated director Sara Dosa, "Time and Water" is a universal reflection on the power of home and what it means to be alive amid profound epochal change.

events.title: Amy Webb Book Signing
events.description: Amy Webb will be signing copies of  “The Big Nine, Signals Are Talking and Genesis Machine” at the SXSW Bookstore.

events.title: The Dads
events.description: Inspired by the Emmy-Award winning short documentary of the same name (Netflix, 2023), "The Dads" chronicles fathers of trans and nonbinary children as they are forced to choose between country and family when a new right-wing administration and conservative Supreme Court take hold in the United States. Filmed over the course of a year spanning retreats in rural Maine and Minnesota, protests, family milestones, a pivotal U.S. Supreme Court decision, and the collapse of gender-affirming care for youth, "The Dads" captures this national reckoning with remarkable intimacy through verite footage and interviews with the film’s main protagonists. This is fatherhood as an act of radical resistance.

events.title: The Agency Owners Meet Up
events.description: The Agency Owners Meet Up is a place for founders, owners, managers, and directors of creative and digital agencies to come together in the midst of the whirlwind that is SXSW. You are not alone, whether you are one person in a home office or a team of hundreds, we all share similar challenges in the daily struggles of running a successful agency. When agencies talk with each other and collaborate, it benefits everyone! Join your speakers and agency professionals from around the world as we take a moment to network, connect, share, collaborate, and spark ideas.

events.title: Ambitious Things: How Big Ideas Become Real
events.description: Everyone has that one idea. The big, unruly, “what if?” thing. The idea that feels exciting... and terrifying. Ambitious Things is a creative-philosophical talk about how to turn ambitious ideas into ambitious realities. Drawing on decades of experience leaping into the unknown, writer, director, and Studio Farland founder Hal Kirkland shares the small steps that help us start, keep going, and stay inspired enough to finish, without waiting for permission, certainty, or perfect conditions. A talk for anyone cradling the weight of a wild idea and who need a boost to finally make it real.

events.title: Berlin House: Party, Pitches & Perspectives - Day 3 at German Haus
events.description:
BERLIN HOUSE brings the energy of Berlin to Austin for a full day of bold ideas, creative tech and global connections. Join inspiring conversations, discover standout startup pitches, and experience how Berlin’s innovators shape the future. Meet creators, founders and partners from across the world - then close out the night with an authentic Berlin rave featuring Anja Schneider, JOPLYN, Martin Eyerer and more.

https://why.berlin/event/south-by-southwest-sxsw-2026/

events.title: Beyond Trends: Building Influence on AI-Saturated Algorithms
events.description: It’s estimated that 90% of content will be AI generated by 2026. But what does that actually mean for creators? The impending boom of AI generated content will create an algorithm shift. In a world where AI tools can create content that can instantly copy any aesthetic, sound, or format, trends will no longer be the path to relevance, but a path to fatigue. This presentation shares actionable insights to embrace radical individuality and make sure that content creators of today are not the ones that get left behind tomorrow.

speakers.name: Fana Yohannes
speakers.title: Algorithm & trends expert, Creator advisor, ex-, ex-Instagram

events.title: Build the Future: Entrepreneurship Within Reach
events.description: Entrepreneurship is one of the last viable paths to economic mobility in America—offering ownership, stability, and long-term wealth. But that path is narrowing fast. Early-stage funding to women and underrepresented founders has dropped nearly 50% since 2020 (Crunchbase, 2023), while systems like childcare, capital access, and mentorship remain fragile. This session brings together cross-sector leaders to ask: What must we build now to keep entrepreneurship within reach for the next generation?

speakers.name: Jailan Griffiths
speakers.title: Vice President, Global Head of Purpose

events.title: Building Brands That Back Creators
events.description: As creators become the cultural vanguard, brand marketing must evolve. Author of the ICYMI newsletter Lia Haberman joins Mike McGarry, SVP of Marketing at Patreon, in a conversation on how to build campaigns that don’t just feature creators — they center them. Learn actionable insights from Patreon's marketing strategy which amplifies authenticity, drives relevance, and builds loyalty across both creator and fan communities. Through viral case studies and creator-led activations, this session will arm marketers, CMOs, and creatives with the tools to thrive in a world where creators are the brand.

speakers.name: Lia Haberman
speakers.title: Creator Economy And Influencer Marketing Expert And Author Of The Icymi Newsletter

events.title: Capturing Chaos: A Q&A with the DP & CLT of The Pitt
events.description: For this panel our moderator will chat with the Cinematographer and CLT of hit HBO Series, The Pitt. Our conversation will focus on lighting the ER of The Pitt and capturing the chaos of such a high stress environment of Season 1 & 2. We will dive into camera and lighting workflows, unique challenges of the shoot, and fun never-before-heard stories from life on set of The Pitt.

events.title: Creating Real Pathways for Emerging Music Artists
events.description: Building a music career today requires mentorship, community, and access. This panel brings together artists and brand leaders for an honest conversation about how brands can create platforms that nurture emerging talent and shape the next wave of music culture. Drawing from real experiences and programs like JBL’s Music Academy, panelists will talk about the tools and resources that help artists find their footing early on. The discussion will also explore how brands can show up in ways that feel genuinely helpful and rooted in creative growth.

speakers.name: Chris Epple
speakers.title: Vice President, Marketing, Americas at JBL

events.title: Ethical & Unethical AI in Music
events.description: Join Virginie Berger (Forbes) as she moderates a hard-hitting session with Kato On The Track, Michael MJ Jacob (CTO of BeatStars), and a leading industry voice to separate hype from harm. We’ll unpack real cases training data, rights and licensing and give creators the practical rules and tools they need to protect their work and profit from AI, not be erased by it.

speakers.name: KXVI
speakers.title: GRAMMY-nominated producer, Entrepreneur, and Content Creator

events.title: Featured Session: 10 Breakthrough Technologies of 2026
events.description: Each year, MIT Technology Review reporters and editors assemble a list of the top breakthrough technologies that will change the world. We ask ourselves: What will really matter in the long run? And while we can’t see the future, we expect these technologies to affect our world in a big way, for decades to come. Niall Firth will share the publication’s list of ten breakthrough technologies with the SXSW audience, explaining each one and how it will impact the way we live and work.

events.title: Featured Session: Albuquerque Aftermath: From Breaking Bad to Pluribus with Rhea Seehorn, Vince Gilligan, and Key Creatives
events.description: Welcome to Albuquerque, home of Breaking Bad, Better Call Saul, and now Pluribus!  Creator Vince Gilligan will be joined by Rhea Seehorn (Pluribus' Carol and Better Call Saul's Kim) as well as composer Dave Porter, costume designer Jennifer Bryan, and producer Trina Siopy. The conversation will explore the collaborative process behind some of television's most acclaimed series, Albuquerque’s role as a creative anchor, and the close partnerships that have been cultivated over more than a decade working together. The group will also reflect on the longevity of a franchise that remains a juggernaut in the cultural zeitgeist, as well as the challenges of inventing a new universe in a familiar city.

events.title: Featured Session: The Internet After Search
events.description:
The economic model that has funded the Internet for three decades is breaking. AI systems now provide answers directly instead of sending users to websites, and AI agents are beginning to handle transactions without people ever visiting a site. Content creators are losing traffic and revenue, and nobody has figured out what replaces it.

As CEO and co-founder of Cloudflare, Matthew Prince has a unique view of how the web is changing and what comes next, handling 20% of all Internet traffic. This session will examine the post-search Internet and the profound shift in power. We’ll dive into how AI agents are changing commerce, who truly controls information access, and the looming question of who gets paid for content. The choices we make now regarding compensation, ownership, and digital access will determine the web's future trajectory.

events.title: How B2B Creators Are Driving the Next $100M Wave
events.description: While everyone is focused on channels like TikTok and Instagram, B2B creators are quietly building the next $100M wave in the creator economy. These "professional creators" aren’t chasing trends, they’re trusted experts turning LinkedIn, newsletters, and podcasts into engines for influence and revenue. This panel brings together leading voices from both sides of the ecosystem (Brand and Creator) to explore how creators are transforming B2B go-to-market strategies, reshaping brand trust, and unlocking new ways to drive growth in high-consideration industries.

events.title: How to Make a Mindf*ck with James Ward Byrkit (Coherence) & Kate Andrews (It's What's Inside)
events.description: This candid conversation goes behind the scenes of two original, one-location genre films that did the impossible. COHERENCE began as a micro-budget, largely improvised experiment made with a group of friends in a single house, and went on to build a global cult following that’s still growing more than a decade later. IT’S WHAT’S INSIDE, an underdog midnight selection from first-time filmmakers, premiered at Sundance and shocked the industry with a $17M sale. Together James and Kate will unpack how these mind-bending films were made outside the traditional system, how creative constraint becomes the engine instead of the obstacle, and why trusting audiences to lean into complexity might be the smartest move a filmmaker can make right now.

events.title: How to Raise $$$ From Angel Groups: What We Really Look For
events.description: The objective of this session is to get more Early-Stage companies to apply for funding through the 200+ Angel Groups and Funds across the US. The strategy is to explain how the "Industry" actually works, from the perspective of people on the inside of one of the most active Angel groups in the US (Central Texas Angels) and a highly experienced Angel investor (investments in 110 companies through Angel Groups). This is a chance to demystify a process which a lot of entrepreneurs see as too difficult to be worth doing---and to help get the broad-based US innovation economy back in gear again.

events.title: Humanoid Robots Are Clocking In: Meet Who’s Putting Them To Work
events.description: You’ve seen the viral humanoid demos—now meet the people actually shipping them. From hospitals to warehouses, humanoid robots are already on shift. They ride elevators, open doors, and work alongside people in busy environments. But making that leap from prototype to real-world, reliable performance? It’s hard. This panel brings together renowned founders and researchers who’ve built and deployed some of the first real humanoids at scale. Join us for a behind-the-scenes conversation about what's working, what’s not, and what it really takes to get robots out of the lab and into the world.

events.title: Legal 101 for Startups & Creative Entrepreneurs
events.description: Starting a business is exciting, but skipping legal basics can lead to expensive mistakes. In this session, attorney and founder Morgan Ipanema breaks down the essential steps to legally protect and scale your business. From choosing the right structure to safeguarding your brand and client relationships, this session gives women-led startups, creatives, and freelancers the tools to grow confidently—without the legal overwhelm.

events.title: Lessons Learned: How We Made Our First Feature
events.description: So you've written or gotten your hands on a great screenplay...now what? Emily Robinson (UGLY CRY), Michael Lukk Litwak (MOLLI & MAX IN THE FUTURE), and Hannah Pearl Utt (BEFORE YOU KNOW IT, CORA BORA) are here to tell you how they did it. Making your first narrative feature is a daunting process. Come take a fascinating peak behind the lens to hear how these three extraordinary filmmakers did it. We'll look at how they collaborated with their producers and dozens of other craftspeople and artisans to create masterpieces with small budgets but great vision.

events.title: The New Arena: How Sports, Fans & Culture Are Evolving
events.description: Sports fandom is evolving from passive viewership to active, always-on participation. Fans, Athletes, and Creators are reshaping how culture is made, shared, and celebrated. This session explores how brands can authentically tap into the new dynamics of fandom, from game days to off-seasons. Learn how Athletes are the new storytellers, how fan communities are driving cultural moments, and how marketers can show up with relevance and purpose in this new era of sports and engagement.

events.title: Orchestrate or Obsolete: Leading the AI-Powered Near Future
events.description:
The problem isn’t AI — it’s our leadership model. We’re still leading like humans are the only ones in the room… as the room quietly fills with AI agents.

In the very near future, every decision will be co-authored by humans, AI agents, and live ecosystem signals — and the leaders who master this orchestration will rewrite how business works.

Near Futurist Neil Redding shows how leadership must evolve in the Agentic Era, from command and control to the orchestration of human–AI symbiosis. You’ll leave with a clear mental model for leading in systems where humans and AI participate together, plus daily leadership rituals for thriving as business capabilities evolve in real time.

events.title: Plantman & Blondie: A Dress Up Gang Film
events.description:
An offbeat comedy about friendship, purpose, and trying to grow something real in a city built to keep people apart.
Cory is a lonely, doomscrolling thirty-something whose most consistent relationship is with his Instagram algorithm. His apartment? An emotionally vacant, sterile, void. His fridge? Mostly Celsius. And his idea of connection is dodging calls from the one person who still tries: Fox, a soft-hearted, ex-con with terrible advice rooted in institutional paranoia and his love of films. 
Everything shifts when Cory has a run-in, literally, with Plantman, a rogue horticultural crusader armed with a mysterious dossier of negligent plant owners.

events.title: Project Swagger Live
events.description:
Robin Arzón is the Vice President of Fitness Programming and Head Instructor at Peloton, a 27x marathon and ultra-marathon runner, founder of the Swagger Society media company, two-time New York Times bestselling author, MasterClass Instructor, and proud Latina, mother, and wife.  

In this live episode of her new podcast with Vox Media, she'll be sharing the rituals, strategies, and routines that elevate her hustle.

events.title: Same Same But Different
events.description: When Rana’s visa application is denied, she faces the reality of returning home to Iran. That is, until Adam – her wealthy boss’s son and her summer fling – proposes a green card wedding. Wrestling with the implications of his offer, Rana enlists help from a questionable shaman, Adam’s pure-hearted mom, and most importantly her two Iranian best friends Nadia and Setareh, who arrive on Cape Cod for a wedding weekend full of opinions, chaos, and drama with their own American boyfriends. Just as total disaster approaches, the three women come together in a transformative moment of acceptance, growth, and coming of age – evolving this weekend into one that will change them all forever.

events.title: South Asian Meet Up
events.description: A vibrant meetup for South Asians across entertainment, media, startups, and beyond. Whether you're an artist, creative, filmmaker, standup comedian, or a founder, join this space to build meaningful connections, share ideas, and find your crew. From diaspora storytelling to cross-industry collabs, this session is where South Asian excellence meets SXSW energy. Open to all who want to grow community and amplify our voice.

events.title: The Storytelling Paradox: Reflect, Refract, or Revolutionize
events.description: Storytellers reveal truths that connect us—uncovering hidden patterns, holding up mirrors to society, exploring our shared humanity, and amplifying voices at the margins. Individual stories gain power when they accumulate, from the #MeToo movement to documentaries that change how we see the world. But decades of human choices—about technology, distribution, and who profits -—have left storytellers without basic infrastructure to tell stories that matter. How do storytellers preserve their power to reveal, connect, and transform?

events.title: Summer 2000: The X-Cetra Story
events.description: In the summer of 2000, four pre-teen friends formed a band called X-Cetra and burned a homemade album onto a few CD-Rs. The following year, consumed by adolescent concerns of boys and drug store shoplifting, their labor of love was quickly forgotten.... Until 20 years later, when someone uploaded it online. At first, it garnered a small base of outsider-art fans, but soon it was discovered by record labels, sampled by mainstream artists, and eventually the subject of a Rolling Stone article. With their teen dreams of pop stardom coming true decades later, X-Cetra reunites to see if they can rekindle the unselfconscious girlhood they’d captured in the album those many years ago.

events.title: SXSW Pitch-Entertainment, Media, Sports & Creator Content
events.description:
The SXSW Pitch provides a platform for early-stage technology startups to present their groundbreaking products and services to a panel of distinguished industry experts, influential media professionals, and leading venture capitalists and angel investors.

On Saturday, March 14, five innovative companies will take the stage in Salon FGH at the JW Marriott, showcasing their ideas, innovations, and entrepreneurial vision before a live audience and judging panel. Come be inspired by the next generation of tech innovators shaping the future.

Entertainment, Media, Sports & Creator ContentTechnologies and applications that are re-inventing the experience of leisure, information, sports, and entertainment. Industries these technologies address may include gaming, music, film, television, video, arts, mixed-reality events, news and publishing, e-sports, sports analytics, streaming, computer-directed reporting, podcasting and audio content, social media, virtual production, user-generated content platforms, digital fashion and avatars, children’s technology, digital storytelling, and more.

Winner of the Entertainment, Media, Sports & Creator Content Technologies will be announced at the Award Ceremony, Saturday, March 14th at 6:30pm.

events.title: Time Travel & Archives: Reclaiming Memory Through XR
events.description: The panel brings together artists using immersive tools — from AR and AI to dance and gaming — to explore how we can reimagine archives, reclaim erased histories, and create portals into the past and future. Each of us approaches this through different mediums, but with a shared urgency around memory, embodiment, and speculative technology. The idea is to explore how immersive practices can act as a kind of time travel: allowing us to move through historical absence and presence, remix narratives, and build alternate realities where marginalized voices take center stage.

events.title: Unscripted Gold: Turning Real Life into Global Hits
events.description:
What does it take to turn raw, real-life moments into a binge-worthy, culture-shifting unscripted hit? From the rise of reality competition shows to docuseries that dominate streaming charts, the unscripted genre is having a serious moment. But while the content may be “real,” the strategy behind it is anything but improvised.
 
Join Ryan O’Dowd, President of Unscripted at BBC Studios, Sharon Vuong, EVP of Unscripted Programming at NBC, Jilly Pearce, SVP of Unscripted for ABC & Hulu and Emily Longeretta, Sr. TV Features Editor at Variety,  as they dive into the magic of making unscripted content that travels globally. We’ll explore how formats are born, why authenticity matters more than ever, and how producers are adapting to shorter attention spans, TikTok culture, and the binge-all-in-one-weekend model.
 
Whether it’s turning everyday people into breakout stars or local stories into international sensations, this panel pulls back the curtain on what works, what flops, and what’s next in unscripted.

events.title: Weird FTW: What Happens When Brands Zig While Others Zag
events.description: Big brands have big budgets, but scrappy brands win by embracing "weird"—something their larger counterparts can’t replicate. This session unites "CPG Avengers": founders, creative leaders, and brand stewards who've built fanatic communities from scratch. They're forging businesses with great scale and impact in record time. Hear how they're redefining the GTM playbook by inventing their own. We'll cover everything from cults to clubhouses to coffins. These experts shaped modern brand-building and will reveal unconventional strategies that continue to outmaneuver giants.

events.title: Where Climate Science Meets Industry Innovation
events.description: Can industry partnerships lead to scientific breakthroughs? Can climate science support business interests? Partnerships lead to win-win outcomes: business needs sparking scientific “Eureka!” moments and science innovation supporting business decisions. Join the non-profit University Corporation for Atmospheric Research for a talk at the nexus of science and industry: a research institution connecting climate science to real-world users, a startup using quantum sensors to detect oil and gas leaks, and an exploration company realizing efficiencies and reducing emissions with new technologies.

speakers.title: Professor and Director of the Nelson Enterprise

speakers.title: CTO & Co-Founder; Professor

events.title: WILD COURAGE: Go After What You Want & Get It
events.description:
What if the traits you need to succeed are the exact opposite of what you’ve been told? 

To get ahead, you need to be Weird, Selfish, Shameless, Obsessed, Nosy, Manipulative, Brutal, Reckless, and Bossy. And that takes courage. 

NYT bestselling author and former Google exec Jenny Wood offers a bold, tactical playbook to ditch fear—of failure, uncertainty, and judgment by others—and apply these nine eyebrow-raising traits in a sane and savvy way to go after what you want and get it, whether you’re trying to snag a stretch promotion, impress your new boss, or land a life-changing deal.

speakers.name: Jenny Wood
speakers.title: Keynote Speaker, NYT Bestselling Author, Former Google Executive

events.title: Winning at Work: Why it Pays to be a Status Seeker
events.description: Status - one of the biggest determinants of our quality of life and career success - is poorly understood and rarely discussed. Professor Alison Fragale, organizational psychologist and bestselling author of Likeable Badass: How Women Get the Success They Deserve, sheds light on the science of status and its relationship to power in the workplace: what it is, why it matters, and how we leverage it for individual and collective success.

speakers.name: Alison Fragale
speakers.title: Professor, Organizational Psychologist, And Author Of Likeable Badass: How Women Get The Success They Deserve

events.title: Amazing Live Sea Monkeys
events.description: From her crumbling estate on the Potomac, Yolanda Signorelli von Braunhut is engaged in a David-and-Goliath battle to wrest control of her late husband Harold’s iconic toy Amazing Live Sea Monkeys! back from the corporate men who she insists stole them from her. Harold von Braunhut and Yolanda Signorelli worked together for forty years before Harold - a genius magician, scientist and inventor – passed away and left his iconic novelty toy in Yolanda’s care. Yolanda alone possesses the true Sea-Monkeys secret formula and she alone must free them, not only from their captors, but also from the stain of her husband’s dark legacy.

events.title: The Audacity
events.description: Set inside the bubble of Silicon Valley, The Audacity takes on the warped dreams, outsized egos, and ethical lapses of the self-styled inventors of the future. In a world of jaded billionaires, psychiatrist-gurus, bio-hacked tech bros, AI labs and disillusioned teens being optimized in elite private schools, an audacious data-mining CEO (Billy Magnussen) strives to turn insight and influence into profit and power. The darkly comedic drama confronts reality, privacy, and the delusions fueling our ever-changing world.

events.title: Burger Mart From Invincible, Brought to You by Brisk
events.description: Step into your own episode of Invincible at the show’s iconic Burger Mart, built from the ground up in collaboration with Brisk. Order a hot BM and fries, get your photo taken at the scenic center booth, score a free custom Brisk can, and walk away with a full swag bag of exclusive merch.

events.title: The F-Stop
events.description: The F-Stop is bringing Focus Features films Obsession and The AI Doc: Or How I Became an Apocaloptimist to life through an immersive traveling Airstream experience. Step inside for immersive visuals, exclusive merch, and a creative breather between screenings, all inspired by bold, auteur‑driven storytelling.

events.title: Girl Tones
events.description:
Girl Tones, of planet Earth, are a high-energy rock duo brought to life by two sisters named Kenzie and Laila. Both classically trained musicians, Kenzie transitioned from cello to guitar and Laila from piano to drums in an effort to electrify sentient beings from this galaxy to the next. Their debut releases were produced by Brad Shultz of Cage The Elephant and released via his label Parallel Vision in partnership with Big Loud Rock.
Their first offerings have earned the praise of Rolling Stone, VICE, Consequence, PAPER, NME, DORK and many others with Flaunt saying, “Their sound is fluid, and yet with each release, they evolve as a harmonious group, developing their unique sound as one.”
Girl Tones has toured with Cage The Elephant across the globe, as well as The Velveteers, hey, nothing. and Silversun Pickups in North America. Making their unignorable festival debut at Lollapalooza, Shaky Knees, Austin City Limits and more, Rolling Stone said, “While the White Stripes — their most obvious comparison — were about controlled energy, Girl Tones are proudly imperfect.”
As the band jumps into 2026, they have no shortage of new music and new tour dates up their sleeves.
events.venue: Radio Day Stage @ Downright Austin Backyard

events.title: GRAMMY U Meet Up
events.description:
Are you an aspiring music industry professional or emerging artist? Come learn more about GRAMMY U, the Recording Academy's membership program for full-time college students, or those aged 18-29, pursuing a music career.
GRAMMY U Representatives Ily Aguilar (National Projects Rep) and Mykel Merritt (Texas Chapter Rep) will kick things off by discussing the member benefits that come with GRAMMY U, which is celebrating its 20th Anniversary this year. Afterward, network with Recording Academy staff, Texas Chapter Board members, and fellow industry peers who are excited to take the next step in their music careers.

events.title: High Score Game Arcade presents the Worldwide Tic-Tac-Toe Championship
events.description:
The Worldwide Tic Tac Toe Championship comes to its final, high-stakes moment at SXSW. After months of play across cities and communities around the world, this activation marks the culmination of a global tournament—bringing finalists, fans, and curious passersby together for live competition, spectacle, and celebration. Simple rules, universal appeal, and unexpected intensity converge in one last showdown where strategy, speed, and bragging rights are decided in real time.

More information here: highscoregamearcade.com

events.title: Invincible VS Arcade Pop Up
events.description: Invincible VS, a new 3x3 tag fighter launching on April 30, 2026, is appearing at SXSW with an exclusive arcade pop up featuring a roster of 10 playable characters including a new unannounced fan favorite fighter. Free swag and giveaways will be available for all who come to play the most epic and bloody fight in the universe, with a special gift for fans who pre-order the game onsite or show proof of preorder.

events.title: Paramount+ The Lodge
events.description: The Paramount+ Lodge returns with the ultimate fan experience, offering an unforgettable and immersive journey that lets guests engage with hit content, iconic franchises and live championship sports. Back for its fourth consecutive year, the Lodge takes over Clive Bar on Austin’s Rainey Street, transporting fans and new audiences into the worlds of their favorite series and sports on Paramount+.

events.title: Peaky Blinders: The Immortal Man - The Garrison
events.description: The Garrison at SXSW is an immersive experience that transports guests into the world of Netflix's film Peaky Blinders: The Immortal Man. Rich in period detail, the space channels the grit and glamour of the Shelby legacy through a custom bar, beer taps, whiskey-forward cocktails, and vintage seating. Included are hidden “easter eggs”, allowing fans to step inside the story, stay a while, and leave with a Peaky-inspired tattoo or trim as a lasting memory.

events.title: Sinner Supper Club
events.description:
Nora is late. Alice unceremoniously brought her partner, whose name no one can remember. Jayae doesn't want to be around "these" people...but came anyway? And Genevieve, the host, has put an unhealthy amount of pressure on this eviction funeral (kinda cringe, right?) to solve all of their problems. 

As they barrel through the evening, this disintegrating friend group, delirious from the heat and lack of food, desperately throws Hail Marys, caution to the wind, and lamb against the wall, trying to harness some semblance of what they used to have.

...and then their dead friend shows up.

It’s also the perfect spot to access most of our music venues by foot or a quick rideshare. Each day the Music Clubhouse will host meetups and networking events as well as activations.

events.title: Vibrating Music Hammocks
events.description:
The Music Hammock transforms its fabric into a speaker, resonating your body with the frequencies of the music so you feel as if you’re lying inside a sound system. In our fast-paced society, we often disconnect from our bodies. This installation offers a full-body listening experience, shifting your attention from mental chatter into physical awareness. Experience sound not only through your ears, but through your entire body.

events.title: Daughters of the Forest
events.description:
"Daughters of the Forest" is a story of entanglements: between humans and mushrooms; the visible and the invisible; generational knowledge and modern science. This sci-fi documentary invites us to reconsider the experiences of both human and non-human inhabitants of our world.

We follow Lis and Juli, two young scientists from indigenous communities that have long lived in symbiosis with the many mushrooms in their regions. The world they know is changing, and their pursuits are threatened by deforestation, lack of opportunity, and loss. Still, they share how mushrooms show us different possibilities of coexistence, helping them overcome obstacles to reshape their lives and futures.

events.title: Famous Friend
events.description:
Famous Friend is the sun-bleached, indie surf solo project of ASCAP award-winning artist and producer Zachariah Carlson. Born out of the fame-soaked dreamscape of West Los Angeles, Famous Friend began as an alter-ego, a playful mirror of the city’s obsession with image. His music blends washed-out indie surf guitars with sparkling dream pop production and post-punk drums, balancing joy and heartbreak in equal measure.

The result is nostalgic and cinematic: beach day euphoria melts into late night reflections about relationships past and present. Songs like “Tanlines” and “Nora” have earned millions of streams and support from KCRW tastemakers and helped secure him a spot as a recent member of the prestigious Taco Bell Feed the Beat class of 2025. Amidst all the noise, Famous Friend continues to turn California melancholy into shimmering, golden-hour anthems for dreamers and outsiders.

P.S. The multi-instrumentalist is also a frequent writer, producer, collaborator with some of Los Angeles’s premiere indie and alternative acts like Winnetka Bowling League, Casket Cassette, and Floats as well as composer for shows like the Emmy-Nominated “Alexa & Katie.”
events.venue: Radio Day Stage @ Downright Austin Backyard

events.title: Keynote: TOM SACHS: SHOW THE WORK, TELL THE STORY
events.description: Internationally acclaimed artist Tom Sachs transforms everyday materials into visionary works and inimitable worlds. From his New York studio, Sachs leads his team in a multidisciplinary art practice across sculpture, painting, ceramics, industrial and graphic design, and movie making. His body of work notably includes his bricolage Space Program, NikeCraft, and the recently published Tom Sachs Guide (Phaidon). He has exhibited at institutions such as The Solomon R. Guggenheim Museum, New York, The Whitney Museum of American Art, New York, The Centre Georges Pompidou, Paris, and the Mori Art Museum, Tokyo. In this session, Sachs discusses the path from idea to execution to exhibition, shares the rituals and obsessions that perpetuate curiosity and creativity, and explains his latest and biggest conceptual work, I.S.R.U–and how you can be part of it.

events.description: Sips & Sounds festival wristband required for entry; RSVP to claim your spot. Get ready for unforgettable performances from Christina Aguilera, Calvin Harris, Foster The People, and more among the city’s iconic skyline, plus refreshing Coca-Cola beverages and a curated selection of local food and drink to enjoy all weekend long. events.title: Connecty Official SXSW Social: Ice Cream + Coffee + Community
events.description:
Join Connecty for an Official SXSW Ice Cream + Coffee Social featuring Amy’s Ice Cream at Cenote. We’re turning one of East Austin’s dreamiest coffee houses into a neighborhood SXSW oasis. Whether you want a frothy latte, cool sugar and cream from the legendary Amy's, or a quick break from the hustle, come recharge with us at the indoor + outdoor patio space.

Why Stop By:
- Ice Cream + Coffee, yes please: Enjoy complimentary Amy’s Ice Cream and craft coffee from Cenote (on us!). A full service bar is also available for purchase.
- The Tech: Get an exclusive first look at Connecty, the new app designed to simplify IRL gatherings for hyper local communities. From smart event suggestions to custom contact labeling for your communities, check out how how we’re making it easier to organize everything from casual hangouts to large events. (New tech; patent pending).
- The Connection: We are seeking Connecty "Founding Members" - folks who are already organizing group events and looking for the right organization tool to do it. Tell us your hosting pain points, feature requests, and meet the team building the solution.

Access & Entry:
- SXSW Badge Holders: Priority Access. Simply scan your badge at the door.
- Local Connectors (Non-Badge): We have a limited guest list reserved for community organizers, social chairs, and event hosts to come check out the app and chat about features wanted and the pain points of scheduling. (Subject to capacity).

Want a spot? Head to Instagram @connecty_official for instructions on how to RSVP.

https://www.getconnecty.com/sxsw

events.title: Fireside Chat with Matthew Prince
events.description: Rooftop. SXSW. Small room. Big conversation.Join Matthew Prince for a live moderated interview (journalist/moderator TBD) on how AI is changing the internet in real time — from human clicks to agent-to-agent traffic, and why Workers is becoming where these agents actually run. We’ll cover security, privacy, and policy, but keep it practical and conversational. Drinks and light bites on us.

events.title: Grace Sorensen
events.description: Grace Sorensen is one of the fastest independent-rising stars in the music scene. As a multi-hyphenate singer, songwriter, and dancer, she’s been dubbed "Austin's Wonderkid" and “Austin’s R&B Cool Girl” by the Austin Chronicle and KUTX. In her young career she has already been featured on Joe Budden’s “Sleeper Picks,” collaborated with BLK ODYSSY, been inducted to the Recording Academy's Class of 2025, played Austin City Limits Festival, SXSW Austin & London, and surpassed one million organic streams on her single "Digits.” She debuted her versatile album "BLUEPRINT" February 2025 and has exciting expectation of new collaborations, visual projects, and records.
events.venue: Radio Day Stage @ Downright Austin Backyard

events.title: Power Ballad
events.description:
When Rick (Paul Rudd), a past-his-prime wedding singer, meets fading boy-band star Danny (Nick Jonas) during a gig, the two bond over music and a late-night jam session. But when Danny turns one of Rick’s songs into the hit that reignites his career, Rick sets out to reclaim the recognition he believes he deserves - even if it means risking everything he cares about. From writer-director John Carney (Sing Street, Once), POWER BALLAD is a feel-good story about music, self-respect, friendship, and the price of ambition. 

Lionsgate presents, in association with 30WEST + Fís Éireann / Screen Ireland, a Likely Story / Distressed Films production, in association with Treasure Entertainment.

events.title: Woodstockers
events.description:
In the summer of '69, Lenny Baker and his best friend Calvin Reddick went to Woodstock. What they witnessed there changed their lives, so much so that they decided to never go home again. Armed with a vision of a new path forward, they built a life in upstate New York alongside Rebecca and Lizzy, two women they met at the festival and married soon after. Decades of willful detachment followed, but every trip has its comedown.

Now, more than half a century later and with his marriage up in smoke, Lenny is forced to face a hard truth: the better world they once envisioned never quite arrived… and if it ever does, he won't be around to see it. Calvin's sudden death makes that painfully clear.
