events.title: Stalefish
events.description:
Stalefish is a 6 piece rock/pop band based in Austin, TX. Coming off of their 2025 EP, 'New Pop Experiments Vol. 1', the band is currently finishing their 3rd LP, 'Bueno', recorded in the first two weeks of 2026.

Contrary to their bedroom studio/DI upbringing, this is their first attempt at recording the basic tracks live, minimizing overdubs. It is an effort to inject the raw energy of their live performances into their recordings. 

Stalefish has 3 lead singers/songwriters: Dalton Hausman, Jake Magee, and producer turned bandmate Sam Franklin. The resulting songs are about love and heartbreak, infatuation, loneliness, and skepticism of the current music landscape. Inspired by artists like Ween, Wilco, and Teenage Fanclub, the band offers a collection of their patented ‘90s/’00s style rock, complete with synthesizer, saxophone, glockenspiel, guitar solos, and funky, odd time signatures. 

Dubbing themselves the “hardest working slacker rock band”, Stalefish has always operated under a true DIY ethos. With their forthcoming LP, the band looks to take that mindset and apply it to the national/international stage.

RIYL: Ween, Wilco, Spoon, Teenage Fanclub, Dinosaur Jr.

events.title: Mallory's Ghost
events.description: Mallory, plagued by fears of being unremarkable, joins her playwright boyfriend Sam on a retreat to coastal Maine. When she learns he once brought his glamorous ex, Louise, there, she’s struck with an obsessive curiosity about his past. As her jealousy takes hold, Mallory becomes convinced she’s being haunted by the ghost of Louise herself... Pulled into a journey that slips between past and present, rivalry and affection, melancholy and creativity, Mallory drifts further from her old life and toward something essential. "Mallory’s Ghost" is a psychological and playful exploration of envy, and the strange path it can lead back to the Self.

events.title: Camila Rivers
events.description:
Camila Rivers is an emerging force in the Austin R&B scene, celebrated for her soulful voice and emotionally honest songwriting. Drawing from inspirations like Jazmine Sullivan and Joseph Solomon, Camila blends classic R&B with modern soul by exploring themes of love, relationships, and self-discovery. As a self-proclaimed “lovergirl,” Camila’s live performances create an intimate experience rooted in raw vulnerability and a touch of magic.

Camila has been a featured performer at Kinky Curly Coily Festival 6, Soul of the City, and Juneteenth Freedom Festival. She was also highlighted by Jackie Venson on 88.7 KAZI’s “Top Black Austin Artist” list for her song “Empire.” Currently, Camila is a Tiny Desk Contest contestant for 2026 and is set to release her upcoming EP in late 2026.

events.title: Posavant
events.description: POSAVANT is a band founded by music producers/multi-instrumentalists Nick and SirK. The band's identity is rooted in a desire to revitalize rock in the modern world and bring controversy back to a genre that has long been bereft of individuality. The band has an unwavering motto of making "real" music, unaffected by digital changes and the plastic nature of modern rock.

events.title: Prissy P
events.description:
Prissy P is a Bay Area–raised DJ and curator based in Austin, TX. Shaped by Northern California’s cultural diversity, her sound blends R&B, hip hop, reggaeton, Afrobeats, and global rhythms into sets rooted in feeling, movement, and connection.

She is an active presence in Austin’s music scene, DJing across nightlife, corporate events, and large-scale community activations, including athletic and wellness-driven experiences. Her ability to move fluidly between nightlife and daytime environments reflects her range as both a DJ and curator.

Outside the club, Prissy P focuses on music in open-air and daytime settings. Through projects like Picnic Beats and Vitamin R&B, she creates spaces where sunshine, music, and nature come together. As someone who navigates depression and anxiety, outdoor environments paired with music have been deeply grounding, turning personal rituals like beach days and picnics into shared experiences.

Her long-term goal is to become an MLB stadium DJ, specifically for the Los Angeles Dodgers. A lifelong baseball fan, she believes music is the heartbeat of a stadium, shaping energy, emotion, and collective memory.

events.title: Still Blank
events.description: Still Blank’s sound is a unique blend of shoegaze haze, folk intimacy, and emotionally raw ambient alt-rock grit. With lyrics steeped in people-watching, dreams, nature, and existential observation, their songwriting draws from both introspection and their surroundings. Ben and Jordy met by chance in Liverpool 2 years ago sparking a lightning-in-a-bottle creative partnership. What started as casual jam sessions in a basement quickly evolved, with sessions ranging from stripped-back recordings on a broken classical guitar to studio lock-ins fuelled by long walks through rural Wales and a shared commitment to imperfection. In May 2025 they performed their first show as a band at Permanent Records Roadhouse. Debut single "What About Jane" is a grungy, folk-inflected reflection on identity, societal perception, and the expectations we’re forced to confront to uncover who we really are.

events.title: Ryan Dove
events.description: Ryan Dove is a rapper and producer from El Paso, Texas, now based in Austin. Known for his energetic shows across the city, he makes lighthearted, relatable hip hop that keeps crowds smiling and moving. If you’re looking for a fun, feel-good live experience, Ryan Dove delivers every time.

events.title: better joy
events.description:
“I like that the better joy sound’s evolving; it’s what we do as people, so it’s only natural the sound grows with me” says Bria Keely, better known by her stage name - better joy. A vivid indie-pop guitar project backed by a band, better joy fuses sparky melodies with strong guitars and pulsating bass lines, coated in lyrics that delve deep into all things vulnerable. The upcoming EP ‘at dusk’, a sister EP to her debut ‘heading into blue’, reflects a moment in her life “where I just stopped trying to please anyone or caring whether the music I wrote ‘fit’ a mold. It’s not on anyone else to define what better joy is: it’s on me”. 

Originally a singer-songwriter, Bria’s route into the indie guitar scene wasn’t conventional: ‘I’m not one of those musicians who grew up on The Cure or played in guitar bands when I was a teenager: I was listening to pop and that’s about it!’. A piano player and singer from a young age, it wasn’t until uni when she sang at the piano after a night out that her friends encouraged her to consider music as a career and she started writing her own music. “I was pretty bad at first, but I just kept at it. And now songwriting is something I can’t live without: for me, it’s therapy”. It was during this period that she started to fall in love with guitar bands, from Wunderhorse and Phoebe Bridgers to 80s guitar bands like The Cure and Mazzy Star, influences that have impacted the sonic development of better joy. 

With her music described by BBC Radio 6 as bright, indie pop, better joy burst on the scene in 2024 with a string of singles and successful support tours; the start of 2025 saw a sell out of vinyls of her debut EP ‘heading into blue’ and a near sold out 10 city UK and EU debut headline tour in March 2025. And 2025 isn’t slowing down: she’s the main UK & EU support for Amy Macdonald in November and February 2026. “I still can’t get my head round it, to be honest. I was playing to a Glasgow audience of 100 people in March and in December I’ll be playing to over 13,000 at the Hydro Arena: it’s a bit bonkers”.

Produced by Mike Hedges (The Cure, Manic Street Preachers, U2), mixed by Caesar Edmunds (Wet Leg, Beach House) and Robbie Nelson (Rolling Stones, Gregory Porter, Beck) and recorded at Chale Abbey Studios on the Isle of Wight, the 6-track EP, ‘at dusk’ is the antidote to the previously sunny introduction to better joy, ‘heading into blue’. Where naivety and openness shone through before, ‘at dusk’ is more contemplative and vulnerable. “It’s so normal to go headfirst into something, whether it be a relationship or a situation, with positivity and excitement, then for reality to leave you a bit jaded and changed” she explains. Whilst the bright and jangly guitars still shine through, it’s lyrics like ‘I never showed you the heavy metal in my bones’ and ‘watch me push against the clouds’ that clearly mark the tonal shift. But in true better joy fashion, the whole EP is uplifting and whilst it acts as a bookend to the debut EP, it leaves the listener hopeful for what music is coming next; the EP is “closing a chapter of my life where insecurity and self-doubt dominated my everyday experience. It’s me accepting the vulnerability that I felt and kind of promising that I’m gonna back myself from now on”. 

‘At dusk’ dances the indie-pop line with authenticity and joy, mixing dark and light tones and sounds, with a big injection of nostalgia. The first single, ‘this part of town’ is about embracing the unknown of relationships and acknowledging the fear that comes with vulnerability: “Eurgh, I hate being vulnerable, it’s really not my bag, but then I realised it’s such a universal feeling and sometimes you just have to accept it comes with being in unknown territory”. ‘steamroller’ is a dark and haunting anthem for anyone who has ever been trampled on by a ‘steamroller’. Bria recalls holding it back from her live set until her team encouraged her to try it, and the first time she did, she burst into tears - something that still happens now. ‘plugged in’ is a love song, for those people who go through their life believing they’re not made for love, until they meet their person and ‘i’m there’ is a thank you to the person who waited for you to come home to them. ‘big thief’ is about taking back your power, before the EP finishes with the beautiful ‘so long’, a goodbye to something that could have been.
events.venue: British Music Embassy @ Palm Door on Sixth

events.title: Buckets
events.description: Introducing Buckets: The Los Angeles-based fearsome foursome are a powerhouse of nostalgic indie punk. Piecing together shredding guitar, screaming gang vocals, and dynamic extremes from track-to-track, or even verse-to-verse, the Southern California outfit aren't shy about who they are or what they're all about. Consisting of members from across North America, Tanner Houghton, Sasha Massey, Mitch Rossiter, and Hiram Sevilla pull together their shared DIY ethos and vast experience in music to craft an emotionally powerful performance. From the studio to the stage, the group never disappoints.

events.title: DannyRitmo
events.description:
Danny Ritmo: The High-Energy Pulse of the Stage
With over 15 years of experience behind the decks and on the mic, Danny Ritmo has solidified his reputation as Austin’s finest DJ and MC. Known for an electrifying stage presence that blurs the line between performer and crowd leader, Danny doesn't just play music—he creates an atmosphere.
Career Highlights
Danny has brought his signature high-energy sets to some of the industry's most prestigious stages, including:
• SXSW Festival: Commanding the iconic Billboard Stage.
• Rumbazo Fest: Taking the heat to the Las Vegas strip.
• Artist Support: Trusted to set the tone for high-profile Latin artists, seamlessly blending global rhythms with modern club energy.
Whether he’s navigating a massive festival crowd or an intimate high-stakes event, Danny Ritmo’s veteran instincts and bilingual charisma make him a powerhouse in the Latin music scene and beyond.

events.title: Easy Honey
events.description: Easy Honey sounds like the starry nights, sunny graveyards, and small-town college Dairy Queens of the South, where the band took form. The group's songs have quickly become anthems of nostalgia for their indie rock audience of daydreamers and night seekers. Easy Honey released their album, Cupidity Unlimited, with contributors such as Adam Lochemes (Arlie, Zach Bryan), Jon Gilbert (Mt. Joy, Adam Melchor, Arcy Drive), and Charlie Stavish (Phoebe Bridgers, Jenny Lewis). The band's raucous yet sentimental live show delivers the realness that people crave in a post-COVID/internet-driven world.

events.title: Funny Or Die Approved
events.description: In partnership with The Stand Comedy Club, Funny Or Die is resurrecting their legendary live comedy legacy - think the spirit of the original epic Oddball Festivals, back, and blessed by the comedy gods themselves. This isn't just another stand-up show; it's a hand-picked, ruthlessly curated night of comedy that's earned the ultimate stamp: Funny or Die Approved. Hosted by Pete Lee. Full lineup coming soon!

events.title: Ryley Hall
events.description:
Ryley Hall is a multi-talented musician, singer, and actor. She was born in Covington, Louisiana and raised in San Antonio, Texas. She began her music career in elementary school, performing in choir and school plays. During her years in high school, she began writing original music with Chelsea Guy and together they wrote her debut album Moments. On her sixteenth birthday, she was gifted a guitar by her grandmother and began playing acoustic shows locally. 
Ryley graduated from the University of Incarnate Word in May of 2025, where she majored in Music Industry Studies.  She recently released her single, "F U" in February 2026.
Ryley's love for music stems from the joy and escape it gives to the listener. She feels that when we listen to music we are all equal, because music touches us at our core and brings out emotions we have all experienced in our lives. She is equally passionate about acting and voice over work, and is actively pursuing these careers along with her music. Regardless of the form it takes, Ryley dreams of building her career in the arts. Her goals include becoming a full-time entertainer and touring the world.

events.title: Shunk
events.description: Formed over the Fall of 2022, Shunk is a four piece from Montreal. Drawing from a vast catalog of musical influences, their sound ranges from shimmering French love songs, to cataclysmic rock. The band's live performances are intense and mesmerizing, the whimsical lyrics and cutting riffs fashion a distinctive sound.

events.title: Ben Buck
events.description:
With deep influences in the golden era and traditional styles of underground hip hop, Ben Buck strives to innovate and continue the legacy of artists who paved the way before him. Hailing from a musical family, Ben Buck’s father Mike Buck was a founding member of the legendary blues group “The Fabulous Thunderbirds”. Mike Buck is also the owner of the historic Antone’s Record Shop in Austin Texas where both Ben and his sister Billie work. His sister Billie Buck is also the frontwoman for the punk band “Sailor Poon” (Austin Chronicle’s Best Punk Band 2018-2020). She is a gifted designer and poster artist, and does many designs for Ben’s album covers. 

Ben Buck has been an omnipresent sight in the Texas music world. He has beatboxed on stage with artists such as Ghostface Killah, Bushwick Bill (Geto Boys), Czarface and Skyzoo. 
In 2023 the City of Austin Texas honored Buck with the declaration of “Ben Buck Day”, recognized annually on April 13th. Later that year on the Austin stop of “The Eric Andre Explosion Tour” Buck was the invited music guest and was interviewed by the legendary comedian, he performed an impromptu beatbox segment with Eric Andre and freestyled alongside him

events.title: Fatherr
events.description:
Born and raised in La Habana, Cuba, Father carries the rhythm of the island in his blood and the ambition of the streets in his soul. Now based in Austin, Texas, he’s bringing a bold new energy to the global reggaeton‑trap scene — one that fuses Cuban passion, trap swagger, and luxury‑driven ambition into an unmistakable sound.
Father’s music is defined by dynamic trap bars, rapid‑fire high notes, and a hard‑hitting reggaeton pulse that bridges Latin rhythm and modern trap innovation. Every track radiates his fast‑paced and glamorous lifestyle — a reflection of success earned, not given. With lyrical authenticity and relentless flow, he delivers the intensity of the Cuban streets elevated by the shine of world‑class luxury.
Now positioned in Austin’s vibrant music scene, Father is ready to redefine how the world experiences Latin trap. His mission is clear: to represent his home, his culture, and the next generation of international Latin sound — all while living life at full speed.
Father isn’t just an artist. He’s a movement — from La Habana to the world.

events.title: Ain TheMachine
events.description:
“We have never seen a proposal even remotely similar to that of Ain TheMachine.” — DJ Mag

Ain TheMachine is a Grammy-nominated Brazilian artist based in Berlin whose work reimagines how electronic music is made and performed. Instead of conventional instruments, he creates music live from the body, the voice and everyday objects, working across genres from Brazilian downtempo to Techno. His shows and videos often break the fourth wall, inviting the audience to contribute sounds that become part of the piece.

His unique approach has drawn international attention: he has been featured in one of Beatport’s most viewed and commented posts and has performed at iconic clubs and festivals such as Fusion Festival (Germany), Sisyphos (Berlin), D-EDGE (Brazil) and Suma Han (Turkey). Supported by artists including Purple Disco Machine, Sam Divine and Mano Le Tough, he releases music on his label Mundo Afora Records and on respected imprints such as Black Book.

He has delivered four TEDx talks in three countries, played with Prince’s guitarist Miko Weaver, jammed with Bobby McFerrin, and had his productions remixed by Mad Professor.

events.title: Ancient Greece
events.description: Ancient Greece hails from the underworld of the Toronto music scene. This is the odyssey of a band stitched together not just by music but by camaraderie and a penchant for the anarchic. Raspy echoes, beating drums, guttural chords, and sharp melodic riffs weave tales of urban decay and what it means to be chewed up, swallowed alive, and come out the other end kicking and screaming.

events.title: Hector Gannet
events.description: Hector Gannet are from the town of North Shields, high on England’s north east coast. Things centre on lead singer-songwriter Aaron Duff whose compositions draw closely on his beloved home terrain. Yet Hector Gannet’s music – folk, rock, ancient, modern – also reaches out into the wider world. Hector Gannet have been praised by music lovers from Chris Packham to Sam Fender, while Uncut magazine acclaimed the band as “North Shields’ answer to Crazy Horse”. There have been live dates with artists from Elbow, Sea Power to Lindisfarne, Richard Thompson & Kathryn Williams – & massive shows with Sam Fender at the vast North Eastern shrine that is St James’ Park football ground. Hector Gannet have drawn pleasing reactions. On BBC 6 Music, musician and broadcaster Tom Robinson greeted a “band of exceptional talent”. In a **** review, MOJO magazine saluted the “pointedly political, natural-world-advocating folk rock” of their The Land Belongs To Us album. Louder Than War website put Hector Gannet among 25 bands to change your life. Forthcoming album includes rousing soul sermons which blend their North Eastern heart with touches of Dexy’s, Style Council-period Weller and a bit of the Boss

events.title: Isis Destiny
events.description: Isis Destiny is an Austin-based artist blending dreamy R&B, experimental pop, and psychedelic shoe gaze. Her music explores intimacy, transformation, and self-discovery, pairing hypnotic vocals with immersive production. Rooted in emotion and visual storytelling, Isis Destiny and her band The Lovers create a world that feels both vulnerable and powerful—inviting listeners into a universe that lingers long after the music ends.

events.title: Amor Vincit Omnia
events.description:
Amor Vincit Omnia is a pop-project created by producer Baldur Skúlason
and singer Erla Hlín Guðmundsdóttir. The band name, translating to Love
Conquers All, encapsulates their humouristic approach to serious subjects,
since the name is to them, both beautiful and a bit ridiculous at the same
time. Amor’s music is best described as playful and eccentric, with an
Icelandic sense of carelessness. Their sound is inspired by people who push
the boundaries of pop music, such as Björk, Jockstrap and Kate Bush.
In 2024, Amor released their debut EP, brb babe, earning them Reykjavik
Grapevine’s ‘One to Watch’ and the Kraumur Awards. Since the release, they
have played at one of the biggest festivals in Iceland ‘Aldrei fór ég Suður’
and collected over 30 performances around the country. This year they will
be playing at the iconic Iceland Airwaves off-venue showcase,
demonstrating that they are now ready to take their infectious beats abroad.

events.title: Gio
events.description:
Gio is a Texas-bred R&B artist from Killeen, now based in Austin, creating music that feels both nostalgic and urgent. Blending the soul of classic ’90s R&B with a raw Southern edge, her sound is smooth, emotional, and unapologetically real—made for late nights, healing moments, and everything in between.

A multi-award–winning artist, Gio’s journey is rooted in lived experience and fearless storytelling. Known for her buttery vocals, seamless riffs, and signature whistle runs, she delivers songs and performances that are intimate, powerful, and deeply felt. Her debut project RMDY introduced a body of work centered on release, vulnerability, and connection.

Whether on record or on stage, Gio creates an atmosphere—one that pulls listeners in and lingers long after the music fades. With authenticity at the core and intention behind every note, she continues to define her place as a compelling voice in modern R&B.

events.title: Grandmas House
events.description:
Grandmas House, Bristol’s finest and loudest 4 piece, have been busy honing their grunge and post-punk influenced sound. With an attack that is both relentless and melodic, the all-female band are a genuinely unique proposition - refusing to be pigeon holed, they are here to shake up perceptions with their intelligent, stylish and raucous take on rock music.

Citing influences from Nirvana to Porridge Radio and Idles to boygenius, the band have been developing their dynamic songwriting. The music moves between aggressive and heavy instrumentation and slower, more melodic passages, creating a powerful contrast. They use their voices to create layered harmonies and the result is a unique and expansive sound.

The band have supported Idles, Big Special, Katy J Pearson and Arxx. They’ve been championed by BBC Introducing and BBC Radio 1 and have had BBC 6 Music support from Steve Lamacq, Emily Pilbeam and Amy Lamé.
events.venue: British Music Embassy @ Palm Door on Sixth Patio

events.title: Leonilo Jaimes
events.description:
Originario de Austin, Texas, Leonilo Jaimes descubrió su pasión por la música a los 11 años tras recibir su primera guitarra. A los 17, inspirado por referentes del regional mexicano como Ariel Camacho y Eslabón Armado, comenzó a componer temas de amor y desamor basados en vivencias propias y de su entorno.

En 2021, lanzó de forma independiente su EP "PARA ELLA", logrando un impacto inmediato con sencillos como "POR ESO TE CANTO YO" y "HALLOWEEN". Su éxito en plataformas digitales es contundente: cuenta con 280 mil oyentes mensuales, destacando éxitos como "PENSANDO EN TI" (2.5 millones de reproducciones) y su primer sencillo "TU VENENO", que ya roza los 3 millones.

Un talento sincero, leal y humilde, Leonilo Jaimes está dedicado a consolidarse como un artista integral y referente dentro del género regional mexicano.

events.title: Ideal Collective
events.description: Formed in 2017 Ideal Collective consists of 5 MCs Salus Herb, Rowski, Mikeal, Darxx and Marvodagreat.With DJ-GSharp backing them on the 1's and 2's Ideal blends vintage Hip-Hop styles reminiscent of golden era rap crews such as Wu-Tang Clan, Jurassic 5, and a Tribe Called Quest, but bring a fresh take on it with the blending of modern productions and vinyl cyphers with lifestyle raps and turn up tracks you'll get a bit of everything when listening to Ideal Collective.

events.title: Perfect
events.description: In a world devastated by a contaminated water supply, Kai, a lost soul, finds herself living out of her car after a bad breakup. Each day is a struggle until fate intervenes and leads her to a hidden utopian lake, where the water is pure and life flourishes. At this secret haven, Kai encounters a band of eccentric misfits each with their own stories of loss and hope. Among them is Mallory, an enigmatic and wealthy pregnant woman living out an escapist fantasy. Despite their vastly different backgrounds, Kai and Mallory are drawn to each other, and a sudden, passionate romance ignites. As their bond deepens, Kai begins to uncover the layers of Mallory’s life and the secrets she harbors.

Each day is a struggle until fate intervenes and leads her to a hidden utopian lake, where the water is pure and life flourishes. At this secret haven, Kai encounters a band of eccentric misfits each with their own stories of loss and hope. Among them is Mallory, an enigmatic and wealthy pregnant woman living out an escapist fantasy. Despite their vastly different backgrounds, Kai and Mallory are drawn to each other, and a sudden, passionate romance ignites. As their bond deepens, Kai begins to uncover the layers of Mallory’s life and the secrets she harbors.

events.title: Total Wife
events.description:
Come Back Down, the new album by Nashville experimental-pop duo Total Wife, was born from the edge of sleep. When composer and producer Luna Kupper would begin to fall asleep during late-night mixing sessions, the songs would follow her into the halfway place between dream and lucidity. Like Dale Cooper in Twin Peaks, she’d wake with a new perspective on the puzzle she was piecing together. “I’m a psychological mixer — I’m trying to think of how someone’s experiencing the sound, versus getting stuck in trying to make all these different tones and using all this gear to make something sound a certain way,” Kupper says.

And like a spiral from waking life into dream, the songs on Come Back Down are endlessly self- referential, building whole universes from a single point. Kupper sold all of her synths to make rent before she started working on the album, and so every inorganic sound is instead built from samples of the band’s own work. A guitar on one song may be reprocessed and used as a synth on the next, while everywhere on the album vocal samples are taken from a single unreleased cover of Elliott Smith’s “Between the Bars.” In tribute to this process, the album was almost named The Julia Set after the mathematical equation which feeds into itself again and again, creating beautiful fractal images. The intention was to create something complex but accessible; experimental, yet precise and without abstraction.

events.title: Aaron Page
events.description: Aaron Page is an emerging force in contemporary R&B whose music is as heartfelt as it is captivating. His journey began early, watching his older brother perform in a high school quartet and singing at talent shows during summers spent at his family’s camp. Early on, those cafeteria performances sparked a love for music that deepened with time. Aaron’s artistic foundation was laid at a music and arts academy in Bridgeport, Connecticut, where he became the lead vocalist in a jazz ensemble and honed his understanding of song structure. It was there he realized music wasn’t just a passion – it was his purpose. Drawing inspiration from icons like Drake, Kanye West, John Mayer, Ryan Leslie, The Weeknd, and Michael Jackson, Aaron developed a sound that is moody, melodic, and emotionally raw. R&B runs deep in Aaron’s veins – it’s the core of his identity and the soundtrack of his upbringing. His lyrics are rooted in personal experiences and the world around him, unafraid to be vulnerable and honest. That sincerity resonates in tracks like “Pretty Girls Love R&B” – a breakout hit celebrating women and creating a vibe that’s both comforting and confident. Aaron has already left his mark on major stages nationwide, joining R&B heavyweights PARTYNEXTDOOR on the Sorry I’m Outside Tour and Bryson Tiller on the Back and Better Tour as an opening act. Whether on stage or in the studio, Aaron moves with love and intention, using music as both an escape and a celebration. Most recently, Aaron released his new EP, Before I Go – a sultry, rain-soaked sonic experience that offers a glimpse into his evolving style. With smooth melodies and infectious rhythms, the project is perfect for summer nights, late drives, and moments of reflection. It’s a boundary-pushing body of work that positions him as a distinctive voice in modern R&B. Now, he’s stepping boldly into the spotlight – bringing a fresh, emotionally rich perspective to R&B while honoring the genre’s timeless soul.

events.title: Amy Gadiaga
events.description:
As a bassist, vocalist, and composer, my journey as a music creator has been shaped by my rich cultural heritage and passion for blending traditional jazz with contemporary influences. I grew up in the suburbs of Paris, born to parents of Senegalese, Gambian, and Malian descent. This background continues to inspire my artistry, which merges the sounds of jazz legends like Betty Carter and Wayne Shorter with the soulful rhythms of artists such as D’Angelo and Stevie Wonder. 
 
Since moving to London at 18 to study double bass at Trinity Laban Conservatoire of Music and Dance, I have built a strong live track record, performing at renowned festivals and venues including the EFG London Jazz Festival, Jazz Café, Cheltenham Jazz Festival, We Out Here, Brick Lane Jazz Festival, and Pizza Express Soho. These experiences have been pivotal in building my fanbase and establishing my presence in the UK. Internationally I have performed at the Montreux Jazz Festival and countries around the world including France, Poland , South Korea and more.

events.title: Bagworm
events.description:
Carroll’s worldview is dominated by the threat of catastrophe and the decline of morality in the face of human extinction. Then he steps on a rusty nail. He stumbles through the modern world, searching for romance, shedding toxic friendships, and fighting for truth... all while struggling to maintain his deteriorating health and sanity. 

As his moral crusade edges closer to self-destruction, Carroll is confronted with the ultimate existential question: are we really doomed, or is he just dying of tetanus?

events.title: Brainwasher
events.description: Brainwasher (Oklahoma City) is the brainchild of Matthew Duckworth Kirksey (vocals, drums, keyboards, sampler) and Tommy McKenzie (guitar, bass, keyboards, sampler), known for their involvement in celebrated acts such as The Flaming Lips, Miley Cyrus, Brothers Griiin, Beachy Head, and Net. The pair offers a meddled strain of trip-hop, touching on industrial, new wave, and shoegaze, in encapsulating stripped-down, psyched-out songs that connect directly with the lizard brain. Their debut full-length album, 39 Lightyears from Heaven, drops on October 24th, 2025 under Montréal boutique imprint Mothland.

events.title: The Braymores
events.description: The Braymores are an Alternative/Folk Rock group hailing from Chicago, IL. The group features members Matt Tilles (Vocals/Guitar), Keegan Melaniphy (Guitar), Russell Oren (Drums), and Connor Kohanzo (Bass). The band released their first EP ‘Talking to Trees’ in late 2023 followed by their debut LP ‘Who You’d Have Been’ in late 2024, receiving considerable underground buzz and cementing their position in the Chicago scene.

events.title: c_robo_
events.description: not sure

events.title: Mike & Nick & Nick & Alice
events.description: “Mike & Nick & Nick & Alice” is a hilarious, stylized, R-rated action-comedy about two gangsters and the woman they love trying to survive the most dangerous night of their lives. As if that wasn’t enough, there’s one wild ingredient added to the mix: a time machine. The film, which will premiere March 27, 2026, exclusively on Hulu, stars Vince Vaughn, James Marsden, Eiza González, Keith David, Jimmy Tatro, Stephen Root, Lewis Tan, Ben Schwartz, Emily Hampshire, and Arturo Castro, and is written and directed by BenDavid Grabinski, produced by Andrew Lazar, p.g.a., and executive produced by Richard Middleton and Vanessa Humphrey.

events.title: Reductress Live!
events.description: That's what she/they said! From the women who taught you how to “Drive Your Man Crazy in Bed With These Twelve Trumpet Solos” comes the first-ever Reductress Live stand-up show in Austin, TX. Join us at the Creek and the Cave at 9pm on March 14th for a night of laughs — and if we're lucky, we'll kill this "Tony" fellow once and for all.Full lineup coming soon!

events.title: Semisoft
events.description: Semisoft is a dreamy post-grunge trio hailing from Tacoma, Washington. Blending spacey, hypnotic textures with explosive riff-driven energy, their sound lands somewhere between Fuzz, PJ Harvey, and Natural Child. Following the release of their Greenway Records debut 7", the band is preparing to unveil their second EP on Den Tapes, the Seattle-based cassette label and community founded by Kay Redden. Looking ahead, Semisoft’s long-awaited full-length album is slated for release next year.

events.title: Andrea Daniela
events.description:
Andrea Daniela was born to be on stage. A dynamic singer, violinist, dancer, and actor raised in Houston, she blends deep mariachi roots with a fearless, modern edge. Her career has taken her to international stages and acclaimed theatrical productions, earning recognition for both her powerful voice and magnetic presence.

Now based in Austin, Andrea steps into a new era with her debut album “Mariachi Mestiza y Mala Mujer” a bold fusion of mariachi, cumbia, pop, and hip-hop that celebrates culture, duality, womanhood, and self-made artistry. As the founder of Houston’s first all-female mariachi band and the creative force behind her own talent agency, she continues to redefine what mariachi means for the next generation.

events.title: Azamiah
events.description:
Primed to be the next group from the UK jazz underground to break out, Azamiah draw on 
jazz roots while touching on everything from James Blake’s production techniques to dubby 
low-end, taking the listener on a journey across moody and light landscapes.  Their 2023 
debut album ‘In Phases’ won praise from The Skinny and CLASH and received plays on BBC 
6Music and NTS.  A bridge between first album, and second, their recent EP ‘Two Lands’ 
released in May 2025 resonates with emotional honesty and is played with a fresh intensity. 
The band has played on stages across the UK and Europe including Latitude Festival, Jazz on Wick, Hidden Door, Edinburgh Jazz and Blues Festival, Brick Lane Jazz Festival, JAZZMI (IT) & North Sea Round Town (NL). Having recently completed their first UK headline tour in October 2025 to electric audiences in Glasgow, London, Bristol, Manchester, Leeds and Brighton and flooded with requests for a re-press of 'In Phases', a dedicated fanbase is making themselves known.

events.title: Die Slo
events.description:
An underground hip-hop collective; Die Slo Entertainment, that doubles as a record label, is the combination of three Austin-based hip-hop groups who merged to work collectively as one unit. Its core members include Sertified , SouthSide Hippie, WKDZD, and Clova. With a particularly diverse set of emcees, all coming from different cultural backgrounds, Die Slo Entertainment produces equally diverse music, and are believers in the alternative and underground nature of their music, the group of hip-hop producers attempt to spread their positive motto
"Stay humble but stay hungry," throughout the world.

events.title: Midnight Short Program
events.description: Indulge your cravings for horror, gore, and dark comedy.

events.title: The Rise of the Red Hot Chili Peppers: Our Brother, Hillel
events.description: An in-depth look at the gritty formative years of the Red Hot Chili Peppers and the singular vision of original guitarist Hillel Slovak. Featuring interviews with bandmates Flea and Anthony Kiedis and others close to Slovak, the film explores the band’s early evolution on the LA music scene and the deep bond of their childhood friendship.

events.title: Summer of ’94
events.description: "Summer of ’94" reveals the wild rise of the U.S. Men’s National Team on the road to the 1994 World Cup—and the history they were never meant to make. With no league and no roadmap, a ragtag group of players and an unlikely coach endured a grueling two-year training camp, hoping simply not to embarrass their nation at the first-ever World Cup on American soil. Armed with camcorders, the players documented it all, capturing raw moments as underdogs grew into future legends. Featuring never-before-seen footage and new interviews with Alexi Lalas, Cobi Jones, Tony Meola, and coach Bora Milutinović, the film shares how chaos, chemistry, and grit forged a brotherhood that changed US soccer forever.
events.venue: Rollins Theatre at the Long Center

events.title: Lynn
events.description:
LYNN is a 24-year-old artist from Birmingham, Alabama, making waves in the Hip-Hop/Rap and R&B scene. Her music is all about owning the moment, showcasing the power of women through bold, unapologetic rap bars, while also hitting us with those smooth, soulful R&B vibes.
Though she’s just getting started, LYNN has already made a big splash, earning the title of “Bama Hip-Hop/Rap Female Artist of the Year” at the 2022 Alabama Music Awards. She’s all about breaking boundaries and creating a space for herself in the industry while uplifting her community along the way.
With her unique sound and unstoppable energy, LYNN is on a mission to inspire and pave the way for others, all while cementing her place as one of the freshest voices in the game.

events.title: Mên An Tol
events.description:
Formed in the orbit of a South London pub, the spirit of Mên An Tol’s music can be traced back to frontman Bill Jefferson’s own musical education in his native Cornwall where he’d play folk sessions in and around the local pubs – in-fact the band name itself is taken from a rural site of ancient stones.

The band’s instant chemistry (completed by mandolinist Felix Knox, bassist Max Silvey, drummer Tom Stevens and guitarist Robert Wiseman) is writ-large as they channel the raw grit of folk greats like The Pogues and The Waterboys alongside the mainstage urgency and confidence of Britpop giants. Perhaps most vitally, the songs proudly reclaim lost folk traditions with the use of the mandolin coupled with vibrant storytelling.

The band released two EP's in 2025, the most recent being September's 'This Land’, featuring the track ‘Not Ideal’ - produced by Carlos O’Connell of Fontaines DC who got involved after seeing them live. 

Throughout the year Mên An Tol have gone from strength to strength. They've picked up praise from NME, Rolling Stone UK, The Independent, DIY, So Young and more. At radio the band were on the B List at BBC 6 Music with single 'Not Ideal' and recorded a Maida Vale session for Steve Lamacq. On his Apple Music radio show Elton John has given two different tracks a spin, stating "I really love their sound". 

The band played two shows at 2025 Glastonbury Festival alongside European festival runs, UK touring and dates supporting The Libertines and Miles Kane. They also played The Great Escape and finished the year with a packed out London headline at The Lexington.
events.venue: British Music Embassy @ Palm Door on Sixth

events.title: JOPLYN
events.description:
JOPLYN is a Berlin-based electronic live act moving between melodic house, techno, and electronica, guided by a distinct voice - both literal and emotional. Writing, producing, and performing exclusively original material, her live shows unfold as immersive experiences where vocals, synths, and improvisation meet intuition and intensity.
Her music has traveled widely through collaborations with artists such as Booka Shade, Röyksopp, Robyn, Damian Lazarus, MK, and Jan Blomqvist, with releases on labels including Defected, Get Physical, Diynamic, Crosstown Rebels, Mobilee, and Watergate Records. In 2022, Pete Tong named her BBC Radio 1’s Future Star.
Beyond the club, JOPLYN’s work reflects a growing curiosity for depth, vulnerability, and transformation. After more than 150 shows worldwide, including Ibiza residencies at Hï Ibiza and WooMoon/Cova Santa and a debut at Coachella’s Yuma Tent, she is opening a new chapter. She is currently working on her fourth studio album, set for release in 2026 on her own label None Of The Above (N.O.T.A.) Berlin, exploring a more expansive and emotionally resonant sound.

events.title: Kali Horse
events.description: The experimental art-rock collab of multi-instrumentalist creators Sam Maloney and Desiree Das Gupta, Kali Horse blends fantasy and harsh realism, colliding genres with reckless abandon. Production that dips between the best of alt-rock and avante-pop spheres, Kali Horse is a celebration of intentional genrelessness.  Digital and live drums under emotional harmonies, swimming guitar enveloped by foley samples make the live band ripple with eccentricity. Their avante-pop whimsicality channels Björk, their soaring anthemic moments reflect their rock roots. The combo of Sam's feathery vocal and Des' powerhouse belt has their voices in conversation with one another - a hypnotic connection. The debut record 'Some Type of Electric Lagoon' (2023) is a vibrant metaphorical swamp journey, an opus. The new EP '2099' veers into industrial soundscapes - a bold snap back to reality. More bite and grit, with a higher polish than ever thanks to Emmy-winning foley artist Brandon Bak (Possum, OOZ). The live act lit up festivals like NYC’s New Colossus and Ontario's River & Sky, opening for and somehow making sense with SUUNS and Ruby Waters alike. Hypnotic. Psychedelic electronic. artrockbeats.

events.description:
"I've not stopped playing this for days" - STEVE LAMACQ, BBC RADIO 6
"Authentic...really special" - BBC RADIO 6 ROUNDTABLE

"Stunning and Beautiful" - GOD IS IN THE TV

"Is this the best new band in the UK?" - THE ZINE

events.title: Stormbound
events.description: Step inside the eye of the storm. "Stormbound" thrusts audiences into the heart of the world’s most powerful hurricanes with breathtaking, never-before-seen footage captured from within. As wind, water, and land collide, the film follows storm chaser Jeff Gammons, who for more than thirty years has pushed closer than anyone else to document every major hurricane to strike the United States. Now tested by a near fatal disease , Gammons continues his pursuit—revealing the personal cost of chasing nature at its most extreme and the larger environmental forces shaping our world. "Stormbound" is a high-stakes, immersive experience that places audiences face-to-face with nature at its most powerful.

events.title: The Tiarras
events.description: Meet The Tiarras: Tori, Sophia, and Tiffany Baltierra, a dynamic trio of multi-faceted artists who effortlessly blend genres and cultural influences to create global music that knows no boundaries. Sisters turned bandmates, The Tiarras have embarked on a journey that defies conventions and embraces sonic exploration. Hailing from a Mexican-American heritage, The Tiarras draw from the rich tapestry of musical diversity that surrounded their upbringing. Their vibrant compositions seamlessly weave together elements of rock, Latin, pop, soul, reggae, and blues, resulting in an eclectic yet refined sound that challenges the very notion of genre. Fueled by a passion for community and inclusivity, The Tiarras' music is a conduit for spreading positive energy and empowering messages. Their tracks, like "Soy Chingona" and "Let Love Free," resonate far and wide, gaining recognition on prestigious platforms including NPR World Cafe, Mitú & Grimy Goods. Committed to releasing more original music that defies expectations and embraces their global influences, their journey is one of breaking boundaries, sparking positive change, and leaving an indelible mark on the music landscape.

events.title: INK
events.description: Superstar songwriter and genre-defying artist Ink is a lauded creative force, celebrated for her work on seismic cultural projects like Beyonce's GRAMMY® Award-winning COWBOY CARTER, RENAISSANCE and Kendrick Lamar's GNX – including co-writing multi-week No. 1 smash “Luther." Most recently, the latter earned Ink 3 nominations at the 2026 GRAMMYs: Album of the Year, Record of the Year, and Song of the Year. With her debut EP BIG BUSKIN’ released in October 2025, including singles "Turquoise Cowboy," “Hoedown,” and “Sweet Tea,” Rolling Stone proclaimed, "Ink is ready to fully dive into her own artistry." Making waves and more music on the horizon, along with a debut performance at Stagecoach, 2026 marks the official rise of a powerful new voice in American music. Born in Germany and raised in Georgia, Ink got her start busking on the streets before going on to collaborate with legends like Trae tha Truth and Nipsey Hussle. Her music – rooted in country, Southern rap and classic Americana – is as rich and bold as her story.
events.venue: Austin City Limits Live at the Moody Theater

events.title: Mid Century Modern
events.description:
Mid Century Modem (MCM) is a Seattle-based alternative jazz duo featuring Seattle Hip Hop emcee/producer King Khazm, and singer/songwriter, Jesse Kogita.

2024 Golden Ear Award Nominees for NW Alternative Jazz Group of the Year, MCM’s music is a hand-built collage of original and improvised digital and live music built on the foundations of jazz and hip hop. They have shared the stage with Kassa Overall, Abstract Rude, Myka 9, DJ Scene, Supreme La Rock, Def-I, and others, and in 2026, were recognized by the City of Los Angeles for their contributions to the arts.

Their musical journeys have spanned over two decades respectively, with both artists performing throughout the United States, and internationally at events such as Montreux Jazz Festival, North Sea Jazz Festival, Sturgis Motorcycle Rally, Hempfest, World’s Fair Dubai, Earshot Jazz Festival, and Festival de la Juventud.

events.title: Grace Sorensen
events.description: Grace Sorensen is one of the fastest independent-rising stars in the music scene. As a multi-hyphenate singer, songwriter, and dancer, she’s been dubbed "Austin's Wonderkid" and “Austin’s R&B Cool Girl” by the Austin Chronicle and KUTX. In her young career she has already been featured on Joe Budden’s “Sleeper Picks,” collaborated with BLK ODYSSY, been inducted to the Recording Academy's Class of 2025, played Austin City Limits Festival, SXSW Austin & London, and surpassed one million organic streams on her single "Digits.” She debuted her versatile album "BLUEPRINT" February 2025 and has exciting expectation of new collaborations, visual projects, and records.

events.title: Kill Me
events.description: Jimmy wakes up in a bathtub filled with his own blood, his wrists slit and his life rapidly nearly completion. This would be a textbook failed suicide attempt, only…Jimmy didn’t do it? At least, he’s pretty sure he didn’t. Alongside Margot, the 911 operator who took his call that faithful night, Jimmy begins an amateur-hour murder investigation, desperate to prove that this is a whodunnit and not a hedunnit. The list of suspects who might be happy if Jimmy wasn’t around anymore is fairly long—angry ex-girlfriends, frustrated siblings, exasperated psychiatrists, and resentful stepfathers. But the prime suspect is Jimmy himself.

events.title: Chief Cleopatra
events.description:
Jalesa Jessie, Chief Cleopatra is an Austin-based Soul Rock singer and songwriter known for her "non-genre-denominational" sound that blends rock, soul, gospel, and funk. Originally from Corsicana, Texas, she began her musical path as a drummer in her school’s marching band before moving to Austin in 2017 to pursue a career as a frontwoman. 

She gained significant attention following her 2019 debut EP, Lesa x Lenny Vol.1, and was named KUTX Artist of the Month in February 2022. Her 2022 EP, Luna, was produced by Walker Lukens and released via Park The Van Records, earning comparisons to artists like Santigold.

A six-time official SXSW artist, she has opened for notable acts including The Wailers, Girl Talk, and Adrian Quesada of Black Pumas. Cleo became a member of the Recording Academy in 2022 and her 2023 single "Weekend Warrior" was in consideration for four Grammy nominations. 

Her music is often described as "genre-bending," featuring register-spanning vocals and a strong visual aesthetic that includes ornamental fashion. She cites Tina Turner as a primary inspiration for her energy and presence. Cleo is currently unsigned.

events.title: Fish Hunt
events.description: Fish Hunt is the musical project of New York native Lucy Mondello. Equipped with a unique affinity for all things careful and sensitive, Lucy’s songwriting is rich and thoughtful, think a homemade meal or a patchwork quilt. She found her voice listening to such artists as Modest Mouse, Johanna Warren, and Animal Collective, which has led her to a unique sonic palette that’s all her own. Her sophomore release, Self Taught, sees her adding to the quilt in a big way, collaborating with many of her musical contemporaries to create a dynamic record that is as courageous as it is cozy. In addition to her own work, Lucy has also played in the live bands of artists Claud, Diet Cig, and waveform*.  Recently released LP: Self Taught, January 12th 2024.  Upcoming LP: Fall 2026.

events.title: Kenzzo
events.description:
Kenzzo is an artist from Monterrey, Nuevo León. With just 21 years and an EP released this 2025, it has already positioned itself as one of the new promises of pop in Mexico.
His proposal, which he calls inorganic pop, seeks to expand musicals horizons with fresh sounds that start from the mixture of the warmth of the grand piano and experimentation with digital synthesis.

events.title: Gus Englehorn
events.description: If Gus Englehorn didn’t exist, one of his songs would have to invent him. A former pro snowboarder reborn as a nomadic psych-pop prophet, Englehorn has lived a rollercoaster life that reads like one of the fantastical fables that fill his songbook. Back in January 2020, right at the dawn of the pandemic, Englehorn released his first album, Death & Transfiguration [...] But even as life has since opened up again, Englehorn is still firmly situated in a world of his own madcap design. Where 2022’s Dungeon Master walked the tightrope between DIY discord and prog-scaled storytelling, his third album, The Hornbook, magically transmutes the entire history of 20th-century rock ‘n’ roll—’50s golden oldies, ‘60s garage spunk, ‘70s glam flamboyance,‘80s indie transgression, ‘90s lo-fi weirdness—into an alien transmission from the future. The Hornbook was mixed by Paul Leary from the legendary punk band Butthole Surfers and marked the beginning of a fruitful collaboration. Leary and Englehorn reunited on The Broken Balladeer, due February 27th 2026, this time with Leary taking on the role of producer. They also enlisted the help of industry legends Stuart Sullivan, Howie Weinberg and Kramer.

events.title: Hokum
events.description: When novelist Ohm Bauman retreats to a remote inn to scatter his parents’ ashes, he is consumed by tales of a witch haunting the honeymoon suite. Disturbing visions and a shocking disappearance forces him to confront dark corners of his past.

events.title: Sassy 009
events.description:
Sassy 009 is the shape-shifting project from Oslo-based producer, songwriter and vocalist Sunniva Lindgård. After finding early acclaim as a trio with 2017’s Do You Mind EP, Sassy 009 rebooted as a solo vehicle in 2019, later evolving into 2021’s sultry, bass-driven Heart Ego mixtape. But for Lindgård, her album Dreamer+ is her true debut: a concept-driven album pieced together from nearly four years of studio effort, and an ambitious attempt to take complete control of her artistry. Steered by freshly distorted vocals and elements of grunge, shoegaze, ‘90s beatronica and gauzy hyperpop, the album is a record of self-discovery and self-effacement at once, studded with guest contributions from Blood Orange, BEA1991 and Yunè Pinku.

Since the release of Dreamer+ in January, Sassy 009 has sold out her UK and EU tour dates, toured as main support for Blood Orange, had press support from Pitchfork, Stereogum, The FADER, CLASH, CRACK, DAZED and more.. she's collaborated with US rap superstar Don Toliver by adding vocals to his track 'Pleasures Mine' from his Billboard no.1 album 'Octane'. 2026 has a lot more in store for Sassy 009.

events.title: Seulement
events.description:
Seulement is the solo project of Mathieu
Arsenault, an electronic musician and
audiovisual artist from Montreal. His work
explores the imperfections of the human body
in our era of technological perfection. More
specifically, he is interested in the integration
and transformation of the human voice and
gesture in digital arts. First known as the lead
singer of the electronic rock band Technical
Kidman, his solo practice now extends to
audiovisual performances, as well as albums
and experimental films. His work has been
presented at numerous festivals including
MUTEK Montréal (CA), ELEKTRA (CA),
Videocittà (IT), Modular M+ (HN), CODEC
(PE), Lunchmeat (CZ), Wavelength (CA),
Sound/Image (UK), International Film Festival
Rotterdam (NL), Festival International des
Films sur l’Art (CA), Iceland Airwaves (IS) and
Suoni Per Il Popolo (CA).

events.title: SpaceGoonz
events.description: As was foretold by the prophecy, the SpaceGoonz have entered this plane of existence. They crash-landed in Austin, Texas, in 2023. Their current mission: to reinvent what it means to be a Hip-Hop artist in the capital city of Texas. They are returning to SXSW for the third consecutive year, continuing to help elevate the local Hip-Hop scene into a nationally recognized hub for the art form. Comparable to Wu-Tang Clan, Brockhampton, Flatbush Zombies, ETC. Consisting of members from all around the country and spanning multiple generations, their sound is a collage of the different Hip-Hop practices, melded together by the diverse backgrounds of every member. So it doesn’t matter what god you believe in or what media you consume, as long as, when we say “Space,” you say… “Goonz”

events.title: SRI
events.description:
SRI is a Brooklyn-based DJ, producer, and artist crafting futuristic club music through a South Asian lens. Known for percussive, high-energy sets and hypnotic vocals, she builds immersive worlds that feel both cinematic and visceral.

“SXSW is about discovery, and this showcase highlights how South Asian artists are shaping what’s next. I’m excited to bring my world, my sound, and my community into that space.” She will be featured as a performer for the SOUTH ASIAN HOUSE Soundvilla showcase for SXSW 2026.

Leading up to her showcase performance, she will be releasing a single that fuses the worlds of Brooklyn, NY and Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India.

events.title: The Stand Presents
events.description: The Stand presents a special SXSW showcase at Esther’s Follies, bringing its signature mix of killer lineups, top-tier talent, and unmistakable New York energy to Austin. Known as one of New York City’s premier comedy venues and a launchpad for today’s biggest names, The Stand delivers a high-energy night featuring some of the sharpest, most in-demand voices in stand-up, including some special guest drop ins!Lineup coming soon!

events.title: Steven Bamidele
events.description:
Nigerian-born, London-based singer, songwriter, musician, and producer Steven Bamidele is known for his distinctive reverb-drenched falsetto, synth textures, and syncopated beats. Citing the influences of contemporary creators Frank Ocean, Tyler the Creator, Solange and Childish Gambino, he puts social commentary and artistic narratives at the forefront of his music. 

His recent sophomore album THE CRASH! was written against the backdrop of an ever-changing world, combining indie-soul and jazz, acoustic and electronic textures, along with daydream-esque storytelling. The LP received support from Blues Project, Somewhere Soul, BBC Radio 3, BBC 6Music, BBC Introducing, WorldwideFM, Clash, Wordplay and Fusicology, alongside playlisting from Jazz FM, FIP Radio France and KCRW.

To critical acclaim, he has headlined London’s iconic 100 Club, Brighton's Dome Studio and Prince Albert, Jazz re:freshed, Pizza Express Live Soho and more.  Steven has supported renowned artists Alice Russell, Sly5thAve, Hot 8 Brass Band, Marlon Craft, Kymara, Ebi Soda, while making festival appearances at We Out Here, Love Supreme, Shambala, The Great Escape, Brick Lane Jazz, SXSW London and beyond.
events.venue: British Music Embassy @ Palm Door on Sixth Patio

events.title: willoh
events.description:
Missouri native willoh is riding the crest of a wave of excitement over her new series of singles leading up to her spring 2026 album release.  On her latest track, EARMILK writes ““OUCHIE” defies easy categorization, blending synth-pop, raw punk attitude, and alt-rock vibes into a shifting, avant-garde sound.”  


Willoh’s self-produced 20205  debut, not more than that, but more please presents us with a raw honesty rendered through snowy vocals that sit in rarefied air and belies the artist’s 19 years. In September she released the labyrinthine “Buckshot” to critical acclaim.

From her home in Springfield, Missouri, willoh records and creates music, having first found her footing on Garageband before graduating to LogicPro–making the upgrade from her earnings working many long shifts at McDonalds.

events.title: Scuttino
events.description: "Your Favorite Cousin” Scuttino is one of the most exciting new voices in hip-hop. The multifaceted rapper, singer, and songwriter hails from Oak Cliff, a tough inner-city area of Dallas, Texas that’s also home to artists such as Yella Beezy, N’Dambi, and The D.O.C. With his love for hip-hop, neo-soul, and R&B, Scuttino has developed a versatile vibe that fuses classic instrumentation with modern production, along with his own mellow style and gift for wordplay. Inspired by a diverse range of artists, from T-Pain to Lil Wayne to hometown hero Erykah Badu, he has crafted a sound that is fresh and innovative, yet rooted in tradition and southern culture. Scuttino sets himself apart from other artists with his smooth and confident flow, his soulful melodies, and his distinctive vocal fry, which gives him a unique and recognizable voice that makes him stand out in the crowded hip-hop universe. This breath of fresh air has captivated audiences, both locally and online, with streams and views that are constantly piling up across multiple platforms. Keep your ears open for Scuttino, who's sure to take the music world by storm and become your favorite artist's "Favorite cousin".

events.title: KID PHENOMENON
events.description:
A seven-member dance and vocal group that embodies Tokyo's new generation culture, "TOKYO NEO POP".
Armed with their unique performance style, these young talents are set to create a new phenomenon from Tokyo to the world.
Debuting in August 2023.

events.title: Vintage Jay
events.description: Vintage Jay hailing from off Rundberg Ln in Austin’s gritty, very culturally diverse Northside.  Austin based rapper and DJ has risen up to speak for a section of Austin that has rarely had a voice. Blending tales from the streets with very poignant bars of consciousness and social reform. Vintage Jay was featured on KUTX radio September Artist of the month and KUTX Summer Jam. Making him an official NPR Session artist. The city of Austin has also given Jay his official proclamation date September 12th. From producing cultural and musical events to as well expressing his life through music. Jay has become an individual of many traits, his latest album Still I Rise, speaks of a new age of creativity and musical expression to the ear. His growth in his music is something that appears in every album, and one thing that never changes is that he stays true to himself and the craft. Jay has become a true tastemaker and one of the biggest Latino figures in Austin, TX. To represent the Latino culture with pride and honor is something Jay has done since day 1.

events.title: Sparks
events.description:
Cleo is new to Sparks, Nevada when she discovers a cigarette vending machine that inexplicably produces a book on Jean-Luc Godard. When she meets the Crop soon after, Cleo’s morphed into a cinephile, and when she learns of the Crop’s reservoir visits, she’s certain that she could time travel and meet Godard in 60s Paris.	

Crop leader Antoine is enamored with Cleo but rankled by her insinuations that Crop life is boring. When Cleo disappears at the reservoir, Antoine calls into question his own sense of purpose, before unexpected adventures materialize—a shootout, a dreamy gay barbecue—until Cleo returns to Sparks and the Crop must figure out where she’s been and if she’s lost her mind.

events.title: Sparks
events.description:
Cleo is new to Sparks, Nevada when she discovers a cigarette vending machine that inexplicably produces a book on Jean-Luc Godard. When she meets the Crop soon after, Cleo’s morphed into a cinephile, and when she learns of the Crop’s reservoir visits, she’s certain that she could time travel and meet Godard in 60s Paris.	

Crop leader Antoine is enamored with Cleo but rankled by her insinuations that Crop life is boring. When Cleo disappears at the reservoir, Antoine calls into question his own sense of purpose, before unexpected adventures materialize—a shootout, a dreamy gay barbecue—until Cleo returns to Sparks and the Crop must figure out where she’s been and if she’s lost her mind.

events.title: College of Hip Hop Knowledge
events.description:
What started as a positive movement in hip hop culture and community turned 
into a super group of emcees performing with a 4 piece band and DJ live.  CHHK is a local ATX nonprofit for artist empowerment and a live hip hop act who performs with the band The Dropouts.  They always provide a good time with upbeat positive hip hop in a high energy performance.  Diverse emcees paired with some of the most talented musicians in Austin make for an uniquely ATX hip hop sound you won't hear anywhere else.  Often called the WuTang of Texas CHHK's diverse emcees run the gambit of cultures, backgrounds and sounds culminating in a sound that is undeniable.

events.title: American Dollhouse
events.description: A woman inherits her childhood home, seeking solace from a chaotic city life marked by addiction and debt. Unbeknownst to her, a psychotic neighbor becomes disturbingly obsessed with her due to a haunting resemblance to the neighbor’s deceased mother. As the fixation turns violent, her friends begin disappearing one by one, drawing her into a perverted, blood-soaked Christmas nightmare she may not survive.

events.title: Don Esco
events.description: 27-year-old professional DJ and MC based in Austin, Texas, known for rocking the city’s biggest nightclubs. With high-energy, crowd-driven sets and international DJ experience, he blends Latin hits, House, Latin House, reggaeton, and global club sounds. Don Esco has upcoming international performances in Colombia and continues to represent Austin’s Latin nightlife on a global stage.

events.title: OOZ
events.description:
OOZ is an experimental noise-rock band from Toronto, CA. ⁠
⁠
OOZ embodies immediacy & improvisation in their approach to playing and recording. ⁠Live shows are loud, physical and chaotic with sounds collapsing under pressure as the room turns into part of the set.

events.title: Smooth Nature
events.description: Smooth Nature is a new age R&B group mixing old school and new school sounds of the full spectrum of R&B. Mixing Rock, soul, funk, blues, and jazz, Smooth Nature is bringing back a familiar yet new sound, to push love, healing, and peace with each song

events.title: Tom A Smith
events.description: A 21 year old singer/songwriter/producer based in Sunderland, England.  Signed to Fiction Records and previously worked with Miles Kane and Hugo White (The Maccabees(

events.title: Whitelands
events.description: Originally inspired by a Slowdive KEXP session, London-based quartet Whitelands fuse their diverse musical backgrounds into an updated spin on shoegaze that amplifies marginalized voices and perspectives. Formed in the late 2010s as the solo project of Etienne Quartey-Papafio, Whitelands evolved into a full band ahead of their official debut album, Night-Bound Eyes Are Blind to the Day (2024), released during a U.K. tour with Slowdive. The project takes its name from a campus at London’s Roehampton University, where Quartey-Papafio first performed live. Their self-titled 2018 debut, a lo-fi blend of jagged indie rock and hazy grunge textures, hinted at the immersive sound they would later embrace. A turning point came when Quartey-Papafio stumbled upon Slowdive’s 2017 KEXP performance, igniting a deeper fixation on shoegaze. The current lineup consists of Jagun Meseorisa, Vanessa Govinden, and Michael Adelaja who bonded through shared experiences of neurodivergence and racial identity. Whitelands’ forthcoming album, Sunlight Echoes (out January 30, 2026), expands their sound, moving beyond shoegaze’s shadows toward something bigger, brighter, and unmistakably their own.
events.venue: British Music Embassy @ Palm Door on Sixth

events.title: The Animeros
events.description:
With musical notes that span well beyond genres like bolero, psychedelic, and cumbia, The Animeros not only make their audience hit the dance floor, but they also invite their listeners and tastemakers alike to a glimpse of their rich cultural upbringing.  

The group who is made up of Nick Tozzo (drummer and percussionist), Nicolas Sanchez (bassist), and Mauro Lopez (guitarist) craft a genre-blending sound that drifts between the lush jungles of Colombia, the palm-lined streets of 1960s coastal Mexico, and the dusty cantinas of West Texas.

Their journey took an unexpected turn when their music reached the ears of Dan Auerbach, (The Black Keys). Auerbach first heard them by chance, music floating from an open hotel window that stopped him in his tracks. They are now signed to Auerbach’s Easy Eye Sound label.  

“I feel like it's only a matter of time for these guys and for the music that they play. All they have to do is be themselves,” Auerbach said. “They're playing the kind of music that they can play forever until they're 100 years old because it's rooted in history, but it's very much in the present.”

events.title: BigXthaPlug
events.venue: Austin City Limits Live at the Moody Theater

events.title: 2charm
events.description:
2charm☆ blends indie house heaven pop techno dubstep baile to make magic ☆
Sticky and playful vocal hooks abound, pairing beatific production with beautiful vocal melodies, delivering something that’s equal parts ecstasy and transcendence. 2charm’s music could be likened to the sparkle that bounces off sheened cheeks under dingy club lights, in the same way the Balearic sea shines in July ☆

events.title: Amie Blu
events.description: “Rich with honesty and unbridled emotion” (Rolling Stone UK), Amie Blu feels perfectly at home in a new wave of alternative artists - Mk.gee, Dijon, SZA - whose casual handle on genre nonetheless feels completely rooted in classic, crafted songwriting. Born of French heritage in South East London, Amie cut her teeth in community projects growing up - ArtsTrain, Flames Collective – whilst developing her sound, and sense of self, across 2024 mixtape how we lose. Introspective but frank, songs like ‘everything about her’ showed a poetic brand of realism - and soulful, stop-you-in-your-tracks voice - way beyond Amie Blu’s years. Since then, Amie has opened for Joy Crookes, Jacob Banks, Faye Webster and sold-out her own headline dates as she builds up to 2025's debut album, when all is said and done. Featuring acclaimed singles like 'swimming in pity', 'shadow', and 'missing everything', it's a record drenched in feeling; startling explorations of love, loss, depression and human connection, but ultimately about the relationship with the self. Far from an exploration of endings, when all is said and done is the start of something truly special from Amie Blu.

events.title: ANJA SCHNEIDER
events.description:
Anja Schneider is a DJ, producer, radio broadcaster, label boss, tireless creative force and mentor. She was recognised in 2021 with the award of an Honour Prize by The Berlin Music Commission for having had “an outstanding impact on the music scene” as recognition for her work supporting fellow artists and cultural institutions.

Anja continues to operate as one of electronic music’s most vital artists, currently focused on multiple projects. Including her 20th anniversary as a professional DJ and producer featuring an array of internationally recognized artists and worldwide gigs. Her 'Club Room' radio show that just crossed the mark of over 300 episodes, the freshly launched 'The Story / Loveparade' podcast  that gained remarkable recognition in the scene and last but not least a new, monthly party series 'PuMp' at Tresor’s little sibling OHM.

events.title: Boutique Feelings
events.description: Dusted with elements of psychedelia, compounded by ethereal sonic landscapes, and catapulted by melodic rhyme schemes, Boutique Feelings (Montréal, CA) invites reflection on socio-political norms while offering an alternative take on hip-hop. Subverting traditional compositional techniques, this new project from Karim Lakhdar—known as the singer, guitarist, and keyboardist for progressive psych rock collective, Atsuko Chiba—explores themes of cultural and personal identity through vivid offbeat storytelling and catchy distortion-mangled hooks, resulting in music that toes the line between rap, psychedelic funk, trip-hop, krautrock, as well as sample-based and electroacoustic music.

events.title: Kids
events.description:
Kids is an art punk project focused on writing the most subversive music possible within tight limitations. Their sound is characterized by a lack of effects pedals, idiosyncratic arrangements and song forms, and an irreverent high energy that contrasts with their relatively minimal sound. The crown jewel of Kids is in the double vocals: All of their music relies on meticulous interplay between Venezuelan guitarist Julio Prato and bass player Ani Kramer on the vocal front, reimagining the idea of a song as more of a conversation between lead vocalists rather than the highlight of just one. All this is laid atop a flurry of cutting edge guitar work, grounding bass lines, and the one-of-a-kind surgical manner of drumming Colin Ferguson always brings to the table. 

Their debut full length album REPETITIOM VARIATIOM released in the summer of 2024 is their most ambitious release to date, relying on disorientation,  indulgently varying repetition, evocative imagery, and their signature sound palette to conceive music that feels familiar, humorous and encouraging, yet pronouncedly uncanny.

events.title: SXSW Comedy Presents
events.description: Catch the best of the fest on one stage. SXSW Comedy brings you a curated powerhouse lineup featuring iconic voices and the must-see breakout performers you’ll be bragging about discovering first. Lineup coming soon!

events.title: TTSSFU
events.description: TTSSFU – aka Tasmin Nicole Stephens – quickly went from being a mere fixture in Manchester’s indie scene to one of its fastest-rising stars, now poised to break out well beyond it. Known for conjuring vast, atmospheric worlds from her bedroom using just Garageband, she watched as early releases like her Warhol-inspired 2024 EP “Me, Jed and Andy” picked up steam. Since then, she’s traded bedrooms for stages supporting Kim Deal, English Teacher, Soccer Mommy and Mannequin Pussy, plus sold out headlines across the UK and packed festival sets from Green Man to the Great Escape.
events.venue: British Music Embassy @ Palm Door on Sixth Patio

events.title: Kaash Paige
events.description:
Kaash Paige (born D’Kyla Paige Woolen on January 8, 2001, in Dallas, Texas) is a singer and songwriter known for her smooth blend of R&B, EDM , Alternative, Pop and hip-hop. She began uploading songs to SoundCloud while in high school, breaking out with her viral hit “Love Songs” in 2018. That success led to her first album Parked Car Convos (2019) followed up by Teenage Fever (2020), both filled with dreamy, emotional storytelling!

Kaash continued to evolve with her 2022 project S2ML showcasing deeper songwriting and more confidence in her sound. By 2024 , she began moving independently, focused on creative freedom and ownership.

In 2025, Kaash Paige Dropped a Trap Mixtape Titled “KAASHMYCHECKS” & A R&B/HIP HOP PROJECT Titled “2 Late To Be Toxic”. she has leveled up globally Going on her China Tour summer of 2025. headlining her second U.S. Tour “ Better than revenge “ & performing in Brazil at the Cena Festival in November 2025 .  

marking a new chapter in her career as an international artist. From SoundCloud uploads in Dallas to world stages across continents, Kaash Paige continues to prove why she’s one of the most refreshing and visionary voices in the world.

events.title: The Kellows
events.description:
"Your future headliners of tomorrow" - Jess Iszatt RADIO 1
"That is the way to do it." — John Kennedy, RADIO X


Sheffield’s most exciting alt-indie export

Following the meteoric rise of their previous release ‘Breathe Me In’—and the industry-shaking buzz of their breakthrough ‘Do You Want Me To?’—the Steel City four-piece are no longer just "ones to watch." Having already secured the backing of tastemakers like Steve Lamacq (BBC Radio 6 Music), John Kennedy (Radio X), and BBC Radio 1, The Kellows are entering 2026 with the momentum of a band destined for the main stage.

Recording in Sheffield with legendary producer Alan Smyth (the man behind the desk for the Arctic Monkeys' seminal early tracks). That iconic Sheffield DNA is woven into the fabric of the single, capturing the raw, electric energy that has become the band's hallmark.

Led by the formidable 17-year-old lineup of Will Harris (Vocals/Guitar), Evan Applegate (Guitar/Vocals), Charlie May (Bass), and Rueben Huddleston (Drums),

events.title: Spoon Benders
events.description:
Spoon Benders is a three-piece punk rock band from Portland, Oregon, delivering raw volume, sharp hooks, and nonstop momentum. Stripped down and loud, the band thrives on a high-energy live show that feels just barely contained—fast, sweaty, and direct, with nothing wasted.
Built on constant movement, Spoon Benders have spent years touring relentlessly, honing their sound on stages across the country and earning a reputation as a band that hits hard and never phones it in. Their music channels punk’s urgency and grit, powered by tight chemistry and an aggressive edge that only a three-piece can deliver.
Now, Spoon Benders are preparing to release their highly anticipated third album, capturing the intensity of the road and the confidence of a band fully in its stride. With new songs on the way and the volume turned up, Spoon Benders continue to prove that three people are more than enough to make some serious noise.

events.title: Cashier
events.description: On their debut EP ‘The Weight,’ the Lafayette, Louisiana, four-piece reaches full definition, distilling themes of desire, insecurity, and disconnection into five tightly wound, melody-driven songs released by Julia’s War Recordings, the legendary Philly label founded by Doug Dulgarian of TAGABOW. Across the EP, bandleader Kylie Gaspard’s deeply direct vocal delivery cuts through dense riffs, grounding their songs with her gritty, emotional lyrics. Having recently shared stages with genre titans like Dinosaur Jr., Whirr, Nothing, and Narrow Head, Cashier are building a reputation for a massive sound that resonates far beyond their bayou home.

events.title: Spike Fuck
events.description:
Spike F*ck is a rare figure in contemporary music: direct, disarming, and impossible to pin down. Emerging from Melbourne’s underground in the late 2010s with The Smackwave EP, Spike fused bleak synth-pop, post-punk melodrama, and brutally honest songwriting into something both vulnerable and confrontational. Armed with only a backing track and a microphone, early live shows saw Spike sing candidly about addiction, gender, dysfunctional love, and collapse: a kind of wounded sincerity that quickly drew a cult following. Just as things seemed to be breaking open, Spike disappeared, retreating from public life amid a personal reckoning.

After a four-year hiatus -- during which time rumours swirled about death, institutions, or becoming a monk -- Spike returned sober, clear-eyed, and transformed. The music that followed is bigger, wilder, and more alive. Performed with a rotating full band, the new material draws from ‘70s glam, spiritual soul, and damaged rock and roll, but always filtered through Spike’s unmistakable voice: bruised, intense, poetic.

These are songs about recovery, identity, survival, and letting go not sanitised, not triumphant, but real. Where the early work stared into the void, the new work steps forward with purpose. It’s not a reinvention. It’s an evolution, one born from chaos, now grounded in clarity.

events.title: congratulations
events.description:
congratulations are a hall of mirrors party troop. they are devils and tarts in equal measure. they lock their horns and then spin round and round and round until dizzy cacophony erupts. sugarcane hooks vs. slaughterhouse screams. taut, fizzing guitars & caustic electronics nipping at the heels of huge fuzz bass & booming percussive grooves. leah is the green one. jamie is dressed in blue. greg’s red, james is yellow. they’re here to move you.

Bursting onto the scene with a kinetic new sound, congratulations have quickly garnered a reputation for their raw energy, tight instrumentation and electrifying live performances. With punchy melodies and infectious hooks, congratulations deliver a mix of anthemic and experimental sounds fusing art-rock, garage, synth-pop and post-punk. The band’s lyrics explore themes of modern life, love, and self-discovery, delivered with a compelling honesty and emotion. congratulations’ fresh take on familiar sounds has earned them critical acclaim and a devoted and rapidly-growing fanbase, positioning them as one of the UK’s most exciting up-and-coming acts.

Signed to Bella Union records, with the bands debut album "Join Hands" due for release on February 13th. 

Having gained support previously from BBC Radio 1 and BBC 6Music including a live session for 6Music for Marc Riley.  Previous supporters of congratulations include Iggy Pop, Craig Charles, Nick Grimshaw, Chris Hawkins and Jess Izzatt.

events.title: Hot Garbage
