events.description: Hot Garbage melt into a heavily volatile yet undeniably palatable amalgamation of sonic elements. Calling on the driving rhythms of dark post-punk and motorik krautrock, the Toronto-based outfit seamlessly works shining melodies and swirling textures into deliberate, brooding arrangements. Since forming in 2015, the four-piece have toured extensively throughout Canada, the United States, Europe and the United Kingdom, bringing their intense live sets to festivals such as Levitation, Freakout Fest, Treefort, SXSW, Sled Island, FME, M for Montreal and Pop Montreal, and sharing the stage with notable acts such as Osees, Ty Segall, L.A. Witch, Frankie and the Witch Fingers, JJUUJJUU, Mdou Moctar, Wand and Kikagaku Moyo. The quartet recently returned with Precious Dream (January 19, 2024 via Mothland & Exag’ Records), a sprawling collection of songs written in isolation and brought together alongside visionary producer Graham Walsh (METZ, Preoccupations, Holy Fuck, !!!), offering an exhilarating new breath into the world of post-punk and modern psychedelia, a listening experience that is equally cathartic and introspective.

events.title: Nug
events.description: Nug is a musical group made up of four friends in Portland, OR. Blending and bending the genres of Post Punk, Indie Rock, Shoegaze, Nu-metal, Psych Rock, and probably some other things, Nug has been described we-think-affectionately as “Parquet Courts meets Grateful Dead” and “a jam band for people who hate jam bands” and “really friendly guys making loud music”. Nug’s debut record “Kerfuffle” released in February of 2025 and remains released to this very day.

events.title: YES AND MAYBE
events.description:
Born amidst the cultural vibrancy of Glasgow and Paris, YES AND MAYBE is an electrifying two-piece band that pushes the boundaries of contemporary music. 
 
The first band member, a multi-instrumentalist and writer, excels in crafting minimalist guitar-based melodies, demonstrating a perfect blend of ingenuity and precision. His obsessive self-criticism and penchant for perfection have allowed him to transform his influences into his own unique sound.
 
The second member, a performer, writer, and producer, brings his experiences and emotions to life through introspective lyrics paired with evocative, ethereal vocals. His artistry lies in balancing deeply metaphorical, grounded lyrics with melodies that evoke a sense of escapism. This potent mix of realism and fantasy forms an integral part of YES AND MAYBE's distinctive sound.
​
Their songwriting process, both organic and instinctive, evolves from a simple phrase or a recorded sound into a comprehensive musical piece within a day. Their songs encapsulate their raw emotions, serving as a beacon of authenticity in an industry often mired in overproduction.
 
YES AND MAYBE, though relatively new, brings a refreshing spontaneity and a shared vision to redefine the musical landscape. Their commitment to creating music that resonates with their listeners' shared experiences makes them a band worth investing in. Keep an eye on this Glasgow based duo—they're a unique proposition with a future as innovative as their sound.
events.venue: British Music Embassy @ Palm Door on Sixth Patio

events.title: EL DUSTY
events.description: EL DUSTY is a Latin Grammy–nominated DJ and producer from Corpus Christi, Texas, known for blending cumbia roots with modern club sounds like house, hip-hop, and global bass. Through his productions, performances, and events, he bridges Latin culture with contemporary dance floors worldwide while building community through music, parties, and collaborations that push cumbia into the future.

events.title: Andrew Cushin
events.description:
Firmly established as an artist’s artist with the likes of Noel Gallagher, Sam Fender, Louis Tomlinson and Pete Doherty.
Andrew Cushin is primed to rise to the next level with the May 2nd release of his second album ‘Love
Is For Everyone’. Building upon his acclaimed debut ‘Waiting For The Rain’. The 2nd album charted in the UK official top 40 album charts.
 Andrew recently teamed up with his local brewery Anarchy Brew Co to create his own L.I.F.E IPA beer,
which is now available from their website. It represents his latest brand collaboration after being invited to headline
The Soundcheck, the debut live event from the Aston Martin Aramco Formula One team, late last year. Andrew has played Italian, Dutch and British GP with Aston Martin F1 team in 2025.
Andrew toured the full UK headline in May and October 2025 as well as EU . He is currently on his 3rd successive year of touring North American/Canada headline tour.
In October 25th 2025 Andrew Cushin sold out his hometown show at Newcastle City Hall in front of 2500 fans.
2025 has been a huge success for Andrew Cushin breaking through the top 40 and now firmly establishing himself as a firm favourite in the UK live scene.

events.title: bloodsports
events.description:
Taking over the sweaty New York venues and curbside congregations that came to be
synonymous with the name, Bloodsports is set to release their long awaited debut LP Anything
Can Be A Hammer via brand new New York label Good English Records on October 17th.
Bloodsports has become an undeniable force amidst their latest line up, where members Sam
Murphy (guitar/vox), Jeremy Mock (Guitar), Liv Eriksen (bass/vox) and Scott Hale (drums) find
solace in the capitulation of sonic strain; where angular sedition blends with economical
melodies that lighten the load of the self-destruction that these songs embrace. But as bold as
their landscapes have been prior, Anything Can Be A Hammer finds the band embracing a more
dynamic approach, maturing in their techniques as these songs brim over with subtle fixations –
balancing a steady pace of experimentation and curiosity that linger amongst the rhythmic blows
and befuddling depths that the band confidently explores. Fragile, yet abundant, Bloodsports
leans into that patience that plays to our own interior designs, where Murphy’s lyricism is a
notion of both what we know and what we think we know, as it all comes to the fore when our
obsessions are at large. It’s an album that’s got blood in its veins and a finger on the pulse.

events.title: BALACLAVA
events.description:
BIRTHED FROM NYC WASTE WATER AND SOAKED IN FORMALDEHYDE, BALACLAVA ANSWERS THE LIFE LONG QUESTION OF WHAT ANIMATED TRASH WOULD SOUND LIKE.

BALACLAVA INVITES YOU INTO THE FRAY, WASTES NO TIME, HANDS YOU A DRINK, AND DELIVERS WHAT YOU'VE BEEN MISSING. THE DISTRACTION YOU NEEDED. THE ANTIDOTE TO THE BUMMER. BALACLAVA IS SCUZZED UP, BEER SOAKED, SYNTH SWIRLING, NECK TWISTING, MUSLCE MOVING, GAIN CRANKED, SUGARY SWEET PUNK TUNES THAT LEAVE YOU WITH EAR WORMS THAT BORROW FOR DAYS TO COME. OVER THE PAST FEW YEARS BALA HAVE BEEN CUTTING THEIR TEETH ON JUST ABOUT EVERY DIRTY NYC VENUE FLOOR, LEAVING THOSE WHO ATTEND A SHOW SWEATY, HAPPY, AND HOOKED. FOR LOVERS OF LOUD GUITARS, DELAY SOAKED VOCALS, CRUNCHED UP BASS, OR THE HEAT THAT LINGERS IN THE ROOM ONCE THE SHOW HAS ENDED, LOOK NO FURTHER. SO POUR ANOTHER, PET A DOG, KISS YOUR HOMIES, GRAB A LOVER, PICK UP YOUR FEET AND ENJOY. BALACLAVA LOVES YOU.

events.title: Frankfurt Helmet
events.description:
Rising rapidly within the global indie scene, Frankfurt Helmet has emerged as a definitive voice in Chinese independent electronic music. As one 
of China’s most innovative trans-media projects, the duo—comprising acclaimed drummer Romna and sound artist Yufei—merges their diverse 
backgrounds to push the boundaries of electronic soundscapes.
Their sonic identity is defined by a striking contrast: the ethereal, atmospheric depths of modular synthesis layered over cold, precision
engineered mechanical rhythms. Having graced the stages of major international festivals and art exhibitions, Frankfurt Helmet continues to 
redefine the intersection of live performance and sound art on a global scale.

events.title: Unsafe Space Garden
events.description:
Unsafe Space Garden is a genre-bending outfit from Portugal known for their chaotic, theatrical and deeply immersive live shows. With a sound rooted in neo-psychedelia, experimental rock and a touch of surreal humour, the band pushes musical boundaries with fearless creativity and a clear artistic vision.

Described by European press as “a surrealist orchestra,” their concerts often blur the line between performance and ritual - unpredictable, cathartic and strangely uplifting. Their critically acclaimed albums Bro, You Got Something In Your Eye – A Guided Meditation (2021) and Where’s The Ground? (2023) draw comparisons to artists like Frank Zappa, Captain Beefheart or The Flaming Lips, while forging a language uniquely their own.

More than just experimentalists, Unsafe Space Garden are storytellers - unpredictable, emotional and sonically adventurous. A live act designed to be seen, heard, and remembered.

events.title: EDDY
events.description:
E D D Y began her music career during the pandemic, teaching herself how to DJ while in lockdown in Sacramento. What started as practicing mixes at home quickly evolved into a fast-rising career, leading her to share stages with some of her musical idols, including Akon, RUSS, Don Toliver, Diplo, Chase B, and AG Club. She has performed at major events such as Sol Blume and Concert in the Park.

She has completed two independent DJ tours across the United States, as well as an international European tour alongside artist LEW, establishing herself as a dynamic live performer with global reach.

Now based in Los Angeles, E D D Y continues to expand her artistic identity. In addition to DJing, she creates original music rooted in alternative pop with influences from Alt-R&B and Afrobeats. Her sound is emotive and genre-blending, shaped by her experiences, growth, and journey through life and love.

Beyond music, E D D Y is the founder of PLUSH, a creative collective and event platform that has grown from a local party series into a multi-city brand curating immersive, high-energy experiences and spotlighting emerging talent.

events.title: Victoryland
events.description:
Victoryland is the Brooklyn-based project of musician Julian McCamman. His label-debut, My Heart Is A Room With No Cameras In It, out January 23, 2026 via Good English, is a triumphant, despondent, and ultimately fun experimental pop-rock album. Victoryland started in Philly 2023 with the release of tape, Sprain, which echoed more of what the Philly scene was dishing out: lo-fi, tape-recorded rock with a capital R. It was the collaborative efforts of producer Dan Howard that brought the new vision and sound into full focus.Dan and Julian previously worked on Julian’s now-defunct Texas-to-Philly based band, Blood’s Loving You Backwards LP, a collaborative effort between six bandmates. That experience pushed Julian toward a more personal process of recording, starting with home demos and then bringing them to Dan to shape into songs. This relationship ultimately led Julian to move to NYC.

The sound of the album, recorded between Julian’s Bed Stuy basement and Dan’s Williamsburg studio, is the sound of a bright and beaming collaboration. Landing somewhere between lo-fi and hi-fi production, the songs have the glossiness of a radio-friendly hit mixed with the distortion and rough edges of a home demo. Every song keeps at least one element of the initial recording, while building around the loops and half-songs Julian scrapped together. The lyrics on the record span from humorous self-aware popisms (“‘you and I’ will soon be, used to be ‘us’”) to crushing realities of bitterness(“i’ll never forgive you, that’s how I keep you close”) to abstract imagery (“mothers wave from doorways, in ostinato”), all delivered with such an immediacy and fervor that in the middle of singing along, you wonder if this guy slept much last night. 

My Heart wrangles with heavy subject matter (love, disconnection, sexual frustration, emptiness etc.), but the terminal statement of the record is about the cleansing nature of pop music. That, if a song can force you to “bliss out” over a hook or a loop, or even make you dance, it can be the spoonful of sugar to swallow the hard pill with; this is what Victoryland strives to do: package the most exhausting realities of life, love, and the search for connection in a world starved of it, into a fun 2-5 minutes, and for the runtime of Victoryland’s first major statement, you might even feel like you’re not alone.

events.title: DannyRitmo
events.description:
Danny Ritmo: The High-Energy Pulse of the Stage
With over 15 years of experience behind the decks and on the mic, Danny Ritmo has solidified his reputation as Austin’s finest DJ and MC. Known for an electrifying stage presence that blurs the line between performer and crowd leader, Danny doesn't just play music—he creates an atmosphere.
Career Highlights
Danny has brought his signature high-energy sets to some of the industry's most prestigious stages, including:
• SXSW Festival: Commanding the iconic Billboard Stage.
• Rumbazo Fest: Taking the heat to the Las Vegas strip.
• Artist Support: Trusted to set the tone for high-profile Latin artists, seamlessly blending global rhythms with modern club energy.
Whether he’s navigating a massive festival crowd or an intimate high-stakes event, Danny Ritmo’s veteran instincts and bilingual charisma make him a powerhouse in the Latin music scene and beyond.

events.title: Alex Irish
events.description:
Alex Irish is a Texas-born artist redefining modern hip-hop through a genre-blurring sound that weaves rap, rock, pop, and Latin influences into something unmistakably her own. Rooted in Dallas, her music balances emotional depth with bold production, pairing lived experience with sharp musical instincts.
After surviving a life-altering shooting in 2021, Alex turned adversity into creative momentum, channeling resilience into her art rather than retreating from it. Her latest EP "From Dallas, With Love" debuted to strong momentum, earning over 50,000 streams in its first week and charting on the iTunes Hip-Hop charts. The project also received a nomination for EP of the Year at the Dallas Entertainment Awards.
Known for commanding performances and cinematic songwriting, Alex continues to carve out her own lane. With new music on the way, she represents a new chapter of Dallas hip-hop that is fearless, versatile, and unmistakably global.

events.title: Alina Pash
events.description:
Alina Pash is a Ukrainian artist now based in Los Angeles, building a bold new live experience in the U.S.—a mystic rap-based opera that fuses deep-root Ukrainian ritual, ethnic vocal power, and modern bass/electronic production. Her performances feel like ceremony: cinematic, high-voltage, and emotionally precise—where folklore meets the club, and tradition becomes future music.

Back home, Alina built a major name fast: she performed on Kyiv’s main square for Independence Day in front of President Volodymyr Zelensky, and later that same night headlined the country’s biggest rave, Brave! Factory—proof of her rare ability to command both national stages and underground culture. She’s shared bills with top international acts, earned wide media attention, and continues to push Ukrainian sound into global pop and bass ecosystems.

In March she drops a deluxe release with 15 remix features—largely U.S. collaborators—bridging her world into American scenes. Now, she’s developing a new album and an expanded 2026–2027 performance program—built for discovery rooms and tastemaker festivals in the U.S. and beyond.

events.title: Alkyone
events.description:
Alkyone is a Greek singer-songwriter hailing from the mountains of northern Greece. Born and raised in a small town surrounded by rivers and forests, she began her musical journey at the age of six, training as a classical pianist, before embracing songwriting as her true path.
Influenced by her father’s deep love for folk music, Alkyone began experimenting with traditional songs and textures, weaving a distinct folklore thread into her musical identity. Her sound blends indie songwriting, cinematic atmospheres, and folk elements from the Mediterranean and the Balkans. Singing in both English and Greek, her lyrics explore memory, growing up, and our evolving relationship with the world, while her concerts carry an intimate, personal, and emotionally charged atmosphere.
She has performed across Europe (Konzerthaus, Tonhalle, Carré, SNF, Onassis Foundation and others). In 2023, she collaborated with Vincent Moon and was featured on La Blogothèque. Her critically acclaimed debut album Exit Sign was released in 2023, while her second studio album, Small Philosophies, is expected in late spring 2026.
Her stage name, Alkyone, is a tribute to a recurring dream in which she was a bird.

events.title: Avanti Patel
events.description:
Avanti Patel is a multi genre Musician based out of Mumbai- A hindustani classical vocalist, playback singer, theatre maker & composer. 
She started learning Hindustani Classical Vocals at age 5 and is currently training with Padmashri Vidushi Ashwini Bhide Deshpande of the Jaipur Atrauli Gharana.

Among her most recent projects is O Gaanewali, a theatre-concert-piece based on the lives and music of the Courtesans, Tawaifs and Women performers in India. O Gaanewali has been widely performed, with over 75 live shows across several Indian cities and festivals like Jashn-e-Rekhta, Magnetic Fields in Rajasthan, Serendipity Arts Festival in Goa,  and legacy venues like The Royal Opera House and Prithvi Theatre in Mumbai.

Avanti is currently producing her 2nd EP titled 'O Gaanewali Session 2', after the success of her debut EP released last year, titled ‘O Gaanewali Session 1’. Both EPs include the genres of Thumri, Dadra, Ghazal with a classic ‘old world meets contemporary’ style of production, available on all music streaming platforms and on Youtube.

events.title: Azamiah
events.description:
Primed to be the next group from the UK jazz underground to break out, Azamiah draw on 
jazz roots while touching on everything from James Blake’s production techniques to dubby 
low-end, taking the listener on a journey across moody and light landscapes.  Their 2023 
debut album ‘In Phases’ won praise from The Skinny and CLASH and received plays on BBC 
6Music and NTS.  A bridge between first album, and second, their recent EP ‘Two Lands’ 
released in May 2025 resonates with emotional honesty and is played with a fresh intensity. 
The band has played on stages across the UK and Europe including Latitude Festival, Jazz on Wick, Hidden Door, Edinburgh Jazz and Blues Festival, Brick Lane Jazz Festival, JAZZMI (IT) & North Sea Round Town (NL). Having recently completed their first UK headline tour in October 2025 to electric audiences in Glasgow, London, Bristol, Manchester, Leeds and Brighton and flooded with requests for a re-press of 'In Phases', a dedicated fanbase is making themselves known.

events.title: Bijaan
events.description: “Whether I’m welcome or not” raps Bijaan on the opening bar of his debut single, “Jungle”, a line that immediately sets the tone for an artist unafraid to claim his space. Bijaan is a Calgary-based MC whose artistry bridges contents and cultures and has already captured the attention of major DSPs, key industry festivals, and fellow hip-hop artists and producers. Canadian born, with roots in East Africa and India, he brings a distinctly global perspective to hip-hop. Produced by the Polaris Prize-nominated hip-hop heavyweight Producer, Junia-T, “Jungle” is a bold exploration of identity, unapologetic self-belief, and belonging, anchored by Bijaan’s sharp lyricism and a unique, commanding delivery. From releasing mixtapes in high school, all the way to performing at major Canadian festivals and showcases such as NXNE, The JUNOs, Sled Island, Do It For The Culture, and Aurorapalooza, Bijaan has carved out his place as a rising voice in Canada’s hip-hop scene. Blending introspection with bravado, while taking inspiration from his varied cultural roots, he stands at the forefront of a new generation of artists redefining what it means to be global in hip-hop.

events.title: Blair Davie
events.description:
Blair Davie is a singer-songwriter from Perth, Scotland.  Inspired by their love of emotional, heartfelt music from artists such as Dodie, 
Dermot Kennedy and Bon Iver, Blair’s music is their way of presenting the most honest and passionate version of themself to the world. 
Their music deals with coming to terms with their own bisexuality, loss and heartbreak; but also, the beauty that life can offer.

events.title: Casie Farrell
events.description:
DJ Casie Farrell is a rising force in the Texas electronic music scene, known for her high-energy tech house, techno, and house sets. A Houston native with deep musical roots, Casie turned her lifelong passion for rhythm and movement into a DJ career after graduating from The DJ School Dallas in 2020.

Since then, she has performed across Texas and beyond, developing a sound that blends funky tech house, hypnotic and peak-time techno, and innovative looping. She has shared lineups with artists such as Gettoblaster, Oostil, Mija, Mike Dunn, Bruno Furlan, Offaiah, Shay de Castro, and DJ Swisha. Her performance credits include the opening party at Meow Wolf, Bauhaus Houston, Breakaway Festival, and headlining the iconic It’ll Do Club in Dallas.

Casie has also brought her sound to New York City, Oklahoma, Burning Man, where she closed for The Crystal Method, and internationally to Amsterdam during ADE 2024. In 2025, she was selected to perform at Seismic Dance Event 8.0, where she was featured in EDMTunes as one of Dallas’s breakout electronic artists.

events.title: Devy Stonez
events.description:
Devy Stonez is a Louisiana-born, Dallas-based rapper whose music blends Southern rap perspective with melodic nuance and lyrical confidence. Over the past five years, he has quietly built a reputation as an artist who understands pace—favoring cohesion, replay value and presence over excess.

His most recent releases, including I LUV STONEY and Tuff, connected with audiences through soulful delivery and genre experimentation. Influenced by artists like The Notorious B.I.G., Dom Kennedy, and Curren$y, Devy pairs sharp writing with a smooth, homegrown flow that feels grounded and balanced.

With millions of streams, awards, charting releases, and a growing international audience, Devy has established real momentum as an independent artist. Now he enters a new era defined by balance, intention, and growth. His upcoming music reflects an artist moving with patience and clarity—becoming who he always knew he was meant to be, in his own time. New releases are rolling out now, with a forthcoming studio album set to mark his most focused and evolved chapter yet.

events.title: DJ 4:12
events.description:
From Greenwood, South Carolina, to Atlanta, Georgia, Debaron Hughes has always loved the art of music—the space it creates, the way it invites people in. What started out as just a passion growing up in a quaint little mom-and-pop town suddenly turned into a lifestyle in 2013: “Debaron Hughes” became DJ4:12. 

He’s come a long way since he moved to the city where the players play, finding his own groove, specializing in creating inimitable moments and experiences through his fingertips on a turntable. 

Over the past few years, he’s had the incredible opportunity to DJ for multiple artists, such as Lecrae in his “I’m Turnt” music video, Montell Fish, NF, KB, Tedashii, Canon, and Trip Lee (just to name a few).

He’s also been able to DJ at conferences like Destination Imagination, Catalyst, and Propel Women. When he’s not touring, he enjoys getting to DJ for Atlanta Track Club, America’s second-largest running club. 

His most recent endeavors have found him DJing for multiple Fortune 500 companies, including Walmart, Pfizer, and Kraft Heinz, to name a few.

events.title: DJ Dan
events.description: DJ Dan is a pioneering American house music DJ and producer, recognized as a key innovator of the "West Coast House" sound since the late 1980s. Known for blending funk, techno, and breakbeats, he rose to prominence in the90s rave scene, co-founded the Funky Tekno Tribe, and launched InStereo Recordings.

events.title: Don Glori
events.description:
Unpicking the thread that stitches together Don Glori’s music would be an impossible task. His records combine elements of Jazz, Funk, Soul, RnB and Samba, yet he doesn’t fit neatly into any of those genres. His live show is more jazz - punk - funk than anything. One thing is certain, there is an undeniable, joyful, spirit that permeates through his music.

Following on from the success of his 2024 album ‘Don’t Forget to Have Fun’, Don Glori is back with his third offering, this time on Mr. Bongo - ‘Paper Can’t Wrap Fire’.
“A kaleidoscopic genre-surfing odyssey that brings together the worlds of jazz, soul and funk. Feeling both contemporary and classic, familiar yet novel, it’s an assured third release that sees an artist in full flight, showcasing their creative prowess and the uniqueness of their musical voice.”

events.title: Ella Ion
events.description:
Emerging from Kaurna Land (Adelaide, Australia), fragmented-folk musician Ella Ion crafts music that cuts deep to the core. Drawing on influences of indie-rock, folk and country, her eloquent lyricism and masterful musical control delivers a cacophony of raw emotion, anchored by grit and heart. Ion has already amassed a loyal following across Australia, as well as listeners streaming her music across the UK, US, Europe and more. 

From intimate encounters of tender folk to electrifying post-rock arrangements, Ion flaunts her ability to transform a room of anyone and everyone into a fan. Ella Ion is holding nothing back as she barrels forward in a direction of raw sonic and personal exploration. Ion has supported Suki Waterhouse, Folk Bitch Trio, Jake Bugg, and Greg Mendez at shows across Australia, UK and Europe, as well as taking to the stage at The Great Escape Festival and Green Man Festival in the UK.

events.title: Emi Angeles
events.description: EMI ANGELES is a trap artist born in Mexico City and raised in Nuevo León, whose music emerges from a deep creative and spiritual duality. His name comes from the abbreviation of José Emiliano Angeles Aguado and his strong connection to the Catholic faith, a constant pillar within his identity. His project is built around two alter egos: CRVZ, which embodies madness, contained rage, and raw energy, and Ángeles, his more human, sensitive, and everyday side. Influenced by Detroit trap, hood trap, and artists such as Playboi Carti, Ye, and Abhir, EMI ANGELES delivers an authentic and daring sound designed to send chills through the body, shake emotions, and leave a lasting imprint on the listener. His first encounter with music came at an early age after discovering Michael Jackson, leading him from dance to songwriting and eventually to the microphone. Key moments such as his EP ALTER/EGO and the loss of his best friend marked a turning point in his journey, solidifying his artistic commitment. Today, EMI ANGELES transforms the unknown into experience, creating music that connects with what many are afraid to name, aiming to leave a lasting legacy within the Mexican trap scene.

events.title: Hania Derej
events.description:
Hania Derej (20) - composer, pianist, arranger and conductor. Student of the Conservatorium van Amsterdam (jazz composition and arrangement) and the Music Academy in Kraków (symphonic conducting). Author of over 130 compositions she creates music in a variety of styles, including illustrative, jazz, chamber, film or electronic music. She has won multiple composition and performance awards including the Grand Prix of Energa Ladies Jazz Festival in Gdynia, Main Prize in “Sanki” 2025, music contest of “Gazeta Wyborcza” newspaper (the new hope of the polish music scene), the Main Prize of the first “Jazz Talents” competition within the 21st edition of Jazz Spring Zakopane 2025, Triton Award for the greatest artistic personality of the 54 th edition of FAMA Festival 2024 in Świnoujście, a special award for compositions and arrangements at the Junior Jazz Festival 2023 in Wadowice, and the “Young Composer 2023” award funded by the Polish Composers’ Union in Warsaw during the International Piano Forum in Sanok. Within this Piano Forum, Hania also received piano awards, such as a distinction for the performance of a concert with the National Polish Philharmonic Chamber Orchestra and a concert with the Lviv Chamber Orchestra “Academy.” 
As a conductor, Hania has had the opportunity to lead concerts with the National Philharmonic Chamber Orchestra (Poland), Elblag Chamber Orchestra (Poland), Lviv Chamber Orchestra “Akademia” (Ukraine) and the Moravian Philharmonic Symphony Orchestra (Czech Republic), among others. Hania also participates in international music projects and conferences in Europe, such as European FAMES Orchestra (Macedonia), The Playground Residence (Germany, The Netherlands), International Sync Camp (Poland), International Jazz Platform (The Netherlands, Norway, Poland), Music Export Academy in Poland, Global Conservatory and Eastern European Music Export Academy (Ukraine), “Iceland Airways networking mission”, ESNS Showcase Festival & Conference networking mission (The Netherlands) and Jazzahead 2025 (Germany). Last but not least - in the JAZZTOP 2024 music critics’ survey of the international magazine JAZZFORUM, Hania Derej won the “New Hope” award for her solo work and came 5th in the “New Hope - Ensemble” category (for her work as Hania Derej Quintet). In April 2025, Hania was awarded a distinction in the nationwide “Young Promoter of Poland” Contest, under the Honorary Patronage of the Wife of the President of the Republic of Poland, for young Poles whose activities contribute to the popularization of knowledge about Poland and building a positive image of Poland in the world.

events.title: Hohnen Ford
events.description: Born and raised in North London, Hohnen Ford grew up immersed in London’s vibrant Jazz scene, becoming fixated on instrumental jazz music of the 20th Century and later studying Jazz at the Royal Academy of Music. Since graduating, Hohnen Ford has been developing a unique and timeless approach to songwriting drawing on influences from the Great American songbook to artists such as Joni Mitchell.

events.title: I-SKY
events.description:
I-SKY, West Malaysian based Producer-DJ - inspired by the likes
of Skrillex, Baauer, TNGHT and Boys Noize; started with shows that always promised a
tailored selection expanding from his favourite local/regional products to carefully curated underground dance finds from his internet digs, he since has established himself as a household name in the 2010s KL nightlife scene.

While DJ-ing has always been a conduit for his artistry, I-SKY delivers his crafted studio-to-stage experience best as both an artist and passionate producer. Known for his fresh-to-death remixes, I-SKY originals ride along the same wavelength too through his constant redefinitions of electronic dance.
Though the name doesn't have any literal meaning, the autodidactic disciplinary defines his namesake with, "I just needed
to find a catchy name... to find something that rhymes with my first initial, hence, the I... and SKY. Over the years, I guess the name gave meaning to itself. There's a saying: the sky is the limit. I've always hated being stuck in a box. I like to let my creativity run wild. To be free to experiment & dabble in different sounds & styles. So, l am the limit to what I can and wanna do."

events.title: ICHIGORINAHAMU
events.description:
rinahamu is a Tokyo-based artist, songwriter, composer, producer, and DJ.
Rooted in electronic music, she creates a distinctive world that seamlessly blends music, fashion, and culture.
In addition to her solo work, she is also active as a vocalist for BPM15Q and Tokyo Den-Nou, both projects from Den-On-Bu.

events.title: ISCREAM NEVER GROUND
events.description:
Japanese Super Loud Rock Band, Iscream Never Ground (commonly known as ING), was formed in 2017. 

Blending an intense loud rock foundation with diverse musical elements, ING crafts each song with a unique approach :sometimes incorporating digital sounds, other times featuring wind instruments. 

The electrifying synergy of stormy lyrics, fierce shouts, and the dynamic interplay of male and female triple vocals (Rango, Ziro~, and Miki) fuels a high-energy, danceable rhythm that never lets up, creating a sweat-drenched frenzy akin to a non-stop sports festival. 

Fusing metal, hardcore, punk, and game music influences, ING continues to ignite rock fans worldwide, both online and onstage.

events.title: Jade Omari
events.description: Jade Omari is an independent singer-songwriter from Hyattsville, Maryland known for her raw lyricism and soul-driven sound. She crafts songs rooted in emotional truth, growth, and resilience. Her live performances create a genuine connection—where storytelling and presence take center stage!

events.title: JAKEGATEWOOD
events.description:
JAKE GATEWOOD is a Texas-based DJ, producer, creative director, and curator whose disco- and house-driven sound has become a staple on dance floors across the U.S. Known for groove-forward, high-energy sets, his work is built for packed rooms and long nights.

As an artist and curator, Jake has performed alongside and collaborated with acts including Yung Bae, Never Dull, Coco & Breezy, Lee Foss, Marshall Jefferson, Joshwa & more, earning a reputation for versatility behind the decks and a sharp ear for forward-thinking dance music.

In 2022, he founded Take A Break, a house-music label, event series, and festival platform that has quickly become a cornerstone of the Southern dance-music scene. After selling out 20 consecutive shows and moving over 20K tickets, Take A Break has grown into a multi-scale brand supporting both emerging and established artists.

Jake also maintains an ongoing partnership with Apple Music, curating DJ mixes and editorial content that bring his taste and perspective to a global audience. Beyond music, he is the creative force behind BOOGIES, a Dallas-based discotheque rooted in classic dance-floor culture with a modern edge.

events.title: Kenzzo
events.description:
Kenzzo is an artist from Monterrey, Nuevo León. With just 21 years and an EP released this 2025, it has already positioned itself as one of the new promises of pop in Mexico.
His proposal, which he calls inorganic pop, seeks to expand musicals horizons with fresh sounds that start from the mixture of the warmth of the grand piano and experimentation with digital synthesis.

events.title: La Texana
events.description: La Texana, the music project of José Ramírez, was born in 2021 in Tijuana, Baja California. At 17, with just a laptop and guitar, he began recording music inspired by Spanish alternative rock and post-punk influences. He debuted with Nunca He Sabido Amar, and in 2023 released his first EP, Morro, featuring Un Día Como Hoy, now with over 6.5 million streams. In 2025, La Texana released his first full-length album, signed by the spanish label Sonido Muchacho "La Casa Que Cae", a 10-track record exploring identity and new beginnings, reaching over 8 million streams. It includes standout tracks like Terco, El Sol, and Dispara. In May, he performed a sold-out debut at Lunario of Auditorio Nacional and is now touring across Mexico (40+ cities) and 7 countries, with more dates to come. La Texana is currently preparing for his biggest show yet at Teatro Metropólitan in February 2026. His style continues to evolve, blending vulnerability and nostalgia, while connecting with a new generation of Mexican musicians and growing an international audience.

events.title: Lil Asian Thiccie
events.description:
Powered on infectious hooks and eclectic (even, erratic) genre switch ups, Lil Asian Thiccie; Kuala Lumpur-based singer-rapper-songwriter-overall-Dope-Person, has earned a spot in the forefront of the Malaysian urban music scene.

With a growing catalogue teasing trap, pop, and everything electronica in between; her tongue-in-cheek lyrics and barefaced delivery marks a distinct sonic purrrson-uh!
Having established herself as a one-of-one female hip hop starlet in 2018 to her pop-empowered revolution in 2021, Lil Asian Thiccie finds her balance between eras towards defining a trademark Gen-Lil Asian Thiccie sound.

events.title: Little Guilt
events.description:
Delivered from the West coast of Australia, Little Guilt arrive as a cocktail of honeyed vocals, hypnotic synths and wistful lyricism brought forth with driving guitars. Since their formation in early 2021, the indie outfit have unwittingly captured the hearts of music lovers in both the digital realm and on stage through sold-out venues around Australia.

Since their debut, Little Guilt have supported Los Bitchos, Great Gable, Telenova, Old Mervs and more. They’ve earned acclaim from tastemakers including Tone Deaf, Frankie Magazine, Pilerats and Music Feeds, secured airplay across triple j, Double j, triple j Unearthed and community radio. The group were also showcasing artists at Bigsound 2024. 

2025 saw Little Guilt release two singles and join UK artist Freak Slug as the main support on their Australian national tour. The five-piece has kicked off this year supporting Nilüfer Yanya and showcasing at SXSW Austin. You can expect to hear new music from Little Guilt with their new 6-track EP releasing mid-2026. 

With a subtle air of formidable cool and songs to sink your teeth into, it seems a little guilt goes a long way.

events.title: LU GOT THE TASTE
events.description:
From Monterrey, Nuevo León, Mexico, LU GOT THE TASTE was born from the fusion of music and dance. Having begun her exploration of dance and performance at the age of seven, encompassing genres such as jazz, heels, contemporary, and showdance, Lu launched her musical career in front of the microphone and camera. Her perfect control of rhythm and her body are evident in each of her tracks, from hip hop to dembow and even alternative. One thing is clear: LU is here to stay.

Under the Slowly label in collaboration with Angeles Mafia, LU's project promises to be the underdog of 2026.

events.title: Mau P
events.venue: Billboard Presents The Stage at SXSW

events.title: MURTY
events.description:
There’s something about MURTY’s voice that sounds like a storyteller who can flirt, argue, and get in his feelings all within the same breath. He slides between smooth R&B, natural soul instincts, and unfiltered honesty. His songs feel like late-night confessions, unsent texts, and the confidence it takes to say what most people only think.

 He sings with intention. There’s humor in the pain, soul in the simplicity, and zero interest in staying in one lane. MURTY isn’t here to sound perfect. He’s here to sound like himself, flaws, feelings, and all. He's not just making music. He’s making moments you laugh at, relate to, and secretly replay.

events.title: Perdón Amor
events.description: Three friends from northern Mexico who have been making music together since 2020. Perdón Amor was born in 2024, and the trio keeps pushing forward, driven by their passion and strong chemistry in the studio and on stage. Their energy and creativity shine through in the new sounds and bold rhythms they’re creating, showing where they’re headed and making Perdón Amor a project worth watching in 2026

events.title: Pierce Washington
events.description: Pierce Washington is an award-winning hip-hop artist from Dallas, Texas, whose sound bridges jazz influences, live instrumentation, and modern production — creating music that feels both timeless and forward-thinking. Known for his cinematic storytelling and commanding stage presence, Pierce has emerged as one of the leading voices in Dallas hip-hop. His collaborations with legendary producer Madlib and rap icon Lil Wayne showcase his versatility and creative range. Fresh off headlining The Proof of Concept and Folktales tours, Pierce continues to push artistic boundaries through his innovative approach to music, visuals, and brand artistry.

events.title: Planet Dev
events.description: dj based in austin, tx.

events.title: Plastikboy
events.description:
Plastikboy is known for creating fresh songs that stand out for their unique sound and passionate lyrics, addressing love as a source of both inspiration and sorrow. His distinctive, soulful vocal timbre has been one of the most defining aspects of his music.
Plastikboy work revolves around his worldview, human relationships, and his own emotions. His music explores themes such as intense love, obsession, and emotional dependency, presenting a raw and honest approach. 
Her lyrics reflect an artistic space free from judgment, where she openly expresses her feelings. Key projects include "Si no estás" (2023), her debut single in the plug genre, and "Alfin del día" (2024), an R&B and alternative pop EP.

events.title: Redzed
events.description:
REDZED is a Czech rap-metal outlier turning underground chaos into global momentum. Writing and producing everything himself — from raw guitar riffs to hard-hitting beats — he fuses serrated modern rap with the weight of late-’90s/’00s metal. The result is a dark, cinematic crossover that speaks fluent mosh pit and playlist alike.

His 2024 album Tales Of A Necromancer solidified a singular vision, while viral tracks like “Rave In The Grave,” “Meth Phonk,” and “Drugs = Magic” have racked up tens of millions of streams, pushing him past one million monthly Spotify listeners worldwide.

Onstage, REDZED is relentless — sweat-drenched, high-impact, and impossible to ignore. After sold-out headline shows, international tours, and major European festival slots, he arrives ready to turn SXSW into a collision of rap kids and metal die-hards.

Enter the pit.

events.title: RIA
events.description: Ria is a rising Mexican singer-songwriter from Mexicali, Baja California, whose fresh, emotional, and deeply personal voice bridges tradition and innovation in regional Mexican music, exploring themes of resilience, love, heartbreak, and everyday life. With a sound that carries both emotional depth and fearless authenticity, she stands out as a fresh creative force. She is helping redefine the role of women in Mexican music, bringing a powerful feminine lens to the regional genre and inspiring a new wave of female artists. Her stage debut arrived on the ¡AY MAMÁ! TOUR, where she opened for Tito Double P in both Monterrey and Guadalajara, performing for over 20,000 fans and leaving a striking impact on the live circuit. Today, she continues expanding her audience with over 105k monthly Spotify listeners and her single “Pagana” surpassing 1.4 million views on YouTube, positioning her as one of the most promising emerging voices carrying regional Mexican music to global audiences.

events.title: t-low
events.description:
t-low is one of the most distinctive voices of the new German music generation. With a raw emotional honesty and a sound rooted in emo rap and alternative pop, he has become a defining figure in the post-Gen-Z youth culture of the German-speaking world. Born and raised in a small town in northern Germany, t-low emerged from SoundCloud culture and quickly gained nationwide attention with his unfiltered lyrics and melodic sensibility. His music explores themes of mental health, love, identity, and existential struggle delivered with a rare vulnerability that resonates deeply with his audience.

With multiple gold and platinum records, sold-out tours, and chart-topping singles, t-low has established himself as a generational voice in Germany. Yet despite his commercial success, he has consistently pushed boundaries and stayed artistically uncompromising. In late 2025, t-low will release his highly anticipated comeback album "REAL MUSIC", marking a return to his roots with a more introspective, emotionally complex sound. His showcase at SXSW 2026 is not about breaking into the U.S. market - it’s a statement.

events.title: Tia Tutt
events.description: Tia Tutt, born on January 6th in Augusta, GA, hails from Lincolnton, GA. From an early age, she faced the profound loss of her brother, shaping her journey with profound challenges. However, Tia found solace and expression in music, which became her refuge and passion. Her path led her to Los Angeles, where she endured a grueling two-year period of homelessness. Despite the adversity, Tia persevered, channeling her experiences into her music. During this time, she recorded an impressive four mixtapes, each containing 20 songs, showcasing her resilience and dedication to her craft. Despite the hardships she faced, Tia emerged stronger, using her artistry as a means of empowerment and self-expression. Today, she continues to live vibrantly, thriving as both a person and an artist, constantly evolving and creating music that resonates with audiences around the world. Tia’s journey is a testament to the power of perseverance and the transformative nature of music in the face of adversity.

events.title: The Tullamarines
events.description:
The amalgamation of four distinct voices from Adelaide, The Tullamarines tell their stories through a shared perspective that feels intimate, honest, and quietly uplifting. Josh, Angus, Benny and Lucinda met on the local gig circuit, quickly bonding over a mutual love of songwriting and collaboration. From those early connections, they’ve crafted a sound that reflects each member’s individual sensibilities - a style they affectionately call cosy-pop.
 
Their songs move through life’s highs and lows with the warmth of an old friend, inviting listeners into their living room, putting the kettle on, and sitting with whatever feeling the day brings. That sense of closeness runs through both their recorded work and their live shows.
 
Having appeared on festival line-ups including Beyond The Valley, Laneway Festival, Spin Off Festival and New Year’s Eve on the Hill, and toured extensively alongside artists such as Old Mervs, The Preatures, Ball Park Music and Alex Lahey, The Tullamarines continue to build a reputation for heartfelt songwriting and deeply human performances.

events.title: urboi.
events.description: urboi. es un productor y DJ mexicano con una trayectoria consolidada dentro de la música electrónica. Ha trabajado con artistas como Guaynaa, Anuel AA, Bruses, Dillon Francis y SIA, logrando discos de oro, platino y una nominación al Latin Grammy. Su enfoque versátil le ha permitido conectar con distintas escenas y públicos, presentándose en festivales como EDC México y Tecate Pal Norte.

events.title: Valsian
events.description: Oscar and Eunice, a music electronic pop mexican duo.

events.title: Ximena Soto
events.description: Ximena Soto is an upcoming artist from Monterrey, México, and a rising voice in contemporary R&B. Her music blends modern R&B with nostalgic samples inspired by trending sounds from the 80s and 90s, shaping a fresh identity. Backed by established producers in the Mexican music scene, Ximena has fully found her sound and is currently working on an EP set for release next year. As an ambassador of the LGBTQ+ community, she delivers “hot music” rooted in freedom, self-expression, and emotional connection, reaching audiences beyond labels and genres.

events.title: YES AND MAYBE
events.description:
Born amidst the cultural vibrancy of Glasgow and Paris, YES AND MAYBE is an electrifying two-piece band that pushes the boundaries of contemporary music. 
 
The first band member, a multi-instrumentalist and writer, excels in crafting minimalist guitar-based melodies, demonstrating a perfect blend of ingenuity and precision. His obsessive self-criticism and penchant for perfection have allowed him to transform his influences into his own unique sound.
 
The second member, a performer, writer, and producer, brings his experiences and emotions to life through introspective lyrics paired with evocative, ethereal vocals. His artistry lies in balancing deeply metaphorical, grounded lyrics with melodies that evoke a sense of escapism. This potent mix of realism and fantasy forms an integral part of YES AND MAYBE's distinctive sound.
​
Their songwriting process, both organic and instinctive, evolves from a simple phrase or a recorded sound into a comprehensive musical piece within a day. Their songs encapsulate their raw emotions, serving as a beacon of authenticity in an industry often mired in overproduction.
 
YES AND MAYBE, though relatively new, brings a refreshing spontaneity and a shared vision to redefine the musical landscape. Their commitment to creating music that resonates with their listeners' shared experiences makes them a band worth investing in. Keep an eye on this Glasgow based duo—they're a unique proposition with a future as innovative as their sound.

events.title: ZAMAERA
events.description:
Zamaera is a Malaysian rapper, singer-songwriter, and storyteller known for her fearless, genre-defying sound and commanding live performances. Blending sharp lyricism with experimental production, she has carved a distinct space for herself in Southeast Asia and beyond.

Breaking through Malaysia’s hip-hop scene in the mid-2010s, Zamaera gained international recognition through releases such as ZvsZ and Get Munni, leading to performances across the region and abroad.

In 2021, she founded Mean Malaya Entertainment, a creative platform championing artistic independence and Malaysian talent. Her commitment to uplifting women in music led to the creation of Queendomfest, Southeast Asia’s first all-female music festival.

In 2025, Zamaera became the fourth Malaysian artist to perform at SXSW in Austin, Texas. Building on that momentum, she now presents the first-ever dedicated national showcase, Made In Malaysia, at SXSW 2026, featuring an all-Malaysian lineup.

Her latest single, Ikan Kekek, released in February 2026, reimagines a traditional Malay folklore rhyme through trap and techno textures, exploring cultural memory, artistic freedom, and non-linear expression.

events.title: Podcast Movement Evolutions @ SXSW
events.description:
Join us as we merge Podcast Movement Evolutions with Sounds Profitable’s SXSW presence to create podcasting’s home base at one of the world’s most influential creative festivals. We will be hosting a series of talks, live performances, and networking events throughout the weekend.

More information here: https://evolutions.podcastmovement.com/

events.title: Registration (JW Marriott)
events.description: Pick up your SXSW Badge or Music Wristband in Griffin Hall of the JW Marriott. Your badge is required in order to attend any sessions, events, or socials.

events.title: Coffee Break, Cabu Style
events.description:
Experience the latte reimagined!
While most lattes use dairy or alt milks (yawn); Cabu blends cold brew coffee with the creamy part of the cacao bean for a velvety smooth mouthfeel and subtle notes of chocolate. Taste the difference; caffeinate creatively.

events.title: Daily Decode
events.description:
Start your day with clarity.

Each morning, PwC leaders will break down what’s happening on the ground at SXSW and translate it into practical, actionable insights for you and your clients. These 20-minute briefings cut through the noise to surface what matters most across agentic commerce, Gen Alpha, industry convergence, emerging technologies, and evolving consumer behavior.

You’ll leave with a sharper point of view, clear implications for your business, and tangible ways to turn cultural momentum into competitive advantage.

events.title: FQ Lounge™ @ SXSW
events.description: Please join us in the FQ Lounge™ @ SXSW.https://events.thefemalequotient.com/sxsw26

events.title: Jeremy Jarrett’s morning mimosa lightning talk
events.description:
Join us for Morning Mimosas with Kinetic Vision CEO Jeremy Jarrett. He’s talking about modern manufacturing with an experiential twist.

Innovation doesn’t happen in theory — it requires experience. Join Kinetic Vision CEO Jeremy Jarrett as he explores how experiential development accelerates learning, reduces risk, and transforms the journey from concept to production through rapid prototyping, real-world testing, and iterative problem-solving. His company embeds students and emerging talent into hands-on work, shaping the future of advanced manufacturing.

events.title: Laura Geller's Mature Beauty Boutique
events.description: Step into Laura Geller’s Mature Beauty Boutique at the Congress Ave Block Party, a beauty experience designed for confidence at every age. Get expertly shade-matched and receive a FREE Baked Balance-n-Brighten Color Correcting Foundation. After that, enjoy photo moments at our sticker wall, plus free swag and even more makeup goodies. Discover easy, glow-boosting essentials designed to enhance your natural beauty!

events.title: The Odoo Lounge
events.description: Swing by the Odoo Lounge at SXSW to recharge, kick up your feet, and get some work done. For a chance to win a prize, visit the Odoo Lounge and see how Odoo makes companies better, one app at a time.

events.title: Registration (Downright Austin)
events.description: Pick up your SXSW Badge or Music Wristband on the Capitol View Terrace of the Downright Hotel. Your badge is required in order to attend any sessions, events, or socials.

events.title: Registration (Fairmont Austin)
events.description: Pick up your SXSW Badge in the Manchester Ballroom of the Fairmont Austin. Your badge is required in order to attend any sessions, events, or socials.

events.title: Registration (Omni Austin Hotel - Downtown)
events.description: Pick up your SXSW Badge in the Guadalupe Room of the Omni Downtown. Your badge is required in order to attend any sessions, events, or socials.

events.title: University of Cincinnati Lounge
events.description: Think of us as the ultimate college lounge: coffee, chargers, comfy chairs, some adult beverages, and all the fuel you need to spark your next great idea. Oh, and there will be a free Allbirds drawing every day.

events.title: The Analog Revival: Handmade in the Age of AI
events.description: In a world of AI content, audiences crave the imperfections of handmade art. From viral stop motion to sold-out film rolls and indie zines, analog crafts are booming. This panel explores how creators use nostalgia, scarcity, and authenticity to build loyal communities, monetize slowness, collaborate across mediums, and cut through digital noise.

events.title: Artistic Disruption for Business Innovation
events.description: Unlock radical imagination with avant-garde creativity methods from Chicago’s Futurist Salon. In this interactive workshop for innovation and culture leaders, you’ll apply speculative avant-garde techniques—surrealist games (metaphor jamming, automatic writing), situationist exercises (dérive-style cultural mapping), and futurist scenario play—to reframe challenges, discover unseen connections, and spark breakthrough ideas. You’ll leave with hands-on tools and a simple framework for hosting your own salons that shift mental models and drive bold innovation across your organization.

speakers.name: Michael Hyzy
speakers.title: Vice President Of Ai Strategy And Innovation

events.title: Augmented IQ: Scaling Human + AI Potential
events.description: Too many leaders today use AI to automate yesterday. Some use AI to do their thinking. But if we don't think critically and creatively, if we don’t define how we compete more effectively with AI, then we leave it to AI slop and cognitive Darwinism to shape our future. This is a moment for mastering AIQ: the Augmented Intelligence Quotient. The best leaders master IQ, EQ, and SQ. AIQ is the practice of becoming exponentially smarter with AI, to augment our thinking and output to achieve what wasn’t possible before AI. In this special session, Brian Solis, Futurist, author, Head of Global Innovation at ServiceNow will share a mindshift map to move from efficiency to augmented possibility, to automate what should be automated, and augment what only humans can imagine to reshape the future.

speakers.name: Brian Solis
speakers.title: Futurist, Author, Head of Global Innovation

events.title: Beyond AI: The New American Dream
events.description: The American workforce is shifting faster than anyone expected. A four-year college degree is no longer the sole path to economic stability. As AI automates many white-collar roles, demand for skilled trades is accelerating—electricians, HVAC technicians, welders, and operators who will build and maintain the infrastructure behind the AI boom itself. Yet millions of workers have been told these careers do not represent “success.” In this session, the Business for Good Foundation explores why hands-on careers may become the most stable and upwardly mobile jobs of the next decade, and how philanthropy, business, and policymakers can create new pathways, remove barriers, and expand access to a modern American Dream.

events.title: Co-Creating the Future of XR Distribution
events.description: As immersive media rapidly evolves, we face a critical window of opportunity to shape an equitable distribution ecosystem. Join the Independent XR Distribution Coalition for a participatory workshop on imagining a flourishing XR field. The session will begin with a presentation of distribution pipeline research and a database of venues and platforms, followed by a mapping exercise that surfaces the issues artists, audiences, and producers face in XR. Participants will sketch speculative distribution pathways across diverse platforms, using artist-centered strategies as building blocks.

events.title: Collab Culture: Turning One-Off Brand Deals into Lasting Partnerships
events.description: In today’s content landscape, creators aren’t just making videos—they’re building universes. Long-form, narrative-driven programming is emerging as a way for creators to tell richer stories while incorporating brands in ways that feel natural and engaging. Creators aren’t just starring in the content—they’re producing the :15 and :30 ads that live across the platform. This session explores how creators can develop authentic brand partnerships that align with their vision, scale their careers, and transform one-off deals into long-term relationships built on trust, creativity, and shared values. Attendees will hear directly from top creators about why these deep partnerships are redefining how modern audiences connect with advertising that values authenticity and substance over surface-level promotion.

events.title: Conversation Culture: A Live AEO/AI Search Audit for Brands
events.description: Search is no longer transactional. It’s conversational, AI-driven, and increasingly shaped by how Answer Engines interpret brands. In this live workshop, Avenue Z and Profound will conduct real-time AEO Brand Audits to show how brands appear across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and other AI-native experiences. You will learn how AI Search influences demand, reputation, and revenue, and leave with an actionable audit framework and tactics to understand, control, and scale how your brand shows up in the zero-click internet.

events.title: Experience the Future of Flight
events.description: Experience flying in a Cirrus aircraft through Apple Pro Vision goggles and then check out the all new SR Series G7+ aircraft on-site.

events.title: Featured Session: A Conversation with Andrew Ross Sorkin on the 1929 Financial Crash —  and Today’s Economy
events.description:
Are we living through a 1929 moment and don't know it yet?

Global markets are navigating one of the most consequential inflection points in decades. Artificial intelligence is rewriting the rules of entire industries. Regulatory policies are shifting under our feet. Geopolitical tensions are rising. And through it all, a familiar pattern is emerging — one that Andrew Ross Sorkin has spent years studying.

Sorkin is the author of 1929: Inside the Greatest Crash in Wall Street History — and How It Shattered a Nation, an instant New York Times bestseller that reveals how overconfidence, speculation, and political dysfunction converged to produce the worst financial disasters in American history. He's also the co-anchor of CNBC's Squawk Box, founder of The New York Times' DealBook, and one of the most influential voices in finance and media.

In conversation with Joe Weisenthal — co-host of Bloomberg's cult-favorite Odd Lots podcast — Sorkin will draw the lines between 1929 and now: the warning signs that were missed then, the ones flashing today, and what it would take to avoid repeating history.

events.title: Featured Session: The Guardian in Conversation with Mahmoud Khalil on the Cost of Dissent
events.description: When Mahmoud Khalil was targeted and nearly deported by the Trump administration for his advocacy, his life as a Palestinian student and soon-to-be father were irrevocably upended. Now released from detention – but still facing the threat of deportation – Khalil joins The Guardian for an unflinching conversation on his ordeal, the system that tried to silence him, and the personal and political stakes of resistance.

events.title: Flatstock
events.description:
Looking for the perfect centerpiece for your gallery wall, a concert poster of your favorite artist, or your favorite Texas-themed memorabilia? Look no further than Flatstock! This eclectic art market continues to capture the spirit of music mementos while also highlighting unique collectibles. Flatstock provides an ongoing series of opportunities to admire artwork in person and to meet the artists who created it. This Expo is free and open to the public.

See the Flatstock Guide here: https://app-na1.hubspotdocuments.com/documents/558236/view/1620947864?accessId=75a3c4

See the floor plan here: https://sxsw2026-flatstock.expofp.com/

events.title: From Charity to Strategy: The Business Case for Migrant and Refugee Entrepreneurship
events.description: What if the next wave of high growth companies is emerging from founders on the move? From refugee camps in the Netherlands to Cairo’s Little Damascus and innovation hubs in Iraq’s Kurdistan, migrant and refugee entrepreneurs are transforming overlooked markets into engines of growth. Valentina Primo has helped unlock over $10 million in investment and create 50,000 jobs across 17 countries as founder of Startups Without Borders. Victoria Kuketz has designed corporate strategy and led public policy efforts on workforce development, productivity, and economic inclusion at Catalyst and the Public Policy Forum. In this panel, they reveal how corporate and nonprofit partnerships can turn economic inclusion from a social initiative into a competitive innovation strategy.

events.title: From NPC to Main Character: The Power of Belonging
events.description: Cultural conversations around “main character energy” and a loneliness epidemic have made some feel like NPCs in the game of life. But what drives someone to join a Twitch stream or wear a jersey to a bar? Belonging. Fandoms aren’t mindless obsessions — they’re identity-shaping communities that turn disconnected observers into players. This talk explores how brands can drive growth through belonging by inviting people in through storytelling, access, and shared imagination—turning passive audiences into passionate communities.

events.title: From Shorts to Shows: Why Creators Are Flocking to Podcasts
events.description: Whether it’s the Golden Globes introducing a “podcast” category, celebrities and politicians turning to podcasts to promote their work or shape public opinion, or video platforms like YouTube becoming the #1 TV streaming service, podcasts are an increasingly significant part of the creator economy. Hear from creators and industry leaders about the opportunity they see in podcasting, and how they’re using podcasts to launch and grow their own multi-platform media businesses.

speakers.name: Ray Chao
speakers.title: SVP & General Manager, Audio & Digital video

events.title: The Future of Storytelling in the Age of AI
events.description:
Why is everyone still reading the same article when no two readers are alike? This session challenges the future of storytelling in AI—where the promise isn’t cheaper content, but stories as personal as your own fingerprint.

Led by MasterClass founder and CEO David Rogier, this conversation will challenge assumptions about creativity, technology, and culture—and invite the audience to imagine a future where AI helps us tell the most human stories of all: our own.

events.title: hālo haus
events.description: hālo haus is a 4 day gathering centered on beauty, wellness, and longevity. Hosted on a full street closure in downtown Austin, the program blends fireside chats, leading voices, experiential activations, and recovery-focused offerings within an open, discovery-driven format. hālo haus brings together founders, creators, clinicians, and cultural leaders to explore how self-care and performance are evolving alongside culture.

events.title: How to Get the Job: Building a Career in Music
events.description: Philip Payne and Sofia Martinez will reveal how they secured roles at major music companies. Whether you’re aiming for a full-time position or independent contract work, they will share the exact strategies they used to get their foot in the door.From A&R and touring to agency roles, Philip and Sofia will break down what actually work - including successful cold outreach and turning internships into careers.You’ll walk away with industry-standard networking tips and a personalized roadmap to jumptart your own career.

events.title: Imagining Futures & Amplifying Voices: Day 4 at German Haus
events.description:
Shape tomorrow through collaborative imagination in our futuring ideathon, then explore how symbols and civic spaces can reimagine global belonging in polarized times. Discover German startups revolutionizing MediaTech, entertainment, and mobility with innovations from immersive storytelling to next-gen EV infrastructure. The afternoon features thought leadership on talent mobility and music industry transformation. Cap off the evening at the German Rave Night with performances by Ikkimel, Miss Bashful, and Luca Eck.

For more information please visit: https://www.german-haus.com

events.title: Innovation & Impact: Female Leaders Transforming Legacy Industries
events.description: Women are leading the transformation of legacy industries and reimagining how we lead, move, and show up in the world with confidence. This panel brings together female leaders to explore how women are shaping the future through innovation, purpose-driven leadership, and consumer-centered solutions. These leaders will give insight into how to build brands that disrupt the status quo; how staying true to a clear vision creates space to be responsive and agile; and share lessons in cultivating teams to drive long-term success. A conversation about what’s next — with the women building it.

events.title: Innovators Today and the Future of Play
events.description:
For generations, play has shaped how we imagine, connect, and create. Today it spans toys, gaming, anime, sports, and emerging tech, blending physical and digital worlds into shared experiences. As new technologies, platforms, and global fandoms accelerate, play is being redefined in real time. 

Play is no longer confined to a toy aisle, a console, or a screen; it now unfolds across worlds, driven by creativity, community, and connection. 

Join industry innovators exploring how breakthrough technologies, powerhouse partnerships, and mixed-world experiences are shapin g the future of play, creativity, and culture.

events.title: Mentor Meet Up
events.description: Are you a SXSW Mentor? Are you looking for a Mentor? Want to learn about Mentoring at SXSW? Join SXSW Programmer Audrey to get the scoop on the program, meet other Mentors – or if you’re a Mentee and need a little more advice!

events.title: Mentor Session: Annie Hardy (Cisco)
events.description: Meeting with this mentor is highly recommended if you're interested in Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning, Entrepreneurship, Future of Work.
