events.title: On with Kara Swisher Live
events.description: Join award-winning journalist Kara Swisher for a live taping of On with Kara Swisher, where she’ll sit down with a special guest for a no-holds-barred interview.

events.title: The Present and Future of Live Experiences
events.description: Events have been the most sought after B2B marketing channel over the past four years. In the age of AI and deep polarization, in person experiences offer the perfect outlet for multiple generations to gather and engage with brands. But events are not easy! What is working today and how are brands engaging offline? Join Julius Solaris for a data-backed journey with a clear objective, helping you make your events more attended, sponsored and engaging.

events.title: Prompt to Publish - AI Tools for the Modern Content Creator
events.description: From idea to post, AI is transforming how creators brainstorm, write, and scale. In this hands-on workshop, you’ll explore tools that accelerate, not replace, your voice: from custom GPTs for ideation to AI-powered editors that adapt to your style. We’ll cover how to maintain consistent content without burnout and utilize automation to support authentic community building. Walk away with real workflows that streamline creation and deepen audience connection.

events.title: Radiolab: How It's Made and What That Means for You
events.description:
Radiolab is one of the world’s most groundbreaking audio programs—famous for its curiosity-driven storytelling, innovative sound design, and ability to make complex ideas feel both thrilling and human. Now, you can get a behind-the-scenes look at how it all comes together.

In this masterclass, we'll trace every step of the production process. We'll explore how the show finds and structures stories that keep listeners hooked. We'll dive into the show's unique approach to scoring and sound design. And we'll discuss how to use these practices in your next project.

events.title: Ready for your Brand Close-Up?
events.description: Visit YouTube at the Brand & Marketing track to capture your own custom video to post on YouTube Shorts. Our team will guide you through the process and help you capture a unique brand snapshot of your time at SXSW. Open to all attendees during conference hours.

events.title: Resistance into Momentum: Leading Through Reluctant Change
events.description: Change isn’t optional—but engagement is. In this energizing talk, change strategist Jeff Skipper reveals how leaders can turn organizational resistance into momentum. With stories from Fortune 100 transformations and fast-growing companies, Jeff shows why most change fails (hint: it’s not the process) and how to co-create clarity, alignment, and commitment—even in reluctant teams. Walk away with tools to lead change with precision and humanity, and yes—maybe even a little grace.

events.title: Retail as a Stage: Merch, Culture & Artist Identity
events.description: Retail has become more than a revenue stream. It’s a cultural touchpoint and a powerful platform for artist marketing. This panel explores how brands and bands collaborate to extend an artist’s presence far beyond the stage through merch, in-store activations, exclusive drops, and co-branded campaigns. Hear how retail partnerships are shaping music fandom, fueling discovery, and embedding artists deeper into culture. We’ll break down how artists are leveraging retail to build lasting fan engagement.

events.title: SÃO PAULO HOUSE 2026 - WE ARE BORDERLESS
events.description:
Welcome to São Paulo House, a borderless hub where the world meets São Paulo, now.

Across four days at SXSW, the house brings together global content, meaningful encounters, live music and immersive experiences in one vibrant space on Congress Avenue. By day, ideas and exchanges shape conversations. By night, shows and performances transform the house into a cultural hotspot.

Explore creativity, innovation, and culture, shaping what’s next from the energy of now.

Please find more information here: https://saopaulohouse.com/

events.title: Space House
events.description:
YOU ARE ALREADY LIVING IN THE SPACE AGE. And this SXSW, you can find out how. Space House is an immersive sanctuary dedicated to new and commercial space - where founders, astronauts, futurists and technologists explore topics spanning from how space is shaping our daily lives, to if the Moon is the “new Mars”. Expect bold ideas, curated experiences, conversations with visionary space leaders of today and the kind of collisions that spark what’s next.

www.thisisspacehouse.com

events.title: Speaking for the Dead: How True Crime Shapes Justice
events.description: True crime is one of the most powerful ways the public grapples with justice and violence. Join Thien Ho, Sacramento DA and lead prosecutor on the Golden State Killer case; investigator Paul Holes, whose forensic work helped identify the killer; and historian Anne Soon Choi, whose biography of Thomas Noguchi explores the Coroner to the Stars’ most famous cases, including Marilyn Monroe and RFK. Together, they examine how law, forensic practice, technology, and storytelling shape how victims are represented, cold cases are solved, and truth is constructed. Moderated by publisher Stephanie Lim.

events.title: Stories from a Second Chance
events.description:
Join author Jesse Crosson for a special first-public reading of his forthcoming memoir,  (publishing March 10, 2026). In this session, Jesse will read select passages that dive into his journey and how the hard-won lessons he learned apply to your life as well! He will discuss how accountability is the pathway to freedom, how service is redemption in action and how building a life of options is much more successful than building a life of plans.

This is a rare chance to hear these stories live and unfiltered, straight from the place where transformation began. Pre-order the book now and be among the first to hear the journey from darkness to rebirth—on stage at SXSW.

https://www.jessecrosson.com/my-book/

events.title: Superhuman Suite at Antone’s: The Future Is All You
events.description:
Superhuman makes its SXSW debut with a three-day takeover of Antone’s. Check out the immersive Epochs of Communication, along with panels, keynotes, comedy, and live music!

10:00am - 11:15am: Startups Networking Breakfast
11:15am - 12:15pm: Rebuilding the Startup Operating System With AI
1:00pm - 1:45pm: Start Here: The Art and Science of Getting Unstuck
2:30pm - 3:30pm: The Taste Economy: Why Human Curation Matters More Than Ever
4:00pm - 5:30pm: Community Meetup & Happy Hour
7:30pm - 10:30pm: Sun Room, Susannah Joffe, Timmy Skelly, Luke Tyler Shelton & Saige Davis

events.title: SXSW Bookstore
events.description: Check out the SXSW Bookstore to browse the latest work authored by this year’s conference participants. Support your favorite speakers and find something you connect with to take back home. Open daily on the 6th floor of the Hilton Austin Downtown.

events.title: SXSW Pitch Alumni: Where Are They Now?
events.description: Past winners of the SXSW Pitch competition are back to share how their lives and entrepreneurial journeys have changed since winning on the SXSW Pitch stage. Catch-up on their latest endeavors, hear directly from the winning founders, and learn how they leveraged the SXSW Pitch platform to take their startups to the next level.

events.title: Tennessee House - Knoxville & Oak Ridge in the A.M.
events.description:
The Tennessee House showcases what's happening in tech, innovation, and culture across the Volunteer State. Be there for 3 days of bold thinking, eye-opening connections, and unforgettable fun.

We're spotlighting Knoxville and Oak Ridge from 10am to 3pm. Start your morning in East TN with an exciting look at what’s new in nuclear, and meet some of Knoxville's next-gen companies.

Doors open at 10am ** Limited-edition swag, bites, and drinks **

events.title: This is cool: Immersive Videos in headsets are exciting!
events.description: I know, I know: you’ve seen it all before. In 2016-2020, many people thought VR would be *the thing*. It didn’t happen, and you’ve moved on. We didn’t. See: VR is cool, actually. Talk to any creative, any filmmaker: they want in. Why? BECAUSE IT’S AWESOME! Come to this talk and learn how the latest cameras and headsets *finally* make it easy to create mind-blowing experiences. I’ll show you a few projects that came out recently, share some audience numbers - and you’ll get why Immersive Videos are the most undervalued creative opportunity at the moment!

events.title: We’re on the Cusp of Communicating with Whales
events.description: Chasing one of the most ambitious scientific discoveries of our time, a group of biologists, linguists, roboticists, & legal scholars have joined forces to understand what animals are saying to each other & devise a way to talk to them. Leveraging state-of-the-art technology, including a groundbreaking machine learning engine, Project CETI scientists have made huge progress decoding the communication of sperm whales. We will explore the impact of interspecies communication & what it means for humanity, the legal rights of animals, animal intelligence, and the future of conservation.

speakers.name: David Gruber
speakers.title: Founder and President of Project CETI, Marine Biologist, Professor, and National Geographic Explorer

events.title: Why Most Companies Will Never Be AI Native
events.description: AI-native has become the goal, but for many organizations it’s unrealistic or unnecessary. This conversation will look honestly at what AI-native really means and why teams get stuck trying to achieve it. We’ll explore the technical, organizational, and human bottlenecks that hold companies back, and how strong leaders decide when to invest, when to adapt, and when to walk away. A grounded discussion about tradeoffs, judgment, and practical AI outcomes.

speakers.name: Nabil Bukhari
speakers.title: President, AI Platforms and Chief Technology Officer

events.title: YAMAHA CREATOR PASS STUDIO
events.description: A new creative experience is making its SXSW debut. Hands-on music and audio tools. Real-time creation. Designed for creators of all levels. No watching from the sidelines — just jump in and make something.

events.title: You Can’t Create Cultural Relevance Without Community
events.description: For marketers, being part of culture is no longer optional. As community-led discovery overtakes search monoculture, smart brands recognize that communities don’t want sponsors; they want neighbors. 65% of consumers say they’re more loyal to brands that foster meaningful connections. This panel explores the difference between relevance and rejection and demonstrates how showing up with humility, consistency, and value turns audiences into collaborators, unlocking cultural traction that drives lasting loyalty.

speakers.name: Marcus Collins
speakers.title: Professor, Best Selling Author, Keynote Speaker, Cultural Scholar
speakers.company: University of Michigan - Stephen M. Ross School of Business

events.title: Futuring Our World: An Imaginative Ideathon
events.description:
We don’t enter the future – we imagine it first. In this ideathon, participants “hack the future” through collaborative imagination, treating the future as an active practice we can shape together. Moving through themed stations across society – cities, work, tech, & the arts – we’ll examine how narratives of progress shape innovation. The session will be facilitated by social scientists from the Technical University of Munich in cooperation with the City of Austin, creatives, and other partners.

https://www.german-haus.com

events.title: SXSW Pitch "Meet the Startups"
events.description: When the pitches are complete and the winners are revealed, the excitement continues! Meet our amazing startups, connect with their founders, and check out live product demos.

events.title: The Ascent
events.description: "The Ascent" is the inspiring true story of Colorado Springs bilateral-amputee climber Mandy Horvath’s record-breaking attempt to crawl to the summit of Mt. Kilimanjaro on her hands. At 21, Mandy lost both of her legs under mysterious circumstances—an event that shattered her trust in the world around her. As she pushes her body to its limits on Africa’s tallest mountain, Mandy must reckon with the unanswered questions of her past and learn to trust again if she is to succeed.

events.title: Congress Avenue Block Party
events.description: The Congress Avenue Block Party (formerly known as the Registrant Lounge) is the go-to space for all SXSW attendees to maximize their SX experience, offering daily complimentary drinks, food, and sponsor swag. Open throughout the conferences & festivals, this convenient and relaxing meeting point near the hub of SXSW action is an ideal spot to unwind and connect with other attendees. New for 2026, the Block Party is free and open to the public!

events.title: Crep Protect Clean & Chill
events.description: Get your sneakers cleaned and be in with the chance of winning some exclusive prizes with Crep Protect, the worlds leading sneaker care brand.

events.title: Free JonnyPops Samples - A Better Pop for a Better World!
events.description: Stop by the JonnyPops tent to enjoy the simple ingredients, delicious taste and kindness in every pop! Free pops and swag will be distributed each day. https://www.jonnypops.com/

events.title: Layers of Place: Austin
events.description: Through a co-creative process with the community, Austin transforms into a platform for multidimensional, pluralistic inquiry, delving into themes such as racial justice, historical memory, memorialization, environmental stewardship, and the impact of technology on civic life. The importance of plurality is central, presenting six perspectives on different concepts and viewpoints. In a world that is increasingly polarized and lacking in nuanced perspectives, Layers of Place emphasizes the collective experience. By expanding “public space” to include both the tangible environment and the virtual layers accessible through AR, we create a new form of communal experience.

speakers.name: MIT Open Documentary Lab’s AR and Public Space Artist Collective

events.title: The Life We Leave
events.description: When Washington state became the first in the world to legalize human composting, entrepreneur Micah Truman puts it all on the line to build the world's first large-scale terramation facility. But when the conventional deathcare industry resists, he is forced to pivot, and must learn to care for the grieving while transforming his business.  Alongside Funeral Directors, Brie Smith and Katey Houston, he begins to understand the double bottom line is the only way to truly profit. What begins as an ambitious venture becomes personal as they rediscover human connection, ritual, and legacy.

events.title: Los Lobos Native Sons
events.description: "Los Lobos Native Sons" is the definitive, authorized chronicle of one of America’s most enduring, genre-defying bands. Tracing Los Lobos’ rise from East L.A. streets to global acclaim, the film offers unprecedented access to their archives and an intimate look at the brotherhood driving their journey. Through electrifying performances and candid interviews—with Linda Ronstadt, Rubén Blades, Tom Waits, Dolores Huerta, Danny Elfman, Jackson Browne, Cheech Marin, Edward James Olmos, Peter Frampton, George Lopez, Bonnie Raitt, and more, the film celebrates their legacy as cultural trailblazers blending rock, roots, and Mexican traditions into a sound uniquely their own.

events.title: Moving Memory
events.description:
Move between memories. Moving Memory uses AR to enhance how New Public Art’s interactive artwork Kempelen’s Owls makes a place to bridge the relationships between nature and technology, geometric and organic, clandestine and open, seen and hidden.
When you enter the space between Kemplen’s Owls and begin the AR experience, you hear music and see playful, colorful animated figures performing motion-captured choreography, and tiny sparkling streams of symbols: dodecahedrons, leaves, owls, and gears. Mirror or respond to the choreography of the avatars in poses or dance, and take photos with them in the app. If you discover the secret, you may feel seen indeed. What do you intend to remember?

events.title: My/Mochi Joyfully Chill Ice Cream Shoppe
events.description: My/Mochi, the original and world's largest mochi ice cream brand, is inviting SXSW-goers to Taste the Joy! Our delightfully delicious ice cream wrapped in pillowy sweet rice dough comes in more than 20 flavors like Cookie Dough, Strawberry and Mango. So stop by our Joyfully Chill Ice Cream Shoppe at the Congress Ave Block Party Mar 12-18 to experience the joy for yourself!

events.title: The Painterland Sisters' Yogurt Farm Stand
events.description: Step into the Painterland Sisters' Yogurt Farm Stand to sample our organic skyr yogurt and for hands-on farm education. Learn what organic regenerative farming really means, explore sensory elements from the farm, and taste some simply yummy skyr yogurt packed with probiotics and protein. Straight from the pasture to your spoon - made with love!

events.title: Seekers of Infinite Love
events.description:
Kayla Bachman, an author who struggles with emotional connection, Zach Bachman, a lawyer who dreams of being a folk singer and Wes Bachman, a graphic novelist / gambling & pill addict, meet to discuss their younger sister Scarlett who joined a cult in Kentucky. 
Zach and his dysfunctional and absent parents have hired cult deprogrammer Rick Delacroix to help them rescue Scarlett. 
They embark on a roadtrip to save their sister, and bring their family together.

events.title: SXSW Expo: XR Experience
events.description:
Virtual reality, augmented reality, and mixed reality technologies are finding new ways to enhance our ability to perceive the world that surrounds us and redefining how we experience it. The projects presented in our XR Experience emphasize storytelling and art in the immersive world. Come immerse yourself in the most creative minds of the world at the SXSW XR Experience.

See the floor plan here: https://sxsw2026-xr.expofp.com/

events.title: Texas Short Program
events.description: Vibrant work filmed in, inspired by, or connected to the Lone Star State.
events.venue: Rollins Theatre at the Long Center

events.title: The Verdadero 360 Tequila Experience
events.description:
The Verdadero 360 Tequila Experience is a 21+ tasting and education experience designed to let guests experience the Spirit For More. Guests sample different expressions while learning about agave, craftsmanship, and what sets Verdadero apart. The experience encourages curiosity, conversation, and connection. A 360 photo booth allows guests to capture and share the moment.

Check us out on Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/verdaderotequila/

events.title: XR Experience Competition
events.description: World premieres of mind bending immersive art.

events.title: XR Experience Special Events
events.description: Celebrating exciting, out-of-the-box ways artists are using technology to bring their art to life.

events.title: XR Experience Spotlight
events.description: Masterful immersive art from around the world.

events.title: Cookie Queens
events.description: “Cookie Queens” is a coming-of-age story about the joys, pressures, and pain points woven into one of America’s most cherished rituals: Girl Scout Cookie season. Captivating, candid, and full of heart, the film follows four girls ages 5-12 as they navigate the annual whirlwind of selling, striving, and succeeding. For these Girl Scouts, selling cookies isn’t just about Thin Mints and sisterhood - it’s a crash course in commercialism. Behind the smiles lie real pressure: long hours, ambitious goals, and weighty expectations. With humor, warmth, and a keen eye for small moments revealing big truths, “Cookie Queens” shows how growing up is shaped by tensions between community and capitalism.

events.title: The Saviors
events.description: Sean and Kim Harrison are a suburban couple about to divorce. By renting their guest house to a quiet Middle Eastern brother and sister, Amir and Jahan Razi, they find a perfect solution: raise money to fix and sell their house, then separate. But when bizarre occurrences begin to add up – mysterious lights, missing animals, glimpses of unexplainable tech – in the days before the President’s upcoming visit to town, their guests' strange behavior starts to seem suspicious and potentially dangerous. As Sean and Kim investigate their new tenants, they rediscover the emotional connection they once shared. But reconciliation may come at a significant cost in this timely and provocative thriller.

events.title: The Saviors

By renting their guest house to a quiet Middle Eastern brother and sister, Amir and Jahan Razi, they find a perfect solution: raise money to fix and sell their house, then separate. But when bizarre occurrences begin to add up – mysterious lights, missing animals, glimpses of unexplainable tech – in the days before the President’s upcoming visit to town, their guests' strange behavior starts to seem suspicious and potentially dangerous. As Sean and Kim investigate their new tenants, they rediscover the emotional connection they once shared. But reconciliation may come at a significant cost in this timely and provocative thriller.

events.title: SXSW Community Service Awards Recognition: Last Prisoner Project
events.description: The SXSW Community Service Awards celebrate leaders and non-profit organizations from Austin and around the world who work tirelessly to improve the standing of the specific groups and causes that they serve.Mary Bailey is a dedicated community organizer and social justice advocate. As managing director & co-founder of the criminal justice reform non-profit, Last Prisoner Project, Mary leads development efforts and cultivates community partnerships that enable Last Prisoner Project to fight for the release of cannabis prisoners and support them as they rebuild their lives. Her dedication to this mission has bolstered the organization's programs, which has saved over 360 years of prison time, provided $9M in legal services, passed 10 record clearance laws, and distributed over $3.8M to constituents through direct grants, commissary funds, and other financial support. She feels strongly that nobody should be in prison for cannabis and is dedicated to helping to inspire a more socially conscious cannabis industry.Before co-founding Last Prisoner Project, she was the CEO of Alpha Agency, a Hawaii-based production company specializing in creating events that inspire positive social change through music, education, and community engagement. She also hosted the Maui Cannabis Conference, the Maui Yoga Festival, and monthly community block parties for the County of Maui Office of Economic Development. Mary received the High Times Dope Award and the High Times list of the Top 100 Most Influential People in the Cannabis Industry, the Advocate of the Year Award from Benzinga, the Top 100 Most Influential People for Activism by Cannabis Global Times, 40 under 40 from Cannabis Now Magazine, and serves as a SXSW Mentor.

events.title: Access to Capital for the World's Underbanked Entrepreneurs
events.description: "Access to Capital for the World's Underbanked Entrepreneurs" will be a creative discussion centered on how to expand financial access for underbanked and underserved entrepreneurs around the world – helping to create local jobs and economic mobility for founders from Detroit to Nairobi to the Za'atari refugee camp and beyond. Two award-winning social entrepreneurs and human rights leaders will discuss their work on the ground in the U.S., Africa, and Asia to connect women, refugee, and low-income individuals to the capital they need to launch and grow life-changing micro-enterprises.

events.title: The Age of Sameness
events.description: We go to the same cafés, follow the same glossy lists, and sit in front of the same Netflix queue. Now we are also beginning to think the same, shaped in part by AI tools. Sameness has a long history. What began as a primal need for safety became structural with the Industrial Revolution, shaped by markets, politics, and broadcast culture. Algorithms accelerated this process, compressing cognition. Together, these forces have eroded the conditions for human creativity by disrupting rhythm. Sameness runs so deep that we feel it, but cannot name it. The Age of Sameness maps this crisis.

events.title: AI Killed Your Website Traffic (And What to do About it)
events.description: Marketing is experiencing its most significant disruption in 20 years. With 60% of searches resulting in no clicks and AI set to overtake traditional search by 2028, the old playbook is expired. From the creators of inbound marketing, join HubSpot CMO Kipp Bodnar and growth strategist Steph Smith for a special live recording of the podcast, “Marketing Against the Grain,” where they’ll unveil a new methodology to help businesses shift from controlling traffic to maximizing conversion, from providing answers to enabling actions, and from mass marketing to AI-personalization at scale.

events.title: Beyond the Gatekeepers: The Impact of Grassroots Communities
events.description: The music industry is undergoing a massive restructure, but a new, healthier model is emerging. This panel unites leaders from LWC, BAK, jump.global, and digilogue to reveal how grassroots communities are reshaping the industry. We'll explore their profound impact on members' mental health, career growth, and the creation of new opportunities. This session will demonstrate that when gatekeepers fail, a better, more supportive, and thriving music industry can be built through collective action.

speakers.name: Paulina Vo
speakers.title: Co-Founder at Highnote, Co-Founder & General Manager at The Digilogue  Highnote

events.title: Beyond the Grid: Motorsport Culture Meet Up
events.description: Motorsport is having a cultural breakthrough from mainstream moments like Drive to Survive and the F1 Movie to sim racing, TikTok fandoms, and grassroots club culture. However, most spaces still center the same legacy voices. This Meetup brings together fans, creators, marketers, and community builders who are shaping what motorsport looks like next. Whether you're growing a following, building a brand, or simply finding your people, this is a space to connect, share stories, and spotlight rising voices across all motorsport passion points.

events.title: Brains & Bots: Evolving the Future of Intelligence Together
events.description: Does offloading thinking to AI cause cognitive atrophy or free our brains to think about more complex problems? That’s the million-neuron question. This provocative panel explores “adaptive intelligence”, where human and machine learning loops converge. A neuroscientist, futurist, and AI visionary unpack how co-learning systems, neuromorphic design, and spatial computing can amplify creativity, decision-making, and human agency in a world where algorithms don’t just support us, they shape us.

speakers.name: Heather Collins, PhD
speakers.title: Cognitive Neuroscientist, Innovation curator, Peak Performance Expert

speakers.name: Julissa Germosen
speakers.title: Tech Executive, Author, Human Connection & AI Leadership Expert

speakers.name: Dan Chuparkoff
speakers.title: AI Educator & Innovation Expert - ex-Google Leader

events.title: The Cold Outreach Playbook for Tech Sales
events.description: Standing out in a crowded inbox or on a cold call is one of the toughest challenges in B2B sales. In this session, Glenn Kramon, Pulitzer Prize winning New York Times editor and Stanford Business School instructor, shares proven communication strategies that help sales professionals earn attention and credibility with decision-makers. You’ll learn how to open with impact, tailor messages to business priorities, remove unnecessary jargon, and strike the right balance of professionalism and authenticity to drive meaningful responses.

events.title: The Creator’s Brain: Neuroscience Tools for Content Ideas
events.description: What if you could train your brain to generate better content ideas? This neuroscience-backed session explores how creators can tap into the brain’s natural creativity systems specifically for content production. With live brainwave demos on stage, you’ll see what happens during “Eureka” moments and how to trigger them on demand. Walk away with practical, brain-based tools to improve video ideation, storytelling, and content flow in the creator economy.

events.title: Darkchild On the Record: Music, Legacy, and Change
events.description: Rodney “Darkchild” Jerkins has shaped pop music for 25+ years, producing hits for icons like Brandy, Beyoncé, MJ, and SZA. Now leading his indie label Alienz Alive, he joins The MLC’s Jamie Dominguez for a candid fireside chat on legacy, ownership, and building a sustainable career with purpose. Jerkins shares lessons learned, what the industry gets wrong, and how transparency, mentorship, and community can help creators thrive in today’s ever-evolving, Wild West-like music economy.

speakers.name: Rodney Jerkins
speakers.title: GRAMMY Award winning super-producer, artist, and founder/CEO

events.title: Eyewitness to Power: Citizen Journalism, Viral Video & Accountability
events.description:
Armed with a phone: This panel explores how everyday people—armed only with cell phones—have become primary witnesses to state violence and how their footage reshapes public narrative and justice processes. #WhileBlack shows both the moral power and unpredictable personal cost of such witnessing. While the recent video of the Minneapolis ICE shooting underscores how recordings can surface in real time to both inform and inflame national debate, #WhileBlack, is also set in Minneapolis and it explores the impact of witnessing on the brave citizen journalists who are increasingly becoming harbingers of the truth.  Who gets to record, who gets to be believed, who gets protection, and how do social platforms’ monetize the impact of visceral, real-world events? #WhileBlack powerfully examines some of the most viral murders and beatings by police over generations through the lens of technology.

Trauma in the digital age: Repeated viewing of viral moments of racial violence takes a deeply human toll, not only on the witnesses themselves but on the communities who see themselves reflected in those moments again and again. This panel investigates how does the constant replay of these moments affect mental health, civic engagement, and collective resilience? 

The Ethics of Watching: What does responsible viewing look like, and how do we educate audiences to engage ethically with real-world suffering?

events.title: Featured Session: Social Media Masterclass 2026 with Ex-YouTube & Instagram Insider
events.description: Great content starts with great ideas. In this talk, you’ll learn how to find better ideas for your social posts from Jon Youshaei who worked inside Instagram and YouTube for 8 years. Jon used this process to grow his audience to 1M+ followers while being featured in TIME, Fast Company, and Inc magazine for “cracking the code on how to go viral.” No more running out of ideas. No more waiting for inspiration. Whether you’re trying to grow on Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn, TikTok, or X, this talk outlines a repeatable process to grow your audience — and become a respected voice in your niche.

events.title: Find Your People: The Story Builders Meet Up
events.description: Join Howard Rosenman for an intimate SXSW Meet Up designed for storytellers and Hollywood-curious builders who want real connection and a rare, unfiltered window into how the industry actually works. Rosenman is an Academy Award-winning producer (Best Documentary Feature for Common Threads: Stories from the Quilt) whose credits span Father of the Bride, Buffy the Vampire Slayer, The Family Man, The Celluloid Closet, and Call Me by Your Name.This meet up will open with a short, candid “ask me anything” style kickoff from Howard about building a lasting creative career, earning trust in rooms with high stakes, and what separates projects that get made from projects that stay ideas. The rest of the hour is designed for organic conversation and real introductions, with Howard available for questions and perspective you rarely get outside the Hollywood inner circle.

speakers.name: Howard Rosenman
speakers.title: Movie and Television Producer, Writer & Actor

events.title: From Pitch to Pilot: How Corporates Partner and Build
events.description: Startups are often pitched on “strategic partnerships” with large companies, but most never progress beyond a pilot. This panel features innovation leaders from a healthcare innovation and venture arm, a mobility and sustainability-focused enterprise, and a national restaurant brand redefining service through digital innovation. Together, they’ll unpack how corporates build new ventures, and what it takes for founders to gain traction and create lasting value with enterprise partners.

speakers.name: Stefanie Diaz
speakers.title: Principal Of Innovation And Venture Strategy

events.title: How The Independent Industry Is Uniting To Help Shape Policy
events.description: Join Lisa Hresko of the American Association of Independent Music (A2IM) and Reid Wick of the Recording Academy for a conversation about music advocacy and the work of strengthening creative communities. Together, they’ll explore how industry organizations champion independent voices, shape policy, and create meaningful opportunities for artists and music professionals. The discussion will highlight the practical ways advocacy supports a more connected, sustainable music ecosystem.

speakers.name: Reid Wick
speakers.title: Director of Regional Advocacy & Member Engagement

events.title: How to Manage AI Anxiety at Work
events.description: As AI transforms how we work and lead, it’s not just a technical revolution—it’s an emotional one. In this session, Harvard Business Review author Morra Aarons-Mele explores how current and emerging leaders can manage AI anxiety, build psychological safety for themselves and their teams, and keep humans at the center of innovation. Attendees will learn to navigate fear and resistance with empathy, reframe anxiety as fuel for growth, and lead with clarity, flexibility, and courage through change.

events.title: How to Not Screw Up Your Startup–Answering Legal Questions
events.description: Startup-savvy attorneys bring their real-world experience to SXSW in a fast-paced legal Q&A packed with insight, strategy, and storytelling. From navigating AI patents and trademark showdowns to managing sketchy investors and sudden privacy crises, they’ll tackle complex legal issues with humor and clarity. Attendees get tailored advice, practical tools, and a Startup Legal Survival Kit—no billable hours required. Think speed-dating, but for the legal hurdles every founder faces.

events.title: The Next Evolution of XR & Shared Realities in Entertainment
events.description: Iconic worlds are being reimagined across XR and shared-reality formats, giving audiences new ways to step inside the stories they love. Bringing together leaders from Meta, Universal Film, Nexus Studios and Cosm, we’ll explore how spatial storytelling is evolving as major IP moves into these new environments – and what’s ahead as these mediums step from the bleeding-edge into the mainstream. The panel will unpack what audiences are responding to, how scalable business models are emerging across platforms, and the new creative opportunities this opens up for worldbuilders.

events.title: Pivot Live
events.description: Join tech journalist Kara Swisher and NYU Professor Scott Galloway as they offer sharp, unfiltered insights into the biggest stories in tech, business, and politics. They’ll make bold predictions, pick winners and losers, and bicker and banter like no one else. After all, with great power comes great scrutiny.

events.title: Podcasters Meet Up
events.description: Everyone has a podcast now, but no one really talks about how to actually grow one or make money from it. That’s what this meetup is for. Hosted by Grace Ling and Justin Nguyen from How Creators Make Money podcast, we’re bringing podcasters together to trade real tips, share what’s worked and what hasn’t, and connect with people who get it. Whether you’re on episode 2 or 200, you’ll leave with ideas, new friends, and maybe your next collab.

events.title: Predicting Culture to Power Brand Momentum
events.description: Culture does not shift all at once. There are signals before it moves. This session explores how breakthrough brands identify early patterns, decode what they mean, and act ahead of the curve. Rather than reacting to trends, these leaders use cultural foresight to shape products, missions, and strategies that create momentum. The discussion will offer practical insight into how predicting culture drives relevance, loyalty, and measurable business impact.

events.title: Resilience Through Innovation: AI at NPR and KQED
events.description: With budgets cut, public media faces new threats. Yet the mission remains vital. Hear how public media is embracing innovation with AI-powered creativity and content personalization to community-led storytelling. Join us to explore this dynamic future.

events.title: Robots to Reality: AI Logistics Shaping Consumer Lives
events.description:
What happens when AI moves beyond the hype and starts transforming the entire journey, from supply chain operations to the customer experience? 
We’ll explore how AI and robotics eliminate friction, anticipate customer needs, and turn operational and behavioral data into faster deliveries, greater transparency, and a seamless, elevated customer experience.

events.title: Round Table: Narrative Filmmaking: Adam Hoelzel, Jessica M. Thompson, and Paul Gandersman
events.description: An extension of our popular Mentor Sessions, our Round Table Sessions not only allow attendees to learn from the industry experts that sit at each of the three tables in this session but they also allow attendees to learn from the questions and experiences of their peers as well. This Round Table Session will bring together industry experts and SXSW attendees for an enlightening discussion on Narrative Filmmaking.

events.title: Their Town
events.description: When Abby’s boyfriend drops out of the high school play, she finds herself helping a school outlier step into the role opposite her. They spend a long night wandering around their town, examining their futures and unearthing surprises from their past.

events.title: Unreasonable by Nature: The Psychology of Consumer Choice
events.description: As much as we'd like to think that splurgy new car and our Prime Day shopping carts are the fruits of reason, purchases big and small aren’t governed by logic. People purchase based on who they are, how they feel and what surrounds them at the time. Humans are 'Unreasonable by Nature,' and this panel will illustrate how to grow brands by aligning with the true psychological drivers of consumer decisions. Expert academics from leading American business schools, Ryan Hamilton, Alix Barasch and Keisha Cutright, will explore how rational marketing tactics often fail where unreasonable appeals win.

speakers.name: Keisha Cutright
speakers.title: Associate Professor of Marketing
speakers.company: Duke University’s Fuqua School of Business

speakers.name: Alix Barasch
speakers.title: Associate Professor of Marketing

events.title: When the Future Dies: Ritualizing Grief + Joy
events.description: Building on last year's session 'Putting Endings in Our Beginnings', Juli Rush continues sharing her research on how we might ritualize both joy + grief as individuals and collectives to build more resilient systems. Bringing her work as a futurist, researcher at the University of Houston, and as a death doula, Juli shares both ancient and new rituals to employ within a chaotic and complex world. This work focuses on disrupting our business-as-usual world to build futures that see endings as new possibilities for the future.

speakers.name: Juli Rush
speakers.title: Adjunct Faculty in Foresight Grad Program

events.title: Who Owns Me? Legal War Over Identity in the Creator Economy
events.description: Who owns your face, your voice, your following? In the creator economy, your identity is currency but also your biggest legal risk. This session exposes how influencers, founders, and professionals are losing control of their name, image, and likeness (NIL) in business disputes, brand deals, and even divorce. With deepfakes and Al cloning now part of the mix, you'll learn how to lockdown your identity before someone else monetizes it. If you are the brand, you better own it. Your face may be famous, but it's also vulnerable.

events.title: Why Isn’t Gen Z Having Sex? How Politics Invaded the Bedroom
events.description:
Young people are in the midst of a sex recession – they’re having much less sex, way less often – and they’re taking flak from all sides. Some say young women are too sex negative in the wake of #MeToo and the fall of Roe v Wade. Others blame young men for becoming enamored with the manosphere and internet porn. 

Placed against the backdrop of a sexually-conservative, anti-LGBTQ+ Trump administration – and a Democratic opposition too scared to broach the subject – this conversation will explore Gen Z’s worries about romance and dating, and what it means for the rest of us.

events.title: Wired for Change: How AI Is Supercharging Clean Energy
events.description: The transition to renewable energy systems presents unprecedented challenges for power system reliability and financial stability during the integration of clean energy sources. AI technology transforms the ability of utilities and investors and technologists to predict renewable energy output while maintaining grid stability and securing funding for advanced energy infrastructure. The panel unites experts from the technology and finance sectors with industry professionals and policymakers to examine AI's practical effects on future energy systems.

events.title: Mile End Kicks
events.description: Grace Pine, a driven though easily distracted 23-year-old. She leaves her quirky parents’ home for a shared apartment found on Craigslist to devote herself to writing the next great book in the 33 1/3 album exploration series. Hers will be on the iconic Alanis Morissette opus Jagged Little Pill. Loft parties introduce Grace to two paramours. Unfortunately, they are members of the same rock band, Bone Patrol. And instead of sequestering herself away to complete her draft, she uses her music industry know-how to get in with the band as their publicist.Through wine-fuelled poetry readings and other ill-advised choices, Grace is in the trenches of self-discovery.

events.title: Basht.
events.description:
"Basht. are an Irish band whose backgrounds collide into something heavy and hungry." - DORK

Following on from a year of supporting Wunderhorse on tour, as well as shows with Been Stellar, Goo Goo Dolls and Deadletter, Basht. have earned their stripes with emphatic live performances. Having propelled themselves up to being one of the hottest rock/alternative acts, whispers of more new music on the horizon leaves many in eager anticipation for 2026.
events.venue: Radio Day Stage @ Downright Austin Backyard

events.title: For the Students Meet Up
events.description: Following How to Get the Job: Building a Career in Music, FTS will open doors for a casual mixer and industry networking session. FTS team members will be on the ground alongside panelists Sofia Martinez (WME) and Philip Payne (Plan A Consulting). With Philip serving as the professor behind FTS' Music Business Foundations program and Sofia being an alumni of the program herself, this will be a good-spirited community meet-up where badge-holders from across the music industry can connect, swap stories, and chop it up about their individual pathways into the space.

events.title: High Score Game Arcade presents the Worldwide Tic-Tac-Toe Championship
events.description:
The Worldwide Tic Tac Toe Championship comes to its final, high-stakes moment at SXSW. After months of play across cities and communities around the world, this activation marks the culmination of a global tournament—bringing finalists, fans, and curious passersby together for live competition, spectacle, and celebration. Simple rules, universal appeal, and unexpected intensity converge in one last showdown where strategy, speed, and bragging rights are decided in real time.

More information here: highscoregamearcade.com

events.title: Joybubbles
events.description: A boy discovers he can control the global telephone system by whistling a magic tone. Born blind and yearning for connection, his early obsession with the telephone sparks a subculture that shapes the future of hacking and technology.

events.title: Paralyzed by Hope: The Maria Bamford Story
events.description: Blurring the line between performance and personal crisis, comedian Maria Bamford turns her mental health journey into material that’s riotously funny and ultimately inspiring. What emerges is a portrait of an artist transforming vulnerability into creative strength through honesty.

events.title: Paramount+ The Lodge
events.description: The Paramount+ Lodge returns with the ultimate fan experience, offering an unforgettable and immersive journey that lets guests engage with hit content, iconic franchises and live championship sports. Back for its fourth consecutive year, the Lodge takes over Clive Bar on Austin’s Rainey Street, transporting fans and new audiences into the worlds of their favorite series and sports on Paramount+.

events.title: Pizza Movie
events.description: It’s a Friday night and college students Jack and Montgomery have got big plans: They’re going to do drugs and order pizza. But when the home-made drug they ingest turns out to be MUCH wilder than they thought, the simple journey down two flights of stairs to retrieve their pie becomes a mind-bindingly transformative quest. Still though, how hard can it be? The only thing in their way is a broken elevator, Montgomery’s social anxiety, the fact that everybody in the school hates Jack, a sociopathic RA, a vengeful butterfly, a robot with a dream, and this insane drug that has absolutely no regard for the basic laws of reality.

events.title: SXSW Film & TV Clubhouse
events.description: The Film & TV Clubhouse is located at 800 Congress Ave, just steps away from the Paramount Theatre, where some of the most exciting screenings of the Festival are set to premiere. It will serve as the home base for the film community to gather, discuss, and network. Each day the Film & TV Clubhouse will host meetups and networking events as well as activations.

events.title: SXSW Innovation Clubhouse
events.description: The historic Brazos Hall is the official Innovation Clubhouse for 2026. It's the perfect place to connect with attendees looking to gain insights and inspiration from like-minded conference-goers. Each day the Innovation Clubhouse will host meetups and networking events as well as activations.

events.title: SXSW Music Clubhouse
events.description: The Music Clubhouse is located at The Downright Austin. Perfect for networking and industry connections, the Clubhouse will also feature live performances at Radio Day Stage and mentor sessions. It’s also the perfect spot to access most of our music venues by foot or a quick rideshare. Each day the Music Clubhouse will host meetups and networking events as well as activations.

events.title: Vibrating Music Hammocks
events.description:
The Music Hammock transforms its fabric into a speaker, resonating your body with the frequencies of the music so you feel as if you’re lying inside a sound system. In our fast-paced society, we often disconnect from our bodies. This installation offers a full-body listening experience, shifting your attention from mental chatter into physical awareness. Experience sound not only through your ears, but through your entire body.

events.title: We Are The Shaggs
events.description: Three sisters from rural New Hampshire formed a band in the late 1960s, but not by choice. Betty, Dorothy, and Helen Wiggin had no interest in playing music. In fact, they had no musical abilities at all. It was their father Austin, inspired by a prophecy, who became convinced that his girls would become rock stars. He pulled his daughters out of school, bought them a pair of cheap guitars and a drum kit, dubbed them The Shaggs, and basically commanded them to make music. In 1969, he brought the girls to a storefront recording studio outside of Boston, and the result is one of the most head-scratching and polarizing albums ever committed to vinyl. "We Are The Shaggs" is their story.

events.title: Daughters of the Forest
events.description:
"Daughters of the Forest" is a story of entanglements: between humans and mushrooms; the visible and the invisible; generational knowledge and modern science. This sci-fi documentary invites us to reconsider the experiences of both human and non-human inhabitants of our world.

We follow Lis and Juli, two young scientists from indigenous communities that have long lived in symbiosis with the many mushrooms in their regions. The world they know is changing, and their pursuits are threatened by deforestation, lack of opportunity, and loss. Still, they share how mushrooms show us different possibilities of coexistence, helping them overcome obstacles to reshape their lives and futures.

events.title: Keynote: Why the Future of AI Must be Human Centric
events.description: AI scientist, entrepreneur, and investor Rana el Kaliouby has devoted her life’s work to humanizing technology before it dehumanizes us. In this conversation with journalist and podcast host Bob Safian, Dr. el Kaliouby explains what it means to keep humans at the center of the AI revolution. The next generation of AI companies will radically shift the way we work, live, and connect. How do we innovate with intention in the race ahead? Dr el Kaliouby demonstrates how to leverage the economic opportunity of AI while unlocking human potential – and solving humanity’s most challenging problems.

speakers.name: Bob Safian
speakers.title: Host of Rapid Response; Founder of The Flux Group; Former Editor-in-Chief of Fast Company

events.title: KOJ
events.description:
KOJ is the sound of defiance rising from Liverpool, UK: a working-class voice turned outward, loud enough to cut through the noise, resilient enough to remain unshaken, and connected enough to represent a frustrated generation.

Drawing from the raw British sub-cultural sounds of Grime, Rap and Punk, KOJ creates music that confronts power while rooted in relatability and everyday struggle. Revolutionary in spirit yet populist in appeal, his music is built to connect, move, and be felt collectively. At its core is courage - raw, direct lyricism exploring survival and defiance, darkness and light, pressure and pride.

KOJ showcased his lyrical authority on his acclaimed debut EP Villain With A Conscience, earning support from Clash, Wonderland, The Face, Apple Music and Amazon Music.
Live is where KOJ reaches another level. He doesn’t perform - he leads. From Boomtown to Radio 1 Big Weekend, Reeperbahn and SXSW, his shows become charged, communal moments where tension turns to release.

More than a catalogue, KOJ is building a movement through purpose-driven visuals, tech-led collaborations and his growing TRiBE community — “a man on a mission,” as The F-Word Magazine puts it.
events.venue: Radio Day Stage @ Downright Austin Backyard

events.title: Still Blank
events.description: Still Blank’s sound is a unique blend of shoegaze haze, folk intimacy, and emotionally raw ambient alt-rock grit. With lyrics steeped in people-watching, dreams, nature, and existential observation, their songwriting draws from both introspection and their surroundings. Ben and Jordy met by chance in Liverpool 2 years ago sparking a lightning-in-a-bottle creative partnership. What started as casual jam sessions in a basement quickly evolved, with sessions ranging from stripped-back recordings on a broken classical guitar to studio lock-ins fuelled by long walks through rural Wales and a shared commitment to imperfection. In May 2025 they performed their first show as a band at Permanent Records Roadhouse. Debut single "What About Jane" is a grungy, folk-inflected reflection on identity, societal perception, and the expectations we’re forced to confront to uncover who we really are.
events.venue: British Music Embassy @ Palm Door on Sixth Patio

events.title: XOT Energy House
events.description: XOT Energy House lands at the SXSW Artist Lounge as a dynamic space built to fuel creativity. This experience invites artists and attendees to recharge with XOT Energy while connecting through music, culture, and movement. Blending vibrant fruits and high-energy moments, the XOT Energy House becomes a hub for discovery, expression, and inspiration throughout SXSW.
events.venue: Downright Hotel - Creekside Room & Outdoor Patio

events.title: Jenna Cole
events.description:
Jenna Cole is a Newcastle-based Afrobeats artist, songwriter and producer creating globally-minded music from the heart of Whitley Bay. Blending warm vocals with infectious rhythms and soulful melodies, her sound moves between Afrobeats, R&B and Pop, delivering records that feel both intimate and energetic.

As a former principal Songwriter and Creative Director within a major label girlband line up, Jenna has taken this vast experience and continued to develop her songwriting and production as a solo Artist, crafting a sonic that is true to her roots and rapidly connecting with her new-found international audience. After amassing over 2M views and 500k streams on her debut release in 2025, she was named a BBC Introducing  "One to Watch" for 2026, and makes her live US debut at SXSW Austin.
events.venue: Radio Day Stage @ Downright Austin Backyard

events.title: One World? Rethinking Cosmopolitanism
events.description:
This panel examines cosmopolitanism as a concept that seems outdated in times of nationalism and polarization. Teddy Cruz and Fonna Forman focus on cross-border urban projects in their work, taking a bottom-up approach, while artist Thomas Mandl addresses the topic from a top-down perspective with his One World Flag. Together, the panel will address the question of how architecture, initiatives, and symbols can promote solidarity as a lived political practice and how global belonging can be rethought today.

https://www.german-haus.com

events.title: The Comeback Season 3
events.description: 20 years after the first season debuted in 2005, and 10 years after season two, the HBO original comedy series "The Comeback," from Michael Patrick King and Lisa Kudrow, will return again for a third and final season.

events.title: Rana el Kaliouby Book Signing
events.description: Rana el Kaliouby will be signing copies of “Girl Decoded: A Scientist's Quest to Reclaim Our Humanity by Bringing Emotional Intelligence to Technology” at the SXSW Bookstore.

events.title: Hector Gannet
events.description: Hector Gannet are from the town of North Shields, high on England’s north east coast. Things centre on lead singer-songwriter Aaron Duff whose compositions draw closely on his beloved home terrain. Yet Hector Gannet’s music – folk, rock, ancient, modern – also reaches out into the wider world. Hector Gannet have been praised by music lovers from Chris Packham to Sam Fender, while Uncut magazine acclaimed the band as “North Shields’ answer to Crazy Horse”. There have been live dates with artists from Elbow, Sea Power to Lindisfarne, Richard Thompson & Kathryn Williams – & massive shows with Sam Fender at the vast North Eastern shrine that is St James’ Park football ground. Hector Gannet have drawn pleasing reactions. On BBC 6 Music, musician and broadcaster Tom Robinson greeted a “band of exceptional talent”. In a **** review, MOJO magazine saluted the “pointedly political, natural-world-advocating folk rock” of their The Land Belongs To Us album. Louder Than War website put Hector Gannet among 25 bands to change your life. Forthcoming album includes rousing soul sermons which blend their North Eastern heart with touches of Dexy’s, Style Council-period Weller and a bit of the Boss
events.venue: British Music Embassy @ Palm Door on Sixth Patio

events.title: Art to Infrastructure: Creating a Company as an Artist
events.description: Join actor Billy Magnussen and the co-founder of his production company HappyBad Bungalow, alongside representatives from artist-led companies Madhouse Films and Not Your Daddy’s Films, for a candid conversation on building and sustaining a company as an artist.

events.title: Artist Demo Listening Session Hip-Hop/Rap/R&B (Part 2)
events.description: Artist Demo Listening Sessions, Presented by Discovr Radio, at SXSW are an interactive format where attendees have the opportunity to play demos for music experts, sparking real-time feedback and meaningful industry connections. You must be present to have your music in the running to be heard! SXSW attendees not having demos played are encouraged to attend and listen in on the fun! Each session will be followed up a social hour. Physical submissions will not be accepted at the door. events.title: Boundary Breakers & Innovators Meet Up
events.description:
Join us to explore the bleeding edge. Strange ideas, emerging research, and projects that don’t quite fit anywhere else yet. The conversation is intentionally cross-disciplinary and open to ideas from any industry or domain.

Come armed with the niche interest you’ve been diving deep on. We want to hear what you’re most excited about and spark conversations that stretch beyond the obvious.

events.title: Cassettes & Cults: Making The Red Weather Podcast
events.description: Using the scripted podcast Red Weather as a focused case study, this session explores how narrative audio is developed from script to final performance, and why podcasts have become a powerful, creator-driven pathway for original IP. With creator Rider Strong and key cast members, the panel examines writing, performance, and collaboration, with a focus on practical, on-location recording in real environments — redwoods, diners, and moving cars — and how physical space shapes immersive audio storytelling.

events.title: Casting TV In The 21st Century
events.description: No art form encapsulates the shifting landscape of media from the 20th to 21st centuries quite like television. What started out as 3 broadcast networks derived from radio has grown into a global juggernaut of content consumption. How has casting for scripted series morphed and changed alongside the gargantuan changes in how audiences watch television? How has the workflow of casting augmented in the wake of the COVID-19 pandemic? How is casting for television unique and distinct from casting for feature films? Three of Hollywood's top casting directors are here to answer your questions.

events.title: The City That Plays: Digital Twins Reimagining LA & Beyond
events.description: Los Angeles is a vibrant playground for innovation where data, design, and community imagination converge. Powered by cutting-edge Earth-observing satellite systems, digital twins are transforming how LA plans for resilience, equity, and the joy of the games. Join us to explore groundbreaking projects—from wildfire recovery to creating green space networks—that leverage user-friendly immersive technology to connect AI, local stories, and spatial data. Discover how these immersive tools are shaping a smarter, more resilient city ready for the Olympics and the complex challenges ahead.

events.title: Composing for Wellness: Music as a Cognitive Utility
events.description: As streaming reshapes how music is experienced, functional audio—designed to boost focus, mood, and behavior—is redefining where and how music matters. From classrooms to clinics to retail, neuroscience-backed compositions are driving emotional outcomes and creating measurable improvements in learning, productivity, and sentiment. This panel explores how composers, researchers, and platforms are creating purpose-built music that now outperforms major label artists—financially and functionally—on DSPs and B2B services.

speakers.name: Max Ferguson
speakers.title: Senior Creative Manager - Sync Licensing, Artist Development, Catalog Strategy

events.title: The Creator Playbook for Successful Content & Communities
events.description: The creator economy is demanding. Success requires adapting to constant shifts in algorithms and platform policies, as well as mastering how to build a loyal community and creating content that truly moves, engages, and stands out in a saturated feed. Join creator marketing leaders from Epidemic Sound and Patreon for this hands-on workshop focused on translating expertise into sustainable income. You will learn and immediately apply proven strategies for compelling storytelling, community growth, and leveraging music to maximize your content's success. Laptops are required for this session.

events.title: Culture Meets Commerce: Building the Next $1B Brand
events.description:
Emma Grede, serial entrepreneur and multiple-time billion-dollar brand founder, joins Alison Furman, PwC US Consumer Markets Industry Partner, and Dallas Dolen, PwC US Technology, Media & Telecommunications Industry Partner, for an engaging panel discussion on how culture and commerce collide to create the next billion-dollar product category.

The discussion will explore how cultural relevance, technology, and consumer behavior intersect to help shape emerging brands, and what today’s business leaders should understand to build, scale, and sustain the next generation of category-defining companies.

events.title: Data Equity Core Conversation
events.description: As data becomes the raw material of modern life, how do we ensure it's collected, shared, and used in ways that build, not break, trust? This structured meet-up invites technologists , policymakers, and community advocates to explore responsible data practices across industries. Together, we’ll reflect on the disappearance of public data, rising mistrust in institutions, and what it means to build for integrity, transparency, and equity. Participants will share challenges and insights, contribute to a collective best practices, and connect with others shaping the future of ethical data use.

events.title: The Founder’s Edge: How Psychedelics Unlock Creativity, Resilience, and Conscious Leadership
events.description: Startup founders face relentless pressure, emotional volatility, and decision fatigue. This session explores how intentional psychedelic experiences, combined with integration practices, can expand perspective, dissolve ego-driven blind spots, and strengthen leadership presence. Drawing from The Mind Shift Network’s work with executives and entrepreneurs, we’ll examine how psychedelics catalyze authentic innovation, emotional intelligence, and purpose-driven company culture.

events.title: From Monk to Manager: Zen Lessons for Loving Your Work
events.description: By most accounts Jackson Kerchis has had an unusual career path: he launched a (failed) fintech startup, created the world's first major in happiness, lived 4 months as a Zen monk, spent 2 years in management, and then founded a consulting firm researching happiness at work. This session combines the art of Zen with insights from the social sciences to help you craft a new way of work. Even if you don't have your "dream job," you'll learn the ingredients for what makes for an engaging and satisfying work experience.

events.title: From Niche to Noticed: New Paths for Indie Films
events.description: You made a great film. Now what? With streamers scaling back, traditional buyers pulling out, and theatrical costs soaring, indie filmmakers are left navigating a broken and uncertain distribution pipeline. This session explores bold, alternative release strategies—grassroots outreach, community-driven campaigns, eventized theatrical runs, digital-first models, and more—that are helping meaningful, niche stories find their audiences. We’ll examine the macro industry shifts behind the disruption and spotlight the innovative approaches rewriting the independent film playbook.

events.title: The Hour That’ll Define 2026: Culture, Trends, & What’s Next
events.description:
Most trend reports feel like homework. Not this one.

This is an hour of zero effort, all takeaways.

Chris Danton and Kirsten Ludwig have spent the year decoding what’s actually happening across culture, F&B, Silvers, Alphas, retail, tech, wellness, beauty, and travel for GOOD THINKING — the newsletter 16K+ executives at Target, LVMH, and Klaviyo wait for every week.

Now they’re bringing you the distilled version:

10 trends that matter most for 2026 — delivered with pace, perspective, and zero patience for the obvious.

You’ll leave knowing exactly what to do on Monday — and how to think for the year ahead.

events.title: How Creators Teach: Turning Knowledge Into Income and Community
events.description:
​Today’s leading creators aren’t just entertaining; they’re teaching and sharing information. From wellness challenges and cohort-based coaching to digital courses and paid memberships, creator-led learning has become one of the most sustainable ways to grow audience, revenue, and build community.

In this session, you’ll learn which learning formats from cohorts to in-person retreats are working now (and which have burned out). Panelists will break down how to design and monetize educational content that builds loyalty, whether you’re launching your first paid challenge, growing a coaching business, or integrating brand partners into your community. You’ll leave with a framework for launching your own “creator classroom”, one that deepens connection and drives consistent income.

speakers.name: Olivia Owens
speakers.title: Head Of Creator Partnerships & Business Development

events.title: How to Avoid Spreading Misinformation on Your Platform
events.description:
It’s no secret that today’s media landscape is more fractured than ever. As trust in legacy media declines, people are consuming news in less traditional ways and, instead, often turn to content creators for the latest news, commentary, and connection. But how can they balance influence and responsibility in such a fast-paced digital ecosystem?

Join industry-leading creators and strategists in conversation to explore how, in a digital world driven by clicks and engagement, you can communicate responsibly online. We’ll dive into how to build and leverage community, recognize and preempt false narratives, and turn complex realities into sharable content while engaging your audience authentically.

events.title: Immigrant Founders: Fueling America’s Future
events.description: Immigration is a contentious and tumultuous topic these days. But the contributions of global talent are clear: Immigrants make up only 15% of the U.S. population, but 40% of Nobel science laureates and 44% of tech unicorn founders. Tom Zhang made his way from a small town in rural China to an Ivy League PhD and an Austin-based robotics startup. Doug Rand has helped global talent navigate the immigration system as a senior government official, co-founder of Boundless, and now head of a philanthropic fund. While many recent immigration policies may create obstacles for global founders, there are still several viable pathways to obtain a visa and start a company in the U.S. Come learn how America can remain the top destination for great immigrant entrepreneurs.

events.title: Is There Too Much Music?
events.description: Congrats, you can release a song in 10 minutes. Now do that every week, promote it constantly, and hope the algorithm’s in a good mood. Everyone celebrates accessibility, but nobody talks about how creators are stuck in a never-ending cycle of release, promote, repeat, with fewer results. What happens when the platforms encourage constant output, but discovery is increasingly unpredictable and unsustainable? Is the current system helping artists succeed, or just keeping them busy? The volume is up, so how do we tune into what really resonates?

events.title: It Writes Itself: AI Variety Show & Creative Workshop
events.description: Based on the “mind-expanding” AI variety show that sold out in NYC, LA, and CDMX, and fresh off of runs at Meta Connect, Disney, and Unilever, IT WRITES ITSELF is “an AI creativity workshop for people who hate workshops.” Part playground, part performance, it’s an interactive mash-up of AI experiments, games, stories and surprises tailored to the folks in the room, resulting in a fun, funny, weird, and occasionally existential workshop like none other. You’ll leave with your brain rewired, curiosity lit up, and a newfound way to explore AI that’s actually fun.

events.title: Jurassic Warnings: What Dinosaurs Knew About the End of the World
events.description: What can a 65-ton dinosaur teach us about the climate crisis and how we care for our health today? In this dynamic session, world-renowned paleontologist Dr. Kenneth Lacovara, who discovered Dreadnoughtus – one of the largest land animals to ever walk the Earth; and bestselling physician-scientist Dr. William Li, explore how the fossils hold urgent lessons for our future. From the extinction of giants like Dreadnoughtus to fossilized evidence of diseases like cancer, they reveal how Earth's deep past can help us understand modern threats to humans – and what we can do about them.

events.title: Lose Your Mind to AI? A Neuroscientist and an AI CEO Debate
events.description: AI can be your most powerful productivity tool… or a shortcut to cognitive decline. Neuroscientist Dr. Sahar Yousef and AI education company CEO Greg Shove debate the ultimate question: “AI feels like borrowing 30 IQ points, but will it ultimately make us dumber?” They will share new, unpublished UC Berkeley data showing that most “AI augmentation” is shallow cognitive offloading in disguise and outline a research-backed playbook for HOW you can leverage AI without losing what makes you most valuable: your mind.

events.title: More Pavlov, Less Badges: Gamification Isn't What You Think
events.description: Before there were prize wheels, badges, and leaderboards, there was a scientist and his dogs. Join gamification experts Adam Messing and Kinley Clifford to talk about the common misconceptions around gamification and how understanding behavioral and motivational science is the key to unlocking it. This interactive workshop will be jam-packed with fun and useful exercises and games.

events.title: Operating Systems of the 3rd Millennium: AI + XR + NEURO
events.description: Neural interfaces are entering a new phase where AI algorithms read brain signals in real-time and power adaptive feedback loops. This panel convenes OpenBCI and cross-disciplinary experts to show how AI turns raw brain signals into actionable insights, powers real-time closed-loop haptics and visuals, and scales from lab demos to consumer and research-grade neurotech. We’ll dissect technical hurdles, safety imperatives, and the roadmap to trustworthy neurotechnology.

events.title: Pokémon Meet Up: Trainers, Creators & Fans Unite!
events.description: Calling all Trainers! From Kanto to Paldea, this high-energy Pokémon Meet Up is your chance to connect, cosplay, and geek out over everything Pokémon. Whether you're a day-one fan, a content creator, or just Poké-curious, join us for a fun, inclusive space to trade stories, show off projects, and celebrate the game that captured the world. Let’s unite, evolve, and catch some unforgettable memories together!

events.title: Reality Hacked: Tech, Story, and the Future of Experience
events.description: What if the real world had hidden story portals waiting to be found? This panel explores an ongoing collaboration between Meow Wolf and Niantic that uses AR, geolocation, and immersive storytelling to transform physical places into layered, interactive experiences. From sidewalks to city parks, spaces become stages for narrative discovery, inviting people to move, play, and connect in new ways. Dennis Hwang (Niantic), Vince Kadlubek (Meow Wolf), and Scott Stein (CNET) join moderator Kati Murphy to share what happens when imagination meets infrastructure—and the streets start telling stories.

speakers.name: Dennis Hwang
speakers.title: VP of Visual and Interaction Design

events.title: Redbreast Unhidden Showcase
events.description:
In partnership with SXSW Film & TV Festival 2026, Redbreast Single Pot Still Irish Whiskey invites you to join in an unforgettable cinematic experience. Accompanied by an iconic Redbreast cocktail and sweet treats, we’re shining a light on five exceptional short films, hand-picked by award-winning Irish actor Andrew Scott. Bold and original, these five shorts represent the best of what the artform has to offer. 

Attendees must be over 21 and be SXSW badge holders. Entry is not guaranteed and permitted on a first come first serve basis.

events.title: Round Table: Documentary Filmmaking: Nilu Amin, Rebecca Stern, and Royd Chung
events.description: An extension of our popular Mentor Sessions, our Round Table Sessions not only allow attendees to learn from the industry experts that sit at each of the three tables in this session but they also allow attendees to learn from the questions and experiences of their peers as well. This Round Table Session will bring together industry experts and SXSW attendees for an enlightening discussion on Documentary Filmmaking.

events.title: Star‑Powered Startups: Hits, Misses & Messes
events.description: This panel builds on last year’s exploration of incubation models to spotlight how celebrities today are acting as startup founders, investors, and brand builders. We’ll unpack the good, bad and ugly details of celebrity‑backed ventures—from Skims to Goop—exploring brand fit, media power, product execution, partnership pitfalls, and long‑term viability. Attendees will gain actionable insights into how celebrity involvement amplifies opportunity… and risk.

events.title: Stop Apologizing to Your AI: How Anthropomorphism Deludes Us
events.description: Why do we talk to our cats, feel guilty throwing away childhood toys, or bond with our robot vacuum? Scientist and bestselling author Justin Gregg reveals how anthropomorphism, one of humanity's oldest psychological quirks, secretly influences nearly every decision we make. Drawing on cutting-edge research from his latest book Humanish, Justin explores our universal tendency to see human-like qualities in everything around us, and shows how understanding this bias can transform our relationships with animals, technology, and each other.

events.title: Summer of ’94
events.description: "Summer of ’94" reveals the wild rise of the U.S. Men’s National Team on the road to the 1994 World Cup—and the history they were never meant to make. With no league and no roadmap, a ragtag group of players and an unlikely coach endured a grueling two-year training camp, hoping simply not to embarrass their nation at the first-ever World Cup on American soil. Armed with camcorders, the players documented it all, capturing raw moments as underdogs grew into future legends. Featuring never-before-seen footage and new interviews with Alexi Lalas, Cobi Jones, Tony Meola, and coach Bora Milutinović, the film shares how chaos, chemistry, and grit forged a brotherhood that changed US soccer forever.

events.title: The Way We Move
events.description: THE WAY WE MOVE is a feature-length documentary about Amber Galloway, a star ASL (American Sign Language) interpreter who specializes in live music interpretations. Amber teaches her art to share her life’s mission : making music accessible to the Deaf community. Armed with her astounding teaching skills, she will take her struggling new recruits on a one-of-a-kind journey, hoping they have what it takes to join her at Austin City Limits music festival. As the film unfolds, we learn about Amber’s painful past and about the lives of her recruits, Julian Ortiz and Angela "AV" Vilavong, as they come together and forge life-long bonds. A film about music, Deaf culture, connection and resilience.
events.venue: Rollins Theatre at the Long Center

events.title: World Travelers Meet Up
events.description: Where to next? This casual meet up is for SXSW attendees who enjoy exploring the world, swapping travel stories, and sharing recommendations for their favorite destinations. If you've traveled to Austin, don't be shy – come say hi, meet fellow travelers, make new connections, and maybe even get inspiration for a future trip.

events.title: XR Filmmakers Meet Up
events.description: Come connect with fellow creators and curious minds exploring XR Film. Whether you’re already making immersive work or just excited by what’s possible, join us to mingle, share ideas, and spark conversations about the future of XR storytelling.

events.title: #Skyking
events.description: In exclusive interviews and air traffic control audio, #SKYKING tells the story of Horizon Air ground service agent Richard “Beebo” Russell, who clocked into work, stole a $33 million plane, and took off into the skies of the Pacific Northwest—embarking on a white-knuckle flight that came to embody the hopes, dreams, and despair of the American working class.
