events.title: Adam's Apple
events.description: "Adam's Apple" is an intimate, collaborative documentary told through the dual perspectives of Adam, a transgender teen, and his mother, visual artist Amy Jenkins, that offers an authentic and tender counterpoint to the hostility facing trans youth today. Adam’s journey balances the milestones of gender transition with the rhythms of adolescence. As Adam asserts his identity and steps out into the world, his parents grapple with the challenges of raising a teen while learning to let go. Through a visually poetic approach, the film transforms a deeply personal archive, collected over two decades, into a powerful, joyful testament to the beauty and difficulty of reckoning with profound change.

events.title: Morra Aarons-Mele Book Signing
events.description: Morra Aarons-Mele will be signing copies of “Anxious Achiever” at the SXSW Bookstore.

events.title: Brian
events.description: It sucks to be Brian. He’s smart, funny, and capable, but his mental health issues make it hard for anyone to see it - especially when compared to his effortlessly cool older brother. At school, Brian harbors an unrequited crush on Brooke: she’s smart, kind, pretty… and very much his teacher. A disastrous drama club audition leads to yet another one of Brian’s trademark public meltdowns. Thus begins Brian’s search for his new “thing”. On paper he’s chosen the worst possible fit: running for class president. With help from his therapist and the new kid, Justin, Brian launches his high-stakes campaign and sparks a messy, exquisitely awkward journey toward self-acceptance.

events.title: Jenna Cole
events.description:
Jenna Cole is a Newcastle-based Afrobeats artist, songwriter and producer creating globally-minded music from the heart of Whitley Bay. Blending warm vocals with infectious rhythms and soulful melodies, her sound moves between Afrobeats, R&B and Pop, delivering records that feel both intimate and energetic.

As a former principal Songwriter and Creative Director within a major label girlband line up, Jenna has taken this vast experience and continued to develop her songwriting and production as a solo Artist, crafting a sonic that is true to her roots and rapidly connecting with her new-found international audience. After amassing over 2M views and 500k streams on her debut release in 2025, she was named a BBC Introducing  "One to Watch" for 2026, and makes her live US debut at SXSW Austin.
events.venue: British Music Embassy @ Palm Door on Sixth

events.title: MEEK
events.description:
You know that moment you realised Lady Gaga was named after a Queen song? MEEK is kind of the musical and stylistic culmination of that connecting glue, the secret chemical equation that bonds them. She is walking class war, musical defiance and the return of glam rock at its most instantly and commercially appealing. She’s dancing on the gay bar bar-top with a sparkler fizzing in your cocktail. 

MEEK is not a work in progress. She is fully formed, earned her stripes, comes from nothing, nepo-baby baiting execution of timeless pop brilliance. While sounding directly descended from the DNA of famed countercultural misfits and bona fide pop aces, all strewn across the decades, her music is a no messing, straight shoot for the top.
events.venue: Radio Day Stage @ Downright Austin Backyard

events.title: Ugly Cry
events.description: When Delaney's boyfriend leaves town to shoot a splashy zombie movie, she becomes obsessed with a character she’s auditioning for after she learns the producers think she has an "ugly cry." But when she tries to make her cry prettier, her performance suffers. Can she contort herself, and her face, to have the perfect cry? Her attempts to change herself cause Young Delaney to haunt her, catapulting present day Delaney deeper down the rabbit hole. She isolates herself and grows increasingly delusional, and interested in physical fixes to her acting problem. How can she make the world see her as she sees herself? How can she become and become and become? She will become famous. Or die trying.

events.title: Apolo
events.description: "Apolo" follows the journey of a family formed by a transgender couple, revealing the nuances of love, daily life, and the constant struggle for recognition and respect. The documentary offers an intimate look into their family dynamics, inviting us to rethink our notions of affection, care, and society itself. As we accompany Apolo’s pregnancy, we are led to reflect on the challenges and dramas faced by the couple — Isis Broken and Lourenzo Gabriel. The father is the one giving birth, and society is not yet ready for that reality. The feature-length documentary marks the directorial debut of actress Tainá Müller and trans woman and musician Isis Broken.

The documentary offers an intimate look into their family dynamics, inviting us to rethink our notions of affection, care, and society itself. As we accompany Apolo’s pregnancy, we are led to reflect on the challenges and dramas faced by the couple — Isis Broken and Lourenzo Gabriel. The father is the one giving birth, and society is not yet ready for that reality. The feature-length documentary marks the directorial debut of actress Tainá Müller and trans woman and musician Isis Broken.

events.title: Plantman & Blondie: A Dress Up Gang Film
events.description:
An offbeat comedy about friendship, purpose, and trying to grow something real in a city built to keep people apart.
Cory is a lonely, doomscrolling thirty-something whose most consistent relationship is with his Instagram algorithm. His apartment? An emotionally vacant, sterile, void. His fridge? Mostly Celsius. And his idea of connection is dodging calls from the one person who still tries: Fox, a soft-hearted, ex-con with terrible advice rooted in institutional paranoia and his love of films. 
Everything shifts when Cory has a run-in, literally, with Plantman, a rogue horticultural crusader armed with a mysterious dossier of negligent plant owners.

events.title: Loren Heat
events.description:
Seductive, sharp, and unapologetically fearless, Loren Heat is a bold new force in UK pop. Emerging from Middlesbrough in the industrial heartland of north east England, Loren wasted no time making waves with their debut EP “Scarlet Haze”.

Exploring the turbulence of admitting your feelings and experiencing some of your hardest points in life, Heat’s heart-on-sleeve lyrics combine the sweetest parts of love with the most vulnerable parts of lust.

Their sharp-edged pop has already caught the attention of major tastemakers including Clash, DIY, Spotify, Apple Music, BBC Introducing, Record of the Day, Notion, Atwood and Earmilk, to name but a few.

Inspired by global icons like Billie Eilish, Lady Gaga, Slayyyter, Dua Lipa and JADE, Loren is as unapologetic as their story – an exploration of queerness, identity and the raw chaos of navigating life in the North East.

After a breakthrough 2025 which saw Heat perform acclaimed sets the likes of The Great Escape, Kendal Calling and BBC Introducing from the Glasshouse, Loren recently inked a deal with Interval Records (Generator/Universal Music Group).
events.venue: British Music Embassy @ Palm Door on Sixth Patio

events.title: Drift
events.description: Isaac “Drift” Wright, a self-taught photographer and Army veteran haunted by trauma, finds healing through breathtaking, illegal climbs of the world’s tallest structures. But his pursuit of art sparks a high-stakes battle with law enforcement in this intimate portrait of risk, resilience, and freedom in modern America.

events.title: Rock Springs
events.description: A grieving Chinese and Vietnamese American family move to an isolated house in a new town. Eight-year-old Gracie, silent since the death of her beloved father, begins to interact with a dark presence in the woods behind their new home. Her mother, Emily, struggles to hide her suffocating grief, cutting her off from Gracie and her mother-in-law, Nai Nai. When Gracie is taken by the dark presence, her family has to confront the ghosts of the past and their shared trauma to find her. The story intertwines historical events from the 1885 massacre of Chinese coal miners with present-day supernatural elements, culminating in a poignant exploration of loss, memory, and reconciliation with the past.

events.title: ASSSSCAT
events.description: UCB’s signature improv juggernaut is a live comedy show with an all-star cast of comedians from film, television, and your favorite streaming services performing improv inspired by true stories from a surprise celebrity guest. ASSSSCAT has played to critical acclaim and sold-out audiences across the country.

events.title: Behind the Scenes of the Fandom Economy
events.description: Reality TV doesn’t just create stars — it creates superfans. Join NBCUniversal and one of their beloved stars for an insider look at how unscripted storytelling turns cast moments, catchphrases, and cultural momentum into full-blown fandoms. From Bravo’s most talked-about franchises to live reunions to Peacock’s social buzz, and IRL fan experiences, this session pulls back the curtain on how obsession is built — and why audiences keep coming back for more. Discover how talent-driven moments spark conversation, fuel community, and open the door for brands to authentically plug into fandom.

speakers.name: Andy Cohen
speakers.title: Host & Executive Producer, 'Watch What Happens Live with Andy Cohen'

events.title: Behind The Viral Hit: Why It's Not What It Seems
events.description: In an era where TikTok virality can catapult unknown artists to millions of streams overnight, the music industry faces a critical question: how do we transform fleeting moments into lasting careers? This panel brings together industry experts to lift the lid on viral streams and explore strategic frameworks that separate one-hit wonders from career artists. Drawing from real-world case studies, the discussion will provide actionable insights for artists, managers, and industry professionals looking to build careers that transcend trending sounds and create lasting cultural impact.

events.title: Brené Brown & Adam Grant Live
events.description: Join us for a live conversation with research professor Brené Brown and organizational psychologist Adam Grant, where they'll explore their shared curiosities and make a special announcement.

events.title: CHALK
events.description:
Chalk is the project of award-winning musicians and filmmaker
duo Ross Cullen and Benedict Goddard. An informed mix of
Dublin's guitar band scene and the sweaty hardcore dance
floors of their native Belfast, Chalk are IDLES meets Daniel Avery,
Death Grips meets Bicep - techno-infused industrial punk.
Since forming in 2022, Chalk have had a rise like no other,
quickly establishing themselves as an unmissable live act and
unpredictable, ferocious songwriters. Their debut UK/IRE tour
sold out, and led to further bookings across Europe as word of
their performance and guitar-melded techno spread via word of
mouth and support with national radio in the UK.
These songs were collated into the Conditions Trilogy, a family of
thirteen tracks that combine gritty Irish and German-influenced
techno and dance music with gothic, post-punk and jagged
guitar riffs and vocal melodies. This unique blend earned them
the support and kudos of their peers in Fontaines D.C., IDLES
and Sprints, all of whom handpicked the band to support them
throughout their tours.
events.venue: Radio Day Stage @ Downright Austin Backyard

events.title: The Creator Strategies Needed to Reach Gen Z & Gen Alpha
events.description: This session will spotlight the increasing momentum of the creator economy and how creators have become role models to younger generations. While most companies remain focused on reaching Gen Z, we’ll discuss how brands will need a fresh creator marketing strategy that merges culture, authenticity, and relevance if they expect to break through with digitally native Gen Alpha, as the oldest approach adulthood in the coming years.

speakers.name: Donna Tuttle
speakers.title: VP of Marketing And Corporate Communications

events.title: Danny Rensch & Dark Squares: Chess, Cults, and Survival
events.description: International Chess Master, Chess.com co-founder, and leading voice for the global chess movement, Danny Rensch will take the stage at SXSW to discuss his newly released memoir. Described as Educated meets The Queen’s Gambit, the book offers a gripping, deeply personal account of his childhood inside an abusive cult and the extraordinary role chess played in helping him survive, rebuild, and ultimately change the trajectory of his life.

events.title: The End of News? Defining Journalism in the Creator Era
events.description: Audiences are increasingly turning to content creators for everything from quick news recaps to in-depth explainers, raising urgent questions about standards and credibility. Is this shift the future of journalism or the erosion of it? Building on original data from the Pew-Knight Initiative and insights from the creator economy, this session will explore how the definition of “journalism” is evolving in real time. We will go beyond debate to identify the tools, norms, and strategic shifts needed to preserve public trust in a creator-driven information ecosystem.

events.title: Featured Session: A Conversation with Jack Conte
events.description:
Jack Conte is CEO and co-founder of Patreon, a media and community platform where creators give their biggest fans access to exclusive works and experiences. He founded Patreon in 2013 with Sam Yam (CTO), driven by the belief that creators should be paid for the value they provide to the world. Jack leads the team on their mission to build tools that give Patreon’s 300,000+ creators freedom, independence and ownership over their work and the communities they build. Since launching, Patreon has sent over $10 billion to creators.

As a filmmaker and touring musician in the bands Pomplamoose and Scary Pockets, Jack has a deep understanding of and appreciation for creators. That passion is the driving force in the work Patreon is doing to usher in a new creative economy that puts the power back in creators’ hands.

events.title: Featured Session: From Meme to Meaning: Making the Most of Accidental Virality
events.description: In today’s content-driven landscape, brands can go viral in ways they never intended. This panel explores the unpredictable nature of online virality through the lens of brands like Nuuly and Graza. Panelists will unpack what it takes to lead with creativity, clarity, and cultural fluency under pressure—and how chaotic moments can become opportunities for connection, growth, and relevance. Expect a rare behind-the-scenes look at the modern social media playbook these experts are writing in real time.

events.title: Featured Session: Reclaiming our Humanity in the Age of AI
events.description: Too often, AI feels like something that’s done to us, not with us or for us. It will affect every aspect of our lives. But AI is neither poison nor panacea. It is and will be what we make it. Now is the moment to shape the future of AI for people. This panel will explore how we build the ecosystem and infrastructure to ensure that people will benefit the most from AI. Experts in AI, philanthropy, and advocacy, will offer a new way of thinking about AI that moves from Silicon Valley’s mantra of “move fast and break things” to an alternative vision that centers our humanity.

speakers.name: John Palfrey
speakers.company: John D. and Catherine T. MacArthur Foundation

events.title: From Headline to Streamer: How Publishers Adapt Stories for TV
events.description:
What makes a piece of journalism ripe for adaptation? As headlines spark conversations across social and in everyday life, studios are attuned to how audiences respond—often using that response to guide their next project. But it’s publishers that are uniquely positioned to bring these stories to the screen, thanks to their unparalleled access to journalists and sources.

Hear from Vox Media, Buzzfeed, and The Atlantic as they share insights on which stories to adapt,  how to decide the best genre for journalism IP, and how to work with journalists to expand reporting across platforms.

speakers.name: Karolina Waclawiak
speakers.title: Head of Documentary and Director of Development, Scripted TV , Buzzfeed Studios

events.title: The Future Of Streaming in the Superfan Era
events.description: Mainstream streaming focuses on personalized algorithms and passive listening. Meanwhile, some niche platforms embrace a participatory model where superfans don’t just consume music—they interact with it, shape it, and financially support creators in real time. These platforms embed tipping, live chat, and fan community engagement into the experience. This panel explores how fandom-driven models are redefining streaming and how “social radio” tech can help mainstream DSPs catch up. What if streaming became social, not solitary?

speakers.name: Janishia Jones
speakers.title: Founder / Researcher

speakers.name: Brian Zisook

events.title: How SXSW Film Composers are Redefining Cinema: Featuring Bear McCreary
events.description:
This panel discussion celebrates ASCAP composers with films screening at
SXSW 2026. We’ll unearth new tools, strategies, discuss biggest film and music trends, and how they are reshaping the world of film composition in this new era of cinema.  Attendees will witness a cue by
cue breakdown, as each composer showcases clips from their films at SXSW and
favorite musical moments. Afterward, select attendees can meet with composers for advice, guidance and
feedback on their work. Moderated by acclaimed composer Bear McCreary (Battlestar Galactica, The Walking Dead, Godzilla: King of
the Monsters).

events.title: In This Together: Power, Partnership & Reproductive Freedom
events.description: Across boardrooms, courtrooms, and communities, a growing wave of men are standing up for reproductive rights and changing conversations around abortion and maternal health. In this session, men across law, business and health advocacy explain why they’ve turned their platforms, personal stories and convictions into action. From expanding access to care, to shifting workplace culture, to fighting for safer childbirth, they actively participate in the movement for health, equity and freedom. With clarity, urgency and humor, this conversation calls in male audiences, giving them ways to show up.

speakers.name: Rob Bonta
speakers.title: Attorney General
speakers.company: State of California Department of Justice

events.title: Launchpad: Ready, Set, Communicate
events.description: Launching a brand? It’s not just what you build. It’s how you talk about it that determines take-off or stall. Strategic communications are your launch control pad. Know what to say and when to say it? Make the right connection and you’re flying. Join this interactive session to discover why comms is your brand’s biggest advantage at launch and beyond. Bring your challenges, get expert feedback and leave ready to make your brand soar.

events.title: Lights Out: Preserving Our Night Sky in the Modern Space Age
events.description: The increasing number and brightness of satellite constellations in Earth's orbit are significantly impacting ground-based and optical astronomy. So how do we balance humanity's expansion into space while protecting our study of the stars from Earth? Join the conversation on a sustainable future for space and hear from the experts on the front lines—astronomers, satellite companies, and space industry pioneers—as they discuss collaborative solutions to mitigate satellite brightness and preserve our night sky.

events.title: The New Gold Rush of AI Data Centers
events.description: As AI accelerates, demand for data centers has sparked a modern-day gold rush reshaping land use, energy, and regional economies. Drawing on her experience developing large-scale projects in high-growth markets, Anita Verma-Lallian explains why certain regions are emerging as AI infrastructure hubs while others face real constraints. She breaks down what drives site selection, from zoning and entitlements to power, water, and community impact, cutting through the hype to reveal where the true opportunities lie and how communities can realistically position themselves for long-term investment.

events.title: The New Growth Playbook: Activate Consulting’s 2026 Tech & Media Outlook
events.description: The global internet, media, and technology industries are entering a new era—one that will unlock more than $1.3 trillion in incremental revenue by 2029. But as silos disappear and competition intensifies, the rules of growth are being rewritten. In this session, Michael J. Wolf, Founder and CEO of Activate Consulting, presents the firm’s 2026 Tech & Media Outlook, revealing how leading companies must rethink strategy, product, and consumer engagement to stay ahead. Learn which trends will define the next phase of the digital economy—and why winning in 2026 will depend on owning attention across every moment of the consumer’s day.

events.title: Pedal Steel Noah
events.venue: Flatstock Stage @ Austin Marriott Downtown (Moontower Hall)

events.title: Power Shift: How Podcasters are Monetizing on Their Terms
events.description:
Today’s creators aren’t just hosting shows – they’re building media empires. In this live conversation, leading voices in podcasting share how they’ve taken their shows to the next level and grown into full-fledged creator brands. They’ll discuss how audience connection, creative control, smart monetization, and business strategy fuel their growth as they scale from indie success to industry icons.


Together, the group will unpack what it now takes to build a show that grows beyond the feed – into community, video, partnerships, products, and more. This is the new era of creator ambition: where podcasts become platforms, creators own their rise, and the next generation of icons are built by those serious about scale.

events.title: Protecting Your Mental Wellness as a Creator with Elyse Myers
events.description: Join creator and NYT bestselling author Elyse Myers for a candid conversation on authenticity, mental wellness, and brand continuity, moderated by acclaimed creator strategist Antonia Alakija. Elyse shares how she protects her voice, navigates imposter syndrome, and embraces her neurodivergence to sustain a recognizable, reliable brand. Drawing from her bestseller That’s a Great Question, I’d Love to Tell You, she brings humor and honesty, showing how embracing lived experiences helps creators stay grounded amid constant digital change.

speakers.name: Elyse Myers
speakers.title: Comedian, Creator, and New York Times Bestselling Author

events.title: Revolutionizing Astronomy with Next Generation Big Data
events.description: Massive datasets, like those in astronomy, are the lifeblood of AI innovation.  The panel, led by researchers from the NSF-Simons AI Institute for Cosmic Origins, will discuss how AI is transforming astronomy to unlock new insights into the origins of our universe. They will present visualizations showing state-of-the-art astronomical datasets built on flagship observations and supercomputing simulations of the Universe. They will discuss how these data can be used to develop novel AI methods that accelerate discovery, expanding the frontiers of AI possibility inside and outside astronomy.

events.title: Sober Space Meet Up - 3/15
events.description: Sober Space is a welcoming gathering place for people in all forms of recovery during SXSW 2026. This space hosts all-format recovery meetings for Friends of Bill and all SXSW attendees who are seeking a supportive meeting environment during the festival. Participants are invited to sit together and share experience, strength, and hope in a confidential, judgment-free setting. Meetings are facilitated by The SIMS Foundation alongside trusted leaders from the recovery community.

events.title: Tech Happens Here: Libraries as Innovation Partners
events.description: Libraries are books and so much more! We will spotlight how public and national libraries are launchpads for emerging tech, from AI to XR, while staying rooted in community trust and accessibility. Hear from library innovators and creative technologists co-creating inclusive spaces for play, learning, and critical tech discourse. We’ll explore libraries bridging the gap between innovation and equity, and how YOU can partner with them to build meaningful, community-driven projects. Expect a lively conversation that challenges assumptions, shares real-world collaborations, and sparks new ideas.

speakers.name: Jennifer Cleary
speakers.title: Director, Combined Arts and North West

speakers.name: Oonagh Murphy
speakers.title: Senior Lecturer in Digital Culture and Society

events.title: Tech Made in France Meet Up
events.description: Founders, investors, corporates & service providers from all sectors: come plug into the French Tech ecosystem at the Tech Made in France Meet Up! France is now Europe’s #1 tech ecosystem, home to some of the world's finest innovators and companies. Let’s unlock transatlantic opportunities & collaborations!

events.title: Tech-Free Creativity and Connection Meet Up
events.description:
Take a break from the buzz of SXSW at our second annual Tech-Free Creativity and Connection Meet Up — Something to Write Home About edition.

Unplug and create a one-of-a-kind postcard to your future self or someone special. With scratch art, embroidery, colored pencils, and more, this screen-free space invites artists, makers, and daydreamers to connect and create. Stamps will be provided so you can mail your creation or leave it to us to send out. 

Drop by anytime and stay as long as you like. Reflect, recharge, and create something special to write home about.

events.title: Too Many Interests? Good! Build Your Career Around Them.
events.description: What if your dream job doesn’t exist? So you create it! During this interactive session, award-winning designer and creative educator Julie Bonner shares how she built a joyful, sustainable career by making a living from her diverse interests. Through branding, community, and creative entrepreneurship, Julie shows how to create a clear professional story and turn multiple interests into real income.

events.title: Welcome to the Transformation Economy
events.description: As we shift deeper into today’s Experience Economy, people increasingly want to go beyond merely memorable to highly meaningful, deeply transporting, and even truly transformative experiences. B. Joseph Pine II, author of the 2026 book The Transformation Economy: Guiding Customers to Achieve Their Aspirations, shows why this is so and how brands can help customers flourish by guiding them to become who they want to become, whether that’s improving wellbeing, increasing prosperity, developing knowledge, or finding purpose.

events.title: Why Innovative Mental Health Benefits Are the Future of Work
events.description: Mental health is now a make-or-break factor in workforce productivity, retention, and culture. But traditional offerings - meditation apps, and EAPS - aren’t cutting it. This panel explores bold, evidence-backed solutions like ketamine-assisted therapy, stellate ganglion block, and emerging psychedelic treatments. Hear from leading researchers and forward-thinking employers who are reshaping mental health support to drive performance, reduce costs, and keep their people thriving.

events.title: KING NO-ONE
events.description:
With a name as regal as their ambition, KNO are reshaping boundaries as they set out to release their debut album in April 2026.

This charismatic trio built their reputation through relentless touring and a catalogue of singles that bristle with both confidence and vulnerability.

Glistening guitar riffs, punchy rhythms and poetic narratives ensure their sound is both urgent and heartfelt.

These narratives are channelled into lyrics that are as revealing as they are relatable.

The songwriting is a testament to their roots. Each track is a vignette of life, steeped in nostalgia, resilience and a yearning to belong. It’s music that’s as much about catharsis as it is about connection.

First single ‘Transgressions’ is a confessional anthem. Nostalgia and identity are painted vividly in the second single as the band retrace childhood, its warmth underpinning an unflinching honesty.

Yet it’s the title track which lies at the emotional heart of this debut. Empathy is portrayed as both gift and curse, a force that connects deeply to others’ pain, yet at times threatens to overwhelm.

It’s a debut album that’s as unguarded and unflinching as the band themselves, sure to resonate with anyone whose heart has ever felt too full.
events.venue: British Music Embassy @ Palm Door on Sixth

events.title: Comic Relief and The Moth Present: Funny Story
events.description: Two powerhouses unite for an unforgettable evening of stories at SXSW Comedy Fest. The Moth—whose live storytelling events and beloved podcast have brought over 65,000 true personal stories to audiences worldwide—partners with Comic Relief to present a special Moth Mainstage show featuring a cast of comedians.As Comic Relief marks 40 years of harnessing laughter for good, and The Moth nears 30 years of connecting the world through the power of true personal stories -- this show brings together storytellers who understand that humor can shift perspectives, build bridges, and inspire action. Expect raw, hilarious, and deeply human tales.

events.title: Film & TV Industry Happy Hour
events.description: Join Aputure at our SXSW Film & TV Happy Hour! We’ll provide drinks, bites, vibes and a space to network with other film and TV professionals. We invite you to spend the evening connecting, learning, and sharing ideas with other filmmakers, crew, and creatives!

events.title: Marketplace

events.title: Tennessee House - Meet Memphis on Sunday evening
events.description:
The Tennessee House showcases what's happening in tech, innovation, and culture across the Volunteer State. Be there for 3 days of bold thinking, eye-opening connections, and unforgettable fun.

Grab your blue suede shoes & head west to the Digital Delta – we're spotlighting Memphis from 5pm to 10pm. Meet the entrepreneurs behind Bluff City's most exciting companies, and explore the future with game-changing data centers.

Doors open at 5pm ** Limited-edition swag, bites, and drinks **

events.title: Tom A Smith
events.description: A 21 year old singer/songwriter/producer based in Sunderland, England.  Signed to Fiction Records and previously worked with Miles Kane and Hugo White (The Maccabees(

events.title: Grind
events.description:
This horror anthology tackles the modern work landscape through four timely perspectives – the hustle culture of an MLM, the endless repetitiveness of a food delivery driver, the online horrors of a content moderator, and the unionization of a familiar-feeling coffee shop. "Grind" shows what it means to be a worker in a world defined by wealth inequality and ruled by endlessly greedy oligarchs, one not so far removed from our own. 

This is a film for anyone who's ever hated their job, had a bad boss, or felt taken advantage of at work. In other words, it's a film for all of us.

events.title: Hokum
events.description: When novelist Ohm Bauman retreats to a remote inn to scatter his parents’ ashes, he is consumed by tales of a witch haunting the honeymoon suite. Disturbing visions and a shocking disappearance forces him to confront dark corners of his past.

events.title: Normal (on 35mm)
events.description: The latest collaboration between Bob Odenkirk, "John Wick" creator Derek Kolstad and "Nobody" producer Marc Provissiero, director Ben Wheatley’s kinetic neo-Western stars Odenkirk as an unassuming substitute sheriff with a troubled past who, after moving to a small, sleepy town, responds to a bank robbery and unknowingly uncovers something far more explosive.

events.title: They Called Us Outlaws - The Cosmic Cowboys, Honky Tonk Heroes and Rise of Redneck Rock
events.description: What happened in Austin and in Nashville in the late 60s and early 70s was nothing less than a tectonic shift in country music.  From Tennessee to Texas, musicians were breaking rules and flouting tradition in what the industry would come to label - Outlaw Country.  Featuring over 120 recording artists, songwriters and producers;  including the legends that created the sound and the scene and the current stars and emerging artists that are taking it forward.
events.venue: Rollins Theatre at the Long Center

events.title: #WhileBlack
events.description: #WhileBlack is an urgent documentary that centers on one of the most viral videos of our time: George Floyd’s murder, seen 1.4 billion times in 12 days, sparking protests in over 2,000 cities worldwide. With exclusive access to Darnella Frazier and others like  Diamond Reynolds, who livestreamed Philando Castile’s killing, the film reveals how social platforms and corporations profit from viral Black trauma, while survivors endure lasting psychological and physical danger. #WhileBlack is a powerful meditation on modern witnessing, exposing the human cost of viral footage while asking urgent questions about race, technology, and accountability.

events.title: The Dads
events.description: Inspired by the Emmy-Award winning short documentary of the same name (Netflix, 2023), "The Dads" chronicles fathers of trans and nonbinary children as they are forced to choose between country and family when a new right-wing administration and conservative Supreme Court take hold in the United States. Filmed over the course of a year spanning retreats in rural Maine and Minnesota, protests, family milestones, a pivotal U.S. Supreme Court decision, and the collapse of gender-affirming care for youth, "The Dads" captures this national reckoning with remarkable intimacy through verite footage and interviews with the film’s main protagonists. This is fatherhood as an act of radical resistance.

events.title: Gotham Comedy Club Presents
events.description: Gotham Comedy Club is one of New York’s most popular stand-up destinations. For almost 30 years, their coveted stage has hosted national acts and fostered generations of young comedians into heavyweights who still call Gotham home. Tonight they're back at the fest, bringing some of Gotham’s stars to the stage at SXSW.Full lineup coming soon!

events.title: I Got Bombed at Harvey's
events.description: In 1980, an ingenious boobie-trapped ticking time bomb - filled with 1,000 pounds of dynamite - was wheeled in the front doors of Harvey’s Wagon Wheel Casino in Lake Tahoe. Along with the bomb was a note demanding $3 million within 24 hours. While the bomb squad attempts to disarm the explosive, the FBI races the clock to deliver the ransom and simultaneously catch the extortionists. Nothing goes as planned, and each step uncovers darker secrets and suspicions of a deeper motive.

events.title: Monitor
events.description: Maggie works as a content moderator for VueQ Moderation Services, spending her days filtering the internet’s darkest content, driven by guilt over her sister's suicide.  When Maggie blocks a cryptic video uploaded by an anonymous user, she and her team begin to be hunted by an insidious entity that haunts them through every screen in their lives.

events.title: The Shitheads
events.description: Macon Blair's third feature is a raucous and wildly entertaining descent into madness. Dave Franco and O’Shea Jackson Jr. are perfectly (mis)matched as Mark and Davis, the fumbling circumstantial chaperones in charge of transporting the increasingly psychotic Sheridan (a brilliant Mason Thames). Phenomenal supporting turns from Nicholas Braun, Peter Dinklage, and Kiernan Shipka round out the ensemble cast, each more unexpected and bizarre than the last. Blair treats us to his signature absurdist sense of humor and douses it with gasoline and psychedelics, crafting an uncanny world where the worst intentions net the highest yields and the open road is full of Shitheads.

events.title: Chili Finger
events.description: When Jessica Lipki discovers a severed human finger in her bowl of chili, she recognizes an opportunity to seize control of her stagnating life. Jess blackmails the regionally-beloved fast-food chain for $100,000 in return that she and her blissfully ignorant husband, Ron, keep quiet about the incident. Unbeknownst to Jess, her stunt has caught the attention of "the" Blake Junior, the plutocratic founder behind the "Blake Junior’s" food empire. He recruits his ex-marine buddy, Dave, to investigate Jess and discover the truth behind the chili finger...

events.title: Thanks for Nothing
events.description: Katharina, Ricky, Malou, and Victoria live in a self-made anarchist group home - no parents, no school, no rules. Under the loose watch of social worker Ballack, things are going pretty well. But Katharina doesn’t want to live past 18, and her birthday is two weeks away. Her friends scramble to hide her suicide attempts, afraid the truth will destroy the only “home” they’ve ever had. In this darkly comedic tale of rebellion, abandonment, and surviving the absurd, "Thanks For Nothing" is the kids' collective FU to the adults who’ve abandoned or failed them.

events.title: Anima
events.description: After being let go from her robotic companion start-up, Beck, an anti-social engineer, finds herself in the offices of a new company claiming to preserve a person's consciousness inside a cloud system. Her first assignment: drive the company's most valuable client, Paul, a lonely button manufacturer, to his final appointment.

events.title: DJ Gotta Strut
events.description:
Danyell Nelson Hewlett, professionally known as DJ Gotta Strut, is an open-format DJ, actor, and event producer trusted with diverse, international audiences across fashion, corporate, sports, and large-scale cultural events. Her sound blends Southern hip hop, pop, R&B, Afrobeats, dancehall, Latin crossover, and global crowd favorites, delivered with confidence, precision, and style. 

CAREER HIGHLIGHTS
	•	NYC New Year’s Eve Yacht DJ
	•	Largest Fourth of July Fireworks Celebration in the U.S. (NYC)
	•	Miami Superfest – Super Bowl LIV
	•	Featured DJ on Sway in the Morning
	•	1st female contestant on Turn the Tables with Pretty Lou
(Def Jam, Warner Records, Terror Squad)

Winnie Stackz Couture Fighting Cancer Fashion Show

events.title: EddieAngel
events.description:
EddieAngel is part of a new wave of Chicano R&B artists reshaping the sound of alternative soul in Austin and beyond. Fronted by singer-songwriter Angel Estrada, the project has steadily built momentum through emotionally grounded songwriting and a growing local fanbase.

His 2024 debut EP Love Bomb and follow-up single “Spell” introduced his dreamy and nostalgic storytelling, while 2025’s “Holding On” (ft. Tobias Lund) surpassed over 100K streams and secured playlist support. Now, EddieAngel launches a new era with his latest single “PAYASO”. As the foundation for forthcoming EP Chicano Blues, 'PAYASO' sets the tone for an EP that fuses Mexican heritage with R&B, soul, and rock, positioning EddieAngel as a rising voice in Chicano and alternative R&B spaces.

events.title: Facebook Presents
events.description: Facebook is excited to present an unforgettable evening of stand-up comedy, where the global stage meets the SXSW stage! With 3 billion people connecting on Facebook globally every month, comedians are able to showcase their talent and grow their audience around the world. Now, we’re bringing this vibrant community to the SXSW Comedy stage.Full lineup coming soon!

events.title: Korda Korder
events.description:
"I've not stopped playing this for days" - STEVE LAMACQ, BBC RADIO 6
"Authentic...really special" - BBC RADIO 6 ROUNDTABLE
"Sounding Amazing" - JOHN KENNEDY, RADIO X
"Stunning single" – HUW STEPHENS, BBC RADIO 6
"A Spellbinding Song" - FRESH ON THE NET
"Stunning and Beautiful" - GOD IS IN THE TV
"One of those records that stops you in your tracks" - AMAZING RADIO
"Is this the best new band in the UK?" - THE ZINE

events.title: Leviticus
events.description: "Leviticus" is the story of Naim and Ryan, two teenage boys living in a conservative Christian community in regional Victoria. When their attraction to each other is identified by the local pastor, the pair are subjected to a disturbing conversion ritual which unknowingly releases a violent entity that terrorizes the town. As Naim and Ryan attempt to survive the bigotry of their fellow town members, they must also defend themselves against the unleashed spiritual being that takes the form of the thing the boys desire most - each other.

events.title: King Cooley
events.description: King Cooley is a neo-soul, hip-hop artist based in Atlanta, Georgia and known for blending her warm southern-twang, certified rap bars, and captivating melodies. With a sound that’s equal parts nostalgic and forward-thinking, King Cooley’s music is an introspective journey through themes of love, self-discovery, and social change. Her breakthrough track, "Climate Change," brought critical attention to her ability to address complex issues with authenticity, gaining over 300,000 streams on Spotify. Following this success, King Cooley’s latest video, “Get Down,” has racked up over 100,000 views on Youtube and songs like “Got That” and “Reunion Season” have been featured on Netflix’s Love Is Blind tv show, and Tyler Perry’s, Sistas, on BET, respectively.

events.title: The Sun Never Sets
events.description:
Wendy's life is thrown into chaos when her boyfriend, Jack, who is older and divorced with children, insists they take space to evaluate the relationship. During their break, Wendy unexpectedly runs into her ex, Chuck, forcing the three of them into a confusing and volatile triangle.

The film was shot on 35mm on location in Alaska.

events.title: DDA TINK
events.description: Emerging as a compelling force in independent hip-hop, DDA Tink is known for emotionally layered storytelling and thought-provoking lyricism. Fusing melodic undertones with introspective bars, Tink creates music that resonates with listeners navigating growth, pain, and self-discovery. Tink is a raw and reflective voice in hip-hop, blending pain, purpose, and poetry. While delivering unfiltered truths over soulful production. With a sound grounded in authenticity and artistic vision, DDA Tink continues building a catalog that connects deeply and leaves lasting impact.

events.title: J Soulja
events.description:
J Soulja is a powerhouse in Austin’s hip-hop scene—known for his sharp lyricism, electric performances, and trailblazing hustle. He’s rocked stages alongside stars like Wale and members of TDE, toured Texas with Curren$y, and headlined his own sold-out show in Austin.

His music caught major attention after he created the official theme song for comedian Brian Simpson’s Netflix Special “Live From The Mothership,” now surpassing 100,000 streams and 10,000+ Shazams across platforms.

Beyond the mic, J Soulja is the founder of The Pre-Roll ATX, the city’s premier open mic and artist development platform that’s launched countless local talents onto major festival stages like SXSW, ACL, and even Roskilde Festival in Denmark.
With brand collaborations from Swisher Sweets to Adidas & even including receiving a Proclamation for his own day in Austin Texas - J Soulja stands as both an artist and architect of Austin’s next hip-hop era—turning independent grind into global momentum..

events.title: Jazz re:freshed DJs
events.description:
As a close-knit family made up of music promoters, DJs, label owners and festival organisers, they’ve been regenerating jazz and jazz-influenced music culture since their 2003 conception.
JRF has cooked up a session that brings the spirit of the jazz & club culture they hail from.

THE DJs
Top Rock and Adam Rock - Founders of Jazz re:freshed

events.title: Saige Davis
events.description: Raised in a sunny southern California beach town, Saige Davis writes country-leaning songs straight from the heart with melodies that feel everlasting. Writing primarily on her own, she creates music that feels grounded and familiar - and yet wholly her own. Influenced by both the country classics and also Americana with a modern edge, her songs lean on acoustic guitars, simple arrangements, and lyrics that leave room to breathe. Whether written quietly at home or brought to life in the studio with producers Caleb Nelson (Mt. Joy) and Patrick Lyons (Colter Wall, Luke Grimes, Noeline Hoffman), Saige’s music shows a deep respect for timeless storytelling and feels imminent for a breakthrough in the year ahead.

events.title: Ifeanyi Elswith
events.description:
Hailing from Chicago’s South Side, Ifeanyi Elswith is an R&B/Hip-hop artist known for her fearless fusion of jazz, soul, pop, house, reggae, dancehall, and her Belizean roots—crafting a sound that’s unmistakably hers. Named 1st runner-up for The Chicago Reader’s ‘Best R&B Artist’ of 2023 and a 312 Award nominee for Afro Artist of the Year, she’s been highlighted by platforms like Chicago Tribune, Vocalo, Windy City Live, and Audiotree.
Ifeanyi has shared stages with artists such as Oddisee, Twista, Vic Mensa, dancehall legends Capleton and Junior Reid, and Panic! At The Disco’s Brendon Urie. Her music has reached global audiences through placements on MAX, NBC, Tubi, and in a Belikin Beer commercial in Belize. With her unique style and magnetic, pretty gyal energy, Ifeanyi isn’t just making music—she’s making waves.

events.title: lucky break
events.description: lucky break is a 24-year-old New York-born indie rock artist based in San Francisco. Blending classic alt-rock, punk, and modern indie pop with a knack for homegrown radio hooks, the Biggest Thing EP marks lucky break's first official release. The collection, poised to establish the artist as a significant new voice in music, was recorded with Elliot Woodbridge (Ha Vay) in a makeshift car studio, each track  offering a glimpse into the mysticism and whimsy of her expansive sonic world. And it’s just the beginning: Her full-length debut will release May 2026.

events.title: Sugabooo
events.description:
Fresh from a seminal performance at All Together Now’s Last City stage, Sugaboo is set to make a statement as he has sold 450 tickets to his debut headline show in the Iconic Dublin venue Whelans.  From forwarded many times WhatsApp releases to 12K monthly Spotify listeners, Sugaboo has been building a buzz in the Dublin underground. His debut mixtape “Kimmagination” released in August 2025 has garnered attention from Kneecap’s Moglai Bap who endorsed the album on instagram.  When the Irish ex-Taoiseach Leo Varadkar is a follower. Lewis Capaldi is an early fan aswell and has been playing Goin Ballistic to the crowds before his arena shows on his recent UK tour.

Earlier this year, Sugaboo featured on Lil Skag’s “Pilgirmmage to Kimmage,” which received Track of the Week on the Nialler9 blog. With a collaborative mixtape with Lil Skag, “Skagaboo,” on the horizon. 

Sugaboo’s momentum is building now. Having opened for Mik Pyro of Republic of Loose fame to a sold-out crowd in Whelan’s main room, Sugaboo has proven his live credentials. With a string of shows under his belt, having toured Ireland and the UK. Expect live versions of the tracks you’ve had on repeat, plus a few surprises. Bring the crew, bring the energy. This isn’t just a show – it’s a statement of raw energy. Dublin 12 inside the place; real bars, no industry fluff, No hype merchants, no messing just a room full of heads who’ve been watching this build from the shack days.

events.title: BriTANicK: dummy
events.description: BriTANicK is the sketch comedy duo of Brian McElhaney and Nick Kocher. They have written for "Saturday Night Live," and "It's Always Sunny in Philadelphia." and made a whole bunch of online sketch comedy videos. BriTANicK has performed live all over the world including sold out runs at the Edinburgh Fringe Festival and the Montreal Just For Laughs Festival. Don’t miss their brand new live show "dummy" that is 1/3 sketch comedy, 1/3 childhood trauma, and 3/4 them being bad at math.

events.title: deCasa
events.description:
deCasa is a genre-bending duo hailing from Puerto Rico, now making waves from their home base in Austin, TX. Comprised of two brothers, the project blends the vibrant rhythms of the island with the wide-open sonic landscapes of the Lone Star State—a fusion they proudly call beach music.

Seamlessly weaving English and Spanish lyrics, deCasa crafts a sound where reggae meets western twang, merengue grooves collide with funk, and cultures converge in unexpected harmony. Anchored by a powerhouse drummer whose precision and flair elevate every performance, the band delivers a live show that’s as explosive as it is unforgettable.

Texas audiences have seen them light up stages from Austin’s Mohawk to San Antonio’s Paper Tiger, Dallas’ Granada, and Houston’s White Oak Music Hall. Along the way, they’ve shared bills with some of the state’s most notable acts, steadily building a reputation as one of the region’s most compelling emerging artists.

With their unique cross-cultural sound, undeniable chemistry, and high-energy performances, deCasa is a name you’ll be hearing much more of—one to watch closely in 2026.

events.title: The Family Battenberg
events.description:
‘The Family Battenberg have perfected a filthy, fuzzy psychedelic sound that they’ve coined as “spider rock.” (The Face)
The Family Battenberg's 'Anteater' single, released in April 2025, is an independent release by the Cardiff based four-piece. The track was written in just a day, and it was recorded at Tom Rees’ (Buzzard Buzzard Buzzard) studio while he was on holiday. To master the recording the group sought out long-time collaborator Eddie Al-Shakarchi (Boy Azooga, Loathe, Swim Deep.)

Aligning with the soundscape that’s signature to them, ‘Anteater’ is The Family Battenberg finessed. Drenched in fuzzy saturation, spacey vocals ricochet between a blistering guitar, all while a double-tracked mono drum plays like a call to action.  This is an anti-love song. When unhealthy adoration becomes a quest for romance, or approval in this case, we find ourselves doing strange things. In this story, the protagonist justifies total metamorphosis in the name of subservience. “It’s self-humiliation in the pursuit of a potential suitor’s attention,” as frontman Eliot puts it. Anyone that has seen this band live before is sure to recognise it from past setlists. The group had played it as an unreleased track amongst their own shows and a host of major festivals, namely,

Greenman, Trans Musicales 2024, Reeperbahn 2024 and ESNS 2025. As budding upcomers, the group have also supported the likes of Getdown Services, Panic Shack, Gruff Rhys and the Bug Club.

Championed by Steve Lamacq, Amy Lame, Huw Stephens and Adam Walton, the group are already making their mark on the industry.

'Wow I love that, a South Walian answer to Psychedelic Porn Crumpets' John Kennedy, Radio X

events.title: Grrrl Gang
events.description: Hailing from the cultural city of Yogyakarta, Indonesia, Grrrl Gang is a rising force in the independent music scene with their infectious melodies, anthemic songs, and electrifying live performances. The power trio, composed of Angeeta Sentana on guitar and vocals, Akbar Rumandung on bass, and Edo Alventa on guitar, has been making waves in the Southeast Asian music scene since their formation in 2016. Grrrl Gang's music is a celebration of their collective roots and a testament to the power of pop music to connect people across cultures and borders. Their lyrics touch on themes such as feminism, mental health, and relationships with a raw honesty that speaks to a generation of young listeners. With their infectious energy, socially conscious lyrics, and unique sound, Grrrl Gang is poised to take the global music scene by storm and become a voice for a new generation. Their full-length debut album, Spunky! is the sound of a band not content to rest on its laurels, despite gathering an impressive list of achievements since Grrrl Gang first got together in 2016 and proceeded to take the local, regional, and international indie scenes by storm.

events.title: Honey I'm Home
events.description:
Recently named #1 emerging act at Europe’s leading new-music showcase festival (ESNS), a list with a strong track record of identifying artists before their breakthrough. “Honey I'm Home is reaping the benefits of the shoegaze revival. But it's not just timing, they are really great. The packed room gets their faces melted off, but sometimes gets a breather in the shape of a beautiful verse. The unexpected breaks, original melodies and smart tempo changes give the set its own, authentic sound.”

Honey I'm Home is an Amsterdam-based shoegaze outfit that powerfully captures the raw energy of '90s alternative rock and blends it with a fresh, modern sound. Inspired by bands like My Bloody Valentine, Smashing Pumpkins, and DIIV, they've created their own unique take on the shoegaze, indie, and emo genres. On stage, Honey I'm Home unleashes their full power: captivating live shows that balance between fragile intimacy and explosive outbursts.

The band supported Hotline TNT, Goat Girl and Foxing on shows in the EU & UK, and played key EU showcase festivals including ESNS, Reeperbahn Festival and Left of the Dial. New single got featured on Line of Best Fit, BBC6 and Melomania on Spotify.

events.title: Killakmadeinbrooklyn
events.description:
Killakmadeinbrooklyn, also known as Killa K, is a Brooklyn-born rapper delivering unapologetic hip-hop rooted in real life, emotional truth, and street confidence. Her music blends sharp lyricism, bold femininity, and raw storytelling—turning pain, betrayal, and self-discovery into power-packed records.

Independent and self-driven and a mother of two Killa K carved her lane without following industry formulas. Her sound is confrontational yet relatable, balancing hard bars with vulnerability and confidence with honesty. Every release reflects growth, self-awareness, and an unfiltered voice that refuses to be ignored.

events.title: Luke Tyler Shelton
events.description: Born in the new millennium, Luke Tyler Shelton makes soul-soothing rock-and-roll with all the ineffable charm of a faraway time. With a profound gift for dreaming up heavenly melodies and fantastically loose grooves, the Los Angeles native found his sound as part of a close-knit scene of young musicians and artists—a DIY-minded community whose spirit and sensibilities recall the near-mythic creative hotbed of early-’70s Laurel Canyon. Produced by Shooter Jennings (Brandi Carlile, Tanya Tucker) and Jonathan Wilson (Father John Misty, Angel Olsen), Luke’s debut body of work merges country-rock, folk-pop, and Southern soul into songs that immediately transport the audience into a state of enchanted ease.

events.title: Mên An Tol
events.description:
Formed in the orbit of a South London pub, the spirit of Mên An Tol’s music can be traced back to frontman Bill Jefferson’s own musical education in his native Cornwall where he’d play folk sessions in and around the local pubs – in-fact the band name itself is taken from a rural site of ancient stones.

The band’s instant chemistry (completed by mandolinist Felix Knox, bassist Max Silvey, drummer Tom Stevens and guitarist Robert Wiseman) is writ-large as they channel the raw grit of folk greats like The Pogues and The Waterboys alongside the mainstage urgency and confidence of Britpop giants. Perhaps most vitally, the songs proudly reclaim lost folk traditions with the use of the mandolin coupled with vibrant storytelling.

The band released two EP's in 2025, the most recent being September's 'This Land’, featuring the track ‘Not Ideal’ - produced by Carlos O’Connell of Fontaines DC who got involved after seeing them live. 

Throughout the year Mên An Tol have gone from strength to strength. They've picked up praise from NME, Rolling Stone UK, The Independent, DIY, So Young and more. At radio the band were on the B List at BBC 6 Music with single 'Not Ideal' and recorded a Maida Vale session for Steve Lamacq. On his Apple Music radio show Elton John has given two different tracks a spin, stating "I really love their sound". 

The band played two shows at 2025 Glastonbury Festival alongside European festival runs, UK touring and dates supporting The Libertines and Miles Kane. They also played The Great Escape and finished the year with a packed out London headline at The Lexington.

events.title: Saint Harison
events.description: Bio: Saint Harison is a rising artist with an undeniable voice from Southampton, United Kingdom. He currently lives in Los Angeles, CA. Having quickly risen to Internet fame from public support from SZA and Jazmine Sullivan to Justin Bieber, Timbaland and Elton John, he’s one of the latest artists to watch. Citing Amy Winehouse and Frank Ocean as two key musical influences, Saint has been covered by Rolling Stone, British Vogue, Wonderland, etc. and was named Apple Music's global Up Next artist. He made his late night TV debut on Jimmy Kimmel Live! after his viral COLORS performance of “ego talkin,” which sparked the viral #egotalkinchallenge on TikTok. His 7-track EP lost a friend was released in 2023 and has amassed over 200M cumulative streams, continuing to grow. He returned in fall 2025 with his single "ghosted," and recently released his latest single "bad," produced by Grammy-winning producer duo NovaWav (Beyoncé, JAY-Z, Jazmine Sullivan, etc.). He's gearing up to release his highly anticipated project this year.
events.venue: British Music Embassy @ Palm Door on Sixth

events.title: Somebody Someone
events.description:
Austin, TX–based artist SOMEBODY SOMEONE (they/them) crafts intimate, emotionally incisive pop rooted in sharp songwriting and atmospheric production. Their debut single “Better” was called “riveting and spellbinding” by American Songwriter, setting the tone for a body of work that favors vulnerability, restraint, and depth.

A longtime presence in the Austin music community, Somebody Someone has been featured by NPR’s Tiny Desk, selected for the Tiny Desk Contest On The Road Tour, appeared on the popular Telepathy Tapes podcast, and performed at Adam Duritz of Counting Crows’ Underwater Sunshine Festival in NYC. Their work invites deep listening and connection—music that lingers, revealing more with each pass.

events.title: Vinilious DJ
events.description: Curating vinyl for the random moments in life that help you forget the present.

events.title: Zola Marcelle
events.description:
The Bantu & Boundless artist, Zola Marcelle, is a Zimbabwean-born, London-based multidisciplinary artist. With a rare mix of Shona and Sotho heritage, her journey through music, culture, and history is steadily shaping her into an exciting contemporary voice of her generation. Raised partially in Bulawayo with a family steeped in music, Zola grew up with a deep connection to song and her African roots. 

Belonging to a generation of active participants in Zimbabwe’s independence struggle, Zola adopted a profound sense of responsibility, identity, and freedom. Having grown up in a home where music was a staple diet, Zola was surrounded by the global sounds of legends like Sankomota, Andrae Crouch, Stevie Wonder, Jimmy Dludlu and Sibongile Khumalo. When she wasn’t listening to these musical greats, Zola would accompany her father on photography outings, a combination of visual and sonic inspiration that would later fuel her own creative process. These early experiences gave her a foundation in both artistry and activism.

events.title: Niiasii
events.description:
Niiasii is an alternative pop artist from Southeast Virginia pushing the boundaries between pop, R&B, and alternative sounds. Her music is fueled by true emotion, a mix of love, heartbreak, and the relentless pursuit of freedom. On stage, Niiasii is electric. Turning vulnerability into energy, and every performance into a deep connection with the audience. With shows across the East Coast, she’s created her own lane for genre- bending music and unapologetic expression
 
One of Niiasii's notable accomplishments is her music project titled "The Art Of Changing Form," which has gained significant recognition with over 100,000 streams. Since that release, Niiasii has gone on to deliver 3 more cohesive projects that have solidified and deepened her community of supporters. As the buzz continues to build, this emerging alt-pop talent stands firmly on the path to breakthrough success.

events.title: RAKEL
events.description:
RAKEL is an Icelandic artist working in song, memory, and atmosphere. Her music folds together voice, field recording, and emotion into layered compositions that feel intimate and expansive. She has become a quietly singular presence in the Icelandic music landscape, performing with artists like Nanna (Of Monsters and Men), Axel Flóvent, and Kaktus Einarsson. Her debut album - a place to be - was released on Ólafur Arnalds’ OPIA Community in October 2025 and garnered widespread acclaim from top Icelandic and global media alikel, with The Line of Best Fit calling her “Iceland’s next breakout star” and writeups in Billboard, Exclaim!, SPIN, London Standard and more. She dominated the Iceland Airwaves festival in November 2025, with the festival awarding her the prestigious “PLUS Award”, granted to one artist each year that is ready to take over the world. 

a place to be is part diary, part landscape. Birds, clocks, breath, soft synths, the creak of a floorboard, nothing is too small to become part of the composition. RAKEL’s work invites you into a space where thought becomes sound, memory becomes movement, and music becomes a place to be, for now.

events.title: Audible Presents Mexodus: A Musical Journey Across Borders
events.description:
Experience the groundbreaking live-looping hip-hop musical Mexodus. Created and performed by Brian Quijada and Nygel D. Robinson, this innovative work explores the untold history of the Underground Railroad that ran south into Mexico.

Through a blend of musical influences and compelling storytelling, Mexodus brings to life the struggles and triumphs that reveal the bond between two unlikely friends. Join Quijada and Robinson as they deliver “an electrifying theatrical experience” (The New York Times Critic’s Pick) that transports through time and across borders in a concert version of “the season’s first must-see musical” (The Wrap).

events.title: Kayanne Peppa
events.description: Born in 2001, Philadelphia ignited its very own genre-bending firecracker: Kayanne Peppa. Also known as “Bunnii,” Kayanne began her creative journey at a young age, exploring various arts, writing, orchestra, & musical theater. Her curiosity later expanded into cosplay/design, & music laying the foundation for the bold world she creates today. Inspired by her brother, she began recording her own raps on GarageBand in high school, transforming a playful hobby into something more. Her music now emerges from the depths of fearless self-expression, blending hip-hop grit, punk rebellion & an unmistakable sense of play. With her animated and striking stage confidence, Kayanne Peppa turns every performance into an experience. Being instantly recognizable for her bunny ears, each show she lovingly gives them out to honor the memory of her beloved bunny, Kirby.Drawing inspiration from artists like Missy Elliott, Aaliyah, Michael Jackson, Avril Lavigne, Gwen Stefani to name a few, she refused to stay in one lane. To her life is one big anime, where exaggeration, bold looks, and unapologetic individuality are quite essential.Kayanne Peppa’s music is made for main characters only!

events.title: Tamera King
events.description: Tamera King is a rising R&B singer-songwriter, podcaster, and creative force known for her raw honesty, soul-stirring voice, and empowering presence. With a sound rooted in vulnerability and confidence, Tamera creates music that speaks to the highs and lows of love, growth, and self-worth. Her lyrics cut deep, drawing from real-life experiences while inviting listeners to embrace their strength and femininity. Beyond the music, Tamera is the creator of the podcast This Girl to That Girl, where she shares wisdom, personal reflections, and candid conversations designed to inspire women to evolve into their most confident, purpose-driven selves. She blends her gift for emotional storytelling with her prophetic intuition, using her voice to spark change, healing, and deep reflection. As both an artist and a woman of faith, Tamera King is dedicated to being more than just a voice on a track—she’s a reminder that you can be powerful, soft, and rooted all at once. Whether she’s singing about heartbreak, resilience, or the beauty of solitude, Tamera is a reflection of what it means to grow in public while staying grounded in truth.

events.title: Mobeethicc
events.description: Mobee Thicc is a southside Chicago born & raised DJ who in 6 years, has brought people together with her dynamic & unique open-format style and are in high demand from neighborhood bars to major festival stages. She has begun to expand her portfolio to include major US cities including NYC & Houston, TX. Mobee is sure to bring you hours of quality sets that will leave lasting impressions on your crowds!

events.title: MT Jones
events.venue: British Music Embassy @ Palm Door on Sixth Patio

events.title: 60 JUNO
events.description:
Emerging from Merced, CA, 60 JUNO (sixty juno) leads Central Valley Post-Punk with his own distinct blend of DIY indie-rock and dark-wave elements that create a truly notable sound worth remembering. 

By incorporating heightened energy and rough, low vocals into the usual wistful, dreamy componenets typical of the Indie-Rock genre, 60 JUNO has truly created a lane of his own making.
 
The independent 22-year old musician is the sole driving force behind the bass, drums, guitar and vocals that seamlessly translate heavy nostalgia into deep, dreamy melodies.

events.title: Ben Ellis
events.description:
At just 23, Cardiff-born singer-songwriter Ben Ellis has become one of the UK’s most quietly magnetic new voices, blending intimate acoustic songwriting with the emotional depth of indie-pop. His upcoming third EP marks a pivotal moment both emotionally and musically. Written across two trips to Los Angeles in the aftermath of a breakup, the project explores the complexities of heartbreak, drifting between moments of clarity and confusion.

“There was so much love still there,” Ellis says. “It’s crazy how art kind of comes from those moments.” Lead single “Where She Goes” emerged from a journal entry written the day after the breakup.

From there, the EP grew into a layered and collaborative body of work. Tracks like “When It Ends” push into rock territory with biting guitars, while “Animal” leans into warm, ’70s-inspired folk textures reminiscent of Fleetwood Mac. Co-produced by Grammy-nominated Matt Rad and longtime collaborator James October, the sessions saw Ellis push himself creatively, from late-night listens to Damien Rice to recording live drums at LA’s legendary Studio 606.

events.title: JeRonelle
events.description:
Known for his powerhouse vocal range, silk-smooth tone, and engaging stage presence, JeRonelle is steadily carving out his lane as a standout among the new generation of R&B.

Hailing from the city of Omaha, JeRonelle first hit the national spotlight during the 2nd Season of FOX's hit show, 'The Four', leaving an undeniable impact with each performance. Since his television debut, he's found himself in collaboration with a who's who of acclaimed artists including Drake, Kanye West, Durand Bernarr, & Daley - all while earning recognition from prominent platforms including VIBE Magazine, Rated R&B, BET, and Apple Music Radio with Ebro.

Continuously forging his own path, JeRonelle's music blends the timeless textures of R&B with subtle hints of Pop and church-based influence to create a sound that is both fresh and familiar, while conveying emotional depth and vulnerability.

events.title: Amy Gadiaga
events.description:
As a bassist, vocalist, and composer, my journey as a music creator has been shaped by my rich cultural heritage and passion for blending traditional jazz with contemporary influences. I grew up in the suburbs of Paris, born to parents of Senegalese, Gambian, and Malian descent. This background continues to inspire my artistry, which merges the sounds of jazz legends like Betty Carter and Wayne Shorter with the soulful rhythms of artists such as D’Angelo and Stevie Wonder. 
 
Since moving to London at 18 to study double bass at Trinity Laban Conservatoire of Music and Dance, I have built a strong live track record, performing at renowned festivals and venues including the EFG London Jazz Festival, Jazz Café, Cheltenham Jazz Festival, We Out Here, Brick Lane Jazz Festival, and Pizza Express Soho. These experiences have been pivotal in building my fanbase and establishing my presence in the UK. Internationally I have performed at the Montreux Jazz Festival and countries around the world including France, Poland , South Korea and more.

events.title: BettySoo
events.description:
BettySoo, a "Korean-Americana" artist raised by immigrant parents in Spring, Texas, grew up on a steady diet of classical music, the Great American songbook, country radio, and the jewels of folk songwriters and Texas songwriting legends. If Heat Sin Water Sin (with Gurf Morlix) built her audience, When We’re Gone (2014) firmed her place in the first rank of songwriters, and 2025's If You Never Go Away proved her staying power.
She’s won awards and played festivals/shows: Kerrville, Mountain Stage, SXSW, Calgary, E-Town, BBC2 with Bob Harris.

In addition to a heavy touring schedule, she has been a go-to harmony vocal singer and arranger for dozens of artists' albums, including Eliza Gilkyson, James McMurtry, Robert Harrison, Jaimee Harris, Bonnie Whitmore, Graham Weber, and others.

Pre-pandemic, BettySoo toured solo, and as a member of multiple bands. Since 2022, she has been touring internationally in support of (and as a member of the band for) both James McMurtry and Chris Smither.

events.title: Chatterton
events.description: “I do it with my heart on my sleeve,” Pierce sings on Blouse, the lead single and closing track of Chatterton’s latest EP, Tiny Empire. It’s the first release from the Oxnard, CA-based duo, consisting of Brock Pierce and Logan Scrivner, since 2024’s debut Fields of This, the album which earned them a slot on Pitchfork’s Best Rock Albums of 2024. The lyric embodies the new EP well—especially coming from a pair who often prefer to keep things abstract rather than confessional. Pierce may grumble that “everything has changed” on “Punching Bag,” yet Tiny Empire stands as a testament that sometimes change can work in your favor.

events.title: Dirty Laundry
events.description: In this special event from Dropout, host Lily Du gathers four guests to tell secrets, guess who they belong to, and enjoy a few cocktails made by Grant O'Brien.Full lineup coming soon!

events.title: Imposters
events.description: After a couple’s baby boy is taken, the desperate mother learns of a way to bring him back. However, her husband begins to suspect that what she returned with isn't their son.

events.title: KING NO-ONE
events.description:
With a name as regal as their ambition, KNO are reshaping boundaries as they set out to release their debut album in April 2026.

This charismatic trio built their reputation through relentless touring and a catalogue of singles that bristle with both confidence and vulnerability.

Glistening guitar riffs, punchy rhythms and poetic narratives ensure their sound is both urgent and heartfelt.

These narratives are channelled into lyrics that are as revealing as they are relatable.

The songwriting is a testament to their roots. Each track is a vignette of life, steeped in nostalgia, resilience and a yearning to belong. It’s music that’s as much about catharsis as it is about connection.

First single ‘Transgressions’ is a confessional anthem. Nostalgia and identity are painted vividly in the second single as the band retrace childhood, its warmth underpinning an unflinching honesty.

Yet it’s the title track which lies at the emotional heart of this debut. Empathy is portrayed as both gift and curse, a force that connects deeply to others’ pain, yet at times threatens to overwhelm.

It’s a debut album that’s as unguarded and unflinching as the band themselves, sure to resonate with anyone whose heart has ever felt too full.

events.title: Mallory's Ghost
events.description: Mallory, plagued by fears of being unremarkable, joins her playwright boyfriend Sam on a retreat to coastal Maine. When she learns he once brought his glamorous ex, Louise, there, she’s struck with an obsessive curiosity about his past. As her jealousy takes hold, Mallory becomes convinced she’s being haunted by the ghost of Louise herself... Pulled into a journey that slips between past and present, rivalry and affection, melancholy and creativity, Mallory drifts further from her old life and toward something essential. "Mallory’s Ghost" is a psychological and playful exploration of envy, and the strange path it can lead back to the Self.

events.title: The Man with the Big Hat
events.description:
An unsung pioneer of 1970s Texas Progressive Country, Steven Fromholz had a knack for snatching defeat from the jaws of victory. Revered by legends like Willie Nelson, Lyle Lovett & John Denver, he remained commercially unknown. He sought redemption on the Rio Grande as a river guide until a debilitating stroke erased his musical memory, stripping Fromholz of his artistic identity.
This intimate and impressionistic portrayal, bolstered by newly discovered archives as well as never-before-heard recordings, unveils the evolution of Fromholz, and reshapes the notion of success and artistic fortitude.

events.title: Marissa Nadler
events.description:
For over two decades, Marissa Nadler has carved out a singular place in the musical landscape, where ethereal folk, shadowy Americana, ambient soundscapes, and experimental textures converge. Anchored by her unmistakable mezzo-soprano and fingerstyle guitar, Nadler’s music conjures vivid emotional worlds—intimate, otherworldly, and timeless.
A prolific songwriter, Nadler has built a discography defined by spectral beauty and haunting lyricism. Her songs, dreamlike and lush, are rich with imagery and nuance. Nadler released her debut album, Ballads of Living and Dying,  in 2004, a collection that announced her as a major voice in the underground. A skilled visual artist as well, Nadler’s background in painting deeply informs the cinematic scope of her songs. Following her early work, she partnered with Sacred Bones and Bella Union for July (2014), marking a new chapter in creative clarity and critical acclaim. Strangers (2016), For My Crimes (2018), and The Path of the Clouds (2021) further expanded her sonic palette.
Her 10th full-length, New Radiations, was released on August 15th. Expansive, melodic, and emotionally vivid, it captures Nadler at her most personal and visionary.

events.title: Sūn Byrd
events.description:
With a Spellemann (norwegian Grammy) nomination for their debut album in hand, Sūn Byrd is ready to kick off  the new campaign for the upcoming album In Paradiso, heavily inspired by American and British soul from the 60s and 70s.

With a horn section that never rests, basslines that drive the songs forward, neatly ironed pants, and undeniable coolness, Sūn Byrd could just as easily be born in New Orleans as in Oslo. But it's in Norway that they've first made a name for themselves. They released their Spellemann-nominated debut album in 2024 and have already played over 250 concerts together. You can just try to imagine how tight Sūn Byrd sounds live, and then add a little more. Now, they're about to release In Paradiso, their first album on Jansen Records.

On In Paradiso, you'll be served soulful tracks that follow in the footsteps of artists like Leon Bridges, Thee Sacred Souls, and Sharon Jones and The Dap-Kings. Johan Helland's vocals are perhaps the first thing that stands out, with its distinctive tone, range, and vulnerability, but it’s when the whole band comes in that you’re truly dazzled. The keys, horns, guitar, and bass all find their place, seamlessly shifting between being a musical locomotive and charming you into submission with beautiful ballads.

Sūn Byrd’s music is universal and timeless, and there’s really nothing that sounds like this on the Norwegian music scene today. It’s perfect for large festival stages, would make a great soundtrack for countless films, or simply while you hang out after closing time at a smoke-filled off-license bar in the southern U.S.

events.title: Amber Jaii
events.description: Amber Jaii is a multidisciplinary artist, producer, and DJ creating high energy music and experiences rooted in confidence, movement, and self-expression. Blending dance driven production with bold, genre-fluid sound, she designs every layer of her world. From music and visuals to live sets and curated events. AJaii’s work invites audiences to step into their power, move freely, and feel unapologetically themselves!

events.title: Capturing Bigfoot
events.description:
On October 20, 1967, Roger Patterson captured 59 seconds of film showing a creature walking through the Northern California woods—footage that became the most analyzed and debated in history. Fifty-seven years later, a reel of 16mm film discovered in a safe changes everything.

"Capturing Bigfoot" reveals the untold story behind the world's greatest mystery, told for the first time by Patterson's own son and the people who were there.

This is a story about family legacy, broken friendships, and belief itself.
