events.title: Remey Williams
events.description: Remey Williams is a 2× Grammy-nominated singer, songwriter, producer, and drummer from Camden, New Jersey, now based in Hampton, Georgia. Raised in the church and born into a musical legacy as the son of O’Jays bassist Jimmy Williams, Remey began playing drums at age 10 and developed a soulful, emotionally driven sound. He has collaborated with artists including Summer Walker, Usher, Ari Lennox, and Childish Gambino, contributing to certified projects such as Still Over It. Currently the touring drummer for Summer Walker, Remey’s work spans live performance, production, and major TV placements, including PowerBook: Ghost and The Chi.

events.title: ARXX
events.description:
Queer Brighton powerpop besties Hanni (they/them) and Clara (she/her) released their second album ‘Good Boy’ in Autumn 2024. They’ve toured with MUNA, Fletcher, Yungblud and The Big Moon, and they composed several original songs performed by the cast of BBC drama Riot Women, which aired in Autumn 2025.

They are currently working on their third album with longterm collaborator Steve Ansell (Blood Red Shoes), which will continue their mission to spread queer joy in 2026 and beyond.
events.venue: British Music Embassy @ Palm Door on Sixth

events.title: Dyna Edyne
events.description:
Dyna Edyne (TreeWoman) is carving out her own lane in modern R&B—where raw vocals meet melody-first storytelling. Her writing leans honest and close-up, the kind that turns lived experience into something you can replay.

That emotional clarity has been picking up steam. She’s earned recognition from platforms like On The Radar, landed a Range Rover brand partnership, performed with SoundCloud & opened up for Leon Thomas during Mutt's don't heal tour—signals that her world is expanding well beyond her local scene.

Released in Winter 2025, Where the Petals Fall feels like the next chapter: soft around the edges, heavy in meaning, and rooted in vulnerability, growth, and soul. It’s the kind of album that doesn’t chase a moment—it creates one

events.title: Kaash Paige
events.description:
Kaash Paige (born D’Kyla Paige Woolen on January 8, 2001, in Dallas, Texas) is a singer and songwriter known for her smooth blend of R&B, EDM , Alternative, Pop and hip-hop. She began uploading songs to SoundCloud while in high school, breaking out with her viral hit “Love Songs” in 2018. That success led to her first album Parked Car Convos (2019) followed up by Teenage Fever (2020), both filled with dreamy, emotional storytelling!

Kaash continued to evolve with her 2022 project S2ML showcasing deeper songwriting and more confidence in her sound. By 2024 , she began moving independently, focused on creative freedom and ownership.

In 2025, Kaash Paige Dropped a Trap Mixtape Titled “KAASHMYCHECKS” & A R&B/HIP HOP PROJECT Titled “2 Late To Be Toxic”. she has leveled up globally Going on her China Tour summer of 2025. headlining her second U.S. Tour “ Better than revenge “ & performing in Brazil at the Cena Festival in November 2025 .  

marking a new chapter in her career as an international artist. From SoundCloud uploads in Dallas to world stages across continents, Kaash Paige continues to prove why she’s one of the most refreshing and visionary voices in the world.

events.title: Michael The Lion
events.description:
Michael The Lion is the latest and greatest pseudonym of long-time Philadelphia DJ and producer DJ Apt One.  Michael's trademark sound features live instruments sitting seamlessly with sampled grooves to create organic, classic textures.  The Lion sound is always funky, always strong and always ready for the floor.

Michael was a part of the multi-genre style of DJing that catapulted his adopted Philadelphia to the pinnacle of the DJ world in the early 2000s. His years of seasoning as a DJ have seen him play all styles imaginable all across North America and Europe.  As a part of the duo RCMP, his work foreshadowed the emergence of Nu-Disco before the genre even had a name. Now, as Michael The Lion, he is pushing the boundaries of funk in modern dance music.

events.title: Lee Vasi
events.description:
Lee Vasi is an Atlanta-based R&B artist originally from Fayetteville, North Carolina. Raised singing with her siblings and performing in theater, her Puerto Rican-Dominican and African American heritage shaped her diverse musical influences and passion for honest storytelling. She wrote her first song at age 10 while backstage at The Lion King on Broadway, where she performed as Young Nala, and later appeared on American Idol.

After taking time to reconnect with her faith and artistic direction, Lee returned in 2023 with her single “My Bad,” which gained traction following a bilingual a cappella performance on Kai Cenat and Speed’s livestream. In early 2024, her breakout single “Teach Me” went viral on Instagram and TikTok ahead of release, earning her first Billboard chart entries, including #2 on Gospel Digital Song Sales and #21 on Hot Gospel Songs.

events.title: Gwenno
events.description: Gwenno is a Welsh songwriter and music producer from Cardiff, Wales. She explores her Celtic/Anglo British identity through her songs in Welsh, Cornish and English, blending early folk and blues guitar with psychedelic electronic BBC Radiophonic Workshop and Joe Meek flourishes to capture a history of 1500 years. She released he debut album, the Welsh Music Prize Award winning Y Dydd Olaf, in 2015, a concept album inspired by a late 60s sci-fi novel of the same name about a world which is taken over by artificial intelligence with its protagonist documenting it all in Welsh as an act of defiance and preservation of a minoritised language against Big Tech. In 2018 she released her Cornish language album, Le Kov, an exploration of 2000 years of Cornish history which led to an increase of 10% in Cornish learners worldwide. Her third album, Tresor, was released in 2022, an album about motherhood which was shortlisted for the Mercury Music Prize the same year. In 2024 she released her 4th, trilingual album, Utopia, which included songs written in English for the first time in her solo career.

events.title: The Fox
events.description: Nick (Jai Courtney), affable heir to a wealthy rural landowner, discovers his fiancée, Kori (Emily Browning), is cheating on him and wants nothing more than to just fix the problem. One night, he captures a rogue Fox (Olivia Colman), and she offers him a trade-off: if Nick lets her live, the Fox will help him save his relationship. All he has to do is push Kori into a magic hole with the power to change her into the perfect partner. Nick follows the Fox’s advice and the Kori who re-emerges seems to be everything he ever wanted. Until her strange new quirks make him question his decision.

events.title: Pär Hagström and Charlatans of Love
events.description:
(New album DREAMERS BELIEVERS ILLUSIONISTS PREACHERS out in November 2025)
Pär Hagström has always moved along the outer edges of music – from the first stumbling chords on his family’s pump organ in Huskvarna, through 90s death metal and 70s hard rock, to the innermost heart of gospel. It’s a journey shaped as much by philosophy, literature, and theater as by rock clubs and church halls, eventually arriving at a universe of its own where drama and soulful preaching merge into one.
As a frontman, Hagström is as much a preacher as he is a singer. His voice carries a natural theatrical force – raspy and silky at the same time – with an instinctive readiness to let the music chafe, sweat, and hypnotize. Drawing inspiration from Tom Waits, Led Zeppelin, Mavis Staples and the Blind Boys of Alabama, and together with his band Charlatans of Love, he has in recent years shaped a new musical entity where gospel, soul, psychedelic rock, and funk meet in something as seductive as it is uncompromising.

DREAMERS BELIEVERS ILLUSIONISTS PREACHERS is a continuation of the mini-album The End Again (2024), picking up where the story left off.

speakers.name: Pär Hagström and Charlatans of Love

events.title: The Peril at Pincer Point
events.description: Jim Baitte, a layabout sound designer desperate to prove himself, is working on a new horror flick from the tyrannical yet lauded b-movie director P.W. Griffin. Accused of lacking vision and creative courage, Jim is sent to the remote island where the film was shot to capture a sound powerful enough to elevate the film's finale. Once there, eerie local fables surface: for years, ambitious and headstrong youth have lost their souls to a ghostly sea captain for his spectral crew. As Jim entangles himself further into the bizarre locals, scenery, and prophecy, he can’t help but ponder the ever-confirming legend, and if recording it might just cost him more than his career.

events.title: Haylie Davis
events.description:
Haylie Davis belongs to an intriguing LA scene that boasts several acts harking back to the halcyon days of Laurel Canyon songwriting – including Alex Amen, Drugdealer, Sylvie and Sam Burton, many of whose projects she has appeared on. From origins of psychedelic folk pop and 70s cosmic Americana, Haylie’s sound is an infectious alternative take on modern pop music, with plenty of hooks and a huge chorus; she is the Carly Simon for post-Generation Z. Her euphoric range sits somewhere between Joan Baez, Carole King and Emmylou Harris.

“Gently hued Laurel Canyon folk-pop songs”  - Rolling stone

events.title: Ms. Ca$H
events.description: Ms. Ca$H is a Georgia rapper whose sharp delivery and "get-money" mindset blend ATL trap rhythm with Southern grit. Known as The Female Sweet Jones, she crafts anthems for the hustlers and self-made queens chasing independence. With tracks like Money Mission and Amen, she's turning her grind into a lifestyle brand — one verse at a time.

events.title: Sun Room
events.description:
Born and raised in San Diego’s surf-rock scene, Sun Room went from getting their house shows shut down for playing too loudly to selling out venues across a dozen countries. Formed in 2021, the band gained viral attention after two songs featured on Netflix’s Outer Banks. Expanding beyond their hometown, they sold out U.S. shows, supported Louis Tomlinson, toured Europe with Inhaler, and headlined their first North American tour in fall 2022, selling over 15,000 tickets. In spring 2023, Sun Room toured North America with Inhaler before returning to SoCal to finish At Least I Tried, which earned widespread acclaim.

In summer 2025, Sun Room released their latest EP, Ritual of Chaos, before supporting Flipturn and embarking on a 20+ date headline tour. The project showcases the band’s love of blues-rock, shoegaze and post-punk garage influences absorbed from playing worldwide. Their live show channels the energy of their early San Diego house shows - bigger and more electrifying with every performance. 

Sun Room continues to push their sound, explore new cities, and draw inspiration from their experiences. Their highly anticipated debut album is set for release in early 2026.

events.title: The Anything But BASIC Cabaret
events.description: A one-night-only variety show hosted by Chelsea Devantez and Ashley Nicole Black featuring the entire cast of BASIC, a 2026 SXSW World Premiere film (Ashley Park, Leighton Meester, Kandy Muse and more!). Join us for an unforgettable night of comedy, music, drag, and special appearances at Esther’s Follies.

events.title: BULLETBALLET
events.description:
BULLETBALLET is an independent project from Ciudad Juárez, México formed by Analaura Fuentes & Hector Becerra. Their sound mixes elements from shoegaze, krautrock, dreampop & synth, as well as beats & rythms from electronica & trip-hop; creating hypnotic atmospheres with guitar layers, synthesizers & vocals; touching on social themes, personal experiences & fantasies.

Since 2022, they've had the opportunity of playing at different venues & events on the border of Ciudad Juárez & El Paso, Texas & in cities like Chihuahua, Delicias & Mexico City,
sharing the stage & supporting acts like Mint Field, Lorelle Meets the Obsolete, Phantogram, Holy Wave, Twin Tribes, Diles Que No Me Maten, Little Jesus, Nuovo Testamento,
Valgur, Public Memory, Mabe Fratti, among other national & international talents.

They debuted in 2023 with the EP Nice Things From A Short Life, followed in 2024 by the single Bloodsport, written and produced by the band.

At the moment, BULLETBALLET are in a production stage, hoping to launch new music & live dates in 2026.

events.title: Byron Juane
events.description:
As soon as Byron Juane stepped onto the stage, you could feel his authenticity. There was no facade, no put-on persona to hide behind. Instead, there was raw honesty, a transparent openness that left no doubt in anyone's mind that this artist was the real deal.

And that authenticity was reflected in every note, every lyric. It wasn't just about making a catchy tune or pandering to the latest trends. Byron was creating music that meant something, that spoke to the heart and soul.

From the very beginning, he knew that he wanted his music to stand the test of time. He wanted it to be the kind of music that people would still be listening to decades from now, reminiscing about that moment when they first heard it and feeling all the same emotions rush back.

And he's been succeeding. With every new release, he's taken his music to new heights, soaring higher and higher on the wings of his talent and passion.

But what's perhaps most remarkable is how new Byron is to the game. Despite that, his sound is like nothing else out there, a fresh take on the very soul of music that feels like it's been missing for far too long.

events.title: Crash Land
events.description: Lance, Clay, and Darby have spent their childhoods drinking, wreaking havoc, and filming crude stunts in their small town. Everyone hates them. Wanting to finally prove their lives have meaning, the boys set out to make a “real movie” and in the process are forced to confront emotions and experiences they’ve never considered: love, loss, and ultimately, what it means to grow up.

events.title: Hemi Hemingway
events.description: With the rock’n’roll panache of a dive bar matador and the emotional force of a knife in the guts, Hemi Hemingway makes music that thrills, spills and breaks hearts. The effortlessly slick New Zealand star has a connoisseur’s ear for the finest parts of musical history, sweeping 60s rock, 50s sheen and 80s romanticism into the present day, refurbishing and refashioning them into something new and fresh. At home in the spotlight, he’s a showman in the best troubadour traditions, but one with real depth, showcasing swagger and vulnerability in equal measure.

events.title: JayaHadADream
events.description: Jamaican-Irish rapper JayaHadADream is one of the UK’s most exciting new voices, blending raw, introspective lyricism with grime and hip hop influences. Raised in Cambridge and shaped artistically in Nottingham, she took an unconventional path into music—starting a career teaching A-Level Criminology at just 21, before leaving the profession in 2023 to pursue music full-time. Her breakout came in 2024 when she won the Glastonbury Emerging Talent Competition, handpicked by Michael and Emily Eavis, earning a coveted slot on one of the festival’s main stages. Since then, she’s lit up Reading, Leeds, Boomtown, BBC Radio 1’s Big Weekend, and SXSW London, with a range of packed sets at Glastonbury 2025. Known for her emotive delivery and sharp pen, Jaya has received critical acclaim from Rolling Stone UK, NME, and TRENCH, with airplay on BBC Radio 1, Capital Xtra and Kiss. Her bold, genre-spanning sound has led to standout collaborations in both rap and electronic music, including tracks with Zero and Gardna. With co-signs from Mick Jenkins, Stormzy and so many more, JayaHadADream is defining the future of UK rap.
events.venue: British Music Embassy @ Palm Door on Sixth Patio

events.title: Knats
events.description:
Knats, a quintet led by two lifelong best mates from Newcastle Upon Tyne, Stan Woodward (Bass) and King David-Ike Elechi (Drums), alongside their younger sidekick and virtuoso Trumpeter, Ferg Kilsby, making Geordie Jazz, with sophisticated arrangements, strong melodies and danceable grooves.

After moving to London at the end of 2022, Knats took London by storm playing sold out jazz re:freshed and Rough Trade East headliners, supporting Str4ta at a sold Jazz Cafe and performing for the BBC proms; as well as working with and backing the likes of Geordie Greep, Eddie Chacon, Yellowdays and collaborating with major fashion brands Palace, Beams and Arc’teryx. Following their signing to Gearbox Records at the beginning of 2024, Knats released their debut self-titled album in March of 2025 and embarked on their first UK headline tour. From this they went on to receive critical acclaim from the likes of Jazzwise, Downbeat, Rolling Stone Japan, The Guardian and many more; as well as being nominated for ‘Jazz Newcomer of the Year’ at this year’s Parliamentary Jazz Awards.

events.title: The Tremolo Beer Gut
events.description: TESTING

events.title: Miss GIRL6
events.description:
MISS GIRL6 is a cultural leader, artist, and visionary whose influence spans ballroom, music, fashion, and community advocacy. Based in Austin, Texas, she is the **Iconic Mother of the House of LEPORE**, a formidable ballroom house she co-founded with in San Antonio before expanding into Austin. Under her leadership, the House of LEPORE has become a cornerstone of Texas ballroom, creating bold, affirming spaces for Black, queer, trans, and BIPOC communities rooted in excellence, artistry, and chosen family.

Natalie made history by helping bring the **first official ballroom event to SXSW**, amplifying ballroom culture on a global stage while preserving its authenticity and community-centered values. Known for her commanding presence, elegance, and unapologetic glamour, she embodies the title of Mother Icon—mentoring future generations while continuously evolving as an artist.



Expanding her creative reach, MISS GIRL6 recently released music video **“DRIP, a song that she’s featured in. Drip is a bold visual statement blending high fashion, ballroom energy, and Southern Black excellence. Mother Icon Natalie LEPORE is not just building a house—she is building a lasting legacy.

events.title: Escape The Internet (Part 1)
events.description:
The internet is in shambles... and it's time to leave it for good. In this game built for a movie theater, you and the audience play as internet refugees armed only with your phones. Your mission? To escape the AI slop apocalypse and reach the Island of Sanctuary, rumoured to be the last good place on the Internet.

From legendary creator Lucas Rizzotto, "Escape The Internet" blends cinema, gaming and theater to create an entirely new genre of live entertainment - one that will make you laugh, cry, and reveal who you - and the ones around you - truly are.

events.title: Fifteen
events.description: Set in Mexico City, Fifteen reimagines the iconic quinceañera as a chaotic mix of comedy and creature horror. Through Mayte and Ligia’s unbreakable bond, the film explores class divides, the illusions of adolescence, and the fear of growing up—wrapped in kitsch aesthetics, blood-soaked humor, and biting social critique.

events.title: Amazing Live Sea Monkeys
events.description: From her crumbling estate on the Potomac, Yolanda Signorelli von Braunhut is engaged in a David-and-Goliath battle to wrest control of her late husband Harold’s iconic toy Amazing Live Sea Monkeys! back from the corporate men who she insists stole them from her. Harold von Braunhut and Yolanda Signorelli worked together for forty years before Harold - a genius magician, scientist and inventor – passed away and left his iconic novelty toy in Yolanda’s care. Yolanda alone possesses the true Sea-Monkeys secret formula and she alone must free them, not only from their captors, but also from the stain of her husband’s dark legacy.

events.title: MikMula
events.description:
Ms. Jamika better known as MikMula born and raised in Savannah , GA  is not just an artist she’s an experience. With razor-sharp bars, silky melodies, and a presence that commands attention the moment she steps on stage, she embodies confidence, growth, and feminine power.

Rooted in authenticity and driven by purpose, her music speaks to elevation, self-worth, and leveling up in every season of life. Whether delivering hard-hitting rap verses or smooth, hypnotic flows, Queen Jamika brings intensity, intention, and undeniable star quality.

At SXSW, expect energy, evolution, and a performance that leaves a mark.

events.title: Panic Shack
events.description:
If there's one thing Panic Shack know, it's how to have a good time. Comprised of Sarah, Meg, Romi, Em and Nick, the band formed in 2018 as a middle-finger to the “members-only club” atmosphere of indie and punk scenes – not just because they’re male-dominated, but because they make playing music seem out of reach or, even worse, boring.
 
This carefree approach gives Panic Shack’s music the same effect as popping a bottle of Prosecco – explosive, intoxicating, and delightfully chaotic. With barely any music available online, they built a word-of-mouth following off the back of their live shows, which have been praised for fusing “thrashy early LA-style punk with choreography that owes something to the Go-Go’s and Iron Maiden all at once” (The Guardian).Released in 2022, their acclaimed Baby Shack EP bottled the lightning they have on stage, cementing their ability to blend killer hooks with a contagious sense of humour.

Released in July 2025, Panic Shack’s self-titled debut album represents a serious level up. It finds the band expanding their gutsy punk sound into fuller territory, packed with vocal harmonies, synths and electronic experimentation.

events.title: Spacestation
events.description:
In 2022, five young men from Iceland, unsure of where their life was going formed a rock band, with the goal of bringing style, fun, dance and catchy songwriting back to Icelandic rock music. Spacestation has in the past couple of years gained a reputation as the country’s most exciting new rock group and its most proliferate live band.

Like Velvet Underground, Sonic Youth and My Bloody Valentine before them, Spacestation aspire to redefine what noise can be within the context of pop music. 

Their music combines inventive use of alternate tunings, guitar strumming and feedback, with the intensity of shoegaze, catchy Krautrock rhythms and the attitude of 60s psychedelia, to create a new, jogging, sonic landscape that makes you waste away insightful nights dancing with strangers.

events.title: Nightbus
events.description:
Nightbus are a brooding, cinematic two-piece (4 members live) blending post-punk, trip-hop, and late-night electronica into something dark, hypnotic and unmistakably their own. Formed in Manchester UK in 2023, their music captures the anxious beauty of city life after hours—dripping in atmosphere - bass-heavy and emotionally raw. With haunting vocals, reverb-soaked guitars, and minimalist beats, they echo the ghosts of The Knife, Portishead, early Cure, Chromatics and the XX, all while carving out a space all their own. 

The early demos caught the ears of tastemaker label and magazine So Young, who released two 7"s from the band, one in 2023 and another in 2024 - both selling out with champions at BBC R1 and 6 Music, The Guardian, NME, The Fader, Brooklyn Vegan, The Line Of Best Fit, Dummy, DIY + Dork supporting the singles. 

Underground shows followed leading to festival appearances at Left Of The Dial, Blue Dot, Manchester Psychfest and Float Along, headline shows at Supersonic in Paris, Manchester and London and support shows with Rock Action signings Bdrmm across the UK. 



Nightbus released their debut album 'Passenger' on Melodic records, October 2025 to critical acclaim.
events.venue: British Music Embassy @ Palm Door on Sixth

events.title: QUANNA
events.description: Quanna is a Savannah-born, New York–based creative entrepreneur, artist, and cultural organizer, best known as the founder of CareFreeBlackGirl, a nationally recognized lifestyle brand celebrating Black femmes through music, community, and entrepreneurship. As a musician, Quanna has released multiple projects, including Q, Miss Thang, and her 2025 single “Rollin Up”, and plans to release more music in 2026. Her sound blends hip-hop, R&B, and alternative influences, showcasing her versatility as an artist. Over the last year, she has performed at major cultural events including SXSW, Charlotte Pride, Toronto Pride, Brooklyn Fashion Week, and more, consistently using her platform to amplify Black femme voices. At SXSW, Quanna continues to merge music, community advocacy, and cultural programming, creating space for creativity, connection, and visibility for Black women and femmes nationwide

events.title: Amor Vincit Omnia
events.description:
Amor Vincit Omnia is a pop-project created by producer Baldur Skúlason
and singer Erla Hlín Guðmundsdóttir. The band name, translating to Love
Conquers All, encapsulates their humouristic approach to serious subjects,
since the name is to them, both beautiful and a bit ridiculous at the same
time. Amor’s music is best described as playful and eccentric, with an
Icelandic sense of carelessness. Their sound is inspired by people who push
the boundaries of pop music, such as Björk, Jockstrap and Kate Bush.
In 2024, Amor released their debut EP, brb babe, earning them Reykjavik
Grapevine’s ‘One to Watch’ and the Kraumur Awards. Since the release, they
have played at one of the biggest festivals in Iceland ‘Aldrei fór ég Suður’
and collected over 30 performances around the country. This year they will
be playing at the iconic Iceland Airwaves off-venue showcase,
demonstrating that they are now ready to take their infectious beats abroad.

events.title: Bombing with Eric Andre
events.description: Join stand-up comedian Eric Andre as he hangs with his friends to talk about BOMBING. They talk about their worst moments in all sorts of ways - on stage, in public, bombing in life and many more gnarly stories that may or may not involve audience members throwing a punch. Were these tales from being “under the influence”? Some. And some are just his adventures. Bombing with Eric Andre is part of iHeartMedia and Will Ferrell’s Big Money Players podcast network.

events.title: FEET
events.description:
When FEET self-released their debut album in 2019, the group offered up a particularly oblique title: What’s Inside Is More Than Just Ham. But once listeners delved into the record,  they found sloshing’s of guitar music that careered wildly between indie, psych, and subtle shades of new wave across an exciting and unpredictable 35 minutes. Since then, FEET have seen prominent live shows have seen them supporting the likes of Inhaler and even The Rolling Stones at their huge 2022 Hyde Park shows. The bands second album "Make It Up" garnered further critical acclaim with the band being invited to perform a BBC 6Music Live session off the back of the single releases Greasy Boy, Why Would I Lie and The Real Thing. 

The band are returning in 2026 with their third album to be released on Submarine Cat Records amidst a year of heavy touring which will see the band on two UK and European headline stints throughout the album campaign. A very welcome return, then, for one of Britain’s most inventive bands, starting a new chapter afresh that builds on the brilliance of their first outing and takes it to a new level entirely. 2026, it’s fair to say, is ready for Feet to stomp all over it.

events.title: Femi Temowo
events.description:
Femi Temowo is a MOBO Award-nominated artist, composer, and music producer. His mastery on guitar and distinctive styles quickly earned him widespread recognition, leading to collaborations with world-class artists including George Benson, Amy Winehouse, Courtney Pine, Taylor Swift, The Roots, Omar, Soweto Kinch, and many more.

Beyond his virtuosity as a guitarist, Femi is a highly respected producer known for crafting warm, immersive soundscapes that blend jazz, soul, and African rhythms with contemporary influences. His production portfolio includes studio albums, live projects, and original scores for prestigious institutions such as the BBC and the National Theatre. Among his recent work, Femi has produced tracks for emerging UK artist Frenchie (formerly The Naked Eye), bringing his signature blend of musical
depth and emotional resonance to new voices. Continuously evolving, Femi Temowo remains a vital creative force, shaping modern music with authenticity, cultural heritage, and innovative artistry.

events.title: Graham Reynolds
events.description: Called “the quintessential modern composer” by the ​London Independent​, Austin-based  composer-bandleader-improviser Graham Reynolds records and performs music for film, theater, dance, rock clubs, and concert halls. He recently scored Richard Linklater’s He recently scored Richard Linklater’s Blue Moon (Sony) with Ethan Hawke and Margaret Qualley, Hit Man (Netflix), Happy Jail (Netflix), Stop Hitting Yourself (Lincoln Center Theater), Out of Her Mind (BBC), Grimm Tales (Ballet Austin), and a multi-year commission from Ballroom Marfa, The Marfa Triptych, culminating in his Creative Capital Award winning project Pancho Villa from a Safe Distance. Amidst his many other projects, Graham also serves as the Artistic Director of the new music focused non-profit Golden Hornet. In 2020, Graham signed with London-based record label Fire Records and released his original score for Alfred Hitchcock’s silent classic, The Lodger. His most recent release with Fire, Mountain (March 2025), is a full-length solo album that draws from the full breadth of his musical career.

events.title: Jadarrion
events.description: Known for deep selections across vinyl and digital, and a growing catalogue of groove-driven productions, Jadarrion continues to push boundaries and solidify his place as a name to watch.

events.title: Lew Apollo
events.description:
Lew Apollo is a rising force in modern soul, captivating audiences with his soul-stirring melodies and poignant songwriting. KUTX praised him as “the perfect summer vibe,” a fitting description for an artist whose music blends hypnotic guitar, cinematic production, and a sultry, smoky voice into lush, resonant soundscapes. Originally hailing from rural Barnum, MN, Lew’s artistry is deeply rooted in his home state’s heritage, fusing the legacies of Bob Dylan and Prince with modern influences like Hozier, Leon Bridges, and Labrinth.
The tragic loss of his father in 2022 profoundly shaped Lew’s songwriting, catalyzing a body of work that confronts themes of grief, isolation, and resilience while offering hope and connection. His debut EP JUNGLE, produced by BLK ODYSSY, introduced him as a bold new voice and fueled a run of sold-out shows at iconic Austin venues like The Pershing and Antone’s.
Since then, Lew has taken his music to wider audiences, touring in support of Los Lonely Boys and earning airplay on KUTX with his single “Diamonds and Gold” as well as “Let the Light In” from his debut album. Self-produced from start to finish, Fool’s Gold has already surpassed 300,000 streams in under two months and is creating buzz for its fearless vulnerability and lush production. Press outlets have echoed the excitement: AMP Music declared “Lew Apollo will be a force in the R&B and pop stratospheres. Be warned,” while Earmilk praised how “Apollo’s signature smoky voice sets the tone for a sultry soundscape.” With his clear vision and unwavering dedication to using music as a vessel for healing, Lew Apollo is quickly emerging as one of the most exciting new voices to watch in soul.

events.title: Nudo
events.description: nudo is a psychic handshake/brain trust between Joaquin Tenorio and Eric Hernandez. Hailing from Ciudad Juarez, Chihuahua, MX and Eagle Pass, Texas, USA, respectively. The pair met while living in Austin, TX and have been making music together since 2017. Throughout this time, their sound has journeyed from something like an improvised industrial, to more aleatoric collage passages, and is currently honing in on a more song based, corrido oriented zone, however pried apart.

events.title: Jaxs
events.description:
Jaxs, the electrifying lyricist from Currie, North Carolina, broke out as a Top 5 finalist on Netflix’s Rhythm + Flow Season 2. Known for her pen, magnetic presence, and genre-blending sound, she delivers every performance.
 
More than an artist, Jaxs is a branding powerhouse. She’s partnered with DTLR x New Balance and BACARDÍ x Casa BACARDÍ at Dreamville Festival, cementing her influence beyond music. She’s also graced stages like SXSW, Howard University Springfest, Grind Pretty Festival, did DTLR HBCU TOUR 2025 and more.
 
Her freestyle over a beat by super producer Timbaland went viral, amassing over 4 million views and proving her lyrical skill on a global scale. Her single “DOX MRTNS” was named an Editor’s Pick by The Hype Magazine, and she’s keeping the momentum going with her newest release, “Tomato Tomato”—a bold, witty track that showcases her originality and edge.
 
Influenced by Eminem, André 3000, Missy Elliott, Joyner Lucas, and Childish Gambino, Jaxs brings a fearless, Southern-rooted sound that pushes boundaries. With over 500K followers across social media, a rising brand profile, and nonstop creative energy, Jaxs is one of hip-hop’s most exciting new forces.

events.title: Adult DVD
events.description:
Adult DVD, the Leeds based six piece have become known for their relentless output of euphoric hooks and grooves along with a relentless touring schedule that has taken them to Glastonbury, Greenman, End Of The Road and several European festivals this Summer.
Formed by vocalist Harry Hanson and synth-player Greg Lonsdale, the project quickly expanded to a full band with Danny Blackburn (guitar/synth), Jake Williams (synth), Jonathan Newell (drums), and George Manson (bass). From the outset, their tongue-in-cheek lyrics, pulsating electronics, big choruses and unique production style (their releases are all self-produced) set them apart from the indie-rock landscape. 
Few songs capture the chaotic fun of Adult DVD more than their first release ‘Bill Murray’ - now a firm fan favourite and sing along moment at every festival set. First ‘proper’ single ‘Do Something’ from their 'Next Day Shipping' EP earned a spot on the BBC 6 Music B-list and support from BBC Radio 1, BBC Introducing and Radio X. Subsequent single ‘Because I Like It’ also landed onto the 6 Music B-list, and accompanying live performance from the BBC’s 6 Music festival.
Adult DVD’s live shows are fast becoming legendary. From sold-out hometown headline gigs at Brudenell Social Club and Belgrave Music Hall (2 in the round shows in one day) to storming sets at The Great Escape, Deer Shed Festival, and Live at Leeds, their performances are high-energy and unmissable.
Whether tapping into their love for chorus-centric indie or the influence of acid house floor fillers, DJing, or remixing their musical contemporaries their core appeal remains consistent: undeniable humour, bold danceable instrumentals and instantly memorable songwriting."
events.venue: British Music Embassy @ Palm Door on Sixth Patio

events.title: Hana Lili
events.description:
Hana Lili is on a mission to pursue her truth. For the Welsh artist, songwriting has always been a way to make sense of what words can’t quite hold. Her self-titled EP, Hana, marks her boldest step yet — an intimate collection that distils emotion into its rawest form. Blending confessional storytelling with the dynamic spirit of 90s and early 00s alt-rock, Hana crafts
songs that balance vulnerability and power. Drawing inspiration from artists like Alanis Morissette, Radiohead and Gwen Stefani, she channels emotional honesty through soaring melodies and unfiltered energy. Each song feels like a conversation with herself — an exploration of identity, doubt, and the small moments that shape who we are.
Hana’s music merges introspection with rebellion, turning personal chaos into connection. Raised in Wales and a first-language Welsh speaker, Hana’s sense of place runs deep. Her roots in the Welsh Eisteddfod tradition — a celebration of language, music, and storytelling — instilled in her a lasting belief in the power of creative expression.
With a sound that bridges intimacy and universality, Hana Lili stands as one of alt-pop’s most distinct and fearless emerging voices.

events.title: Mobeethicc
events.description: Mobee Thicc is a southside Chicago born & raised DJ who in 6 years, has brought people together with her dynamic & unique open-format style and are in high demand from neighborhood bars to major festival stages. She has begun to expand her portfolio to include major US cities including NYC & Houston, TX. Mobee is sure to bring you hours of quality sets that will leave lasting impressions on your crowds!

events.title: Zae France
events.description:
Zae France isn’t just making music, he’s redefining R&B. Blending nostalgia with innovation, his latest releases, including his
electrifying new single “RAX” and fan-favorite “Start 2 Finish,” have further solidified his status as one of the genre’s leading voices in
2025. 

With standout records like “Give It Up,” “Layin’ Low” with Ne-Yo, “Leg Day,” and “Whoa” featuring DaDa, Zae has amassed millions of streams, proving his ability to craft timeless hits that resonate.

Fresh off a highly successful 25-city tour with Eric Bellinger in 2024, he continues to captivate audiences with his smooth melodies, heartfelt lyricism, and undeniable
stage presence. His influence extends beyond the music, with major media spotlights on Revolt TV, On The Radar Radio, and MajorStage’s Pink Room with Drea.

Backed by industry heavyweights and a
rapidly growing fanbase, Zae France isn’t
just part of R&B’s new wave, he’s shaping
its future, one timeless record at a time

events.title: Boogietraxx
events.description:
As a rhythmic renovator of retro funk, Boogietraxx offers a lens into the discoverse that brought dance music to the masses but offers a uniquely soulful and modern twist.
Born in Staten Island, NY and now living in Austin, TX for the last few years, Boogietraxx, is helmed by producer/DJ Brandon Keeks who brings an array of influences in his soundscapes that feature filter house, French touch, and filter funk.

Brought up on a nutritious diet of Prince, Kashif, George Benson, Daft Punk, DJ Falcon, Romanthony, and countless others, Boogietraxx’s sound is rooted in the future with accentuated basslines and laser-guided melodies.

Fresh off of landing a #1 Nu-Disco/Disco best selling vinyl release on Juno.uk, Boogietraxx’s music has been supported by the likes of David Penn, Chromeo, Disco Dom, Don Diablo, and even had his music spun at Coachella by Barry Can’t Swim. After a busy 2025 traveling to cities like Chicago, New York City, Seattle, Madison, and more, there's no stopping where Boogie can go to next.

events.title: CHALK
events.description:
Chalk is the project of award-winning musicians and filmmaker
duo Ross Cullen and Benedict Goddard. An informed mix of
Dublin's guitar band scene and the sweaty hardcore dance
floors of their native Belfast, Chalk are IDLES meets Daniel Avery,
Death Grips meets Bicep - techno-infused industrial punk.
Since forming in 2022, Chalk have had a rise like no other,
quickly establishing themselves as an unmissable live act and
unpredictable, ferocious songwriters. Their debut UK/IRE tour
sold out, and led to further bookings across Europe as word of
their performance and guitar-melded techno spread via word of
mouth and support with national radio in the UK.
These songs were collated into the Conditions Trilogy, a family of
thirteen tracks that combine gritty Irish and German-influenced
techno and dance music with gothic, post-punk and jagged
guitar riffs and vocal melodies. This unique blend earned them
the support and kudos of their peers in Fontaines D.C., IDLES
and Sprints, all of whom handpicked the band to support them
throughout their tours.
events.venue: British Music Embassy @ Palm Door on Sixth

events.title: KELS
events.description: Originally from Pittsburgh, KELS has been based in Atlanta for three years. She gained significant buzz when she went on a 52 show US Tour in 2023 independently with no management and no label. Her following grew by 5 times while she was on the road for 8 months on her own. Her fans funded the entire tour. KELS headlined the Atlanta Jazz Festival in May 2024, opening for Andre 3000. In 2024 and 2025 she went on another independent 55 show tour fully funded by her fans.  With co-signs from both Big Boi and Timbaland, she is currently working on her debut EP in 2026.

events.title: Mackwood
events.description:
Dubbed “UK music’s best kept secret” (Clash UK), drummer and producer Mackwood is rapidly emerging as one of the most exciting voices in the new wave of UK jazz and beyond. Cutting his teeth with Col3trane, Jim Legacy and ELIZA, and coming up through crossover projects like Silhouettes Project and Levitation Orchestra, Mackwood has carved out a distinctive niche between progressive jazz, beatmaking and alternative dancefloor rhythms. His sound fuses the pedigree of UK and international jazz with London’s new generation of player-producers, continuing the UK’s celebrated tradition of boundary-breaking crossover.

Now stepping into the spotlight with his debut album MASTER CHANGES, he is cementing his reputation as a forward-thinking artist with global reach. With roots in jazz but a sound that bridges hip hop, electronic and bass culture, Mackwood’s music crosses scenes and audiences alike. His collaborations span both acclaimed names and rising talent, while his live energy and versatility are fast building him a worldwide reputation.

events.title: Thelonious Love
events.description: Artist & Activist, Thelonious Love is back with a powerful new sound. On his fourth studio project, with love, from JURNT Entertainment, lyrically at least, nothing is off the table for Love. His diary of songs range in themes from mental health, queer & black identity, addiction, relationships, social justice, and social media. Swaggering a unique baritone delivery, Love blends genres together while adding live instrumentation to deliver a unique Hip-Hop sound. Backed by his band and his boyfriend, Sean Maddox, Theo’s live show has evolved into on of Austin’s most memorable performances.

events.title: Monsieur Van Pratt
events.description:
Monsieur Van Pratt, founder of Super Spicy Records, is a prominent producer
and DJ originally from Mexico City, whose influence on electronic music is widely recognized both nationally and internationally. With an impressive career that included more than 100 releases in digital format and 30+ on vinyl, which consolidarse him as a key figure in the Disco, Funk, and House scene. His music has been released by prestigious record labels such as Toy Tonics (coming in 2026), Too Slow To Disco, The Disco Express, Tropical Disco Records, Buddha Bar, his own label Super Spicy Records, among others, underlining his status on the global scene. With a musical style deeply rooted in Disco, Funk, and
Jazz, Monsieur Van Pratt combines classical elements with contemporary
touches, creating a sound experience that is both nostalgic and innovative. His work not only stands out for its technical quality, but also for its ability to connect emocional y with the listener, making him a central figure in the evolution of modern dance sound.

events.title: Spoon Benders
events.description:
Spoon Benders is a three-piece punk rock band from Portland, Oregon, delivering raw volume, sharp hooks, and nonstop momentum. Stripped down and loud, the band thrives on a high-energy live show that feels just barely contained—fast, sweaty, and direct, with nothing wasted.
Built on constant movement, Spoon Benders have spent years touring relentlessly, honing their sound on stages across the country and earning a reputation as a band that hits hard and never phones it in. Their music channels punk’s urgency and grit, powered by tight chemistry and an aggressive edge that only a three-piece can deliver.
Now, Spoon Benders are preparing to release their highly anticipated third album, capturing the intensity of the road and the confidence of a band fully in its stride. With new songs on the way and the volume turned up, Spoon Benders continue to prove that three people are more than enough to make some serious noise.

events.title: Diles que no me maten
events.description: Psychedelic Punk in Spanish. Forced Jazz meditation.

events.title: Werkha
events.description:
Werkha (aka Tom Leah) is a multi-instrumentalist, producer & DJ hailing from Manchester and Cumbria. He has been consistently releasing music and creating live experiences for over a decade. Werkha’s music fuses analogue jazz-funk vibes with the UK’s electronic, resulting in a number of releases nestled between the sounds of broken beat and cinematic moments. Deep synths and delectable drums ride alongside live horns and a wealth of string textures. Shortly after his track “Sidesteppin” was picked up by Gilles Peterson for his Brownswood Bubblers compilation, Werkha’s debut landed on the acclaimed Brighton imprint Tru Thoughts. He went on to sign to the Worldwide Award-winning First Word Records, releasing his self-produced sophomore album ‘All Werk Is Play’ in 2022. This featured collabs with MC Chunky (Eglo Records / Swamp 81), Ellen Beth Abdi (A Certain Ratio), Kemani Anderson (Secret Night Gang), Nick Blacka (GoGo Penguin) and Tom Driessler (Tom Misch / Jordan Rakei) amongst others. 
 
His vibrant energetic live shows include a selection of instruments, looped and fused with a mix of tightly packed samples that set the moment alight, blending beauty and dance.

events.title: AJTHEFLANNELGOD
events.description: Born in Michigan and raised in Atlanta, AJTheFlannelGOD, also known as flannel, creates music rooted in emotional honesty and duality. Blending alternative hip-hop, melodic rap, and soulful textures, his sound reflects the balance between Midwest introspection and Southern influence. Through introspective lyrics and hypnotic production, flannel explores themes of love, grief, ambition, and self-discovery. The foundation of his evolving HAPPYSAD creative vision. His songs feel like journal entries set to rhythm, offering listeners both vulnerability and confidence in the same breath. More than an artist, flannel is building a multidimensional world that extends into film, fashion, and visual storytelling. With projects like “Love Is War”  and the forthcoming [flannel], he continues to shape a distinct voice that resonates with anyone navigating life’s contradictions.

events.title: amri
events.description:
amri fuses her Indian roots into putting a spin on her much-loved Soul and R&B to create a fresh, new, jazzy, colourful sound. Branching into a range of sounds built in Carnatic melodies, amri balances relatable lyrics to a fun, fresh groove. Born and primarily brought up in London alongside Guernsey, she draws from these experiences in her writing. With so many inspirations she branches from, her soulful, sweet melodies will surely hold a piece of something you love and play over in your head! 

She touches on her exposure in the world as a young woman of colour, translating this into getting you to feel, sing and move with her. Her debut EP ‘grooves in a SMILE’ invites you into her world to feel, sing and move with her. Having been interviewed on BBC Bristol’s Breakfast show, songs featured on BBC Introducing Radio and showcased in RESONATE and KICKDRUM magazines, amri has been gaining attention, and seems not to be slowing down.
Now based in Bristol with her band, her blend of the smooth, sultry edges of jazz and soul, combined with brass and sitar, creates a unique fusion that’s not one to miss..

events.title: Attalie
events.description:
Attalie is a California-based music seamstress whose sound lives at the intersection of jazz, alternative R&B, and neo-soul. Her music serves as a sanctuary — a space where listeners are invited to let their guard down, look inward, and reconnect with themselves, empowered to be and become in spite of societal norms.

Her work has received critical acclaim and has been featured by The Guardian, The FADER, CLASH, Mixmag, BBC Radio 1Xtra, KEXP, KCRW, NTS Live and more.

She is currently unveiling a new chapter of her work led by two visual singles, Carry Me and Light, both offering an intimate glimpse into the sonic and visual world of her upcoming project, set for release in 2026.

events.title: Azamiah
events.description:
Primed to be the next group from the UK jazz underground to break out, Azamiah draw on 
jazz roots while touching on everything from James Blake’s production techniques to dubby 
low-end, taking the listener on a journey across moody and light landscapes.  Their 2023 
debut album ‘In Phases’ won praise from The Skinny and CLASH and received plays on BBC 
6Music and NTS.  A bridge between first album, and second, their recent EP ‘Two Lands’ 
released in May 2025 resonates with emotional honesty and is played with a fresh intensity. 
The band has played on stages across the UK and Europe including Latitude Festival, Jazz on Wick, Hidden Door, Edinburgh Jazz and Blues Festival, Brick Lane Jazz Festival, JAZZMI (IT) & North Sea Round Town (NL). Having recently completed their first UK headline tour in October 2025 to electric audiences in Glasgow, London, Bristol, Manchester, Leeds and Brighton and flooded with requests for a re-press of 'In Phases', a dedicated fanbase is making themselves known.

events.title: Batry Powr (Nicole Miglis)
events.description:
Batry Powr is Hundred Waters frontwoman Nicole Miglis exploring long-form meditation music with battery-powered instruments.

Nicole Miglis is a songwriter, multi-instrumentalist and producer who's music has been featured in publications including Pitchfork, Stereogum, Rolling Stone, NPR and The New York Times. Her band Hundred Waters have performed on the David Letterman and Stephen Colbert late night shows, as well as festivals including Coachella, Bonnaroo, and the band’s own festival FORM. From 2022-24 she toured as the lead vocalist for Bonobo’s Fragments world tour, and artist with whom she’s collaborated with, most recently for the 2025 soundtrack of Shinichirō Watanabe’s latest anime series, Lazarus.

Her live performances feature her love of blending electronic and acoustic instrumentation, and background in classical piano, into a musical form form all her own.

events.title: Bohemio
events.description:
Bohemio is a collective of friends from different cities, united by music and a shared creative vision. Blending their talent with natural charisma, they’ve taken off on social media, inviting audiences to connect with their youthful energy and rich musical roots.

Positioned at the forefront of the new wave of cumbia and regional Mexican music, Bohemio fuses the genre’s tradition with a fresh, original sound. They’ve built a highly engaged fanbase on TikTok and Instagram, where their modern cumbias frequently go viral and become part of their audience’s everyday soundtrack, setting them apart as one of the most promising acts in today’s regional scene.

events.title: Couch Dog
events.description:
WE MAKE MUSIC FOR DANCING, CRYING AND KISSING.

Couch Dog is Maxwell Ferrer (lead vocals + guitar), Tasha Lee (bass), Pablo Acosta (lead guitar) and Liam Reece (drums). The band originally formed in San Luis Obispo, CA, and are currently based out of Los Angeles. The Dogs aim to push the boundaries of indie and garage rock with every release (whether it’d be glitchy electronics, gazey ambiance or stripped-back instrumentation). Unraveler, their latest EP, is Couch Dog’s most sonically diverse release to date. The project excels at retaining their classic and beloved sound from 2023’s “How to Ruin Your Life Fast”, distinguished by energetic guitar riffs, driving rhythms, and earnest lyricism, but elevates it with left field experimentation, song writing from different members and new textures.

Since day one, they have placed an emphasis on putting on unforgettable live shows, helping audiences connect with their material deeply. Starting from sold-out house shows in their home town, to headlining a US tour, they always work on fostering a strong sense of community, belonging and freedom to go absolutely nuts in the mosh pit.

events.title: DJ CZ
events.description:
DJ CZ is a Brazilian DJ and music producer with over 8 years of experience as a DJ and 6 years as a producer, recognized as one of the standout names in Brazil’s urban and dance music scene. He has performed more than 650 shows across Brazil, building a strong nationwide connection with audiences.

Currently reaching between 3 to 5 million monthly listeners on Spotify, DJ CZ has accumulated over 350 million total streams across digital platforms. His catalog includes major hits such as “Rabetão de Terremoto” (100M+ streams), “Construção de Amor” (50M+), “Braba No Chá” (45M+), “Telefone do GW” (40M+), and “Brisada Que Ela Se Joga” (15M+), alongside several other million-stream tracks.

In 2025, he reached a key milestone with his first international tour in Canada, performing in Toronto, Québec, and Montreal, expanding his global reach. DJ CZ has collaborated with leading Brazilian artists including Kevin O Chris, Zé Felipe, MC Jacaré, MC GW, MC Meno K, MC Nito, and MC Jhey.

Known for his high-energy performances, strong musical identity, and hit-making ability, DJ CZ continues to grow as a global artist, delivering tracks that dominate playlists, clubs, and festivals worldwide.

events.title: Don Glori
events.description:
Unpicking the thread that stitches together Don Glori’s music would be an impossible task. His records combine elements of Jazz, Funk, Soul, RnB and Samba, yet he doesn’t fit neatly into any of those genres. His live show is more jazz - punk - funk than anything. One thing is certain, there is an undeniable, joyful, spirit that permeates through his music.

Following on from the success of his 2024 album ‘Don’t Forget to Have Fun’, Don Glori is back with his third offering, this time on Mr. Bongo - ‘Paper Can’t Wrap Fire’.
“A kaleidoscopic genre-surfing odyssey that brings together the worlds of jazz, soul and funk. Feeling both contemporary and classic, familiar yet novel, it’s an assured third release that sees an artist in full flight, showcasing their creative prowess and the uniqueness of their musical voice.”

events.title: Ella Ion
events.description:
Emerging from Kaurna Land (Adelaide, Australia), fragmented-folk musician Ella Ion crafts music that cuts deep to the core. Drawing on influences of indie-rock, folk and country, her eloquent lyricism and masterful musical control delivers a cacophony of raw emotion, anchored by grit and heart. Ion has already amassed a loyal following across Australia, as well as listeners streaming her music across the UK, US, Europe and more. 

From intimate encounters of tender folk to electrifying post-rock arrangements, Ion flaunts her ability to transform a room of anyone and everyone into a fan. Ella Ion is holding nothing back as she barrels forward in a direction of raw sonic and personal exploration. Ion has supported Suki Waterhouse, Folk Bitch Trio, Jake Bugg, and Greg Mendez at shows across Australia, UK and Europe, as well as taking to the stage at The Great Escape Festival and Green Man Festival in the UK.

events.title: J’cuuzi
events.description: Describing J’cuuzi as a band is at the very least inaccurate, or worse: incorrect. While they deliver electrifying, borderline acrobatic live performances of high octane, glitchy songs that modulate between serrated post punk guitar and pulsing electro beats, there is a shocking theatricality to them that the word “band” lacks the range to capture. The members wear handmade couture, with bulbous anime-esque proportions and insectile features sewn into drag silhouettes. They often perform while stacked on top of each other, or hoisted over each other’s heads. Their stage is set like a cheap studio apartment: a spinning blue egg chair and a stack of guitar amps sit on either side of a bedazzled ironing board, from which a spinning disco ball hangs. Since their inception in February 2024, J’cuuzi’s ferocity has earned them opening slots for acts like Viagra Boys, Stereolab, Tune-Yards, Shannon and the Clams, Upchuck, Snooper, and Warmduscher. Whether you call them a band, a performance art troupe, or a fashion house; J’cuuzi has set a pace of expansion and experimentation that proves theirs is an act worth watching.

events.title: Joe Patitucci
events.description:
Joe Patitucci is a multi-media artist and pioneer in the field of plant music and bio-sonification, uniquely blending his background in music, design, and environmental advocacy. His innovative work creates immersive sonic environments that bridge  natural and digital worlds, resonating with audiences' intuitive connection to Earth.

As the creator of PlantWave, Joe uses specialized sensors to translate the bio-rhythms and electrical frequencies of plants into ambient music. This groundbreaking approach revolutionizes how we perceive and interact with plant life, opening new avenues in sound art, wellness, and environmental consciousness.

Joe's installations and performances, ranging from intimate galleries to large-scale festivals, have captivated audiences worldwide. His commitment to art as a medium fosters a deeper understanding of the bond between humans and nature.

In 2021, Joe’s company, Data Garden, released PlantWave. PlantWave enables anyone to experience plant music in their homes, gardens, or on the trail, democratizing this unique interaction and integrating Joe's vision into everyday life.

events.title: Kodie Shane
events.description:
A cornerstone of Atlanta’s alternative scene, Kodie Shane is the seasoned architect of "Ethereal Trap." Evolving from a teenage prodigy into a fully autonomous force, she navigated the major-label system at Epic Records before successfully negotiating her independence. Today, she operates with 100% creative control and a "glitter-eyed" aesthetic that defies convention.

A songwriter first, Kodie holds credits on 95% of her catalog, with over 100 releases and 100M+ streams to her name. Her raw vulnerability and melodic precision have made her a premier collaborator and a global touring staple. Whether headlining international dates from London to South Africa or supporting icons like Jhené Aiko, Lil Uzi Vert, and Willow Smith, her high-octane stage presence is unmatched.

Beyond music, Kodie is a premier tastemaker cited by Vogue and Pitchfork. Blending luxury high fashion with streetwear, she has fronted global campaigns that challenge gender norms, solidifying her status as a visual icon for a loyal community of 850,000+ followers and 300,000 + monthly listeners on Spotify

events.title: Lightbath
events.description:
Lightbath explores sound, space, and form through generative processes that treat the machine as collaborator. In the composer-as-gardener spirit, improviser and sound designer Bryan Noll plants musical seeds and guides them into pieces that unfold in the present moment.

“Working with generative processes feels like a collaboration,” says Noll, “as if it’s alive and interacting with me. It’s an active meditation where I set the initial framework and listen, remaining agile enough to guide the musical conversation.”

Lightbath’s sound and process took shape through YouTube videos that capture the physical act of coaxing music from modular systems. Pitchfork described these “artfully unpretentious demonstrations” as a “strange, sui-generis niche,” calling them “part performance, part tech tutorial, and part audio-visual wallpaper.”

Noll has released music on RVNG Intl and Seil Records and contributed music to series for Apple TV+ and SHOWTIME. His work has also appeared in campaigns for Apple, Coinbase, and Headspace. As a sound designer, he has created patches and presets for Moog Music, Novation/Focusrite, G-Force Software, and Polyend.

events.title: MARCO PLUS
events.description:
Marco Plus is carving out his own lane in hip-hop, blending razor-sharp lyricism with boundless sonic versatility. Hailed as a symbol that rap is alive and well, his technical prowess and raw authenticity have earned nods from outlets like Power 105.1’s The Breakfast Club, Complex Mag, Rap Caviar and more.

After spending a week with the giants of Dreamville, it was clear that Marco’s pen could hold weight in any room. His viral moment on Kai Cenat’s Mafiathon stream only further solidified his undeniable talent and magnetic presence, showing the world that his confidence is rooted in skill, not hype. His latest album, Marco Plus vs. Tha Underworld, continues that statement featuring a standout collaboration with Smino and proving he can spar with some of the sharpest voices in the game. Whether it’s on livestreams, stages, or in the booth, he’s amongst those leading the charge.

events.title: Money Mark
events.description: Legendary composer, inventor, and the unofficial “Fourth Beastie Boy,” Money Mark has been rewriting the sonic playbook since ’75. With a career spanning Billboard #1s and collaborations with icons like David Byrne, Jack White, Miley Cyrus, and Beck, he is the ultimate musical pivot point. Part virtuoso, part mad scientist, Mark currently spends his time inventing new instruments and using unconventional experiments to find the sounds of tomorrow.

events.title: mypilotis
events.description:
mypilotis (pronounced: “my-pilloh-TEA”, one-word, stylized in all lowercase) is a San Antonio-based indie project and alias of multi-instrumentalist, songwriter, and self-proclaimed “homemade producer”, Chesca Umeno, blending DIY charm with catchy melodies, addictive hooks, and thoughtful songwriting, crafted with love at home in a small room, played with electric energy, and shared with awkward charm.

In the studio, mypilotis consists of solely Chesca who writes, records, and plays all of the parts and instruments. On tour and during live performances, mypilotis is supported by close friends and fellow musicians – Joey Gonzalez on lead guitar, Edgar Betancourt on drums, Sophie Kurihara bass, and JJ Herron on keys. mypilotis takes inspiration from artists such as Dayglow, Ginger Root, Boy Pablo, Mini Trees, and ATARASHII GAKKO! where the artist has grown from intimate DIY home recordings to a must-see high-energy live act.

events.title: Oscar Ortiz
events.description:
“Music will never stop evolving, and I will continue to grow with it.” ~Oscar Ortiz

Born into an artistic family of Regional Mexican artists, Oscar Ortiz is the youngest of four leading artists in the genre: Gerardo, William, and Kevin Ortiz. However, Oscar shines on his own with his youthful style and talent as a composer, fusing cumbia and ballads with modern corridos.

His solo music began to transcend borders with the singles “El Del C8” (2023) and “FIRST LOVE” (2024) with Edgardo Núñez; the latter catapulting him onto the global scene with over 200 million streams on Spotify, a No. 1 spot on Billboard Regional Mexican Airplay, platinum certifications, and virality on TikTok.
This phenomenon was followed by other songs that consolidated his musical identity, such as "ALVRGZO" (with Alex Favela and Código FN), "Anillos" (with Oscar Maydón), "Modo Bélico" (with Polo González), "23/7," and "Ice Cream" (with Los Mismos de la M).

Oscar Ortiz didn't stop there. In 2025, he continued to reap hits like "Y Si Te Vas," a single released with Carin León, which peaked at #5 and is currently #7 on Billboard's Regional Mexican Airplay charts. Additionally, he has other songs released this year, such as “Aplauso” with Matisse, “AMIGOS PARA QUÉ”, “CARO,” and soon “LAST KISS” which will be released in October 2025. Added to this is his biggest project to date: his first studio album, projected to be released in January 2026. In Oscar's words, this project brings “a lot of love and heartbreak… corridos, versatile sounds, a little bit of everything,” in addition to collaborations with artists from different regional currents.

events.title: Oya Noire
events.description:
Oya Noire (she/they) is a stunning Haitian-American singer and songwriter from Brooklyn, NY. An undeniable force and artist, Oya started off as a backup vocalist for 2x Grammy winner, Timothy Bloom. Now, as an independent artist, Oya Noire channels her New York City roots fusing high-energy with Neo-soul and Jazzy rhythms that linger long after the song ends. 

A storyteller with magnetic lyrics, Oya writes songs that are honest and unapologetically her own. She mesmerizes audiences, captivating music lovers at iconic venues such as Baby’s All Right, SOBs NY, and Blue Note Jazz Club. With her stage presence and call-and-response hooks, Oya's hit singles “Slow Down”, “Hunnid Band$”, and “Gangsta” are sure to warm up any crowd. A fan-favorite with over 5.5 million streams across DSPs and a well-anticipated mixtape on the way, Oya Noire leaves no heart untouched and no lyric wasted.

events.title: Passion Pit
events.description: Passion Pit is an American alternative indie pop band formed in 2007 in Cambridge, Massachusetts, primarily acting as the moniker for singer-songwriter and producer Michael Angelakos. Initially a solo project, the band gained fame for, high-energy, synth-driven pop, with hits like "Sleepyhead" and "Take a Walk".

events.title: Rafa Parra
events.description:
Rafa Parra, cantautor/productor originario de la Ciudad de México. Experimentando con nuevas formas de expresión dentro del pop urbano, mezclando letras románticas con ritmos irresistibles como el dembow y el merenguetón. Su estilo fresco y
emocional invita tanto a bailar como a enamorarse.
Con canciones como “A Besos Si” y “Olaya <3”, Rafa ha comenzado a llamar la atención por su forma única
de contar historias de amor con flow, ritmo y mucha sensibilidad. Su música suena a momentos reales:
mensajes no enviados, fiestas que terminan en confesiones y corazones que laten más fuerte.
Rafa crea canciones que se sienten cercanas, con hooks pegajosos y melodías que se quedan en la
cabeza. Su propuesta es emocional y pensada para conectar con quienes viven el amor con intensidad,
entre el reggaetón lento y las composiciones.

events.title: Raq Baby
events.description: Chicago-born and Atlanta-raised, Raq Baby is carving out his own lane in hip-hop with an unapologetic sound that blends raw street emotion with melodic vulnerability. His music captures the highs and lows of his come-up — gritty, honest, and charged with energy that connects instantly with the youth of his generation. Raq continues to captivate his audience with is newest project I Never Gave AF, a bold statement of self-determination that earned him a placement on local playlists and music blogs across the South. His sound fuses the unfiltered storytelling of classic trap with drill rap — creating music that hits hard both in the club and through headphones. On stage, Raq’s presence is magnetic. He’s performed alongside artists like SahBabii, YTB Fatt, Hunxho, and Vonoff1700, bringing an unmatched energy that’s helped him sell out his first headline show at Atlanta’s Aisle 5 and secure bookings at Rolling Loud. Beyond the music, Raq Baby stands as a voice for authenticity — a young artist who’s seen struggle, growth, and triumph, and channels all of it into his art. Raq Baby is more than an artist — he’s a movement in the making.

events.title: The Red Eye Gamblers
events.description:
The Red Eye Gamblers are a psychedelic southern rock band with a uniquely Austin, Texas sound. They bridge elements of rock, bluegrass, and jammy psychedelia to create a new experience with every show.

They have a deep repertoire, and in over two years of live shows, they have never played the same set list twice. They will often venture outside of their normal 5-piece lineup featuring a saxophone, djembe, and harmonica to create an unforgettable live experience.

They released their debut single "Let You Down Easy" in October 2024. A fan favorite from live shows, "Let You Down Easy" is a fast-paced song about simply saying goodbye. In September 2025, they followed it up with their next single "Whiskey Memories." "Whiskey Memories" is a powerful ballad about reminiscing on the past and learning to move on from the troubles it may have caused. The song features introspective lyrics, instrumental breakdowns, and showcases even more of what The Red Eye Gamblers have to offer.

From starting with backyard shows in east Austin, all the way to the Continental Club and the incredible stages at SXSW 2025,  The Red Eye Gamblers are one of THE bands to watch for SXSW 2026 & beyond

events.title: Rehash
events.description:
Rehash is an indie-rock band from South Florida that began with two high schoolers making music in their bedrooms. In June 2023, they wrote and recorded their self-titled debut album “Rehash”, cementing themselves as one of the most exciting emerging acts on the East Coast. To date, everything has been written, recorded, produced, mixed, and mastered by the band. Their latest project “mock” has been a favorite of fans since its release in June of 2025. With more music on the way, Rehash is gearing up for their biggest year yet. 

They started off touring on opening runs with acts like Alexsucks and Dogpark. They’re currently on tour and have sold out 75% of the shows. 

With the release of their sophomore album Mock in June 2025, Rehash saw explosive growth—streaming numbers jumped over 50% in the last two months, reaching over 5 million monthly streams.

events.title: Soucream
events.description:
Isaac Sosa, better known as SOUCREAM, is a Venezuelan artist born on July 5, 2003. He lived in his country until 2018, the year in which he emigrated with his family to Buenos Aires, Argentina. There he discovered the world of funk and began to collaborate with Mauro Hansen, his producer and creative ally, with whom he continues to create today.

In January 2023, he decided to leave Buenos Aires and settle in Miami, Florida, a city that opened the doors to accelerated growth within the Latin Funk movement, recognized “el funk de tu pais”.

events.title: Steven Bamidele
events.description:
Nigerian-born, London-based singer, songwriter, musician, and producer Steven Bamidele is known for his distinctive reverb-drenched falsetto, synth textures, and syncopated beats. Citing the influences of contemporary creators Frank Ocean, Tyler the Creator, Solange and Childish Gambino, he puts social commentary and artistic narratives at the forefront of his music. 

His recent sophomore album THE CRASH! was written against the backdrop of an ever-changing world, combining indie-soul and jazz, acoustic and electronic textures, along with daydream-esque storytelling. The LP received support from Blues Project, Somewhere Soul, BBC Radio 3, BBC 6Music, BBC Introducing, WorldwideFM, Clash, Wordplay and Fusicology, alongside playlisting from Jazz FM, FIP Radio France and KCRW.

To critical acclaim, he has headlined London’s iconic 100 Club, Brighton's Dome Studio and Prince Albert, Jazz re:freshed, Pizza Express Live Soho and more.  Steven has supported renowned artists Alice Russell, Sly5thAve, Hot 8 Brass Band, Marlon Craft, Kymara, Ebi Soda, while making festival appearances at We Out Here, Love Supreme, Shambala, The Great Escape, Brick Lane Jazz, SXSW London and beyond.

events.title: The Chief Suite at SXSW
events.description: The Chief Suite at SXSW is a space for executive women to hear from top leaders, connect, and get inspired.From Chief, the most powerful network of senior women leaders. Learn more about membership at www.chief.com.

events.title: The Chief Suite at SXSW
events.description: The Chief Suite at SXSW is a space for executive women to hear from top leaders, connect, and get inspired.From Chief, the most powerful network of senior women leaders. Learn more about membership at www.chief.com.

events.title: Daily Decode
events.description:
Start your day with clarity.

Each morning, PwC leaders will break down what’s happening on the ground at SXSW and translate it into practical, actionable insights for you and your clients. These 20-minute briefings cut through the noise to surface what matters most across agentic commerce, Gen Alpha, industry convergence, emerging technologies, and evolving consumer behavior.

You’ll leave with a sharper point of view, clear implications for your business, and tangible ways to turn cultural momentum into competitive advantage.

events.title: Free Professional Headshots Presented by Precision Camera & Video with Fujifilm
events.description: Precision Camera & Video, in partnership with Fujifilm, is offering FREE professional headshots! This is a great opportunity to get a sharp, high-quality image with expert guidance. Don’t miss your chance to elevate your professional look.

events.description:
Whether you’re pressure-testing a big idea or sparking fresh innovation, this 20-minute laser-style coaching session is the ultimate game-changer for your SXSW Emerging Tech Expo experience. Book your session with one of 30+ ICF-credentialed coaches and make your next move intentional.

Sign up for a session here: https://signup.com/client/invitation2/secure/161661456086/false#/invitation

events.description: Looking to update your LinkedIn profile, business card, or marketing material? Swing by for a free professional headshot by Precision Camera & Video and Fujifilm. This is an awesome chance to get a sharp, high-quality photo. Don’t miss out on this fantastic opportunity to elevate your image with expert help!
