events.description: Pick up your SXSW Badge in the Guadalupe Room of the Omni Downtown. Your badge is required in order to attend any sessions, events, or socials.

events.title: SXSW Expo: Emerging Tech
events.description:
Showcasing a collective of industry disruptors, the Emerging Tech Expo features businesses spearheading the development of revolutionary technology. At the forefront of tech, these breakthrough exhibitors are shaping the future of tomorrow’s solutions. Plug into the network of visionary leaders that are pioneering the digital frontier. The Expo will be free and open to the public on Wednesday, March 18.

See the floor plan here: https://sxsw2026-sxexpoetech.expofp.com/

events.title: University of Cincinnati Lounge
events.description: Think of us as the ultimate college lounge: coffee, chargers, comfy chairs, some adult beverages, and all the fuel you need to spark your next great idea. Oh, and there will be a free Allbirds drawing every day.

events.title: Agents at Work: Build AI That Ships with v0
events.description: Vibe coding isn't just for demos and landing pages anymore. In this hands-on workshop, the team behind v0 by Vercel will show you how to use natural language to build AI agents that actually transform how you work, inspired by agents already running in production at Vercel. You'll build your own and walk away with something real you can bring back to your team. No coding background needed. Just bring a problem worth solving, and we'll help you ship the solution.

events.title: Aging Policy = Youth Policy. Let's Act Like It.
events.description:
Aging is often framed as an old person's problem. But millions of young people in America are already affected, with 3.6 million youth ages 15–22 caring for loved ones with little support, and over 7% of young workers’ earnings go to Social Security and Medicare, despite having minimal trust those benefits will be there for them as they age.

This conversation will challenge and embolden attendees to see aging as a multigenerational issue—calling on leaders to give younger generations a seat at the table and on young people to speak out to shape the future of America's social safety net.

events.title: Authenticity vs. Deepfake: Who Validates What's Real?
events.description: With deepfakes and synthetic media on the rise, the line between real and fake is razor-thin. A recent UK/US study found that most consumers can’t identify AI-generated fakes - only 0.1% of participants could accurately distinguish real from fake content. So, Unico’s Tech Advisor, Davi Reis explores how identity verification methods are now more critical than ever to fight fraud, detect synthetic media, protect users, speed transactions, while also building trust in the post-truth era. What if authenticity becomes the ultimate currency?

speakers.name: Davi Reis
speakers.title: Tech Advisor for Unico
speakers.company: ACESSO DIGITAL TECNOLOGIA DA INFORMACAO S.A.

events.title: Beyond Branding: Advertising as Infrastructure for Change
events.description: Advertising is evolving—from persuasion to public service. Marco Venturelli explores how brands like AXA and McDonald's are turning campaigns into agents of change, from securing housing in contract fine print for domestic violence survivors to lighting dark city streets with golden arches. Showcasing powerful work from across the globe, he reveals how marketing budgets can solve real problems—not just build brands but build solutions.

events.title: Can AI Learn Your Voice? Let's Find Out Live
events.description:
Can AI learn your unique voice? In this session, AI engineer & educator Harper Carroll (Stanford, Meta) fine-tunes an open-source model on her own X posts, and tests the result live.

While the model trains, she breaks down the science behind what's happening: how AI models are just probability machines, why smaller models can outperform larger ones for specific tasks (and what this means for you, your business, & your wallet), open vs. closed-source models, and how fine-tuning fundamentally changes a model's output compared to prompt engineering alone. This is for all levels of understanding.

events.title: Can Biotech Help Save Coral Reefs?
events.description: Coral reef ecosystems are in crisis due to climate change, pollution, and overfishing, and traditional restoration methods are limited in scale. This panel explores how biotechnology, materials science, and synthetic biology are converging to give reefs a fighting chance. From lab-grown super algae to bioactive reef coatings, scientists and startups are creating new tools to restore reefs faster, smarter, and more effectively. To scale impact, they are also developing sustainable business models and innovative funding partnerships.

events.title: Cannabis Prisoners in the Era of Legalization
events.description: As cannabis becomes legal across the country, tens of thousands of Americans remain incarcerated for the same plant. This panel brings together advocates and directly impacted leaders to examine the state of cannabis legalization, expose how cannabis prisoners are being left behind, and offer solutions. From clemency to re-entry, the panel will share strategies to ensure justice is at the center of cannabis reform, not just profit.

events.title: Connecting Creatives Networking Meet Up
events.description: Tired of surface-level networking and awkward pitches? You’re not alone—53% of professionals say making real connections is their biggest challenge. Join this interactive, no-pitch Connect 4 Speakeasy, a collaborative space for creatives to engage deeply through real conversations, problem solving, and discovering the four allies every creative career needs. Learn to navigate networking strategically at SXSW and beyond to grow your audience and elevate your brand while connecting with people, not positions, to build authentic bonds.

events.title: Corporate Dark Arts: The Real Rules of Marketing Power
events.description: This panel cracks open a vault of 60+ anonymous confessions from marketing leaders all over the world who've survived the C-suite by honing a new set of under-the-radar corporate superpowers. They evolved, not by fighting the forces of doubt, but by flipping them—using ambiguity as leverage, tension as traction, and absurdity as armor. What they faced first, every role faces now.

speakers.name: Dominic Leung
speakers.title: Executive Director of Strategy and Transformation

events.title: Creative Pitching: Nerve Bundle To Boardroom Wrecking Ball
events.description: Next time you’re nervous pitching to a client, ask yourself, “What’s my wrecking ball here?” It could be your tone, your brevity, or your charisma. FACT: Most creative folk don’t get proper pitch/prezo training. They wing it. What if you could learn to tell/sell energizing stories that sprinkle magic dust all over the client? Did you know this is an often-overlooked, age-old art form? Your workshop guide is keynote speaker & firecracker pitching coach Jon, and he’s spoken at SX 18 times & trained 1000s in 26 countries. He’ll prep you to deliver & destroy in boardrooms & on stages the world over.

events.title: Featured Session: Launch, Land, Orbit: The Future of Space with Firefly
events.description: A fireside chat with Jason Kim, CEO, and Brigette Oakes, VP of Engineering, at Firefly Aerospace. In 2025, Firefly became the first commercial company to successfully land on the Moon, and now the company is working towards a repeat in 2026. Firefly’s next lunar is bigger and bolder, set to land on the far side of the Moon for the first time in American history. This company is simultaneously launching rockets to fill a void in the growing satellite market while also preparing to orbit a constellation of spacecraft in support of in-space maneuverability, space domain awareness, and more. Jason and Brigette will discuss what’s next for the company and where the space industry is headed next.

events.title: Featured Session: Shit You Should Care About: Live
events.description: Ever wondered what it’s like to accidentally start a global media empire from your uni group chat? In this live SXSW show, Lucy Blakiston scrolls back through the feed that is the Shit You Should Care About story. Expect internet reckonings, hot takes, a fangirl-to-SHE-EO pipeline, and behind-the-scenes SYSCA drama - all stitched together with honesty, humour, and a little bit of heartache. It’s like flicking through your favourite Instagram account, but in real life. No bullshit - just Lucy, the posts that changed everything, and what it’s like being a very normal girl trying to stay real in front of a very not-normal number of people.

events.title: Frontier Firms in Action The Playbook for AI Skills Adoption
events.description: AI is transforming how organizations learn and innovate. Microsoft shares a practical playbook for embedding AI skills across roles, accelerating skill development and fostering a culture of continuous learning . Discover actionable  steps to map capabilities, launch adaptive learning journeys, and accelerate AI adoption, enabling your workforce to grow with the future of AI.

speakers.name: Todd Minor
speakers.title: Global Learning Leader, Microsoft Customer & Partner Solutions

events.title: The Future of Live Music: Immersive and Interactive
events.description:
The future of live music is interactive, immersive, and powered by real-time technology. This panel explores how concerts are evolving across physical and digital spaces through XR platforms, Unreal Engine, virtual performance, and production design.

Leaders from Meta, Magnopus, Epic Games, and Wave will share how they are transforming concerts into multi-sensory experiences, blending creativity and technology to shape the next generation of live performance.

speakers.name: Eric Krueger
speakers.title: Head of Platform and Developer Strategy

events.title: Global Advertising and Marketing Meet Up
events.description: We could all use a little more real human connection in the creative industries right about now. This is a come-as-you-are gathering for passionate creative folk who work in advertising, marketing, or a creative field nearby. If you’re someone who makes things, shape ideas, and cares deeply about the work, you are one of us. Whether you’re here to meet new friends in the business, trade stories and insights, or let your network grow naturally, this is an ego-free zone. No sales pitches and no icky networking – just bring a coffee, a curious mind and positively lovely vibes.

events.title: The Great Fusion Debate: How Far Away Are We Really?
events.description: Fusion energy could transform civilization or remain perpetually out of reach. Some say commercially viable fusion is decades and billions of dollars away, one of the hardest problems humanity will solve. Others claim it's coming by 2028. Which is it? The gap between these predictions comes down to what “viable” means and which technical barriers matter most. This panel tackles the friction head-on with grounded discussion on fusion milestones, market economics, and fusion's role in powering AI and energy infrastructure. Expect hard questions and competing perspectives from people building and tracking the technology.

events.title: How AI is Driving the Future of Visual Work & Creativity
events.description: Join Canva CCO Rob Giglio for a fireside chat on the collision between AI and visual creativity. As evolving technologies like AI have helped democratize design and content demands skyrocket, Rob reveals how visual work is evolving from exclusive expertise to universal expression. Learn why the future isn't AI replacing designers--it's AI empowering everyone to think visually, communicate effectively, and create impact at scale.

speakers.name: Liz Bacelar
speakers.title: Global Head Of Ai & Advanced Analytics

events.title: In Uncertainty We Trust: The New Rules of Leadership
events.description: When disruption hits, from AI to remote work, leaders face make-or-break moments. Control is out; trust is in. In this interactive workshop, you’ll discover the new rules for navigating change without losing your people. You’ll gain actionable tools and a proven playbook to steady teams, spark innovation, and keep your best people engaged—even when the future is uncertain. Real-world case studies and peer learning will help you transform uncertainty from a risk into your leadership superpower. Walk away ready to anchor your team, accelerate trust, and lead boldly through whatever comes next.

events.title: The Last Human at the FDA: AI on a Skeleton Crew
events.description: Historic workforce cuts at FDA, CDC, and NIH are gutting review desks and lab benches. Regulators now pin hopes on AI triage engines to keep drug approvals, inspections and outbreak models on track. With capacity math and pilot algorithms already in production, we'll discuss accountability when fewer humans oversee smarter tools. What’s the single most important question to tell if a regulatory AI is trustworthy or just a black box? Where do the FDA and CDC need outside expertise? How can orgs support, innovate or build partnerships without entanglement in ethical or bureaucratic red tape?

speakers.name: Alan Minsk
speakers.title: Partner / Chair of the Food and Drug Practice / Co-chair of the Life Sciences industry team

speakers.name: Leslie Isenegger
speakers.title: Practice Leader, Corporate Pricing & Public Affairs

speakers.title: VP, Regulatory Consulting: AI & Digital Policy, Real-World Research

events.title: Mentor Session: Nathan Weyer (DNA INC.)
events.description: Meeting with this mentor is highly recommended if you're interested in Business Development, Future of Work, Storytelling, Marketing/Advertising/PR.

events.title: Music’s Middle Class: The Reality, The Revolution
events.description: The music industry is often categorized by sensationalized classes of either rich superstars or "starving artists" – and we often miss an opportunity to talk about its middle class who have learned to create a living from the craft they love. So what does the redefining of success in music looks like? We'll take you inside real case studies for you to learn how to build a sustainable, balanced career without selling out or burning out. Whether you're an artist, producer, or songwriter, the "middle class" can be achieved by staying focused on something that's real rather than in the rearview.

events.title: The New Era of Alzheimer’s Disease: Can We Diagnose Earlier?
events.description: Imagine a world where Alzheimer's disease can be detected before memory fades. Would you want to know if you were at risk? For most Americans surveyed, the answer is yes: nearly 4 in 5 say they would want to know before it impacts their lives. This session explores emerging tools to diagnose Alzheimer's disease at the earliest stages, the challenges ahead, and what early awareness means for people, caregivers, and healthcare systems preparing for new approaches to proactive brain health.

speakers.name: Dr. Richard S. Isaacson
speakers.title: Preventive Neurologist, Institute For Neurodegenerative Diseases

events.title: The Pickleball Payoff: Betting on America’s Top Sport
events.description: Major League Pickleball and the PPA Tour are transforming pickleball into America’s next major pro sport. With 311% growth and investors like LeBron James and Tom Brady, the game is booming. This session features voices from across the sport, including the world’s #1 player, and MLP’s commissioner, to explore league building, athlete branding, sponsorship, and media. Attendees will get a full-picture snapshot of pro pickleball’s rapid evolution.

events.title: Ready for your Brand Close-Up?
events.description: Visit YouTube at the Brand & Marketing track to capture your own custom video to post on YouTube Shorts. Our team will guide you through the process and help you capture a unique brand snapshot of your time at SXSW. Open to all attendees during conference hours.

events.title: SÃO PAULO HOUSE 2026 - WE ARE BORDERLESS
events.description:
Welcome to São Paulo House, a borderless hub where the world meets São Paulo, now.

Across four days at SXSW, the house brings together global content, meaningful encounters, live music and immersive experiences in one vibrant space on Congress Avenue. By day, ideas and exchanges shape conversations. By night, shows and performances transform the house into a cultural hotspot.

Explore creativity, innovation, and culture, shaping what’s next from the energy of now.

Please find more information here: https://saopaulohouse.com/

events.title: SECOND NATURE: How Outdoor Collectives Are Reclaiming Nature
events.description: Who gets to feel at home in nature? This panel explores findings from The Mix Global’s cross-Atlantic research on underrepresented outdoor collectives in the UK and US. Featuring pioneers like Wanderlust Women, Black Outside, Inc., and Camping to Connect, we uncover how Black, Brown, and Latinx-led initiatives are transforming outdoor spaces into hubs of healing, joy, and belonging. Expect data-driven insights, lived experiences, and bold questions that challenge brands and organizations to rethink who they design for, who they speak to, and who they show up for in outdoor culture.

events.title: Sensory Storytelling - Using XR to Connect to the Body
events.description:
Touch, breath, viscera, pulsing sound - XR can be much more than a trick of the eye. Meet 4 artists developing revolutionary work supported by the UK’s Immersive Arts.

Hear about their groundbreaking work that connects our bodies and senses; a multiplayer VR work redefining menopause (The Baby Factory is Closed); a multisensory dancefloor foregrounding access (Beat Blocks); explore breath as a symbiotic force fusing VR, networked performance, and biosensitive technologies (Breathscapes); and a hands on interactive sci-fi work exploring queer & post-human ecologies (Hermaphrogenesis).

events.title: Superhuman Suite at Antone’s: The Future Is All You
events.description:
Superhuman makes its SXSW debut with a three-day takeover of Antone’s. Check out the immersive Epochs of Communication, along with panels, keynotes, comedy, and live music!

11:30am - 12:30pm: The Future of Work Is Still Human
1:00pm - 2:00pm: Unprompted Advice: How to Sharpen the Skills that AI Can’t Touch
2:30pm - 3:15pm: Before You Hit Send: What Work Actually Feels Like in an AI Era
4:00pm - 5:00pm: It Writes Itself: A Live AI Comedy Variety Hour
8:30pm - 10:30pm: Top Dawg Entertainment Music Showcase: Ray Vaughn, Kal Banx, Yakiyn, Kembe X & Devin Malik

events.title: SXSW Bookstore
events.description: Check out the SXSW Bookstore to browse the latest work authored by this year’s conference participants. Support your favorite speakers and find something you connect with to take back home. Open daily on the 6th floor of the Hilton Austin Downtown.

events.title: Vibrant Wellness Exhibit Booth
events.description:
Personalized health and longevity are no longer niche topics—they’re becoming cultural priorities that will define the future of medicine, wellness, and human potential. Our exhibit space brings together integrative medicine, nutrition, longevity, and lifestyle optimization to explore how cutting-edge science and holistic approaches are reshaping the way we think about aging and long-term vitality. From cellular function to optimizing hormones, nutrition, brain performance, and exercise routines, our clinical experts will share what’s next in the rapidly evolving field of longevity—and how diagnostics can help inform longevity roadmaps.

https://vibrant-wellness.com/

events.title: When AI does the work, what do humans do next?
events.description: AI is becoming core infrastructure across every industry, but the biggest challenge is preparing people to use it with confidence, judgement, and trust. In this fireside chat, Justina Nixon‑Saintil, IBM VP and Chief Impact Officer, shares why AI readiness is key to performance and resilience. Drawing on IBM’s approach to responsible, human-led AI and its global work in education and workforce development, she’ll discuss what it takes to build a workforce that uses AI effectively and ethically.

speakers.name: Justina Nixon-Saintil
speakers.title: Vice President & Global Chief Impact Officer

events.title: Who Predicts Better and Why? Humans, AI, and the Anatomy of a Forecast
events.description: AI models process vast signals; humans bring judgment and context. But who calls real-world outcomes better, and when? This session compares human and model forecasts on headline events, drawing on newsroom practice, product experience, and reasoning-centric AI research. We’ll map where models’ pattern breadth wins, where human context does, and why hybrids often work best. Instead of scoreboards alone, we’ll discuss how journalists and analysts should use uncertainty ranges, disclose methods and sources, and avoid feedback loops that can steer the story itself.

events.title: Why Work Sucks (And How We Can Make It Joyful Again).
events.description: Feeling burned out, underpaid, or like your work doesn’t matter? You’re not alone. Most companies mean well, but outdated systems give too much power to bad actors, leading to misaligned incentives and broken cultures. This session introduces the Work Evolution Framework, a six-part roadmap that helps you identify where things have gone off track and how to fix them. Walk away with a clear diagnostic tool and practical steps to build a work culture where everyone can be successful and happy.

events.title: Work AI House
events.description: Step into Glean’s Work AI House at SXSW, where the future of work comes to life. Experience live demos that turn scattered information into instant answers, hands-on labs with AI teammates, and conversations with leaders reimagining productivity. From curated sessions and intimate roundtables to relaxed networking on the patio, every moment is built for real-world takeaways. Leave inspired, with practical ways to bring Work AI to your team on Monday and measure impact in weeks.https://events.glean.com/glean-at-sxsw2026

events.title: You Are the Visionary: How to Stay Authentic While Using AI
events.description: If an artwork is to be ours, it must be a product of our own vision. AI assistants are readily available. But how do we make sure we never give away so much to a virtual assistant that nothing we create feels like it is authentically ours anymore? How can we keep the joy, the purpose, and the power of our making while engaging AI to support the project of our work coming into being? This workshop will offer a series of core principles, plus meditation and journaling practices, designed to help participants intuit which parts of their project to do themselves and which to outsource.

events.title: @BooksyBiz at SXSW 2026
events.description: Join Booksy, the fastest-growing booking platform for beauty services, in our pop-up salon and spa at the Congress Ave Block Party.Get free hair, nail, barber and massage services and consultations from our superstar Ambassadors and Top Texas Providers.

events.title: Capturing Bigfoot
events.description:
On October 20, 1967, Roger Patterson captured 59 seconds of film showing a creature walking through the Northern California woods—footage that became the most analyzed and debated in history. Fifty-seven years later, a reel of 16mm film discovered in a safe changes everything.

"Capturing Bigfoot" reveals the untold story behind the world's greatest mystery, told for the first time by Patterson's own son and the people who were there.

This is a story about family legacy, broken friendships, and belief itself.

events.title: Congress Avenue Block Party
events.description: The Congress Avenue Block Party (formerly known as the Registrant Lounge) is the go-to space for all SXSW attendees to maximize their SX experience, offering daily complimentary drinks, food, and sponsor swag. Open throughout the conferences & festivals, this convenient and relaxing meeting point near the hub of SXSW action is an ideal spot to unwind and connect with other attendees. New for 2026, the Block Party is free and open to the public!

events.title: Crep Protect Clean & Chill
events.description: Get your sneakers cleaned and be in with the chance of winning some exclusive prizes with Crep Protect, the worlds leading sneaker care brand.

events.title: Free JonnyPops Samples - A Better Pop for a Better World!
events.description: Stop by the JonnyPops tent to enjoy the simple ingredients, delicious taste and kindness in every pop! Free pops and swag will be distributed each day. https://www.jonnypops.com/

events.title: Layers of Place: Austin
events.description: Through a co-creative process with the community, Austin transforms into a platform for multidimensional, pluralistic inquiry, delving into themes such as racial justice, historical memory, memorialization, environmental stewardship, and the impact of technology on civic life. The importance of plurality is central, presenting six perspectives on different concepts and viewpoints. In a world that is increasingly polarized and lacking in nuanced perspectives, Layers of Place emphasizes the collective experience. By expanding “public space” to include both the tangible environment and the virtual layers accessible through AR, we create a new form of communal experience.

speakers.name: MIT Open Documentary Lab’s AR and Public Space Artist Collective

events.title: Los Lobos Native Sons
events.description: "Los Lobos Native Sons" is the definitive, authorized chronicle of one of America’s most enduring, genre-defying bands. Tracing Los Lobos’ rise from East L.A. streets to global acclaim, the film offers unprecedented access to their archives and an intimate look at the brotherhood driving their journey. Through electrifying performances and candid interviews—with Linda Ronstadt, Rubén Blades, Tom Waits, Dolores Huerta, Danny Elfman, Jackson Browne, Cheech Marin, Edward James Olmos, Peter Frampton, George Lopez, Bonnie Raitt, and more, the film celebrates their legacy as cultural trailblazers blending rock, roots, and Mexican traditions into a sound uniquely their own.
events.venue: Rollins Theatre at the Long Center

events.title: Moving Memory
events.description:
Move between memories. Moving Memory uses AR to enhance how New Public Art’s interactive artwork Kempelen’s Owls makes a place to bridge the relationships between nature and technology, geometric and organic, clandestine and open, seen and hidden.
When you enter the space between Kemplen’s Owls and begin the AR experience, you hear music and see playful, colorful animated figures performing motion-captured choreography, and tiny sparkling streams of symbols: dodecahedrons, leaves, owls, and gears. Mirror or respond to the choreography of the avatars in poses or dance, and take photos with them in the app. If you discover the secret, you may feel seen indeed. What do you intend to remember?

events.title: My/Mochi Joyfully Chill Ice Cream Shoppe
events.description: My/Mochi, the original and world's largest mochi ice cream brand, is inviting SXSW-goers to Taste the Joy! Our delightfully delicious ice cream wrapped in pillowy sweet rice dough comes in more than 20 flavors like Cookie Dough, Strawberry and Mango. So stop by our Joyfully Chill Ice Cream Shoppe at the Congress Ave Block Party Mar 12-18 to experience the joy for yourself!

events.title: New Mexico House
events.description: The New Mexico House is taking over The Courtyard ATX for a full-day immersive activation showcasing the intersection of our deep cultural roots, unique film and tech ecosystem.

events.title: The Painterland Sisters' Yogurt Farm Stand
events.description: Step into the Painterland Sisters' Yogurt Farm Stand to sample our organic skyr yogurt and for hands-on farm education. Learn what organic regenerative farming really means, explore sensory elements from the farm, and taste some simply yummy skyr yogurt packed with probiotics and protein. Straight from the pasture to your spoon - made with love!

events.title: Pretty Lethal
events.description: An action-packed thriller where five ballerinas, stranded in a remote forest, take shelter at an unsettling roadside inn. They must weaponize years of brutal training, turning grace, discipline, and even pointe shoes into tools for survival.

events.title: SXSW Expo: XR Experience
events.description:
Virtual reality, augmented reality, and mixed reality technologies are finding new ways to enhance our ability to perceive the world that surrounds us and redefining how we experience it. The projects presented in our XR Experience emphasize storytelling and art in the immersive world. Come immerse yourself in the most creative minds of the world at the SXSW XR Experience.

See the floor plan here: https://sxsw2026-xr.expofp.com/

events.title: The Verdadero 360 Tequila Experience
events.description:
The Verdadero 360 Tequila Experience is a 21+ tasting and education experience designed to let guests experience the Spirit For More. Guests sample different expressions while learning about agave, craftsmanship, and what sets Verdadero apart. The experience encourages curiosity, conversation, and connection. A 360 photo booth allows guests to capture and share the moment.

Check us out on Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/verdaderotequila/

events.title: XR Experience Competition
events.description: World premieres of mind bending immersive art.

events.title: XR Experience Special Events
events.description: Celebrating exciting, out-of-the-box ways artists are using technology to bring their art to life.

events.title: XR Experience Spotlight
events.description: Masterful immersive art from around the world.

events.title: Agridulce (Bittersweet)
events.description:
In the Dominican town of Cabarete, bachata is a way of life far from the dance halls that it occupies overseas. A snapshot of four children, each confronting an existential challenge, Agridulce shows how music guides their journey of self discovery. With five years of filming, director Frank Pavich (Jodorowsky’s Dune) captures pivotal moments of the children’s coming of age.

Generations collide, and the children struggle for balance in a world troubled by conflict. Along the way, they’re mentored by teachers of a school devoted to bachata, the once denigrated music that has become the Dominican Republic’s primary cultural export.

events.title: Stormbound
events.description: Step inside the eye of the storm. "Stormbound" thrusts audiences into the heart of the world’s most powerful hurricanes with breathtaking, never-before-seen footage captured from within. As wind, water, and land collide, the film follows storm chaser Jeff Gammons, who for more than thirty years has pushed closer than anyone else to document every major hurricane to strike the United States. Now tested by a near fatal disease , Gammons continues his pursuit—revealing the personal cost of chasing nature at its most extreme and the larger environmental forces shaping our world. "Stormbound" is a high-stakes, immersive experience that places audiences face-to-face with nature at its most powerful.

events.title: A.I. News That’s Fit to Print
events.description: In adopting artificial intelligence, news organizations are making starkly different choices about when and how to use the technology. Which is great, because we can compare and contrast each approach, to identify some early best practices. Zach Seward, who leads the A.I. Initiatives team at The New York Times, will present those findings across a wide range of compelling — and sometimes really terrible — uses of A.I. for journalism. He will also offer a look at how The Times is using A.I. to bolster the human expertise of its newsroom, while discovering new forms of reporting.

events.title: Animation Professionals Meet Up
events.description: The Animation Professionals Meet Up is a chance to mix with animation industry folks and make some sweet connections. This event is hosted by SXSW veterans Craig Staggs and Steph Swope of Minnow Mountain, animators behind Tower (PBS), Undone (Amazon), and Apollo 10 1/2 (Netflix). Animation pros at any level are invited to join us for the third year of this epic exchange of business cards and social media profiles. Leave your mark on our huge live-drawing canvas featuring the amazing cutting-edge technology of a Sharpie. These are your people!

events.title: The Ascent
events.description: "The Ascent" is the inspiring true story of Colorado Springs bilateral-amputee climber Mandy Horvath’s record-breaking attempt to crawl to the summit of Mt. Kilimanjaro on her hands. At 21, Mandy lost both of her legs under mysterious circumstances—an event that shattered her trust in the world around her. As she pushes her body to its limits on Africa’s tallest mountain, Mandy must reckon with the unanswered questions of her past and learn to trust again if she is to succeed.

events.description: Meeting with this mentor is highly recommended if you're interested in Music Coordination.

events.title: Below the Line Mentor Session: Sandra Adair (Detour Filmproductions)
events.description: Meeting with this mentor is highly recommended if you're interested in Film Editing.

events.title: Bending Reality: Scaling Film Productions with AI Workflows
events.description: Go behind the scenes of groundbreaking short films, The Bends and Pathways, developed under the Entertainment Technology Center, to explore how AI is reshaping the future of filmmaking. The Bends and Pathways both pushed the boundaries of traditional workflows using AI-integrated pipelines. In this panel, filmmakers and tech leads reveal how they reimagined VFX and production processes to deliver ambitious visuals without ballooning resources. This session offers an inside look at what’s possible when artificial intelligence becomes a central creative force in production.

events.title: The Brain Science of Getting and Keeping Attention
events.description: Attention is everything. It’s the gateway to memory, persuasion, and customer action. But in a hyper-saturated world, even the best content gets ignored. Cognitive neuroscientist Dr. Carmen Simon shares surprising findings from her studies of buyers’ brains, revealing what actually captures and sustains attention. This session busts myths ( attention spans aren’t shrinking!) and reveals four types of attention you must master to create effective campaigns. If you're building a brand, selling an idea, or designing a message, don’t just hope your audience is paying attention, design for it.

events.title: Brainwave Breakthroughs: The Next Healthcare Frontier
events.description: Tech is rewriting medicine’s playbook. Dive into AI engines, brain-computer interfaces, and VR therapies transforming healthcare. Learn which disorders they tackle and the trends poised to disrupt diagnostics, workflows, and recovery. These tools feed on rich cognitive data to personalize treatment in real time. Explore innovative applications that convert living rooms into mini clinics. Discoveries in brain science ripple beyond neurology, inspiring smarter solutions across healthcare.

events.title: Conflict Contagion: The New AMR Threat
events.description: The CDC calls antimicrobial resistance(AMR)-when bacteria, viruses, fungi, and more stop responding to medicine-the next global epidemic, estimating 10M deaths/yr from AMR by 2050. Infectious disease expert Dr. Antoine Abou Fayad's new findings show that global conflict is greatly increasing the spread. Heavy metals left in soil by munitions are causing bacteria to become resistant in additional ways, and this version of AMR spreads easily via animals, humans, & even inorganic products. So, you may be far from Gaza or the Ukraine, but those conflicts are still very dangerous to your health.

speakers.name: Dr. Antoine Abou-Fayad, PhD
speakers.title: Associate Professor of Experimental Pathology, Immunology and Microbiology

events.title: Creative Destruction Unleashed by Artificial Intelligence
events.description: Artificial intelligence is a highly disruptive technology that will challenge existing institutions in all industries and domains globally. Traditional approaches to creating value will become less and less effective as this technology spreads. On the other side, this technology opens up new potential to create exponentially expanding value but, to harness this potential, we need to become very creative in imagining and implementing new approaches to managing organizations.

speakers.name: John Hagel
speakers.title: Founder & CEO
speakers.company: Beyond Our Edge & Center For Growth

events.title: "Does Music Need So Much Copyright Law?"
events.description: When Jack Dorsey tweeted “Delete all IP law” and Elon Musk agreed, the music biz thought it was just provocative nonsense. But next thing you know, Trump fired the Register of Copyrights after she said AI companies need to pay up for music they're ingesting. Then music companies pivoted from suing AI platforms to making big deals with them. So what gives? Is copyright law too restrictive or even unnecessary? Mozart didn't need it to make music. Sure, but Mozart died penniless.  A wise and experienced panel will explore both sides of this heated and fascinating issue, and keep it high level.

events.title: Fashion Networking Meet Up
events.description: This interactive meet up is designed for fashion students, professionals, and creatives to connect through guided speed networking. Attendees will rotate through small groups for real conversations about careers, creativity, and community. Whether you're just starting out or have years of experience, this is your chance to build authentic relationships and meet others who care about where fashion is headed.

events.title: Featured Session: How to Design a Company That AI Can’t Outpace
events.description:
Yes. We’re failing at AI. But it’s not because the tools aren’t good enough. We’re failing because we’re designing for a system that’s already obsolete. The winners of the AI era won’t be the fastest tool adopters, but the ones who redesign how work is organized, value is created, and ecosystems are navigated.

In this session,, Ian shows you how to think and build like an AI-native and re-architect organizations, sharing a practical map and mindset shift to thrive in a future where what’s valued changes in real time.

events.title: Featured Session: The Future of News
events.description: A thriving news industry is essential—not only to democracy, but also as a powerful platform for marketers and advertisers. Yet concerns about brand safety have caused many to retreat from news content, often based on outdated fears and misinformation. In an era of rapid technological disruption—including the rise of AI and increasing cultural polarization— this panel unites marketers and media experts to challenge assumptions and champion news. We'll explore how advertisers can re-engage with journalism in ways that uphold brand values, build consumer trust, and deliver real business results.

speakers.name: Rebecca Grossman-Cohen
speakers.title: Chief of Staff to the CEO and SVP, Strategic Partnerships

events.title: The Future of Work Is Still Human
events.description: As AI reshapes how we work, fundamental questions about voice and individual expression are emerging. Rahul Vohra, Founder of Superhuman Mail, explores why the most powerful tools don’t replace human judgment or flatten individual expression, but expand what people are capable of doing. Grounded in his experience building Superhuman Mail, Rahul discusses how founders and builders can design technology that amplifies human capability while ensuring the work still sounds, feels, and belongs to the user.

events.title: The Guardian’s Football Weekly Live
events.description:
Join the Guardian’s Football Weekly hosts Max Rushden and Barry Glendenning, alongside Senior editor, soccer Alexander Abnos, and special guest Brendan Hunt, co-creator and “Coach Beard” of Apple TV’s Ted Lasso for a live podcast recording. Football Weekly, the #1 soccer podcast, offers a uniquely balanced format - insightful enough for devoted followers, yet accessible and entertaining for casual listeners.

Expect the show’s signature take on this year’s World Cup, the biggest global soccer tournament ever. Plus the biggest stories in soccer all brought to life on stage with lively debate, funny stories, and audience interaction.

events.title: Health & MedTech Professionals Meet Up
events.description: The future of health doesn’t come from one sector—it emerges when pharma, devices, clinicians, researchers, hospitals, and startups collide with bold ideas. This Meet Up brings together the full health innovation community to trade insights, surface real opportunities, and explore the technologies reshaping care. Hosted by a longtime SXSW Health & MedTech advisor, this is the room where emerging breakthroughs, future collaborators, and big conversations find each other.

events.title: How Secret Mall Apartment Crushed It
events.description: Secret Mall Apartment premiered at SXSW in 2024.  Though a festival smash the documentary did not get acquired by a distributor. Undeterred, filmmaker Jeremy Workman raised $100k independently to self-release the film in theaters. The documentary went on to gross nearly 1MM in box office, playing in nearly 250 cities for nearly 6 months, and was subsequently acquired by Netflix where it entered the Netflix Top 10 on its first day. Workman and his team utilized both traditional and innovative approaches to upend the playing field. Look behind the curtain and learn how they pulled it off!

events.title: How the Pop-Tarts Bowl Became the Biggest Name in CFB
events.description: In the highly competitive and tradition-rich landscape of college athletics, few brand partnerships have achieved the level of cultural impact and consumer engagement as the Pop-Tarts Bowl. What began as a straightforward sponsorship evolved into a standout case study in modern sports marketing, illustrating how creativity, cultural relevance, and bold brand identity can redefine the value of a naming rights agreement.

events.title: Human+AI Alliance: Talent Leaders & AI Developers Collab
events.description: Breaking down the critical divide in AI implementation: the gap between those who design AI experiences, build AI systems, and develop humans to work with them. AI designers create experiences, developers build systems, talent leaders develop humans, UI/UX designers shape interactions—but they rarely collaborate. Result? AI implementations fail because they ignore human experience design and adaptation needs. We'll break down silos between these groups, creating the cross-functional alliance every organization needs but few achieve.

events.title: It’s Fun Proving People Wrong. Turn Adversity into Success.
events.description: If you’ve ever been underestimated or overlooked you’ll know that success is the best revenge. Madison Tevlin (a trailblazer with Down syndrome who was told at birth by doctors she wouldn’t amount to much) and Ashley Callingbull (who is a First Nations Activist and the first Indigenous Sports Illustrated Model) will share stories of how they used haters, doubt, and being underestimated as even stronger fuel for chasing their dreams and creating change. This session is for anyone who believes in breaking barriers, redefining limits, and proving the seemingly impossible is in fact possible.

speakers.name: Ashley Callingbull
speakers.title: First Indigenous Woman Crowned Miss Universe Canada | Actress | Model | Host | First Nations Activist

speakers.name: Madison Tevlin
speakers.title: Actor, Content Creator, Public Speaker, Model, Host, Advocate

events.title: Liquid Brands & Vanishing Interfaces: New Rules of Experience
events.description: The website is dying. The mouse is next. In this bold fireside chat, Alex Hamilton and Suff Syed challenge everything we know about digital experience. From liquid brands that move across surfaces to voice interfaces that erase traditional UX, they’ll unpack what happens after design as we know it. What does it mean when a brand meets you, in your car, your watch, your fridge, your earbuds? What does design look like when it’s generated, optimised, and personalised in real time? Expect a thrilling look at the collapse of static web thinking.

speakers.name: Suff Syed
speakers.title: Head of Design – Product & AI Leader

events.title: Narrative Intelligence: The New Leadership Infrastructure
events.description: In a world of constant volatility, leadership isn’t just strategy—it’s meaning-making. This Core Conversation explores Narrative Intelligence as a practical skill grounded in psychology and neuroscience, helping founders and executive leaders create clarity, trust, and direction under pressure. Narrative is often mistaken for “good communication,” but it functions more like infrastructure—the framework people use to interpret events, assign meaning to risk, and decide what to do next.Together, we’ll anchor the discussion around pivotal turning points—the catalyst moments when something shifts internally and a new path becomes possible. Through guided conversation, participants will practice turning real scenes from their lives into clear lessons, actionable resilience tools, and stronger leadership presence. Attendees will leave with a sharper personal narrative, a more compelling way to translate complexity for teams and stakeholders, and a repeatable approach to leading with emotional depth—turning story into direction, and direction into results.

events.title: Neuroaesthetics in the Future of Design
events.description: Neuroaesthetics is the science of how art, design, culture, and technology shape the brain and body, impacting emotion, connection, and behavior. Bringing together leaders in neuroscience, art, and technology this panel unpacks the rising field of neuroaesthetics as a new essential for the future of design. Through research, experiential and digital design work from leaders in the field, we’ll explore how this interdisciplinary field is redefining how we create, collaborate, and care, offering new tools to design for health, meaning, and human experience in an increasingly complex world.

speakers.name: Susan Magsamen
speakers.title: Founder and Executive Director
speakers.company: International Arts + Mind Lab (Iam Lab), Center For Applied Neuroaesthetics

events.title: Over Your Dead Body
events.description: A dysfunctional couple head to a remote cabin to supposedly reconnect, but each has secret plans to kill the other.

events.title: PanelPicker Evaluators Meet Up #2
events.description: OPEN TO SXSW PANELPICKER EVALUATORS ONLY! Come meet your fellow SXSW PanelPicker Evaluators! This is your opportunity to network and chat with other professionals in our SXSW community who shape our Conference each year.

events.title: Pitches to Pipelines: Accelerating Circular Water Economy
events.description: The circular water economy is reshaping how we manage water, energy, and resources. This session highlights how innovation, financing, and collaboration drive the shift from linear to circular systems while building the next generation of water leaders. It will also spotlight WEF’s Circular Water Economy 101 course as a model for advancing education and innovation.

events.title: r/Health Answers Everywhere: Who to Trust in the Age of AI?
events.description: AI, social platforms, and online communities have transformed how patients and doctors seek health information long before they meet at the point of care. But with endless answers comes a critical question: who should we trust? Join Reddit’s pharma lead, a patient advocate and former r/BreastCancer moderator, and Dr. Ania Bilski—an emergency medicine physician and VP of Clinical AI at OpenEvidence—for a candid discussion on trust, safety, and the future of care in an algorithm-driven world.

speakers.name: Ania Bilski
speakers.title: Emergency Medicine Physician and VP, Clinical AI

events.title: Reading the Room: Keys to Career Growth in the Music Business
events.description: If you’ve ever hit “send” and immediately regretted it, you’re not alone. Communication isn’t just what we say—it’s how, when, and why we say it. That said, the music business often feels like guessing the vibe in a room you’ve never walked into. From making meaningful connections to recognizing when you’re overthinking, this panel will help you unpack how to implement the intangibles (personality, first impressions, etiquette, etc.) with purpose and clarity in the music industry. We’ll also explore the fine line between being overbearing and simply asking for help. No matter where you're at, this is about learning to show up with confidence and authenticity every time.

speakers.name: Nick Ayoub
speakers.title: Head of Digital Strategy and Operations

speakers.name: Anthony Langone
speakers.title: Head of Music and Brand Communications

events.title: Round Table: XR Filmmaking: Charlotte Mikkelborg and Rory Mitchell
events.description: An extension of our popular Mentor Sessions, our Round Table Sessions not only allow attendees to learn from the industry experts that sit at each of the three tables in this session but they also allow attendees to learn from the questions and experiences of their peers as well. This Round Table Session will bring together industry experts and SXSW attendees for an enlightening discussion on XR Filmmaking.

events.title: Seeing is Believing: XR for Communicating Climate Resilience
events.description: Climate risks are often invisible in daily life: too abstract for action, too complex for traditional media. This session showcases how XR, digital twins, and immersive storytelling can transform risk perception from data to visceral shared experience. Panelists will share examples from wildfire-prone communities and coastal resilience projects, unpacking immersive media's unique power to overcome misinformation, bridge silos, and build trust.

events.title: SXSW Episodic Pitch-A-Thon presented by SeriesFest
events.description: Back for its seventh year, the SXSW Episodic Pitch-A-Thon presented by SeriesFest gives filmmakers a chance to take their series ideas to the next level—while audiences get a front-row look at the art of the pitch! Independent filmmakers selected for SXSW Film + Television 2026 will present their projects directly to top executives from television, news media, and digital platforms—on stage, in front of a live audience, and a panel of industry experts.

events.title: The Systems We Build: Business Models for Meaningful XR
events.description: XR is booming… Or is it? How secure are business models in the interactive/immersive sector and how well do they support creators to have social impact? And how do you thrive - not just survive - as a creator, producer, developer of this type of work, right now? Acknowledging challenges and uncertainty but also highlighting opportunities, the panel reflect on their own journeys - including successes, challenges and startings-over - to explore alternative models and offer practical advice for creators and producers to make work that matters: including protecting your IP and your wellbeing.

speakers.name: Danielle Giroux
speakers.title: Interdisciplinary Researcher: XR, Storytelling & Community Practice
speakers.company: Independent (in partnership with Unframed Collection and INREV)

events.title: Viva La Revolution: How the Digital Age is Transforming Wellness
events.description: Digital technologies have become indispensable in healthcare and wellness, touching every aspect of how we stay healthy and receive care today. As a community of innovators, we’ve already proven the viability of technologies such as wearables, telehealth, artificial intelligence, and mHealth. Join us in imagining how these technologies will look in the future and how they will synergize with one another in the digital health ecosystem of tomorrow. In this talk, we will discuss the latest advancements and policies that can accelerate the digital age of healthcare. We will delve more into specific technologies, exploring the promise they hold and the pitfalls we must watch out far as we use them to build the healthcare tools of tomorrow. Together we’ll learn how we build a digital future in which we live healthier and more fulfilling lives!

speakers.name: Pavitra P. Krishnamani, MD, MS
speakers.title: Emergency Medicine Physician
speakers.company: The University of Texas MD Anderson Cancer Center

events.title: We, the People: Confronting A Rapidly Accelerating Autocracy
events.description: In 2021, the United States was designated as a global backslider in the International IDEA report, a designation that remains. Part of that finding was attributed to a lack of effective parliament (Congress), the insurrection on January 6, 2021, and election denialism. In the years since, the concerns have only increased. This session will focus on how we, the people, respond. It will include a discussion of how we can work together to galvanize communities and local, state and federal leaders to reverse this trend, and what’s at stake.

events.title: Why AI Fails Without Better Ways of Working
events.description: AI use is exploding, but for most teams, the payoff isn’t. Why? Because AI can’t fix broken workflows—it only amplifies the chaos. Backed by new research from Atlassian’s Teamwork Lab, this session reveals why the real unlock isn’t more AI, but better ways of working. Learn how high-performing teams rethink workflows, decision-making, and knowledge sharing to turn AI into a real driver of impact. With real-world examples and actionable takeaways, this session is for anyone ready to stop spinning their wheels and finally make AI work—for their teams and their business.

events.title: Why Boring Brands Break the Internet
events.description: When the default expectation is dull, entertaining content is a growth hack. This panel gathers marketers from categories often considered ‘boring’ like sunscreen, hygiene, and language apps, who have proven that irreverence, humour, and showmanship drive disproportionate returns. Learn why the blandest brands can become the boldest entertainers.

events.title: Wishful Thinking
events.description: Julia and Charlie, a volatile couple in Portland, Oregon, are at a loss for how to repair their broken relationship. Julia, an ambitious game designer, and Charlie, a struggling musician working in sound design to pay the bills, are pushed by Julia's friend into attending a couples-therapy seminar run by twin healers, the Tillies, who claim to fix relationships through energy work. The session triggers a karmic universal system that makes the state of their relationship affect the world around them. With earthquakes, the stock market, and entire nations at risk, Charlie and Julia must confront whether their love can survive amidst so much destruction.

events.title: Zero-Gravity, Zero Barriers: Future of Inclusive Spaceflight
events.description: Discover what true Space accessibility means at this groundbreaking SXSW panel. Experts—including the first deaf Asian female pilot and aspiring astronaut, the founder of the Blind Institute of Technology, and a Space leader championing disability inclusion—reveal what it will take to make Space open to all. Explore innovations in pilot training, zero-gravity research, AI-assisted interfaces, and adaptive prosthetics. Learn how inclusive Space design inspires broader accessibility on Earth, reshaping our vision of who belongs in the final frontier.

events.title: Downbeat
events.description:
Down-on-his-luck drummer Mauro flees a trail of bad decisions and lands on his sister Isa’s couch in Boston. With no money and nowhere to go, he begins busking as a bucket drummer. As playing on the streets brings small wins, he falls back in love with the freedom and pounding momentum that made him chase music in the first place. But Mauro pushes his luck pursuing a secret relationship that endangers his bond with Isa, and bit by bit draws everyone else into his own feral shortcomings.
Set to the rhythms of the street, DOWNBEAT is a raw, high-energy portrait of an artist using music as escape and the collateral damage left behind when movement replaces growth.

events.title: Leviticus
events.description: "Leviticus" is the story of Naim and Ryan, two teenage boys living in a conservative Christian community in regional Victoria. When their attraction to each other is identified by the local pastor, the pair are subjected to a disturbing conversion ritual which unknowingly releases a violent entity that terrorizes the town. As Naim and Ryan attempt to survive the bigotry of their fellow town members, they must also defend themselves against the unleashed spiritual being that takes the form of the thing the boys desire most - each other.

events.title: High Score Game Arcade presents the Worldwide Tic-Tac-Toe Championship
events.description:
The Worldwide Tic Tac Toe Championship comes to its final, high-stakes moment at SXSW. After months of play across cities and communities around the world, this activation marks the culmination of a global tournament—bringing finalists, fans, and curious passersby together for live competition, spectacle, and celebration. Simple rules, universal appeal, and unexpected intensity converge in one last showdown where strategy, speed, and bragging rights are decided in real time.

More information here: highscoregamearcade.com

events.title: The Pirate King
events.description: Returning stateside, Todd Gillis struggles to hold down work due to his condition and trauma from his time in Afghanistan . When his ex-wife sues for custody of his beloved daughter, Emmylou, Todd hits rock bottom. In an effort to impress his case appointed judge, Todd joins a pirate re-enactment crew that his daughter is fond of. Through a newfound community Todd begins a journey of healing he never expected.

events.title: Sinner Supper Club
events.description:
Nora is late. Alice unceremoniously brought her partner, whose name no one can remember. Jayae doesn't want to be around "these" people...but came anyway? And Genevieve, the host, has put an unhealthy amount of pressure on this eviction funeral (kinda cringe, right?) to solve all of their problems. 

As they barrel through the evening, this disintegrating friend group, delirious from the heat and lack of food, desperately throws Hail Marys, caution to the wind, and lamb against the wall, trying to harness some semblance of what they used to have.

...and then their dead friend shows up.

events.title: Summer 2000: The X-Cetra Story
events.description: In the summer of 2000, four pre-teen friends formed a band called X-Cetra and burned a homemade album onto a few CD-Rs. The following year, consumed by adolescent concerns of boys and drug store shoplifting, their labor of love was quickly forgotten.... Until 20 years later, when someone uploaded it online. At first, it garnered a small base of outsider-art fans, but soon it was discovered by record labels, sampled by mainstream artists, and eventually the subject of a Rolling Stone article. With their teen dreams of pop stardom coming true decades later, X-Cetra reunites to see if they can rekindle the unselfconscious girlhood they’d captured in the album those many years ago.

events.title: SXSW Film & TV Clubhouse
events.description: The Film & TV Clubhouse is located at 800 Congress Ave, just steps away from the Paramount Theatre, where some of the most exciting screenings of the Festival are set to premiere. It will serve as the home base for the film community to gather, discuss, and network. Each day the Film & TV Clubhouse will host meetups and networking events as well as activations.

events.title: SXSW Innovation Clubhouse
events.description: The historic Brazos Hall is the official Innovation Clubhouse for 2026. It's the perfect place to connect with attendees looking to gain insights and inspiration from like-minded conference-goers. Each day the Innovation Clubhouse will host meetups and networking events as well as activations.

events.title: SXSW Music Clubhouse
events.description: The Music Clubhouse is located at The Downright Austin. Perfect for networking and industry connections, the Clubhouse will also feature live performances at Radio Day Stage and mentor sessions. It’s also the perfect spot to access most of our music venues by foot or a quick rideshare. Each day the Music Clubhouse will host meetups and networking events as well as activations.

events.title: Vibrating Music Hammocks
events.description:
The Music Hammock transforms its fabric into a speaker, resonating your body with the frequencies of the music so you feel as if you’re lying inside a sound system. In our fast-paced society, we often disconnect from our bodies. This installation offers a full-body listening experience, shifting your attention from mental chatter into physical awareness. Experience sound not only through your ears, but through your entire body.

events.title: Keynote: Nature Speaks. Can AI Help Us Listen?
events.description: More than 8 million species share our planet. Until now, we’ve only understood the language of one. In this keynote, Aza Raskin, Co-founder of Earth Species Project, explores how AI is being used to decode the languages of other species—revealing complex, learned communication across the animal kingdom. For the first time in history, we can truly listen. The question isn’t if we’ll break the interspecies barrier. It’s whether we’ll do it in time to change everything.

events.title: XOT Energy House
events.description: XOT Energy House lands at the SXSW Artist Lounge as a dynamic space built to fuel creativity. This experience invites artists and attendees to recharge with XOT Energy while connecting through music, culture, and movement. Blending vibrant fruits and high-energy moments, the XOT Energy House becomes a hub for discovery, expression, and inspiration throughout SXSW.
events.venue: Downright Hotel - Creekside Room & Outdoor Patio

events.title: The Family Battenberg
events.description:
‘The Family Battenberg have perfected a filthy, fuzzy psychedelic sound that they’ve coined as “spider rock.” (The Face)
The Family Battenberg's 'Anteater' single, released in April 2025, is an independent release by the Cardiff based four-piece. The track was written in just a day, and it was recorded at Tom Rees’ (Buzzard Buzzard Buzzard) studio while he was on holiday. To master the recording the group sought out long-time collaborator Eddie Al-Shakarchi (Boy Azooga, Loathe, Swim Deep.)

Aligning with the soundscape that’s signature to them, ‘Anteater’ is The Family Battenberg finessed. Drenched in fuzzy saturation, spacey vocals ricochet between a blistering guitar, all while a double-tracked mono drum plays like a call to action.  This is an anti-love song. When unhealthy adoration becomes a quest for romance, or approval in this case, we find ourselves doing strange things. In this story, the protagonist justifies total metamorphosis in the name of subservience. “It’s self-humiliation in the pursuit of a potential suitor’s attention,” as frontman Eliot puts it. Anyone that has seen this band live before is sure to recognise it from past setlists. The group had played it as an unreleased track amongst their own shows and a host of major festivals, namely,

Greenman, Trans Musicales 2024, Reeperbahn 2024 and ESNS 2025. As budding upcomers, the group have also supported the likes of Getdown Services, Panic Shack, Gruff Rhys and the Bug Club.

Championed by Steve Lamacq, Amy Lame, Huw Stephens and Adam Walton, the group are already making their mark on the industry.

'Wow I love that, a South Walian answer to Psychedelic Porn Crumpets' John Kennedy, Radio X
events.venue: British Music Embassy @ Palm Door on Sixth Patio

events.title: German Music Export at SXSW: Day 5 at German Haus
events.description:
For the final day at the German Haus we go out with a bang. If you are a music industry professional come early for networking between 02:00 - 03:00PM. The daytime showcase starts at 3:00PM featuring Agatha is Dead!'s raw post-punk intensity, Bikini Beach's fuzz-drenched garage psych and t-low's emotional trap. For the evening we’ve curated bold and uncompromising performances: from KUOKO's dreamy indie synth-pop and Rosa Anschütz's experimental soundscapes to Modeselektor's high-energy bass-heavy beats.

For more information please visit: https://www.german-haus.com

events.title: The Last Critic
events.description: Sixty years & a million records ago, Robert Christgau invented Rock music criticism. Anyone who has ever read or written a Pop music review has been influenced by Christgau, who canonized legends from The Ramones to Public Enemy & infuriated icons from Lou Reed to Billy Joel. Now in his eighties, Bob is still at it—amazingly with the same vigor, wit, concision and craft that has defined his expansive career. But in a world where albums are irrelevant, where print is dead & where algorithms have eclipsed critics we are forced to ask: What happens next—for Bob, but also for all music criticism? Is this the end of something? Is Robert Christgau the last critic?

events.title: Artist Demo Listening Session: Indie/Rock/Alt
events.description: Artist Demo Listening Sessions, Presented by Discovr Radio, at SXSW are an interactive format where attendees have the opportunity to play demos for music experts, sparking real-time feedback and meaningful industry connections. You must be present to have your music in the running to be heard! SXSW attendees not having demos played are encouraged to attend and listen in on the fun! Each session will be followed up a social hour. Physical submissions will not be accepted at the door. Demo’s will be played on a first-come, first-served basis and attendees must submit their demo’s prior to the day of the session by 11:59pm. Please carefully read and fill out the form below to officially submit your demo: https://airtable.com/appYFNh7bkKd8nmwh/pagfBEWaVPizme5jr/form

events.title: Breaking a Band in 2026: The Girl Tones Blueprint
events.description:
What does it actually take to break a new act in 2026, without a legacy playbook?

This session brings together Girl Tones (sister duo Kenzie & Laila), Daniel Oakley, co-founder of the indie label Parallel Vision (with Brad Shultz of Cage The Elephant and Darren Potuck), and Nicole Rich, Director of Streaming at Big Loud Rock, Parallel Vision’s label partner, for a candid, tactical walkthrough of a modern artist-development model.

events.title: Build a Future Ready Catalog for the Modern Music Ecosystem
events.description: Learn how to prepare your music for the modern licensing landscape across sync, creator campaigns, digital platforms, and emerging AI opportunities. This interactive workshop covers asset prep, rights setup, metadata strategy, pricing basics, and the steps artists and labels need to take to make their catalogs discoverable and revenue ready. You will leave with a clear roadmap and tools to support long term licensing success.

events.title: Building Hollywood Buzz Without the Hollywood Style Campaign
events.description: A number of specialty streaming platforms have been able to scale their audiences without needing to invest regularly in big launch stunts, massive advertising campaigns, and other means typical of the Hollywood machine. Hear from marketing heads at streaming services like Rakuten Viki, BritBox, and Hallmark+ about their secrets for leaning into fandom to build loyal audiences.

events.title: Decoding Nature: How AI is Learning to Program Biology
events.description: AI mastered Go, then human language—now it can write DNA. Glen Gowers, CEO of Basecamp Research, explains how his team trained AI on the world’s largest evolutionary dataset, spanning 1 million new species, to design a "beyond-CRISPR" tool for precise gene insertion—a long-standing challenge in genetic medicine. Microsoft’s Alicia Frame unpacks the AI advances enabling this scale, while UT Austin biophysicist Ilya Finkelstein explains the rigor required to turn AI-designed biology into safe, effective medicine.

speakers.name: Ilya Finkelstein
speakers.title: Professor Of Molecular Biosciences

events.title: Designing For Human Connection in Vertical Cities
events.description: What if buildings were designed not just around structure or code, but around human experience? As cities are constantly evolving, architect Eran Chen shares how architecture contributes to the built environment to benefit its community. Two of the guiding principles for his design philosophy, “form follows experience” and “porosity leads to prosperity,” are carried to ODA’s projects worldwide. The session will explore how an experience-centric approach can redefine design globally to create urban environments that challenge the boundaries of conventional structure and improve engagement.

events.title: Digital Health Engagement? Design for Intermittent Use
events.description: Sustained user engagement is critical to the success of digital health interventions, particularly for chronic and long-term conditions that require patients to self-manage care over extended periods. But the prevailing design paradigm - adapted from consumer technology - often assumes continuous use as the marker of engagement. Real-world evidence demonstrates health behaviors are inherently intermittent. This presentation shows why & how “designing for intermittent use” is an essential strategy for improving user engagement and health outcomes.

events.title: Don't Be Cringe: How to Actually Win Gen Z & Alpha
events.description: Winning Gen Z/Gen Alpha means rewriting storytelling—yet most attempts feel like pandering. Hear from Grammy-winning EA exec Steven Schnur, TikTok gaming lead Tina Tran, YouTuber and Fortnite legend Sam “DuckyTheGamer” Hatch, and Emmy-winning Baobab Studio’s Content Chief Kane Lee on what works now. Roblox to TikTok: how trends start, why authenticity beats budget, and how to build worlds audiences actually live in.

speakers.name: Steven Schnur
speakers.title: Worldwide Executive and President of Music

speakers.name: Tina Tran
speakers.title: Global Lead, Gaming Partnerships & Business Development

events.title: EAST × WEST: Cross-Cultural AI Trends in Music Production
events.description: This session will explore the evolving Chinese music industry, focusing on how AI is being used in production, the current industry standards, and how DSP platforms and labels are responding to these innovations. We will highlight real examples of cross-cultural collaborations and demonstrate how technology is reshaping music creation, distribution, and label strategies, offering insights for international artists and partners interested in China’s market.

speakers.name: MKJ
speakers.title: Independent Worldwide Music Producer and DJ

events.title: Featured Session: The Great Flip: Why Every Industry Is Running Backwards
events.description: Technology isn’t just accelerating progress, it's changing the very process of progress itself: product testing can happen virtually before building, clinical trials can be simulated before major lab investment, distribution can dictate where production happens. This session will change how you see every workflow in your business. You'll walk away armed with a practical framework that will help you learn how to identify inversions in your own industry. The future belongs to leaders who think in reverse.

events.title: Featured Session: The Internet of Value Meets the Internet of Intelligence
events.description:
As AI and blockchain mature in parallel, we are witnessing the emergence of two powerful networks: the Internet of Intelligence, where autonomous AI systems reason and act, and the Internet of Value, where tokenized assets and stablecoins move frictionlessly across borders.

This session explores what happens when these two networks converge — when AI agents can hold, send, and earn value — and how this convergence will reshape global commerce, financial systems, and enterprise operations. Drawing from her experience leading AI transformation at Circle, an internet infrastructure company pioneering stablecoins, Li Fan will share both the vision and operational realities of building compliant, intelligent, and scalable financial infrastructure for the AI era.

events.title: Featured Session: Trusted, Valued, Essential: Why PBS is Here to Stay, With or Without Federal Funding
events.description: Last summer, Congress went against the will of the American people by taking back dedicated federal funding for public television that helped PBS and member stations provide a unique and vital service to America. It was a big blow for the entire public television system that simultaneously forced PBS and member stations to make stark decisions and led to communities across the country stepping up to support the programming they know and love. For perhaps the first time, Congressional action showed the country that public television could be taken away — something viewers realized they wanted to protect. In this fireside chat, hear directly from Paula Kerger, the longest-serving president and CEO in PBS history, about how PBS offers what the commercial media can’t, and why that means the service is here to stay.

events.title: Film & TV Audience and Community Building Meet Up
events.description: After 8 years on the road as a pop-up screening outfit, Austin’s Hyperreal Film Club put down roots at their single-screen theater in East Austin. Now a year-and-a-half into the experiment, join the creators of the club to talk lessons learned (so far!), meet other indie filmmakers to talk about creative exhibition opportunities and strategies; and dream up new ways to use film programming and community building to create the film community you've always imagined.

events.title: The Great Recalibration: Centering Humanity in the Age of AI
events.description:
AI is rapidly reshaping how we work, create, and connect—yet at the same time, people are craving the tactile, the real, and the human. As AI-generated content floods our world, a new question emerges: where do we fit?

This panel explores the tension between acceleration and authenticity. How do we design AI that strengthens community instead of replacing it? How do we protect meaning, creativity, and trust in an era of misinformation and automation?

Innovation leaders will examine the cultural shift already underway and share a vision for an AI-powered future where human values and relationships remain at the center.

events.title: The Great Tech Trivia Break
events.description: Join Microsoft for high‑energy trivia. Play from your phone—no sign‑ups, no pressure—just fast rounds, big laughs, and fun prize giveaways. It’s built to spark curiosity and boost your energy in minutes. After the final question, stick around for a quick demo of AI Skills Navigator to see how AI can elevate your learning journey. Come for the trivia, stay for the insight, leave inspired.

events.title: Healthcare Disruption: What Does It Look Like?
events.description: Healthcare is at an inflection point: soaring costs, regulatory uncertainty and public mistrust. All signs point to change, but what form will it take? This discussion brings together leaders from across healthcare, life sciences and technology to explore what meaningful disruption in healthcare looks like, and what it will take to rebuild trust, advance equity and deliver innovation at scale. Drawing from experience in emergency care, communications and technology, we'll imagine what a more connected future of care could look like and how those aspiring to improve it can bring it to life.

events.title: How Anime Became a Worldwide Cultural Force
events.description: Anime isn't niche; it’s the fastest-growing global fandom in entertainment. Among Gen Z, 54% say they “like” or “love” it, placing anime’s cultural relevance alongside major sports and global icons. Its emotional power runs deep: 48% of fans have had a crush on a character, showing anime’s ability to build emotional worlds and deep connections. For Gen Z, it’s identity and community; for Gen X, nostalgia. With leaders from Crunchyroll, Twitch, and anime community voice Lena Lemon joining us, this panel explores anime’s rise and future.

events.title: How to Not Be Cringey On Camera: Media Insider Secrets
events.description: Hate being on camera? You're not alone! But nowadays everyone is expected to be confident and camera-ready—for social media, conferences, and even meetings. Award-winning media expert Kim Rittberg, now a public speaking and video coach, spent 15 years in media at Netflix and PEOPLE Magazine and has trained thousands to not just stay calm but shine under the lights. In this lively session, Kim shares insider secrets to help you win over anyone—on stage or on video. You’ll leave with tangible on-camera and speaking tips, more confidence, and a roadmap to becoming a thought leader.

events.title: Imposters
events.description: After a couple’s baby boy is taken, the desperate mother learns of a way to bring him back. However, her husband begins to suspect that what she returned with isn't their son.

events.title: Intelligence on Tap: Designing the Frontier Firm
events.description: Welcome to the era of intelligence on demand. Microsoft’s Work Trend Index introduces the Frontier Firm: built on abundant AI, where digital agents aren’t tools, they’re teammates. While some fear AI replacing jobs, the real risk is ignoring it. With 80% of employees maxed out and 82% of leaders betting on AI, the question isn’t if you’ll use digital labor, it’s how. Frontier Firms are rethinking org charts, hiring AI trainers, and managing human-agent ratios like headcount. This is your blueprint for building a business where AI scales work and where human judgment stays at the center.

events.title: Intergenerational Workplace Culture Meet Up
events.description: The stereotypes between generations at work are old and tired, and they’re getting in the way of real collaboration. This Meet Up creates space for all generations to talk openly about communication, mentorship, and what working together should look like, while also exploring “friendtorship,” a collaborative, cross-generational relationship built on authenticity, shared learning, and mutual support.

events.title: Leading with Both Sides: The Business-Creative Hyphenate
events.description: More professionals than ever are combining business acumen with creative ambition, choosing careers that embrace both. This conversation explores what it takes to lead in corporate spaces and pursue creative passions with purpose. Hear from leaders who’ve scaled brands, launched movements, and redefined success—without “starting over.” We’ll share practical tactics for integrating creative identity into leadership and professional branding, and explore how corporate-to-creative leaders are reshaping success, innovation, and the future of work.
