events.title: The LEGO Futures Imaginarium: Play Your Way to Tomorrow
events.description: What if your most imaginative future was already inside you, hidden in your most cherished moment of childhood play? The LEGO Imaginarium is a hands-on foresight workshop where participants use LEGO bricks, storytelling, and memory prompts to reconnect with their inner child and build physical models of possible futures. Guided by futures thinking tools, the LEGO system in play, and inspired by the creativity of kids, this session blends strategic foresight with playful, hands-on exploration to unlock fresh perspectives on what’s next in the future.

events.title: Lies My Creative Director Told Me: Myths of the Agency World
events.description: Join some of the most senior creative leaders from four of the most successful digital design agencies in the world as they discuss the current existential moment for creativity and innovation in agencies. They will discuss the current state of creative agencies, including how AI, emerging technologies, and ever-evolving client expectations are fundamentally reshaping the industry, and how they are reshaping their teams and how work gets done. Discover what's irrevocably changing, what remains constant, and perhaps even unearth a few trade secrets along the way.

events.title: Making a Vision Pro Documentary: "D-Day: The Camera Soldier"
events.description:
This session dives into the making of "D-Day: The Camera Soldier", a documentary built from the ground up for Vision Pro.

From technical breakthroughs in video, 3D, and interaction design to the creative vision that brought it to life, hear directly from TIME, TARGO, and the team behind the project—tracing the journey from initial concept to distribution on Vision Pro.

events.title: Noah Kahan: Out of Body
events.description: As a career-defining chapter propels him into global stardom, musician Noah Kahan stands at a crossroads. In the wake of the breakout success of Stick Season—an album born from the quiet of rural Vermont and embraced around the world—Noah begins work on his follow-up album while facing the mounting pressure of what comes next. Over a whirlwind year of sold-out tours and unprecedented acclaim, he returns to his Vermont roots and family. Buoyed by his uncanny wit, he searches for a sense of home and creative inspiration as he confronts the deeply personal struggles that have left him out of sync with himself.

events.title: The Numbers Behind the Hits: How Data is Driving K-pop's Global Domination
events.description: This exclusive industry panel brings together major Korean music labels and data analytics leaders to reveal the strategies behind K-pop's global dominance—and what Western music can learn from it. Hear how Korean labels leverage data to make decisions about tours, content, and promotion across different regions. We'll talk about the distinctive "superfan" cultivation approach that prioritizes deep engagement through multi-platform content funnels over traditional radio-and-playlist reach, and examine their export-first philosophy: building global audiences from day one with multilingual content and culturally-adaptive campaigns rather than establishing domestic success first.

events.title: The People's LAB: AI, Storytelling & the Future from Queens
events.description: What if the next great tech lab wasn’t in Silicon Valley—but in Queens? This panel explores how cultural institutions like the Museum of the Moving Image (MoMI) — the first museum in the U.S. dedicated to the moving image—can lead public innovation. MoMI LAB, a bold new initiative, puts artists and storytellers at the center of exploring how AI, XR, and emerging tools can shape more ethical, imaginative civic futures. In one of the world’s most diverse communities, artists, technologists, and funders are working to shape technology around public values—not private gain.

events.title: Plot Twist: Romance Authors Redefining Creator Success
events.description: Romance as a genre transformed book publishing, but in an industry known for gatekeeping, this growth happened via indie authors & entrepreneurs in the creator economy. By building direct relationships with readers on platforms like Kindle, Patreon, BookTok, and internal email newsletters, these creators have scaled faster, marketed smarter, and reshaped book discoverability. This panel explores how creators and marketers across industries can apply these strategies to grow fanbases, monetize directly, and turn niche communities into powerful engines of cultural influence and business success.

events.title: Powerful AI, Terrible UX:  Designing a Smarter UX
events.description: Enterprise AI is getting more powerful, but for many users it still feels slow, awkward, and hard to trust. The problem is rarely the model or the data. It is the experience. Too many tools rely on chat interfaces that add cognitive load, cause prompt fatigue, and fail in high pressure workflows. This session explores why enterprise AI UX keeps breaking down and how cognitive design can reduce friction, rebuild trust, and make AI fit how people actually work.

events.title: Round Table: Screenwriting: Aaron Karo, Aaron B. Koontz, and Cheryl Eagan-Donovan
events.description: An extension of our popular Mentor Sessions, our Round Table Sessions not only allow attendees to learn from the industry experts that sit at each of the three tables in this session but they also allow attendees to learn from the questions and experiences of their peers as well. This Round Table Session will bring together industry experts and SXSW attendees for an enlightening discussion on Screenwriting.

events.title: Shifting From Beauty to Belonging—the Next Cultural Movement
events.description:
For decades, beauty marketing rewarded aspiration, perfection, and the impossible. But consumers — especially multicultural and Gen Z audiences — have rejected that script. They want relief. relevance. representation. And a brand that actually sees their lived reality.
In this provocative session, Kimberly Hairston-Hicks, CMO of Gold Bond and founder of Good Beauté, argues that the most powerful force reshaping consumer behavior today isn’t the beauty industry — it’s the Belonging Economy.

events.title: The Skin–Brain Connection: How the Microbiome Relates to Stress and Mood
events.description: Groundbreaking new research reveals for the first time that the skin microbiome – particularly the presence of Cutibacterium – is linked to lower stress and improved mood. In this solo session, Dr Samaras elucidates the link that was uncovered - via the skin–brain axis - and what it means for the future of beauty, mental health, and product innovation. Using advanced AI models, they decoded complex microbiome data to uncover patterns no human could detect. This is not just skincare – it’s a new frontier in holistic wellbeing. And imagine the unlocks when we add the power of quantum computing.

events.title: Smart Talks Live: Brewing Smarter with HEINEKEN and IBM
events.description: How is HEINEKEN transforming itself into the world’s best‑connected brewer? Malcolm Gladwell and HEINEKEN’s Chief AI Officer, Surajeet Ghosh, sit down for a live episode of Smart Talks with IBM podcast to explore how the company is using data, AI and strong partnerships to create better experiences for customers and consumers worldwide. Hear how HEINEKEN is modernizing its digital backbone, empowering its people, and unlocking new ways to innovate in the future of beer.

events.title: Sports Marketing & the World's Most-Watched Sporting Event
events.description: The World Cup is the most-watched sporting event & ultimate proving ground for brands ready to think beyond borders & traditional playbooks. Yet, we persist in approaching this once-every-four-years opportunity with tired strategies. It's not about slapping logos on jerseys; it's about cultural fluency at scale. The next cycle brings unprecedented viewing fragmentation, creator-driven content & fans expecting authentic engagement across 20+ markets simultaneously. ADWEEK's William Bradley and top CMOs explore how to revolutionize global sports marketing for the next World Cup.

speakers.name: Caroline Clayton
speakers.title: Svp, Communications And Chief Marketing Officer

events.title: Stop Playing Nice: Brand Safety Is Killing Your Business
events.description: In an AI-driven world, mediocre is invisible. With access to the same tools, budgets, and tech, only bold, resonant, and risky content cuts through. Safe marketing and SEO-optimized blogs won’t win visibility anymore—because AI doesn’t rank what’s average; it ranks what connects. Andrew Warden, CMO of Semrush, reveals why even top marketers are struggling to break through in generative search—and what it takes to truly earn attention when LLMs are the new gatekeepers. Learn how to ditch the illusion of “safe” and unlock real visibility in an era where the algorithm is no longer your ally.

events.title: Urbanists and Citymakers Core Conversation
events.description: Urbanism, SXSW, and Austin are an inseparable pairing!  In 2025 we kicked off the the urbanists meetup where dozens of architects, planners, and placemakers took a pulse of the most exciting urban ideas at SXSW. We also forged ties between SXSWers with local Austinites. The meetup features a round of self introduction, followed by some light, interactive networking activities. We will also discuss urbanism in Austin, and provide a platform for attendees to propose walks and outings to see new and historic projects that make up Austin’s urban fabric.

events.title: Visualising Feeling: Real-Time EEG Emotion Technology
events.description: What if you could see your brainwaves turned into real-time art that reveals how you feel? EVE (The EEG Visualizer of Emotions) is a live emotional visualization tool that transforms EEG signals into dynamic, responsive visuals. Blending neurotechnology, AI, and art, EVE opens new ways to explore emotional insight, user experience, and live experience. It can create interactive & personalized sensory designs, drive immersive wellbeing experiences, measure mood, emotion & real-time neural responses, map emotional learning & deepen meaning.

events.title: KOJ
events.description:
KOJ is the sound of defiance rising from Liverpool, UK: a working-class voice turned outward, loud enough to cut through the noise, resilient enough to remain unshaken, and connected enough to represent a frustrated generation.

Drawing from the raw British sub-cultural sounds of Grime, Rap and Punk, KOJ creates music that confronts power while rooted in relatability and everyday struggle. Revolutionary in spirit yet populist in appeal, his music is built to connect, move, and be felt collectively. At its core is courage - raw, direct lyricism exploring survival and defiance, darkness and light, pressure and pride.

KOJ showcased his lyrical authority on his acclaimed debut EP Villain With A Conscience, earning support from Clash, Wonderland, The Face, Apple Music and Amazon Music.
Live is where KOJ reaches another level. He doesn’t perform - he leads. From Boomtown to Radio 1 Big Weekend, Reeperbahn and SXSW, his shows become charged, communal moments where tension turns to release.

More than a catalogue, KOJ is building a movement through purpose-driven visuals, tech-led collaborations and his growing TRiBE community — “a man on a mission,” as The F-Word Magazine puts it.
events.venue: British Music Embassy @ Palm Door on Sixth

events.title: Cornbread Mafia
events.description:
The unbelievable true story of the Cornbread Mafia, a group of Kentucky farmers who built the largest domestic marijuana syndicate in U.S. history. Sons of tobacco farmers, moonshiners, and bootleggers, they turned to pot to keep their families fed.  

What followed was straight out of Kentucky folklore: lion cubs on the farm, backroad police chases, and a code of silence that baffled prosecutors. Part true crime and part cartoon, the film blends community, the War on Drugs, and a whole lot of weed with the humor and heart of the folks who lived it.

events.title: Do You Love Me
events.description: "Do You Love Me" is a playful and personal journey through Lebanon’s audiovisual memory, composed entirely of archival footage. It is a love letter to Beirut, spanning 70 years of film, TV, home videos, and photography, exploring the Lebanese collective psyche - marked by joy and intimacy, destruction and loss. Through the eyes of citizens, filmmakers and artists, the film reconstructs a fragmented history in a country without a national archive, celebrating creative expression as both resistance, renewal and a way to preserve memory.

events.title: Loren Grush Book Signing
events.description: Loren Grush will be signing copies of “The Six” at the SXSW Bookstore.

events.title: My NDA
events.description: Three people bound by non-disclosure agreements face extreme personal risk to expose how a simple intellectual property contract is weaponized to silence, manipulate and control.

events.title: One Another
events.description: Sometimes it takes the end of something to know what is really at stake. Joe, Giorgia, and Lorri are all grappling with the possible end of an intimate friendship at vastly different stages of life: a cross-country move, a mental health crisis, and a shift into empty-nesting have forced them each to reevaluate the support they need from those closest to them. Chronicling three different friendships over the course of three years, "One Another" brings together verite with a wealth of personal archives to intertwine their journeys as they search for what it really means for us to care for each other. The result is a story of change, heartache, and connection in this ode to platonic love.

Joe, Giorgia, and Lorri are all grappling with the possible end of an intimate friendship at vastly different stages of life: a cross-country move, a mental health crisis, and a shift into empty-nesting have forced them each to reevaluate the support they need from those closest to them. Chronicling three different friendships over the course of three years, "One Another" brings together verite with a wealth of personal archives to intertwine their journeys as they search for what it really means for us to care for each other. events.title: Sender
events.description: Julia was fired three weeks ago. She also got sober three weeks ago. She’s starting over in a suburban rental, and doing a lot of online shopping to help make the space her own, fast. When packages she didn’t order start showing up at her door — a blender, a corkscrew, her signature shade of lipstick — they feel so unnervingly tied to her past that it starts to feel like someone is watching her. The shopping site Smirk denies responsibility. But increasingly paranoid, Julia tumbles down a rabbit hole to find the identity of her anonymous sender.

events.title: And Her Body Was Never Found
events.description: Mor Cohen and Polaris Banks did the impossible, made a movie with just two people, while camping, with a script based on their real arguments. Most couples would kill each other under those conditions. They were no exception.

events.title: The Snake
events.description: When Jamie, ungovernable 40 something wild child collides with her venomous mother Anne, her life blows up spectacularly leaving her evicted and single. This sends Jamie on a pig in a hurricane journey for “home”; breaking into her Nana’s house to prove it should be hers, a rejected bid to move in with her van dwelling punk rock ex, and a stint in her best friends pied a terre, which ends with Jamie hooking up with her husband.

events.title: Ben Ellis
events.description:
At just 23, Cardiff-born singer-songwriter Ben Ellis has become one of the UK’s most quietly magnetic new voices, blending intimate acoustic songwriting with the emotional depth of indie-pop. His upcoming third EP marks a pivotal moment both emotionally and musically. Written across two trips to Los Angeles in the aftermath of a breakup, the project explores the complexities of heartbreak, drifting between moments of clarity and confusion.

“There was so much love still there,” Ellis says. “It’s crazy how art kind of comes from those moments.” Lead single “Where She Goes” emerged from a journal entry written the day after the breakup.

From there, the EP grew into a layered and collaborative body of work. Tracks like “When It Ends” push into rock territory with biting guitars, while “Animal” leans into warm, ’70s-inspired folk textures reminiscent of Fleetwood Mac. Co-produced by Grammy-nominated Matt Rad and longtime collaborator James October, the sessions saw Ellis push himself creatively, from late-night listens to Damien Rice to recording live drums at LA’s legendary Studio 606.
events.venue: British Music Embassy @ Palm Door on Sixth Patio

events.title: Apolo
events.description: "Apolo" follows the journey of a family formed by a transgender couple, revealing the nuances of love, daily life, and the constant struggle for recognition and respect. The documentary offers an intimate look into their family dynamics, inviting us to rethink our notions of affection, care, and society itself. As we accompany Apolo’s pregnancy, we are led to reflect on the challenges and dramas faced by the couple — Isis Broken and Lourenzo Gabriel. The father is the one giving birth, and society is not yet ready for that reality. The feature-length documentary marks the directorial debut of actress Tainá Müller and trans woman and musician Isis Broken.

events.title: Apolo
events.description: "Apolo" follows the journey of a family formed by a transgender couple, revealing the nuances of love, daily life, and the constant struggle for recognition and respect. The documentary offers an intimate look into their family dynamics, inviting us to rethink our notions of affection, care, and society itself. As we accompany Apolo’s pregnancy, we are led to reflect on the challenges and dramas faced by the couple — Isis Broken and Lourenzo Gabriel. The father is the one giving birth, and society is not yet ready for that reality. The feature-length documentary marks the directorial debut of actress Tainá Müller and trans woman and musician Isis Broken.

events.title: Dreamquil
events.description: Set in the not so distant future when poor air quality leads to people living mostly virtually lives. Carol is a dissatisfied career mother, struggling to find connection within her marriage to Gary and her child. With the day to day familiarity of their home and lives feeling increasingly claustrophobic, and worried she could be heading towards divorce, Carol leaps at the chance to get her life back on track by signing up for "DreamQuil", an avant-garde digital wellness retreat. When Carol returns home however, she discovers her family has been living with "Carol 2", a robot the corporation sent designed to help in her absence, and things take a mysterious and sinister turn.

events.title: Music Video Program
events.description: A dynamic mix of creativity and stylish visuals where music and storytelling collide.

events.title: Serling
events.description: "Serling" is an immersive first-person journey exploring the life and legacy of one of television’s most visionary storytellers, Rod Serling. Told almost entirely in Serling’s own words, drawn from never-before-heard recordings and personal dictations, the film captures the man behind "The Twilight Zone" in all his complexity. The film weaves archival material with atmospheric recreations that echo the eerie visual language Serling made iconic. As his unmistakable voice guides us, Serling emerges not only as a master of storytelling, but as a man grappling with the trauma of war, the moral compromises of fame, and the hope that America might one day live up to its own ideals.

events.title: Linda Hill & Emily Tedards Book Signing
events.description: Linda Hill will be signing copies of “Genius at Scale” at the SXSW Bookstore.

speakers.name: Linda A. Hill
speakers.title: Wallace Brett Donham Professor of Business Administration

events.title: AI at the Speed of Life: How Technology is Reshaping Drug Discovery and Delivery
events.description: Artificial intelligence is transforming nearly every industry—but in healthcare, its impact is uniquely personal. The pharmaceutical industry stands at an inflection point: what once took a decade or more to move from scientific hypothesis to patient treatment is being fundamentally reimagined through AI, advanced computing, and automation. Yet in an industry where lives hang in the balance, speed must be matched with rigor, and innovation with responsibility. Join leaders from pharma and technology for a conversation about deploying AI at scale to accelerate breakthroughs while maintaining the highest standards of patient safety, governance, and compliance.

speakers.name: Diogo Rau
speakers.title: Vice President And Chief Information And Digital Officer

events.title: AI Builders Meet Up
events.description: Join fellow founders, engineers, researchers, and product leaders who are building the next generation of AI products. This casual meetup brings together hands-on innovators to swap stories, share tools, and talk about what’s working (and what’s not) in the fast-moving world of AI. Whether you’re training models, shipping products, or scaling teams—come meet your peers and compare notes

events.title: Andrew Cushin
events.description:
Firmly established as an artist’s artist with the likes of Noel Gallagher, Sam Fender, Louis Tomlinson and Pete Doherty.
Andrew Cushin is primed to rise to the next level with the May 2nd release of his second album ‘Love
Is For Everyone’. Building upon his acclaimed debut ‘Waiting For The Rain’. The 2nd album charted in the UK official top 40 album charts.
 Andrew recently teamed up with his local brewery Anarchy Brew Co to create his own L.I.F.E IPA beer,
which is now available from their website. It represents his latest brand collaboration after being invited to headline
The Soundcheck, the debut live event from the Aston Martin Aramco Formula One team, late last year. Andrew has played Italian, Dutch and British GP with Aston Martin F1 team in 2025.
Andrew toured the full UK headline in May and October 2025 as well as EU . He is currently on his 3rd successive year of touring North American/Canada headline tour.
In October 25th 2025 Andrew Cushin sold out his hometown show at Newcastle City Hall in front of 2500 fans.
2025 has been a huge success for Andrew Cushin breaking through the top 40 and now firmly establishing himself as a firm favourite in the UK live scene.
events.venue: British Music Embassy @ Palm Door on Sixth

events.title: ASSSSCAT
events.description: UCB’s signature improv juggernaut is a live comedy show with an all-star cast of comedians from film, television, and your favorite streaming services performing improv inspired by true stories from a surprise celebrity guest. ASSSSCAT has played to critical acclaim and sold-out audiences across the country.

events.title: Brands x Music: Bringing together Activations & Artists
events.description: Some brands don’t just show up - they create cultural moments. Today’s most innovative marketers are blending bold brand activations with the power of music and star power to build emotional resonance and spark global buzz. In this lively discussion, hear from marketing leaders at the world’s most forward-thinking brands as they explore how to craft unforgettable experiences that connect with consumers on a visceral level, through sound, story, and shared energy. Learn how music-fueled campaigns are driving loyalty, elevating brand perception, and shaping the future of experiential marketing.

events.title: CRAFTING SEKIRO: NO DEFEAT: HAND-DRAWN ANIMATION & ORIGINAL SCORE (SNEAK PEEK FIRST LOOK)
events.description: FromSoftware’s Sekiro is being reimagined as a hand-drawn anime built with an analog-first (hand drawn) philosophy, prioritizing craftsmanship, motion, and texture over shortcuts. Join director Kenichi Kutsuna, composer Shuta Hasunuma, and Crunchyroll’s Associate Creative Director and Host Lauren Moore, for a behind-the-scenes look at how Studio Qzil.la is bringing Sengoku Japan to life: from research and concept, to action choreography, background art, and sound.

events.title: Curious Critters and Human Health
events.description: Ozempic revolutionized diabetes treatment, inspired by Gila monster venom - proving nature holds answers to health challenges. This session explores how unique organisms like snails and cavefish can improve our quality of life. Panelists discuss the most exciting ways curious critters, genetic engineering and biomimicry transform human health and society through nature-inspired discoveries that could change our future.

events.title: Embodied Regulation in a Dysregulated World
events.description:
Insight doesn’t change lives.
Integration does.

Trauma isn’t stored in memory.
Leadership isn’t built in theory.
Both live in the body — and the nervous system that governs it.

This immersive session is a nervous system reset for a world stuck in chronic fight, flight, and freeze — a living portal between ancient medicine and modern neuroscience.

The experience begins with a short, grounded presentation on the power of breath and how it directly influences the sympathetic and parasympathetic nervous systems, shaping emotion, decision-making, and presence in real time.

Participants are then guided through a trauma-informed somatic breathwork and meditation practice, using mouth breathing to safely release trapped emotional and survival energy — without storytelling or retraumatization.

The session transitions into nasal breathing, supporting embodiment, integration, and regulation — moving the body from release into grounded coherence.

We close with a live ocean drum ritual, using rhythm and vibration to anchor integration at a cellular level, followed by an optional sharing circle for connection and reflection.

This is not self-optimization.
This is embodied regulation.

Participants leave regulated, present, and connected — with a lived understanding of breath as a tool for emotional regulation, resilience, and conscious leadership.

events.title: ESG is dead. Now What?
events.description: Cultural backlash killed the ESG (Environmental, Social, and Governance) framework as a tool for motivating and measuring action on climate and social justice—proving that publicly traded companies are not going to drive us to a radically better economy. What is it? Nature-positive finance, a new approach that’s holistic, comprehensive, and resilient to political and stock market shifts. Three impact investing leaders illustrate the idea in practice, with a focus on finding scalable place-based strategies, spotting system change opportunities, and tying environmental impact to social impact.

speakers.name: Lubna Maria Elia
speakers.title: Interim Ceo / Managing Director Of Impact Capital Lab

events.title: Featured Session: Actionable Ikigai: Career Planning in the age of AI
events.description:
Most career advice stinks.

Why? Because we can’t manage what we don’t measure, and most of us are flying blind.

Join futurist and three-time SXSW fan favorite Mike Bechtel as he turns his foresight toolkit inward and demystifies the future of career planning in the age of AI with a flight-tested dashboard he’s used himself for the past 20 years.

Over the course of this session, Mike will offer the audience tips, techniques, and even take-home-tech to help them determine their "reason-for-being“, plot a practical path to get there, and critically, know when to make course corrections.

Tuned towards early to mid-stage professionals, with relevance to students and senior leaders seeking a recalibration, this fast, story-rich session blends personality with practicality, giving today’s audience the mindset and toolset to design more intentional futures.

events.title: Featured Session: The Latticework of Mental Models For a Great Life!
events.description: Join renowned investor and philanthropist Mohnish Pabrai for a thought-provoking talk on the key mental models that have shaped major decisions in his life, from business and investing to philanthropy and personal growth. An avid follower of Warren Buffett and Charlie Munger, Pabrai has long embraced Munger’s call to develop a “latticework of mental models,” a multidisciplinary toolkit for thinking clearly and avoiding misjudgment. In this session, he will go beyond simply restating the classics. Instead, he will highlight the select models he has found most indispensable, the ones that have guided him in navigating uncertainty, spotting opportunities, and sidestepping avoidable errors. Pabrai will introduce new mental models of his own, distilled from decades of experience, hard lessons, and reflection. These additions help bring to light patterns of behavior and decision-making that he believes are critical for anyone seeking not just financial success, but a truly fulfilling life.

events.title: Foresight Improv
events.description:
Do you wish you could predict the future? Come challenge our panel of futurists as they try to do it themselves! 

In 2024, SXSW attendees put a panel of futurists’ knowledge to the test, challenging them to improvise their view on the future of 18 audience-selected topics from toilet paper to war to thinking. Attendees submitted ideas into a fishbowl that spurred a constructive view of the future of a topic, in 3 minutes or less. This year we hope to return bigger and better with some new tricks and twists. Expect a rousing, dynamic, fun-filled adventure into the future and beyond!

events.title: Fuel or Friction? Private Equity in the Age of AI
events.description:
AI hype is at a fever pitch. Every headline promises a venture-backed moonshot ready to upend entire industries. But that is not how most AI will scale. Private equity is quietly shaping what real adoption looks like inside operating businesses. Andrew Brooks, CEO of Contextual.io, makes the case that capital structure is one of the most overlooked forces in AI’s future. VC rewards urgency and outsized bets. PE rewards operational discipline, durable growth, and EBITDA performance. Especially in markets where transformation takes time. This session explores what actually changes when PE enters the picture and why the next phase of AI may favor staying power and measurable impact over speed.

- How capital incentives shape AI product decisions and timelines

- Why private equity’s performance discipline can create more sustainable AI businesses than growth-at-all-costs VC models

- How PE alignment enables company growth without the pressure to chase hype cycles

events.title: How to Break Through to Digital Services & Tech Platforms
events.description: Music’s digital evolution has unlocked unprecedented access for artists and teams—putting key decision-makers, pitch opportunities, and powerful connections within reach. But greater access brings new layers of complexity. In this panel, we’ll bring together the humans who have played on both sides of the digital music spaces you love. They’ll give a glimpse into the tech intricacies and communication behind closed doors leading to proper partnerships. More importantly, we’ll give tangible systems to how artists and teams can win through patience and persistence.

events.title: How to Create Immersive 3D Stories With Real Humans
events.description: The explosion of virtual stories across platforms has seen an increase in the integration of real humans in immersive experiences. The evolution of stunningly realistic volumetric video now enables real human capture and integration in scenes that are life-like and spatially adaptive. The innovations that are now making the human more prominent in complex virtual narratives are being led by producers and toolmakers who are building a network of dynamic volumetric artisans. This session features leading developers of mixed reality, VR, and mobile AR that render virtual humans - not avatars.

speakers.name: Corey Rosen
speakers.title: EVP, creative development, production and storytelling

events.title: Indie Film, Hollywood Tech: Virtual Production on Any Budget
events.description: Independent filmmakers are told to write small. But LED volume technology is unlocking worlds of possibility outside the Hollywood system, proving virtual production isn't just for sci-fi blockbusters. From queer horror-comedies to intimate dramas to stylized period pieces, we'll look at real-world case studies that show how accessible virtual production can be. Learn how to think about LED volumes, Unreal Engine, and more from script to budget without technical overwhelm—and discover how to make those 'impossible' scripts possible.

events.title: Inside the International Scam Syndicate: How We Fight Back
events.description: Scamming is a multibillion-dollar, transnational business rivaling legitimate enterprises.  In actual offices, their workers labor leg to leg at long tables -- cubicles would actually be more humane. Scams are now a way for nation-states to steal the wealth of Americans, at speed and scale. These criminals are on a rampage, and those in power, in the US and abroad, aren't really focused on stopping it. Hear from a former prosecutor hell-bent on disrupting this prolific crime, an expert in deception, and a scam survivor and podcaster about how we can all fight back.

events.title: It All Begins With Birds – Insights, Joy, and Lessons from Avian Life
events.description: Explore the vital role birds play in our world. Not only do birds contribute to biodiversity and the stability of ecosystems, birdwatching carries psychological and emotional benefits – inspiring creativity, mindfulness, and a sense of wonder. By observing birds, we can learn about adaptation, social interaction, and survival strategies. Whether you are a seasoned birdwatcher or simply enjoy the cheerful songs outside your window, this session promises to deepen your appreciation for birds and their essential place in our lives, encouraging you to observe, protect, and celebrate our feathered friends.

events.title: Neurogaming: The Future of Interactive Entertainment
events.description: From button-mashing to brain-driven play, neurogaming is set to rewrite the rulebook. This panel hosted by OpenBCI gathers neurogamers and more to show how real-time EEG/EMG decoding replaces sticks and keys with pure intent, unlocking worlds that respond to mood, focus, and micro-gestures. We’ll spotlight a live neurogaming case study, unpack further real-world examples, and sketch the roadmap toward a brain-driven future of play.

events.title: Perceptual Diversity: Art & Neuroscience in Design
events.description: How can we design for a world where no two people experience reality the same way? This panel explores the science and power of perceptual diversity, how differences in how we sense, process and interpret shape identity, connection, and emotion. With expert voices from neuroscience, immersive design, and the arts and through the new lens of neuroaesthetics: we’ll explore how expanding perception can create more inclusive, empathetic, and visionary futures across art, health, and technology.

events.title: Psychedelics: The Paradigm-Changing Future of Mental Health
events.description: Psychedelic treatments are rapidly moving from research into clinical practice, signaling a potential transformation in how we treat mental health conditions. This session will explore how clinical innovation, care delivery models, and advocacy are converging to reshape mental health care safely and effectively for the millions who need better options. Attendees will gain insight into the steps required to bring psychedelic treatments into clinical settings, what patient access can look like, and how providers are navigating the evolving landscape as these treatments enter mainstream care.

events.title: Rewriting the STEM Pipeline: How Girls Get in the Driver’s Seat—and Stay There
events.description:
From the Space Race and electric vehicles to AI, women have shaped the biggest breakthroughs in history—yet the STEM gender gap still refuses to close. So, what actually works?

Join Meridith Maskara, Chief Development Officer at Girl Scouts of the USA and Kelsey Gaines, STEAM Education Lead at General Motors for an interactive, "campfire” chat that unpacks how early exposure, real world skills, and unexpected partnerships can flip the script. Since 2018, Girl Scouts across the U.S. have earned more than 5 million STEM badges, building confidence and curiosity long before career paths are set. The conversation will explore why, even amid today’s tech boom, girls and women are still getting left behind—and how programs designed for modern girls are rebuilding the STEM pipeline from the ground up.

And yes-- Girl Scout cookies will be available.

events.title: Round Table: Legal: Dale Nelson, Paul Szynol, and Sophia Yen
events.description: An extension of our popular Mentor Sessions, our Round Table Sessions not only allow attendees to learn from the industry experts that sit at each of the three tables in this session but they also allow attendees to learn from the questions and experiences of their peers as well. This Round Table Session will bring together industry experts and SXSW attendees for an enlightening discussion on Legal.

events.title: Sober Space Meet Up - 3/16
events.description: Sober Space is a welcoming gathering place for people in all forms of recovery during SXSW 2026. This space hosts all-format recovery meetings for Friends of Bill and all SXSW attendees who are seeking a supportive meeting environment during the festival. Participants are invited to sit together and share experience, strength, and hope in a confidential, judgment-free setting. Meetings are facilitated by The SIMS Foundation alongside trusted leaders from the recovery community.

events.title: Sphere of Influence: Record of Culture Or Creative Compromise
events.description: When it comes to music for film and ad content, an original music track often becomes a romantic ideal – demo love. Halle Petro from Sonic Union, Rich Robinson from Warner Chapel Music, and artist Billy Corgan will discuss the top 10 licensed songs, the songwriter’s point of view, language and ideas as inspiration, and how to interpret originally, versus infringing upon what’s come before (including AI). How do we understand original music? This panel will offer best practices about musical creative ideations, and the insight and language to up your creative output and collaborations.

events.title: "The Past is Prologue” how do we make for today's audiences?
events.description:
Everything that has come before us has set the stage for now. Our audiences are looking for new, innovative and fresh storytelling, with expectations based on what they have experienced previously. So, how can we make new moments of magic and keep surprising our audiences? 
With a lightning opening provocation from Sarah Ellis, Director of Creative Innovation from the Royal Shakespeare Company, Createch Frontiers examines how we can innovate ancient traditions of storytelling and keep our audiences engaged.

speakers.name: Ayanna Thompson
speakers.title: Scholar of Shakespeare, race, and performance at Arizona State University and Executive Director of ACMRS

speakers.title: Head of Culture, Creative Industries, and Digital Roadmap

events.title: Under 25 Meet Up
events.description: For founders, builders, and ambitious minds under 25. Whether you're starting a company, working on something big, or still figuring it out, this is your chance to connect with peers who are actually doing the thing. Featuring Cameron Van Der Berg, who quit his engineering job in 2018 to start Infravision and just raised $91M to build aerial robotics that transform power grid construction. Real talk about going all-in, building hard things, and what it actually takes.

events.title: US Healthcare in Crisis: Who Cares? Who Wins?
events.description: A little over a year ago, Dr. Elisabeth Potter scrubbed out of an operating room to take a call from an insurance company and stepped into a national conversation about how our system is treating patients and healthcare workers. Time to scrub out again, and talk about the health of our $5.6 trillion system, the value of independent voices and the state of our healthcare workforce. She is joined on stage by Trina Spear, co-Founder and CEO of Figs, Inc. for a conversation, a pep talk, a call for assistance to creative innovators willing to take on a big, hairy challenge.

speakers.name: Dr. Elisabeth Potter, MD
speakers.title: Reconstructive Plastic Surgeon & Founder Of Redbud Surgery Center

events.title: Waste is the New Gold: How Trash Will Fund the Next Economy
events.description: From wastewater to e-waste, the world is drowning in “garbage” that holds untapped value. But a new class of startups, scientists, and technologists is flipping the script by turning industrial runoff into rare earths, landfills into lithium banks, and toxins into trillion-dollar opportunities. This session will dive into how biology, chemistry, and data science are transforming global waste streams into the raw materials of the clean economy. Think of it as a startup gold rush just under our feet.

speakers.name: Jessica Crosley
speakers.title: Vice President R&D and Sustainability Innovation

events.title: Your Brand Has Multiple Personalities. Is that a Problem?
events.description: Your brand acts completely different on TikTok vs LinkedIn vs Instagram - but is that authentic multi-dimensionality or dangerous personality disorder? We'll diagnose real brands live, dissect epic platform fails, and teach the difference between healthy code-switching and brand schizophrenia. Through interactive challenges, learn why Gen Z can spot inauthentic adaptation from miles away, which archetypes can successfully platform-hop, and how to maintain consistent values while speaking each platform's native language fluently.

events.title: Hana Lili
events.description:
Hana Lili is on a mission to pursue her truth. For the Welsh artist, songwriting has always been a way to make sense of what words can’t quite hold. Her self-titled EP, Hana, marks her boldest step yet — an intimate collection that distils emotion into its rawest form. Blending confessional storytelling with the dynamic spirit of 90s and early 00s alt-rock, Hana crafts
songs that balance vulnerability and power. Drawing inspiration from artists like Alanis Morissette, Radiohead and Gwen Stefani, she channels emotional honesty through soaring melodies and unfiltered energy. Each song feels like a conversation with herself — an exploration of identity, doubt, and the small moments that shape who we are.
Hana’s music merges introspection with rebellion, turning personal chaos into connection. Raised in Wales and a first-language Welsh speaker, Hana’s sense of place runs deep. Her roots in the Welsh Eisteddfod tradition — a celebration of language, music, and storytelling — instilled in her a lasting belief in the power of creative expression.
With a sound that bridges intimacy and universality, Hana Lili stands as one of alt-pop’s most distinct and fearless emerging voices.
events.venue: British Music Embassy @ Palm Door on Sixth Patio

events.title: Family Movie
events.description:
The Smiths have gathered once again on their quaint family farm to make the latest in a string of low-budget horror movies. No, the movies aren't particularly "successful." Some might even call them "bad." But at least the family is together, and that's what matters to Jack and Ellen. Their adult children, on the other hand - Trent and Ula - are working up the courage to leave this particular family tradition behind. 
Simmering family dysfunction turns to pure chaos when a real dead body shows up on set. Can they come together to keep the movie on track, or will this be the Smith family's final act?

events.title: Film & TV Industry Happy Hour
events.description: Have a drink with SAGindie and SAG-AFTRA at their official Film & TV Industry Happy Hour to network and mingle with fellow actors, filmmakers, creatives, and other industry professionals at SXSW. Open to Film and Platinum badge holders, 21+.

events.title: The Happiest Hour: Cookie-Inspired Cocktails with Girl Scouts
events.description:
Because SXSW deserves a happy hour with purpose.

Join Girl Scouts for the happiest of hours—where iconic cookies meet creative cocktails, and good vibes come with an even better cause. Sip on Cookie-inspired drinks, sample the newest Girl Scout cookie, and connect with fellow SXSW attendees over a shared love of innovation, community, and a little something sweet.

This come as you are gathering is a chance to celebrate the entrepreneurial spirit of Girl Scouts, support an incredible nonprofit organization, and toast to the next generation of leaders—all while discovering bold new takes on classic flavors you know and love.

Come for the cocktails. Stay for the cookies. Leave knowing your happy hour did some real good.

events.title: Industry Happy Hour with NextEra Energy Resources
events.description:
Enjoy networking with industry peers, small bites, and cocktails amid downtown Austin views.

https://www.nexteraenergyresources.com/

events.title: SXSW Comedy Presents
events.description: Catch the best of the fest on one stage. SXSW Comedy brings you a curated powerhouse lineup featuring iconic voices and the must-see breakout performers you’ll be bragging about discovering first. Lineup coming soon!

events.title: Adult DVD
events.description:
Adult DVD, the Leeds based six piece have become known for their relentless output of euphoric hooks and grooves along with a relentless touring schedule that has taken them to Glastonbury, Greenman, End Of The Road and several European festivals this Summer.
Formed by vocalist Harry Hanson and synth-player Greg Lonsdale, the project quickly expanded to a full band with Danny Blackburn (guitar/synth), Jake Williams (synth), Jonathan Newell (drums), and George Manson (bass). From the outset, their tongue-in-cheek lyrics, pulsating electronics, big choruses and unique production style (their releases are all self-produced) set them apart from the indie-rock landscape. 
Few songs capture the chaotic fun of Adult DVD more than their first release ‘Bill Murray’ - now a firm fan favourite and sing along moment at every festival set. First ‘proper’ single ‘Do Something’ from their 'Next Day Shipping' EP earned a spot on the BBC 6 Music B-list and support from BBC Radio 1, BBC Introducing and Radio X. Subsequent single ‘Because I Like It’ also landed onto the 6 Music B-list, and accompanying live performance from the BBC’s 6 Music festival.
Adult DVD’s live shows are fast becoming legendary. From sold-out hometown headline gigs at Brudenell Social Club and Belgrave Music Hall (2 in the round shows in one day) to storming sets at The Great Escape, Deer Shed Festival, and Live at Leeds, their performances are high-energy and unmissable.
Whether tapping into their love for chorus-centric indie or the influence of acid house floor fillers, DJing, or remixing their musical contemporaries their core appeal remains consistent: undeniable humour, bold danceable instrumentals and instantly memorable songwriting."
events.venue: British Music Embassy @ Palm Door on Sixth

events.title: Forbidden Fruits
events.description: At a mall store, Apple leads a secret witch cult with coworkers Cherry and Fig. New hire Pumpkin questions their sisterhood, forcing them to confront inner darkness or meet violent ends.

events.title: My Brother's Killer
events.description: The unsolved murder of Billy London, a gay adult film performer brutally killed in West Hollywood, was an urban legend for 33 years. A documentary intended to honor his life took an unexpected turn when members of the community joined forces to uncover overlooked clues, and seek a resolution to the mystery of who killed him. Drawing on a rare trove of VHS and personal footage, the film reveals a chilling overlap between the victim and some of the suspects who were captured on camera in films made in the narrow window of Billy's death.

events.title: Big Girls Don't Cry
events.description: Summer 2006, 14-year-old Sid is caught between her own burgeoning sexual curiosity and acceptance from an older group of girls. As she delves deeper into rebellion, she leaves behind a trail of destruction as she goes. Big Girls Don’t Cry is a love letter to all the women that still feel shame scars from this time of their lives; who did things they wished they hadn’t, or didn’t do things they wished they had; to hold up a mirror and say yes; that was f#&*ed up.

events.title: Big Girls Don't Cry
events.description: Summer 2006, 14-year-old Sid is caught between her own burgeoning sexual curiosity and acceptance from an older group of girls. As she delves deeper into rebellion, she leaves behind a trail of destruction as she goes. Big Girls Don’t Cry is a love letter to all the women that still feel shame scars from this time of their lives; who did things they wished they hadn’t, or didn’t do things they wished they had; to hold up a mirror and say yes; that was f#&*ed up.

events.title: Scarlet Girls
events.description: What does it mean to be a woman in a country where abortion is banned in all circumstances? In this lyrical documentary, women and girls speak about the challenges and consequences regarding unsafe abortion in the Dominican Republic.

events.title: SXSW Comedy Presents
events.description: Catch the best of the fest on one stage. SXSW Comedy brings you a curated powerhouse lineup featuring iconic voices and the must-see breakout performers you’ll be bragging about discovering first. Lineup coming soon!

events.title: Unlocking Her Next Chapter | Fitness with Kayla Barnes
events.description: Day 1 features Kayla Barnes, who will explore how to design a longevity-focused exercise plan that can be customized for women in all seasons of life and training levels, while accounting for the unique nuances of female physiology. The conversation will cover cycle syncing, differences between female and male training, and the role of mobility, flexibility, and balance in long-term health. Kayla will also dive into efficiency-driven workouts using key biomarkers like VO₂ max, grip strength, lean body mass, and bone density—why they matter, how to train them, and how to track progress. Attendees will leave with practical strategies including exercise snacks, HIIT, complementary therapies, and exclusive custom content created for event participants. Kayla is one of the world’s top female longevity experts and has been studying female longevity for over a decade with speaking engagements all around the world.

events.title: Mickey
events.description: Mickey spent the last ten years exploring her transition process within the conservative context of Sinaloa, Mexico. Through digital archives, artistic reenactments, and deeply personal encounters, the film moves between tenderness and rage, transforming memory into an act of freedom. An exploration of self-perception and a non-punitive confrontation with the past.

events.title: Narrative Short Program 3
events.description: Exceptional storytelling that captivates, surprises, and excites.
events.venue: Rollins Theatre at the Long Center

events.title: Seahorse
events.description: Nola, a sous chef searching for stability, is barely holding her life together. After a brutal Friday night shift, she crashes her bike and wakes to find her estranged father, Cyrus, now unhoused, standing over her. Taking him in forces long-buried wounds to the surface. As past and present collide, Nola is pulled into a reckoning with grief, forgiveness, and the fragile possibility of repair.

events.title: Drag
events.description: Two sisters with a contentious relationship decide to rob a rural home in upstate New York. The simple robbery turns into a nightmare when one of them throws out her back and becomes immobilized on the second floor. The night spirals out of control as they embark on a painful journey to make it out before the homeowner returns.

events.title: Love Language
events.description: Following a failed engagement, Louisa "Lou" Klaussner, an aspiring author who pays the bills by writing social media copy for a tortilla chip company, falls into a side hustle writing wedding vows for other people. When Lou reconnects with her college best-friend and long-time crush Warren, she is shocked to find he is the fiancé of one of Lou's wedding vow clients… putting Lou in the middle of a complicated love-rectangle.

events.title: Mam
events.description: After falling in love with Vietnamese cuisine during a life-changing trip abroad, Jerald—a self-taught chef from small-town Texas—arrives in New York City with one goal: to open his own restaurant. Juggling odd jobs and secretly perfecting recipes in a basement kitchen, he’s running out of time and money. When he meets Nhung, a sharp-witted Vietnamese waitress, their unlikely alliance sparks a bold culinary journey. From improvised street hustles to a hidden speakeasy, they fight to turn Jerald’s dream into reality. A story of passion, resilience, and unexpected friendship in the heart of the city.

events.title: Manhood
events.description: "Manhood" follows Dallas entrepreneur Bill Moore as he attempts to make penis enlargement as commonplace as Botox. Along the way, an OnlyFans star and a father of five put their bodies—and their insecurities—on the line. Blending dark humor with unexpected empathy, "Manhood" examines shame, addiction, and the fragile myths of American masculinity. From Executive Producers World of Wonder ("RuPaul’s Drag Race"), Sheila Nevins ("Real Sex"), Penny Lane ("Hail Satan"), Producer Kerry Mack ("Proof of Concept"), and Director Daniel Lombroso ("White Noise").

events.title: Manhood

Along the way, an OnlyFans star and a father of five put their bodies—and their insecurities—on the line. Blending dark humor with unexpected empathy, "Manhood" examines shame, addiction, and the fragile myths of American masculinity. From Executive Producers World of Wonder ("RuPaul’s Drag Race"), Sheila Nevins ("Real Sex"), Penny Lane ("Hail Satan"), Producer Kerry Mack ("Proof of Concept"), and Director Daniel Lombroso ("White Noise").

events.title: Crash Land
events.description: Lance, Clay, and Darby have spent their childhoods drinking, wreaking havoc, and filming crude stunts in their small town. Everyone hates them. Wanting to finally prove their lives have meaning, the boys set out to make a “real movie” and in the process are forced to confront emotions and experiences they’ve never considered: love, loss, and ultimately, what it means to grow up.

events.title: Dead Eyes
events.description: A firest person horror film. Sean and his fiancée, Grace, enter a remote forest to find Sean’s missing father, Paul, who vanished after the death of his youngest daughter, Lilly. Returning to the site of Lilly’s death forces Sean to confront his inner demons, which begin to materialize externally. Their search takes a terrifying turn, revealing Paul’s secret. He’s been conducting experiments, aimed at resurrecting Lilly. The forest is now inhabited by cannibalistic little girls, each a clone of Lilly, battling to prove their identity as the 'real' Lilly. As Sean and Grace uncover the grim truth, they face terrifying creatures and grapple with unsettling questions about life and death.

events.title: DJ AG
events.description:
DJ AG is a genre-shifting DJ and producer whose influence sits at the crossroads of Black British culture, global pop and contemporary electronic music. His sets move from grime and UK rap to afrobeats and alternative soul without losing pace or purpose. This approach has made him a trusted name for artists and audiences who want more than a standard club experience.

AG has shared stages with and played for artists including Ed Sheeran, Will Smith, Burna Boy and Skepta. His profile continues to grow as he brings his sound to live shows, brand events and cultural moments that pull in diverse crowds. Known for reading a room with accuracy rather than hype, AG builds environments where every transition feels intentional.

His work has been covered by a range of platforms and press titles reflecting his reach across culture, style and music. Coverage includes features and appearances in GRM Daily, Complex, Notion, Trench, Mixtape Madness and BBC platforms which have positioned him as one of the most versatile names emerging from the UK scene.
events.venue: British Music Embassy @ Palm Door on Sixth

events.title: Elijah Delgado
events.description:
Elijah Delgado is a 23-year-old singer-songwriter from Austin, Texas, creating what he calls Indie Rock Lullabies — a blend of cinematic energy, textured guitar work, and raw emotion. Since releasing his debut EP When I Was On Cloud 9 in 2021, which surpassed 700,000 Spotify streams, Elijah has emerged as one of Austin’s most compelling young voices.

He’s performed on some of the city’s biggest stages, including Blues On The Green 2025 for 20,000+ fans, the national anthem at Austin FC, and opening slots for Chaparelle, Next of Kin, Zach Person, and West 22nd. Festival highlights include Old Settler’s, UtopiaFest, Hot Summer Nights, and ACL Radio’s Drop-In, alongside headlining milestones like Meridian’s first sold-out show and a packed Stubb’s Indoors set following Dayglow.

His latest release, Moonboy (June 2025), showcases a bold evolution. The explosive single “Hide + Seek” contrasts with the aching title track, "Moonboy", exploring isolation, hope, and transformation. With vulnerable lyrics, dynamic shifts, and soulful delivery, Elijah is building a loyal audience and cementing his place as a rising Austin artist to watch.

events.title: He Bled Neon
events.description: After learning his brother’s death may be murder, Ethan returns to Las Vegas to uncover the truth, and confront the violent past he buried. Once a street kid, he’s now living the good life in L.A., engaged to his dream girl and working for her father’s real estate firm. But when he gets a text saying his brother overdosed, the promise he made to never return home shatters, pulling him back into the world he thought he’d escaped.

events.title: iHeartPodcast Awards 2026
events.description:
America is in love with podcasts. We love the brilliant storytelling, inspiring us to think differently, making us laugh and helping us learn... Today, Podcasters speak to tens of millions every week. Influencing pop culture AND public opinion. And now iHeartRadio is recognizing the top podcasts in America, based on the podcasts you say are the best. The eighth-annual iHeartPodcast Awards returns, the major Podcast Awards program where your vote will decide who wins. Over 20 categories like Crime, Comedy, Music, Sports, Curiosity, hundreds of nominees and special guests. The 2026 iHeartPodcast Awards will return live from SXSW in Austin, TX.

More Information Here: https://www.iheart.com/podcast-awards/
events.venue: Austin City Limits Live at the Moody Theater

events.title: JLQ
events.description: JLQ (aka the Julie Lowery Quartet) is a quartet on Austin’s Flak Records known for its lush vocals and catchy melodies. The band features Austin music veterans Julie Lowery (lead vocals, acoustic guitar), Andy Maguire (bass), David Mider (percussion) and Jenny Smith (violin) playing and singing dreamy, four-part harmony ear worms.

events.title: Jordan Walsh
events.description:
Jordan Walsh is a percussionist, producer, and educator based in Austin, Texas. A proponent of electronics and theater in music, he strives to perform the most absurd music with the most genuine fervor. Jordan's recent work includes esteemed composers including Elainie Lillios, Aida Shirazi, José Martinez, and Louis Raymond Kolker. Frequently engaged as a solo performer, Jordan has appeared at the SEAMUS conference, the New York City Electroacoustic Music Festival, Percussive Arts Society International Convention, New Music Dublin, and the Bowling Green State University New Music Festival.

Jordan currently serves as principal percussionist for the Density512 new music collective, is a member of minimalist metal group Goliath Was Bigfoot, acts as the sometimes third part of the legendary Line Upon Line Percussion, and is one half of the live-only-nonbroadcast-pirate-radio phenomenon Peach Blossom Highway. When he is not engaged with contemporary classical music, he can be found playing drums with Austin Bands including Maru Haru and Middle Sattre. Jordan proudly endorses Pearl/Adams Percussion, Sabian Cymbals, Black Swamp Percussion, and Innovative Percussion.

events.title: Midnight Short Program
events.description: Indulge your cravings for horror, gore, and dark comedy.

events.title: Notting Hill Carnival Dancers
events.venue: British Music Embassy @ Palm Door on Sixth

events.title: Ruido Selecto
events.description: Ruido Selecto is a musician, producer, and sound engineer from Medellín, Colombia. His music focuses on Caribbean rhythms such as Cumbia, Salsa, Electronic Dub, and Afro-diasporic styles that have traditionally reached Colombia through the Picó Soundsystem culture. Ruido defines his sound as "Caribbean Bass." Since 2015, he has released two studio albums and several collaborations and EPs (Secret Lab 2015, Piratería Caribeña y Contrabando 2019 Equador 2022, and Cumbia Soundsystem EP 2025). In 2024, he released a series of remixes of iconic tracks from the legendary Colombian label Discos Fuentes, titled 14 CAÑONAZOS EN DUB, an audiovisual production that was highlighted by the specialized media outlet Gladys Palmera. He has toured nationally and internationally in Mexico and Central America, with additional performances in the United States and Europe. Ruido Selecto has participated in festivals such as Altavoz, África Futura, and Invazion Fest, sharing the stage with artists like Mitú, Afrotronix, Ghetto Kumbé, Systema Solar, Alligatorz, among others. He has worked as a producer and mastering engineer for Discos Fuentes , Folcore Barcelona and No Sabes.

events.title: Talise
events.description:
Talise is a Canadian songwriter rooted in old-time, blues, and Americana. Accompanying herself on banjo and guitar, she writes and performs with a spare, intimate sound and a deep, dark-toned voice, carrying songs shaped by honest storytelling and the stark beauty of the northern landscape.
Outside of music, she spends much of her time learning and practicing bushcraft and traditional land-based skills, a way of life that continues to shape her perspective and writing.

events.title: Jenna Cole
events.description:
Jenna Cole is a Newcastle-based Afrobeats artist, songwriter and producer creating globally-minded music from the heart of Whitley Bay. Blending warm vocals with infectious rhythms and soulful melodies, her sound moves between Afrobeats, R&B and Pop, delivering records that feel both intimate and energetic.

As a former principal Songwriter and Creative Director within a major label girlband line up, Jenna has taken this vast experience and continued to develop her songwriting and production as a solo Artist, crafting a sonic that is true to her roots and rapidly connecting with her new-found international audience. After amassing over 2M views and 500k streams on her debut release in 2025, she was named a BBC Introducing  "One to Watch" for 2026, and makes her live US debut at SXSW Austin.
events.venue: British Music Embassy @ Palm Door on Sixth

events.title: Chatterton
events.description: “I do it with my heart on my sleeve,” Pierce sings on Blouse, the lead single and closing track of Chatterton’s latest EP, Tiny Empire. It’s the first release from the Oxnard, CA-based duo, consisting of Brock Pierce and Logan Scrivner, since 2024’s debut Fields of This, the album which earned them a slot on Pitchfork’s Best Rock Albums of 2024. The lyric embodies the new EP well—especially coming from a pair who often prefer to keep things abstract rather than confessional. Pierce may grumble that “everything has changed” on “Punching Bag,” yet Tiny Empire stands as a testament that sometimes change can work in your favor.

events.title: Larry Seaman
events.description: 'One of Austin's best songwriters' has a new album, Mind How You Go, out on Flak Records. Larry's killer band includes Jon Sanchez (Flying Saucers, Roky Erickson), Andy Maguire  ( Spoon, Dogzilla), Ray Flynt (2020), and Jenny deWulf Smith (JLQ).

events.title: Wilby
events.description: Jersey-born Maria Crawford has been paving her way through the Nashville independent music scene since 2014. Now Brooklyn-based, she continues to capture listeners with her fiercely vulnerable songwriting and compelling live performances. Wilby’s debut single “Bad” (2020) gained immediate attention, followed by "Translucent Beauty” (2021), drifting between bedroom pop and indie rock. Her sophomore EP, “Happiest Woman” (2023), marked a shift toward showcasing a full-band production, mirroring the force of Wilby’s live sound. Wilby’s debut album, “Center of Affection” (2025, via Hit the North Records), explores both the cathartic side of indie-rock and the vulnerable side of twangy folk. Wilby has been featured in FLOOD Magazine, Luna Collective, and Ones To Watch, named an Artist to Watch by Atwood Magazine, with support from Seattle’s KEXP and Nashville’s WNXP and Lightning 100.

events.title: Babatunde Hip Hopera
events.description:
Babatunde Akinboboye is an internationally celebrated Nigerian-American baritone and the pioneering force behind Hip Hopera—a bold, genre-defying fusion of classical opera and hip-hop. With a powerful operatic voice and magnetic stage presence, Babatunde merges centuries-old vocal mastery with the cultural pulse of modern Black music, creating a sound that is as revolutionary as it is resonant.
Born of Nigerian descent and classically trained in Western opera, Babatunde’s unique cultural and musical background fuels his mission to make opera more accessible and culturally relevant. His breakout moment came in 2018 when he went viral for blending Rossini’s Largo al Factotum with Kendrick Lamar’s HUMBLE—a performance that amassed over 10 million views and earned global media coverage from TIME, MSN, and Classic FM.

Since then, Babatunde has refined Hip Hopera into a distinct artistic movement, captivating audiences across the world through both digital platforms and live performance. With a loyal global following in the millions, he has become a cultural influencer who is using his voice—literally and figuratively—to expand the boundaries of what opera can be.
His classical résumé is just as compelling. He has performed lead roles with renowned companies such as Los Angeles Opera, Detroit Opera, and Utah Opera, including standout performances in The Central Park Five, Carmen, and Faust. A passionate advocate for African and African American composers, Babatunde brings visibility and vitality to voices often excluded from the classical canon.

Following his successful City Winery tour, Babatunde is preparing to release his debut studio album and headline an international tour in  2026—a showcase of how Hip Hopera continues to evolve as both an art form and a cultural bridge.

events.title: CHAOS WITH CHELSEA PERETTI, NATASHA LEGGERO, AND SABRINA JALEES
events.description: Darkness and chaos abound. Come blow like a leaf through these wild winds and hyper-fixate on said chaos with Chelsea Peretti, Natasha Leggero, and Sabrina Jalees. Show includes a cold-read of a scene written specifically for this show, and beautiful, au courant stand-up.

events.title: Julie Nolen
events.description:
Julie Nolen is a Texas-based singer-songwriter whose music blends raw storytelling with the grit of rock & roll. Born under the wide-open skies of West Texas, her songs carry the dust of desert highways and the resilience of those who call them home. A proud voice in queer country, Julie brings authenticity to a genre rooted in tradition, proving that country music is for everyone.

In 2025, she was an official SXSW artist, showcasing her dynamic live performance. Now, she’s rolling out a five-song project leading up to a full EP drop in time for AmericanaFest in September. The lead single, “Love Me When I’m Leaving,” sets the tone for a collection of songs that explore the beauty and heartbreak of moving on.

Whether playing an intimate acoustic set or leading a full band, Julie delivers music that’s as honest as it is powerful. 

Little bit moody, little bit soulful country, a little in your face, unapologetic, bold.

events.title: KUOKO
events.description: KUOKO is an artist from Hamburg, Germany, known for her unmistakable voice and pop music shaped by her own electronic production. With millions of streams to her name, she brings brand new music to SXSW- expect a live set made to both dance and drift.

events.title: Lucky
events.description:
Growing up in Staghorn Flat, Victoria, Lucky burst onto the scene in flurry of fuzzy guitars
and captivating storytelling. Blending the raw energy of alternative rock, with the dreamy
haze of modern indie, her music captures the nuances of life's everyday moments and
dives deep, putting you right at the centre of her world.

Having supported the likes of The Belair Lip Bombs, Hockey Dad, Armlock and Dear
Seattle, the Melbourne based artist is set for an exciting 2026 - following the release of
her single ‘Lady Beetle’, Lucky is building a devoted audience who are eagerly waiting to
see what’s in store next.

events.title: Panic Shack
events.description:
If there's one thing Panic Shack know, it's how to have a good time. Comprised of Sarah, Meg, Romi, Em and Nick, the band formed in 2018 as a middle-finger to the “members-only club” atmosphere of indie and punk scenes – not just because they’re male-dominated, but because they make playing music seem out of reach or, even worse, boring.
 
This carefree approach gives Panic Shack’s music the same effect as popping a bottle of Prosecco – explosive, intoxicating, and delightfully chaotic. With barely any music available online, they built a word-of-mouth following off the back of their live shows, which have been praised for fusing “thrashy early LA-style punk with choreography that owes something to the Go-Go’s and Iron Maiden all at once” (The Guardian).Released in 2022, their acclaimed Baby Shack EP bottled the lightning they have on stage, cementing their ability to blend killer hooks with a contagious sense of humour.

Released in July 2025, Panic Shack’s self-titled debut album represents a serious level up. It finds the band expanding their gutsy punk sound into fuller territory, packed with vocal harmonies, synths and electronic experimentation.

events.title: Rampage Sound
events.venue: British Music Embassy @ Palm Door on Sixth

events.title: WifeKnife
events.description: Somewhere among Brooklyn’s slurry of slayers, WifeKnife emerged in the spring of 2022. Sarah Hamilton’s vocals cradle then convulse the crowd, her lyrics poetic and evocative. This combined with sludgy metal/grunge-influenced riffs and hard-hitting yet danceable drum beats, makes for an experience and sound that melts faces and defies expectations.

events.title: Grrrl Gang
events.description: Hailing from the cultural city of Yogyakarta, Indonesia, Grrrl Gang is a rising force in the independent music scene with their infectious melodies, anthemic songs, and electrifying live performances. The power trio, composed of Angeeta Sentana on guitar and vocals, Akbar Rumandung on bass, and Edo Alventa on guitar, has been making waves in the Southeast Asian music scene since their formation in 2016. Grrrl Gang's music is a celebration of their collective roots and a testament to the power of pop music to connect people across cultures and borders. Their lyrics touch on themes such as feminism, mental health, and relationships with a raw honesty that speaks to a generation of young listeners. With their infectious energy, socially conscious lyrics, and unique sound, Grrrl Gang is poised to take the global music scene by storm and become a voice for a new generation. Their full-length debut album, Spunky! is the sound of a band not content to rest on its laurels, despite gathering an impressive list of achievements since Grrrl Gang first got together in 2016 and proceeded to take the local, regional, and international indie scenes by storm.

events.title: Camille Schmidt
events.description:
Camille Schmidt is a Brooklyn-based songwriter who writes with the kind of emotional clarity most people spend their lives avoiding. Her songs are known for their near mythic ability to turn confession into something communal. 

With her debut album Nude #9 (2025), Schmidt renders revealing portraits of herself, friends, exes (all real names used), and strangers encountered in passing: a rambling OBGYN, a woman reading breakup texts on a plane, a Reiki healer who ends a session early after claiming Schmidt’s blue aura is overwhelming. Schmidt reminds us here that she is, at her core, a storyteller. 

Sonically, Nude #9 abandons allegiance to genre. Moving beyond the folk-rooted approach of Good Person, Schmidt folds synthesizers, sequencers, and post-punk rhythms into her writing. The album appeared on multiple Best Albums of 2025 lists, with critics describing Schmidt as one of indie music’s “most important rising voices.” The cult-like devotion forming around her work has become a defining part of her momentum, increasingly evident in the way her songs translate from record to room. Schmidt is now at work on new music.

events.title: American Dollhouse
events.description: A woman inherits her childhood home, seeking solace from a chaotic city life marked by addiction and debt. Unbeknownst to her, a psychotic neighbor becomes disturbingly obsessed with her due to a haunting resemblance to the neighbor’s deceased mother. As the fixation turns violent, her friends begin disappearing one by one, drawing her into a perverted, blood-soaked Christmas nightmare she may not survive.

events.title: The Eric Hisaw Band
events.description: The Eric Hisaw Band is a roots rock’n’roll trio based in Austin, Tx. The 2025 Flak Records release Otra Vez draws on influences ranging from John Lee Hooker, Jerry Lee Lewis & Link Wray filtered through a 1960’s Nuggets era garage rock sensibility. The bulk of the material was developed while Hisaw was laid up with a gunshot wound from a wayward bullet that entered his family’s southeast Austin home. Using small Fender amps, lots of tremolo, Silvertone & telecaster guitars, Hisaw, drummer Shawn Peters and bassist Ron McRae create a rough and tumble,  driving sound to support Hisaw’s literate tales of outsiders living on the fringes of the American dream. Since McRae’s departure to Eugene, OR, bass duties have been filled by Jimmy Pettit (of the great 80’s Joe Ely Band) who has brought his own unique raw power rock’n’roll spirit to the band’s live show. Look for lots of regional shows & new music from the band coming soon.

events.title: Hemi Hemingway
events.description: With the rock’n’roll panache of a dive bar matador and the emotional force of a knife in the guts, Hemi Hemingway makes music that thrills, spills and breaks hearts. The effortlessly slick New Zealand star has a connoisseur’s ear for the finest parts of musical history, sweeping 60s rock, 50s sheen and 80s romanticism into the present day, refurbishing and refashioning them into something new and fresh. At home in the spotlight, he’s a showman in the best troubadour traditions, but one with real depth, showcasing swagger and vulnerability in equal measure.

events.title: bloodsports
events.description:
Taking over the sweaty New York venues and curbside congregations that came to be
synonymous with the name, Bloodsports is set to release their long awaited debut LP Anything
Can Be A Hammer via brand new New York label Good English Records on October 17th.
Bloodsports has become an undeniable force amidst their latest line up, where members Sam
Murphy (guitar/vox), Jeremy Mock (Guitar), Liv Eriksen (bass/vox) and Scott Hale (drums) find
solace in the capitulation of sonic strain; where angular sedition blends with economical
melodies that lighten the load of the self-destruction that these songs embrace. But as bold as
their landscapes have been prior, Anything Can Be A Hammer finds the band embracing a more
dynamic approach, maturing in their techniques as these songs brim over with subtle fixations –
balancing a steady pace of experimentation and curiosity that linger amongst the rhythmic blows
and befuddling depths that the band confidently explores. Fragile, yet abundant, Bloodsports
leans into that patience that plays to our own interior designs, where Murphy’s lyricism is a
notion of both what we know and what we think we know, as it all comes to the fore when our
obsessions are at large. It’s an album that’s got blood in its veins and a finger on the pulse.

events.title: The Fox
events.description: Nick (Jai Courtney), affable heir to a wealthy rural landowner, discovers his fiancée, Kori (Emily Browning), is cheating on him and wants nothing more than to just fix the problem. One night, he captures a rogue Fox (Olivia Colman), and she offers him a trade-off: if Nick lets her live, the Fox will help him save his relationship. All he has to do is push Kori into a magic hole with the power to change her into the perfect partner. Nick follows the Fox’s advice and the Kori who re-emerges seems to be everything he ever wanted. Until her strange new quirks make him question his decision.

events.title: Jamie Duffy
events.description:
At just 24, Jamie Duffy has emerged as one of Ireland’s most compelling new artists, blending folk, classical, and contemporary influences into a sound that’s both intimate and cinematic. His debut single Solas became the most streamed debut by an Irish artist since Hozier’s Take Me To Church, with over 135+ million streams on Spotify, 27 million YouTube views, and 7.3 billion views on TikTok.

In 2024, he released his debut EP On A Wing, sold out his first Irish headline tour (2,600+ tickets), and supported Andrea Bocelli and Hans Zimmer at BST Hyde Park.

In October 2025, he released his highly anticipated debut album Jamie Duffy. Crafted over two years between wild coastlines and still nights across the two awe-inspiring landscapes of Ireland and Iceland, the album reflects Jamie’s rural Monaghan roots, shaped by changing environments, Irish folklore, love, light and trepidation. It is a true labour of love and effort rarely known by those in their early twenties, but for Jamie, it was a journey he’s been working towards for some time. While evident themes of nature, journey, light and hope spring forward from early listens, the messages within the album, will hopefully, be different for everyone.

Alongside the album, Jamie has scored his first feature film 500 Miles, (starring Bill Nighy and Maisie Williams) due to be released in 2026. Reuniting with his album producer Atli Örvarsson at his home studio in London, the project highlights the creative strength and synergy between the two collaborators.
