With over 2 million monthly listeners on Spotify and sold out dates across Ireland, UK and Europe, Jamie is cementing his status as a formidable and rapidly rising global artist whose music continues to resonate with a massive and expanding international audience.

events.title: Marni Ct.
events.description:
Marni carries a down-to-earth and authentic energy. The indie rock band formed in Los Angeles, California, in 2022, and consists of Nicolas Lara (vocals, guitar), and Michaela Gradstein (vocals, guitar). The project began as Lara’s solo work in Palm Springs, where he released the debut album Whiskey Girl, before evolving into a full band the following year.

Marni intertwines heavy distorted guitars with beautifully soft moments, drawing on influences such as Title Fight, Greet Death, and Hovvdy. Their newest  EP fml era (2025), produced by Corey Coffman of Gleemer, is a portrait of being down on your luck, with unpolished guitars, and emotionally direct storytelling.

events.title: Basic
events.description: After Gloria and Nick break up, Gloria takes us through Nick's dating history, untangling his web of ex-girlfriends through details she can find online. But when she discovers Kaylinn, the hottest most basic ex-girlfriend to ever exist, Gloria not only loses herself, she loses control of the story she's been telling.  Basic is a comedy that blends the magical-realism of jealous paranoia with the magic of falling in love.

events.title: CDSM
events.description: CDSM a.k.a. Celebrity Death Slot Machine is a “freakout post-punk group” (FLOOD Magazine) based in Atlanta, GA. Their stylish sonic onslaught is anchored around dancey rhythms, atypical synthesizer work, timely saxophone growls, as well as goth rock-esque melodies that serve to recount bizarre humor-laden tales from a derelict parallel universe. Since forming in 2021, the band has toured North America and Europe, sharing the stage with likes of The KVB, Bodega, Sheer Mag, Iceage, and Model/Actriz, while also taking part in events such as SXSW, Treefort Festival, Art Rock Festival, Hopscotch Festival, and M for Montreal. CDSM’s introductory EP, Hell Stairs (2022), was both glamorous and bleak, swanky and derelict, uplifting and crushing, described by the band as “hedonism clinking in your glass, change jingling in the pit of your chest.” Atlanta’s hot new commodity followed with a slew of music videos – “GOGO” (May 11th, 2023), “Entertainment” (2023), “DOM” (2023), and “SHADY” (2024) – amidst a stretch that saw them bring their sweaty live set to the very best underground venues the United States, Canada and Europe have to offer.

events.title: Crowd Control
events.description: A live stand-up show from Dropout, hosted by Jacquis Neal, where the audience is the main material.Full lineup coming soon!

events.title: Girl Tones
events.description:
Girl Tones, of planet Earth, are a high-energy rock duo brought to life by two sisters named Kenzie and Laila. Both classically trained musicians, Kenzie transitioned from cello to guitar and Laila from piano to drums in an effort to electrify sentient beings from this galaxy to the next. Their debut releases were produced by Brad Shultz of Cage The Elephant and released via his label Parallel Vision in partnership with Big Loud Rock.
Their first offerings have earned the praise of Rolling Stone, VICE, Consequence, PAPER, NME, DORK and many others with Flaunt saying, “Their sound is fluid, and yet with each release, they evolve as a harmonious group, developing their unique sound as one.”
Girl Tones has toured with Cage The Elephant across the globe, as well as The Velveteers, hey, nothing. and Silversun Pickups in North America. Making their unignorable festival debut at Lollapalooza, Shaky Knees, Austin City Limits and more, Rolling Stone said, “While the White Stripes — their most obvious comparison — were about controlled energy, Girl Tones are proudly imperfect.”
As the band jumps into 2026, they have no shortage of new music and new tour dates up their sleeves.

events.title: Joyeria
events.description:
Joyeria (pronounced Joy-ah-ree-ah) is a London-based outfit led by a Canadian-Polish songwriter who famously spent years quitting bands at their peak to keep his creative soul intact. Now a staple of London's underground scene, the group is a vehicle for "working in the dark"—a shape-shifting project that prizes sincerity over polish.

Musically, Joyeria delivers a darkly comic blend of slacker indie and experimental post-punk. Fronted by a deadpan baritone, the songs tackle the absurdity of modern adulthood, capitalism, and workday fatigue with biting, sardonic wit. Their EPs, FIM and Graceful Degradation, were produced by Dan Carey, captured raw and live-to-tape to preserve the "chaos" of the moment rather than a rehearsed demo.

While born from a singular vision, Joyeria is a formidable four-piece band. Known for being "purposely under-rehearsed," the ensemble thrives on improvisation, ensuring no two sets are the same. With a stage presence that balances Ian Curtis’s intensity with Stephen Malkmus’s irony, the band utilizes an unpredictable, dissonant energy to create a sound that is as imposing as it is eccentric.

events.title: Marley Hale
events.description: Born in Texas and raised in Northern California, Marley Hale’s musical influences followed: Texas’s deep, country and western swing roots met San Francisco’s folk and rock legends. The result: classic country tropes, turned on their heads through a switching of roles or a repossessed identity; delicate, revelatory explorations of what it means to be a friend, lover, or neither; and second person addresses to herself that offer both an onlooker’s and her own perspective. After California, Hale spent time in Austin, TX and Portland, OR before relocating to Brooklyn, NY, where she recorded her debut EP, By My Own Ways, released July 2024, and began touring the US and Canada. After spending the better part of three years on the road, she moved back home to Austin, where she now resides.

events.title: P.H.0
events.description:
P.H.0 [P-H-"zero"] is a NYC-based SILKPUNK quartet reshaping the city's underground. Fusing the raw, intense metal riffs with the haunting cry of the traditional Chinese erhu and techno-dystopian synths, they craft sounds that are at once chaotic and controlled, futuristic and ancient. Their live shows—referred to as "rituals"—transform ancient Taoist traditions into ear-crushing soundscapes that defy time, crashing into chaotic mosh pits under visceral strobing lights to create what some describe as a rave in an abandoned shrine from Cyberpunk 2077.

Their momentum has carried them from NYC festivals like New Colossus and Punk Island to sold-out shows across the East Coast, proving their reach in every environment—from the historic Gramercy Theatre, where they were handpicked by Danish prog-metal giants VOLA to support their North American tour, to inside an abandoned tunnel where they performed for more than 500 ravers. They were further recognized by NPR's Tiny Desk as a top 50 "Top Shelf" artist in 2025, and by Bandcamp Daily, who praised their debut album KARMA for “reimagining what Asian music might sound like.” P.H.0 continues to build a cult following, one ritual at a time.

events.title: Theo Lawrence
events.description:
For the past 10 years, Theo Lawrence has been making a name for himself as France's favorite songbird. A truly one-of-a-kind country singer and genuine keeper of the flame, Lawrence came into his own on his Austin-made 2023 LP release, Cherie, and on his all-acoustic album, Pickin' & Singin'. His most recent release, a duet All Fifty States (with Melissa Carper), is a playful back-and-forth about two people in love who don’t always see eye to eye. It's a perfect showcase of storytelling, connection, and the artistry Theo brings to every song.

Lawrence pens classic love songs and delivers with a croon straight out of the Charlie Rich and Ray Price golden years. In recent years, he has played a pivotal role in reviving an interest for Country Music in Europe, and with his recent move to Austin, TX, Theo Lawrence is bringing his honed craft back to its American cradle.

Newly signed to Warner Records, we expect to hear Theo's name a lot more in the coming months and years.

events.title: MORGAN
events.description:
With combined streams of over 100 million and a dedicated online following, Morgan is doing things her way. Morgan began performing at just three years old and by eighteen she’d joined Rudimental as a globally-touring vocalist. Her solo debut ‘My Year’ spotlit her brand of sparkling pop, before a collaboration with Ebenezer (‘Mulholland Drive’) earned her over 10 million streams. Her subsequent EP ‘Alien’ referenced golden-era pop. That same year, ‘ADCT’ (written when she was 17) soared to the #1 spot on both TikTok Trending Sounds and the UK Top 50, earning over 30 million streams. Morgan also co-wrote and featured on Rudimental & Digga D’s ‘Be the One’, Sigma’s ‘Adrenaline Rush’ and Purple Disco Machine's most recent album.  She’s been writing for some of the biggest K-pop artists (including NCT’s Jaehyun, TWICE & Aespa).

Morgan released her EP ‘Emotional Gangster’ last October and went on to sell out her first UK headline tour at the end of the year including a show at London’s iconic Jazz Cafe. She turned up the heat with the release of ‘One Man’ featuring the legendary Beenie Man, paired with the unapologetic anthem ‘Bad Gyal Energy’.
events.venue: British Music Embassy @ Palm Door on Sixth

events.title: Luke Tyler Shelton
events.description: Born in the new millennium, Luke Tyler Shelton makes soul-soothing rock-and-roll with all the ineffable charm of a faraway time. With a profound gift for dreaming up heavenly melodies and fantastically loose grooves, the Los Angeles native found his sound as part of a close-knit scene of young musicians and artists—a DIY-minded community whose spirit and sensibilities recall the near-mythic creative hotbed of early-’70s Laurel Canyon. Produced by Shooter Jennings (Brandi Carlile, Tanya Tucker) and Jonathan Wilson (Father John Misty, Angel Olsen), Luke’s debut body of work merges country-rock, folk-pop, and Southern soul into songs that immediately transport the audience into a state of enchanted ease.

events.title: Ceremony
events.description: When the ooligan vanishes from Bella Coola, its absence remains like a scar, pointing to a history that reaches far beyond the river. From ramshackled Nuxalk Radio, voices rise through crackling airwaves to trace the forces no one was meant to uncover. What begins as a local broadcast becomes an awakening as testimony, watercolour animation and rare archival weave a story of survival, return and the quiet revolution of an Indigenous Nation that refuses to disappear.

events.title: Rosa Anschuetz
events.description: Rosa Anschütz is a musician and sound artist whose practice merges composition, installation, and performance. Her sound blends the dark ambience of post-punk and cold wave with ethereal polyphony and synth-driven melodies. She has released three LPs: Votive (2020), accompanied by nine clay sculptures inspired by votive offerings; Goldener Strom (2022), which was staged at the Deutsche Oper Berlin; and Interior (2024), featuring nine tracks, each accompanied by a sequined landscape hand-stitched by Anschütz. Her new album, Sabbatical, was released on September 26, 2025, on Heartworm Press, US.

events.title: Graham Reynolds
events.description: Called “the quintessential modern composer” by the ​London Independent​, Austin-based  composer-bandleader-improviser Graham Reynolds records and performs music for film, theater, dance, rock clubs, and concert halls. He recently scored Richard Linklater’s He recently scored Richard Linklater’s Blue Moon (Sony) with Ethan Hawke and Margaret Qualley, Hit Man (Netflix), Happy Jail (Netflix), Stop Hitting Yourself (Lincoln Center Theater), Out of Her Mind (BBC), Grimm Tales (Ballet Austin), and a multi-year commission from Ballroom Marfa, The Marfa Triptych, culminating in his Creative Capital Award winning project Pancho Villa from a Safe Distance. Amidst his many other projects, Graham also serves as the Artistic Director of the new music focused non-profit Golden Hornet. In 2020, Graham signed with London-based record label Fire Records and released his original score for Alfred Hitchcock’s silent classic, The Lodger. His most recent release with Fire, Mountain (March 2025), is a full-length solo album that draws from the full breadth of his musical career.

events.title: Jamie Dred
events.description:
Jamie Dred is a UK-born DJ and event producer of Jamaican descent, based in Austin, Texas, for over 10 years.
The son of legendary sound system selector Lippy and Greensleeves artist Princess Black (of Capital Letters), reggae has been the foundation of his musical upbringing from day one.
Raised in England through the '90s and 2000s, he was shaped by the UK's dynamic music scene. After running a successful record label and managing multiple artists and producers in the UK, he relocated to Austin to DJ, produce events, and build community.
He produces and manages events with AllTheVibesEnt., where you can expect Soca, Reggae, Dancehall, Amapiano, Drill, Grime, Hip-Hop, Afrobeats, and beyond. He also creates learning opportunities through Dub Academy.
Jamie holds a residency at Soho House Austin and has played everywhere from London (Carnival) to One Fest (Canouan) and Salibou Fest (The Gambia), plus Miami, New York, Denver, Vegas, Oakland, and more.
events.venue: British Music Embassy @ Palm Door on Sixth Patio

events.title: Victoryland
events.description:
Victoryland is the Brooklyn-based project of musician Julian McCamman. His label-debut, My Heart Is A Room With No Cameras In It, out January 23, 2026 via Good English, is a triumphant, despondent, and ultimately fun experimental pop-rock album. Victoryland started in Philly 2023 with the release of tape, Sprain, which echoed more of what the Philly scene was dishing out: lo-fi, tape-recorded rock with a capital R. It was the collaborative efforts of producer Dan Howard that brought the new vision and sound into full focus.Dan and Julian previously worked on Julian’s now-defunct Texas-to-Philly based band, Blood’s Loving You Backwards LP, a collaborative effort between six bandmates. That experience pushed Julian toward a more personal process of recording, starting with home demos and then bringing them to Dan to shape into songs. This relationship ultimately led Julian to move to NYC.

The sound of the album, recorded between Julian’s Bed Stuy basement and Dan’s Williamsburg studio, is the sound of a bright and beaming collaboration. Landing somewhere between lo-fi and hi-fi production, the songs have the glossiness of a radio-friendly hit mixed with the distortion and rough edges of a home demo. Every song keeps at least one element of the initial recording, while building around the loops and half-songs Julian scrapped together. The lyrics on the record span from humorous self-aware popisms (“‘you and I’ will soon be, used to be ‘us’”) to crushing realities of bitterness(“i’ll never forgive you, that’s how I keep you close”) to abstract imagery (“mothers wave from doorways, in ostinato”), all delivered with such an immediacy and fervor that in the middle of singing along, you wonder if this guy slept much last night. 

My Heart wrangles with heavy subject matter (love, disconnection, sexual frustration, emptiness etc.), but the terminal statement of the record is about the cleansing nature of pop music. That, if a song can force you to “bliss out” over a hook or a loop, or even make you dance, it can be the spoonful of sugar to swallow the hard pill with; this is what Victoryland strives to do: package the most exhausting realities of life, love, and the search for connection in a world starved of it, into a fun 2-5 minutes, and for the runtime of Victoryland’s first major statement, you might even feel like you’re not alone.

events.title: Big Zeeks
events.description:
Hailing from the heart of Harlesden, North West London,
“The Fresh Prince of
Harlesden” aka “BIG ZEEKS” is an independent, universal dancehall lyrists, who
is an undisputed, talented artist, who consistently sets the bar high with
continuous growth and versatility.
Firmly cementing his place as a pivotal figure within UK dancehall music with
hits: #Happy, YO, It’s a lot of money, BIG ZEEKS has built much of his notoriety
by building a cult following, bridging the gap between UK Rap and Jamaican
Dancehall merged to create a sub-genre: UK Dancehall.
BIG ZEEKS has gained much of his notoriety by building a sound reputation
working with some of the most critically acclaimed artists such as Dexta Daps,
Chronic Law, Spice, Shensea, Kranium and WSTRN
His roaring talent has allowed him to sell out his own headline shows, toured
the world as a supporting act globally, and had the amazing opportunity of
performing at various international festivals including the reknowned
infamous Glastonbury, City Splash+ more. Not only is Big Zeeks
building an organic following, he has managed to accumulate over 5,000,000
streams on Spotify alone with the continuity of numbers rising daily.
events.venue: British Music Embassy @ Palm Door on Sixth

events.title: Chili Finger
events.description: When Jessica Lipki discovers a severed human finger in her bowl of chili, she recognizes an opportunity to seize control of her stagnating life. Jess blackmails the regionally-beloved fast-food chain for $100,000 in return that she and her blissfully ignorant husband, Ron, keep quiet about the incident. Unbeknownst to Jess, her stunt has caught the attention of "the" Blake Junior, the plutocratic founder behind the "Blake Junior’s" food empire. He recruits his ex-marine buddy, Dave, to investigate Jess and discover the truth behind the chili finger...

events.title: Deloyd Elze
events.description: Deloyd Elze, aka Jacob Henry Allen, is a genre-blending artist and poet from Jacksonville, Florida, whose music fuses traditional American songwriting with experimental and electronic textures. Over the past decade, Deloyd has tinkered with soundscapes that meld twangy guitars, lo-fi drums, dissonant synths and rich acoustic textures into ‘digital twang,’ a sound that seamlessly weaves between country, indie and electronic. The name Deloyd Elze honors his great-grandfather, a resilient man whose legacy of grit and defiance inspires his artistry. Like his namesake, Deloyd’s music is rooted in authenticity, reflecting the complexities of the human experience. Now based in Los Angeles, he’s creating music that speaks to life’s many layers, drawing from his family’s history and his own journey of self-discovery and survival.

events.title: Sex Mask
events.description: Experiencing Sex Mask live is all gas, no brakes. The band’s artsy, electric fusion of proto-post-punk and writhing no-wave cool leaves little room for breathing space – and not least of all because shirtless frontman Wry Gray will often find himself directly within the immediate peripheral of anyone close to the front.

events.title: The Way We Move
events.description: THE WAY WE MOVE is a feature-length documentary about Amber Galloway, a star ASL (American Sign Language) interpreter who specializes in live music interpretations. Amber teaches her art to share her life’s mission : making music accessible to the Deaf community. Armed with her astounding teaching skills, she will take her struggling new recruits on a one-of-a-kind journey, hoping they have what it takes to join her at Austin City Limits music festival. As the film unfolds, we learn about Amber’s painful past and about the lives of her recruits, Julian Ortiz and Angela "AV" Vilavong, as they come together and forge life-long bonds. A film about music, Deaf culture, connection and resilience.

events.title: Les Itinérantes
events.description:
One of France’s most distinctive a cappella acts, Les Itinérantes turn three voices into an immersive, ritual-like live experience.

Les Itinérantes (french for "The Wanderers") are one of France’s most acclaimed a cappella trios, recognized for transforming vocal performance into a powerful live experience. Founded in Paris in 2017, the group was born from a chance encounter and a shared desire to explore the voice beyond established genres.

Without instruments, they approach singing as a living, embodied material - a space of memory, transmission, and human connection. Their repertoire spans over nine centuries of music and more than fifty languages, blending ancient and traditional songs with original compositions. This diversity is not encyclopedic, but intentional: a search for what unites people across time, cultures, and borders.

Praised by the French press for the ritual, purity, and emotional depth of their performances, Les Itinérantes are known for rare vocal precision and a strong sense of presence. Their concerts are intimate and immersive, offering audiences a focused, shared experience of listening.

events.title: Swapmeet
events.description:
Swapmeet are an Adelaide/Kaurna Country based four piece who are set to release their debut album in 2026. With indie rock foundations, characterised by sonic experimentation, and a punk spirit, Swapmeet are known in the local and international circuit for their playful, chaotic onstage presence.

After a successful showcasing debut at BIGSOUND 2024 - the band returned home for the South Australian Music Awards where Swapmeet were awarded "Best Release" for their debut EP "Oxalis" and "Best Song" for fan favourite "Ceiling Fan".

2025 saw the band tour nationally with The Murder Capital and support Suki Waterhouse at PICA. In between sold out debut headline shows - Swapmeet showcased at SXSW Sydney 2025 and left having been awarded with "Best Emerging Artist". Swapmeet will be backing this up at SXSW Texas - making this the bands international live debut.

events.title: Buzz Screening 1
events.description: A film that everyone is talking about, and audiences need another chance to see it.

events.title: Buzz Screening 7
events.description: A film that everyone is talking about, and audiences need another chance to see it.

events.title: Narrative Short Program 1
events.description: Exceptional storytelling that captivates, surprises, and excites.
events.venue: Rollins Theatre at the Long Center

events.title: Never After Dark
events.description: A wandering medium, Airi spends her life guiding restless spirits out of the world of the living. Summoned to an isolated country house, she comes face to face with a grotesque apparition with powers that defy Airi’s experience. As she digs deeper into the house’s past, a secret comes to light — and Airi finds herself hunted by a far more unpredictable force. For the first time, her greatest adversary is not the supernatural, but the living.

events.title: Alien Chicks
events.description:
Alien Chicks are a trio hailing from the streets of South London, known for their electrifying blend of punk, rap and jazz. They create a sound that is raw and innovative, capturing the spirit of London's underground music culture. The line-up features the vocals and sharp guitar work of Josef Lindsay, the pulsating basslines of Stefan Parker-Steele and the explosive drumming of Martha Daniels. Whether delivering rapid-fire rap verses, intricate jazz-inspired bass riffs, or thunderous punk rhythms, Alien Chicks continue to push boundaries and defy expectations, drawing praise from The Independent, NME, Rolling Stone, and Radio 1.

The band’s journey began in grassroots venues across the city, in particular The Windmill, Brixton, where their high-energy performances and unique sound helped them build a loyal following. With huge momentum following their biggest London headliner yet at The Garage, following a sold out Oslo Hackney, four iconic sets at The Great Escape, 2000 Trees and Glastonbury. They have also toured with English Teacher, Lambrini Girls, The Libertines and Big Special.

Alien Chicks' music is a testament to their diverse influences and fearless approach to genre.

events.title: Angela Autumn
events.description: Angela Autumn is a songwriter and banjo player from a forgotten steel town. Strongly tied to the buried stories of her childhood, her dark country songs reinvent folk tradition through the lens of eco-feminist transcendentalism. The singer’s straightforward lack of pretension speaks from the vantage point of the outsider— and, often — the sounds of the unspoken.

events.title: Bubba Lucky
events.description: Bubba Lucky is a project created by Taylor Lumpkin initially performing solo with a drum machine, now the band has six members, including members from Gus Baldwin, and the sketch, whisper, commercial breaks, and late wife. Taylor Lumpkin is originally from Louisiana but has spent over a decade Participating in the Austin music scene.

events.title: Buddy
events.description: A brave girl and her friends must escape a kids television show.

events.title: haha Laughing
events.description: haha Laughing is an Austin-based experimental noise rap project consisting of long-time local musicians Jay Dilick and Aby Oviedo. The duo blends elements of hardcore rap, free-jazz, distorted electronic music and punk energy into 3 minute explosions of catchy catharsis. The chaos they curate is driven home through their live shows where Dilick and Oviedo's back and forth vocals, noise breakdowns, sample flips, and sense of playfulness create a must see live performance that is energetically engaging and delightfully disorienting. haha Laughing has released multiple EP's and singles since 2021, and released their first album "LOSING TEETH DREAM" in May of 2025. Their follow up EP "BIG WHATEVER" is set to be released Spring 2026. haha Live. haha Laugh. haha Love.

events.title: Little Wilderness
events.description:
Little Wilderness is a dynamic, homegrown rock band that draws inspiration from the rugged landscape of Southwest Colorado, blending the raw energy of rock 'n roll with the unique environmental influences of the Four Corners region. Formed in 2011, the band has become a key player in Durango's music scene, with a lineup that includes Paul Henderson (guitar/singer), Dan Szabo (lead guitar), Juan Lopez (bass), and David Sachs (drums).

Their debut album, Big Tent (2019), released on Flak Records out of Austin, Texas, encapsulates their diverse sound. The album's opening track, “Crazy World,” is a high-octane composition that sets the tone with its fiery guitar riffs and driving rhythm. Other songs, like “Narrow Gauge,” incorporate elements of country and Americana, while tracks like “Laid Low” and “Starting New” showcase their indie rock sensibilities. The band’s style evokes the spirit of an era when garage bands ruled the airwaves, characterized by loud amps and hard-hitting drums.
With their blend of gritty rock 'n roll and Southwestern flavor, Little Wilderness proves that the genre is alive and well, and they’re here to keep it that way.

events.title: Montclair
events.description: Montclair is the Austin, Texas-based, independent folk-rock project resulting from four friends’ expression of joy and curiosity for life. Montclair's sound explores themes of self-discovery and emerging adulthood, from the beloved surf rock groove of “Pastel Lies” to the forlorn folk guitar wave in “Passing Through”. Their debut album, “Heart is Alive!” explores their musical potential and emotional range, both on full display in the first two singles, the titular and upbeat “Heart is Alive!” and the enigmatic rock powerhouse “Coming to the Rescue”. With a dynamic range of music, Montclair’s live performances are energetic and engaging, and they are known to have a strong crowd pull in Texas. Montclair has been invited to play onstage to crowds at festivals and iconic Texas venues such as House of Blues Houston, and a sold-out Antone's Nightclub, with nationally touring acts like Echosmith, The Brook and The Bluff, Dayglow, Giant Rooks, The Wldlfe, Briscoe, and many more. They look forward to the release of their debut album and the adventures and inspirations that await them ahead.

events.title: Perfect
events.description: In a world devastated by a contaminated water supply, Kai, a lost soul, finds herself living out of her car after a bad breakup. Each day is a struggle until fate intervenes and leads her to a hidden utopian lake, where the water is pure and life flourishes. At this secret haven, Kai encounters a band of eccentric misfits each with their own stories of loss and hope. Among them is Mallory, an enigmatic and wealthy pregnant woman living out an escapist fantasy. Despite their vastly different backgrounds, Kai and Mallory are drawn to each other, and a sudden, passionate romance ignites. As their bond deepens, Kai begins to uncover the layers of Mallory’s life and the secrets she harbors.

events.title: Phoenix Jones: The Rise and Fall of a Real Life Superhero
events.description: In 2010, reports began surfacing of a masked vigilante in a black-and-gold supersuit stopping crime on the streets of Seattle. His name is Phoenix Jones. Armed with pepper spray, a taser, and a team of costumed crime fighters, he quickly becomes an international media sensation. But when his true identity is exposed by the Seattle Police, the heroic image begins to unravel and his team abandons him. Ten years later, as protesters seize six blocks of Seattle and declare a no cop zone, Phoenix reemerges amid legal trouble and public skepticism. Is he a hero, or a con-artist hiding behind a mask?

events.title: SXSW Comedy Presents
events.description: Catch the best of the fest on one stage. SXSW Comedy brings you a curated powerhouse lineup featuring iconic voices and the must-see breakout performers you’ll be bragging about discovering first. Lineup coming soon!

events.title: Two-Man Giant Squid
events.description: A post-punk project out of Brooklyn NY, Two-Man Giant Squid has earned acclaim in the New York City underground for their ability to fuse dance-punk, garage, and psych influences into fierce live shows and ambitious recordings (KEXP, SPIN). They lean on an eclectic mix to produce their sound including matter-of-fact vocal delivery, intricate synth design, and lately- a theremin. Their most recent LP was unveiled at last year’s SXSW festival and later charted at #89 on National Indie Radio charts. With a slate of releases & tours planned for 2026, Two-Man Giant Squid brings their signature creativity and DIY spirit to the forefront of the post-punk revival.

events.title: Unsafe Space Garden
events.description:
Unsafe Space Garden is a genre-bending outfit from Portugal known for their chaotic, theatrical and deeply immersive live shows. With a sound rooted in neo-psychedelia, experimental rock and a touch of surreal humour, the band pushes musical boundaries with fearless creativity and a clear artistic vision.

Described by European press as “a surrealist orchestra,” their concerts often blur the line between performance and ritual - unpredictable, cathartic and strangely uplifting. Their critically acclaimed albums Bro, You Got Something In Your Eye – A Guided Meditation (2021) and Where’s The Ground? (2023) draw comparisons to artists like Frank Zappa, Captain Beefheart or The Flaming Lips, while forging a language uniquely their own.

More than just experimentalists, Unsafe Space Garden are storytellers - unpredictable, emotional and sonically adventurous. A live act designed to be seen, heard, and remembered.

events.title: See You When I See You
events.description: With the help of his family, a comedy writer battles PTSD after the tragic death of his sister.

events.title: Trophy Wife
events.description: Trophy Wife is unapologetic. Based in Brooklyn, this trio bares all through a hazy, distorted lens. With the 2024 release of their debut album Get Ugly, McKenzie Iazzetta’s confessional lyrics, Christian Pace’s riff-like bass lines, and Michael Martelli’s pounding drums transform raw diary entries into cathartic anthems for the parts of ourselves that are best swept under the rug.

events.title: Shallowater
events.description: Born where the dust bowl never died. Raw West Texas dirtgaze.

events.title: Daniel Fears
events.description:
Singer, songwriter, and multi-instrumentalist Daniel Fears knows that music is more than just sound. It’s a journey, capable of taking us to places we’ve never been or bringing us closer to who we really are. With every note, every chord, every lyric, Daniel strives to create something that feels authentic and grounded.
Since his debut in 2020, he’s been nominated for “Best R&B” at the Austin Music Awards, opened for internationally-touring artists like Mac Ayres and BLK ODYSSY, had his music featured in an NAACP Image Award-nominated short film, and toured with Latin Grammy Nominee Gina Chavez for the American Music Abroad program. 

His latest release, a fully-orchestrated live EP “Close To Home”, is available on all streaming services.

events.title: Modeselektor
events.description:
Gernot Bronsert and Sebastian Szary hardly need an introduction. Since the early 2000s, the East Berlin duo has evolved from local techno innovators into a globally established force. Along the way they founded Monkeytown Records, a creative hub that now spans their own releases and an eclectic roster of artists across genres.

Friendship, openness and an unshakable curiosity have always defined MODESELEKTOR. Their sound has never stayed in one lane, diving headfirst into IDM, hip hop, UK bass, breaks, house and ambient. Collaboration has been equally essential. Their albums and live shows have featured artists like Thom Yorke, Tommy Cash, Flohio, Siriusmo, Blixa Bargeld, Iggor Cavalera, Catnapp, Otto Von Schirach, Paul St. Hilaire, Omar Souleyman, Anti Pop Consortium, Miss Platnum and many more. Bronsert and Szary have always created as one, rarely working separately.
Their work with Sascha Ring, aka Apparat, as Moderat opened an entirely new chapter, leading to sold-out tours and arena shows. When Apparat returned to his solo work, MODESELEKTOR took a needed break, retreating to the studio with renewed purpose.

events.title: SUUVI
events.description:
SUUVI is a Cuban-Chinese composer, producer, and multidisciplinary artist whose roots in electronic cello-driven performance inform a bold, genre-fluid sonic vision. After 15+ years appearing internationally as a classical soloist in venues such as Carnegie Hall, La Fondation Louis Vuitton, and the Berlin Philharmonie - and touring as the solo cellist in Hans Zimmer’s live show - she expanded beyond the stage, blending cello, electronics, and storytelling to craft immersive works that reflect her multicultural background and social-impact mission. She has composed and produced original music for theater, dance, and film/TV, working across genres from contemporary classical to electronic, hip-hop, and pop, with artists like D-Smoke, Teyana Taylor, FAVE and many more - earning recognition for her boundary-pushing artistry and emotional depth.

Her debut album, Dark Therapy, pushes post-classical music into avant-garde electronic and cinematic realms, inviting listeners into a space of introspection, healing, and sensory immersion.

events.title: AKA BK
events.description:
AKA BK is an alternative indie project based in Los Angeles. With influences from bands like The Pixies, The Yeah Yeah Yeahs, and the Breeders, their live show plays like nerves exposed: charged, joyful and disarmingly human, turning their vulnerability into sharpened momentum. The band closes the distance between their fans, both literally and figuratively, inviting them to join in on their tongue-in-cheek moments of mushy playfulness and feverish moshing. 

The foundation of AKA BK is built on long standing friendships, with BK (lead vocals) and Cecile Herledan (bassist) forming their first band at the age of 11 in Metro Detroit. The band is rounded out by fellow guitarists Julian Cullars and Sean Gunner Lee, who have been playing in LA bands since 2013.

events.title: Special Guest
events.venue: British Music Embassy @ Palm Door on Sixth Patio

events.title: mer marcum
events.description:
Waco, Texas-born, now Brooklyn-based alt-folk indie artist and producer Meredith (mer) Marcum has emerged into the New York City scene. Trading her small-town roots for Brooklyn’s bustling music scene, mer set out to carve her niche and make authentic art in many forms, which comes through in her singular and introspective music characterized by evocative, lyrical intimacy underscored by fresh production. 

mer marcum is currently gearing up to release her debut EP, You Never Did Anything Wrong, on May 1, which kicked off with the single, “Body (ft. Jia*),” earlier this year, and amassed over 250k streams in the first month. Last year, she supported Hollis Howard, Hudson Freeman, and Deloyd Elze. Most recently, she opened for Devon Again’s sold-out NYC show and will be opening for Darryl Rahn in March.

She has recieved acclaim from the likes of NPR All Songs Considered, Ones To Watch, Wonderland, Line of Best Fit, BBC Radio 6, and many more.

events.title: 2charm
events.description:
2charm☆ blends indie house heaven pop techno dubstep baile to make magic ☆
Sticky and playful vocal hooks abound, pairing beatific production with beautiful vocal melodies, delivering something that’s equal parts ecstasy and transcendence. 2charm’s music could be likened to the sparkle that bounces off sheened cheeks under dingy club lights, in the same way the Balearic sea shines in July ☆

events.title: Home Counties
events.description: Home Counties return with their second album 'Humdrum', a sharp, dance-driven evolution produced by Al Doyle of LCD Soundsystem and Hot Chip. Trading guitars for restless grooves and twitchy synths, the band dissect the chaos of modern life with wit and precision. Dual vocalists Will Harrison and Lois Kelly explore jealousy, self-doubt and overthinking across ten hook-laden tracks that balance melancholy and euphoria. Already acclaimed for their electrifying live shows, Humdrum cements Home Counties as one of the UK’s most inventive new bands.

events.title: Joudy
events.description:
"Pain is a fine knife sharpened by love." So says Joudy frontman Diego Ramirez when reflecting on the NYC group's latest endeavors. This emotional clarity and exposed honesty is a hallmark of the band's most vital, intense era yet. Set aside are the evocative lyrics and lush soundscapes of their earlier releases. In their place, lyrical and sonic directness is embraced on the unvarnished and love-torn upcoming album Permanent Maintenance (out DATE on Trash Casual). This is a record that distills Joudy's soaring rock into something simply shorter, louder, and stronger.

For the trio, rounded out by fellow Venezuelan emigres Hulrich Navas (drums) and Carlos Rey (bass), this streamlining is just another natural step forward as they uncompromisingly blaze a trail amongst life's shadowy moments.

Joudy have always tried to make sense of "this messy universe". While the wide angle lens fantasies of recent albums, Obertura and Destroy All Monsters, sought to do that through grand expositions, Permanent Maintenance brings it down to the most acute of human experiences: to love and to lose. While these are deeply personal songs, they are universal.

events.title: Kali Horse
events.description: The experimental art-rock collab of multi-instrumentalist creators Sam Maloney and Desiree Das Gupta, Kali Horse blends fantasy and harsh realism, colliding genres with reckless abandon. Production that dips between the best of alt-rock and avante-pop spheres, Kali Horse is a celebration of intentional genrelessness.  Digital and live drums under emotional harmonies, swimming guitar enveloped by foley samples make the live band ripple with eccentricity. Their avante-pop whimsicality channels Björk, their soaring anthemic moments reflect their rock roots. The combo of Sam's feathery vocal and Des' powerhouse belt has their voices in conversation with one another - a hypnotic connection. The debut record 'Some Type of Electric Lagoon' (2023) is a vibrant metaphorical swamp journey, an opus. The new EP '2099' veers into industrial soundscapes - a bold snap back to reality. More bite and grit, with a higher polish than ever thanks to Emmy-winning foley artist Brandon Bak (Possum, OOZ). The live act lit up festivals like NYC’s New Colossus and Ontario's River & Sky, opening for and somehow making sense with SUUNS and Ruby Waters alike. Hypnotic. Psychedelic electronic. artrockbeats.

events.title: SXSW Comedy Presents
events.description: Catch the best of the fest on one stage. SXSW Comedy brings you a curated powerhouse lineup featuring iconic voices and the must-see breakout performers you’ll be bragging about discovering first. Lineup coming soon!

events.title: Cashier
events.description: On their debut EP ‘The Weight,’ the Lafayette, Louisiana, four-piece reaches full definition, distilling themes of desire, insecurity, and disconnection into five tightly wound, melody-driven songs released by Julia’s War Recordings, the legendary Philly label founded by Doug Dulgarian of TAGABOW. Across the EP, bandleader Kylie Gaspard’s deeply direct vocal delivery cuts through dense riffs, grounding their songs with her gritty, emotional lyrics. Having recently shared stages with genre titans like Dinosaur Jr., Whirr, Nothing, and Narrow Head, Cashier are building a reputation for a massive sound that resonates far beyond their bayou home.

events.title: Hania Derej
events.description:
Hania Derej (20) - composer, pianist, arranger and conductor. Student of the Conservatorium van Amsterdam (jazz composition and arrangement) and the Music Academy in Kraków (symphonic conducting). Author of over 130 compositions she creates music in a variety of styles, including illustrative, jazz, chamber, film or electronic music. She has won multiple composition and performance awards including the Grand Prix of Energa Ladies Jazz Festival in Gdynia, Main Prize in “Sanki” 2025, music contest of “Gazeta Wyborcza” newspaper (the new hope of the polish music scene), the Main Prize of the first “Jazz Talents” competition within the 21st edition of Jazz Spring Zakopane 2025, Triton Award for the greatest artistic personality of the 54 th edition of FAMA Festival 2024 in Świnoujście, a special award for compositions and arrangements at the Junior Jazz Festival 2023 in Wadowice, and the “Young Composer 2023” award funded by the Polish Composers’ Union in Warsaw during the International Piano Forum in Sanok. Within this Piano Forum, Hania also received piano awards, such as a distinction for the performance of a concert with the National Polish Philharmonic Chamber Orchestra and a concert with the Lviv Chamber Orchestra “Academy.” 
As a conductor, Hania has had the opportunity to lead concerts with the National Philharmonic Chamber Orchestra (Poland), Elblag Chamber Orchestra (Poland), Lviv Chamber Orchestra “Akademia” (Ukraine) and the Moravian Philharmonic Symphony Orchestra (Czech Republic), among others. Hania also participates in international music projects and conferences in Europe, such as European FAMES Orchestra (Macedonia), The Playground Residence (Germany, The Netherlands), International Sync Camp (Poland), International Jazz Platform (The Netherlands, Norway, Poland), Music Export Academy in Poland, Global Conservatory and Eastern European Music Export Academy (Ukraine), “Iceland Airways networking mission”, ESNS Showcase Festival & Conference networking mission (The Netherlands) and Jazzahead 2025 (Germany). Last but not least - in the JAZZTOP 2024 music critics’ survey of the international magazine JAZZFORUM, Hania Derej won the “New Hope” award for her solo work and came 5th in the “New Hope - Ensemble” category (for her work as Hania Derej Quintet). In April 2025, Hania was awarded a distinction in the nationwide “Young Promoter of Poland” Contest, under the Honorary Patronage of the Wife of the President of the Republic of Poland, for young Poles whose activities contribute to the popularization of knowledge about Poland and building a positive image of Poland in the world.

events.title: Kofi Stone
events.venue: British Music Embassy @ Palm Door on Sixth Patio

events.title: Fine
events.description:
Fine is a Copenhagen-based singer-songwriter and producer whose music blends samples, acoustic and electric instruments into a groovy and ethereal crossover sound, both familiar and dreamlike.

Her debut album, Rocky Top Ballads (2024), turns experiments into songs by cutting and layering band improvisations. Bringing them together with melodies and voice. The album features loose-wristed-head-bobbing drums, a wide range of guitar sounds, bass riffs, reverb-soaked atmospheres, and real sound recordings — all woven together with Fine's distinctive voice and lyrics.

Live, Fine reshapes her hypnotic sound together with her band: Lola Hammerich on guitar (Baby in Vain), Andreas Murga on bass (Gorgeous), and Mads Muurholm on drums.

Starting early, Fine began her career over a decade ago with the Danish electronic trio Chinah, releasing three albums. She has since co-written for New Jeans with Erika de Casier and Smerz, attended Clarissa Connelly’s Kanonschoir, and collaborated with Astrid Sonne under the moniker Coined.

events.title: Rampage Sound
events.venue: British Music Embassy @ Palm Door on Sixth Patio

events.title: Glaze
events.description: Glaze is an shoegaze band hailing from Austin, Texas, blending dreamy soundscapes with powerful, hook-driven melodies. Known for their atmospheric sound and raw, heartfelt lyrics, Glaze crafts music that resonates with themes of self-discovery, love, and the complexities of modern life. The band’s rich guitar tones, tight rhythms, and ambient textures invite listeners into a sonic journey, captivating audiences at each live performance. With a dedicated fan base and a growing reputation for compelling live shows, Glaze continues to make waves in the Austin music scene and beyond, bringing a fresh yet nostalgic vibe to rock.

events.title: Maru Haru
events.description: Maru Haru is a gaggle of musical misfits amplifying Asian American and queer experiences through bombastic anthems, intimate strings, and personal stories of heart and strife. Their projects are community driven, collaborating with multimedia artists, Asian American and LGBTQ+ vendors, and cultural centers throughout Austin, TX for not only concerts, but also films, food festivals, and celebrations. No matter the occasion, Maru Haru is motivated to share affirmation, empathy, and joy through their music.

events.title: Kairo Keyz
events.venue: British Music Embassy @ Palm Door on Sixth Patio

events.title: Casket Cassette
events.description:
A reflection of the industrial grime and perpetual sunny glow of Los Angeles, Casket Cassette (Constant Williams) blends euphoria and melancholy in an expression of existential perseverance. Casket Cassette's depressingly danceable music takes a contemporary spin on the dark sounds of the 1980s Post-Punk and Darkwave movements, drawing further influence from New Wave, EBM, Synthpop and Indie/ Alternative to achieve this duality.

The project takes its name from a memory Williams has from childhood of his father recording a live song onto a cassette tape, then placing the tape into his grandfather's casket as it was being lowered into the ground. Williams' lyrics often reflect upon similarly somber themes such as mental health struggles, loss, heartbreak, addiction and recovery, while also offering glimmers of hope, humor and a general determination to overcome.

Williams lives in LA, and graduated in 2024 from the lowa Writers' Workshop with an MFA in poetry.

events.title: Endearments
events.description:
The music of Endearments has always turned a mirror on the inner self, reflecting life’s deeply personal, often painful moments in the light of clarity and new resolve. Principal songwriter Kevin Marksson and his bandmates, guitarist Anjali Nair and drummer Will Haywood Smith, craft emotionally dense and instrumentally lush pop songs, viewed through the lens of contemporary, dreamy indie rock and embedded with a John Hughes-ian romanticism.

Drawing on the emotive qualities of 80s synthpop and late-90s emo in equal measure, 'An Always Open Door', Endearments’ first full-length record, fine-tunes this heartfelt songcraft, widening the band’s influences and turning up the volume while maintaining the raw lyrical storytelling that’s made them a mainstay in Brooklyn’s highly competitive scene. The end result is a record that reevaluates the past, foregrounding emotional truths through performances that are as kinetic as they are introspective. Produced by Abe Seiferth, the album blends dreamy and down-to-earth influences into a vibrant, varied, and dynamic image of the band’s inner world.

An Always Open Door will be available on March 6, 2026, via Trash Casual.

events.title: Total Wife
events.description:
Come Back Down, the new album by Nashville experimental-pop duo Total Wife, was born from the edge of sleep. When composer and producer Luna Kupper would begin to fall asleep during late-night mixing sessions, the songs would follow her into the halfway place between dream and lucidity. Like Dale Cooper in Twin Peaks, she’d wake with a new perspective on the puzzle she was piecing together. “I’m a psychological mixer — I’m trying to think of how someone’s experiencing the sound, versus getting stuck in trying to make all these different tones and using all this gear to make something sound a certain way,” Kupper says.

And like a spiral from waking life into dream, the songs on Come Back Down are endlessly self- referential, building whole universes from a single point. Kupper sold all of her synths to make rent before she started working on the album, and so every inorganic sound is instead built from samples of the band’s own work. A guitar on one song may be reprocessed and used as a synth on the next, while everywhere on the album vocal samples are taken from a single unreleased cover of Elliott Smith’s “Between the Bars.” In tribute to this process, the album was almost named The Julia Set after the mathematical equation which feeds into itself again and again, creating beautiful fractal images. The intention was to create something complex but accessible; experimental, yet precise and without abstraction.

events.title: Whitelands
events.description: Originally inspired by a Slowdive KEXP session, London-based quartet Whitelands fuse their diverse musical backgrounds into an updated spin on shoegaze that amplifies marginalized voices and perspectives. Formed in the late 2010s as the solo project of Etienne Quartey-Papafio, Whitelands evolved into a full band ahead of their official debut album, Night-Bound Eyes Are Blind to the Day (2024), released during a U.K. tour with Slowdive. The project takes its name from a campus at London’s Roehampton University, where Quartey-Papafio first performed live. Their self-titled 2018 debut, a lo-fi blend of jagged indie rock and hazy grunge textures, hinted at the immersive sound they would later embrace. A turning point came when Quartey-Papafio stumbled upon Slowdive’s 2017 KEXP performance, igniting a deeper fixation on shoegaze. The current lineup consists of Jagun Meseorisa, Vanessa Govinden, and Michael Adelaja who bonded through shared experiences of neurodivergence and racial identity. Whitelands’ forthcoming album, Sunlight Echoes (out January 30, 2026), expands their sound, moving beyond shoegaze’s shadows toward something bigger, brighter, and unmistakably their own.

events.title: Kety Fusco
events.description:
Kety Fusco is electro-acoustic harpist, composer, and producer who has redefined the harp for the contemporary stage. Armed with her 47-microphone electro-acoustic harp, distortion pedals, and electronics, she transforms the instrument into a visceral voice that screams, whispers, and resonates far beyond classical tradition.
Her debut album The Harp was selected by Iggy Pop as “best album” on BBC Radio 6, and in 2025 she will release BOHÈME (A Tree in a Field Records), featuring a collaboration with Iggy Pop. Fusco has toured extensively across Europe and Latin America, performing at prestigious venues such as the Royal Albert Hall, Montreux Jazz Festival, and Mexico’s CENART, and as a Swiss cultural ambassador at the Euro Jazz Festival (Mexico City) and South America tour for Swiss Embassies.
In 2025, she has also been invited by the U.S. Department of State to participate in the prestigious International Visitor Leadership Program (IVLP), recognizing her as an ambassador of Swiss music and cultural innovation.
Her work bridges classical training and radical experimentation, from reimagining Beethoven’s “Für Elise” as a furious electronic cry to composing soundtracks for film and RAI Radio3. With over 200 live shows in three years, Kety Fusco is carving an unprecedented path for the harp in electronic music.

events.title: Radium Dolls
events.description: Radium Dolls are one of Australia’s most exciting rising rock bands, known for explosive live shows, razor-sharp lyricism, and a sound that balances grit, heart, and swagger in equal measure. Formed in Brisbane the four-piece have built a fiercely independent momentum, with their debut album "Legal Speed" (2024) earning national airplay, critical acclaim, and a Queensland Album of the Year nomination. Their sophomore album "Wound Up" debuted at #2 on the ARIA Australian Albums Chart, marking a major breakthrough and driving another fully sold-out national tour. The band have achieved major streaming and editorial success with singles including “Scorching Heat”, “Golden Boy", "Moving" and "Daddy", while their breakout track “Tractor Parts” has recently surpassed one million streams. The band has even caught the attention of music tastemaker Derrick Gee who named Radium Dolls his “favourite band of the moment”. With their debut American tour ahead and SXSW appearances, Radium Dolls are poised to introduce North America to the next era of Australian rock.

events.title: TTSSFU
events.description: TTSSFU – aka Tasmin Nicole Stephens – quickly went from being a mere fixture in Manchester’s indie scene to one of its fastest-rising stars, now poised to break out well beyond it. Known for conjuring vast, atmospheric worlds from her bedroom using just Garageband, she watched as early releases like her Warhol-inspired 2024 EP “Me, Jed and Andy” picked up steam. Since then, she’s traded bedrooms for stages supporting Kim Deal, English Teacher, Soccer Mommy and Mannequin Pussy, plus sold out headlines across the UK and packed festival sets from Green Man to the Great Escape.

events.title: Armanii
events.venue: British Music Embassy @ Palm Door on Sixth Patio

events.title: Fime
events.description: LA alternative indie rock quartet Fime released their debut LP “Sweeter Memory” in 2022. Working with producer Melina Duterte from Jay Som, they infused their garage rock sound with shoegaze, ethereal and gauzy vocals and distorted, reverb laden guitar melodies. Fime is set to release there second album “Just Can’t Win” in September 2025.

events.title: Adult DVD
events.description:
Adult DVD, the Leeds based six piece have become known for their relentless output of euphoric hooks and grooves along with a relentless touring schedule that has taken them to Glastonbury, Greenman, End Of The Road and several European festivals this Summer.
Formed by vocalist Harry Hanson and synth-player Greg Lonsdale, the project quickly expanded to a full band with Danny Blackburn (guitar/synth), Jake Williams (synth), Jonathan Newell (drums), and George Manson (bass). From the outset, their tongue-in-cheek lyrics, pulsating electronics, big choruses and unique production style (their releases are all self-produced) set them apart from the indie-rock landscape. 
Few songs capture the chaotic fun of Adult DVD more than their first release ‘Bill Murray’ - now a firm fan favourite and sing along moment at every festival set. First ‘proper’ single ‘Do Something’ from their 'Next Day Shipping' EP earned a spot on the BBC 6 Music B-list and support from BBC Radio 1, BBC Introducing and Radio X. Subsequent single ‘Because I Like It’ also landed onto the 6 Music B-list, and accompanying live performance from the BBC’s 6 Music festival.
Adult DVD’s live shows are fast becoming legendary. From sold-out hometown headline gigs at Brudenell Social Club and Belgrave Music Hall (2 in the round shows in one day) to storming sets at The Great Escape, Deer Shed Festival, and Live at Leeds, their performances are high-energy and unmissable.
Whether tapping into their love for chorus-centric indie or the influence of acid house floor fillers, DJing, or remixing their musical contemporaries their core appeal remains consistent: undeniable humour, bold danceable instrumentals and instantly memorable songwriting."

events.title: The Sheila Divine
events.description:
Aaron Perrino refuses to be beat. The Boston music scene veteran, who helms The Sheila Divine, has spent decades confounding expectations with songs that deftly weave power-punching political criticism amongst mundane daily frustrations. Songs that expose purest grief alongside deepest love.

The Sheila Divine’s upcoming sixth album, The Middle Ages (out DATE on Trash Casual), is a deeply human document of everyday life. Across ten new tracks Perrino bares his soul and searches his heart in songs that navigate the wide gamut of lived experience: from the wrenching loss of his mother, through parental anxieties for his own children’s wellbeing, to the strains of congested city life, fractured relationships, and rage at what his nation has turned into.

events.title: 0 Miles Per Hour
events.description: 0 Miles Per Hour is a loud, fuzzy, in your face rock band hailing from Orlando Florida. The group has just released their most recent project "Gallop" through Chicago-based label New Morality Zine. The EP captures the band in a moment of clarity and growth. Across five songs they channel the energy of alternative rock through a hazy, melodic lens. "Gallop" represents 0 Miles Per Hour’s most confident and fully realized work to date.

events.title: 2charm
events.description:
2charm☆ blends indie house heaven pop techno dubstep baile to make magic ☆
Sticky and playful vocal hooks abound, pairing beatific production with beautiful vocal melodies, delivering something that’s equal parts ecstasy and transcendence. 2charm’s music could be likened to the sparkle that bounces off sheened cheeks under dingy club lights, in the same way the Balearic sea shines in July ☆

events.title: Alto Moon
events.description:
Atlanta-based artist, producer & songwriter, Alto Moon is redefining “Future Soul”, a sleek collision of Pop, R&B, and electronica that feels both nostalgic and next-gen. Though raised on heartfelt sounds from Southern gospel, Alto’s sound pulses with a modern edge where soul meets synths. Drawing sonic comparisons to Sam Smith, Lenny Kravitz, & Usher, Alto’s smart, cheeky signature songwriting makes it unmistakably his own.

His latest album "godspeed." caught the attention of Bob the Drag Queen, who later appeared on the project’s lead single, "ride." The record marks a defining moment in Alto’s ascent blending bold, club-ready production with nostalgic Pop/R&B.

After appearances on American Idol, MTV, and NPR, Alto continues to spark Atlanta’s underground scene with high-energy performances and a signature retro-futuristic aesthetic. A proud queer voice in pop, he celebrates freedom, reinvention, and the art of moving at your own speed.

events.title: Andy Arthur Smith
events.description:
Andy Arthur Smith is a singer, songwriter, and internet force of nature with 5.1M followers on TikTok (100M+ likes) and 1.1M on Instagram. Often described as “Jim Carrey meets Jacob Collier,” he combines elastic, absurd humor with mind-blowing musical ability by delivering powerhouse vocals, tight harmonies, and genre-jumping arrangements that feel as hilarious as they are impressive.

What started as wildly creative short-form videos has grown into a full-fledged artist project. Andy’s debut EP Shortcut is a whirlwind blend of pop, jazz fusion, soul, and funk, showcasing both his technical chops and emotional depth. Whether he’s belting a hook, stacking harmonies, or slipping into a character mid-song, his performances feel unpredictable and electric. Previous collaborations include Vulfmon, GRAMMY-winning 8-Bit Big Band, KNOWER, and Straight No Chaser.

events.title: Arroba Nat
events.description: Just a girl, with her feelings and a guitar.

events.title: Avanti Patel
events.description:
Avanti Patel is a multi genre Musician based out of Mumbai- A hindustani classical vocalist, playback singer, theatre maker & composer. 
She started learning Hindustani Classical Vocals at age 5 and is currently training with Padmashri Vidushi Ashwini Bhide Deshpande of the Jaipur Atrauli Gharana.

Among her most recent projects is O Gaanewali, a theatre-concert-piece based on the lives and music of the Courtesans, Tawaifs and Women performers in India. O Gaanewali has been widely performed, with over 75 live shows across several Indian cities and festivals like Jashn-e-Rekhta, Magnetic Fields in Rajasthan, Serendipity Arts Festival in Goa,  and legacy venues like The Royal Opera House and Prithvi Theatre in Mumbai.

Avanti is currently producing her 2nd EP titled 'O Gaanewali Session 2', after the success of her debut EP released last year, titled ‘O Gaanewali Session 1’. Both EPs include the genres of Thumri, Dadra, Ghazal with a classic ‘old world meets contemporary’ style of production, available on all music streaming platforms and on Youtube.

events.title: Bayonne
events.description: Since his 2016 debut album Primitives, Bayonne has channeled his vast imagination into an elegant yet wildly experimental form of electronic pop, equal parts meditative and mesmerizing. In the making of his latest body of work, the Austin-based artist/producer/multi-instrumentalist otherwise known as Roger Sellers found himself in even greater need of an outlet for his kinetic creative impulses, thanks to an intense convergence of events in his personal life: his father’s diagnosis with and eventual death from cancer, the end of a significant relationship, and an overwhelming struggle with depression and anxiety. Deeply informed by a deliberate transformation of his musical process, Bayonne’s third full-length Temporary Time ultimately makes for his most expansive work to date—an album of both painfully raw introspection and otherworldly beauty.

events.title: Ben Buck
events.description:
With deep influences in the golden era and traditional styles of underground hip hop, Ben Buck strives to innovate and continue the legacy of artists who paved the way before him. Hailing from a musical family, Ben Buck’s father Mike Buck was a founding member of the legendary blues group “The Fabulous Thunderbirds”. Mike Buck is also the owner of the historic Antone’s Record Shop in Austin Texas where both Ben and his sister Billie work. His sister Billie Buck is also the frontwoman for the punk band “Sailor Poon” (Austin Chronicle’s Best Punk Band 2018-2020). She is a gifted designer and poster artist, and does many designs for Ben’s album covers. 

Ben Buck has been an omnipresent sight in the Texas music world. He has beatboxed on stage with artists such as Ghostface Killah, Bushwick Bill (Geto Boys), Czarface and Skyzoo. 
In 2023 the City of Austin Texas honored Buck with the declaration of “Ben Buck Day”, recognized annually on April 13th. Later that year on the Austin stop of “The Eric Andre Explosion Tour” Buck was the invited music guest and was interviewed by the legendary comedian, he performed an impromptu beatbox segment with Eric Andre and freestyled alongside him

events.title: Brie Stoner
events.description: Brie Stoner is a creative code-switcher who makes music for those who've never belonged to just one place. Raised in Madrid, Spain, and now based in Grand Rapids, Michigan, she channels her multilingual life into indie dream-rock that feels both intimately personal and impossibly vast. Her upcoming LP "Matador" (releasing 2026) is a California-themed love letter, lush and cinematic, featuring orchestral arrangements by acclaimed arranger Kelly Pratt (St Vincent, Beck, and Beirut) and produced by David Vandervelde (Father John Misty). The album weaves strings, woodwinds, and horns through Stoner's poetic storytelling, creating an intimate portrait of artistic endurance, perseverance, motherhood, and the quiet act of creating beauty when the world feels uncertain. Her music has been featured by Ralph Lauren, Victoria's Secret, Orange is The New Black, The Affair, and Yellowjackets as well as other international TV and film campaigns. Featured in Spin, Atwood Magazine, and Magnet, Stoner's new album proves that the best art comes from moving between languages and landscapes.

events.title: Cha’Keeta B
events.description:
Cha’Keeta B is a lyrical emcee from Austin, Texas, known for delivering rap with substance and intention. Influenced by a wide range of artists and genres, her first love has always been writing, drawing inspiration from poets and artists like Jill Scott.

Since 2011, she has released two mixtapes and two EPs, been featured on the “Coast 2 Coast Hottest in Texas” mixtape, and performed multiple times as an official artist at South by Southwest. She has opened for renowned acts including Slim Thug, Naughty By Nature, Tink, Wu-Tang Clan, Oshun, and Z-Ro, among others.

Beyond music, Cha’Keeta B is committed to community impact. She founded the Christmas charity initiative “Rap 4 A Reason,” collecting gifts for underprivileged children in East Austin. She is also the creator of the annual “Kinky Curly Coily Fest,” a natural hair festival celebrating Black women, men, and children, while creating opportunities for artists and small businesses to thrive.

events.title: CHALK
events.description:
Chalk is the project of award-winning musicians and filmmaker
duo Ross Cullen and Benedict Goddard. An informed mix of
Dublin's guitar band scene and the sweaty hardcore dance
floors of their native Belfast, Chalk are IDLES meets Daniel Avery,
Death Grips meets Bicep - techno-infused industrial punk.
Since forming in 2022, Chalk have had a rise like no other,
quickly establishing themselves as an unmissable live act and
unpredictable, ferocious songwriters. Their debut UK/IRE tour
sold out, and led to further bookings across Europe as word of
their performance and guitar-melded techno spread via word of
mouth and support with national radio in the UK.
These songs were collated into the Conditions Trilogy, a family of
thirteen tracks that combine gritty Irish and German-influenced
techno and dance music with gothic, post-punk and jagged
guitar riffs and vocal melodies. This unique blend earned them
the support and kudos of their peers in Fontaines D.C., IDLES
and Sprints, all of whom handpicked the band to support them
throughout their tours.

events.title: Cure for Paranoia
events.description:
Formed in the heart of Dallas but born on the highway, Cure for Paranoia came together during a “doomsday road trip” intended to be their last. Having recently been diagnosed with bipolar paranoid schizophrenia, frontman Cameron McCloud found clarity in a hot-boxed rental car; making music with collaborators Jay Analog and Tomahawk Jonez gave him peace of mind. “He said, ‘this is my cure for paranoia.’ Instantly, everyone’s eyes lit up,” a pivotal realization that cemented the group’s moniker. When the predicted earth-shattering meteor failed to hit, inspiration struck instead. As Jonez recalls, “On the way from Amarillo to Colorado Springs, like eight songs got written.”

Since then, Cure for Paranoia has shared bills with icons ranging from George Clinton & Parliament Funkadelic and Nas to Ludacris and Leon Bridges. Their resume includes stops at SXSW, Fortress Festival, and the NPR Tiny Desk Contest "On The Road" Tour, solidifying their status as festival favorites. While keen to distance themselves from standard regional production, they cultivated a signature "Trippy Soul infused hip hop" sound—a blend prioritized on their anchor project, the Work of A.R.T. EP.

events.title: DAMOYEE
events.description:
DAMOYEE is a genre-fusing artist, musician, composer, and producer whose career began as a young teen performing in Deep Ellum, self-releasing her first album at 16, landing stages at New Orleans Jazz Fest and Gov Ball, and composing an original score for AT&T, all while still in high school. She has parlayed her inherent talent into hundreds of thousands of supporters, industry placements with DC The Don and 2x RIAA diamond-certified artist Bryson Tiller, and partnered with brands such as Meta, Coca-Cola, Cartoon Network, FX x Hulu, Walgreens, and Roland.

Known for remarkable musicianship, evocative lyricism, luminous vocals, and sonic versatility, DAMOYEE moves fluidly across genres, layering live instrumentation and stacked harmonies in her music and performances. Her unique artistry has earned praise from GRAMMYs, NPR, Entertainment Weekly, EBONY, American Songwriter, PAPER, Consequence, and more.

2019's The Whole Truth charted internationally, earned “Best Vocalist” and “Best Female Vocalist” honors in Dallas. 2024's PURPLEXED marked a new creative peak, exploring vulnerability with fearless emotional honesty. Moving forward, DAMOYEE continues with a singular, bold vision.

events.title: DARKOVIBES
events.description: Darkovibes is a boundary-pushing Ghanaian singer, songwriter, and genre-bender whose sound blends Afrobeats, highlife, R&B, and alternative influences into a unique musical identity. A pivotal voice in the new wave of African music, he has collaborated with some of the continent’s biggest stars, including Wizkid, Davido, Shatta Wale, R2Bees, Sarkodie, Stonebwoy, Camidoh, King Promise, M.anifest, Mr. Eazi  and Spinall. Known for his vibrant performances and versatility, Darkovibes has shared stages with many of these artists across Africa and beyond, captivating audiences with his infectious energy and bold creative vision. With a growing global fan base and a track record of innovative releases, Darkovibes continues to redefine contemporary African music and is poised to make a powerful impression at SXSW.

events.title: Dayonthetrack
events.description: Afroheart prodigy, Dayonthetrack was introduced to the world in November 2019, he featured on Groundup Chale tape titled “We Outside; Y3 W) Ab)nten vol 1” where he featured on three songs off the project.   After the EP, he made remarkable strides in songwriting. Writing back to back hits for including Baajo, Celebrate and toxic by Kwesi Arthur writing parts of Adekunle Gold’s lyrics on the latter. He also featured on two songs off the “Son Of Jacob” album which has been exceptional on streaming markets and gained nominations on prestigious events.   His debut EP -SOUNDS AND WAVES released in July 2023 have earned Dayonthetrack over two million streams on all platforms as a solo artist project and his "Ashawo" song off the project being his first solo hit song.

events.title: Delilah
events.description:
Delilah Cabrera, professionally known as Delilah, is a Mexican-American singer-songwriter and Interscope Records artist from Wenatchee, Washington. Raised in a bilingual household, she discovered her passion for music early, singing mariachi at school events and participating in choir—experiences that shaped her emotionally rich, culturally rooted sound.
A multi-instrumentalist who plays piano, guitar, violin, and vihuela, Delilah blends traditional Mexican music with contemporary influences. Her career shifted after a viral performance caught the attention of Los CT Records, founded by Natanael Cano, leading to her signing as the label’s first female artist in its Mexican division through an Interscope partnership.
She has released singles including “Amor Perdido,” “Modelo,” “Entre la Maleza,” and “Butterfly,” collaborated with Becky G on “TODO,” and shared stages with Iván Cornejo. In 2025, she performed at the Selena Tribute Concert in Chicago. Her Interscope debut single, “SI DIOS LO QUERÍA,” was released in September 2025. Now 18, Delilah continues to emerge as a powerful new voice in Latin music.

events.title: Devin the Dude
events.description:
Devin the Dude is a Houston hip hop icon and one of the most enduring voices in Southern rap. Known for his laid back delivery, sharp humor, and effortless storytelling, Devin has built a decades long career rooted in authenticity and real life perspective. His music blends soul, funk, and everyday truth in a way that feels personal while remaining instantly recognizable, earning him a loyal cult following across generations.

Widely respected as an artist’s artist, Devin has collaborated across eras while staying true to his sound and point of view. His catalog includes fan favorites and timeless records that continue to resonate with listeners who value originality over trends. On stage, Devin brings a rare mix of charisma and comfort, delivering live performances that feel equal parts concert, smoke session, and community gathering.

Beyond music, Devin continues to expand his creative footprint through culture forward projects and brand building. He is the co creator of Coughee, a cannabis lifestyle brand rooted in storytelling, quality, and community. Decades into his career, Devin the Dude remains original, influential, and impossible to duplicate.

events.title: Diles que no me maten
events.description: Psychedelic Punk in Spanish. Forced Jazz meditation.
events.venue: Radio Day Stage @ Downright Austin Backyard

events.title: Dizzy Fae
events.venue: The Creek and the Cave Backyard

events.title: DJ Napalm
events.description: Born & raised in Austin, TX, DJ Napalm has been immersed in the local music scene from a young age. At just 14, he launched his journey into radio with KAZI 88.7, one of the longest running stations in Central Texas. There, he was apart of a teen-focused show that offered guidance for high school students navigating everyday challenges, transitioning into a solo radio personality. Along with up & coming local talent, he also interviewed major artist such as Slum Village, Trey Songz, Dorrough & Nivea to name a few. After college, Napalm came back to Austin ready to embrace the Hip Hop scene by linking up with ScoreMore Shows. There he learned the behind the scenes work for live music events and immersive experiences for consumers, such as The Illmore. Meeting artist like Kendrick Lamar, Curren$y and Big Sean evolved his passion into supporting local talent because he knew Austin had artist that could reach the same heights. Linking up with Austin pioneer J Soulja, The Smoke Out ATX (M.A.D.E Agency) & The Pre Roll ATX were born. The highest demanding Hip Hop platform in CTX, they advocate for local artist independence while providing a save space to network and build community.

events.title: DNA
events.description: I am DNA. I am from Houston, Texas (SouthPark). I grew up on the southside of Houston. I am a Navy Veteran. I am married (38 years - high school sweetheart), I have 2 sons, one who served and is a Navy veteran like me, and one who is currently serving on active-duty Navy.  I've always loved to perform and create music. I linked up with Devin the Dude in 2000. I am an original Coughee Brotha, (affiliated with Devin the Dude). I also have a group that I create and perform music with called 3BN (3 BAD NEGROES). We make music that makes your head nod and your feet tap. We write and talk about grown folk shit in our music. Looking forward to performing at this year's 2026 SXSW Music Festival.

events.title: EddyJae
events.description:
EddyJae is an emerging artist and songwriter within the new wave of Mexican music. He has participated as a songwriter on standout tracks such as “Cielo Eterno” and “Sirena” by DannyLux, as well as “Soy Un P*ndejo” by Eslabón Armado, solidifying his presence both behind and in front of the stage.

In addition to his work as a songwriter, EddyJae continues building his career as a solo artist. He recently released his debut album, Ana-Lepsis, a project that marks a key stage in his artistic evolution, standing out for its emotional depth, introspective lyrics, and modern sound with Latin roots.

EddyJae has performed at Viva Pomona 2025 and will be part of SXSW 2026, further strengthening his presence within the independent and alternative circuit.

events.title: Fine
events.description:
Fine is a Copenhagen-based singer-songwriter and producer whose music blends samples, acoustic and electric instruments into a groovy and ethereal crossover sound, both familiar and dreamlike.

Her debut album, Rocky Top Ballads (2024), turns experiments into songs by cutting and layering band improvisations. Bringing them together with melodies and voice. The album features loose-wristed-head-bobbing drums, a wide range of guitar sounds, bass riffs, reverb-soaked atmospheres, and real sound recordings — all woven together with Fine's distinctive voice and lyrics.

Live, Fine reshapes her hypnotic sound together with her band: Lola Hammerich on guitar (Baby in Vain), Andreas Murga on bass (Gorgeous), and Mads Muurholm on drums.

Starting early, Fine began her career over a decade ago with the Danish electronic trio Chinah, releasing three albums. She has since co-written for New Jeans with Erika de Casier and Smerz, attended Clarissa Connelly’s Kanonschoir, and collaborated with Astrid Sonne under the moniker Coined.

events.title: GILT
events.description: Bounce riffs in skinny jeans. Polyrhythms in Affliction shirts. breakdowns4breakdowns? :3

events.title: Ilusión
events.description:
Ilusión is a trio formed by Fernando Soria Salmerón, Jesús Beltrán, and Carlos Mayo Jimenez; three friends who connected through their love for music and shared roots as first-generation Mexican-Americans living in Delaware. With family ties to Quiroga, Michoacán, Jiménez, Chihuahua, and Huehuetlán el Chico, Puebla, their songs carry the weight of two cultures, three journeys, and one voice that speaks from the heart.

They grew up listening to everything — from the romantic ballads their parents played at family gatherings to the raw, emotional sounds of corridos tumbados and alternative rock. That blend of influence shows up in their music, where traditional meets modern, and every lyric is grounded in real feeling. For Fernando, Jesús, and Carlos Ilusión is more than a name — it’s a reflection of their dreams, struggles, and everything they’ve felt along the way. Their sound isn’t boxed into one genre because they don’t live in just one world.

events.title: In Phases
events.description: In Phases is a POC WLW alt-rock artist fusing rock, metal, electronic, hip-hop, and R&B into a gritty, underground-club sound, drawing cinematic influence from action-horror and gothic action films.

events.title: The Irrepressibles
events.description:
The Irrepressibles is the project of Jamie Irrepressible, composer, vocalist, producer, and visual conceptualist known for emotional performance and genre-blurring sound.
