A defining voice in queer art pop and alternative performance, Jamie blends classical beauty, alt-pop experimentation, and bold visual concepts.

Debuting with Mirror Mirror (2010) and its global hit In This Shirt—now over 325M streams and widely used in film and TV—The Irrepressibles gained a devoted international following. Follow-ups Nude (2012) and Superheroes (2020) expanded this cinematic, intimate world.

With Yo Homo! (2024), hailed as “a milestone in queer indie rock” and “desire paired with alt-rock swagger,” Jamie entered a raw, sexually candid, and sonically adventurous new phase.

The Irrepressibles have performed sold-out shows at Barbican Centre, Royal Festival Hall, and Latitude Festival, and collaborated with Röyksopp, ionnalee, and Tinlicker.

Through music, video, and performance, Jamie explores identity, sensuality, freedom, and connection, standing as one of the most compelling queer voices in contemporary music.

events.title: J'ray
events.description:
J’ray is a Nigerian-born Afrobeats singer and songwriter whose sound blends infectious rhythms with emotional storytelling. Raised in Lagos, his passion for music was shaped early through church and community performances, laying the foundation for a style rooted in authenticity and global appeal.

Now based in the United States, J’ray has been building a growing international audience since launching his professional music career in 2017. His music fuses Afrobeats, Afro-fusion, and R&B, marked by vibrant energy, smooth melodies, and themes of love, resilience, and connection.

J’ray has collaborated with artists and producers across Africa, North America, and South America, including award-winning producer DJ Dever and SNDY Music, expanding his reach across cultures and borders.

At SXSW, J’ray delivers a dynamic live performance that reflects his mission: connecting cultures through sound and storytelling while representing the next wave of global Afrobeats music.

events.title: J’cuuzi
events.description: Describing J’cuuzi as a band is at the very least inaccurate, or worse: incorrect. While they deliver electrifying, borderline acrobatic live performances of high octane, glitchy songs that modulate between serrated post punk guitar and pulsing electro beats, there is a shocking theatricality to them that the word “band” lacks the range to capture. The members wear handmade couture, with bulbous anime-esque proportions and insectile features sewn into drag silhouettes. They often perform while stacked on top of each other, or hoisted over each other’s heads. Their stage is set like a cheap studio apartment: a spinning blue egg chair and a stack of guitar amps sit on either side of a bedazzled ironing board, from which a spinning disco ball hangs. Since their inception in February 2024, J’cuuzi’s ferocity has earned them opening slots for acts like Viagra Boys, Stereolab, Tune-Yards, Shannon and the Clams, Upchuck, Snooper, and Warmduscher. Whether you call them a band, a performance art troupe, or a fashion house; J’cuuzi has set a pace of expansion and experimentation that proves theirs is an act worth watching.

events.title: Jamaica Moana
events.description:
Jamaica Moana is THE non-binary Māori (Ngāpuhi/Tainui) and Samoan rapper, songwriter, creative director and ballroom icon reshaping what hip-hop from “down under” can be. Based in Western Sydney on Dharawal and Gadigal land, Jamaica fuses hard-hitting rap, R&B and club electronics with ancestral fire, ballroom attitude and fierce queer identity.

A leader in the Australian ballroom scene and co-founder of The West Ball, Jamaica builds stages where queer, trans and BIPOC communities can take up space on their own terms. Her debut EP BUD & DENI (2025) channels grief, legacy and life in Western Sydney into razor-sharp, deeply personal anthems.

After years of cultivating a cult following across clubs, fashion runways and spaces like Dark Mofo, Phoenix Central Park and Sydney Festival, Jamaica now brings her explosive show to SXSW Austin as the inaugural Walk to Austin Award recipient.

events.title: Jaxs
events.description:
Jaxs, the electrifying lyricist from Currie, North Carolina, broke out as a Top 5 finalist on Netflix’s Rhythm + Flow Season 2. Known for her pen, magnetic presence, and genre-blending sound, she delivers every performance.
 
More than an artist, Jaxs is a branding powerhouse. She’s partnered with DTLR x New Balance and BACARDÍ x Casa BACARDÍ at Dreamville Festival, cementing her influence beyond music. She’s also graced stages like SXSW, Howard University Springfest, Grind Pretty Festival, did DTLR HBCU TOUR 2025 and more.
 
Her freestyle over a beat by super producer Timbaland went viral, amassing over 4 million views and proving her lyrical skill on a global scale. Her single “DOX MRTNS” was named an Editor’s Pick by The Hype Magazine, and she’s keeping the momentum going with her newest release, “Tomato Tomato”—a bold, witty track that showcases her originality and edge.
 
Influenced by Eminem, André 3000, Missy Elliott, Joyner Lucas, and Childish Gambino, Jaxs brings a fearless, Southern-rooted sound that pushes boundaries. With over 500K followers across social media, a rising brand profile, and nonstop creative energy, Jaxs is one of hip-hop’s most exciting new forces.
events.venue: The Creek and the Cave Backyard

events.title: Joe Harvey-Whyte
events.description:
Joe Harvey-Whyte is one of the most innovative and exciting pedal steel players around. He has worked with a diverse range of artists including Liam Gallagher & John Squire , James Vincent McMorrow, The Magic Numbers , Susanne Sundfør , Billy Bragg , Tony Visconti , Nilüfer Yanya , Jody Stephens , Bullion , Mozart Estate, Alabama 3, Young Jesus & many more. 

Aside from his work as a session musician Joe is also a multidisciplinary artist working at the cross section between ambient/experimental music, visual art and environmental sound. His solo work combines the sound of the pedal steel guitar with electronics and field recordings to make works that create a space for deep listening & reflection.

events.title: Jugg Mugg Da Jugganott
events.description: 1/3 of the Odd Squad!!! Coughee Brothaz Lieutenant…

events.title: Just Jim
events.description: Just Jim is a multidisciplinary creative living in Austin, Texas. Known locally as a club DJ, he has carved out a reputation as a tastemaker behind the decks. He has an instinct for connecting with the crowd, and is beloved for his ability to communicate with music. His sets are as genre-defying as they are expansive, which provides the source code for his unique style of production. Although labeled as "house music," elements of Hip Hop, R&B, jazz, experimental, and world music are seamlessly incorporated to make for a rich sound full of hidden gems.

events.title: Karina Galicia
events.description:
Mexican singer and songwriter. Karina Galicia explores her context and surroundings through pop and R&B soundscapes.
Her body of work includes her debut album “Cancionero del Nuevo Milenio” released in 2020, which portrays human fragility and an EP titled “Las Sangres”,that narrates the stories of six Mexican women whose lives were shaped by violence.
In 2024, Karina Galicia signed as a songwriter with Sony Music Publishing. In April 2025, Karina released her second album “Mudanzas” under the label Discos Licenciado by Warner Music. Mudanzas offers a unique and thrilling sonic experience, taking the best of R&B elevating it through fusions of pop and folk. Mudanzas is an album of many facets: emotional,sorrowful, introspective, and above all, filled with love and growth, “I wanted to portray the hope of becoming a better version of myself.My body is a house—my house—and I’m willing to inhabit and break it down as many times as needed.”
Her most notable performances include:
Festival Internacional Cumbre Tajín – 2019, Veracruz
Festival Noche de Primavera – 2021, Mexico City
FESTIVAL HERA HSBC – 2024, Mexico City
FESTIVAL SINERGIA – 2024, Mexico City
HOUSE OF VANS – 2024, Mexico City

events.title: KOAD
events.description: KOAD has one goal as an artist: “I want to make men cry and women dance.” The 23-year-old rapper, producer, and director from the San Fernando Valley is redefining Indian-American artistry with his debut album TREEHOUSE. Born Ajay Dodani to Indian immigrant parents, KOAD blends Bollywood nostalgia, hip-hop, and pop into something unmistakably his own. Teaching himself to produce at 13 and leaving school at 14 to pursue music full-time, he transformed his family garage into a studio with his brother and manager, Amit. His breakout single “Deepika” — a cheeky love letter to Bollywood icon Deepika Padukone — earned co-signs from SZA, Isaiah Rashad, Zane Lowe, and the actress herself. He followed with “dirty,” a sharp satire on cultural fetishization that amassed over 25M views and marked his directorial debut. Now signed to 10K Projects, KOAD is also the co-founder of KOGO, an artist community home to prolific originals including Asha Imuno, Curtis Waters, REHMA, CONNIE, Nafeesisboujee & more. With TREEHOUSE, he fuses vulnerability, swagger, and imagination into a world built for people to feel, dance, and belong.
events.venue: The Creek and the Cave Backyard

events.title: Kodie Shane
events.description:
A cornerstone of Atlanta’s alternative scene, Kodie Shane is the seasoned architect of "Ethereal Trap." Evolving from a teenage prodigy into a fully autonomous force, she navigated the major-label system at Epic Records before successfully negotiating her independence. Today, she operates with 100% creative control and a "glitter-eyed" aesthetic that defies convention.

A songwriter first, Kodie holds credits on 95% of her catalog, with over 100 releases and 100M+ streams to her name. Her raw vulnerability and melodic precision have made her a premier collaborator and a global touring staple. Whether headlining international dates from London to South Africa or supporting icons like Jhené Aiko, Lil Uzi Vert, and Willow Smith, her high-octane stage presence is unmatched.

Beyond music, Kodie is a premier tastemaker cited by Vogue and Pitchfork. Blending luxury high fashion with streetwear, she has fronted global campaigns that challenge gender norms, solidifying her status as a visual icon for a loyal community of 850,000+ followers and 300,000 + monthly listeners on Spotify
events.venue: The Creek and the Cave Backyard

events.title: LA ROSA NOIR
events.description:
La Rosa Noir is a Chicago indie alternative band whose sound blends moody atmospheres with the sharp edges of surf, post-punk, and new wave. Their debut album, Arellano, dives into themes of love, loss, and self-discovery, weaving heartfelt, sentimental narratives through dynamic and emotionally charged arrangements. Formed in 2018, the band grew out of Chicago’s DIY scene and has since taken the stage at Millennium Park, Navy Pier, and Riot Fest, sharing bills with artists such as Jack White, Green Day, Citizen, Son Rompe Pera, and The Red Pears.

For fans of: La Luz, Siouxsie & The Banshees, The Hives, Mazzy Star, The Cramps, Muse.

events.title: La Texana
events.description: La Texana, the music project of José Ramírez, was born in 2021 in Tijuana, Baja California. At 17, with just a laptop and guitar, he began recording music inspired by Spanish alternative rock and post-punk influences. He debuted with Nunca He Sabido Amar, and in 2023 released his first EP, Morro, featuring Un Día Como Hoy, now with over 6.5 million streams. In 2025, La Texana released his first full-length album, signed by the spanish label Sonido Muchacho "La Casa Que Cae", a 10-track record exploring identity and new beginnings, reaching over 8 million streams. It includes standout tracks like Terco, El Sol, and Dispara. In May, he performed a sold-out debut at Lunario of Auditorio Nacional and is now touring across Mexico (40+ cities) and 7 countries, with more dates to come. La Texana is currently preparing for his biggest show yet at Teatro Metropólitan in February 2026. His style continues to evolve, blending vulnerability and nostalgia, while connecting with a new generation of Mexican musicians and growing an international audience.
events.venue: Radio Day Stage @ Downright Austin Backyard

events.title: Leo Von Sol
events.description: Leo Von Sol is a pop and R&B artist based in Austin, Texas, pairing sleek pop songwriting with R&B phrasing, and  a lower baritone vocal presence. Influenced by artists like Tinashe, KAI of EXO, and Omar Apollo, his work blends polished performance instincts with a cinematic visual sensibility and modern production choices. His recent EP, Garden of Sol, is focused on themes of nostalgia, temptation, and solitude, expressed through bright pop and R&B sonics and sun-rich visuals that draw from early-2000s pop language without feeling like a throwback. A Recording Academy member, Leo Von Sol balances candid, behind-the-scenes authenticity with a professionally branded presence, while his style sits at the intersection of luxury streetwear and high fashion, always intentional, elevated, and lived-in.

events.title: Leslie Kirchoff
events.description: Where the New York fashion set goes, you’ll likely find Kirchhoff,” said Style.com about Leslie Kirchhoff, who was named one of their Top 10 New DJs, as well as “The Coolest Girl in the Room” by Paper Magazine in their Beautiful People Issue. After learning to DJ in Paris in 2011, she made her New York debut with a Friday night residency at the notorious Boom Boom Room at the Top of the Standard Hotel, and quickly became an in-demand staple in the downtown Manhattan party scene. Her skills on the decks and timeless music collection have brought her clients like Louis Vuitton, Dolce & Gabbana, Cartier, and American Express, to name a few. She’s performed around the world in cities such as Paris, London, Berlin, Tokyo, Stockholm, Mexico City, Miami, Las Vegas, and more.

events.title: Lil Asian Thiccie
events.description:
Powered on infectious hooks and eclectic (even, erratic) genre switch ups, Lil Asian Thiccie; Kuala Lumpur-based singer-rapper-songwriter-overall-Dope-Person, has earned a spot in the forefront of the Malaysian urban music scene.

With a growing catalogue teasing trap, pop, and everything electronica in between; her tongue-in-cheek lyrics and barefaced delivery marks a distinct sonic purrrson-uh!
Having established herself as a one-of-one female hip hop starlet in 2018 to her pop-empowered revolution in 2021, Lil Asian Thiccie finds her balance between eras towards defining a trademark Gen-Lil Asian Thiccie sound.

events.title: Los Discorde
events.description:
Desde que inició la pandemia no hemos parado de componer y escribir todas las diferentes sensaciones que a lo largo de nuestra visión hemos tenido que recorrer.

Nos gusta pensar en la unidad de las personas cuando existe música en vivo, cuando podemos brincar y bailar con todo el cora. 

Los Discorde somos una familia de amigos y un laboratorio de sonidos en donde nos gusta experimentar con otros artistas las diferentes formas de ver y escuchar lo que nos gustaría que vivieran desde otra perspectiva, pero siempre con la idea de pasarla bello, compartir y disfrutar el camino

events.title: Lucaa
events.description:
Originally from the Blue Ridge Mountains of North Carolina but currently living between LA, NYC and Richmond, VA; Lucaa (she/they) is the brainchild of singer/producer Stepha, who is a 2 spirit Afro-Indigenous artist whose genre-bending indie/alt-pop brand of music features raw and deceptively deep songwriting that pulls from their experiences as a young model in NYC, and being a queer BIPOC artist.  

At a young age, Lucaa remembers listening to their father (who was a backup singer for Stevie Wonder, Earth Wind and Fire, and Michael Jackson) and mother (a trained opera singer). After teaching themself how to sing and play songs on piano by ear, Lucaa now takes a grungier approach to altpop, with influences harnessed from Radiohead, Billie Eilish, Willow, & girl in red.

Lucaa's career is growing quickly. A notable SXSW 2024 showcase early on led to major label interest and a fruitful year of performances and international branding campaigns with Leica Cameras and TurboTax. Lucaa was also a featured artist alongside Black Eyed Peas front man Taboo for Reserved Magazine, and appeared in Vogue Japan's October Edition (print), KEXP, Ones to Watch, and Them.

events.title: Manny Phesto
events.description: Manny Phesto is a Minneapolis/San Diego based hip-hop artist known for sharp lyricism, commanding live performances, and a career built independently. He has toured nationally and performed internationally in Havana, Cuba and Mexico City, with appearances at major festivals including Soundset. Manny has collaborated musically with Devin the Dude and is a co-founder of Coughee alongside him. He has appeared on bills with Ice Cube, J. Cole, Freddie Gibbs & Madlib, and The Alchemist, and his music has been covered by Pitchfork, XXL, and NPR, earning a reputation as a respected performer rooted in culture, community, and independent hip-hop.

events.title: Marilina Bertoldi
events.venue: Radio Day Stage @ Downright Austin Backyard

events.title: Melanie Dyer
events.description:
Growing up on her family's farm in Mount Russell, regional Australia, Melanie Dyer started crafting her stories into songs at the age of twelve. With an authentic blend of her down-to-earth farm girl roots, dynamic stage presence and catchy contemporary songwriting chops, Melanie has performed at some of the world's biggest country festivals, including CMA Fest in Nashville, CMC Rocks, and the Big Red Bash in Australia. As a talented artist and songwriter, Melanie has racked up multiple #1 country radio hits and earned three nominations for Most Performed Country Work at the APRA Awards. 
With over 12.5 million streams, her chart-topping albums Fresh and Between You and Me have garnered her prestigious Golden Guitar nominations and the coveted APRA Professional Development Award. Her breakout hit Memphis T-Shirt catapulted her into the mainstream spotlight on commercial radio networks and a remarkable six-week stint at number one on the Australian Country Hot 50 Chart. In 2025 Melanie relocated to Nashville, Tennessee to chase her dreams of building a global audience and sharing her music across the USA.

events.title: Neptune XXI
events.description:
Neptune XXI is a multidisciplinary artist, storyteller, and cultural architect whose work fuses the spiritual with the sonic. Raised in Northeast Washington, D.C., shaped by Southern lineage, and sharpened by Baltimore’s creative edge, she creates at the intersection of healing, futurism, and ancestral memory. A graduate of Mount St. Mary’s University and author of From My Mind’s Eye, she bridges scholarship with soul, weaving language, sound, and movement into transformative experiences.

Praised by The Baltimore Sun for her “rhythmic mastery and profound syntax,” Neptune XXI has been a resonant voice in contemporary art since her debut EP TwentyOne (2018). Her catalog, including HEAL (2023), Medicine Music (2024), and Medicine Music II (2026) reflects her commitment to collective restoration, emotional liberation, and reclaimed joy. On stage, her performances become multisensory experiences blending music, poetry, and hella swag.

She is also Founder of the non-profit, Nu Indigo Nation, cultivating safe, self-sustaining futures for Black people through art, education, and wellness.
events.venue: The Creek and the Cave Backyard

events.title: OKAN
events.description:
Taking their name from the word for “heart” in the Afro-Cuban religion of Santería, the duo OKAN creates an alchemy of Cuban rhythms and chants with high-octane indie jazz and pop. Singing in Spanish, Yoruba, and Spanglish, OKAN explores resistance, rebirth, and joy — forging rhythm and harmony through acts of survival, both personal and cultural.

Following their Juno Award–winning album Okantomi — performed on NPR’s Tiny Desk and toured internationally while supporting Grammy-winning duo Rodrigo y Gabriela — OKAN’s upcoming fall release "Ife Ira" features a collaboration with Daymé Arocena.

OKAN is led by violinist and vocalist Elizabeth Rodríguez and percussionist and vocalist Magdelys Savigne — both Grammy and Latin Grammy nominees — whose powerful harmonies and fearless musicianship have earned the duo a global following.
events.venue: Radio Day Stage @ Downright Austin Backyard

events.title: P.H.0
events.description:
P.H.0 [P-H-"zero"] is a NYC-based SILKPUNK quartet reshaping the city's underground. Fusing the raw, intense metal riffs with the haunting cry of the traditional Chinese erhu and techno-dystopian synths, they craft sounds that are at once chaotic and controlled, futuristic and ancient. Their live shows—referred to as "rituals"—transform ancient Taoist traditions into ear-crushing soundscapes that defy time, crashing into chaotic mosh pits under visceral strobing lights to create what some describe as a rave in an abandoned shrine from Cyberpunk 2077.

Their momentum has carried them from NYC festivals like New Colossus and Punk Island to sold-out shows across the East Coast, proving their reach in every environment—from the historic Gramercy Theatre, where they were handpicked by Danish prog-metal giants VOLA to support their North American tour, to inside an abandoned tunnel where they performed for more than 500 ravers. They were further recognized by NPR's Tiny Desk as a top 50 "Top Shelf" artist in 2025, and by Bandcamp Daily, who praised their debut album KARMA for “reimagining what Asian music might sound like.” P.H.0 continues to build a cult following, one ritual at a time.

events.title: Planeta No
events.description:
Gonza from planeta no is amazin musician, and play, dance for fun us. 
He currently lives in Mexico City, premiering new music in collaboration with friends he's made throughout his career and during his time in Mexico. It's an incredible show full of color, dance, and lots of rhythm.

events.title: Pretty Jane
events.description: Pretty Jane is a Detroit-born, Nashville-based indie rock/pop trio comprised of Trevor Dalrymple (vocals), Luca DiVergilio (bass), and Ethan Strain (lead guitar), who met after dating the same set of twins. They are known for their intimate and energetic music, which has garnered them over ten million streams and a large online following. Their sound is often described as a blend of alternative and indie with pop appeal, creating music that explores themes of intimacy, connection, and the complexities of relationships earning them the moniker 'music that feels like kissing your friends'.

events.title: Radium Dolls
events.description: Radium Dolls are one of Australia’s most exciting rising rock bands, known for explosive live shows, razor-sharp lyricism, and a sound that balances grit, heart, and swagger in equal measure. Formed in Brisbane the four-piece have built a fiercely independent momentum, with their debut album "Legal Speed" (2024) earning national airplay, critical acclaim, and a Queensland Album of the Year nomination. Their sophomore album "Wound Up" debuted at #2 on the ARIA Australian Albums Chart, marking a major breakthrough and driving another fully sold-out national tour. The band have achieved major streaming and editorial success with singles including “Scorching Heat”, “Golden Boy", "Moving" and "Daddy", while their breakout track “Tractor Parts” has recently surpassed one million streams. The band has even caught the attention of music tastemaker Derrick Gee who named Radium Dolls his “favourite band of the moment”. With their debut American tour ahead and SXSW appearances, Radium Dolls are poised to introduce North America to the next era of Australian rock.

events.title: Rafa Parra
events.description:
Rafa Parra, cantautor/productor originario de la Ciudad de México. Experimentando con nuevas formas de expresión dentro del pop urbano, mezclando letras románticas con ritmos irresistibles como el dembow y el merenguetón. Su estilo fresco y
emocional invita tanto a bailar como a enamorarse.
Con canciones como “A Besos Si” y “Olaya <3”, Rafa ha comenzado a llamar la atención por su forma única
de contar historias de amor con flow, ritmo y mucha sensibilidad. Su música suena a momentos reales:
mensajes no enviados, fiestas que terminan en confesiones y corazones que laten más fuerte.
Rafa crea canciones que se sienten cercanas, con hooks pegajosos y melodías que se quedan en la
cabeza. Su propuesta es emocional y pensada para conectar con quienes viven el amor con intensidad,
entre el reggaetón lento y las composiciones.

events.title: Redzed
events.description:
REDZED is a Czech rap-metal outlier turning underground chaos into global momentum. Writing and producing everything himself — from raw guitar riffs to hard-hitting beats — he fuses serrated modern rap with the weight of late-’90s/’00s metal. The result is a dark, cinematic crossover that speaks fluent mosh pit and playlist alike.

His 2024 album Tales Of A Necromancer solidified a singular vision, while viral tracks like “Rave In The Grave,” “Meth Phonk,” and “Drugs = Magic” have racked up tens of millions of streams, pushing him past one million monthly Spotify listeners worldwide.

Onstage, REDZED is relentless — sweat-drenched, high-impact, and impossible to ignore. After sold-out headline shows, international tours, and major European festival slots, he arrives ready to turn SXSW into a collision of rap kids and metal die-hards.

Enter the pit.

events.title: Rich Garvey
events.description: Rich Garvey is a Liberian Born-Minneapolis based Emcee, Producer, and Engineer. Having an African background exposed him to many genres of music including, Zouk, Calypso, Reggae, etc. His music can also be describe as witty, lyrical, insightful & melodic. His live sets combine live sequencing from the Roland SP 404 MK2 and lyricism that engages the audience.

events.title: Rosa Anschuetz
events.description: Rosa Anschütz is a musician and sound artist whose practice merges composition, installation, and performance. Her sound blends the dark ambience of post-punk and cold wave with ethereal polyphony and synth-driven melodies. She has released three LPs: Votive (2020), accompanied by nine clay sculptures inspired by votive offerings; Goldener Strom (2022), which was staged at the Deutsche Oper Berlin; and Interior (2024), featuring nine tracks, each accompanied by a sequined landscape hand-stitched by Anschütz. Her new album, Sabbatical, was released on September 26, 2025, on Heartworm Press, US.

events.title: Sex Mask
events.description: Experiencing Sex Mask live is all gas, no brakes. The band’s artsy, electric fusion of proto-post-punk and writhing no-wave cool leaves little room for breathing space – and not least of all because shirtless frontman Wry Gray will often find himself directly within the immediate peripheral of anyone close to the front.

events.title: Sofish
events.description:
Sofish is one of the most compelling voices in Mexico’s alternative scene. A singer, songwriter, and Berklee College of Music & Latin Grammy Cultural Foundation scholar, she crafts a sophisticated blend of French House, R&B, and Alt-Pop. Her global appeal was cemented when her single "Me Caigo" went viral across Europe and LatAm, leading Remezcla to call her "iconic… fresh and elegant… diva alert."

Following standout performances at Tecate Emblema and Lunario at Auditorio Nacional, Sofish’s momentum reached new heights in 2025 as the cover of Spotify’s "Novedades Viernes" and opening for pop icon Belinda at Fiestas de Octubre. With over 5 million streams, her sound has dominated flagship playlists like Fresh Finds Global and Mixto.

Currently, Sofish is preparing the release of her debut album, La Femme Illustrée (May 2026), a cinematic project that explores high-end visual artistry and visceral storytelling. Arriving at SXSW 2026 as a genre-bending force, Sofish is not just a rising star—she is the architect of a new, elegant era in Latin alternative music.

events.title: Spike Fuck
events.description:
Spike F*ck is a rare figure in contemporary music: direct, disarming, and impossible to pin down. Emerging from Melbourne’s underground in the late 2010s with The Smackwave EP, Spike fused bleak synth-pop, post-punk melodrama, and brutally honest songwriting into something both vulnerable and confrontational. Armed with only a backing track and a microphone, early live shows saw Spike sing candidly about addiction, gender, dysfunctional love, and collapse: a kind of wounded sincerity that quickly drew a cult following. Just as things seemed to be breaking open, Spike disappeared, retreating from public life amid a personal reckoning.

After a four-year hiatus -- during which time rumours swirled about death, institutions, or becoming a monk -- Spike returned sober, clear-eyed, and transformed. The music that followed is bigger, wilder, and more alive. Performed with a rotating full band, the new material draws from ‘70s glam, spiritual soul, and damaged rock and roll, but always filtered through Spike’s unmistakable voice: bruised, intense, poetic.

These are songs about recovery, identity, survival, and letting go not sanitised, not triumphant, but real. Where the early work stared into the void, the new work steps forward with purpose. It’s not a reinvention. It’s an evolution, one born from chaos, now grounded in clarity.

events.title: Suck Brick Kid
events.description: Suck Brick Kid is a hook-heavy pop-punk band built on big riffs, bigger choruses, and just enough self-awareness to keep it dangerous. For over a decade, they’ve balanced earnest, heart-on-sleeve energy with sharp, tongue-in-cheek lyricism—turning existential spirals and dive-bar observations into shout-along anthems. Their releases are tight, punchy, and conceptually driven, walking the line between chaos and craft. Known for sweaty, cathartic live shows that feel equal parts therapy session and house party, the band thrives in rooms where volume and vulnerability coexist. Suck Brick Kid isn’t trying to reinvent punk—just to play it loud, honest, and impossible to ignore.

events.title: Sultanes del Yonke
events.description: Born on the frontera, Sultanes del Yonke channels the chaos, color, and rhythm of the border into a sound built from the unexpected. As they prepare to promote their debut album, due in April, the band is evolving its sound — keeping their regional rhythms and DIY spirit while weaving in samples, drum machines, and experimental, dance-driven styles. This collision of influences does true justice to the yonke in their name: raw, eclectic, and born from the beautiful chaos of the border. Recent milestones include a tour supporting Tropa Mágica and a standout performance at SXSW, solidifying their expanding live footprint.
events.venue: Radio Day Stage @ Downright Austin Backyard

events.title: Swapmeet
events.description:
Swapmeet are an Adelaide/Kaurna Country based four piece who are set to release their debut album in 2026. With indie rock foundations, characterised by sonic experimentation, and a punk spirit, Swapmeet are known in the local and international circuit for their playful, chaotic onstage presence.

After a successful showcasing debut at BIGSOUND 2024 - the band returned home for the South Australian Music Awards where Swapmeet were awarded "Best Release" for their debut EP "Oxalis" and "Best Song" for fan favourite "Ceiling Fan".

2025 saw the band tour nationally with The Murder Capital and support Suki Waterhouse at PICA. In between sold out debut headline shows - Swapmeet showcased at SXSW Sydney 2025 and left having been awarded with "Best Emerging Artist". Swapmeet will be backing this up at SXSW Texas - making this the bands international live debut.

events.title: Unsafe Space Garden
events.description:
Unsafe Space Garden is a genre-bending outfit from Portugal known for their chaotic, theatrical and deeply immersive live shows. With a sound rooted in neo-psychedelia, experimental rock and a touch of surreal humour, the band pushes musical boundaries with fearless creativity and a clear artistic vision.

Described by European press as “a surrealist orchestra,” their concerts often blur the line between performance and ritual - unpredictable, cathartic and strangely uplifting. Their critically acclaimed albums Bro, You Got Something In Your Eye – A Guided Meditation (2021) and Where’s The Ground? (2023) draw comparisons to artists like Frank Zappa, Captain Beefheart or The Flaming Lips, while forging a language uniquely their own.

More than just experimentalists, Unsafe Space Garden are storytellers - unpredictable, emotional and sonically adventurous. A live act designed to be seen, heard, and remembered.

events.title: Valsian
events.description: Oscar and Eunice, a music electronic pop mexican duo.

events.title: Victor Jones
events.description:
Victor Jones has taken off tremendously in the past year and change, hitting a over million streams on spotify in 2025 alone, with success on tracks such as Mother Teresa and I Get Hurt boosted by strong short form social media campaigns. Victor comes from a background of comedy and theater as much as music, and it shows through even (especially?) in his darkest songs.

Victor plays with a modular backing band consisting of 1-2 people and carefully arranged backing tracks. His shows are high energy, danceable, and chantable. He prides himself on having, at least in the past year, made people cry at every show, and alternately, made them dance.

events.title: Villain Park
events.description: Villain Park is a Los Angeles-based hip-hop duo known for their sharp lyricism, cinematic production, and raw, unfiltered energy. Blending West Coast grit with modern underground sensibilities, the group has built a loyal following through relentless releases and electrifying live performances. With a sound that’s both nostalgic and forward-thinking, Villain Park continues to carve their own lane in independent hip-hop.

events.title: Willy J Peso
events.description:
Willy J Peso is a Detroit-born lyricist whose music reflects the city’s raw honesty, hustle, and resilience. Blending sharp lyricism with cinematic production, his sound balances lived experience, ambition, and introspection—unapologetic and forward-moving.

Operating in the lane of Wiz Khalifa, Curren$y, Larry June, and Big Sean, Willy delivers laid-back confidence, intentional bars, and a lifestyle-forward perspective rooted in independence, ownership, and longevity. His music feels grown and purposeful—made for people building something, not chasing moments.

Beyond the stage, Willy J Peso is a cannabis entrepreneur and reform advocate, partnering with licensed brands across Michigan, New Jersey, and Florida. Through music and business, he pushes equity, normalization, and economic opportunity for communities historically impacted by prohibition.

On stage, Willy doesn’t just perform—he represents a Detroit-born movement driven by culture, entrepreneurship, and reform.

events.title: Worlds Worst
events.description: As SLC-based band, Worlds Worst, release their sophomore LP, American Muscle, the band continues to perfect their unique approach to the indie, slacker rock sound. The new LP, released via tastemaker labels Smoking Room and Julia’s War Records, mixed and mastered by Jack Shirley, features standout singles like "Angus," “Gas Hands” and the 2024 track “Motor Mouth.” On American Muscle, the band takes new risks and showcases how they have grown as songwriters while maintaining their noisy, ‘90s rock style. Worlds Worst has toured extensively across the US, headlined Philly's Julia's War Fest, performed at SLC's Kilby Block Party twice, played the new Best Friends Forever Festival in Las Vegas, Boise’s Treefort Fest, and earned recognition as one of Stereogum’s Best New Bands.

events.title: ZAMAERA
events.description:
Zamaera is a Malaysian rapper, singer-songwriter, and storyteller known for her fearless, genre-defying sound and commanding live performances. Blending sharp lyricism with experimental production, she has carved a distinct space for herself in Southeast Asia and beyond.

Breaking through Malaysia’s hip-hop scene in the mid-2010s, Zamaera gained international recognition through releases such as ZvsZ and Get Munni, leading to performances across the region and abroad.

In 2021, she founded Mean Malaya Entertainment, a creative platform championing artistic independence and Malaysian talent. Her commitment to uplifting women in music led to the creation of Queendomfest, Southeast Asia’s first all-female music festival.

In 2025, Zamaera became the fourth Malaysian artist to perform at SXSW in Austin, Texas. Building on that momentum, she now presents the first-ever dedicated national showcase, Made In Malaysia, at SXSW 2026, featuring an all-Malaysian lineup.

Her latest single, Ikan Kekek, released in February 2026, reimagines a traditional Malay folklore rhyme through trap and techno textures, exploring cultural memory, artistic freedom, and non-linear expression.

events.title: SXSW Expo: Emerging Tech
events.description:
Showcasing a collective of industry disruptors, the Emerging Tech Expo features businesses spearheading the development of revolutionary technology. At the forefront of tech, these breakthrough exhibitors are shaping the future of tomorrow’s solutions. Plug into the network of visionary leaders that are pioneering the digital frontier. The Expo will be free and open to the public on Wednesday, March 18.

See the floor plan here: https://sxsw2026-sxexpoetech.expofp.com/

events.title: University of Cincinnati Lounge
events.description: Think of us as the ultimate college lounge: coffee, chargers, comfy chairs, some adult beverages, and all the fuel you need to spark your next great idea. Oh, and there will be a free Allbirds drawing every day.

events.title: AI & Culture: Empowering the African Diaspora
events.description: AI is transforming industries, yet cultural representation often lags behind. This session explores how AI can be used to preserve cultural heritage, amplify diverse voices, and create new business models across the African diaspora. Through real-world case studies in entertainment, fashion, and events, we’ll uncover strategies for building inclusive AI ecosystems that merge cultural identity, creativity, and innovation for global impact.

events.title: AI is Changing Consumer Behavior: How Brands Must Adapt
events.description: AI is quietly but profoundly changing how people think, act, and decide. From planning trips to seeking therapy, it’s quickly becoming the first stop for answers and everyday decision-making. It’s also reshaping cognition: one MIT study found that frequent ChatGPT users reported higher loneliness and reduced critical thinking over time. This session brings together behavioral experts, cognitive researchers and marketers to explore how AI is rewiring consumer behavior, and how brands can keep up.

events.title: Are We All Biohackers Now?
events.description: From personalized supplement regimens to wearables and AI health tracking, consumers are building their own health ecosystems. This session explores how self-directed health has gone mainstream, transforming how we approach wellness, performance, and prevention. But as products and tools become more accessible, people face an overwhelming and opaque marketplace full of bold claims and conflicting advice. What does it mean to be a “biohacker” today, and how can we take charge of our health whilst also navigating a system that still struggles with transparency?

events.title: Beyond the Sample: The 3D Fashion Revolution You Don’t See
events.description: From eliminating physical samples to populating product pages and TikTok ads with real-time renders, 3D is quietly reshaping the entire fashion lifecycle. This panel dives into what happens behind the scenes—from factory floor to homepage—with leaders across design, supply chain, and digital content discussing the hidden efficiencies, sustainable breakthroughs, and creative freedoms unlocked by 3D technology.

events.title: Building the World We Believe In
events.description: This panel brings together leaders from mission-driven organizations to discuss how they are using business as a force for good. Panelists will share real-world stories about creating impact, building values-driven cultures, and partnering across sectors to address complex challenges. The conversation will highlight innovative models and practical lessons for anyone seeking to create meaningful, lasting change.

events.title: Featured Session: Craft Still Wins: The Irreplaceable Role of Human Instinct, Taste, and Emotion
events.description: Have we lost sight that the creative work that truly impacts you on a human level, requires just that—the craft of a human? Greg Greenberg, award-winning Executive Creative Director at TBWA\Media Arts Lab, Apple’s global creative agency explores the irreplaceable role of human instinct, taste, and emotional intelligence in the creative process. Featuring real-world examples of handcrafted storytelling, he offers a rare perspective on how we can’t lose sight of what truly impacts people on a deep emotional level, human craft, even in a world infatuated by the speed, ease and impact of AI.

events.title: Featured Session: SuperJoost’s State of Play 2026
events.description: Now in its sixth year, State of Play is SXSW’s annual briefing on how games forecast the future of media, tech, and culture. In 2026, the $250B games industry is rebounding — but the bigger story is how play is becoming the new cultural operating system. From musicians and brands building games into their business models to shifting platforms and audience behaviors, this data-driven session reveals where consumers, capital, and creativity are headed next.

events.title: Featured Session: The Three Laws of a Healthy Relationship
events.description: Yung Pueblo, Jillian Turecki, and Case Kenny break down the three laws of a healthy relationship in a conversation that blends self-awareness, communication, and what it truly means to love someone. Explore how connection with yourself sets the tone for intimacy, how optimism shapes the language of conflict, and why lasting love is a practice... not just butterflies or chemistry. Expect practical tools, perspective shifts, and real guidance for building relationships that last. A powerful, grounded session for anyone ready to strengthen how they love and how they show up in partnership.

speakers.name: Jillian Turecki
speakers.title: Relationship Expert, New York Times Bestselling Author

events.title: Finding Belonging in a Disconnected World
events.description: In a world driven by likes, swipes, and algorithmic connection, we’re lonelier than ever. This panel—featuring leading voices in dating, friendship, psychology, and event design—unpacks how we can forge more fulfilling relationships in a tech-saturated world. Whether you're single, partnered, or building a chosen family, you'll walk away with research-backed insights, new frameworks for intimacy, and practical steps to connect more meaningfully—with others and yourself.

speakers.name: Marisa Franco
speakers.title: Professor, Speaker, And NYT Best-Selling Author

events.title: Floods to Fortitude: Infrastructure Resilience
events.description: Infrastructure is facing unprecedented challenges, from aging bridges to extreme weather events. In this session, leaders from the public sector, policy, engineering, and technology will discuss how to build better, more resilient infrastructure for an era of increasing volatility, spotlighting technology’s transformative role in Kentucky’s response to recent devastating floods.

events.title: From “Sick Care” to “Health Care”: Redefining Expectations in Medicine
events.description: For too long, health care has focused on treating diseases after symptoms appear and they have already taken hold. That is what we call “sick care.” Lilly is working to change that by moving to true “health care” where diseases are found earlier, treated sooner and in some cases prevented altogether.​Lilly is already bringing this vision to life with breakthroughs like improving how we manage chronic conditions and extend healthy years, moving earlier in brain diseases, restoring senses with genetic medicines and harnessing the immune system in powerful new ways.

events.title: From Elevator to Spotlight: How to Pitch Anyone, Anywhere
events.description: Whether you're a startup founder, filmmaker, designer, or daydreamer—you've got something to pitch. But most people fail to get attention because they pitch information, not emotion. This workshop blends secrets with startup-tested frameworks to help you craft a pitch that actually lands. Learn the anatomy of an irresistible pitch, practice pitching, and get real-time feedback from a former Imagineer and creative executive who’s pitched everything from billion-dollar theme parks to five-minute film ideas. Expect live coaching, laughter, and lightning-fast lessons that stick.

events.title: From Game to Universe: Tencent’s Strategy for Global IP
events.description: What transforms a mobile game into a billion-dollar entertainment ecosystem? This session reveals the strategic playbook behind turning original IP like Honor of Kings and PUBG into global phenomena spanning film, merchandise, and more. With insights from Tencent’s global publishing operations, the session offers a behind-the-scenes look at how to protect, promote, and power IP that resonates across cultures and platforms. Participants will emerge with a strategic framework for expanding digital properties across industries and global markets.

speakers.name: Yong-Yi Zhu
speakers.title: Vice President of Business Operations, Strategy, and Compliance

events.title: The Future Design Language of Robots
events.description: As robots enter homes, hospitals, and public spaces, their design language — how they look, move, and behave — will shape how we trust and relate to them. This session explores emerging visual, interactional, and behavioral grammars of human-robot interaction. Must robots mimic humans or machines, or can new forms evolve? We’ll examine how design can expand the roles robots play and the relationships we build with them across cultures and contexts.

events.title: How to Build a Career Without Going Viral
events.description: While there are many recent examples of viral songs on social media launching major artist careers, chasing that viral hit isn’t always necessarily sustainable or the most feasible way for an artist to go about building long term success. Rather than solely focusing on going viral, there are several other areas an artist can look at for building their career such as defining their unique brand and sound, consistently releasing high quality music, and building community. This session will dive into each of these areas to provide artists with realistic tips that they can apply to their careers.

events.title: I’m Not Creative (And Other Lies We Tell Ourselves)
events.description: In a world where AI tools can generate logos, write copy, and compose music in seconds, what does creativity look like for the rest of us—especially those who don’t carry a “creative” title? This workshop is for the engineers, strategists, analysts, producers, and anyone else who’s ever said, “I’m not creative.” Through a series of provocative exercises and hands-on prompts, we’ll explore how creativity is evolving beyond traditional mediums—into product flows, systems thinking, code, and prompt design.

events.title: Low-Key Legends: Personal Branding for Introverts
events.description: This session with author of "Personal Branding for Introverts" and branding expert and ex-Forbes Sr. Contributor Goldie Chan focuses on empowering introverts to embrace their unique strengths to build a personal brand while struggling less. Attendees will learn how to harness quiet confidence for storytelling, develop strategies to connect with audiences without overwhelming social demands, and create a branding approach that aligns with their personality.

events.title: Market Inclusion: LGBTQ+ Innovators & Allies Meet Up
events.description: Innovators dedicated to growing and connecting audiences know that inclusivity is simply an additive “And.” To add revenue, you must add customers, which means you must add new communities to your business strategy, and that means considering the experiences and culture of people outside your existing consumer profile. An “And” to understanding means and “And” to people, then an “And” to revenue. Leaders seeking market expansion can connect here to explore how they might better connect with LGBTQ+ communities to grow business opportunities while benefitting arguably the country’s fastest growing consumer demo.

events.title: Moving Culture: Music Brand Campaigns with an Eye for Equity
The Next Digital Wave Excludes Millions. Let’s Fix It.
events.description: Our digital world risks leaving groups behind. This panel issues a call-to-arms for truly inclusive design in physical spaces, where technology amplifies human potential. With 20% of the world's population identifying as neurodistinct in some way, we'll unveil a blueprint for environments that care for all human needs. Explore how Google and Hypersolid are developing adaptable guidelines to unlock unique cognitive strengths - fostering engagement, productivity, and belonging. Join a revolution of the human mind where every mind shines.

events.title: No Time for Safe Bets: Creative Impact Under Fire
events.description: When disaster strikes, there’s no time for creative review. Just hours after violence, fires, hurricanes, war, or other crises strike, frontline groups like World Central Kitchen and Watch Duty hit the ground to save lives, and their marketing and comms teams begin rallying attention and mobilizing donations to make it all possible. In this session, WCK’s Linda Roth, Chief Communications and Strategy Officer, and Liz Caselli-Mechael, Chief Communications Officer at Watch Duty, join Swayable CEO James Slezak to reveal how some of the world’s most important campaigns are using AI and cutting-edge measurement technology to develop authentic, purpose-driven content that works—quickly.

events.title: Not For Me: The Emotional Cost of Exclusionary Design
events.description: What does it feel like to be told — subtly or explicitly — that a product isn’t meant for you? From voice assistants that ignore accents, to websites that don’t account for disability, exclusionary design sends a powerful message: you don’t belong here/this product isn't for you. In this session, we’ll explore how design decisions shape belonging, dignity, and trust—and what happens when that’s broken. Drawing from real user stories, this talk will spark a conversation on what it takes to move beyond surface-level inclusion.

events.title: Perspectives on Cyber Security & Human Rights: Three Cases
events.description: Practitioners from industry (Google), academia (Columbia-SIPA) and civil society (Access Now) will show how cybersecurity impacts human rights. Drawing on research with vulnerable and marginalized communities, including human rights defenders, independent journalists, and the elderly, they will show how people in diverse circumstances attempt to navigate digital spaces safely and freely with few resources. They will offer lessons and debate best practices and norms in cyber capacity-building, corporate human rights due diligence, and technology-informed advocacy from an intersectional lens.

events.title: Pressure-Proof: Become the Manager You Want and Others Need
events.description: Managing today feels like a trap: too much to do, too little trust, and no time to build relationships that make teams thrive. This provocative session draws on decades of experience with Fortune 50 executives and over 12,000 pages of interview data to reveal two surprising truths: pressure—not power—corrupts, and power creates distance. Left unchecked, both warp your best intentions. But when managed well, they can drive clarity, connection, and trust. You’ll leave with practical tools to rethink your role, reset your relationships, and lead with more impact.

events.title: Ready for your Brand Close-Up?
events.description: Visit YouTube at the Brand & Marketing track to capture your own custom video to post on YouTube Shorts. Our team will guide you through the process and help you capture a unique brand snapshot of your time at SXSW. Open to all attendees during conference hours.

events.title: Round Table: Agents & Managers: Eric Borja and Erik Telford
events.description: An extension of our popular Mentor Sessions, our Round Table Sessions not only allow attendees to learn from the industry experts that sit at each of the three tables in this session but they also allow attendees to learn from the questions and experiences of their peers as well. This Round Table Session will bring together industry experts and SXSW attendees for an enlightening discussion on Agents & Managers.

events.title: SAG-AFTRA Low Budget Contracts Made Easy
events.description: A great cast can help level up a low-budget indie film. But many filmmakers assume they can't afford to hire SAG-AFTRA actors. While going through the SAG-AFTRA signatory process may seem intimidating, SAGindie makes it easier by educating independent producers about the ins and outs of hiring professional actors for low-budget films. This workshop highlights the details of the various contracts SAG-AFTRA offers to low-budget films, demystifies the process of working with the union, and offers best practices for indie producers.

events.title: See Where the Money Goes: Rebuild Trust in Humanitarian Aid
events.description:
Trust is under pressure across industries, but in the humanitarian sector it has become existential. As public skepticism around waste, corruption, and opaque systems grows, support for aid can disappear fast—as seen in 2025 with sweeping cuts to U.S. foreign assistance driven by accountability concerns.

This session explores how blockchain is reshaping humanitarian aid by enabling real-time, verifiable tracking of stablecoin-based funds from donor to recipient. We’ll examine what trust-by-design systems mean not just for aid, but for any sector grappling with accountability at scale.

speakers.name: Julia Kuchman
speakers.title: Vice President, Stablecoin Product, Commercial & Money Movement Solutions

events.title:
SPECTREVISION RADIO PRESENTS
REALITY BYTES: THERE IS NO SPOON
events.description:
What if the reality we experience is only part of the picture?
Across philosophy, mysticism, physics, and psychology, a recurring idea emerges: the world we agree upon may be a shared interface — a consensus layer — rather than the totality of what exists. From ancient cosmologies to contemporary speculation about simulated universes, the question persists: is everyday reality the whole story, or just the surface? Consciousness researcher and podcaster Jordan Crowder, computer scientist and author Rizwan Virk, and anomalous phenomena researcher Darren King explore whether reality is layered, participatory, and far stranger than it appears. Moderated by SpectreVision Radio Director Daniel Noah.

events.title: SXSW Bookstore
events.description: Check out the SXSW Bookstore to browse the latest work authored by this year’s conference participants. Support your favorite speakers and find something you connect with to take back home. Open daily on the 6th floor of the Hilton Austin Downtown.

events.title: Theory to Practice: Google’s Responsible Approach to AI
events.description: Every day, more of us interact with AI, prompting deeper questions about how these products are built. This workshop will allow participants to understand the intricacies of LLM training, providing a deeper grasp of how these models truly function. More critically, we'll dive into the essential strategies for mitigating risks and building safeguards into generative AI products. Participants will engage in activities to understand AI red teaming, using golden sets to calibrate AI responses to sensitive prompts, and discuss the potential and limits of various approaches.

events.title: Trust & Tech: Patient-Centered Health Innovations
events.description: In the race to innovate, trust is often the missing link. As AI, data, and digital health tools transform how we diagnose, treat, and connect, the real question is: who’s shaping these innovations—and who’s being left out? This conversation brings together health leaders and community innovators to explore how centering patients and culture in design and data use builds not only better products, but stronger relationships. The takeaway: technology can’t build trust, but people can.

speakers.name: Simon Nazarian
speakers.title: System Executive Vice President & Chief Digital and Technology Officer

speakers.name: Josette Gbemudu
speakers.title: Associate Vice President, Patient Health Innovation

events.title: Vibrant Wellness Exhibit Booth
events.description:
Personalized health and longevity are no longer niche topics—they’re becoming cultural priorities that will define the future of medicine, wellness, and human potential. Our exhibit space brings together integrative medicine, nutrition, longevity, and lifestyle optimization to explore how cutting-edge science and holistic approaches are reshaping the way we think about aging and long-term vitality. From cellular function to optimizing hormones, nutrition, brain performance, and exercise routines, our clinical experts will share what’s next in the rapidly evolving field of longevity—and how diagnostics can help inform longevity roadmaps.

https://vibrant-wellness.com/

events.title: Who Gets to Shape the Future of AI? Talent, Policy & Power
events.description: AI is reshaping every industry—but will America remain the world’s innovation engine? As visa rules tighten and geopolitical suspicion grows, top AI talent is being diverted elsewhere. This panel explores how U.S. immigration, research, and tech policy decisions are influencing the global AI race. Drawing on history and current data, we’ll ask: Can the U.S. still attract the world’s best minds—or will they build the future somewhere else?

speakers.name: Lynn Pasquerella
speakers.title: President
speakers.company: American Association Of Colleges And Universities

events.title: Why SMB Cyber Attacks Could Cripple the U.S. Economy
events.description: Small and mid-sized businesses (SMBs) account for 99.9% of U.S. businesses and nearly half of GDP, yet their cybersecurity capabilities lag dangerously behind. Nation-state actors and cybercriminals now target SMBs and the managed service providers (MSPs) that support them because one breach can cascade across thousands of businesses, posing a serious risk to national security and economic stability. As AI supercharges social engineering and ransomware at scale, this overlooked attack surface has become one of the most urgent vulnerabilities in America.

events.title: Work AI House
events.description: Step into Glean’s Work AI House at SXSW, where the future of work comes to life. Experience live demos that turn scattered information into instant answers, hands-on labs with AI teammates, and conversations with leaders reimagining productivity. From curated sessions and intimate roundtables to relaxed networking on the patio, every moment is built for real-world takeaways. Leave inspired, with practical ways to bring Work AI to your team on Monday and measure impact in weeks.https://events.glean.com/glean-at-sxsw2026

events.title: @BooksyBiz at SXSW 2026
events.description: Join Booksy, the fastest-growing booking platform for beauty services, in our pop-up salon and spa at the Congress Ave Block Party.Get free hair, nail, barber and massage services and consultations from our superstar Ambassadors and Top Texas Providers.

events.title: Animated Short Program
events.description: A whirlwind tour of hand drawn, stop-motion, and digital revelries.
events.venue: Rollins Theatre at the Long Center

events.title: Congress Avenue Block Party
events.description: The Congress Avenue Block Party (formerly known as the Registrant Lounge) is the go-to space for all SXSW attendees to maximize their SX experience, offering daily complimentary drinks, food, and sponsor swag. Open throughout the conferences & festivals, this convenient and relaxing meeting point near the hub of SXSW action is an ideal spot to unwind and connect with other attendees. New for 2026, the Block Party is free and open to the public!

events.title: Crep Protect Clean & Chill
events.description: Get your sneakers cleaned and be in with the chance of winning some exclusive prizes with Crep Protect, the worlds leading sneaker care brand.

events.title: Dreamquil
events.description: Set in the not so distant future when poor air quality leads to people living mostly virtually lives. Carol is a dissatisfied career mother, struggling to find connection within her marriage to Gary and her child. With the day to day familiarity of their home and lives feeling increasingly claustrophobic, and worried she could be heading towards divorce, Carol leaps at the chance to get her life back on track by signing up for "DreamQuil", an avant-garde digital wellness retreat. When Carol returns home however, she discovers her family has been living with "Carol 2", a robot the corporation sent designed to help in her absence, and things take a mysterious and sinister turn.

events.title: Free JonnyPops Samples - A Better Pop for a Better World!
events.description: Stop by the JonnyPops tent to enjoy the simple ingredients, delicious taste and kindness in every pop! Free pops and swag will be distributed each day. https://www.jonnypops.com/

events.title: Lainey Wilson: Keepin' Country Cool
events.description: Follow Wilson as she redefines the modern country star, proving that staying true to yourself can lead to major success. The film explores her personal journey, struggles, and triumphs as she captivates fans on stages across the country.

events.title: Layers of Place: Austin
events.description: Through a co-creative process with the community, Austin transforms into a platform for multidimensional, pluralistic inquiry, delving into themes such as racial justice, historical memory, memorialization, environmental stewardship, and the impact of technology on civic life. The importance of plurality is central, presenting six perspectives on different concepts and viewpoints. In a world that is increasingly polarized and lacking in nuanced perspectives, Layers of Place emphasizes the collective experience. By expanding “public space” to include both the tangible environment and the virtual layers accessible through AR, we create a new form of communal experience.

speakers.name: MIT Open Documentary Lab’s AR and Public Space Artist Collective

events.title: Moving Memory
events.description:
Move between memories. Moving Memory uses AR to enhance how New Public Art’s interactive artwork Kempelen’s Owls makes a place to bridge the relationships between nature and technology, geometric and organic, clandestine and open, seen and hidden.
When you enter the space between Kemplen’s Owls and begin the AR experience, you hear music and see playful, colorful animated figures performing motion-captured choreography, and tiny sparkling streams of symbols: dodecahedrons, leaves, owls, and gears. Mirror or respond to the choreography of the avatars in poses or dance, and take photos with them in the app. If you discover the secret, you may feel seen indeed. What do you intend to remember?

events.title: My/Mochi Joyfully Chill Ice Cream Shoppe
events.description: My/Mochi, the original and world's largest mochi ice cream brand, is inviting SXSW-goers to Taste the Joy! Our delightfully delicious ice cream wrapped in pillowy sweet rice dough comes in more than 20 flavors like Cookie Dough, Strawberry and Mango. So stop by our Joyfully Chill Ice Cream Shoppe at the Congress Ave Block Party Mar 12-18 to experience the joy for yourself!

events.title: The Painterland Sisters' Yogurt Farm Stand
events.description: Step into the Painterland Sisters' Yogurt Farm Stand to sample our organic skyr yogurt and for hands-on farm education. Learn what organic regenerative farming really means, explore sensory elements from the farm, and taste some simply yummy skyr yogurt packed with probiotics and protein. Straight from the pasture to your spoon - made with love!

events.title: SXSW Expo: XR Experience
events.description:
Virtual reality, augmented reality, and mixed reality technologies are finding new ways to enhance our ability to perceive the world that surrounds us and redefining how we experience it. The projects presented in our XR Experience emphasize storytelling and art in the immersive world. Come immerse yourself in the most creative minds of the world at the SXSW XR Experience.

See the floor plan here: https://sxsw2026-xr.expofp.com/

events.title: The Verdadero 360 Tequila Experience
events.description:
The Verdadero 360 Tequila Experience is a 21+ tasting and education experience designed to let guests experience the Spirit For More. Guests sample different expressions while learning about agave, craftsmanship, and what sets Verdadero apart. The experience encourages curiosity, conversation, and connection. A 360 photo booth allows guests to capture and share the moment.

Check us out on Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/verdaderotequila/

events.title: XR Experience Competition
events.description: World premieres of mind bending immersive art.

events.title: XR Experience Special Events
events.description: Celebrating exciting, out-of-the-box ways artists are using technology to bring their art to life.

events.title: XR Experience Spotlight
events.description: Masterful immersive art from around the world.

events.title: Do You Love Me
events.description: "Do You Love Me" is a playful and personal journey through Lebanon’s audiovisual memory, composed entirely of archival footage. It is a love letter to Beirut, spanning 70 years of film, TV, home videos, and photography, exploring the Lebanese collective psyche - marked by joy and intimacy, destruction and loss. Through the eyes of citizens, filmmakers and artists, the film reconstructs a fragmented history in a country without a national archive, celebrating creative expression as both resistance, renewal and a way to preserve memory.

events.title: The Life We Leave
events.description: When Washington state became the first in the world to legalize human composting, entrepreneur Micah Truman puts it all on the line to build the world's first large-scale terramation facility. But when the conventional deathcare industry resists, he is forced to pivot, and must learn to care for the grieving while transforming his business.  Alongside Funeral Directors, Brie Smith and Katey Houston, he begins to understand the double bottom line is the only way to truly profit. What begins as an ambitious venture becomes personal as they rediscover human connection, ritual, and legacy.

events.title: Matt Carmichael Book Signing
events.description: Matt Carmichael will be signing copies of “Meeting My Heroes” at the SXSW Bookstore.

events.title: SXSW Community Service Awards Recognition: DAWA
events.description: The SXSW Community Service Awards celebrate leaders and non-profit organizations from Austin and around the world who work tirelessly to improve the standing of the specific groups and causes that they serve.Jonathan 'Chaka' Mahone is a visionary storyteller who believes in the power of art, and the importance of the artist as a community catalyst for social and cultural change, economic development, healing, planning, and collective conversation.   As a performing artist and musician, he has traveled the world as one-half of the award-winning hip hop duo, Riders Against the Storm (RAS). As a civic leader, Mahone became the first African-American Chair of Austin's Music Commission in 2021.  After more than a decade pushing through barriers constructed by the historic race and genre biases of Austin's music industry, he founded DAWA (a Swahili, Hindi, and Arabic word for medicine), in 2019 to provide a safety net for People of Color that are experiencing short term life crisis. More specifically, people of color who are givers: musicians, artists, social workers, teachers, healing practitioners, and service industry workers.  Through its mission of giving to the givers, and its vision of centering community and culture to drive social impact, DAWA (Diversity Awareness and Wellness in Action) has directly invested over a half million dollars in this group over the last 6 years.

speakers.name: Chaka Mahone
speakers.title: Founder/Director
speakers.company: DAWA (Diversity Awareness and Wellness in Action)

events.title: #Skyking
events.description: In exclusive interviews and air traffic control audio, #SKYKING tells the story of Horizon Air ground service agent Richard “Beebo” Russell, who clocked into work, stole a $33 million plane, and took off into the skies of the Pacific Northwest—embarking on a white-knuckle flight that came to embody the hopes, dreams, and despair of the American working class.

events.title: Agents & Managers Mentor Session: Daniel Leap (Independent Artist Group)
events.description: Meeting with this mentor is highly recommended if you're interested in Screenwriting, Narrative Filmmakers, Agents & Managers, Development.
