events.description: Meeting with this mentor is highly recommended if you're interested in Storytelling, Marketing/Advertising/PR.

events.title: Agents & Managers Mentor Session: Richard Botto (Stage 32)
events.description: Meeting with this mentor is highly recommended if you're interested in Agents & Managers, Screenwriting, International.

events.title: AI Infrastructure: Building Stargate & Beyond
events.description:
The AI revolution has changed how we work, play, and more. It is also driving a major shift in the backend infrastructure that powers these developments.

As AI capabilities accelerate, leading tech companies are moving beyond software and into the physical world of data centers, power, and infrastructure. Why? Because the future of intelligence now depends as much on electricity and silicon as it does on algorithms.

In this session, OpenAI pulls back the curtain on what it really takes to scale AI today. The conversation explores how data center development has become mission-critical, how decisions about where to build are made, and what happens when AI growth collides with real-world limits such as energy, land, and supply chains.

From energy partnerships to site selection, this conversation will reveal how data center development has shaped the landscape in nearby locations – such as OpenAI’s Stargate facility in Abilene, Texas – and perhaps someday far away in Earth’s orbit.

speakers.name: Justin Haan
speakers.title: Partner and Chair of Technology Transactions Group

events.title: AI, Advertising & The Attention Economy
events.description: The average person sees 10,000+ ads daily but remembers almost none. Advertising has an attention crisis and AI is both the cause and the cure. This panel brings together technologists and brand strategists who are rebuilding the advertising stack from first principles: replacing passive impressions with interactive, AI-native content that earn genuine human engagement. We'll unpack what "attention" actually means in an era of generative content, why the next ad format won't look like a video, and what brands must do now before the attention window closes entirely.

events.title: AI: Friend or Foe of DEIB?
events.description:
Headlines warn that AI is hurting DEIB—propagating bias, reinforcing stereotypes, and risking the erasure of marginalized groups and their histories. Yet the same technology has the potential to uncover bias, scale representation, and raise the bar for inclusion at the brand, industry, academic, and societal levels.

With a consumer-focused lens, panelists from MAC Cosmetics, the UN, NYU, and Responsible AI company, SeeMe Index, will explore both sides of the equation: where AI’s blind spots have failed us, where it’s driving progress, and what it takes to ensure technology reflects the world we want to see.

speakers.name: Dr. Fadia Nordtveit
speakers.title: Assistant Professor of Communications / Faculty, Researcher and Consultant

events.title: Architects of Emotion: Designing for Human Connection
events.description: Today’s most iconic venues are more than just architectural marvels; they’re immersive, tech-powered environments designed to bring people together. Join leaders in architecture and brand experience to explore how large-scale stadiums and next-gen immersive destinations are crafted to amplify emotion, ignite human connection, and become part of the stories unfolding within them. These venues go beyond just aesthetics to create shared experiences that resonate long after the moment.

speakers.name: Tyler Washburn
speakers.title: Senior Vice President Venues and Experience

events.title: Bird Lovers Meet Up
events.description: Whether you’re an experienced bird watcher or just appreciate the beauty and magic of birds, all are welcome to join us at the Bird Lovers Meet Up at SXSW! Really, who doesn't love birds?!?! Hosted by journalist and Birds & Nerds podcast host Ramona Schindelheim and National Audubon Society vice president Glynnis Breen.

events.title: Building the Voices of the Future: Redefining Leadership in Music
events.description: In an industry historically shaped by hierarchy and fear-based leadership, a new generation of executives is proving that true influence comes from empowerment, inclusion, and collective accountability. This high-level panel brings together senior leaders from across the music industry to explore how shifting from “I” to “we,” is not only transforming workplace culture - it’s building stronger creative output. Through real stories, we’ll examine how valuing every voice - whether front-facing or behind the scenes - is essential to creating the future of our industry.

events.title: The Courage to Diverge: Charting Your Own Career in Healthcare
events.description: We often look up to those who follow their own path, but the journey there was usually not as easy as it seems. This conversation will touch on the panelist’s individual experiences of charting her own career in healthcare and how she weathered setbacks along the way, while sharing practical tips for how others can draw courage to diverge in their professional journeys.

events.title: Design Trends That Matter
events.description: It’s not news that we’re living in an era of transformation. But what is the role of design in shaping our future? And what is the responsibility of designers? The annual iF Design Trend Report seeks detailed answers. In this dynamic panel, three trailblazing design leaders come together to preview the international design institute’s top insights for 2026. Building on their decades of interdisciplinary expertise, panelists will explore intersectional topics such as autonomous vehicles, humanoid robots, emerging education, multisensory marketing, and much more. For those who love great design!

speakers.name: Nick Foster
speakers.title: Futures Designer, Author, and former Head of Design at Google X

speakers.name: Lisa Gralnek
speakers.title: US Managing Director and Global Head of Sustainability & Impact

speakers.name: Doreen Lorenzo
speakers.title: Assistant Dean, School of Design and Creative Technology
speakers.company: The University of Texas at Austin

events.title: Drift
events.description: Isaac “Drift” Wright, a self-taught photographer and Army veteran haunted by trauma, finds healing through breathtaking, illegal climbs of the world’s tallest structures. But his pursuit of art sparks a high-stakes battle with law enforcement in this intimate portrait of risk, resilience, and freedom in modern America.

events.title: Edie Arnold is a Loser
events.description: Timid dork Edie accidentally takes the spotlight when she starts a punk band with her fellow “turds”, becoming an icon to the rest of the losers at her all-girls Catholic school while managing to piss off the hot girls, the nuns, and the horniest altar boy you’ve ever seen.

events.title: Eternal Icons: Tetris, Sonic & The Art of Timeless Play
events.description: Some stories never fade—they evolve. This session explores how iconic franchises like Tetris and Sonic continue to shape culture and spark creativity. Maya Rogers, President & CEO of Tetris, and Shuji Utsumi, President & COO of SEGA, share how legacy IP adapts to new generations and drives innovation. Moderated by Greg Off, a 20-year game industry veteran and CEO of creative agency Off Base, this panel dives into the enduring power—and future—of beloved entertainment worlds.

events.title: Featured Session: Make Your Own Wave: Russ & Andreea Gleeson on Independence
events.description: Chart topping artist/actor/author Russ sits down with TuneCore Chief Executive Officer Andreea Gleeson to discuss his path to success as an independent artist and the nontraditional fan engagement, release strategies, and alternative revenue streams that have paved the way for global stardom. From the foundation of his label DIEMON to his stint on the Columbia roster, his triumphant return to independence and the success of his latest Billboard chart topping album W!LD, Russ has built a career as a modern renaissance man on his own terms and serves as an inspiration for other aspiring artists.

events.title: Featured Session: Real-World Impact of AI: Opportunities, Risks and Intellectual Property Oh My!
events.description: AI is the most transformative technology of our generation. This session explores the promise and perils of AI, sharing concrete examples of how AI is being applied with impact by businesses, creators and others to drive operational efficiency, enhance customer experiences, increase revenues and augment creativity. The audience will also learn about the risks associated with AI including some novel intellectual property issues (IP) posed, and how to weigh opportunities with risks. The insights shared are from a speaker who has built AI solutions and been at the top levels of technology, law, business and government and boardroom, all of which perspectives are critical to the successful AI applications.

events.title: Finding My Soul in Chinatown: The Making of an Accidental Activist
events.description: Grace Young — James Beard Humanitarian of the Year — never planned on becoming an activist. But when the pandemic gutted America’s Chinatowns she went from cookbook author to the unexpected frontline advocate for America’s Chinatowns. In this talk, she unpacks how personal storytelling, chance encounters, and cultural memories fueled her pivot into activism. Her story challenges you to define your own purpose—and inspires you to show up, push boundaries and take action for the communities and causes you care about.

events.title: From Neanderthal DNA to the Dark Genome: Diversity Explained
events.description: What sets modern humans apart from our cave-dwelling ancestors? The answer: genetic variations that may have hindered Neanderthals from advancing socially & technologically. That's according to Alysson Muotri, PhD, whose work creating brain organoids from stem cells — & studying them on Earth & in space — is shedding light on the factors that make present-day people unique — & especially susceptible to neurological conditions like Alzheimer's & autism. Plus: how the Dark Genome might shape personality, & why it all matters for the future of human aging, medicine, & the colonization of Mars.

speakers.name: Dr. Alysson Muotri, PhD
speakers.title: Director
speakers.company: Sanford Integrated Space Stem Cell Orbital Research (ISSCOR) Center

events.title: The Future of Truth: How AI Reshapes Reality
events.description: Truth has never been straightforward. But now, AI offers to solve it—filter the noise, rank the sources, settle the debate. We’re told it’ll help us see clearly across politics, science, work, art, and justice. But what if the answers it gives us come with hidden terms? In this talk, Steven Rosenbaum unpacks the uneasy promise of algorithmic truth—and what’s lost when machines start shaping what counts as real. The Future of Truth: How AI Shapes Reality.

events.title: Generative Ghosts: AI Afterlives & the Future of Memory
events.description:
As generative AI systems and AI agents increasingly model individuals, both living and dead, we find ourselves on the verge of a new kind of digital immortality. “Generative ghosts” are AI-based simulations that evoke or imitate human beings, created through personal data, online traces, or speculative design. But what are the social, ethical, and emotional consequences of engaging with these digital afterlives?

This panel brings together thought leaders from academia and industry to explore the benefits and risks of AI-generated personas.

speakers.name: Meredith Ringel Morris
speakers.title: Director and Principal Scientist for Human-AI Interaction

events.title: Hey Marketers: Get Out of the Feed and Into the Chat
events.description: The internet has gone quiet, at full volume. Public feeds are louder than ever, but the most meaningful conversations - and the real signals of what people actually care about - are now happening in private spaces. According to GIPHY's research, 90 percent of people share major life updates in group chats before they post them publicly. More than half of Gen Z says their chat knows them better than their family. And every day, 50 percent more GIFs are sent than voice memos. This talk goes inside the shift from public to private sharing, and what it means for brands, creators, and communicators.

events.title: How to Build AI-First Products: Models, Memory, Mastery
events.description: AI is reshaping how we build software products—from conversational UX to fast-evolving AI models that can upend product roadmaps and even entire products. In this session, a leading product exec and a Wharton AI expert share how to design products powered by large language models. You'll learn how AI is reshaping product roles, what it takes to build with ever-evolving models, and why great UX now means thinking in conversations, not clicks.

speakers.name: Kartik Hosanagar
speakers.title: John C. Hower Professor of Operations, Information and Decisions; Co-Director, Wharton Human-AI Research
speakers.company: The Wharton School at the University of Pennsylvania

speakers.name: Aparna Chennapragada
speakers.title: Chief Product Officer of Microsoft Experiences and Devices

events.title: I Think of You Dying: Storytelling That Stings (and Stays)
events.description: Bland is forgettable—and in today's content-saturated world, forgettable is fatal. This session explores how emotionally evocative, creatively risky campaigns like Life360’s “I Think of You Dying”—which tapped into the quiet fear every parent holds—confront the gap between what people truly feel and what brands are willing to say. Hear from creative leaders who are leaning into discomfort to reflect human truths and challenge taboos. The conversation will explore boundaries, backlash, and how pushing limits can drive impact when rooted in authenticity and deep audience understanding.

events.title: Latine/x Voices in Film: Creatives Meet-Up!
events.description: Join Cine Las Americas to celebrate local Latine/x voices in film and the vibrant creative community thriving in Austin. This is a chance to connect with international filmmakers and engage with a platform dedicated to amplifying Latine/x stories. Cine Las Americas, alongside organizations like Malakita Productions and filmmaker Alejandro Pedemonte, showcase how local talent shapes the global film landscape.  Whether you're seeking collaboration, inspiration, or a pathway to share your vision, we invite you to connect and be a part of this vibrant growing community.

events.title: Love Language
events.description: Following a failed engagement, Louisa "Lou" Klaussner, an aspiring author who pays the bills by writing social media copy for a tortilla chip company, falls into a side hustle writing wedding vows for other people. When Lou reconnects with her college best-friend and long-time crush Warren, she is shocked to find he is the fiancé of one of Lou's wedding vow clients… putting Lou in the middle of a complicated love-rectangle.

events.title: Momentum is Everything: How to Build Hype Before the Drop
events.description: The teams behind John Summit, FKA Twigs, and The Beaches know every drop needs momentum to land. In this panel, Laylo CEO Alec Ellin sits down with Wasserman Music SVP of Marketing Sam Alpert and AWAL Director of Digital Marketing Shelby Rosenthal to explore how top artists drive fan attention ahead of on-sale day. From surprise superfan presales to Instagram teasers, merch pop-ups, and more, we’ll break down the strategies that fuel demand and drive fans to take action.

events.title: The New Producers Building the Post-DEI Hollywood Playbook
events.description: As DEI loses institutional backing, a new class of underrepresented producers is rewriting the rules—building hit content, creative power, and commercial leverage on their own terms. This session explores how to turn crisis into strategy, pitching into deals, and representation into real returns. For anyone ready to produce boldly in a cautious industry, this is the roadmap to navigating—and thriving—in post-DEI Hollywood.

events.title: Pharma vs. Supplements: Breaking the False Health Dichotomy
events.description: The future of health isn't about choosing between pharmaceuticals and supplements – it's about understanding how both can work together. This panel explores the need for science-backed supplementation as food systems evolve and health challenges become more complex. We'll break down the false dichotomy between pharmaceuticals and natural supplements, highlighting how reactive medicine and proactive supplementation can coexist. Through expert insights, we'll bridge pharmaceutical literacy with supplement science, empowering consumers to make informed decisions about integrative nutrition.

speakers.name: Simon Hill, MSc, BSc
speakers.title: Nutritionist, physiotherapist, author, and podcast host

events.title: Pizza Movie
events.description: It’s a Friday night and college students Jack and Montgomery have got big plans: They’re going to do drugs and order pizza. But when the home-made drug they ingest turns out to be MUCH wilder than they thought, the simple journey down two flights of stairs to retrieve their pie becomes a mind-bindingly transformative quest. Still though, how hard can it be? The only thing in their way is a broken elevator, Montgomery’s social anxiety, the fact that everybody in the school hates Jack, a sociopathic RA, a vengeful butterfly, a robot with a dream, and this insane drug that has absolutely no regard for the basic laws of reality.

events.title: Psychedelics Meet Up
events.description: Join the conversation shaping the future of psychedelics and connect with curious minds from around the globe. Whether you're just exploring or a seasoned psychonaut, you're invited to dive into meaningful dialogue, forge new connections, and contribute to a growing movement. Together, let’s co-create a vibrant, inclusive psychedelic community.

events.title: Publicity and Marketing Mentor Session: Greg Longstreet (Empirical)
events.description: Meeting with this mentor is highly recommended if you're interested in Agents & Managers, Publicity & Marketing, Screenwriting.

events.title: Publicity and Marketing Mentor Session: Scott Feinstein (42West)
events.description: Meeting with this mentor is highly recommended if you're interested in Publicity & Marketing, "Sales, Acquisitions, & Distribution", Narrative Filmmakers.

events.title: Restorative by Design: Reimagining Wellbeing for Our Cities
events.description: What if true well-being comes not from self-optimization but from collective care? This session explores how we can design public spaces for rest, connection, and restoration. Industry experts share why parks, bathhouses, and shared spaces matter more than ever. From global traditions and new urban experiments, they make the case for new public institutions reviving communal well-being outside of commodified services or tech-driven wellness.

events.title: Round Table: Programming: Brennan Tilley, Rachel Walker, and Raul Benitez
events.description: An extension of our popular Mentor Sessions, our Round Table Sessions not only allow attendees to learn from the industry experts that sit at each of the three tables in this session but they also allow attendees to learn from the questions and experiences of their peers as well. This Round Table Session will bring together industry experts and SXSW attendees for an enlightening discussion on  Programming.

speakers.name: Raul Benitez
speakers.title: Film Programmer
speakers.company: Chicago Underground Film Festival, Midwest Film Festival

events.title: Separating science from science fiction in business content
events.description: One skill never goes out of demand: clear, memorable communication. No matter who you’re designing for, your words and visuals need to stick. But most of what we’re taught about content design is well-intended fiction From “just keep it simple” to “use more pictures,” we follow rules that feel right, but often backfire. There’s no shortage of advice on how to design content that sticks in memory, but how much of it is backed by brain science? This session explores how myths related to repetition, emotion, complexity, imagery and more influence all aspects of user design and experience.

events.title: SpectreVision Radio Live: Ghost In The Machine: Technology, Archetype and The Sacred
events.description:
What if the next frontier of technology isn’t faster phones or smarter algorithms, but a synthesis with the sacred? 
From oracle traditions to large language models, from spirit boards to neural networks, technology has always mirrored our metaphysics. Can AI act as oracle, mirror, muse, even psychopomp? What happens when machines begin speaking in sacred symbols and mythic patterns? Adler will share insights from developing Moods, her AI platform trained on esoteric and psychological frameworks, while Phillip traces the historic entanglement between paranormal belief and technological innovation.

events.title: Tech Marketers Meet Up
events.description: Calling all Tech Marketers attending SXSW. We’re hosting a dedicated meetup for tech marketers to connect, swap notes, and talk shop. Whether you're looking to discuss the latest in AI-driven advertising or want to hear which new vendors your peers are actually excited about, this is the place to be. See you there!

events.title: UNCOMPETE: Choosing Collaboration Over Competition
events.description: The need to compete is deeply ingrained in every aspect of our lives and work. It’s often viewed as a positive: we are told it motivates us to do our best, to work hard, that it drives innovation and excellence. But, what if that’s a lie? In this session, Ruchika T. Malhotra, in conversation with author, speaker and HBR editor Amy Gallo, offers a new framework for flourishing at work and in life, by highlighting five key principles to mythbust what we've been taught about competition, rewrite the rules, and build cultures of collaboration, solidarity, and mutuality—that lift everyone up.

speakers.name: Ruchika T. Malhotra
speakers.title: Founder of Candour, a global inclusion strategy firm and author of Uncompete: Rejecting Competition to Unlock Success.

events.title: What Happens When Software Can Transact Autonomously?
events.description:
Autonomous AI agents are moving beyond recommendations to making decisions and executing transactions on our behalf—reshaping the shopping journey itself. As commerce becomes software-mediated, experiences are increasingly optimized for machines, not humans, changing discovery, choice, and brand interaction. While agent-led commerce reduces friction, it raises new questions around trust and accountability.

This session explores how agentic commerce reshapes incentives for merchants, platforms, developers, and consumers, and introduces the technical frameworks enabling agent-led transactions.

events.title: Why Music Platforms Care About Live Music
events.description: Major music streaming services are focusing more on live music including showcasing concert dates. What’s driving this shift, and what does it mean for artists, promoters, and the broader live music ecosystem?  This panel will delve into the economic and cultural forces shaping the intersection of live and digital music.

speakers.name: Ali Rivera
speakers.title: Head of Live Music & Artist Partnerships

events.title: You, Reorged: The Future of Marketing Careers
events.description: AI is transforming marketing careers, not just the work itself. According to the 2025 CMO Survey, 17.2% of marketing efforts now involve AI and machine learning, with that share expected to reach 44.2% within three years. Traditional career paths are shifting, especially in fast-moving areas like advertising and branding, and hybrid roles like strategist plus prompt engineer are becoming the new norm. This panel dives into how to adapt, build in-demand skills, and navigate a career path that looks very different from even five years ago.

events.title: Goldie Chan Book Signing
events.description: Goldie Chan will be signing copies of “Personal Branding for Introverts” at the SXSW Bookstore.

events.title: Jack Johnson: SURFILMUSIC
events.description: An intimate look into Jack Johnson’s evolution from surfer to filmmaker to world-renowned musician. The documentary traces how his early years making surf films with close friends became a foundation for a much broader creative life, capturing moments in and out of the water that later surfaced in his songwriting. Blending rare footage from those formative surf films and Johnson's personal and family archives with present-day reflections, the film weaves together how lived experience, friendship, and exploration shaped the sound and stories behind the music.

events.title: Asia x Austin Summit
events.description:
**RSVP REQUIRED** FREE for SXSW badge-holders. Positioned at the peak of the SXSW schedule, the Asia x Austin Summit is the premier destination for international delegates, tech founders, and civic leaders to explore the "two-way highway" of opportunity between Asia and the Greater Austin region. Join us for a full day of high-stakes insights, venture-focused pitches, and cross-border networking, all capped off by an immersive film- and pop culture-themed afterparty overlooking the Austin skyline.

https://bit.ly/gaacc-summit-2026

events.title: Basic
events.description: After Gloria and Nick break up, Gloria takes us through Nick's dating history, untangling his web of ex-girlfriends through details she can find online. But when she discovers Kaylinn, the hottest most basic ex-girlfriend to ever exist, Gloria not only loses herself, she loses control of the story she's been telling.  Basic is a comedy that blends the magical-realism of jealous paranoia with the magic of falling in love.

events.title: High Score Game Arcade presents the Worldwide Tic-Tac-Toe Championship
events.description:
The Worldwide Tic Tac Toe Championship comes to its final, high-stakes moment at SXSW. After months of play across cities and communities around the world, this activation marks the culmination of a global tournament—bringing finalists, fans, and curious passersby together for live competition, spectacle, and celebration. Simple rules, universal appeal, and unexpected intensity converge in one last showdown where strategy, speed, and bragging rights are decided in real time.

More information here: highscoregamearcade.com

events.title: Monitor
events.description: Maggie works as a content moderator for VueQ Moderation Services, spending her days filtering the internet’s darkest content, driven by guilt over her sister's suicide.  When Maggie blocks a cryptic video uploaded by an anonymous user, she and her team begin to be hunted by an insidious entity that haunts them through every screen in their lives.

events.title: Music Cities Meet Up
events.description:
Across the U.S., music communities are changing, how people make music, how they earn a living, how venues operate, and how cities respond. This meet-up brings together musicians, venue owners and operators, promoters, industry professionals, city staff, and community advocates working in music scenes of all sizes to discuss how local music scenes evolve and adapt. 

The meetup is designed for anyone who cares about the future of local music, whether you are deeply embedded in your community or simply curious about how music ecosystems function and survive. Attendees will leave with new connections, shared language, and a clearer sense of how others are navigating similar challenges in different cities.

speakers.name: Julia Heath
speakers.title: Policy & Outreach Manager
speakers.company: New Orleans Mayor’s Office Of Nighttime Economy

events.title: The Pirate King
events.description: Returning stateside, Todd Gillis struggles to hold down work due to his condition and trauma from his time in Afghanistan . When his ex-wife sues for custody of his beloved daughter, Emmylou, Todd hits rock bottom. In an effort to impress his case appointed judge, Todd joins a pirate re-enactment crew that his daughter is fond of. Through a newfound community Todd begins a journey of healing he never expected.

events.description: The historic Brazos Hall is the official Innovation Clubhouse for 2026. It's the perfect place to connect with attendees looking to gain insights and inspiration from like-minded conference-goers. Each day the Innovation Clubhouse will host meetups and networking events as well as activations.

events.title: SXSW Music Clubhouse
events.description: The Music Clubhouse is located at The Downright Austin. Perfect for networking and industry connections, the Clubhouse will also feature live performances at Radio Day Stage and mentor sessions. It’s also the perfect spot to access most of our music venues by foot or a quick rideshare. Each day the Music Clubhouse will host meetups and networking events as well as activations.

events.title: Vibrating Music Hammocks
events.description:
The Music Hammock transforms its fabric into a speaker, resonating your body with the frequencies of the music so you feel as if you’re lying inside a sound system. In our fast-paced society, we often disconnect from our bodies. This installation offers a full-body listening experience, shifting your attention from mental chatter into physical awareness. Experience sound not only through your ears, but through your entire body.

events.title: XOT Energy House
events.description: XOT Energy House lands at the SXSW Artist Lounge as a dynamic space built to fuel creativity. This experience invites artists and attendees to recharge with XOT Energy while connecting through music, culture, and movement. Blending vibrant fruits and high-energy moments, the XOT Energy House becomes a hub for discovery, expression, and inspiration throughout SXSW.
events.venue: Downright Hotel - Creekside Room & Outdoor Patio

events.title: Beast Race (Corrida dos Bichos)
events.description: Sometime in the future, Rio de Janeiro lies in ruins—its society fractured by class warfare, its people consumed by a brutal spectacle known as the Beast Race. In this high-stakes competition, masked runners tear through a devastated city while the elite wager on their lives. Every runner must pledge a collateral: a human life condemned to the mysterious, dreaded Coast of Hell if they lose. Mano leads the Death Perimeter, a rebel zone devoted to dismantling the race. But when he discovers his younger sister has been offered as collateral by her boyfriend, Mano is forced to do the unthinkable: enter the race he’s spent his life resisting.

events.title: Mike & Nick & Nick & Alice
events.description: “Mike & Nick & Nick & Alice” is a hilarious, stylized, R-rated action-comedy about two gangsters and the woman they love trying to survive the most dangerous night of their lives. As if that wasn’t enough, there’s one wild ingredient added to the mix: a time machine. The film, which will premiere March 27, 2026, exclusively on Hulu, stars Vince Vaughn, James Marsden, Eiza González, Keith David, Jimmy Tatro, Stephen Root, Lewis Tan, Ben Schwartz, Emily Hampshire, and Arturo Castro, and is written and directed by BenDavid Grabinski, produced by Andrew Lazar, p.g.a., and executive produced by Richard Middleton and Vanessa Humphrey.

events.title: UK XR Takeover
events.description:
Join us for an exciting and informative afternoon at the annual UK XR Takeover. Sessions will ask: who gets to build immersive worlds; whose stories are embedded within them, and how can international cultural infrastructure support an equitable global XR landscape? Future Art and Culture is produced by British Underground and Arts Council England with partnership support from the British Council.

For more information, please visit: https://futureartandculture.com/
events.venue: British Music Embassy @ Palm Door on Sixth

events.title: Adam's Apple
events.description: "Adam's Apple" is an intimate, collaborative documentary told through the dual perspectives of Adam, a transgender teen, and his mother, visual artist Amy Jenkins, that offers an authentic and tender counterpoint to the hostility facing trans youth today. Adam’s journey balances the milestones of gender transition with the rhythms of adolescence. As Adam asserts his identity and steps out into the world, his parents grapple with the challenges of raising a teen while learning to let go. Through a visually poetic approach, the film transforms a deeply personal archive, collected over two decades, into a powerful, joyful testament to the beauty and difficulty of reckoning with profound change.

events.title: The Man with the Big Hat
events.description:
An unsung pioneer of 1970s Texas Progressive Country, Steven Fromholz had a knack for snatching defeat from the jaws of victory. Revered by legends like Willie Nelson, Lyle Lovett & John Denver, he remained commercially unknown. He sought redemption on the Rio Grande as a river guide until a debilitating stroke erased his musical memory, stripping Fromholz of his artistic identity.
This intimate and impressionistic portrayal, bolstered by newly discovered archives as well as never-before-heard recordings, unveils the evolution of Fromholz, and reshapes the notion of success and artistic fortitude.

events.title: Hall of Fame Induction: José Andrés
events.description:
The SXSW Hall of Fame recognizes those trendsetters whose career accomplishments have paved the future in a variety of industries. These honorees inspire the SXSW community with their creativity and hard work in the digital industries.For 2026 José Andrés will be the inductee to the Hall of Fame.Named one of Time’s “100 Most Influential People” in both 2012 and 2018 and recipient of the Presidential Medal of Freedom, José Andrés is an internationally recognized chef, restaurateur, humanitarian, and NY Times bestselling author.
 
A pioneer of Spanish tapas in the United States, he is also known for his groundbreaking avant-garde cuisine and his award-winning group of nearly forty restaurants. José Andrés Group’s concepts include the two Michelin-starred minibar by José Andrés in Washington, DC, the acclaimed NYC food hall Mercado Little Spain, and multiple locations of the Bazaar by José Andrés. He has been awarded the James Beard Foundation’s “Outstanding Chef” and "Humanitarian of the Year” awards, and in 2023 received an Emmy Award for Outstanding Culinary Series for his show “José Andrés and Family in Spain."
 
Andrés is a committed advocate of food and hunger issues and is known for championing the role of chefs in the national debate on food policy. In 2010, he formed World Central Kitchen, a non-profit specializing in delivering food relief in the wake of natural and humanitarian disasters that has served nearly a billion hot meals worldwide. A decade after he introduced his pioneering college course “The World on a Plate," Andrés launched the Global Food Institute, a partnership with George Washington University to develop innovative new food policies and train the next generation of leaders.

events.title: AI, Your Brain & the Battle for Cognitive Sovereignty
events.description: AI tools rewrite emails, generate ideas, even decide what we see and when. But will they make us lazier thinkers—or force us to think beyond? Will it make us think more clearly or manipulate our perspectives? Will it widen the cognitive gap between rich and poor? Are our neuro-rights protected by design—or will screen time just be optimized again? In this live debate, you’ll pick a side: is AI expanding or eroding our minds? Expect sharp provocations, real-time participation, and one rule: you can’t outsource your thinking here. Join the battle for cognitive sovereignty.

events.title: The AI-Powered Bionic Revolution Has Already Begun
events.description: As AI, robotics, and economies of scale converge, a new era of human enhancement is emerging. In this session, bionic limb pioneer Aadeel Akhtar reveals how shared breakthroughs between robots and humans are transforming assistive tech into accessible, intelligent extensions of the body. From real-time adaptive control to mass-producible bionic hands, this is a glimpse into a future where disability is no longer a limitation and AI is rewriting what the human body can do.

events.title: The Anime Advantage: Brand Strategy Meets Cultural Power
events.description: Anime is no longer a niche! It’s one of today’s most powerful tools for extending franchises, reimagining IP, and reaching global audiences. This panel, with leaders from Crunchyroll,  Major League Baseball, and Twitch, explores how talent, brands, and creators are using anime as both a narrative and business engine to fuel next-gen storytelling. For musicians, athletes, game studios, and fashion labels, anime offers a dynamic, fan-forward way to build immersive worlds, show up meaningfully in pop culture, and engage loyal audiences that drive long-term brand equity.

speakers.name: Robin Tilotta
speakers.title: Head Of Brand And Gtm Marketing

speakers.name: Uzma Rawn Dowler
speakers.title: Chief Marketing Officer & SVP of Global Corporate Partnerships

speakers.name: Darren Traub

events.title: The Art of Attracting an Audience
events.description: With people exposed to up to 10,000 calls to action every day, it’s becoming increasingly difficult and expensive for organizations and personal brands to attract audiences. While many believe that more money leads to more awareness, and thus, more audience, research consistently shows otherwise. In fact, aggressive campaigns can backfire when people feel they’re being sold to. The magical key in effective campaigning is rooted in behavioral science, and during this session, people will learn how to create resonating campaigns from crafting communications all the way to advertising techniques.

events.title: Artist Demo Listening Session: Pop (Part 2)
events.description: Artist Demo Listening Sessions, Presented by Discovr Radio, at SXSW are an interactive format where attendees have the opportunity to play demos for music experts, sparking real-time feedback and meaningful industry connections. You must be present to have your music in the running to be heard! SXSW attendees not having demos played are encouraged to attend and listen in on the fun! Each session will be followed up a social hour. Physical submissions will not be accepted at the door. Demo’s will be played on a first-come, first-served basis and attendees must submit their demo’s prior to the day of the session  by 11:59pm.  Please carefully read and fill out the form below to officially submit your demo: https://airtable.com/appYFNh7bkKd8nmwh/pagfBEWaVPizme5jr/form

events.title: Awakening to Light: Returning to Nature’s Rhythm
events.description: Light shapes biology. When spectrum and timing drift, circadian rhythms falter, degrading sleep, cognition, and long-term health. We move from hard science to possibility: technology that calibrates light to natural circadian cues, paired with daily practices - meditation, breath, mindful routines - to restore rhythm.

events.title: Behind the Scenes: Empowering Production with AI Tools
events.description: While generative AI dominates headlines, the true AI revolution in film and television is happening behind the scenes. From automated script breakdowns that assist with casting, budgeting, and identifying visual effects opportunities, to real-time compliance tools for flagging mature content themes, to simplified contract review for summarizing rights and talent obligations, artificial intelligence is transforming how film and television are planned, produced, and delivered. This panel unpacks how AI is streamlining production behind the scenes and raising new legal questions.

speakers.name: Dan Scharf
speakers.title: Head of Global Business Operations, Amazon MGM Studios

speakers.name: Ajay Patel
speakers.title: Global Head of Legal, Amazon MGM Studios

events.title: Break the Algorithm: Why Safe Marketing Is Dead
events.description: Playing it safe is the riskiest move a brand can make. In today’s culture, audiences crave authenticity, emotion, and tension - and the boldest campaigns are the ones that break through. Mariana O’Kelly, Executive Creative Director at Leo Chicago, explores how brands that embrace discomfort, controversy, and cultural tension are redefining connection in a crowded media landscape. From transforming missteps into cultural moments to using emotional storytelling that sparks conversation, this session reveals why bold thinking isn’t just creative, it’s essential for growth.

events.title: Designing Great Public Spaces to Power Economic Opportunity
events.description: Featuring the urban visionaries behind NYC's High Line and DC's 11th Street Bridge Park, this session will explore how we can transform America's abandoned spaces – from old rail lines to vacant bridges – into community-built urban oases. Drawing insights from their new book, "Inspiration from the Field," Scott and Kira will inspire park advocates, urban planners, and city-lovers alike to reimagine America’s post-industrial infrastructure as public assets that can connect rather than divide, while unlocking new economic opportunities and scalable investment into neighboring communities.

speakers.name: Scott Kratz
speakers.title: Executive Vice President & 11th Street Bridge Park Founder
speakers.company: 11th Street Bridge Park, Building Bridges Across the River

events.title: Dirty Data: The Hidden Climate Cost of Our Digital Lives
events.description: Data centers are the invisible engines behind AI, streaming, and cloud computing—but their carbon and resource footprints are growing fast. Decarbonizing these energy-hungry systems takes more than clean power; it requires a full-scale rethink of how we design, build, power, cool, and manage digital infrastructure. This panel brings together leaders in carbon capture, battery storage, green building, water management, and high-performance infrastructure to explore how we can decarbonize the digital world—from the foundations up.

events.title: Dissolve Lab: Clear Your Invisible Barrier Without Burnout
events.description: This immersive, hands-on workshop guides participants through The Dissolve: a nervous-system-safe method for moving through invisible barriers without force or burnout. You’ll name your own stuck point, map its emotional signature, and use tools like breathwork, the Feelings Wheel, and guided visualization to shift it. Walk away with a customized clarity map and a gentle, resonant next step—designed to move you forward with ease instead of push.

events.title: Documentary Short Program 2
events.description: Authentic storytelling that captivates, surprises, and excites.
events.venue: Rollins Theatre at the Long Center

events.title: Escape The Internet (Part 1)
events.description:
The internet is in shambles... and it's time to leave it for good. In this game built for a movie theater, you and the audience play as internet refugees armed only with your phones. Your mission? To escape the AI slop apocalypse and reach the Island of Sanctuary, rumoured to be the last good place on the Internet.

From legendary creator Lucas Rizzotto, "Escape The Internet" blends cinema, gaming and theater to create an entirely new genre of live entertainment - one that will make you laugh, cry, and reveal who you - and the ones around you - truly are.

events.title: F*** Productivity: Make Space for Creative Joy
events.description: Constant productivity is killing creativity. It’s time to rethink the hustle and to step back, put down the phone, and skip the weekend doomscroll in order to supercharge your creative output. From neuroscience-backed hacks to ways to create joy in a remote world, like getting your team to do a few jumping jacks to kick off meetings or sending surprise team care packages, you’ll learn ways to rest, recharge, and fuel your best ideas. Because you won’t be replaced by AI, but you might be replaced by someone who knows when not to use it.

events.title: Featured Session: Cast and Creators on HBO's ROOSTER with Steve Carell, Matt Tarses, Bill Lawrence, and more
events.description: Join the cast and creators behind the HBO Original comedy series ROOSTER, from Warner Bros. Television, for a conversation about the making of the show. Panelists include co-showrunners, executive producers, and writers Bill Lawrence ("Ted Lasso,” “Shrinking”) and Matt Tarses ("Scrubs"), along with series stars Steve Carell (“Greg Russo”/EP), Charly Clive (“Katie Russo”), and Danielle Deadwyler (“Dylan Shepherd”).

events.title: Featured Session: The Science of Scaling: Using Data to Decide When—and How Fast—to Scale Revenue
events.description:
Are You Ready to Scale Sales? How Fast?
These two questions are mission-critical to the success of any startup, product launch, or market expansion. Yet, too often we rely on gut feel—or let irrelevant signals like a recent fundraise or comparisons to past unicorns— to drive our decisions.
The Science of Scaling offers a rigorous framework for founders, executives, and investors to calculate the answers using their company’s actual performance data—not wishful thinking.
Drawing on insights from hundreds of startups over the past 25 years, Mark Roberge—Founding CRO at HubSpot, Senior Lecturer at Harvard Business School, and Co-Founder of Stage 2 Capital—reveals the five most common reasons revenue acceleration efforts fail.
Whether you're a founder starting to scale, an investor guiding your portfolio, or a GM launching a new product, The Science of Scaling framework is your operating manual.
Don’t guess. Don’t gamble. Scale scientifically.

events.title: Featured Session:Not All Superheroes Wear Capes: Out of the Kitchen, Into the Comic
events.description:
Throughout history, food and art have served as two of humanity’s most universal languages. This panel explores their powerful intersection: how culinary storytelling and comic books can combine to reach two deeply passionate, nearly obsessive fanbases. From the global influence of Oishinbo to Anthony Bourdain’s Get Jiro, food-focused comics prove that something magical happens when chefs enter the frame.

Following the success of Feeding Dangerously, a graphic novel about his humanitarian organization World Central Kitchen, Chef José Andrés is joining the Marvel Universe to fight—and feed—alongside Spider-Man and friends. Join Andrés, writer Steve Orlando, and Marvel editor Nick Lowe as they discuss the universal appeal of food and comics, and how the two worlds can come together to inspire new audiences.

events.title: Hands-On UX Design for Agentic AI
events.description: 2026 is the year AI goes fully agentic. UX needs to catch up—or risk sinking with the Figma Titanic. This hands-on workshop is your lifeboat, where we will sketch our way to survival through the stormy waters of agentic AI. Using pencils, sticky notes, and an LLM (ChatGPT, Claude, etc.), we'll prototype autonomous agents using RAG, digital twins, and value matrices. Forget perfect pixels. This is low-fidelity, high-velocity UX for AI. The ship is sinking. Let’s design our way out.

events.title: Harnessing AI Without Losing Our Minds: A Playbook
events.description: As AI reshapes everything, how do you pivot your life, career, or company before you’re left behind? Join Jacqueline Corbelli—3x founder and investor, UN and Vatican advisor, and author of Changemaker—for a practical session on navigating inflection points. Drawing on decades of experience transforming companies, Corbelli shares proven solutions to empower individuals and companies, offering a modern framework for using AI, adopting the right mindset, and evolving in a world where five-year plans no longer apply. Are we too early, too late—or right on time?

speakers.name: Jacqueline Corbelli
speakers.title: CEO and Founder of BrightLine / Author of Changemaker: A Modern Playbook

events.title: How AI Enables a Radical Shift in Understanding Your Health
events.description: What would healthcare look like if we could connect the dots? Care today is still episodic and fragmented, without capturing the bigger picture of your health. This conversation brings together clinician and health tech perspectives to explore how interoperability and connecting disparate data, from wearables to health records, holds the promise to unlock personalized preventative health. We’ll discuss how AI-powered tools are closing data and access gaps, while ensuring data safety and privacy, enabling us to turn fragmented health information into whole person care that never clocks out.

speakers.name: Vindell Washington, MD, MS
speakers.title: Chief Clinical Officer & Head of Health Equity

events.title: How Music with Games is Rewriting the Soundtrack of Culture
events.description: The world’s biggest gaming platforms aren’t battlefields, they’re social networks with soundtracks players choose, share, and craft. This panel brings together innovators from STYNGR, Moonsworth (Lunar), Hangout, and the Major Labels to explore how music discovery, creator tools, and community-driven worlds are reshaping the relationship between artists, players, and platforms. Learn how mods, servers, and UGC economies are becoming the next frontier for music engagement and fandom. Join us for an in depth review of how to harness and monetize the power and cultural capital of music

events.title: How To Break Into a Broken Hollywood: Writing Horror in 2026
events.description: Streamers and studios are consolidating, a full third of television production has been cut, people aren't going to the movies as often anymore, and professionals are not only leaving the industry, but the trades have begun reporting when prominent ones do. But you're undeterred. You intend to break in. And many are saying horror is the industry's salvation. Screenwriter and Producer C. Robert Cargill (Sinister, Doctor Strange, The Gorge, The Black Phone) will discuss writing horror for Hollywood, tips and tricks on how to write, sell, and produce, and share what he’s learned about navigating the current environment swollen with unsold scripts.

events.title: HR and HRTech Professionals Meet Up
events.description: Since 2023, the HR and HRTech Professionals Meetup has provided a fantastic opportunity for attendees to engage in thought-provoking conversations. For 2026, as industries continue to transform due to new technologies and shifting behaviors, we aim to provoke high-quality discussions on relevant workplace topics, including the implications of AI in career development, employability and HR core activities, talent engagement and attraction, upskilling and reskilling, leadership, culture, and challenges associated with a multi-generational workforce.

events.title: Humans or AI? What Buyers Prefer, According to Neuroscience
events.description: AI is transforming business interactions, and one question looms large: do customers prefer human connection? Neuroscience offers a unique lens to answer this. This session shares surprising findings from recent studies tracking how buyers’ brains react in real time to AI agents vs. humans, including what makes AI persuasive, where humans outperform, and why AI often wins attention, but not memory. Drawing on brain scans, voice analysis, and eye tracking, this session reveals what’s actually happening inside your customer’s mind when they interact with AI tools and what to do about it.

events.title: International Syncs You're Missing Out on & How to Get Them
events.description: There's a global sync market outside the US that is thriving. And there are key differences to understand if you want to reach them. This curated group of top international music supervisor panelists will discuss not only those key insights but also get practical about how you can tailor your approach to get the attention you need. Whether you're looking to pitch music or become an ad music supervisor yourself, this panel's intention is to be insightful and provide helpful tools for your next steps. The path isn't linear so all are welcome.

events.title: Launching New & Legacy Talent in a Disrupted Music Industry
events.description: This panel convenes a powerhouse group of professionals across talent representation, production, and management to explore what it really takes to break an artist in 2026.

events.title: A More Personal Computer: How AI is Transforming Desktops
events.description: In this session, MacPaw CTO Vira Tkachenko will explore how AI is redefining the concept of the “personal computer,” offering a more intuitive, private, and personalized experience. Drawing on her experience developing for the Apple ecosystem for 17+ years, she will share insights on building AI for macOS. Vira will trace the journey of Macs from their inception and highlight AI trends in software taking place across the industry. Attendees can learn how on-device intelligence enhances productivity, respects user privacy, and keeps the Mac a powerful tool for focused, meaningful work.

events.title: Past is Prologue: Queer History, Legacies & Bold New Futures
events.description: Visionary artists and activists Richie Shazam and Tourmaline come together to discuss the state of queer and trans identity, legacy, resistance, and progress in America today. Following the 2025 release of Tourmaline’s best selling biography of Marsha P. Johnson, and inspired by their own experiences as multi-disciplinary changemakers, this conversation will focus on the exciting and subversive ways that art and activism can intersect and the lessons we can learn from queer history in order to continue building a more authentic and inclusive future.

events.title: PR & Media Professionals Meet Up
events.description:
Join fellow sports, entertainment, and brand communications professionals for a PR and media meetup during SXSW, hosted by Tony Fay Public Relations. This gathering brings together publicists, media strategists, brand leaders, journalists, producers, and marketers working at the intersection of culture, live events, and storytelling.

Designed as a networking opportunity, this meetup is part of the SXSW experience and brings together peers working across sports, entertainment, and brand communications. Attendees can expect engaging conversations around media strategy, brand storytelling, partnerships, live events, and how PR continues to evolve in an increasingly real-time, content-driven landscape.

Whether you’re looking to expand your network, exchange ideas, or reconnect with industry colleagues, all sports, entertainment, and brand PR and media professionals are welcome.

events.description: An extension of our popular Mentor Sessions, our Round Table Sessions not only allow attendees to learn from the industry experts that sit at each of the three tables in this session but they also allow attendees to learn from the questions and experiences of their peers as well. This Round Table Session will bring together industry experts and SXSW attendees for an enlightening discussion on Producing.

events.title: Seeing Is Believing: The Vision Behind Humanoid & Robotic AI
events.description: Humanoids and robots are moving from science fiction to reality, and vision is key to that evolution. Just as our visual cortex allows humans to perceive and adapt, machine vision gives robots the ability to understand, navigate, and interact with the world around them. This session explores how advances in depth sensing, AI compute, and cloud-scale learning are giving humanoids and robots sight, safety, and awareness to operate naturally among us—and what that means for the future of human-robot interaction.

events.title: Shot by Shot: From Music Videos to Feature Films
events.description: In this lively conversation between three filmmakers, you’ll hear how they’ve successfully leapt from directing music videos with famous artists to premiering acclaimed features at top global festivals. Emma Higgins’ debut, Sweetness, world-premiered at SXSW 2025; RT Thorne’s film, 40 Acres, had its US debut at SXSW 2025; and Floria Sigismondi’s film, The Runaways, has achieved cult status in pop culture. They will discuss the transition from the tight budgets of videos to the logistics of securing funding for their own stories and having the creative license to fulfill their visions.

events.title: SpectreVision Radio Live: Some Central Source: Artists Receiving Signals From Outside the Matrix
events.description: Across epochs and mediums, creators have described inspiration not as invention, but reception. Echoing paranormal researcher John Keel’s suggestion that the human brain functions like a receiver picking up signals from “some central source,” comedian/mystical philosopher Duncan Trussell and SpectreVision co-founder/paranormal experiencer Daniel Noah examine the question, is creativity is less about generating ideas and more about tuning in, and if consciousness is a channel rather than a container, who - or what – is broadcasting through us?

speakers.name: Duncan Trussell
speakers.title: Actor, comic, writer, and host of the The Duncan Trussell Family Hour podcast

events.title: TikTok vs. Real Doc? Doctor Approved Biohacking Tips
events.description: We’re drowning in biohacking hype. Billions of social media impressions promise easy health fixes and longer life, but how much is real? This panel cuts through the noise, separating fact from fiction for popular biohacks like vagus nerve stimulation and bioimplants. Join leading experts who debunk myths, reveal data-backed science and explore the REAL future of health optimization. Whether you’re managing chronic pain, seeking longevity, or striving for peak athletic performance, discover evidence-based strategies to boost your wellbeing in an era of misinformation.

speakers.name: Dr. Geoffrey Ling, MD
speakers.title: Professor Of Neurology And Attending Physician, Neuro Critical Care

speakers.name: Kevin J Tracey, Md
speakers.title: President And Ceo, The Feinstein Institutes For Medical Research

events.title: Will Journalism Survive AI - and Does it Matter?
events.description: Large language models scoop up news for training and live chatbots, but rarely pay a dime. Will they eventually put journalism out of business by self-generating “news” content or regurgitating data collected from gadgets and glasses? With trust and value in news plummeting, perhaps journalism’s role as a watchdog, forum for social exchange, and spark for civic engagement is already defunct. Or does original, ethical reporting offer something special? In this provocative session, experts in AI ethics, journalism and global trends share  divergent views on the future of journalism.

speakers.name: Madhav Chinnappa
speakers.title: Visiting Fellow
speakers.company: Reuters Institute for the Study of Journalism at the University of Oxford; Formerly Director of News Ecosystem Development at Google

events.title: Work Reimagined: Building Attraction, Not Requirements
events.description: Stop fighting about office days and start designing workplace experiences that people actually want. This panel brings together LinkedIn's workforce research leader with real-time employee insights, the architect of Gensler's leading workplace experience platform, and Rivian's expert in customer community building. Discover why meaningful in-person connection becomes even more valuable as AI handles routine work, cutting edge examples of experimental workplaces, and proven strategies to create immediately measurable ROI from thoughtfully designed workplace experiences and communities.

speakers.name: Tony Caravano
speakers.title: Sr Director, Experiential Marketing, Brand Partnerships, Community

events.title: Zig Zag: Having a Weird Career
events.description: What happens when your career makes zero sense on paper—but gets you exactly where you need to be? Two women share their very non-linear journeys: from the Air Force to Harvard to a gratitude startup, and from baking pies to founding a startup. In a world obsessed with “coherent” resumes, this conversation explores how detours, pivots, and reinventions are not just valid—but powerful. Expect laughs, real talk, and permission to break the rules.

events.title: Mam
events.description: After falling in love with Vietnamese cuisine during a life-changing trip abroad, Jerald—a self-taught chef from small-town Texas—arrives in New York City with one goal: to open his own restaurant. Juggling odd jobs and secretly perfecting recipes in a basement kitchen, he’s running out of time and money. When he meets Nhung, a sharp-witted Vietnamese waitress, their unlikely alliance sparks a bold culinary journey. From improvised street hustles to a hidden speakeasy, they fight to turn Jerald’s dream into reality. A story of passion, resilience, and unexpected friendship in the heart of the city.

events.title: Thanks for Nothing
events.description: Katharina, Ricky, Malou, and Victoria live in a self-made anarchist group home - no parents, no school, no rules. Under the loose watch of social worker Ballack, things are going pretty well. But Katharina doesn’t want to live past 18, and her birthday is two weeks away. Her friends scramble to hide her suicide attempts, afraid the truth will destroy the only “home” they’ve ever had. In this darkly comedic tale of rebellion, abandonment, and surviving the absurd, "Thanks For Nothing" is the kids' collective FU to the adults who’ve abandoned or failed them.

events.title: Brian
events.description: It sucks to be Brian. He’s smart, funny, and capable, but his mental health issues make it hard for anyone to see it - especially when compared to his effortlessly cool older brother. At school, Brian harbors an unrequited crush on Brooke: she’s smart, kind, pretty… and very much his teacher. A disastrous drama club audition leads to yet another one of Brian’s trademark public meltdowns. Thus begins Brian’s search for his new “thing”. On paper he’s chosen the worst possible fit: running for class president. With help from his therapist and the new kid, Justin, Brian launches his high-stakes campaign and sparks a messy, exquisitely awkward journey toward self-acceptance.

events.title: Mickey
events.description: Mickey spent the last ten years exploring her transition process within the conservative context of Sinaloa, Mexico. Through digital archives, artistic reenactments, and deeply personal encounters, the film moves between tenderness and rage, transforming memory into an act of freedom. An exploration of self-perception and a non-punitive confrontation with the past.

Through digital archives, artistic reenactments, and deeply personal encounters, the film moves between tenderness and rage, transforming memory into an act of freedom. events.title: Mile End Kicks
events.description: Grace Pine, a driven though easily distracted 23-year-old. She leaves her quirky parents’ home for a shared apartment found on Craigslist to devote herself to writing the next great book in the 33 1/3 album exploration series. Hers will be on the iconic Alanis Morissette opus Jagged Little Pill. Loft parties introduce Grace to two paramours. Unfortunately, they are members of the same rock band, Bone Patrol. And instead of sequestering herself away to complete her draft, she uses her music industry know-how to get in with the band as their publicist.Through wine-fuelled poetry readings and other ill-advised choices, Grace is in the trenches of self-discovery.

events.title: The Saviors
events.description: Sean and Kim Harrison are a suburban couple about to divorce. By renting their guest house to a quiet Middle Eastern brother and sister, Amir and Jahan Razi, they find a perfect solution: raise money to fix and sell their house, then separate. But when bizarre occurrences begin to add up – mysterious lights, missing animals, glimpses of unexplainable tech – in the days before the President’s upcoming visit to town, their guests' strange behavior starts to seem suspicious and potentially dangerous. As Sean and Kim investigate their new tenants, they rediscover the emotional connection they once shared. But reconciliation may come at a significant cost in this timely and provocative thriller.

events.title: Women in Music Meet Up
events.description: Join Women in Music for our annual WIM Meet-Up at SXSW to spark connections and build community across borders. Everyone is welcome!

events.title: The Ascent
events.description: "The Ascent" is the inspiring true story of Colorado Springs bilateral-amputee climber Mandy Horvath’s record-breaking attempt to crawl to the summit of Mt. Kilimanjaro on her hands. At 21, Mandy lost both of her legs under mysterious circumstances—an event that shattered her trust in the world around her. As she pushes her body to its limits on Africa’s tallest mountain, Mandy must reckon with the unanswered questions of her past and learn to trust again if she is to succeed.

events.title: The Truth and Tragedy of Moriah Wilson
events.description: An intimate, arresting portrait of cyclist Moriah Wilson—raised by a fierce, loving family—whose singular drive becomes her superpower, carrying her to athletic brilliance and, devastatingly, toward a life cut short by murder.

events.title: Black Zombie
events.description: From the flickering screens of Hollywood horror, to the haunted cane fields of colonial Haiti, "Black Zombie" unearths the buried origins of the zombie, reclaiming it as a symbol of survival and spiritual resistance.

events.title: UK XR Takeover Party
events.description:
Welcome to the UK XR Takeover Party, bringing together international immersive, film and music delegates to connect, network and collaborate alongside incredible live music from breakthrough UK acts Karma Sheen and Amy Gadiaga. Celebrate the end of the SXSW XR experience with Future Art and Culture - this event is not to be missed.

For more information, please visit: https://futureartandculture.com/
events.venue: British Music Embassy @ Palm Door on Sixth

events.title: Amy Gadiaga
events.description:
As a bassist, vocalist, and composer, my journey as a music creator has been shaped by my rich cultural heritage and passion for blending traditional jazz with contemporary influences. I grew up in the suburbs of Paris, born to parents of Senegalese, Gambian, and Malian descent. This background continues to inspire my artistry, which merges the sounds of jazz legends like Betty Carter and Wayne Shorter with the soulful rhythms of artists such as D’Angelo and Stevie Wonder. 
 
Since moving to London at 18 to study double bass at Trinity Laban Conservatoire of Music and Dance, I have built a strong live track record, performing at renowned festivals and venues including the EFG London Jazz Festival, Jazz Café, Cheltenham Jazz Festival, We Out Here, Brick Lane Jazz Festival, and Pizza Express Soho. These experiences have been pivotal in building my fanbase and establishing my presence in the UK. Internationally I have performed at the Montreux Jazz Festival and countries around the world including France, Poland , South Korea and more.
events.venue: British Music Embassy @ Palm Door on Sixth Patio

events.title: Accelerating Discovery: The Role of Agentic AI in Science
events.description: The new generation of AI models and agentic AI systems are fundamentally transforming the pace of scientific discovery, offering new ways to solve humanity's most complex challenges. By supercharging productivity and augmenting human expertise, these tools help researchers push the boundaries of knowledge faster than ever before. From synthesizing vast scientific literature and generating novel hypotheses to creating new research plans and executing simulations, agentic AI acts as a powerful collaborator in the lab. We are entering a new era of collaborative science, one where AI works alongside researchers to turn the next iteration into the next great breakthrough.

events.title: Another ‘Disgruntled Employee,’ They Said
events.description: When WhatsApp’s former Head of Security raised alarms about flaws that put billions at risk, Meta fired him. He’s not the only insider punished for protecting the public. This session explores the cost of speaking up inside Big Tech—and how we can build real safeguards, legal protections, and public support so that truth-telling in the age of AI isn’t a career-ending act of courage.

events.title: Awaken Your Highest Self
events.description: Are you feeling disconnected, stuck, or unfulfilled? Do you know there’s more to life, but something is holding you back from reaching your potential? In former real-estate entrepreneur and spiritual guide Danny Morel’s new book Awaken Your Highest Self, he teaches you to embrace love over fear and guides you on a journey of self-discovery and healing that will transform your life. Join Danny’s book reading with former actor David Sutcliffe to go beyond labels and limitations and reconnect with the energy that creates everything in life.

events.title: Bespoke: How AI is Ushering in the Era of Precision Genetics
events.description: The pioneering base-editing method of Alexis Komor, PhD, was recently used to create a custom therapy for an infant with carbamoyl phosphate synthetase 1, a deadly rare disease. Her colleague, Gene Yeo, PhD, favors another new approach: RNA-targeting precision therapeutics, which he used to target ALS & aid a child with developmental epileptic encephalopathy. Both employ AI to discover the roots of polygenic diseases—from the ultra-common like diabetes & heart disease to the ultra-rare—& decode the Dark Genome. More on the promise the technology holds for the future of personalized treatment.

events.title: Building Reality: Generative AI for the Physical World
events.description: Generative AI has rapidly advanced in text, imagery, and 3D content, but its potential to shape the physical world remains largely untapped. This panel explores how AI can be used to generate designs for things that can be built, manufactured, or constructed, spanning products, machines, buildings, and infrastructure. Experts in computational design, AI research, and digital fabrication will discuss current challenges, technical hurdles, and the foundational work needed to unlock future impact and bring generative design into the realm of the physical.

events.title: Can Science Safeguard Earth’s Wildlife?
events.description: Habitat loss, climate change, and disease are threatening the ecological integrity of our planet. These threats are driving declines in wildlife populations, accelerated by the loss of genetic diversity. Biobanking, including the cryopreservation of living cells, coupled with advanced digital tools, provides an opportunity for a future where genetic diversity, species, and ecosystems can be protected and restored. This panel will discuss the urgency of protecting species—from microbes to megafauna—and how biobanking and digital strategies are helping give wildlife a lifeline.

speakers.name: Dr. Rae Wynn-Grant
speakers.title: Wildlife Ecologist And Co-Host, Mutual Of Omaha’s Wild Kingdom

events.title: A Conversation with Greg Kwedar (Sing Sing & Train Dreams)
events.description: Greg Kwedar is a two-time Academy Award-Nominated filmmaker. His film SING SING garnered three Oscar nominations, along with nods at the BAFTAs, Critics Choice, and Independent Spirit Awards. It won the NBR Award for Best Adapted Screenplay. Greg co-wrote and executive produced creative partner Clint Bentley's TRAIN DREAMS. The decorated film went on to win the NBR for Best Adapted Screenplay and received four Oscar nominations including Best Adapted Screenplay and Best Picture.

events.title: Crafting Global Games with Local Insight and Cultural Fusion
events.description: Games aren’t just translated, they’re co-created with local communities from day one. This panel pulls back the curtain on how global hits come to life across markets without losing their soul. Hear behind-the-scenes stories on how early local insights fuel global growth, how culturally meaningful in-game experiences with players across regions drive deeper worldwide engagement, and how partnerships with regional hubs are building a global pipeline of creative talent. Nika will share a clear four-step framework to make culture and community central to game development, from concept to launch.

speakers.name: Nika Nour
speakers.title: Senior Vice President & Head of International Business Development

events.title: Creative AF: Women Creatives, Designers, & Content Hustlers
events.description: Whether you shoot it, write it, design it, sing it, or sell it - this space is for you.  Creative AF (aka Women Who Create Sh*t) is a high-energy, no-BS meetup for women-identifying creatives, founders, filmmakers, freelancers, content hustlers, and brand builders who are making sh*t happen. Come for fast-paced connection games, resource swaps, and real talk & stay for the energy and photo-ops you’ll actually want to post. No panels. No gatekeeping. Just powerful, talented women building cool things and backing each other up.

events.title: Designed to Feel: How Tech Brands Build Emotional Worlds
events.description: Today’s most successful tech brands don’t just launch products - they build emotional universes. This session explores how brands are moving beyond screens to connect across sound, space, motion and mood. From sonic identities to tactile packaging and immersive design systems, we’ll unpack how multisensory storytelling creates emotional connections—the real competitive edge in the AI age. This isn’t about rejecting technology - it’s about designing through it to bring feeling and meaning back into experience. Expect provocations and a manifesto for the future of emotionally intelligent design.

events.title: Event Tech Meet Up
events.description:
Are you passionate about the intersection of technology and events? Whether you're at the forefront of managing event technologies, actively involved in producing software for event management, or simply intrigued by the innovative world of event tech, this Meet Up is for you.

What to Expect:
-Networking Opportunities
-Industry Insights
-Collaboration Opportunities

Don't miss this opportunity to expand your network, gain valuable insights, and be a part of shaping the future of event technology.

events.title: Featured Session: Breaking Through Barriers to Innovation: Lessons from Space and Earth
events.description: New paradigm-shifting technologies seem to emerge every day, and the leaders that understand how to properly leverage the opportunities that come along with these new technologies can create huge competitive advantages for their organizations. Dava Newman, Ph.D., a futurist and the MIT Apollo Program Professor of Astronautics (as well as the former director of the MIT Media Lab and the first woman engineer to have served as a NASA deputy administrator) will reveal creative strategies for taking advantage of these opportunities. Learn how to make the most from technology breakthroughs in areas such as finding life elsewhere in the universe; climate+energy, and the convergence of artificial intelligence and generative biology. Dava’s mantra of “Love, Act, Discover, Innovate” urges leaders in business, government, and academia to courageously consider how innovation can truly change the way we engage with each other and our planet.

events.title: Harness Negative Sentiment for Positive Growth
events.description: Some campaigns are known less for what they communicated, and more for how people responded. The social media loudspeaker helps people out-shout brands – and the anticipation of backlash is essential for smart marketers. Backlash is a new stage of the “consumer journey” when any brand decides to assert its values. Part discussion, part crisis simulation, learn to strategize and create for a world where consumers choose the division brands seek to surmount. Steel your values, weather undesired turbulence, and emerge as a business with integrity and advantage.

events.title: How GLP-1s Are Impacting Women’s Health
events.description:
Women are struggling with different issues at different stages of life, whether it be infertility, peri/post menopause symptoms, metabolic dysfunction, autoimmune conditions, and more. 

GLP-1s have sparked interest as a tool for improving these conditions, but haven’t come without criticism. 

Some fear dependence on the medication, others fear muscle loss, and others fear increased cancer risk.

A conversation surrounding how these medications can affect women at different stages, who they are and aren’t indicated for, and how to avoid side effects is needed.
