His battle rap career spans top leagues, highlighted by the headline clash Odanga vs Steve-O on OSBL, notable battles against J Morr and Stuey Newton of Ultimate Rap League, and appearances on RBE and Tha Kulture.

His latest singles, “Maembe” and “Heart,” introduce Find Your Way Home, an upcoming album centered on identity, healing, and self-return. Whether on festival stages or intimate rooms, Odanga creates music meant to uplift, empower, and reconnect listeners with themselves.

events.title: Bubba Lucky
events.description: Bubba Lucky is a project created by Taylor Lumpkin initially performing solo with a drum machine, now the band has six members, including members from Gus Baldwin, and the sketch, whisper, commercial breaks, and late wife. Taylor Lumpkin is originally from Louisiana but has spent over a decade Participating in the Austin music scene.

events.title: FrivolousShara
events.description:
FrivolousShara is a high-voltage Hip-Hop artist and producer blending sharp lyricism, geek culture, and fearless energy into an unforgettable live experience. Blurring the lines between hip-hop, anime, gaming, and internet culture, her sound is bold, playful, and unapologetically her own.

On stage, she brings nonstop momentum, confidence, and charisma. Every set feels like a controlled chaos: hype, emotional, silly, weird, and impossible to ignore. Her music balances fun and intensity, pairing swagger and sauciness with moments of raw honesty that pull the crowd all the way in.

With music featured in professional wrestling and competitive fighting game spaces, FrivolousShara has become a standout force at the intersection of hip-hop and geek culture. She thrives in rooms full of gamers, anime fans, hip-hop heads, and anyone ready to turn up and feel something real.

events.title: Los Gran Reyes
events.description: Los Gran Reyes are a Dallas-based nine-piece cumbia powerhouse led by Agustín Granados Jr. (AG), blending traditional cumbia styles with modern and electronic influences. Drawing from Cumbia Lagunera, Sonidera, and Argentina, their sound is high-energy, culture-driven, and built for the dance floor. Their latest album, Cumbia Vibes, marks a bold new era of cumbia moderna and solidifies Los Gran Reyes as one of the most exciting live Latin acts today.

events.title: Lynn
events.description:
LYNN is a 24-year-old artist from Birmingham, Alabama, making waves in the Hip-Hop/Rap and R&B scene. Her music is all about owning the moment, showcasing the power of women through bold, unapologetic rap bars, while also hitting us with those smooth, soulful R&B vibes.
Though she’s just getting started, LYNN has already made a big splash, earning the title of “Bama Hip-Hop/Rap Female Artist of the Year” at the 2022 Alabama Music Awards. She’s all about breaking boundaries and creating a space for herself in the industry while uplifting her community along the way.
With her unique sound and unstoppable energy, LYNN is on a mission to inspire and pave the way for others, all while cementing her place as one of the freshest voices in the game.

events.title: Social Order
events.description:
Social Order is a Los Angeles and Las Vegas–based trio blending melodic pop, post punk, and darkwave into a sound that feels both cinematic and intimate. Formed during the isolation of 2020, the band features Mason Musso and Anthony Improgo of Metro Station alongside Andrew Ward of Nuwave Fighters. Their music explores the tension between nostalgia and reinvention, light and shadow, intimacy and distance.

They gained early attention with their debut EP How To Lie, followed by singles Worst Way, All My Life, Boys, and the EP Strangers, earning placement on Spotify’s Darkwave playlist and praise from Alternative Press and Post-Punk.com. Entirely self-produced and self-directed, Social Order maintain a strong DIY ethos. The band made their major festival debut at Cruel World and completed a North American tour with French Police in November, continuing to expand their shadowy, emotionally charged world.

events.title: The Pink Stones
events.description: On their intoxicating new album, Thank the Lord...it’s The Pink Stones, Pinkston and his bandmates do precisely that, offering up a joyful, adventurous take on ’60s twang that blurs the lines between cosmic country, folk, bluegrass, soul, and psychedelic rock. Recorded once again with co-producer/engineer Henry Barbe (Drive-By Truckers, Deerhunter) in the band’s hometown of Athens, GA, the collection showcases a more deliberate, mature side of The Pink Stones’ sound, one that reflects all the personal and sonic growth that’s defined the last few years for the hard touring five-piece. The songs on Thank the Lord... are humble and timeless, full of wry, sardonic wit and rich, evocative storytelling, and the performances are easygoing and amiable, with an effortlessly natural feel that belies the masterful craftsmanship behind them. The result is a record that wears its influences proudly on its sleeve, even as it a subverts expectation, a work of poignant longing and playful humor that tips its cap to everyone from Merle Haggard and Earl Scruggs to Don Williams and The Byrds as it looks both forwards and backwards all at once.

events.title: MILHD
events.description: MILHD is an indie pop/rock band carving out a vibrant niche in Austin's music scene. Blending catchy hooks, soulful melodies, and punchy guitar-driven energy, their music is built to connect. Whether in a packed dive bar or on a festival stage, songs like Casanova deliver thoughtful lyrics wrapped in an indie groove that keeps the room in motion.

events.title: TRIM
events.description: Born and raised in Mobile, Alabama, Trim’s journey into music began after an unexpected exit from Division I football and college. What started as freestyling with friends during downtime evolved into a serious pursuit once his raw ability stood out, leading him to record music on BandLab. Early releases gained traction through TikTok music reviews, earning co-signs from Sonny Digital, Ray Daniels, and DJ Plugg —momentum that culminated in the release of his breakout single, Down the Pole.

events.title: Shao Dow
events.description:
Rapper, Manga Author, and occasional Ninja—Shao Dow (Rhymes with “Wow Bro”). He creates music inspired by anime and gaming but written for the soundtrack of life. 

The closest thing you'll ever meet to a real-life anime character, Shao travelled solo to China to train with monks in Shaolin Kung Fu, he taught himself Japanese and now raps skilfully in two languages.

A fiercely independent artist, Shao creates powerful, genre-blending music built on infectious hooks and razor-sharp lyricism. He was selected as the official England representative for the UK’s National Day at Expo 2025 in Osaka, and invited to perform for the Japanese ambassador at the Embassy of Japan in London.

Shao Dow’s music has featured in 'Fortnite' and has been used by games 'God of War' and 'Borderlands 4' as well as Amazon Prime Video for the Arsenal documentary. He also writes the music for the popular One Jump Man vs Shaggy Ball Z animated series. 

When it comes to performing, Shao delivers an unforgettable stage show — mixing high-energy music and Kung Fu for an experience unlike any other, continuing to prove that independence, musical excellence, and Anime Protagonist Energy can go hand in hand.

events.title: Baby Sam
events.description:
Born and raised in Southwest Houston, Baby Sam is a faith-driven artist whose story is built on resilience. After surviving a near-fatal accident at six years old and teaching himself to walk again, he turned pain into purpose through music.

Known as a self-proclaimed “Street Preacher,” his sound blends raw street reality with hope and perseverance. Mentored by Houston legend ESG and later elevated through key industry connections, Baby Sam has continued to rise with consistency and faith.

His accolades include collaborating on a record with Berner and appearing on Sway in the Morning alongside DJ Hollygrove in 2024. Now a signed artist, Baby Sam is steadily building his name—one verse and one stage at a time.

events.title: Marni Ct.
events.description:
Marni carries a down-to-earth and authentic energy. The indie rock band formed in Los Angeles, California, in 2022, and consists of Nicolas Lara (vocals, guitar), and Michaela Gradstein (vocals, guitar). The project began as Lara’s solo work in Palm Springs, where he released the debut album Whiskey Girl, before evolving into a full band the following year.

Marni intertwines heavy distorted guitars with beautifully soft moments, drawing on influences such as Title Fight, Greet Death, and Hovvdy. Their newest  EP fml era (2025), produced by Corey Coffman of Gleemer, is a portrait of being down on your luck, with unpolished guitars, and emotionally direct storytelling.

events.title: MEEK
events.description:
You know that moment you realised Lady Gaga was named after a Queen song? MEEK is kind of the musical and stylistic culmination of that connecting glue, the secret chemical equation that bonds them. She is walking class war, musical defiance and the return of glam rock at its most instantly and commercially appealing. She’s dancing on the gay bar bar-top with a sparkler fizzing in your cocktail. 

MEEK is not a work in progress. She is fully formed, earned her stripes, comes from nothing, nepo-baby baiting execution of timeless pop brilliance. While sounding directly descended from the DNA of famed countercultural misfits and bona fide pop aces, all strewn across the decades, her music is a no messing, straight shoot for the top.
events.venue: British Music Embassy @ Palm Door on Sixth

events.title: Patriarchy
events.description:
Patriarchy is the Los Angeles industrial pop duo of Actually Huizenga and AJ English, exploring sex, power, subversion, and death where desire and fear collide. Known for chaotic, boundary-pushing live performances that dissolve the line between performer and audience, the band fuses infectious electronic pulse with industrial metal, distorted synths, and spoken-word intensity.

Since their breakout releases Asking For It and The Unself, Patriarchy sharpened their sound into something harder and more immediate on 2025’s Manual for Dying, produced in collaboration with Twin Shadow. The album drives their industrial roots deeper into dark club territory while amplifying their theatrical edge.

Their live reputation has carried them from the experimental extremity of Roadburn Festival to the indie forward energy of Wide Awake Festival, the darkwave revivalism of Cruel World Festival, and the metal intensity of Brutal Assault — proving Patriarchy move seamlessly between underground art spaces and large-scale international stages.

At SXSW 2026, they arrive sharper than ever.

events.title: Rosegarden Funeral Party
events.description:
Rosegarden Funeral Party has made a strong mark on the international post punk and goth scene since the release of their debut EP The Chopping Block in 2018. Since then, the band has released the EP At the Stake in 2020 and three full length albums: Martyr in 2019, In the Wake of Fire in 2021, and From the Ashes in 2024. Their work has earned critical acclaim from outlets including Post Punk, LA Weekly, SF Sonic, and the Dallas Observer.

The band has toured extensively across the United States as both a headliner and support act, completing over thirteen tours. In 2023, Rosegarden Funeral Party made their UK and European debut with performances in Italy, the Czech Republic, Slovakia, Scotland, England, and Germany. Highlights included headlining Beautiful Noise Festival and supporting Skeletal Family and Corpus Delicti at Wave Gotik Treffen in Leipzig.

Blending classic gothic sounds with modern pop sensibility, Rosegarden Funeral Party delivers emotionally resonant lyrics centered on heartbreak, healing, and self love. Their message of kindness and connection has helped cultivate a devoted and steadily growing global fanbase.

events.title: Zoe Tan
events.description:
Hailing from Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, Zoe Tan is Southeast Asia’s newest folk singer-songwriter to watch out for. Based in New York, she has played at iconic venues such as The Bitter End for the New York Songwriter’s Circle and S.O.B.’s for their international artist showcase. She has also opened for
acclaimed artists such as Yuna, Lunadira and performed at music festivals such as Urbanscapes. Under Universal Music Malaysia, she has released her songs “Walk Out The Door”, “Distance, and “I Don’t Feel A Thing At All”, acquiring multiple global Spotify Editorial placements. Her debut EP, “I Will Never Go Back” will be coming out in March 2026. Zoe’s art is defined by its ability to honor the flavors of the Malaysian music scene, fuse them into the American music landscape, and to create music that you can hear, see, and feel with every fiber of your being.

events.title: BJ So Cole
events.description:
Hailing from the vibrant streets of New Orleans, BJ SO COLE embodies the essence of the city's rich musical tapestry. Growing up in the heart of this cultural melting pot, they were immersed in the infectious rhythms and beats that define New Orleans bounce music. 
Musical Journey: BJ SO COLE began his musical journey at a young age, inspired by the pioneers of bounce music like DJ Jubilee, Big Freedia, and Katey Red. Their early performances in local clubs and block parties quickly garnered attention, earning them a reputation for their high-energy shows and dynamic stage presence.
BJ So Cole’s music is a fusion of traditional New Orleans bounce with contemporary elements, creating a sound that is both nostalgic and innovative. Known for their rapid-fire call-and-response lyrics and infectious hooks, BJ So Cole has a unique ability to get any crowd moving.
Achievements:
• Released debut single "PUMP IT UP" which quickly became a State wide hit.
• Performed at major festivals including French Quarter Fest, Big Night New Orleans, Pride Fest Nola
• Garnered a significant following on social media platforms: Tik Tok, Instagram, with viral hits and popular dance challenges.

events.title: Onlyheaven
events.description:
OnlyHeaven is a New Orleans–influenced bounce and hip-hop artist known for her high-energy performances, confident delivery, and authentic Southern sound. Blending traditional bounce rhythms with modern rap and R&B influences, she brings a fresh perspective to a legacy genre while connecting with a new generation of fans.

She has performed at major universities, festivals, and national tours, and has received recognition from Billboard and Pitchfork for her contributions to the evolving bounce movement. With a growing catalog, strong streaming presence, and an expanding fan base, OnlyHeaven continues to build momentum as an independent artist on the rise.

Through consistent releases, dynamic visuals, and engaging live shows, she is positioning herself as one of the leading voices in contemporary Southern music.

events.title: Casket Cassette
events.description:
A reflection of the industrial grime and perpetual sunny glow of Los Angeles, Casket Cassette (Constant Williams) blends euphoria and melancholy in an expression of existential perseverance. Casket Cassette's depressingly danceable music takes a contemporary spin on the dark sounds of the 1980s Post-Punk and Darkwave movements, drawing further influence from New Wave, EBM, Synthpop and Indie/ Alternative to achieve this duality.

The project takes its name from a memory Williams has from childhood of his father recording a live song onto a cassette tape, then placing the tape into his grandfather's casket as it was being lowered into the ground. Williams' lyrics often reflect upon similarly somber themes such as mental health struggles, loss, heartbreak, addiction and recovery, while also offering glimmers of hope, humor and a general determination to overcome.

Williams lives in LA, and graduated in 2024 from the lowa Writers' Workshop with an MFA in poetry.

events.title: Dual Core
events.description: Dual Core is an international hip hop duo. They hack computers, and make rap music about it.

events.title: The Gringos
events.description:
The Gringos are an indie rock band building a real-world scene.
Born from house shows, late-night living room sessions, and college basements, their sound blends raw indie rock energy with melodic songwriting and a loose, lived-in Southern warmth. Their music feels like something you stumbled into — loud enough to feel alive, honest enough to feel personal.

The Gringos aren’t just a band — they’re building a community. From packed college rooms to growing regional tours, their shows feel less like concerts and more like gatherings. The kind where strangers become friends, choruses get screamed back, and everyone leaves feeling like they found something.

If you’re looking for polished pop — look somewhere else.
If you’re looking for your new favorite band before everyone else finds them — welcome.

events.title: DJ Hollygrove
events.description:
DJ Hollygrove is a nationally recognized DJ, producer, and cultural curator known for bridging Southern hip-hop, HBCU band culture, and the chopped-and-screwed legacy. He serves as Vice President of Core DJs Worldwide and President of The Chopstars, helping preserve and evolve the sound pioneered in Houston while expanding it to new markets.

A Grammy-winning producer, DJ Hollygrove contributed to The Urban Hymnal, showcasing his deep connection to marching band culture and live instrumentation. His mixes and curations have been featured on Sway In The Morning, The Drunk Mix with Lord Sear, and countless of other FM radio stations, and he has performed at large-scale festivals, celebrity events, and official SXSW stages.

Known for high-energy performances, strategic brand partnerships, and community leadership, DJ Hollygrove seamlessly blends music, culture, and entrepreneurship. Whether on radio, in the club, or on a festival stage, he delivers a signature sound rooted in Southern tradition while pushing the culture forward.

events.title: Agatha is Dead!
events.description:
Formed in the lockdown winter of 2021, Agatha Is Dead! began as a post-punk experiment between longtime friends Lilly and Noah, who first made music together in their school days. Their shared love for Joy Division, The Cure, Molchat Doma, and Fontaines D.C. laid the foundation for their darkly urgent sound. With the addition of drummer Joey Ramone Hansen−bringing grunge and pop−punk bite−and Arthur on bass, the band played their first shows in 2022 and quickly carved out a place in Berlin's underground scene.

The band signed to Berlin label Duchess Box Records in May 2025 and will release their debut EP "order" in on 10th October.

The first singles drew attention from big online magazines such as Post-Punk.com and Diffus as well as major radio station airplay and big playlist support from Spotify and Apple Music.

This September, the band will embark on their first-ever headline tour with shows in Berlin and Leipzig selling out in advance., marking a new chapter in their journey. Their Berlin show at Privatclub sold out an incredible five months in advance, underscoring the growing excitement surrounding the band.

Drawing further inspiration from The Pretty Reckless, DIIV, Liily, and Bloc Party, Agatha Is Dead! have honed a sound that is heavy, hypnotic, and deeply emotional. With their debut EP Order on the horizon, the band are staking their claim in the next wave of alternative rock−grabbing hearts, shaking stages, and refusing to go unnoticed.

events.title: AKA BK
events.description:
AKA BK is an alternative indie project based in Los Angeles. With influences from bands like The Pixies, The Yeah Yeah Yeahs, and the Breeders, their live show plays like nerves exposed: charged, joyful and disarmingly human, turning their vulnerability into sharpened momentum. The band closes the distance between their fans, both literally and figuratively, inviting them to join in on their tongue-in-cheek moments of mushy playfulness and feverish moshing. 

The foundation of AKA BK is built on long standing friendships, with BK (lead vocals) and Cecile Herledan (bassist) forming their first band at the age of 11 in Metro Detroit. The band is rounded out by fellow guitarists Julian Cullars and Sean Gunner Lee, who have been playing in LA bands since 2013.

events.title: Armen Paul
events.description:
Armen Paul is a multi-platinum artist, songwriter and instrumentalist. His latest collaboration, "Hope" received 3x platinum certification in 2025 (#1 on national radio, #3 on UK dance radio). He performed the song in July at Tomorrowland 2023 in Belgium. Armen’s solo work took off when Bella Poarch (#3 top TikTok creator worldwide) and Tony Hawk featured his song "Devil Knows" in their social content (accumulating +175M views on TikTok). His work has received notable acclaim on DSPs with +50M streams ('New Music Friday' in +10 countries, 9 Spotify 'Viral 50' Charts).  

He’ll be releasing a collaboration EP produced by Moby in 2026 with a single collaboration with Don Diablo and remix from Brooks. Armen also has an upcoming single with Nicky Romero.
 
Armen’s music has been licensed by WWE, Adobe, Lyft, and Samsung, and he secured a sync in the feature film titled 'The System' starring Tyrese Gibson & Lil' Yachty (October 2022). His recent Eurovision placement “Survivor” qualified for the 2025 Grand Final in Basel, Switzerland for +160 Million viewers, aired on Peacock globally, and reached Spotify’s Top 50 Global Viral Chart and the Spotify Viral 50 Charts in 25 Countries.

events.title: Bandana Cheyenna
events.description: A prolific songwriter & soulful artist blending country, folk, & pop with witty, emotionally rich storytelling, "hippie songbird" BANDANA CHEYENNA is one to watch in today's music landscape. Already known as one of Nashville's hitmakers, their notable writing credits include Dasha’s global billion-stream hit “Austin (Boots Stop Workin’)," Alexandra Kay’s viral track "Cupid's A Cowgirl,” & more. As an artist, Cheyenna has released two full albums, & most recently Act I of a four-part EP series, "The Artist's Pilgrimage," which was celebrated with a sold-out release party on Music Row. Cheyenna has appeared on radio home of the Grand Ole Opry WSM-AM, performed at Nashville's Pride Festival & legendary Bluebird Café, & is gearing up for a performance on Austin’s major TV network coinciding with their SXSW appearance. A winner of Female Song of the Year at the 2024 People’s Choice Country Awards, & honoree at the 2024 & 2025 ASCAP Awards, their collaborative work includes artists & producers Gayle, Abby Anderson, Breland, Caylee Hammack, Dan Wilson (Chris Stapleton, Adele), Jonah Marais (Why Don’t We), MaRynn Taylor, Mickey Guyton, Nathan Chapman (Taylor Swift), Tigirlily Gold & more.

events.title: Blakchyl
events.description:
Rapper Blakchyl's (formerly known as T-Fly) is a talented, community-minded wordsmith, having come up in the local hip hop community collaborating with music collectives, nonprofits and filmmakers. The queer artist has three European tours under her belt plus opening slots for Talib Kweli, Snow Tha Product, Jean Grae, Bizzy Bone and Scarface and her new album Better Than I Imagined (produced by The Mask), was accompanied by a short film and dropped in July. Always indefatigable, she recently landed a deal with Brighton, UK-based Tru Thought Records as well as an Austin Chronicle cover, was nominated for Best Hip Hop Artist, released an EP (Call Me Sometimes) and played a Waterloo Records in-store. It all comes down to her
"powerful and effervescent songs" (CultureMap) and her love for the craft and it's community.

events.title: Bobby Raps
events.description: Bobby Raps (born Robert John Richardson on December 22, 1992) is an American rapper, singer, and record producer from St. Paul, Minnesota. He first gained recognition as a member of the hip-hop collective Thestand4rd and has since established a solo career marked by a distinctive raspy vocal delivery, introspective lyricism, and multifaceted production work. Over the course of his career, he has collaborated with prominent artists including The Weeknd, Lil Wayne, and Future, further solidifying his reputation as a versatile and influential figure within contemporary hip-hop and R&B.

events.title: BrunOG
events.description:
From the heart of Mexico City emerges BrunOG, an artist and producer who is reshaping the Urban Latin Pop landscape. With a solid trajectory within the industry, BrunOG has evolved from being a visionary producer—recognized even with a Latin Grammy nomination—to an established singer-songwriter with viral international impact. His image has always been synonymous with inspiration and aspiration.
BrunOG’s musical proposal is a sonic blend rooted in Urban Latin Pop, yet it boldly ventures into genres such as Reggaeton, R&B, Afropop/Afrobeat, Hyperpop, Latin, and Alternative Pop. This versatility, however, always maintains a distinctive urban stamp in his lyrics, flows, and metrics, exploring themes of heartbreak, nostalgia, passionate love, sensuality, and romance.
Milestones
Global Viral Success: At 30, his track “Nuestra Canción” became an international phenomenon, driven by its inclusion in the soundtrack of the film “Culpa Mía.” 
Signing with Universal Music US Latin: In 2024, BrunOG joined the ranks of Universal Music US Latin, marking a new and exciting chapter in his career with multinational backing.

events.title: DAIISTAR
events.description:
BIO  
DAIISTAR is an Alt-Indie band formed in Austin, Texas in the spring of 2020. The band takes their inspiration from the neo-psychedelic era of the 80s and 90s (The Jesus and Mary Chain, Spacemen 3, Primal Scream) and pulls it into the future with modulating synthesizers, heavy guitars, bouncing bass lines, and spiraling hooks, creating a narcotic blend of noise and melody. DAIISTAR recorded their first studio album produced by Alex Maas of The Black Angels and engineered by James Petralli of White Denim in the summer of 2021. The band signed to UK based label Fuzz Club Records with their debut album GOOD TIME released on September 8th 2023. The album is available on vinyl including a Levitation Exclusive Edition pressing, as well as CD and digital. DAIISTAR has performed at ACL, SXSW, Levitation Austin, Levitation France, Austin Psych Fest, Barcelona Psych Fest, KEXP, KUTX and has toured with The Black Angels, The Brian Jonestown Massacre, and The Dandy Warhols.

events.title: The Dharma Chain
events.description:
The Dharma Chain are an Australian-formed, Berlin-based independent band blending psychedelic textures, shoegaze, rock, and kraut-driven momentum with poetic lyricism and raw live energy. They’ve built a reputation for emotionally charged performances that feel expansive and immersive.


With no fixed front person, the band moves fluidly between roles. Mixed vocals, hip-hop drum beats, reverb-soaked guitars, and industrial undercurrents collide to create a powerful wall of sound that is dynamic, unpredictable and deeply human.


Their debut album NOWHERE continues to gather momentum, while their second full-length record 'Some Kind Of Pure State', arriving Spring 2026, marks a bold expansion in impact and atmosphere. Festival appearances include Fuzz Club and DesertFest Berlin (2026), with recent highlights at Fusion Festival (2024), Synästhesie (2025) and VOID (2025). 


At SXSW, The Dharma Chain bring a live show that’s raw, hypnotic and built to pull you in.

events.title: Era Wadi
events.description: Era Wadi is an artist, rapper, and songwriter based in Austin, TX. His early musical inspirations began from his father's collection of soul and rock vinyls of the 60s/70s and hip hop of the late 90s/early 2000s. Era Wadi continues to build up his own discography and is releasing music independently. His constant aim at originality and being authentically himself attracts new audiences and has an exciting new EP releasing this Spring. When he’s not making music, you will find him hosting The Wadi Show with his DJ, Lil Em on Twitch + YouTube, a platform for artists by artists that has become one of the top live streaming channels for entertainment. Era Wadi’s unique voice, relatable songwriting, infectious energy, and impeccable beat selection, insure Wadi will carve out his place as an innovator in this new and ever evolving era of culture.

events.title: Famous Friend
events.description:
Famous Friend is the sun-bleached, indie surf solo project of ASCAP award-winning artist and producer Zachariah Carlson. Born out of the fame-soaked dreamscape of West Los Angeles, Famous Friend began as an alter-ego, a playful mirror of the city’s obsession with image. His music blends washed-out indie surf guitars with sparkling dream pop production and post-punk drums, balancing joy and heartbreak in equal measure.

The result is nostalgic and cinematic: beach day euphoria melts into late night reflections about relationships past and present. Songs like “Tanlines” and “Nora” have earned millions of streams and support from KCRW tastemakers and helped secure him a spot as a recent member of the prestigious Taco Bell Feed the Beat class of 2025. Amidst all the noise, Famous Friend continues to turn California melancholy into shimmering, golden-hour anthems for dreamers and outsiders.

P.S. The multi-instrumentalist is also a frequent writer, producer, collaborator with some of Los Angeles’s premiere indie and alternative acts like Winnetka Bowling League, Casket Cassette, and Floats as well as composer for shows like the Emmy-Nominated “Alexa & Katie.”

events.title: Flor de la Frontera
events.description:
Born in McAllen Tx raised in the border with Reynosa Mx mixed cultured, rancher family with passion for folklore, music, outdoors and traditions 
Been doing cumbia for couple of year initially in México giving the cumbia rythms a spicy twist with tropical, norteño, amazónico, tumbado, inmortal ®gional flavors

events.title: Geto Gala
events.description: Geto Gala is an Austin-based hip-hop duo formed by vocalists Deezie Brown and Jake Lloyd. Known for blending Southern rap, "candy slab" tradition, and, in particular, the influence of DJ Screw, they released their debut EP in 2021 before dropping their full-length album, Major League, in 2025.

events.title: Girl Tones
events.description:
Girl Tones, of planet Earth, are a high-energy rock duo brought to life by two sisters named Kenzie and Laila. Both classically trained musicians, Kenzie transitioned from cello to guitar and Laila from piano to drums in an effort to electrify sentient beings from this galaxy to the next. Their debut releases were produced by Brad Shultz of Cage The Elephant and released via his label Parallel Vision in partnership with Big Loud Rock.
Their first offerings have earned the praise of Rolling Stone, VICE, Consequence, PAPER, NME, DORK and many others with Flaunt saying, “Their sound is fluid, and yet with each release, they evolve as a harmonious group, developing their unique sound as one.”
Girl Tones has toured with Cage The Elephant across the globe, as well as The Velveteers, hey, nothing. and Silversun Pickups in North America. Making their unignorable festival debut at Lollapalooza, Shaky Knees, Austin City Limits and more, Rolling Stone said, “While the White Stripes — their most obvious comparison — were about controlled energy, Girl Tones are proudly imperfect.”
As the band jumps into 2026, they have no shortage of new music and new tour dates up their sleeves.

events.title: Glassio
events.description: Glassio is the Dream-Pop–tinged Indie-Dance project of Irish-Iranian songwriter and producer Sam R. Blending melodic sweetness with brooding dance beats, his self-described “melancholy disco” sound has earned over 25 million streams and global acclaim. Since emerging with the viral 2016 EP Poptimism (whose single “Try Much Harder” hit No. 9 on Spotify’s Global Viral Chart), Glassio has toured internationally with acts like Clap Your Hands Say Yeah, Nada Surf, and Electric Youth, and released two acclaimed LPs—For the Very Last Time (2020, Downtown Music) and See You Shine (2022)—with songs featured on Netflix and HBO. Raised between the Middle East and California and later based in New York and London, Sam draws influence from New Wave, 60s chamber pop, and early-2000s electronica, channeling it into rich, cinematic pop. His upcoming third album, The Imposter (2026), written during his move from New York to London, fuses shoegaze, folk, and dream pop in a neo-noir exploration of self-confrontation and creative rebirth. “I wanted this album to make people ask if they’re living the life they’re meant to,” he says. “For me, this is about rediscovering who I am as an artist.

events.title: Jana Diab
events.description:
Jana Diab is a Cairo-born, London‑based singer-songwriter whose work blends emotional vulnerability with a bold, genre‑fluid sensibility. 

Raised in a home steeped in the arts — her mother introduced her to Theater and Broadway — Diab grew up absorbing the power of storytelling and performance. 

Her music draws from the experimental, kaleidoscopic sounds of artists like Lorde, Half Waif, and Saya Gray, yet her lyricism is deeply personal: negotiating identity, ADHD, and the tension of living between cultures. 

In 2023 she released her debut EP Season One via Interscope, and in November she followed it with an extended edition featuring additional tracks.

Most recently, on 17 October, she released her new single “Cipriani,” on U–nation Music, marking the next chapter in her artistic evolution. She also holds the distinction of being the first ambassador for the fashion house Miu Miu across the Middle East.

At 23, Diab continues carving a space that honors her heritage while defying easy categorisation — a voice for third‑culture youth finding clarity through art.

events.title: Jason Cuellar
events.description:
Jason Cuellar is an Austin based DJ, guitarist, producer, and founder of Texas Gold Records. He blends Cumbia, Tejano, Latin, and Texas roots music to create high energy cultural experiences that connect generations and communities. Jason performs during SXSW and produces large scale events at venues including Hotel Vegas, The Far Out Lounge, and Mexic-Arte Museum, drawing 300 to 600 attendees per show.

In 2023, he launched the Unidos Por Música series with support from the City of Austin Live Music Fund, spotlighting Latino artists and multidisciplinary creators. He has also served as a grant reviewer within Austin’s cultural funding ecosystem, giving him insight into artist sustainability and community impact.

For SXSW 2026, Jason is producing and DJing Austin’s biggest Cumbia Showcase at Hotel Vegas. He is actively seeking brand and community partners aligned with Austin’s Latino music movement.

For more information or to contact Jason visit https://www.jasoncuellar.com

events.title: Joe Harvey-Whyte
events.description:
Joe Harvey-Whyte is one of the most innovative and exciting pedal steel players around. He has worked with a diverse range of artists including Liam Gallagher & John Squire , James Vincent McMorrow, The Magic Numbers , Susanne Sundfør , Billy Bragg , Tony Visconti , Nilüfer Yanya , Jody Stephens , Bullion , Mozart Estate, Alabama 3, Young Jesus & many more. 

Aside from his work as a session musician Joe is also a multidisciplinary artist working at the cross section between ambient/experimental music, visual art and environmental sound. His solo work combines the sound of the pedal steel guitar with electronics and field recordings to make works that create a space for deep listening & reflection.

events.title: Kordelya
events.description:
KORDELYA es una artista y productora mexicana de electro-pop y R&B, reconocida por unir lenguajes y culturas a través de sonidos y letras honestas, a veces vulnerables y otras veces irónicamente sarcásticas.
Con su álbum debut Mal Hecha, KORDELYA conecto con público al retratar, con orgullo, la imperfección de ella misma en cada canción. Su vulnerabilidad y autenticidad se reflejan tanto en su música como en sus videoclips cinematográficos, que dan vida a su universo visual.
A lo largo de su carrera, ha compartido escenario con artistas como Ximena Sariñana, José Madero y Leonel García. Además, fue invitada por Billboard como artista asociada en el programa Latin Women in Music, y se ha presentado en plataformas y medios como Telemundo Acceso Total Live, Azteca TV, TIDAL Living Room Sessions y Sofar Sounds Give Rise de Fujifilm Instax.

events.title: Mae Muller
events.description:
Mae Muller is one of Britain’s most dynamic and boundary-pushing pop artists. With a voice forged through honesty and raw emotion, Mae has become an authentic voice for a generation, fearless in her vulnerability, unapologetic in her expression, and unafraid to tell it like it is. 

Mae’s shows are more than just live performances, they are moments of connection. She writes songs that dive into real relationships, self-worth, heartbreak, empowerment, and resilience. Her lyrics and performances have drawn praise for their relatability and emotional truth.

Having already toured arenas with major acts, headlined her own tours, performed on international festival bills, and represented her country on one of music’s largest stages, the journey is only just beginning. With her debut album out and her fanbase ever growing, Mae is ready to build on her momentum, embodying an artist who is fearless, authentic, and endlessly evolving.

events.title: MITA
events.description:
MITA — The Alchemist of Latin Pop 
Based in Mexico City, MITA is a producer, singer-songwriter, composer and DJ shaping a distinctive vision of contemporary Latin pop. Holding a Master’s degree in Social Sciences, she fuses intellect and instinct to read the collective pulse and translate it into refined yet playful Latin pop narratives infused with R&B, Kpop and tropical rhythms. A composer for Netflix and HBO, MITA moves fluidly between the club and the stage, delivering magnetic performances where connection, presence and storytelling place the audience at the center. Her debut album D.A.R (Desire, Love & Romance) frames love as a cyclical journey toward self-acceptance, positioning MITA as a multifaceted voice of modern Latin identity.

events.title: OPR AVON
events.description:
OPR AVON is a Toledo, Ohio–bred artist turning hunger into highlight reels. Blending raw Midwest grit with cinematic storytelling, his sound feels like the fourth quarter with everything on the line. Inspired by underdog journeys and championship mentality, OPR AVON builds music that speaks to pressure, perseverance, and purpose.

His recent project, Road to Glory 25, captures the grind from overlooked prospect to campus legend, fusing sharp wordplay, confident delivery, and stadium-sized energy. Every record feels intentional — crafted for those chasing legacy, not just clout.

Beyond music, OPR represents a mindset: Outlast. Protect. Resist. It’s about standing firm, betting on yourself, and proving you belong in rooms they didn’t expect you to enter.

On stage, expect intensity, authenticity, and a performance that feels bigger than the moment. OPR AVON isn’t here to participate — he’s here to compete.

events.title: Ozer
events.description: Ozer, San Francisco’s own, has been cultivating his lyrical voice since the age of six, first turning to music as a refuge from life’s challenges and later sharpening his craft through the influence of artists like J. Cole, Kendrick Lamar, and Nipsey Hussle. What began as inspiration evolved into intention as Ozer matured—transforming lived experience into honest, reflective songwriting grounded in execution, flow, and substance. Following the release of his latest EP Fog City, he has shared stages with Westside Boogie, Topaz Jones, Trayce Chapman, YGTUT, and more, solidifying his presence as a formidable and thoughtful emcee. A writer at heart and performer by nature, Ozer uses language as a lyrical canvas, drawing from the essence of real life to create music that resonates with clarity, purpose, and lasting impact.

events.title: PONS
events.description:
IF YOU STOP YOU DIE - 

Rock n’ Roll will never be a lazy game. PONS is here to set the record straight.

Channeling the wild, untamable spirit of the masters of the road that came before them, PONS brings a relentless, “NO MERCY” approach to DIY touring. Burning more calories in one night than most bands do in a year, PONS doesn’t play just music—they detonate on stage

Taking cues from the anarchic swagger of Iggy Pop and the electronic chaos of Suicide, frontperson Jack Parker spits the digital bile of our decaying, internet-saturated world straight in your face. It’s a new noise pop for the modern age.

With their dashing look and salesman’s eye, PONS has supported notable acts such as Gogol Bordello, Lambrini Girls, A Place To Bury Strangers, Laura Jane Grace, Geese, Vundabar, Frankie and the Witch Fingers, and more. 

BEAR WITNESS TO PONS.

events.title: Pyrex
events.description: Pyrex Whippa (Kedrick Isaiah Cannady) is a Baltimore-born producer and rapper known for his atmospheric, dark trap beats as a prominent member of 808 Mafia and Metro Boomin’s Boominati collective. He has produced for artists like Future, Young Thug, and 21 Savage, launching his solo rap career in 2019 with projects like Sincerely, Rex.

events.title: Sasha Wrist
events.description:
Sasha Wrist is a bilingual singer-songwriter and vocal artist from Venezuela, now based in Los
Angeles. Her genre-bending sound fuses the grit of hip-hop, the pulse of electronic music, the
sensuality of R&B, and the emotional depth of Latin pop. 

Her voice first gained traction in the global music scene through the viral success of her Splice
vocal packs, which have been downloaded and sampled by producers worldwide, incorporating Sasha’s vocals into standout tracks like “Famax” and “Perreo”.

In late 2024, Sasha released her debut album, LA CHAMA. More than just a debut, the album serves as a love letter to her Venezuelan roots. Tracks like “SUR,” “CORO,” “KRTELUO,” and “LLANEROS” explore her upbringing, resilience, and self-discovery. 

Beginning in early 2025, Sasha made a sharp artistic pivot with the release of The Wrist
Wave, a melodic house EP with tracks like “Ya Te Borre,” and “IGOT2." She also collaborated with some of the world’s biggest phonk artists, Ariis, YB Wasg'ood, and Nakama, on their track “LUNA LA.”

Sasha Wrist's next project, titled "404:NJD" will release in February 15 and will bring her back to rap roots.

events.title: She23
events.description: She23 is an Austin-native singer, rapper, DJ and songwriter known for blending genres and building culture at the same time. Fusing hip-hop, R&B, and alternative influences, She is known for high-energy, club-oriented tracks and local performances. Active in the ATX music scene for over 15 years, She released the "2H3EO" EP in 2024 and is known for singles like "Goofy Goober" & "Chedda". You can also find She23 spinning some of your favorite hits at local venues such as Coconut Club, Traphouse and many more. Beyond the music, she curates and coordinates events that spotlight community, collaboration, and emerging voices. She23 has stepped onto official stages for SXSW, Dream Con, and AfroTech, continuing to make her mark as both a genre-blending artist and a force behind the scenes.

events.title: t-low
events.description:
t-low is one of the most distinctive voices of the new German music generation. With a raw emotional honesty and a sound rooted in emo rap and alternative pop, he has become a defining figure in the post-Gen-Z youth culture of the German-speaking world. Born and raised in a small town in northern Germany, t-low emerged from SoundCloud culture and quickly gained nationwide attention with his unfiltered lyrics and melodic sensibility. His music explores themes of mental health, love, identity, and existential struggle delivered with a rare vulnerability that resonates deeply with his audience.

With multiple gold and platinum records, sold-out tours, and chart-topping singles, t-low has established himself as a generational voice in Germany. Yet despite his commercial success, he has consistently pushed boundaries and stayed artistically uncompromising. In late 2025, t-low will release his highly anticipated comeback album "REAL MUSIC", marking a return to his roots with a more introspective, emotionally complex sound. His showcase at SXSW 2026 is not about breaking into the U.S. market - it’s a statement.

events.title: Torture and the Desert Spiders
events.description:
Torture and the Desert Spiders is a NYC-based indie post-punk project based on the songwriting of NY-native Anna Kunz. The project, previously based in the north of England, has performed well over 400 shows since its inception, including a currently running 46+ week headline residency in NYC as well as shows for the BBC at the Cavern Club (Liverpool), at Webster Hall (NYC), for the British Arts Council with Mattiel (Hull), at Kendal Calling Festival (2022, 2023), and sold out shows at the Supersonic Club (Paris), The Windmill Brixton (London), and Night and Day (Manchester, UK).
The project has recently released two singles mixed by Alex Poeppel (Telescreens). Torture and the Desert Spiders next NYC show will be supporting Cab Ellis at the Bowery Ballroom on January 9th.

events.title: Valee
events.description: Valee is a Chicago-born rapper known for his minimalist delivery, deadpan charisma, and hypnotic approach to trap and street rap. Emerging from the city’s underground, he broke through with cult-favorite records like Womp Womp and Good Job, You Found Me, later releasing projects via Kanye West’s GOOD Music before continuing independently. Valee’s sound is defined by sparse beats, unconventional flows, and an anti-performative cool that has influenced a wave of modern rap aesthetics. He’s collaborated and shared stages with artists across the experimental and mainstream rap spectrum, earning a reputation as a tastemaker’s rapper with lasting cultural impact rather than trend-chasing appeal.

events.title: Valsian
events.description: Oscar and Eunice, a music electronic pop mexican duo.

events.title: Vertarias
events.description: Vertarias is an Austin, Texas-based movement director, choreographer, and singer. Originally from California, they have a background working in the Hollywood film and TV industry. Vertarias is a 3-time "Choreographer of the Year" nominee by the Austin Chronicle and has been recognized by the Rolling Stone Culture Council for their event work. As a performer, they are known for their R&B and pop sound, having released the debut EP "VERT" in 2022. Vertarias, who identifies as queer and non-binary, is dedicated to creating a platform for other talented musical artists.

events.title: Very Necessary
events.description: Two Texas producers, Steelo Foreign and Roy Smith have recorded and produced for an impressive roster of talent, including Gucci Mane, Sada Baby, Smooky MarGielaa, Jazz Cartier, Bella Thorne, ThouxanbanFauni, Maxo Kream, Playboi Carti, OMB Peezy, Stunna4Vegas, Trae Tha Truth, Guapo, Chalie Boy, Warhol.ss, Billyracxx, and many more. Their extensive credits reflect their commitment to excellence and ability to work across genres.

events.title: Vivir Quintana
events.description:
Vivir Quintana is a Mexican singer, composer, and women’s rights activist renowned for blending regional Mexican with different genders. She is widely considered one of Latin America's most powerful voices. Her landmark track, "Canción sin miedo," has become a global feminist anthem against gender-based violence, translated and adapted worldwide.

Vivir was a student at the SACM composition workshop, in which she earned the María Grevers and FONCA scholarships and won the "Éxito SACM 2021" award for Best Independent Song. Forbes also recognized her as one of Mexico's 100 most creative people.

She has shared the stage with icons like Mon Laferte, Andrea Echeverri, Majo Aguilar and Rubén Albarrán.

Currently, she is promoting her second album under Universal Music Mexico, "Cosas que sorprenden a la audiencia" this is a powerful reinterpretation of the traditional Mexican corrido, transforming the genre into an instrument of social justice. The album features ten songs narrated in the first person, telling the true stories of women who were incarcerated or deprived of their physical liberty for defending themselves against gender-based violence and their abusers.

events.title: Wiardon
events.description: Wiardon is an Austin, Texas–based producer and rapper recognized for his versatile sound, which ranges from gritty underground textures to lo-fi, sample-driven, and atmospheric production. His work blends the raw edge of East Coast grime with contemporary West Coast hip-hop influences. Beginning his career as a producer in his early teens, Wiardon has collaborated with artists such as Lucki, Baby Smoove, Mavi, and Wiki, before expanding his catalog with releases as both a rapper and producer.

events.title: Willgood
events.description:
Willgood has now been DJing long enough that the original plan to fund a nationwide automotive repainting initiative exclusively in red has been officially downgraded from “ambitious” to “symbolic.” What started as a financial experiment became a long-term commitment to dance floors, tasteful grooves, and basslines that behave like they know what they’re doing.

Still operating without formal mentorship (DJ Pagliacci remains legally unreachable), Willgood approaches DJing as a serious craft with unserious presentation favoring disco, house, and dance music that sneaks up on you, locks in, and refuses to rush. Still has the long term goal of being the 4th member of Being Dead. He loves Ferraris, not because they’re fast, but because they’re precise, opinionated, and allergic to subtlety.

The hat is gone. The red remains. Catch Willgood at SXSW doing what he does best: keeping it fun, keeping it moving, and quietly convincing you this was always the plan.

events.title: Yoshi
events.description:
YOSHI es considerado uno de los artistas más completos y consolidados de México. Sus habilidades en producción musical, composición y dirección creativa, han resultado en un proyecto que orgánicamente conecta a través de una estética y mensaje únicos. Combinando distintos géneros y sonidos, ofrece una alternativa al mainstream latinoamericano con una propuesta que promete ser el nuevo pop mexicano. Ha trabajado con artistas como Alvaro Díaz, Latin Mafia, Jesse Baez, entre muchos otros. 
Nominado 4 veces a Latin Grammy (Productor y Compositor) Nominado una vez a grammy (Compositor).

events.title: Free Professional Headshots Presented by Precision Camera & Video with Fujifilm
events.description: Precision Camera & Video, in partnership with Fujifilm, is offering FREE professional headshots! This is a great opportunity to get a sharp, high-quality image with expert guidance. Don’t miss your chance to elevate your professional look.

events.title: ICF Greater Austin Charter Chapter: 1:1 Coaching Pop-Up
events.description:
Whether you’re pressure-testing a big idea or sparking fresh innovation, this 20-minute laser-style coaching session is the ultimate game-changer for your SXSW Emerging Tech Expo experience. Book your session with one of 30+ ICF-credentialed coaches and make your next move intentional.

Sign up for a session here: https://signup.com/client/invitation2/secure/161661456086/false#/invitation

events.title: Precision Camera & Video and Fujifilm Presents: Free Professional Headshots
events.description: Looking to update your LinkedIn profile, business card, or marketing material? Swing by for a free professional headshot by Precision Camera & Video and Fujifilm. This is an awesome chance to get a sharp, high-quality photo. Don’t miss out on this fantastic opportunity to elevate your image with expert help!

events.title: SXSW Expo: Emerging Tech (Free & Open to the Public)
events.description:
Showcasing a collective of industry disruptors, the Emerging Tech Expo features businesses spearheading the development of revolutionary technology. At the forefront of tech, these breakthrough exhibitors are shaping the future of tomorrow’s solutions. Plug into the network of visionary leaders that are pioneering the digital frontier. The Expo will be free and open to the public on Wednesday, March 18.

See the floor plan here: https://sxsw2026-sxexpoetech.expofp.com/

events.title: University of Cincinnati Lounge
events.description: Think of us as the ultimate college lounge: coffee, chargers, comfy chairs, some adult beverages, and all the fuel you need to spark your next great idea. Oh, and there will be a free Allbirds drawing every day.

events.title: American Dream 2.0: How Cities Will Design Our Future
events.description: America turns 250 next year, but the original American Dream is broken and outdated. If Singapore can build for efficiency and Copenhagen for equity, what would an American city of the future look like? Civic Innovator founder Andreas Addison invites attendees into a real-time design challenge to reimagine the American Dream for the next 250 years. Grounded in personal story, Brookings research, and proven civic wins from working in City Hall to serving on City Council, this talk introduces a 7-step Civic Innovation process to help cities design for impact with new systems that work for us.

events.title: Beyond Beautiful: A Data-Driven Framework for Design ROI
events.description: Great design is often treated as an expense rather than an investment because we lack concrete methods to measure its business impact. Drawing from proven data valuation methodologies, we'll introduce a practical three-component framework that translates design improvements into measurable business outcomes. We will reference real-world case studies and demonstrate how design decisions directly influence Customer Lifetime Value (CLTV) and Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC), walking through an example showing how a typical e-commerce checkout redesign can generate exponential ROI.

events.title: Build Community Through Storytelling
events.description:
The fastest way to create community isn’t networking.
It’s shared humanity.

In this highly interactive session, FABx founder Colleen Schell and guests guide you through a storytelling experience designed to take the room from strangers to a connected community. You’ll explore why story is more than entertainment: it’s a cultural technology that dissolves separation, builds trust quickly, and invites people to belong. Learn how to share your most potent story and walk away with a powerful tool for connection. 

This isn’t a panel. 
It’s an experiment in connection through sharing your story.

events.title: Come to Your Senses: Designing Analog Tools for a Digital World
events.description: How do you create analog products that resonate in an increasingly digital world? As interest in tactile, sensory experiences grows, designers are rethinking how physical objects engage us—through touch, sound, even scent. From the feel of materials to the rhythm of use, these sensory cues shape how we connect with the tools around us. In this fireside chat, leaders in analog design explore why slowing down matters, what it takes to craft products that invite presence, and how intentionally designed objects can offer a counterbalance to digital speed.

events.title: Defending Democracy: How Cities Rise Up When Feds Push Down
events.description: As federal authoritarianism threatens civil rights, immigration, and economic justice, cities are stepping up to defend democracy. Join District 2 Austin City Councilmember Vanessa Fuentes, at-Large Philadelphia City Councilmember Kendra Brooks, and District 1 Los Angeles City Councilmember Eunisses Hernandez as they share diverse, frontline perspectives in this conversation moderated by Francesca Menes, Managing Director of the Membership & Organizing Team at Local Progress. If democracy survives this moment, it will be because cities held the line.

events.title: Film Production Legal Essentials Workshop
events.description: In this two-hour session, we will crack open some of the legal mysteries of film production. How do you clear content for use in your film?  Do you need an LLC?  How do you structure financial relationships?  The presentation will be in human-readable English (i.e., not too much legal jargon) and provide you with a basic legal foundation before you embark on your next film project. The first 90 minutes of the workshop will be dedicated to answering key production questions, and the remainder of the workshop will be open to a discussion and a Q&A.

speakers.name: Paul Szynol
speakers.title: Attorney/Professor
speakers.company: Film Law Group, University of Michigan Law School, Itchy Dog Films

events.title: From Policy to Practice: AI Implementation in Government
events.description: Artificial intelligence is no longer theoretical. Across the country, governments are moving from conversations about AI governance to real-world deployment — modernizing services, strengthening cybersecurity, improving legislative analysis, and rethinking how the public sector operates. But implementation is where the real work begins.

events.title: How to Be Seen: Building Your Personal Brand
events.description: Your reputation is your career capital. In this hands-on workshop, Alana O’Grady Lauk, a VP of Communications, and Katy Boos, a top thought leadership strategist, will guide you through why your personal brand matters, how to build it with confidence, and what visibility can unlock. You'll learn how to show up online and in real life in ways that feel authentic and sustainable. Expect real examples, actionable tools, and small group exercises designed to help you clarify your message, identify your platforms and target audiences, grow your presence, and speak with purpose.

speakers.name: Alana O'grady
speakers.title: Vice President of Public Affairs and Global Communications

events.title: Medicated for Life? Antidepressants & Conflicting Science
events.description: Are antidepressants really that hard to stop? Do the benefits outweigh the risks? Scientists can’t seem to agree on a definitive answer. And yet, Dr. Mark Horowitz has some 20,000 emails in his inbox from Americans who feel trapped on their meds. With insights from his clinical research at University College London, and his own harrowing journey tapering off antidepressants, Dr. Horowitz, the world leading expert in the science of safely stopping psychiatric meds, exposes the uncomfortable truths behind one of today’s most controversial topics in mental health.

events.title: Mentor Session: Alex Anderson (Sunshine Sachs Morgan & Lylis)
events.description: Meeting with this mentor is highly recommended if you're interested in Marketing/Advertising/PR, Storytelling, Content Strategy/Production.
