events.description: Meeting with this mentor is highly recommended if you're interested in Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning, Entrepreneurship, Future of Work.

events.title: Owning Your Narrative: Global Strategies for Indie Artists
events.description: The international music business is far larger and more lucrative than many expect – just look at the broad worldwide impact of LATAM artists like Bad Bunny and K-Pop groups like BTS. The question is, how does an artist from these regions and beyond achieve this kind of success? The answer lies with music distributors, marketers, and data analysts, who have the tools to break talented artists both in their home countries and around the world. In this panel, experts will explain which resources and team members artists should bring onboard to generate international interest, and when.

speakers.name: Guji Lorenzana
speakers.title: Director, A&R and Client Development, Asia-Pacific

events.title: The Participation Era - How AI & XR Turn Fans Into Players
events.description:
Why do we watch sports? Because we see ourselves in the players.

For decades, fan engagement has been built around access and attention. Now it’s being rebuilt around identity and participation. AI and XR are enabling fans to step inside the narrative — not just consume it. This session explores how sports and entertainment organizations can design participatory systems that transform fandom into shared authorship, cultural relevance, and long-term value.

events.title: PROs, Policy, and the Live Music Economy
events.description: An exploration of recent federal policy and U.S. Copyright Office activity addressing the growing number of Performing Rights Organizations (PROs) in the United States and the implications for the live music ecosystem. We will discuss how the current licensing structures and royalty distribution practices impact creators and live music licensees. The conversation will also examine opportunities for collaboration among PROs, creators, and licensees to improve licensing policy, increase transparency, and ensure a more efficient and equitable framework for licensing live performances.

events.title: Radical Generosity at Scale: the 100% for Purpose Model
events.description: At a moment when many companies are scaling back their social impact commitments, this session will look at the rise of the 100% for Purpose model and a growing movement of companies committing 100% of their profits to good causes. Featuring business leaders and founders who have put purpose at the center of their mission, this panel will explore what it takes to successfully build a brand that exists to give, how generosity and business growth can work hand in hand, and what it would take for more companies to join the movement.

events.title: The RAI of Every Day Things - from Principles to UX Practice
events.description: Responsible AI isn’t a buzzword—it’s a daily practice that drives the appropriate level of trust, mitigates risk, and powers better business outcomes. But what does it look like in product and design? It’s a practical, human-centered approach to designing AI systems that are safe, equitable, and effective. In this session, RAI leaders from Microsoft, SAP, Adobe, and JPMorgan Chase share real tools, UX strategies, and lessons from the trenches. Gain an understanding of RAI - and walk away with actionable best practices to apply now, whether you're leading solo or scaling across an enterprise.

speakers.name: Cecilia Ambros
speakers.title: Head of Content, Research and Product Design in ML/AI Operations, CCB

speakers.name: TB Bardlavens
speakers.title: GM & Director, Product Equity at Adobe

speakers.name: Ruth Kikin-Gil
speakers.title: Responsible AI strategist, Principal UX Designer at Microsoft, Copilot for Security

events.title: Ready for your Brand Close-Up?
events.description: Visit YouTube at the Brand & Marketing track to capture your own custom video to post on YouTube Shorts. Our team will guide you through the process and help you capture a unique brand snapshot of your time at SXSW. Open to all attendees during conference hours.

events.title: The Shortcut to Better Video for Overloaded Teams
events.description: Most teams need video—but don’t have the time to wade through tutorials or waste money on the wrong tools. This session is your shortcut to creating high-quality video using what you already have. Learn how to shoot anywhere and make it look good, what gear actually matters, which tools are worth it, and where AI will (and won’t) save you time. Whether you’re creating content for marketing, recruiting, or internal comms, you’ll leave with practical strategies to get results without getting overwhelmed.

events.title: SXSW Bookstore
events.description: Check out the SXSW Bookstore to browse the latest work authored by this year’s conference participants. Support your favorite speakers and find something you connect with to take back home. Open daily on the 6th floor of the Hilton Austin Downtown.

events.title: Trust, Tech & Disruption: Brand Love When Stakes are High
events.description: In a world where travel is unpredictable, housing is uncertain, and consumers are pulling back, how do brands that serve high-consideration decisions earn trust and love? This panel features leaders from Vrbo, Southwest Airlines, and Realtor.com — three brands navigating economic volatility, shifting expectations, and technological change while staying emotionally resonant. We'll explore how tech platforms build human connection, why emotional loyalty matters more than ever, and how creative strategies can evolve to meet the moment.

events.title: Unbland Your Climate Brand
events.description: Before climate tech can change the world, it needs to attract customers. So why do so many climate companies look like they’re trying to blend into the background?  This highly visual show-and-tell session is about the power of expressive design to drive growth. Join industry leaders who’ve built category-defining brands as they dive into climate design visual clichés and discuss standout brands using design to drive growth. They’ll also reveal the design choices in their work that made customers pay attention and what they learned building brands people want.

speakers.name: Jessica Appelgren
speakers.title: Senior Vice President, Communications And Marketing

events.title: Unlocking the Power of Community in the Post-Social Era
events.description: The marketing landscape is in chaos. As attention spans contract, audiences retreat to private digital spaces and ad costs rise, traditional playbooks are becoming obsolete. Sara Wilson identified this shift in 2020, coining “digital campfires” in Harvard Business Review to describe Gen Z’s move toward intimate communities. In this talk, she shares her community-powered marketing framework—shaped by years at Instagram and advising Fortune 500s—showing how prioritizing relevance over reach by tapping into organic communities drives attention, loyalty, and ROI.

events.title: Vibrant Wellness Exhibit Booth
events.description:
Personalized health and longevity are no longer niche topics—they’re becoming cultural priorities that will define the future of medicine, wellness, and human potential. Our exhibit space brings together integrative medicine, nutrition, longevity, and lifestyle optimization to explore how cutting-edge science and holistic approaches are reshaping the way we think about aging and long-term vitality. From cellular function to optimizing hormones, nutrition, brain performance, and exercise routines, our clinical experts will share what’s next in the rapidly evolving field of longevity—and how diagnostics can help inform longevity roadmaps.

https://vibrant-wellness.com/

events.title: What AI Can’t Replace: People Skills in a Changing World
events.description: AI is changing how we work. But the people skills that help teams thrive, like communication, time management, and adaptability, are here to stay and more crucial than ever (92% of companies say soft skills matter as much or more than hard skills). Learn what makes human skills like feedback, prioritization, and resilience durable in an AI-powered workplace as well as practical ways to grow these essential capabilities into scalable habits, starting with small behaviors that create a big impact.

speakers.name: Vanessa Tanicien
speakers.title: Global Director of Learning and Development

events.title: @BooksyBiz at SXSW 2026
events.description: Join Booksy, the fastest-growing booking platform for beauty services, in our pop-up salon and spa at the Congress Ave Block Party.Get free hair, nail, barber and massage services and consultations from our superstar Ambassadors and Top Texas Providers.

events.title: Beyond The Duplex Planet
events.description: In 1979, David Greenberger, a recent art school grad became activities director at a Boston nursing home. David began interviewing the residents, rejecting pat questions with the unexpected: "Which do you prefer – coffee or meat?," “What is embarrassment?,” and “How close can you get to a penguin?” The result was The Duplex Planet, an early ‘zine characterized by humor, warmth and sincerity. Today David’s work takes the form of spoken word shows and recordings. Beyond the Duplex Planet explores notions of aging and its intersection with art and community. It’s also a slightly ironic look at the life of an artist devoted to documenting the elderly who is himself in his senior years.
events.venue: Rollins Theatre at the Long Center

events.title: Congress Avenue Block Party
events.description: The Congress Avenue Block Party (formerly known as the Registrant Lounge) is the go-to space for all SXSW attendees to maximize their SX experience, offering daily complimentary drinks, food, and sponsor swag. Open throughout the conferences & festivals, this convenient and relaxing meeting point near the hub of SXSW action is an ideal spot to unwind and connect with other attendees. New for 2026, the Block Party is free and open to the public!

events.title: Crep Protect Clean & Chill
events.description: Get your sneakers cleaned and be in with the chance of winning some exclusive prizes with Crep Protect, the worlds leading sneaker care brand.

events.title: The Fox
events.description: Nick (Jai Courtney), affable heir to a wealthy rural landowner, discovers his fiancée, Kori (Emily Browning), is cheating on him and wants nothing more than to just fix the problem. One night, he captures a rogue Fox (Olivia Colman), and she offers him a trade-off: if Nick lets her live, the Fox will help him save his relationship. All he has to do is push Kori into a magic hole with the power to change her into the perfect partner. Nick follows the Fox’s advice and the Kori who re-emerges seems to be everything he ever wanted. Until her strange new quirks make him question his decision.

events.title: Free JonnyPops Samples - A Better Pop for a Better World!
events.description: Stop by the JonnyPops tent to enjoy the simple ingredients, delicious taste and kindness in every pop! Free pops and swag will be distributed each day. https://www.jonnypops.com/

events.title: Lainey Wilson: Keepin' Country Cool
events.description: Follow Wilson as she redefines the modern country star, proving that staying true to yourself can lead to major success. The film explores her personal journey, struggles, and triumphs as she captivates fans on stages across the country.

events.title: My/Mochi Joyfully Chill Ice Cream Shoppe
events.description: My/Mochi, the original and world's largest mochi ice cream brand, is inviting SXSW-goers to Taste the Joy! Our delightfully delicious ice cream wrapped in pillowy sweet rice dough comes in more than 20 flavors like Cookie Dough, Strawberry and Mango. So stop by our Joyfully Chill Ice Cream Shoppe at the Congress Ave Block Party Mar 12-18 to experience the joy for yourself!

events.title: The Painterland Sisters' Yogurt Farm Stand
events.description: Step into the Painterland Sisters' Yogurt Farm Stand to sample our organic skyr yogurt and for hands-on farm education. Learn what organic regenerative farming really means, explore sensory elements from the farm, and taste some simply yummy skyr yogurt packed with probiotics and protein. Straight from the pasture to your spoon - made with love!

events.title: Registration (Downright Austin)
events.description: Pick up your SXSW Badge or Music Wristband on the Capitol View Terrace of the Downright Hotel. Your badge is required in order to attend any sessions, events, or socials.

events.title: Registration (JW Marriott)
events.description: Pick up your SXSW Badge or Music Wristband in Griffin Hall of the JW Marriott. Your badge is required in order to attend any sessions, events, or socials.

events.title: They Will Kill You
events.description: "They Will Kill You" unleashes a blood-soaked, high-octane horror-action-comedy in which a young woman must survive the night at the Virgil, a demonic cult's mysterious and twisted death-trap of a lair, before becoming their next offering in a uniquely brazen, big screen battle of epic kills and wickedly dark humor.

events.title: The Verdadero 360 Tequila Experience
events.description:
The Verdadero 360 Tequila Experience is a 21+ tasting and education experience designed to let guests experience the Spirit For More. Guests sample different expressions while learning about agave, craftsmanship, and what sets Verdadero apart. The experience encourages curiosity, conversation, and connection. A 360 photo booth allows guests to capture and share the moment.

Check us out on Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/verdaderotequila/

events.title: The Last Critic
events.description: Sixty years & a million records ago, Robert Christgau invented Rock music criticism. Anyone who has ever read or written a Pop music review has been influenced by Christgau, who canonized legends from The Ramones to Public Enemy & infuriated icons from Lou Reed to Billy Joel. Now in his eighties, Bob is still at it—amazingly with the same vigor, wit, concision and craft that has defined his expansive career. But in a world where albums are irrelevant, where print is dead & where algorithms have eclipsed critics we are forced to ask: What happens next—for Bob, but also for all music criticism? Is this the end of something? Is Robert Christgau the last critic?

events.title: Plantman & Blondie: A Dress Up Gang Film
events.description:
An offbeat comedy about friendship, purpose, and trying to grow something real in a city built to keep people apart.
Cory is a lonely, doomscrolling thirty-something whose most consistent relationship is with his Instagram algorithm. His apartment? An emotionally vacant, sterile, void. His fridge? Mostly Celsius. And his idea of connection is dodging calls from the one person who still tries: Fox, a soft-hearted, ex-con with terrible advice rooted in institutional paranoia and his love of films. 
Everything shifts when Cory has a run-in, literally, with Plantman, a rogue horticultural crusader armed with a mysterious dossier of negligent plant owners.

events.title: Alphabet of Tomorrow: Trends in Typography
events.description: Typography is shifting fast — shaped by AI tools, new aesthetics, and a global wave of independent designers. In this session, two leading trendspotters unpack seven emerging type trends poised to reshape branding, culture and creative work. Expect a rapid tour of what’s next, why it matters, and how to stay ahead. Drawing on Goodtype’s studio practice (including Kernference and the Typecast podcast) and curatorial research from international graphic design exhibition Hundred Points, this talk distills key patterns shaping visual communication; and what they reveal about the future of design.

events.title: Author Meet Up
events.description: UNLEASH YOUR INNER AUTHOR!Stop dreaming and start dominating the literary world! Join the one and only #KillerPitchMaster Precious Williams for an electrifying deep dive into ALL THINGS AUTHOR.Whether you're a seasoned writer or just tapping out your first chapter, Precious is peeling back the curtain on the secrets to success:Pitch Like a Pro: Talk shop about contracts, marketing strategies, and killer pitches that get your book published—traditionally or self-published.Conquer the Page: Defeat writer’s block, harness inspiration, and learn the best way to leverage emerging technologies to elevate your craft.Your Genre, Your Rules: Get insights on dominating everything from non-fiction to the latest hot genre, long-form novels, and short stories.Connect with authors at every stage, share your journey, and learn how to celebrate every milestone. This is more than a talk; it's your launchpad to literary greatness!

events.title: Building the Alien: Morphology, Mutation & Future Life
events.description: What if we didn’t just search for alien life—but built it? Drawing from Proxima Kósmos, a research project exploring how life and intelligence might emerge under radically different conditions, this session examines the intersection of scientific experimentation and design. Claire Webb and designer Shane Griffin present Xenoterra—a modeled world inspired by evolutionary robotics and AI—that reimagines how we define life itself.

events.title: The Consumer’s Guide to Beating the Bots
events.description: Corporations are weaponizing your personal data to inflate prices, suppress wages, and undermine transparency and basic fairness. This panel will expose how a convergence of corporate power and new technology has created a dizzying array of deceptive pricing practices. From surveillance pricing on airfares to algorithmic price fixing by landlords, companies are leveraging troves of consumer data to rip off customers. Our panelists will share how they have successfully defeated some of these nefarious practices and what policymakers, regulators, and consumers can do to fight back.

events.title: The Cost of Inclusion: Who Pays When Equity Isn’t Trending
events.description: Remember when every brand promised to do better? In 2020, diversity and inclusion roles were created overnight, corporate pledges made, and equity became a buzzword. Fast forward to now, when those diversity offices and leadership budgets are vanishing, and DEI programs face contact attacks. Where does that leave leaders—especially Black women—who were once vaunted as symbols of progress? Expect data, sharp insights, and real stories as we unpack what it takes to create systems where Black women’s leadership can thrive even when equity isn’t trending.

events.title: Dead Deer High
events.description:
DEAD DEER HIGH follows a team of high school slam poets and their English teacher as they prepare for a national poetry competition one year after a tragedy changed their lives forever.

A powerful story of healing, poetry, and resilience in the face of tragedy, Dead Deer High was directed, written, produced, and edited by teachers.

events.title: Design in Tech Report 2026: UX to AX
events.description: Designers make screens/flows for stakeholders to review, for users to test, and for many teams to adjust until everything matches the brand. But as AI acts on human intent directly, we’ll be designing for agents. Not users. Grounded in research, this talk explores the shift to Agentic Experience (AX), moving from crafting interfaces to orchestrating outcomes with zero visual affordances. Early-career designers will snap to this new reality, late-stage folks get to skip it, but mid-career Product people have the most to lose and need to redesign themselves for the AX era.

events.title: Does Better Health Start with Dignity?
events.description: What does dignity feel like in health experiences and outcomes? Why does it matter now more than ever?  We’ll explore the role of dignity as a transformative force and unpack its emerging as a vital indicator of health quality, trust and connection. Dignity is reflected in how we’re treated, heard and how care is delivered. When it’s missing, the consequences are profound. As we evolve and reimagine the healthcare ecosystem so that it works better for everyone, health dignity offers a powerful lens that reveals opportunities to improve how help make health innovation real for more people.

speakers.name: Jewel Jones
speakers.title: Global Inclusion & Health Equity Practice Leader

events.title: Encrypted Resistance: Youth Revolt in Memes, Art & Metadata
events.description:
As authoritarian regimes globally expand digital control through AI-powered surveillance, censorship algorithms, and language policing, free expression faces coordinated attacks. These systems now share tools of repression across borders. In response, youth resist in whispers—through creativity and digital dexterity, they craft encrypted defiance. This panel explores how coded memes, slang, guerrilla art, and diaspora networks fuel encrypted defiance, reshaping protest through cracks in the digital firewall—online and on the ground.
This session is organized by the Human Rights Foundation.

speakers.name: Angelo Sathorn
speakers.title: Thai youth-led movement leader, member of United Front of Thammasat and Demonstration

speakers.name: Xiao Qiang
speakers.title: Research scientist at UC Berkeley School of Information; Founder, Editor-in-Chief of China Digital Times

speakers.name: Joan Donovan
speakers.title: Assistant Professor of Journalism and Emerging Media Studies

events.title: Expediting Psychedelic Research to Qualify for Right to Try
events.description: This session explores psychedelic science and federal Right to Try (RTT) law, which allows patients with life-threatening conditions to access investigational treatments outside of clinical trials. Featuring experts who helped pass historic psychedelic research legislation in Texas and Arizona, the panel will examine the scientific, legal, and ethical considerations of making these powerful but under-researched compounds accessible under RTT. Discussion will cover the current state of psychedelic research, pathways to FDA authorization, and how to qualify for compassionate use of psychedelics.

speakers.name: Logan Davidson
speakers.title: Legislative Director
speakers.company: Veterans Exploring Treatment Solutions (VETS) & Texans For Greater Mental Health (T4GMH)

speakers.name: Dr. Sue Sisley, MD
speakers.title: Principal Investigator & CMO
speakers.company: Scottsdale Research Institute/Field To Healed Foundation

events.title: Featured Session: Human-Centered Storytelling: Create Connection & Community
events.description: The most successful brands and leaders tell stories that move people deeply, spur connection and create community. Cheryl Miller Houser provides a powerful storytelling framework that achieves this by tapping into universally shared human emotions to foster understanding and belonging. Participants leave with actionable tactics they can apply across all platforms to build strong brands, shape culture, ignite loyalty, drive growth and mobilize positive change.

events.title: Featured Session: Ibogaine in America:  The Parable of Our Time
events.description: An ancient African medicine, Iboga, contains the most powerful psychedelic on the planet - ibogaine.  Known for decades in the underground of the West as a profound interrupter of drug addiction, U.S. military veterans have been fleeing to Mexico to access ibogaine treatment in a desperate struggle to save themselves from the physical, psychological, and spiritual ravages of war.  Recent medical discoveries related to ibogaine’s impact on the brain suggest that it may also be the most sophisticated molecule on the planet, holding revolutionary potential to transform the lives of millions across the world whose debilities are not responsive to synthetic pharmacology.  The pursuit of ibogaine’s medicalization within the United States is a daunting mission uniting diverse communities with common afflictions against institutional obstacles which expose and illuminate the dysfunctions of power over people as well as the monumental opportunity we now have for people to prevail over power.

events.title: Female Voices Shaping the Next Era of Preventive Health
events.description: Personalized health and longevity are no longer niche topics—they’re becoming cultural priorities that will define the future of medicine, wellness, and human potential. This panel brings together leading female voices in integrative medicine, nutrition, longevity, and lifestyle optimization to explore how cutting-edge science and holistic approaches are reshaping the way we think about aging and long-term vitality. From cellular function to optimizing hormones, nutrition, brain performance, and exercise routines, these experts will share what’s next in the rapidly evolving field of longevity—and why women are uniquely positioned to lead this transformation.

speakers.name: Dr. Poonam Desai
speakers.title: Founder, Cmo Of Longevity Place, Founder Of Her Longevity, Longevity & Precision Med Expert, Lifestyle Medicine, Menopause Certified

speakers.name: Kayla Barnes-Lentz
speakers.title: Longevity Entrepreneur And The Most Publicly Measured Woman In The World

events.title: Flag Football’s Startup Moment: Building a Global Sport for LA28
events.description:
Football is a cultural institution in America – it’s even taken over its own day of the week. But at the same time, its newest form, flag football, is still in its early stages. With the sport’s forthcoming debut at the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics, flag football is at an inflection point, scaling from community and high school leagues to the world’s biggest sporting stage.
 
In many ways, flag football is operating like a startup inside one of the world’s biggest legacy organizations. It has the agility, accessibility and grassroots appeal of a disruptive product, while also having the NFL’s platform and resources to help it scale.
 
This session will explore how the sport is growing internationally, why it resonates with the next generation of athletes, and what lessons innovators can take off the field by learning about what it takes to create the next Olympic sport.

events.description: The Gaming Content Creator Meet Up is a place for gaming creators of all kinds (long form, short form, streaming, reviews, news, let's play, etc) to come together and hang out at SXSW. Join us to meet gaming creators and others working in the gaming industry in Texas and those who have traveled in from across the country and internationally. Anyone who creates or works in content related to gaming broadly should attend! Video games, table top gaming, board games, retro gaming, gaming hardware, gaming UGC platforms, game devs creating content for their own projects, etc.

events.title: How to Be Seen, Heard, and Remembered on LinkedIn
events.description: LinkedIn is where your reputation takes shape in public. In this session, Don F. McLean reads from The In Crowd for LinkedIn Mastery (#1 in its category on Amazon in its first week!) and shares how professionals can build a presence that opens doors. Attendees will learn how to communicate clearly, show up with consistency, and turn visibility into meaningful opportunity. This talk challenges outdated habits and introduces a sharper, more strategic way to use LinkedIn for growth.

events.title: How to Build a B2B brand with Swagger: Lessons from B2C
events.description: In this talk, the Chief Brand Officer of ServiceNow offers three rules that B2B marketers can use to build a great brand, based on his B2C experiences. He will share tactics he is using to connect his brand with audiences and show up in unconventional places – Tribeca Film Fest, Aston Martin Aramco F1 cars, ads starring acclaimed actor Idris Elba – and how you can apply the lessons he’s learned to your own company, regardless of your budget. Discover why sounding like a human, personalizing your pitch, and using AI to fuel (not replace) your creativity are the keys to winning the brand wars.

events.title: Making a Mind Live from SXSW: When AI Agents Leave the Lab
events.description: Everyone's talking about AI agents, but what actually happens when companies deploy them to do real work? This live recording of the "Making a Mind" podcast explores the gap between how we think agentic AI should work and how it actually behaves in the wild. Cognitive scientist and podcast host Dr. Danielle Perszyk sits down with Michael Giannangeli, head of product, agentic AI for Amazon Nova, plus industry voices from Amanda Doerr, vice president of core shopping at Amazon and more who've recently launched agents into production. Together, they'll dissect real implementation stories—the successes, the surprises, and the moments where human expectations collided with AI reality. We'll explore the fundamental questions emerging as AI agents become collaborators: Where do humans want control versus autonomy? How do we build trust with systems whose reasoning we can't see? And how does cognitive science research translate into product decisions—from tool-calling architecture to the design choices that determine when agents act independently versus ask for help? This isn't a demo. It's an honest conversation about what we're learning as agentic AI moves from theory to practice—and what it reveals about both artificial and human intelligence.

events.title: My Brother's Killer
events.description: The unsolved murder of Billy London, a gay adult film performer brutally killed in West Hollywood, was an urban legend for 33 years. A documentary intended to honor his life took an unexpected turn when members of the community joined forces to uncover overlooked clues, and seek a resolution to the mystery of who killed him. Drawing on a rare trove of VHS and personal footage, the film reveals a chilling overlap between the victim and some of the suspects who were captured on camera in films made in the narrow window of Billy's death.

events.title: No Perfect Plans, Just Progress: Austins Housing Miracle
events.description: In the last two years, Austin, TX, has implemented some of the most ambitious land use reforms in the country, unlocking new possibilities in one of the nation’s fastest-growing and most expensive housing markets. But the real story isn’t just about zoning changes—it’s about the unlikely coalition that made them possible. We will take you behind the scenes of Austin’s housing transformation, sharing how to piece together technical expertise, grassroots activism, and strategic positioning to drive major policy wins.

events.title: Own the Fan, Own the Future: Artists Building Loyalty
events.description: In 2025, music campaigns live or die by fan connection, yet most artists don’t own their audience. Virgin Music Group’s Alice Young unpacks why taking control is more crucial than ever. From privacy-compliant data to personalized fan journeys, learn how to build long-term relationships beyond algorithms. Whether launching your first single or scaling globally, you’ll gain real tactics, tools, and creative strategies to turn passive followers into active superfans.

events.title: Power Ballad
events.description:
When Rick (Paul Rudd), a past-his-prime wedding singer, meets fading boy-band star Danny (Nick Jonas) during a gig, the two bond over music and a late-night jam session. But when Danny turns one of Rick’s songs into the hit that reignites his career, Rick sets out to reclaim the recognition he believes he deserves - even if it means risking everything he cares about. From writer-director John Carney (Sing Street, Once), POWER BALLAD is a feel-good story about music, self-respect, friendship, and the price of ambition. 

Lionsgate presents, in association with 30WEST + Fís Éireann / Screen Ireland, a Likely Story / Distressed Films production, in association with Treasure Entertainment.

events.title: Say Vagina: Platform Censorship, Algorithms, and the Cost to Women's Health
events.description: Across the country, platforms like Meta and the NYC MTA are blocking ads and posts that mention vaginal health, fertility or menopause— censoring essential medical terms and allowing misinformation to spread. In this panel, brand leaders and marketers will explore how censorship is shaping the way women’s health is discussed— or not discussed— in public spaces, and how companies are navigating censorship challenges. It will examine why naming matters and how bold, stigma-breaking messaging can educate, empower, and shift the narrative.

events.title: Serious Fun: How to Bring Game Mechanics into Product Design
events.description: Serious products don't have to be seriously boring. In fact, a little play might be the power-up your product needs. This talk explores how proven game mechanics like feedback loops, progression systems, and "juice" can supercharge your product's design, making it intuitive and addictive (in a good way!). Drawing from indie game dev, client work with major brands, and 40+ game jams, I'll show you how thinking like a game designer creates playful, emotionally resonant experiences. Learn to make your products more rewarding, alive, and user-loved. When in doubt, add more "juice"!

events.title: Smells Like Brand: The Future of Scent Branding
events.description: Every brand has a scent, whether designed or not. Now, brand leaders can control it. This panel explores the frontier of scent branding and the new AI-powered technology that enables it. With the development of olfactory intelligence (OI), brands can harness our most powerful sense, capturing consumers’ memories and influencing their associations. Hear from Generation by Osmo’s Founder and Master Perfumer on how OI has made fragrance accessible for brands and creators of all sizes, and from brand leaders harnessing its power to develop signature scents, including the Museum of Pop Culture.

events.title: Streaming Fraud: Where We Are and How it's Changing
events.description: Even after the first U.S. federal streaming fraud lawsuit in 2024, fraud and anomalous behavior remain major challenges. This panel explores recent developments, how AI is shaping both the problem and the solution, and who’s most impacted. We’ll share personal anecdotes, current case studies, and a ground-level view of how streaming fraud has evolved. We’ll also discuss what’s being done now (besides yelling into the void or shaking our fists at bots)

speakers.name: Kevin Rutherford
speakers.title: Senior Charts/Data Analyst, Streaming Services & Rock

events.title: Mallory's Ghost
events.description: Mallory, plagued by fears of being unremarkable, joins her playwright boyfriend Sam on a retreat to coastal Maine. When she learns he once brought his glamorous ex, Louise, there, she’s struck with an obsessive curiosity about his past. As her jealousy takes hold, Mallory becomes convinced she’s being haunted by the ghost of Louise herself... Pulled into a journey that slips between past and present, rivalry and affection, melancholy and creativity, Mallory drifts further from her old life and toward something essential. "Mallory’s Ghost" is a psychological and playful exploration of envy, and the strange path it can lead back to the Self.

events.title: Mam
events.description: After falling in love with Vietnamese cuisine during a life-changing trip abroad, Jerald—a self-taught chef from small-town Texas—arrives in New York City with one goal: to open his own restaurant. Juggling odd jobs and secretly perfecting recipes in a basement kitchen, he’s running out of time and money. When he meets Nhung, a sharp-witted Vietnamese waitress, their unlikely alliance sparks a bold culinary journey. From improvised street hustles to a hidden speakeasy, they fight to turn Jerald’s dream into reality. A story of passion, resilience, and unexpected friendship in the heart of the city.

events.title: Buddy
events.description: A brave girl and her friends must escape a kids television show.

events.title: A Cowboy in London
events.description: In A Cowboy in London, filmmaker Jared Christopher captures a rare portrait of Charley Crockett on the verge of global stardom. Shot in the verite tradition, the film follows Crockett during a whirlwind week in London: 3 sold-out solo shows at historic Hoxton Hall, candid tv, radio & newspaper interviews, tourist wanderings, and intimate moments with fiancee Taylor Grace, whose camcorder diary intertwines with professional footage. Between forgotten lyrics and celebrity cameos, Crockett confronts the state of America, Ai in music, and the music industry itself, revealing a vulnerable, defiant artist unafraid to speak truth while chasing greatness.

events.title: High Score Game Arcade presents the Worldwide Tic-Tac-Toe Championship
events.description:
The Worldwide Tic Tac Toe Championship comes to its final, high-stakes moment at SXSW. After months of play across cities and communities around the world, this activation marks the culmination of a global tournament—bringing finalists, fans, and curious passersby together for live competition, spectacle, and celebration. Simple rules, universal appeal, and unexpected intensity converge in one last showdown where strategy, speed, and bragging rights are decided in real time.

More information here: highscoregamearcade.com

events.title: SXSW Film & TV Clubhouse
events.description: The Film & TV Clubhouse is located at 800 Congress Ave, just steps away from the Paramount Theatre, where some of the most exciting screenings of the Festival are set to premiere. It will serve as the home base for the film community to gather, discuss, and network. Each day the Film & TV Clubhouse will host meetups and networking events as well as activations.

events.title: SXSW Innovation Clubhouse
events.description: The historic Brazos Hall is the official Innovation Clubhouse for 2026. It's the perfect place to connect with attendees looking to gain insights and inspiration from like-minded conference-goers. Each day the Innovation Clubhouse will host meetups and networking events as well as activations.

events.title: SXSW Music Clubhouse
events.description: The Music Clubhouse is located at The Downright Austin. Perfect for networking and industry connections, the Clubhouse will also feature live performances at Radio Day Stage and mentor sessions. It’s also the perfect spot to access most of our music venues by foot or a quick rideshare. Each day the Music Clubhouse will host meetups and networking events as well as activations.

events.title: THUNDEROSA
events.description:
WORLDWIDE AND BONAFIDE SINCE 1998! The mind melting genius sounds of "Thunderosa" refers to a high-octane Texas rock 'n' roll band known for their "mind-melting" blend of stoner rock, Apocalyptic blues, and Speed boogie. 
"A low down & dirty outfit." (JM)
events.venue: Radio Day Stage @ Downright Austin Backyard

events.title: Vibrating Music Hammocks
events.description:
The Music Hammock transforms its fabric into a speaker, resonating your body with the frequencies of the music so you feel as if you’re lying inside a sound system. In our fast-paced society, we often disconnect from our bodies. This installation offers a full-body listening experience, shifting your attention from mental chatter into physical awareness. Experience sound not only through your ears, but through your entire body.

events.title: Don F. McLean Book Signing
events.description: Don F. McLean will be signing copies of “The In Crowd for LinkedIn Mastery” at the SXSW Bookstore.

events.title: Beyond the 9-to-5: Rewrite Your Success with a Portfolio Career
events.description: Explore how the traditional career path (maybe even yours soon) can be replaced by multi-stream careers that combine financial independence with impact. Join us to learn how you can build a career that offers true flexibility - of place, time, and choice - by thinking like a remote entrepreneur, even if you aren’t one yet. Designing a lean, sustainable portfolio with minimal overhead can help you turn your true passions and causes into scalable income streams, one venture at a time.

speakers.name: Sophie Sumner
speakers.title: Host | Actress | Producer | Mental Health Activist

events.title: Brands Built for Fandom Report
events.description: Fandom has become one of the last true engines of belonging, meaning, and participation as shared institutions fade and identity moves online. This report, from SOON Future Studies and SoHo Experiential, explores how fandom evolved from subculture to cultural infrastructure and why it now carries the emotional weight of legacy systems. We outline what this shift means for brands and how fandom has become not just what people love but where they choose to live.

events.title: Changing the Game: The Playbook for Creator-Driven Campaigns
events.description: Gaming is one of the largest forms of entertainment in the world & the creator economy within it is rapidly expanding. A process that once prioritized creators with the largest audiences & revenue streams has since evolved to working with a range of  creators, targeting those with the most engaged audiences. As the industries continue to grow & scale each year, recruiting, managing, measuring & tracking hundreds of creators can feel impossible, but it doesn’t have to. This panel explores how brands & developers are building smart systems that fuel high-performing evergreen creator programs.

speakers.name: Mitch Inkrott
speakers.title: Global Director of Influencer Strategy & Relations - Battlefield

events.title: Designing AI for Human Thriving
events.description: AI safety won’t be solved with better guardrails. The real question is what we train AI to optimize for. Anastasia Uglova, founder of Better Half and the technologist behind “agentic tech,” argues that today’s systems reward engagement and dependency – especially in the relational domain. What if we designed AI for agency and human thriving instead? This talk explores why relationships are AI’s highest-risk and highest-potential frontier and how a new design philosophy could unlock entirely new forms of social technology.

events.title: Digital Analytics & Innovation Meet Up
events.description: Back by popular demand, this SXSW meetup reunites the data-obsessed and innovation-hungry. In a digital landscape that shifts daily, "analytics" is no longer just about reporting on what happened yesterday—it’s about architecting what happens tomorrow. As the gap between raw data and creative innovation narrows, the role of the analyst is evolving from observer to navigator. Whether you’re a digital analyst, a data scientist or a CMO, join us to move beyond standard KPIs and discuss advanced analytics in product innovation. Come swap war stories, debate ethics, and explore how data democratization is changing the creative process.

events.title: Documentary Filmmaker Mentor Session: PJ Raval (Unraval Pictures)
events.description: Meeting with this mentor is highly recommended if you're interested in Doc Filmmakers, Producers/Production.

events.title: Everything Is a Touchpoint: Designing Cohesive Brand Moments
events.description: Every interaction tells your brand’s story. As marketing guru Seth Godin reminds us, “Every interaction, in any form, is branding.” This workshop explores how every facet of your brand, from your website to a digital campaign or even an internal memo, creates a lasting impression. Join us as we break down universal principles of elevated design, brand consistency, and intuitive user experience, drawing on real-world examples. This session blends inspiration with hands-on practice, equipping you with actionable methods for strengthening brand cohesion across every touchpoint you influence.

events.title: F*ck Bauhaus: A Global Meetup to Recode Creative Work Meet Up
events.description: This is for designers, strategists, technologists, and creative misfits from around the world who refuse to let automation flatten our craft. We’ve designed a dynamic format: a built to spark real connection, fast idea exchange, and collective learning from every person in the room. Whether you want to reshape your creative code, challenge the algorithm, or just find your global crew this is your table.

events.title: Featured Session: A Conversation with Nothing's CEO and Co-Founder Carl Pei
events.description: Join Carl Pei for a wide-ranging conversation about where the tech industry is heading in 2026 - and why Nothing is on a mission to make tech for the next generation. In this session, Carl will reflect on how the consumer tech industry became closed and predictable, and why the next era will require a different mindset. He will share his perspective on some of the biggest shifts facing the industry, including the rise of AI-native hardware, and how AI is becoming a core part of the product experience. The conversation will also touch on Nothing’s own next chapter - from its continued push into audio to the brand’s growing physical footprint with new store openings planned across New York City, Tokyo, London, and India this year. Join Carl for a conversation about rebuilding belief in consumer technology, not by constant product launches, but thoughtful design, cultural relevance and products that people genuinely want to live with.

events.title: Featured Session: How CMOs are Rewriting the Rules of Connection
events.description: Modern CMOs have cracked the code: AI doesn't kill authenticity—it supercharges it. In this session, several CMOs skip the hype to share what actually works. They've turned algorithms into empathy and data into deeper human connections. No fluff, no buzzwords—just the real wins, messy learnings, and breakthrough moments that separate leaders from followers. These aren't your typical "AI will save us all" stories. They're practical insights on building marketing that genuinely serves people, not just metrics.

events.title: Featured Session: The Innovation Engine You’ve Never Heard of: Your Neighbor
events.description: Traditional corporate innovation keeps ideas locked away until launch, but GE Appliances innovation arm, FirstBuild, has flipped the script—inviting passionate enthusiasts to co-create products from day one. The result is a 93% failure rate that just so happens to drive million-dollar successes like the Opal Nugget Ice Maker, which raised $2.7 million in crowdfunding after the community helped shape its development. This session will explore how major corporations can harness the power of co-creation, where rough transparency builds more trust than polished presentations, and where your best product ideas might come from a Reddit user with a 3D printer. Learn how FirstBuild proves that building in public, failing fast, and letting communities vote with their wallets creates better products than closed-door development—and why the future of innovation looks less like a pipeline and more like a playground.

events.title: Future Relic: Failures, Disasters, Detours, and How I Made a Career as an Artist
events.description:
“Inspiration is for amateurs. I’m a professional artist: I wake up every day and go to work.”

This is the mindset that transformed Daniel Arsham from a student scraping by in his Brooklyn studio into one of the most sought-after artists of his generation. In Future Relic, he breaks through the mystique of the art world and shows what it really takes to make it in any creative endeavor.  

He'll discuss the art of the grind: how to run a creative business and why surrounding yourself with ambitious, successful people is non-negotiable.

events.title: How AI Systems Will Make Brands More Human
events.description: As technology has evolved—from mass media to digital to social—brands have developed new abilities to interact with humans. The real transformation that brands undergo with AI won't be just about efficiency, but rather about showing up in the world in new ways that are adaptive, contextually aware, and authentic. Through recent case studies from Google, we'll explore how brands are embedding human creativity into AI systems to enable entirely new forms of human-brand interaction—and why this shift demands a fundamentally different approach to creativity.

speakers.name: Suzana Apelbaum
speakers.title: Head of Creative and Innovation, Google Media Lab Global

events.title: How Sleep Sounds & AI Detect Sickness Days Early
events.description: What if your breathing patterns could warn you that you are getting sick days before you have noticeable respiratory illness symptoms? The answer lies in sleep audio analysis powered by AI. This session explores how new advances can help us detect patterns far before our bodies notice. Sound is passive, honest, and scalable, and with AI trained on 3B nights of data, it can turn every bedroom into a node in an early-warning health network. AI has the power to turn sleep audio into a new public health infrastructure: one that listens, learns, and helps us act before symptoms even appear.

events.title: The Human Firewall: Nurses Defending Patients in the Age of AI
events.description:
Nurses are the canary in the coal mine of our healthcare system, witnessing firsthand how AI, predictive analytics, and corporate data systems reshape patient care. As powerful tech firms like Palantir move into healthcare, access to sensitive patient data is expanding rapidly—often without meaningful oversight from the people responsible for patient safety. 
Nurses see the real-world consequences of these tools long before the public does. Across the country, nurses are organizing unions to ensure these technologies are used ethically and responsibly. In Austin, nurses formed the city’s first private-sector union hospital to challenge unsafe conditions and demand accountability. This panel explores why collective nurse organizing is essential to protecting patients—and how frontline workers are fighting to ensure healthcare’s AI future remains human-centered.

events.title: The Measurement Gap: Why Clicks No Longer Matter (And What Does)
events.description:
Your marketing dashboard is likely missing half the story. Impressions, clicks, and keyword rankings were built for a world where Google sent traffic to websites. When 60% of searches end in AI-generated answers without clicks, those metrics don't fully connect to revenue. AI traffic from platforms like ChatGPT and Perplexity is already converting at 4-5x the rate of traditional search for some brands — but most marketing teams can't see it, let alone measure it.

This session introduces the measurement framework for AI-first marketing: answer share (how often you appear in AI responses), citation rate (how often you're referenced as a source), and AI-driven conversions (revenue from users who never clicked a traditional link). We'll discuss how to design attribution experiments that prove impact, connect your brand’s AI visibility to actual business outcomes, and build an executive dashboard that ties AI performance to revenue.

events.title: The NDA Economy: How Corporations Use Silence as Infrastructure
events.description: The weaponization of NDAs is a core structural feature of the economy that shapes corporate culture. Using cases from My NDA (World Premiering at SXSW 2026), panelists will expose how NDAs are used to protect brands; enable discrimination, harassment, and corruption to go unchecked; and destroy the careers of whistleblowers who risk everything to speak out. Panelists (including two anonymous participants of the film) will also discuss what an ethical NDA looks like and the simple legislative fixes that can solve this problem.

events.title: Print’s Edge in a Culture of Immediacy
events.description: As digital immediacy accelerates creative output and reshapes our ideas of design quality, questions of intention and integrity are more urgent than ever. This session examines how print media—with its deliberate design and intentional editorial standards—offers a model for clearer communication and higher-quality work. We’ll explore how analog formats encourage depth, accountability, and thoughtful creativity in an era obsessed with speed.

events.title: Resistance, Resilience, and Reality: The Fight for Trans Equality
events.description: In the wake of a steep rise in anti-trans legislation and hostile rhetoric, how can we protect our communities and fight for a better future? Join leading trans advocates as they report from the frontlines—a teacher navigating classroom censorship, a lawyer challenging discriminatory laws, and an organizer educating the public while building community. Moderated by a long-time legislative staffer, this panel will explore what it takes to fight from the inside and survey the political realities in Texas. How is anti-trans legislation reshaping the lives of trans folks and the broader community? What does the path to equality look like, and what can we do to move in that direction? Get the facts and leave with actionable steps.

events.title: Safety and Security in the Age of AI Autonomy
events.description: We’re entering an era where AI doesn’t just answer questions—it takes action. From calendar scheduling to full-stack coding, agentic systems are gaining autonomy, unlocking powerful capabilities and introducing novel risks. How do we secure systems that can act on our behalf? Who’s accountable when they fail? In this presentation, Dhamani and Engler, co-authors of the bestselling book Introduction to Generative AI, explore the future of safety, security, and human oversight in a world where AI systems don’t just assist us—they act for us.

events.title: Smarter Together: The Cognitive Toolkit for Better AI
events.description: As AI reshapes how we think, feel, and decide, this workshop explores how marketers, researchers, and creators can design more human-centered AI systems. Blending neuroscience, behavioral science, and real-world case studies, we’ll unpack the psychology behind trust, emotion, and collaboration in AI. Participants will leave with a framework for building AI that enhances—not replaces—human insight, helping teams navigate this new era with curiosity, empathy, and practical wisdom.

speakers.name: Manuel Garcia Garcia

events.title: Texas Video Game Industry Meet Up
events.description:
From Doom and Age of Empires to Words With Friends and Metroid Prime, Texas has produced some of the most iconic games in the world. Home to the 3rd largest video game industry in the U.S., Texas is a powerhouse of talent — and with expanded state support, including cash grants, there’s never been a better time to work in TX-made games.
Join fellow game makers and fans to explore how we can continue to grow and strengthen our industry together. Whether you're a seasoned pro or just getting started, this meet-up is your chance to network, share ideas, and celebrate everything made in Texas

events.title: Why the Midwest Wins: Where Innovation Takes Off
events.description: High-growth companies are increasingly choosing mid-sized tech hubs for talent, R&D strength, collaboration, and capital efficiency. This panel explores the rise of “opportunity-driven ecosystems,” using Ann Arbor as a case study in how cities punch above their weight in mobility, life sciences, AI, and advanced manufacturing. Hear why founders, innovators, and global R&D leaders choose regions like Ann Arbor—and what these ecosystems get right for building, scaling, and investing.

This experience invites artists and attendees to recharge with XOT Energy while connecting through music, culture, and movement. Blending vibrant fruits and high-energy moments, the XOT Energy House becomes a hub for discovery, expression, and inspiration throughout SXSW.

events.title: Anima
events.description: After being let go from her robotic companion start-up, Beck, an anti-social engineer, finds herself in the offices of a new company claiming to preserve a person's consciousness inside a cloud system. Her first assignment: drive the company's most valuable client, Paul, a lonely button manufacturer, to his final appointment.

events.title: Noah Kahan: Out of Body
events.description: As a career-defining chapter propels him into global stardom, musician Noah Kahan stands at a crossroads. In the wake of the breakout success of Stick Season—an album born from the quiet of rural Vermont and embraced around the world—Noah begins work on his follow-up album while facing the mounting pressure of what comes next. Over a whirlwind year of sold-out tours and unprecedented acclaim, he returns to his Vermont roots and family. Buoyed by his uncanny wit, he searches for a sense of home and creative inspiration as he confronts the deeply personal struggles that have left him out of sync with himself.

events.title: #WhileBlack
events.description: #WhileBlack is an urgent documentary that centers on one of the most viral videos of our time: George Floyd’s murder, seen 1.4 billion times in 12 days, sparking protests in over 2,000 cities worldwide. With exclusive access to Darnella Frazier and others like  Diamond Reynolds, who livestreamed Philando Castile’s killing, the film reveals how social platforms and corporations profit from viral Black trauma, while survivors endure lasting psychological and physical danger. #WhileBlack is a powerful meditation on modern witnessing, exposing the human cost of viral footage while asking urgent questions about race, technology, and accountability.

events.title: Beyond Checkpoints: Immunotherapy’s Next Act
events.description: Checkpoint inhibitors opened the door; now a new wave of immunotherapy discoveries is poised to turn more cancers into curable diseases. MD Anderson’s Nobel Laureate James Allison – inventor of the first immune checkpoint inhibitor – and immunotherapy pioneer Padmanee Sharma sit down with 21-year, stage-IV cancer survivor Sharon Belvin and veteran TIME journalist Alice Park to chart where the science goes next and what still blocks its path. Attendees will learn how immunotherapy advances are changing the cancer landscape, including technologies to watch and a candid look at obstacles ahead.

Discover how rigorously boundary testing AI in life-or-death situations—where seconds save lives—reveals critical truths for AI safety. Unpack "good friction" and essential controls to prevent harmful AI, including automation bias. Learn frameworks for responsible human-AI collaboration applicable across any industry, building AI you can stake your life on.

events.title: Designing for Fandom: Where Brand Meets Belonging
events.description: Fandoms aren’t audiences; they’re communities. And communities thrive on meaning, identity, and emotion. This panel explores how brands use design to speak the language of fans and build deep cultural connections. From anime to gaming to pop culture collabs, motion mnemonics, and type systems inspired by subculture, we’ll unpack how visual identity becomes a tool for trust, transformation, and belonging. When done right, design doesn’t just sell, it unites.

events.title: Featured Session: David Pogue on Apple’s First 50 Years
events.description: As Apple enters its second half-century, author David Pogue (“Apple: The First 50 Years”) explores the throughlines of Apple’s astonishing success: simplicity, beauty, elegant design, making the whole widget, focus on very few products, and a deep commitment to the customer experience. He’ll be joined by a special guest to share stories and insights from their decades of launching iconic products.

events.title: Featured Session: From Pilot to Payoff: 7 Pattern-Matched Traits of AI Systems That Actually Work
events.description: Most companies are stuck in “pilot purgatory” with AI. What separates the experiments that stall from the projects that scale? Drawing on research across 450+ companies, Sandy Carter reveals the five common traits that turn AI pilots into ROI-driven successes. Walk away with a roadmap you can apply immediately—whether you’re a startup founder or a Fortune 100 executive.

From the NBA’s digital court activations to Fortnite’s immersive events and EA Sports’ evolving cultural platform, the lines between sport and play are blurring fast. This panel explores how gaming is reshaping how fans engage with sport, not just watching, but emulating, remixing, and co-creating it. The future of global sport is interactive, creator-powered, and playable.

This panel explores how behavioral UX, gamification, and human-centered design can destigmatize what used to be off-limits. From intimacy apps to investing platforms, discover how intentional design is helping users navigate vulnerable moments with confidence. Hear from sex educator Shan Boodram, Alinea’s Gen Z fintech founder Anam Lakhani, Bloomberg’s Riley Griffin, and Play Ventures’ Phylicia Koh—one of few female investors in gaming VC—on how intentional UX is turning discomfort into discovery.

events.title: The Next AI Revolution: From Cloud to Local
events.description: AI adoption is growing, but cloud-based AI is hitting limits like high costs, privacy concerns, environmental damage, & latency issues. This session will explore why the next generation of AI will be specialized, expert, & local. Panelists will unpack how on-device AI can deliver improved performance, privacy, & scalability with a more sustainable infrastructure. They’ll share how local AI is changing businesses, reshaping privacy expectations, and shifting the global tech landscape - and the next steps the industry has to take to make the use of local AI widespread.

events.description: Sober Space is a welcoming gathering place for people in all forms of recovery during SXSW 2026. This space hosts all-format recovery meetings for Friends of Bill and all SXSW attendees who are seeking a supportive meeting environment during the festival. Participants are invited to sit together and share experience, strength, and hope in a confidential, judgment-free setting. Meetings are facilitated by The SIMS Foundation alongside trusted leaders from the recovery community.

events.title: Spinning Out: What It Takes to Build a University Startup
events.description: Research universities sit behind many of the world’s most transformative technologies—but turning discovery into a scalable company remains one of entrepreneurship’s hardest paths. In this panel, three founders who spun their companies out of the University of Michigan share the real story of navigating IP, early capital, team building, market validation, and the “valley of death.” Moderated by a U-M innovation leader, the conversation explores what support matters most, where universities help or hinder, and lessons for founders, investors, and research institutions alike.

speakers.title: Executive Director of Impact Investments & Strategic Alliances

events.title: Technologies of Care: Ritual, Play, & the Future of Wellness
events.description: This interactive talk will explore how artist-led, science-backed immersive experiences can foster emotional expression and wellbeing. Award-winning artists behind Explore Deep and Soul Paint, Sarah Ticho (Hatsumi, XR Health Alliance) and Niki Smit (Monobanda) share tools for co-creating rituals of care through creative health design. Participants will explore emotional mapping, embodiment, and cross-sector collaboration to imagine new pathways for impact across health, art, and education.

events.title: Wishful Thinking
events.description: Julia and Charlie, a volatile couple in Portland, Oregon, are at a loss for how to repair their broken relationship. Julia, an ambitious game designer, and Charlie, a struggling musician working in sound design to pay the bills, are pushed by Julia's friend into attending a couples-therapy seminar run by twin healers, the Tillies, who claim to fix relationships through energy work. The session triggers a karmic universal system that makes the state of their relationship affect the world around them. With earthquakes, the stock market, and entire nations at risk, Charlie and Julia must confront whether their love can survive amidst so much destruction.

events.title: Buzz Screening 8
events.description: A film that everyone is talking about, and audiences need another chance to see it.

events.title: John Maeda Book Signing
events.description: John Maeda will be signing copies of  “How to Speak Machine” at the SXSW Bookstore.

events.title: Poetic License
events.description: "Poetic License" follows Liz a former therapist and soon-to-be empty nester, who relocates to a new town for her husband’s job – a place where she doesn’t know a soul. Her quiet attempt to settle in takes an unexpected turn when she becomes the point of tension between two inseparable best friends and college seniors, Sam and Ari. As their fierce competition for her attention threatens to upend their lives, Liz is pulled into a tangle of longing, self-discovery, and the intoxicating thrill of being truly seen – forcing her to confront the life she’s built and the one she still craves.

events.title: Sender
events.description: Julia was fired three weeks ago. She also got sober three weeks ago. She’s starting over in a suburban rental, and doing a lot of online shopping to help make the space her own, fast. When packages she didn’t order start showing up at her door — a blender, a corkscrew, her signature shade of lipstick — they feel so unnervingly tied to her past that it starts to feel like someone is watching her. The shopping site Smirk denies responsibility. But increasingly paranoid, Julia tumbles down a rabbit hole to find the identity of her anonymous sender.

events.title: Buzz Screening 5
events.description: A film that everyone is talking about, and audiences need another chance to see it.

events.title: Cure for Paranoia
events.description:
Formed in the heart of Dallas but born on the highway, Cure for Paranoia came together during a “doomsday road trip” intended to be their last. Having recently been diagnosed with bipolar paranoid schizophrenia, frontman Cameron McCloud found clarity in a hot-boxed rental car; making music with collaborators Jay Analog and Tomahawk Jonez gave him peace of mind. “He said, ‘this is my cure for paranoia.’ Instantly, everyone’s eyes lit up,” a pivotal realization that cemented the group’s moniker. When the predicted earth-shattering meteor failed to hit, inspiration struck instead. As Jonez recalls, “On the way from Amarillo to Colorado Springs, like eight songs got written.”

Since then, Cure for Paranoia has shared bills with icons ranging from George Clinton & Parliament Funkadelic and Nas to Ludacris and Leon Bridges. Their resume includes stops at SXSW, Fortress Festival, and the NPR Tiny Desk Contest "On The Road" Tour, solidifying their status as festival favorites. While keen to distance themselves from standard regional production, they cultivated a signature "Trippy Soul infused hip hop" sound—a blend prioritized on their anchor project, the Work of A.R.T. EP.
events.venue: Radio Day Stage @ Downright Austin Backyard

events.title: Seahorse
events.description: Nola, a sous chef searching for stability, is barely holding her life together. After a brutal Friday night shift, she crashes her bike and wakes to find her estranged father, Cyrus, now unhoused, standing over her. Taking him in forces long-buried wounds to the surface. As past and present collide, Nola is pulled into a reckoning with grief, forgiveness, and the fragile possibility of repair.

events.title: Stormbound
events.description: Step inside the eye of the storm. "Stormbound" thrusts audiences into the heart of the world’s most powerful hurricanes with breathtaking, never-before-seen footage captured from within. As wind, water, and land collide, the film follows storm chaser Jeff Gammons, who for more than thirty years has pushed closer than anyone else to document every major hurricane to strike the United States. Now tested by a near fatal disease , Gammons continues his pursuit—revealing the personal cost of chasing nature at its most extreme and the larger environmental forces shaping our world. "Stormbound" is a high-stakes, immersive experience that places audiences face-to-face with nature at its most powerful.

events.title: Summer 2000: The X-Cetra Story
events.description: In the summer of 2000, four pre-teen friends formed a band called X-Cetra and burned a homemade album onto a few CD-Rs. The following year, consumed by adolescent concerns of boys and drug store shoplifting, their labor of love was quickly forgotten.... Until 20 years later, when someone uploaded it online. At first, it garnered a small base of outsider-art fans, but soon it was discovered by record labels, sampled by mainstream artists, and eventually the subject of a Rolling Stone article. With their teen dreams of pop stardom coming true decades later, X-Cetra reunites to see if they can rekindle the unselfconscious girlhood they’d captured in the album those many years ago.

events.description: Three people bound by non-disclosure agreements face extreme personal risk to expose how a simple intellectual property contract is weaponized to silence, manipulate and control.

events.title: The Snake
events.description: When Jamie, ungovernable 40 something wild child collides with her venomous mother Anne, her life blows up spectacularly leaving her evicted and single. This sends Jamie on a pig in a hurricane journey for “home”; breaking into her Nana’s house to prove it should be hers, a rejected bid to move in with her van dwelling punk rock ex, and a stint in her best friends pied a terre, which ends with Jamie hooking up with her husband.

events.title: Fifteen
events.description: Set in Mexico City, Fifteen reimagines the iconic quinceañera as a chaotic mix of comedy and creature horror. Through Mayte and Ligia’s unbreakable bond, the film explores class divides, the illusions of adolescence, and the fear of growing up—wrapped in kitsch aesthetics, blood-soaked humor, and biting social critique.

events.title: Fifteen
events.description: Set in Mexico City, Fifteen reimagines the iconic quinceañera as a chaotic mix of comedy and creature horror. Through Mayte and Ligia’s unbreakable bond, the film explores class divides, the illusions of adolescence, and the fear of growing up—wrapped in kitsch aesthetics, blood-soaked humor, and biting social critique.

events.title: Michigan Innovation Mixer
events.description: Connect with founders, investors, and innovators shaping what’s next in Michigan’s tech ecosystem. Ann Arbor SPARK and Innovation Partnerships at the University of Michigan are bringing together the people building, backing, and scaling companies beyond the coasts. Join us after two SXSW sessions for drinks, conversation, and new connections!

events.title: Lew Apollo
events.description:
Lew Apollo is a rising force in modern soul, captivating audiences with his soul-stirring melodies and poignant songwriting. KUTX praised him as “the perfect summer vibe,” a fitting description for an artist whose music blends hypnotic guitar, cinematic production, and a sultry, smoky voice into lush, resonant soundscapes. Originally hailing from rural Barnum, MN, Lew’s artistry is deeply rooted in his home state’s heritage, fusing the legacies of Bob Dylan and Prince with modern influences like Hozier, Leon Bridges, and Labrinth.
The tragic loss of his father in 2022 profoundly shaped Lew’s songwriting, catalyzing a body of work that confronts themes of grief, isolation, and resilience while offering hope and connection. His debut EP JUNGLE, produced by BLK ODYSSY, introduced him as a bold new voice and fueled a run of sold-out shows at iconic Austin venues like The Pershing and Antone’s.
Since then, Lew has taken his music to wider audiences, touring in support of Los Lonely Boys and earning airplay on KUTX with his single “Diamonds and Gold” as well as “Let the Light In” from his debut album. Self-produced from start to finish, Fool’s Gold has already surpassed 300,000 streams in under two months and is creating buzz for its fearless vulnerability and lush production. Press outlets have echoed the excitement: AMP Music declared “Lew Apollo will be a force in the R&B and pop stratospheres. Be warned,” while Earmilk praised how “Apollo’s signature smoky voice sets the tone for a sultry soundscape.” With his clear vision and unwavering dedication to using music as a vessel for healing, Lew Apollo is quickly emerging as one of the most exciting new voices to watch in soul.
events.venue: Radio Day Stage @ Downright Austin Backyard

events.title: Film & TV Industry Happy Hour
events.description: Come network with film and TV industry members at our SXSW Happy Hour! Louisville, Kentucky knows how to roll out the red carpet for one-of-a-kind experiences – and that includes your next production! Home to a 30-35% refundable film incentive, our city offers diverse locations, experienced crew, and established vendors. The Louisville Film Office is here to help you navigate our incentives, connect you to our vast local resources, and ensure your production’s success in the Bluegrass State.

events.title: Gus Baldwin & The Sketch
events.description: Gus Baldwin is a singer/songwriter/ex-hippie/part-time punk from Austin, TX. After a stint holding down drums for Dallas surf punks Sealion in high school, Baldwin went on to form the Psych Pop combo Acid Carousel, which he led for 6 years and 20 something releases before departing the band. Moving to Austin, Baldwin started quickly self releasing a string of singles and EPs on his own GetWithIt! Imprint and establishing himself as the godson of Texas Rock n Roll. Teaming up with former bandmates and friends Gus formed The Sketch in 2022. Embracing the aggression of dirty punk, the looseness of garage, and the charm of power pop, The Sketch established themselves as new cornerstones of the Austin rock scene. Recording their debut LP with the group in one day of recording in LA in the spring of 2024, “The Sketch” is the culmination of Baldwin’s vision, manifested through the power of The Sketch themselves. In late 2025, Baldwin released his first full length solo LP. With the selt-titled debut, Gus focuses in on his rock n' roll stylings, while at the same time showing great versatility as a songwriter. Not being afraid to mix opposite loves of Punk and Pop into one cohesive album.
events.venue: Radio Day Stage @ Downright Austin Backyard

events.title: Serling
events.description: "Serling" is an immersive first-person journey exploring the life and legacy of one of television’s most visionary storytellers, Rod Serling. Told almost entirely in Serling’s own words, drawn from never-before-heard recordings and personal dictations, the film captures the man behind "The Twilight Zone" in all his complexity. The film weaves archival material with atmospheric recreations that echo the eerie visual language Serling made iconic. As his unmistakable voice guides us, Serling emerges not only as a master of storytelling, but as a man grappling with the trauma of war, the moral compromises of fame, and the hope that America might one day live up to its own ideals.

events.title: Apolo
events.description: "Apolo" follows the journey of a family formed by a transgender couple, revealing the nuances of love, daily life, and the constant struggle for recognition and respect. The documentary offers an intimate look into their family dynamics, inviting us to rethink our notions of affection, care, and society itself. As we accompany Apolo’s pregnancy, we are led to reflect on the challenges and dramas faced by the couple — Isis Broken and Lourenzo Gabriel. The father is the one giving birth, and society is not yet ready for that reality. The feature-length documentary marks the directorial debut of actress Tainá Müller and trans woman and musician Isis Broken.

events.title: Campeón Gabacho
events.description: Campeón Gabacho tells the story of Liborio, an endearing and mischievous young migrant whose only talent is taking punches. He crosses the Rio Grande to escape a harsh reality in Mexico, looking for a better life in the United States, and settles in a Latino barrio in New York City. Through his fists, his love, and his words, he faces cultural walls and prejudices that threaten his hopes, and becomes a hero in an unknown land.

events.title: Cornbread Mafia
events.description:
The unbelievable true story of the Cornbread Mafia, a group of Kentucky farmers who built the largest domestic marijuana syndicate in U.S. history. Sons of tobacco farmers, moonshiners, and bootleggers, they turned to pot to keep their families fed.  

What followed was straight out of Kentucky folklore: lion cubs on the farm, backroad police chases, and a code of silence that baffled prosecutors. Part true crime and part cartoon, the film blends community, the War on Drugs, and a whole lot of weed with the humor and heart of the folks who lived it.

events.title: First They Came for My College
events.description: On January 6, 2023, Republican Governor Ron DeSantis enacted a right-wing takeover of a public university called New College of Florida, targeting both its culture and unique academic program for an ultra-conservative makeover. Resistance is immediate, but the campus descends into chaos as powerful political actors make sweeping changes. Caught up in the mix are a group of intellectually curious young people from all sides of the political spectrum intent on completing their studies at New College, which has suddenly become ground zero in the culture wars.
events.venue: Rollins Theatre at the Long Center

events.title: He Bled Neon
events.description: After learning his brother’s death may be murder, Ethan returns to Las Vegas to uncover the truth, and confront the violent past he buried. Once a street kid, he’s now living the good life in L.A., engaged to his dream girl and working for her father’s real estate firm. But when he gets a text saying his brother overdosed, the promise he made to never return home shatters, pulling him back into the world he thought he’d escaped.

events.title: Los Lobos Native Sons
events.description: "Los Lobos Native Sons" is the definitive, authorized chronicle of one of America’s most enduring, genre-defying bands. Tracing Los Lobos’ rise from East L.A. streets to global acclaim, the film offers unprecedented access to their archives and an intimate look at the brotherhood driving their journey. Through electrifying performances and candid interviews—with Linda Ronstadt, Rubén Blades, Tom Waits, Dolores Huerta, Danny Elfman, Jackson Browne, Cheech Marin, Edward James Olmos, Peter Frampton, George Lopez, Bonnie Raitt, and more, the film celebrates their legacy as cultural trailblazers blending rock, roots, and Mexican traditions into a sound uniquely their own.

events.title: Los Lobos Native Sons

Tracing Los Lobos’ rise from East L.A. streets to global acclaim, the film offers unprecedented access to their archives and an intimate look at the brotherhood driving their journey.
