events.title: Tokyo Joshi Pro Wrestling TEXAS STAMPEDE -March 2026
events.description:
TJPW Texas Stampede is a tri-city tour across Austin, Dallas, and Houston featuring 18 star wrestlers from Tokyo Joshi Pro Wrestling, Japan’s premier all-women promotion—the largest overseas event in women’s pro-wrestling history. Driven by the motto “Kawaii × Dream × Strong,” in no other event will you witness a pop idol singing one moment and throwing a dropkick the next.

A super-happy, family-friendly cultural event—bring your friends and kids! In TJPW, All Women Are Heroes!

events.title: Unlocking Her Next Chapter | Food & Nutrition with Dr. Poonam Desai, DO
events.description: Day 3 closes with Dr. Poonam Desai, who will focus on the small, high-impact nutrition and lifestyle shifts that deliver the biggest return on health and longevity. This session will cover what to do—and what to avoid—starting today, including top food priorities, hidden toxin exposures (from water bottles to cleaning products), and simple swaps that reduce toxic load without overwhelm. Dr. Desai will explore longevity through the lens of the lifespan and the decade, from pregnancy and childhood microbiome health to metabolic resilience later in life, helping you identify where your health focus needs a redirect. Grounded in clinical experience, the conversation will cut through wellness noise to offer practical, evidence-based guidance—plus exclusive custom content for attendees to reinforce key takeaways. Dr. Desai is a founder, Longevity Place; double-boarded physician specializing in precision and functional medicine.

events.title: Same Same But Different
events.description: When Rana’s visa application is denied, she faces the reality of returning home to Iran. That is, until Adam – her wealthy boss’s son and her summer fling – proposes a green card wedding. Wrestling with the implications of his offer, Rana enlists help from a questionable shaman, Adam’s pure-hearted mom, and most importantly her two Iranian best friends Nadia and Setareh, who arrive on Cape Cod for a wedding weekend full of opinions, chaos, and drama with their own American boyfriends. Just as total disaster approaches, the three women come together in a transformative moment of acceptance, growth, and coming of age – evolving this weekend into one that will change them all forever.

events.title: Scarlet Girls
events.description: What does it mean to be a woman in a country where abortion is banned in all circumstances? In this lyrical documentary, women and girls speak about the challenges and consequences regarding unsafe abortion in the Dominican Republic.

events.title: Chasing Summer
events.description: After losing both her job and boyfriend, Jamie retreats to her small Texas hometown where friends and flings from a fateful high school summer turn her life upside down.

events.title: Normal (on 35mm)
events.description: The latest collaboration between Bob Odenkirk, "John Wick" creator Derek Kolstad and "Nobody" producer Marc Provissiero, director Ben Wheatley’s kinetic neo-Western stars Odenkirk as an unassuming substitute sheriff with a troubled past who, after moving to a small, sleepy town, responds to a bank robbery and unknowingly uncovers something far more explosive.

events.title: Downbeat
events.description:
Down-on-his-luck drummer Mauro flees a trail of bad decisions and lands on his sister Isa’s couch in Boston. With no money and nowhere to go, he begins busking as a bucket drummer. As playing on the streets brings small wins, he falls back in love with the freedom and pounding momentum that made him chase music in the first place. But Mauro pushes his luck pursuing a secret relationship that endangers his bond with Isa, and bit by bit draws everyone else into his own feral shortcomings.
Set to the rhythms of the street, DOWNBEAT is a raw, high-energy portrait of an artist using music as escape and the collateral damage left behind when movement replaces growth.

events.title: Jack Johnson: SURFILMUSIC
events.description: An intimate look into Jack Johnson’s evolution from surfer to filmmaker to world-renowned musician. The documentary traces how his early years making surf films with close friends became a foundation for a much broader creative life, capturing moments in and out of the water that later surfaced in his songwriting. Blending rare footage from those formative surf films and Johnson's personal and family archives with present-day reflections, the film weaves together how lived experience, friendship, and exploration shaped the sound and stories behind the music.

events.title: Andrea Daniela
events.description:
Andrea Daniela was born to be on stage. A dynamic singer, violinist, dancer, and actor raised in Houston, she blends deep mariachi roots with a fearless, modern edge. Her career has taken her to international stages and acclaimed theatrical productions, earning recognition for both her powerful voice and magnetic presence.

Now based in Austin, Andrea steps into a new era with her debut album “Mariachi Mestiza y Mala Mujer” a bold fusion of mariachi, cumbia, pop, and hip-hop that celebrates culture, duality, womanhood, and self-made artistry. As the founder of Houston’s first all-female mariachi band and the creative force behind her own talent agency, she continues to redefine what mariachi means for the next generation.

events.title: Jacki Daniels
events.description: Jacki Daniels is a Michigan-based, Nashville recording artist known for her powerhouse vocals, magnetic stage presence, and emotionally charged songwriting. In 2025, she was awarded Rising Star of the Year at the Josie Music Awards, the largest independent music awards show in the world, and received four Michigan Music Awards along with the Vehicle City Sound Podcast Fan Favorite Award two years in a row, establishing her as one of pop-country’s most promising new voices. Jacki’s versatility extends well beyond pop-country, with musical roots in rock, folk, a cappella, musical theater, R&B, electronic pop, indie, and classical. She performs everything from intimate solo acoustic sets to full band, high-energy shows, bringing a bold, genre-blending edge to every stage. She is the creator and host of The Jacki Daniels Show and co-host of Singers in the Round, a singer/songwriter showcase highlighting standout talent. Jacki also tours nationally with the Ultimate Kenny Rogers Tribute Show. Check her schedule for upcoming tour dates at www.thejackidanielsshow.com

events.title: KING NO-ONE
events.description:
With a name as regal as their ambition, KNO are reshaping boundaries as they set out to release their debut album in April 2026.

This charismatic trio built their reputation through relentless touring and a catalogue of singles that bristle with both confidence and vulnerability.

Glistening guitar riffs, punchy rhythms and poetic narratives ensure their sound is both urgent and heartfelt.

These narratives are channelled into lyrics that are as revealing as they are relatable.

The songwriting is a testament to their roots. Each track is a vignette of life, steeped in nostalgia, resilience and a yearning to belong. It’s music that’s as much about catharsis as it is about connection.

First single ‘Transgressions’ is a confessional anthem. Nostalgia and identity are painted vividly in the second single as the band retrace childhood, its warmth underpinning an unflinching honesty.

Yet it’s the title track which lies at the emotional heart of this debut. Empathy is portrayed as both gift and curse, a force that connects deeply to others’ pain, yet at times threatens to overwhelm.

It’s a debut album that’s as unguarded and unflinching as the band themselves, sure to resonate with anyone whose heart has ever felt too full.

events.title: Sonido Cachimbo
events.description:
Sonido Cachimbo is a cumbia project born in Ciudad Juárez, México, and rooted in the lived experience of the Juárez–El Paso border region. Formed in the early 2010s amid a context marked by violence, migration, and social fragmentation, the project transforms those realities into an energetic and celebratory sound grounded in popular dance traditions.

Blending cumbia with elements of rock, punk, and other hybrid influences, Sonido Cachimbo creates music that invites collective joy while carrying the memory and resilience of border communities. Their live performances are known for their high energy, festive atmosphere, and strong connection with diverse audiences on both sides of the border.

The project has released two full-length albums, Tropicumbia Fronteriza (2014) and Fiesta Popular (2017), the latter co-produced by Rodrigo Rojas of the Chilean band Juanafe, and has collaborated with artists such as Clemente Castillo (Jumbo), Edna Nao, and Paulina del Campo. In 2024, Sonido Cachimbo released “Monitor,” a reinterpretation of the song by Volován. The group is currently working on a new EP of original material planned for vinyl release.

events.title: willoh
events.description:
Missouri native willoh is riding the crest of a wave of excitement over her new series of singles leading up to her spring 2026 album release.  On her latest track, EARMILK writes ““OUCHIE” defies easy categorization, blending synth-pop, raw punk attitude, and alt-rock vibes into a shifting, avant-garde sound.”  


Willoh’s self-produced 20205  debut, not more than that, but more please presents us with a raw honesty rendered through snowy vocals that sit in rarefied air and belies the artist’s 19 years. In September she released the labyrinthine “Buckshot” to critical acclaim.

From her home in Springfield, Missouri, willoh records and creates music, having first found her footing on Garageband before graduating to LogicPro–making the upgrade from her earnings working many long shifts at McDonalds.

events.title: Jonathan Paige Brown Jr
events.description:
Jonathan Paige Brown is a singer-songwriter based in Virginia. His foundation in the performing arts began with theater in middle school, followed by extensive ballet training throughout high school and college. He trained at the Richmond Ballet, Appomattox Regional Governor’s School for the Arts and Technology, and the SUNY Purchase Conservatory of Dance. During these years of formal dance training, he also taught himself to play guitar and sing.

Jonathan began performing music full-time at nineteen, with his first gig quickly evolving into a residency. He started writing original material at twenty-six. At twenty-eight, he released his first single, "Divine," followed by his second single, "Gesture," which featured a music video showcasing his first dance project.

His songwriting is rooted in deep self-reflection. Jonathan describes his creative process as stemming from "a point at which my awareness truly stretches over new ground. I feel out the unknown with sound."

events.title: 2026 Film & TV Awards
events.description: Join us to celebrate the winners and standouts at the SXSW Film & TV Festival. The SXSW Film & TV Festival Narrative Feature Competition, Documentary Feature Competition are announced each season during the Film Awards ceremony along with all the Short Film Program winners, which are eligible for Jury Awards within their respective screening categories. Come celebrate these winners with us at the Film & TV Awards.

events.title: CJ CHENIER AND THE RED HOT LOUISIANA BAND
events.description: CJ Chenier is born and raised in an indigenous American culture with its distinct language, cuisine and music. Chenier, a Grammy nominated world renowned musician and recording artist, has performed alongside many internationally recognized artists including his GRAMMY awarded winning father, Clifton Chenier “The King of Zydeco,” Paul Simon, Joe Sample, and Ray Parker, Jr. He appeared on the Jon Stewart Show, CNN, was featured on VH1, and Entertainment Weekly.  He has exhibited his musicianship at many large festival venues such as the New Orleans Jazz and Heritage Festival, Chicago Blues Festival, and Austin SxSW Music Conference. In addition, to a GRAMMY award nomination in the Best Regional Roots Music Album category, C.J has received many major awards inclusive of the Living Blues Critics’Poll Award, India Award (from AFIM) for Best Zydeco Album, Coups de Coeur (Blows of Heart) Blues Category Award from I’Academie Charles Cros (France) and Best of the Beat Best Zydeco Album (Offbeat Magazine).

speakers.name: CJ CHENIER AND THE RED HOT LOUISIANA BAND

events.title: Maya Manuela
events.description:
Maya Manuela is an indie-pop artist originally from Duxbury, Massachusetts, raised on an oyster farm before relocating to Nashville in 2019 to pursue music full-time. Her work blends intimate, emotionally precise songwriting with warm, modern production—songs that feel confessional without losing their pop instincts.

In 2023, Maya gained viral traction with her breakout single “Multiverse,” sparking two East Coast tours, festival appearances including Levitate Music Festival and Musicians Corner, and support slots for artists such as Angie McMahon. Her momentum continued with her debut album American Doll (2025), a candid and self-aware body of work that explores desire, disillusionment, and identity with quiet confidence. Named Musicbed’s Artist of the Year in 2025, Maya Manuela has emerged as a compelling new voice in indie pop—equal parts tender, incisive, and unafraid to tell the truth.

events.title: DOSSEY
events.description: DOSSEY started out making squeaky clean pop music in 2017 (NPR’s All Songs Considered actually referred to her in 2018 as “a joyous banquet of roséwave electro-pop”). But by now in 2025, the project has mutated into something brutal, noisy, honest, and unhinged. Motherhood, a slow unspooling of her faith, and the relentless static of American political and social climate have all pushed her toward the genesis of her own brand of dance punk - glitter grunge. So now, DOSSEY’s world hinges on distortion, punk rhythm and anthemic rock vocals influenced by The Clash, Nine Inch Nails and the Yeah Yeah Yeahs.

events.title: Important Group
events.description: Important Group is a very important band from Austin, Texas. You may call it a supergroup that includes members of Being Dead, Punching Bag, They Had So Many Names, Zero Percent APR, and many other side projects. But this is now a main project. Important Group has a repertoire of light-hearted-heartfelt-heart-wrenching songs. Three friends rocking out.

events.title: Sarah Meth
events.venue: British Music Embassy @ Palm Door on Sixth

events.title: Somalia
events.description: omalia is an emerging R&B soul artist from Lithonia, Georgia who has been singing since age 10 and is actively creating her own seat at the table in today’s R&B music scene. Fresh off performing at the 2025 Blavity Fest stage as an Up & Next Artist, she has already opened for icons like 2Chainz, Kelly Price, and Keke Wyatt. A proud Spelman College graduate, Somalia self-funded and curated her own tour, proving her belief in taking control of her artistry and career. Her viral single “Mimosa” has garnered 15K+ views on YouTube, and her 2024 EP "A Soft Place to Land" is available on all streaming platforms. With past performances with the Atlanta BeltLine, Microsoft, Fulton County Arts & Culture, ELEVATE Atlanta, and Six Flags Over Georgia, Somalia continues to captivate audiences with her angelic vocals, dynamic stage presence, and songs that tell stories only she could tell.

events.title: True Jackson
events.description:
True Jackson is an independent artist who blends 90s grunge rock production with an anthemic pop vocal. A native of Los Angeles, True has been embraced by the vibrant New York music scene, having performed at such legendary venues as the Mercury Lounge, Baby’s All Right, and Le Poisson Rouge, to name a few. 
True channels her emotions into catchy hooks and electrifying guitar riffs, painting a clear picture of where she has been and where she’s going with her debut song: “Paint Me”, released in 2024 and featured in the American High film, 'Prom Dates', streaming on Hulu. 
True’s debut EP, RIP TRUE, was released in 2025 and features standouts “Smooth Talking” and “Bad”.  Making music for the crashout girlies, these 4 songs encapsulate struggling with self-doubt and navigating out of her youth into her 20’s, allowing the audience to scream and dance through life, embracing the imperfections instead of sitting in it.
Her follow-up project explores a toxic relationship and how the heroine ultimately regains her power. The project will be released in Spring 2026 with two lead singles coming just before she takes Austin, TX by storm as part of this year’s South by Southwest Festival.

events.title: Water Damage
events.description:
“Arguably the most exciting rock band to emerge from the American experimental underground this decade.” - Grayson Haver Currin, MOJO Magazine 2025

Drones are a powerful force, capable of whisking our thinking mind far, far, away. Austin-based collective Water Damage yields the same power whenever they pick up their instruments. Veterans from other projects (a.o. Swans, more eaze, Spray Paint, USA/Mexico and more), the band is not unfamiliar with the unshakeable power in drones; still, as Water Damage, they stretch out drone’s possibilities to their limits, bowing to the principle ‘Maximal Repetition Minimal Deviation’. Water Damage explore ecstatic oblivion, repeating basic riffs and rhythms until time seems to falter. Once an idea takes off, they pursue it forever; as Pitchfork said, their 2024 double LP ‘In E’ doubles as a “glorious mind eraser”.

events.title: Zeñal Nortex
events.description:
Zeñal Nortex es un grupo de música mexicana. El grupo fue fundado en el año 2022 por su líder, Eliud Garcia junto a el acordeonista Alexis Pérez Aragón. 

La agrupación hace el lanzamiento de su primer disco de estudio titulado “Vamos Por Más” el 27 de Enero del 2023 donde colaboraron con compositores como Rey Rodríguez, reconocido en el género norteño.

Su canción “Ay! Güerita” escrita y producida por Eliud García (vocalista) ha rebasado las 145,000 reproducciones, y temas como el de “Quien Iba a Decirlo” de (Rey Rodríguez) también ha tenido éxito en los números digitales de Spotify y YouTube. 

El más reciente tema de Zeñal Nortex lleva por nombre “El Del X6 ” un corrido que habla sobre la superación del latino, y es parte de una secuencia de corridos “Pa'l Luchon ” y “La Coyote o El Redeye”. 

Nuevo álbum oficialmente anunciado para Marzo 2026. 

For booking: (512) 712-3347
Frontera Chica Music Booking

events.title: Alex Cano
events.description: Alex Cano is a nationally touring Rock/Americana artist hailing from New York’s Hudson Valley. Known for his rich baritone and soaring, gritty rock vocals, Cano’s sound lives at the crossroads of high octane, blues driven rock ’n’ roll and vulnerable Americana balladry. His debut album, Every Rise of the Sun, is a raw chronicle of resilience and survival—equal parts cathartic release and anthemic triumph. Praised by outlets including Paste Magazine and Indie Current for its authenticity and emotional weight, the record established Cano as a voice unafraid to merge heartfelt intimacy with road-tested rock energy. Cano has toured across the US, performing everything from intimate listening rooms to major festivals. He has shared the stage with artists such as Plain White T's, Gin Blossoms, Tyler Bryant and the Shakedown, Band of Heathens, and Chris Barron. Along the way, he’s built a grassroots fanbase bound by a sense of community, connection, and resilience, values that run through all of his work. With a career already marked by resilience, authenticity, and growth, Alex Cano continues to carve his place as one of the most compelling voices in modern Rock/Americana.

events.title: Andrew Cushin
events.description:
Firmly established as an artist’s artist with the likes of Noel Gallagher, Sam Fender, Louis Tomlinson and Pete Doherty.
Andrew Cushin is primed to rise to the next level with the May 2nd release of his second album ‘Love
Is For Everyone’. Building upon his acclaimed debut ‘Waiting For The Rain’. The 2nd album charted in the UK official top 40 album charts.
 Andrew recently teamed up with his local brewery Anarchy Brew Co to create his own L.I.F.E IPA beer,
which is now available from their website. It represents his latest brand collaboration after being invited to headline
The Soundcheck, the debut live event from the Aston Martin Aramco Formula One team, late last year. Andrew has played Italian, Dutch and British GP with Aston Martin F1 team in 2025.
Andrew toured the full UK headline in May and October 2025 as well as EU . He is currently on his 3rd successive year of touring North American/Canada headline tour.
In October 25th 2025 Andrew Cushin sold out his hometown show at Newcastle City Hall in front of 2500 fans.
2025 has been a huge success for Andrew Cushin breaking through the top 40 and now firmly establishing himself as a firm favourite in the UK live scene.
events.venue: British Music Embassy @ Palm Door on Sixth Patio

events.title: Solarrio
events.description:
David Barenboim, known artistically as Solarrio, whose journey reflects an eclectic combination of cultural influences and the pursuit of musical innovation. Born into a family immersed in classical music, David's early life was marked by a growing fascination with pop, hip-hop, and electronic music.

Growing up between Paris, Chicago and Berlin, David found himself drawn to pop and electronic music, genres that would later define his work.

Solarrio’s debut album "All the Wrong Places," released in 2024, is a culmination of his experiences and musical evolution. The album, characterized by its upbeat, fun-loving vibe, still carries the emotional depth. His next album "Toxicology" is slated for a Fall 2025 release, including tracks like "That's Not Me" and "So Many Questions".

From classical music to a pop music innovator, his journey is a testament to the power of embracing change and staying true to one's artistic vision.

events.title: Rafa Parra
events.description:
Rafa Parra, cantautor/productor originario de la Ciudad de México. Experimentando con nuevas formas de expresión dentro del pop urbano, mezclando letras románticas con ritmos irresistibles como el dembow y el merenguetón. Su estilo fresco y
emocional invita tanto a bailar como a enamorarse.
Con canciones como “A Besos Si” y “Olaya <3”, Rafa ha comenzado a llamar la atención por su forma única
de contar historias de amor con flow, ritmo y mucha sensibilidad. Su música suena a momentos reales:
mensajes no enviados, fiestas que terminan en confesiones y corazones que laten más fuerte.
Rafa crea canciones que se sienten cercanas, con hooks pegajosos y melodías que se quedan en la
cabeza. Su propuesta es emocional y pensada para conectar con quienes viven el amor con intensidad,
entre el reggaetón lento y las composiciones.

events.title: Reilly Downes
events.description:
Reilly Downes is a torchbearer of modern heartbreak, blending rustbelt grit with cosmic country soul. Hailing from Texas and now rooted in the Chicago music scene, she’s made a name for herself with her “small, but mighty” voice and songs that cut to the bone. Downes has shared the stage with artists like Maggie Rose, Kaitlin Butts, and Jaime Wyatt, and has been featured in Rollingstone.

With a background in both the Americana and indie circuits, Reilly delivers raw, emotionally charged performances with her band, The Acid Cowboys. Her songs, like sad polaroids of  love and loss, explore themes of queer identity, grief, and survival.

She is currently in the process of recording her sophomore album with executive production by Jaime Wyatt who has worked alongside Butch Walker, Shooter Jennings, The Black Pumas, and more.

events.title: CorMae
events.description: CorMae started as a social media ad and a dream and now has evolved into an up and coming punk and riot grrrl inspired band. The band started in February 2024, and has been steadily making its way into the Austin music scene ever since. Starting with a pop-forward garage rock EP, Cutie Core, released in April of 2025 and ending last year with a bang in October 2025 with the release of their more punk-forward EP “Hot Damn!” and an extra bonus punkified cover of Sheb Woolley’s “Purple People Eater,” CorMae are swiftly becoming an Austin Punk mainstay. The band are nominated by the Austin Chronicle for ATX’s 2025 Best Punk Band and you may also know them from opening shows for the likes of Of Montreal, Murder City Devils, and Pretty Girls Make Graves in 2025. CorMae’s songs are written about life, love, social, and economic struggles and their live show is aimed at commiserating on these issues with the audience. CorMae aims to build a community of friends and fans of all ages, creeds, races, and genders. After all, who doesn’t need a little cathartic shouting or a little dancing every once in a while?

events.title: Dub Gideon
events.description: The Dub Gideon Band was founded in 2009 on the west side of San Antonio, Texas by a group of young men who were deeply inspired by Bob Marley and the spirit of RastafarI.  After the release of their first EP in 2011, titled "Underworld EP in Dub", and the follow up EP "Live in Love" (2012), the band quickly became a staple at all Reggae events around Central Texas and established itself as a force to be recognized.  Always rooted in the dub tradition, the band started to become a backing outfit for artists in the area who they felt needed a platform to perform their music.  The band has backed amazing Texas, international, and Jamaican talent alike such as Likkle Shanx, Alika, Chris Boomer, Teki, Dre Z Melodi, Mister Kali, General Smiley (Michigan and Smiley), Admiral Tibet, Warrior king, Tristan Palma, Spiritual, Luciano, and so many more. Currently based in Austin, the band has re-emerged with a collection of some of Austin's finest Reggae musicians alongside original members from San Antonio.   More than a band, Dub Gideon is a concept, and a force in the world of Reggae Music committed to upholding the true integrity of Roots and Culture Dub Music

events.title: Miguel Ortiz y El Nuevo Estilo
events.description: Miguel Ortiz, nacido y criado en la ciudad de Austin Texas la capital de la música. De padres originarios de la cuna de la independencia nacional, Dolores Hidalgo Guanajuato. Vendió pan y chicles de niño para apoyar a sus padres económicamente. Desde joven edad el interés por la música se le notaba a este joven talento. Lo miraban imitando a uno de sus ídolos de la infancia, a José Guadalupe esparza. “Mi padre tenía un CD de bronco, recuerdo que la primera vez que lo escuche junto a el, fue algo inexplicable. Me enamore de cada tema, sentí algo tan bonito que no podia explicar; simplemente quise replicar lo que yo sentí al escucharlos a ellos, pero con mis temas. Las canciones del grupo bronco y mi padre fueron una gran inspiración para mi. Por mi padre, y por la música de Bronco hago música hoy”, dijo Miguel en una entrevista. Recibió su primer guitarra como un obsequio de su padre cuya única condición fue que aprendiera a tocar. Empezó a tocar la guitarra a los catorce años de edad. Miguel noto que el arte de componer se le dio muy naturalmente, y desde entonces a compuesto cada tema que saca. Hoy viene con un estilo único y fresco ofreciéndoles temas originales de su puño y alma

speakers.name: Miguel Ortiz y El Nuevo Estilo

events.title: Summer of ’94
events.description: "Summer of ’94" reveals the wild rise of the U.S. Men’s National Team on the road to the 1994 World Cup—and the history they were never meant to make. With no league and no roadmap, a ragtag group of players and an unlikely coach endured a grueling two-year training camp, hoping simply not to embarrass their nation at the first-ever World Cup on American soil. Armed with camcorders, the players documented it all, capturing raw moments as underdogs grew into future legends. Featuring never-before-seen footage and new interviews with Alexi Lalas, Cobi Jones, Tony Meola, and coach Bora Milutinović, the film shares how chaos, chemistry, and grit forged a brotherhood that changed US soccer forever.

events.title: SWDEJAY
events.description:
SWDEJAY (Southwest Ejay) is a first-generation Mexican-American DJ from Southwest Detroit, deeply rooted in the city’s rich musical legacy. Known for his high-energy, open-format style, he seamlessly blends Latin House, Reggaeton, Dembow, Baile Funk, and Ghetto Tech — reflecting both his heritage and Detroit’s forward-thinking sound.

As the curator of Fiesta House, he has played a key role in shaping Detroit’s Global Latin club scene, holding multiple residencies at some of the city’s top nightlife venues while building a cultural bridge between Detroit and the world. His sound has reached international dance floors through performances and productions in Paris, Berlin, London, Chicago, Guadalajara, and Mexico City.

A true ambassador of global music, SWDEJAY continues pushing boundaries — bringing Detroit energy, Latin rhythm, and worldwide club culture together wherever he plays.

events.title: Timothy Howls
events.description:
Timothy Howls is the solo project of Tim Lopez, a Santa Barbara-born, Austin-based singer, songwriter, 
multi-instrumentalist, and producer. Lopez is best known as a member of the band Plain White T's, with 
whom he achieved multiplatinum success and received two GRAMMY Award nominations.
In 2021, during the COVID-19 pandemic, Lopez embarked on a solo endeavor under the moniker 
Timothy Howls, marking a shift in his musical style. He released his debut EP, The Rubble, which blends 
introspective singer-songwriter elements with classic and Americana rock influences. Notably, the single 
"Lightning from the Blue Sky" was produced by Adrian Quesada of Black Pumas and mixed by Jim Eno of 
Spoon.
Building on this, Lopez has also explored country music, incorporating its storytelling and melodic 
elements into his evolving sound. The name "Timothy Howls" was inspired by the Latin meaning of 
"Lopez," which translates to "wolf," symbolizing his personal and musical evolution.
Through Timothy Howls, Lopez continues to explore new creative avenues, offering a fresh perspective 
on his musical journey that now embraces a mix of indie, rock, and country influences

events.title: Louie Lee
events.description: Change doesn’t ask for permission; it disrupts and transforms. For Louie Lee, this truth began early. Growing up in a trailer park outside Detroit, he witnessed his mother working three jobs to make ends meet, instilling in him an unyielding work ethic. Battling a hearing impairment while soaking in the diverse sounds of metal, hip hop, rock, pop, and country, music became his escape and means of expression. The loss of his grandfather marked a turning point, igniting a new honesty in his songwriting that earned him Song of the Year at the Detroit Music Awards in 2022. Louie Lee's unique sound, labeled Country Hop & Roll, combines modern 808 basslines with country twang, crafting music that feels both grounded and dynamic. His lyrics delve into rarely explored emotional territories, balancing high-energy anthems with heartfelt ballads. Louie’s live performances forge deep connections with audiences, transforming shows into communal experiences where fans actively participate. As a storyteller, Louie is reshaping country music’s landscape, inviting non-country listeners to the genre while redefining its essence. His journey of creation through truth is just beginning.

events.title: Basic
events.description: After Gloria and Nick break up, Gloria takes us through Nick's dating history, untangling his web of ex-girlfriends through details she can find online. But when she discovers Kaylinn, the hottest most basic ex-girlfriend to ever exist, Gloria not only loses herself, she loses control of the story she's been telling.  Basic is a comedy that blends the magical-realism of jealous paranoia with the magic of falling in love.

events.title: The Tullamarines
events.description:
The amalgamation of four distinct voices from Adelaide, The Tullamarines tell their stories through a shared perspective that feels intimate, honest, and quietly uplifting. Josh, Angus, Benny and Lucinda met on the local gig circuit, quickly bonding over a mutual love of songwriting and collaboration. From those early connections, they’ve crafted a sound that reflects each member’s individual sensibilities - a style they affectionately call cosy-pop.
 
Their songs move through life’s highs and lows with the warmth of an old friend, inviting listeners into their living room, putting the kettle on, and sitting with whatever feeling the day brings. That sense of closeness runs through both their recorded work and their live shows.
 
Having appeared on festival line-ups including Beyond The Valley, Laneway Festival, Spin Off Festival and New Year’s Eve on the Hill, and toured extensively alongside artists such as Old Mervs, The Preatures, Ball Park Music and Alex Lahey, The Tullamarines continue to build a reputation for heartfelt songwriting and deeply human performances.
events.venue: British Music Embassy @ Palm Door on Sixth

events.title: And Her Body Was Never Found
events.description: Mor Cohen and Polaris Banks did the impossible, made a movie with just two people, while camping, with a script based on their real arguments. Most couples would kill each other under those conditions. They were no exception.

events.title: Ben Flournoy
events.description:
I’m Ben Flournoy from Quincy, FL. When I was 10 years old, I saw Marty McFly play Johnny B. Goode in Back To The Future, and the world was never the same to me. 

I got my hands on a guitar and never let go. At 15 years old I decided to dedicate my life to playing the guitar, writing music, touring and living the life of an artist.

I owe a lot to my heroes Stevie Ray Vaughan, B.B. King, Albert King, Jimi Hendrix, Eric Clapton and John Mayer, but I’m here to forge my own path and creating my own sound.

events.title: Joshua Ray Walker
events.description: Joshua Ray Walker is one of Americana’s most arresting new voices. A Texas singer-songwriter whose powerhouse vocals, razor-sharp writing, and magnetic stage presence have earned praise from Rolling Stone, NPR, Billboard, and fans around the world. Known for his humor, heartbreak, and once-in-a-generation vocal range, Walker’s show pulls back the curtain on the characters, places, and moments behind his prolific and acclaimed discography. On stage, he’s warm, hilarious, and disarmingly honest, moving from roaring laughter to pin-drop-quiet confession in a matter of seconds. Joshua Ray Walker’s performances reveal him at his very best: raw, vulnerable, and unforgettable.

events.title: Manhood
events.description: "Manhood" follows Dallas entrepreneur Bill Moore as he attempts to make penis enlargement as commonplace as Botox. Along the way, an OnlyFans star and a father of five put their bodies—and their insecurities—on the line. Blending dark humor with unexpected empathy, "Manhood" examines shame, addiction, and the fragile myths of American masculinity. From Executive Producers World of Wonder ("RuPaul’s Drag Race"), Sheila Nevins ("Real Sex"), Penny Lane ("Hail Satan"), Producer Kerry Mack ("Proof of Concept"), and Director Daniel Lombroso ("White Noise").

events.title: The Shitheads
events.description: Macon Blair's third feature is a raucous and wildly entertaining descent into madness. Dave Franco and O’Shea Jackson Jr. are perfectly (mis)matched as Mark and Davis, the fumbling circumstantial chaperones in charge of transporting the increasingly psychotic Sheridan (a brilliant Mason Thames). Phenomenal supporting turns from Nicholas Braun, Peter Dinklage, and Kiernan Shipka round out the ensemble cast, each more unexpected and bizarre than the last. Blair treats us to his signature absurdist sense of humor and douses it with gasoline and psychedelics, crafting an uncanny world where the worst intentions net the highest yields and the open road is full of Shitheads.

events.title: Drag
events.description: Two sisters with a contentious relationship decide to rob a rural home in upstate New York. The simple robbery turns into a nightmare when one of them throws out her back and becomes immobilized on the second floor. The night spirals out of control as they embark on a painful journey to make it out before the homeowner returns.

events.title: NOA
events.description:
SP
NOA, la nueva cara del Pop Urbano mexa, a sus 21 años, se posiciona como una de las promesas de la escena actual. Es intérprete, compositor y productor musical con formación en instituciones de prestigio internacional como Berklee.
Su sonido es una propuesta distintiva que fusiona la energía del pop estadounidense de 2010 con géneros urbanos y melodías de R&B. Esta versatilidad le ha permitido colaborar con productores ganadores del Grammy y firmar con el sello Cincodoce Music, ademas de presentarse como opening act para artistas como Tito Double P, El Malilla y Bogueto.

EN
NOA, The New Face of Mexican Urban Pop, At 21 years old, NOA is positioning himself as one of the most promising talents in the current scene. He is a singer, songwriter, and music producer with a background in prestigious international institutions such as Berklee College of Music.
His distinctive sound fuses the energy of 2010s U.S. pop with urban genres and R&B melodies. This versatility has allowed him to collaborate with Grammy-winning producers, sign with the label Cincodoce Music, and perform as the opening act for major artists such as Tito Double P, El Malilla, and El Bogueto

events.title: Caleb Michael And The Arrested
events.description:
Caleb Michael And The Arrested formed in 2021, but Caleb had been performing and singing for over a decade. Formed a band as quick as he could and became Caleb Michael And The Arrested. 

By 2022, the band was a local favorite in Denton, Celina, and surrounding areas. The crowds continue to grow and the music has become a high energy Country/ Southern Rock vibe. 

Headlining their first Midwest tour in Summer 2025 has raised their expectations and they have set their sights on some pretty big things in 2026!

events.title: 2026 Film & TV Wrap Party
events.description: Celebrate this year’s Film & TV festival winners at the Film & TV Wrap Party! Live from the Zach Theatre, join us for a spectacular evening guaranteed to be the perfect culmination to this year’s festival.To ensure a safe and enjoyable experience for all our guests we kindly ask that you follow our bag policy for this event. For security reasons only small bags are permitted inside. Large bags, backpacks, and luggage are not allowed.

events.title: Blair Davie
events.description:
Blair Davie is a singer-songwriter from Perth, Scotland.  Inspired by their love of emotional, heartfelt music from artists such as Dodie, 
Dermot Kennedy and Bon Iver, Blair’s music is their way of presenting the most honest and passionate version of themself to the world. 
Their music deals with coming to terms with their own bisexuality, loss and heartbreak; but also, the beauty that life can offer.
events.venue: British Music Embassy @ Palm Door on Sixth Patio

events.title: Dead Eyes
events.description: A firest person horror film. Sean and his fiancée, Grace, enter a remote forest to find Sean’s missing father, Paul, who vanished after the death of his youngest daughter, Lilly. Returning to the site of Lilly’s death forces Sean to confront his inner demons, which begin to materialize externally. Their search takes a terrifying turn, revealing Paul’s secret. He’s been conducting experiments, aimed at resurrecting Lilly. The forest is now inhabited by cannibalistic little girls, each a clone of Lilly, battling to prove their identity as the 'real' Lilly. As Sean and Grace uncover the grim truth, they face terrifying creatures and grapple with unsettling questions about life and death.

events.title: eydrey
events.description:
eydrey is a 26-year-old bilingual artist emerging from the U.S.–Mexico border cities of El Paso, Texas, and Ciudad Juárez, Chihuahua. Shaped by a bi-cultural upbringing, her music reflects the fluid exchange of language, rhythm, and identity that defines the region. Proudly Latina and proudly Mexican, eydrey draws from her roots to create music that reflects both her vulnerability and strength.

Her sound varies across regional mexicano and reggaeton— with bilingual lyrics that explore themes of heartbreak and healing. With a unique sound and a genre-fluid approach to music, eydrey is slowly but surely positioning herself as a compelling voice in the evolving Latin music landscape.

events.title: fifi knifefight
events.description: fifi knifefight is an Austin based glam punk band known for a powerful live presence and raw sound. Blending punk grit with theatrical flair, this is a must-see act for fans of Hole. Fronted by dynamic lead, the eponymous fifi knifefight, their performances often feature driving rhythms, unapologetic lyrics, and an in-your-face style that's intense yet captivating. Tracks like "joanie" and "THE PARTY" showcase their unique mix of emotional depth and defiance. Often found in downtown Austin and recently featured in several local festivals, fifi knifefight continues to make waves in the indie circuits.

events.title: Grupo Salvaje
events.description: Grupo Salvaje is an Austin-based band with deep Mexican roots and over 25 years of musical experience, delivering high-energy performances that ignite dance floors and bring communities together. Known for their cumbias and crowd-moving rhythms, the group proudly represents Mexican and Latin culture through music that connects generations. Drawing from traditional Mexican styles while pushing a vibrant sound, Grupo Salvaje blends cumbias, norteñas, and nonstop dance music into a dynamic live experience. Their versatility and stage presence allow them to adapt effortlessly to any crowd, making every show a celebration.

events.title: Marni Ct.
events.description:
Marni carries a down-to-earth and authentic energy. The indie rock band formed in Los Angeles, California, in 2022, and consists of Nicolas Lara (vocals, guitar), and Michaela Gradstein (vocals, guitar). The project began as Lara’s solo work in Palm Springs, where he released the debut album Whiskey Girl, before evolving into a full band the following year.

Marni intertwines heavy distorted guitars with beautifully soft moments, drawing on influences such as Title Fight, Greet Death, and Hovvdy. Their newest  EP fml era (2025), produced by Corey Coffman of Gleemer, is a portrait of being down on your luck, with unpolished guitars, and emotionally direct storytelling.

events.title: The Peril at Pincer Point
events.description: Jim Baitte, a layabout sound designer desperate to prove himself, is working on a new horror flick from the tyrannical yet lauded b-movie director P.W. Griffin. Accused of lacking vision and creative courage, Jim is sent to the remote island where the film was shot to capture a sound powerful enough to elevate the film's finale. Once there, eerie local fables surface: for years, ambitious and headstrong youth have lost their souls to a ghostly sea captain for his spectral crew. As Jim entangles himself further into the bizarre locals, scenery, and prophecy, he can’t help but ponder the ever-confirming legend, and if recording it might just cost him more than his career.

events.title: SoundMass
events.description:
Sound Mass is an ever-evolving collaboration between Austin’s My Education and Utah’s Theta Naught, celebrated for immersive, cinematic soundscapes and electrifying live performances. Since its inception, the project has captivated audiences with a seamless fusion of post-rock, ambient, classical, and experimental elements, crafting music that is as emotive as it is expansive.

Building on more than a decade of boundary-pushing work, Sound Mass is preparing to unveil a brand-new studio album in 2026, promising bold textures and sweeping arrangements that further refine their signature sound. Their performances at SXSW and beyond showcase the chemistry between these two collectives, offering listeners a transformative, deeply resonant journey through instrumental storytelling.

With a new chapter on the horizon, Sound Mass continues to affirm the power of collaboration and the limitless possibilities of sonic exploration.

events.title: Grind
events.description:
This horror anthology tackles the modern work landscape through four timely perspectives – the hustle culture of an MLM, the endless repetitiveness of a food delivery driver, the online horrors of a content moderator, and the unionization of a familiar-feeling coffee shop. "Grind" shows what it means to be a worker in a world defined by wealth inequality and ruled by endlessly greedy oligarchs, one not so far removed from our own. 

This is a film for anyone who's ever hated their job, had a bad boss, or felt taken advantage of at work. In other words, it's a film for all of us.

events.title: Never After Dark
events.description: A wandering medium, Airi spends her life guiding restless spirits out of the world of the living. Summoned to an isolated country house, she comes face to face with a grotesque apparition with powers that defy Airi’s experience. As she digs deeper into the house’s past, a secret comes to light — and Airi finds herself hunted by a far more unpredictable force. For the first time, her greatest adversary is not the supernatural, but the living.

events.title: Buzz Screening 6
events.description: A film that everyone is talking about, and audiences need another chance to see it.

events.title: The Gasoline Gypsies
events.description:
Crisp harmonies, dual lead guitars, and a rhythm section built on drums, bass, and keys makes up The Gasoline Gypsies. But, their recent exponential growth is born of a work ethic that has earned them the reputation one of the tightest bands in Michigan.
Music built to serve the songs, drawing influence from the roots of rock, folk, bluegrass, and country, The Gasoline Gypsies craft a unique style of Americana Rock; Music painting images of the wonder of nature while engaging thoughtful, and mature poetry, spinning themes that invite us to an understanding of our common human journey. A Gasoline Gypsies show asks us to breathe in all of the world, and exhale a unifying message of realistic hope, celebrating both life’s challenges and joys, reminding us that amid the ebb and flow of life, we are all on this ride together.
The Gasoline Gypsies plugged in can rock large venues. Unplugged they can enchant small rooms.
The Eight time Detroit Music Award winners are feverishly followed by their loyal fan tribe, The Vagabundos. Meet a Vagabundo, and you’ll likely be enchanted by an alchemy that draws together the music, the people, and the family that is The Gasoline Gypsies experience.

events.title: Home Counties
events.description: Home Counties return with their second album 'Humdrum', a sharp, dance-driven evolution produced by Al Doyle of LCD Soundsystem and Hot Chip. Trading guitars for restless grooves and twitchy synths, the band dissect the chaos of modern life with wit and precision. Dual vocalists Will Harrison and Lois Kelly explore jealousy, self-doubt and overthinking across ten hook-laden tracks that balance melancholy and euphoria. Already acclaimed for their electrifying live shows, Humdrum cements Home Counties as one of the UK’s most inventive new bands.
events.venue: British Music Embassy @ Palm Door on Sixth

events.title: Father Romar
events.description:
Romar Daniel, known professionally as FATHER ROMAR—formerly Daddy Dinero and affectionately nicknamed “DAD”—is an American rapper, songwriter, and recording engineer based in Minneapolis, Minnesota. A distinctive voice in hip-hop, he first emerged as one-third of the influential group FREEWIFI, which signed to LA label Rostrum Records in 2016.
FREEWIFI debuted with Connected, followed by FREEQUENCY, featuring Romar’s breakout single “1(800)-ASSS.” The track earned placements on BET Jams and REVOLT TV, helping solidify his reputation as a creative force. The group was also featured by outlets including Sway’s Universe, HipHopDX, and Pigeons & Planes. Their single “Rent’s Due” appeared in Season 2, Episode 2 of Showtime’s The Chi, expanding their reach to national TV audiences.
Musically, ROMAR draws inspiration from Southern rap icons like Lil Wayne, Three 6 Mafia, Mike Jones, J-Kwon, Bone Thugs, and Ludacris. Known for his signature ad-libs—“AHHHHH” and “WHAAATTT”—he blends classic influence with modern innovation. Inspired by artists like A$AP Rocky, he brings bold self-expression through both music and fashion, continuing to evolve from “Daddy” into a boundary-pushing “FATHER.”

events.title: ¿Qiensave?
events.description:
Salinas’ own Cumbia Urbana band, ¿Qiensave?, delivers an infectious fusion of traditional cumbia and modern urban sounds, known for electrifying performances that keep crowds moving. With roots in Michoacán, Mexico, and a home base in Salinas, California, the band has been making waves since 2009, blending cumbia with rock, reggae, and hip-hop while bringing their dynamic live show to stages across the U.S., Mexico, and Colombia.
They gained wider attention with their 2019 debut Mujer, featuring “High Class” and “La Fuga,” and continued their momentum with releases like “Mata De Mota” featuring Tropa Magica, “El DUI” produced by Eduardo Arenas (Chicano Batman), and the fan favorite “Quemayama.” In 2024, they partnered with Grammy-nominated producer El Dusty for the remix album Reanimación and collaborated with Chuck Prophet on Wake The Dead, which hit #1 on the AMA/CDX Americana charts.
Now entering their next chapter, ¿Qiensave? prepares to release their new album Así Las Cosas in summer 2026, led by the single “SED De Tu Amor,” as they continue pushing cumbia forward with a fresh, evolving sound.

events.title: Gus Baldwin & The Sketch
events.description: Gus Baldwin is a singer/songwriter/ex-hippie/part-time punk from Austin, TX. After a stint holding down drums for Dallas surf punks Sealion in high school, Baldwin went on to form the Psych Pop combo Acid Carousel, which he led for 6 years and 20 something releases before departing the band. Moving to Austin, Baldwin started quickly self releasing a string of singles and EPs on his own GetWithIt! Imprint and establishing himself as the godson of Texas Rock n Roll. Teaming up with former bandmates and friends Gus formed The Sketch in 2022. Embracing the aggression of dirty punk, the looseness of garage, and the charm of power pop, The Sketch established themselves as new cornerstones of the Austin rock scene. Recording their debut LP with the group in one day of recording in LA in the spring of 2024, “The Sketch” is the culmination of Baldwin’s vision, manifested through the power of The Sketch themselves. In late 2025, Baldwin released his first full length solo LP. With the selt-titled debut, Gus focuses in on his rock n' roll stylings, while at the same time showing great versatility as a songwriter. Not being afraid to mix opposite loves of Punk and Pop into one cohesive album.

events.title: Luna Tropical
events.description: Luna Tropical is an homage to the cumbias that raised us.  Known for getting asses out of seats with nonstop danceable cumbias, hot accordion and saxophone solos, and dynamic drums, Luna Tropical brings traditional Latin music with a modern flare.

events.title: Minori
events.description:
MINORI out of Kingston Jamaica, dubbed 'Mini from the block', has arrived with a freshness. Tough yet full of soul, she bends Hip Hop, Reggae, RNB, Dub and Dancehall into something different, connecting with people at the core level.
MINORI has been touring Nationally through out the USA since 2021 gracing festival stages such as Reggae Rise Up, Cali Roots, Montana Hemp Fest and opening for internationally acclaimed artists such as Nattali Rize and J-Boog taking audiences by storm with mesmerizing performances. Her epic live show is set on the wings of her masterful lyrical content and powerful vocal talent, winning hearts everywhere she steps.
With her 2021 debut single release RED PILL she pushed Hip Hop / Trip Hop realms amassing attention with her fresh original style.
“Play it loud! I definitely give this one the #RebelMusic stamp of approval. Not often you see this style of lyrical delivery
by a sistren, so it’s very refreshing for me. I’ll be anticipating what else is in store”
- Kabaka Pyramid
"There’s an undeniable presence and power in MINORI’s lyrics and vocal flow"
- Nattali Rize

events.title: The Last Real Circus
events.description:
From Richmond, VA, Jason Farlow & The Last Real Circus craft a raw, soulful blend of Americana and Indie Rock. The project is a musical collective centered on singer-songwriter Jason Farlow, renowned for his energetic stage presence, heartfelt storytelling, and musicianship.
Touring both solo and with his band, Farlow has captivated a loyal following with heartbeat singles like “Nottoway” and “Gypsy Woman.” His sound channels a wide range of influences, from Tom Petty and Joe Cocker to Kings of Leon and Alabama Shakes.
Their rising trajectory has earned them opening slots for an impressive roster of artists, including Jon Russell of The Head and The Heart, Band of Heathens, Blues Traveler, Nicole Atkins, Bones of JR Jones, Devon Gilfillian, Tim Reynolds, Biz Markie, The Sleepwalkers and many others.

events.title: Poiison
events.description:
Poiison is an innovative artist and songwriter from Queens, NY, blending melodic hip-hop, Latin rap, and R&B into a sound uniquely her own. A proud product of New York City, she’s built real momentum—opening for 50 Cent, touring with Shordie Shordie, and completing a 6-city run with Kevin Gates. Her collaborators include Styles P, 2Rare, Fergie Baby, Cash Cobain, and Sha Money XL.

Her musical roots began in church with her mother and were shaped by her sister, a professional drummer. By fifth grade, she was already commanding stages—early signs of the presence she carries today. That spark has grown into a dedicated fan base and touring draw, marking her as an artist with conviction and connection.

In 2025, she released two standout EPs—Pretty Pain and Love Money Art—showcasing her duality: vulnerable yet bold, melodic yet raw. Inspired by icons like Madonna, Sade, Rick James, Lil Wayne, and more, Poiison channels a wide palette into a sound that lives outside the mold.

In 2026, she enters a defining chapter with La Madrina Vol. 2, a project blending originals with standout freestyles over today’s hottest beats — setting the stage for her most impactful year yet.

events.title: Lodri
events.description:
Lodri (Rodrigo Nieves) Venezuelan Producer/Composer based in Austin, currently in his beginnings in the music industry.

Actively involved in the city’s emerging music movement. His sound blends Latin rhythms with electronic influences, creating a fresh and vibrant style that represents the new wave of urban music in Austin.

He has taken part in various local and events, collaborating with artists, collectives, and brands that support the independent music culture.

He brings a strong sense of variety and versatility to his instrumentals.

He experiments with genres such as Afrobeat, Reggaeton and Merenguetón, and has also begun exploring styles like R&B, Tech, and Dembow.

events.title: Chuck Prophet and His Cumbia Shoes
events.description:
Chuck Prophet’s streak of more than a dozen critically acclaimed solo records stretches all the way back to 1990, when the California native first shifted focus from his tenure with pioneering neo-psych band Green on Red to working under his own name. Since then, his songs have appeared in a slew of films and television shows, and his work has been covered by Bruce Springsteen, Solomon Burke, Heart, and a host of others. Rolling Stone dubbed him a “streetwise city kid with an eye for the country,” while Uncut proclaimed him a “renaissance-rocker,” and NPR declared that “no one can turn tales from the outer limits into catchy songs quite like Prophet does.” 

Wake The Dead, Chuck Prophet’s extraordinary new album recorded with ¿Qiensave?, dives headfirst into the world of Cumbia music. The songs are intoxicatingly rhythmic, all but demanding you move your body while you listen. There are flashes of rock and roll, punk, surf, and soul, wrapped up in the rich legacy of a genre that traces its roots back hundreds of years and thousands of miles.

speakers.name: Chuck Prophet and His Cumbia Shoes

events.title: DJ BONES
events.description:
SP
Dj/Productor mexicano y licenciado en negocios de la música que se ha consolidado como una de las propuestas jovenes mas relevantes del país; llegando a hacer mas de 120 shows al año, locales e internacionales.
Actualmente DJ del artista de regional mexicano Tito Double P además de colaborar en eventos con Travis Scott, Young Miko, Cris MJ, Natanael Cano y más. 

EN
Is a Mexican DJ and Producer with a degree in Music Business. 
He has established himself as one of the most relevant and with huge demand emerging talents, performing over 120 shows per year across Mexico and taking part in international tours, achieving global exposure while representing both Mexico and his hometown.
He is currently the official DJ for regional Mexican artist Tito Double P, and has also collaborated on events with artists such as Travis Scott, Young Miko, Cris MJ, Natanael Cano, among others.
With 11 years of experience, Bones stands out for a career defined by talent, a strong musical identity, and remarkable versatility.
Musical Genres: Latin House, Afro House, Reggaeton, Latin & Club Open Format.

events.title: Nattali Rize
events.description:
Nattali Rize is known for high energy, thought provoking and uplifting live performances, the powerhouse international band from Australia & Jamaica channel a deep world & reggae influence to present a one of a kind experience.
With the long awaited sophomore studio album, LIBERATE, released worldwide on March 7th, the Nattali Rize band will be embarking on a global campaign of live shows and opportunities to connect with communities and people around the planet, this powerhouse act will be performing a headline Album Launch Tour in the USA followed by Europe, Australia, Japan and Beyond.
“Nattali is a bright light in the world with a vision that extends beyond the stage.” - Michael Franti
Her global anthem “One People” has amassed over 9 million views on youtube, Nattali and her group continue to connect across borders & waters with many highly acclaimed International festival appearances around the world. “One of the nation’s most refreshing voices” - Rolling Stone
“INFECTIOUS!” - NPR

events.title: Slomo Drags
events.description: Slomo Drags are masters of bouncy indie-rock jams full of gorgeous vocal harmonies and gnarly, angular guitar work. The vibrant music is the perfect trojan horse for wildly irreverent lyrics featuring such characters as The Rich Pervert in the self driving car or The Repeater who corners you on a bar patio and subjects you to a never ending loop of the same three sentences. Slomo is kicking off 2026 with a string of single releases on Spaceflight Records, starting with "Fresh Bread" - a hypnotically catch tune for folks who love paranoia and malaise with their pop.

events.title: Sonora Tukukuy
events.description:
Sonora Tukukuy is a Miami-based music collective, known for its modern take
on roots cumbia rhythms blended with modern sounds fueling Miami’s diverse
community and its permanent growth. Sonora Tukukuy’s fresh approach, combined with the energetic, danceable
nature of cumbia,has helped the genre gain traction at local venues, festivals,
and clubs. They’ve contributed to the resurgence of Latin American folk music in
modern spaces, showing how it can be reinterpreted and made relevant in a
cosmopolitan environment.
Their proposal is enriched by the diverse backgrounds of its members, who come
from various Latin American countries and beyond. This multicultural mix
brings different musical influences, perspectives, and styles into their work,
resulting in a fusion of sounds that appeals to a broad range of audiences. The
band's ability to incorporate various genres and rhythms while maintaining the
core essence of cumbia demonstrates how traditional music can evolve and
connect with contemporary global cultures.

events.title: Drea Dominique
events.description: Born in Long Island, New York and raised in San Diego California, Drea Dominique has the flavor of both coasts. With her smooth R&B voice and fresh twist on the pop sound, Drea Dominique has what it takes to succeed and make an impact in the music world. Drea is garnering a great deal of attention with the release of her singles, "Stutter" and the remixed version with Domino Saints. They are the first of several singles coming from her upcoming project soon to be announced. Drea has also appeared in music videos for some of today’s most high-profile artists. She has done a variety of modeling work, from magazine publications to print ads. Drea is calling Miami, Florida home now and is currently introducing herself to the music industry.

events.title: Enus Sunne
events.description:
SP
Enus Sunne es una figura clave en la evolución de la escena urbana en México. Con más de una década de trayectoria, se ha consolidado como uno de los DJs y productores más completos del país, fusionando versatilidad técnica con una visión empresarial única.
Como CEO y cofundador de Cincodoce, ha transformado la vida nocturna de la CDMX, posicionando el club y su sello discográfico (Cincodoce Music) como referentes internacionales. Su talento lo ha llevado desde el escenario del Coca-Cola Flow Fest hasta clubes emblemáticos en Berlín, Valencia, Montreal y Bogotá.
Más que un DJ, Enus es un curador de experiencias y un visionario que sabe exactamente cómo encender la pista. Su propuesta es, hoy por hoy, un "must" en la escena global.

EN
Enus Sunne, DJ, Producer, and Visionary of the Mexican urban scene.
With a 10-year career, he is the mastermind behind Cincodoce (Club & Music Label) and a benchmark of versatility behind the decks. From Mexico City to the world, he has taken his sound to major stages like Flow Fest and international cities including Berlin and Montreal.

Talent curator and dancefloor architect: Enus Sunne doesn’t just play music—he sets the pulse for what’s next.

events.title: QUIMIKOZ DEL SON
events.description:
QUIMIKOZ IS A LATINO CUMBIA-FUSION BAND BASED IN DALLAS–FORT WORTH, TEXAS,
DELIVERING A HIGH-ENERGY, BARRIO-FORWARD SOUND ROOTED IN TRADITION AND
REIMAGINED FOR TODAY’S AUDIENCES. BLENDING VALLENATO-STYLE ACCORDION MELODIES
WITH AFRO-CUBAN CUMBIA RHYTHMS, REGGAE GROOVES, HIP-HOP INFLUENCES, AND A

CULTURAL EVENTS, MICHELADA FEST FORTH WORTH, CUMBIA NIGHTS AT SUNDANCE SQUARE,
AND OTHER ESTABLISHED COMMUNITY CELEBRATIONS. THEIR 2013 ALBUM QUIMIKOZ 1.0
FEATURES FAN FAVORITES “LLEGÓ LA NEGRA” AND “CUMBIA CAGUAMERA,
” WHILE THEIR 2023

THEIR SONG “LLEGÓ LA NEGRA” IS FEATURED IN THE AMAZON PRIME SERIES SIN HUELLAS,
EXPANDING QUIMIKOZ’S REACH BEYOND THE STAGE. FROM CLUB VENUES AND LARGE OUTDOOR
FESTIVALS TO PRIVATE AND CORPORATE EVENTS, QUIMIKOZ BRINGS RHYTHM, CULTURE, AND
INFECTIOUS ENERGY TO EVERY PERFORMANCE

events.title: Tavo Rayo
events.description:
Tavo Rayo, a south Texas native rising star in the reggaetón and perreo scene, blends infectious rhythms with magnetic stage energy to captivate audiences across the U.S. and Latin America. Known for his dynamic flow and catchy hooks, he’s rapidly gaining momentum carving out a space as a fresh voice in urban Latin music.

With roots deeply planted in the perreo tradition, Tavo Rayo’s sound is a vibrant fusion of old-school reggaetón beats and modern urbano influences, appealing to both traditional fans and a new generation of listeners. His recent singles have garnered notable playlist placements and rave reviews for their authenticity and dancefloor-ready vibe.

Tavo’s live performances are a high-energy experience, blending charismatic interaction with an electrifying presence that commands the stage and ignites crowd participation. As he continues to expand his footprint bringing authentic Latin flavor, undeniable talent, and an engaging performance that leaves audiences wanting more.
